x: Meetra Surik, also known as the Jedi Exile after the Mandalorian Wars, was a legendary female Human Jedi Master. As a Padawan, she chose to disobey the orders of the Jedi High Council and aid the Galactic Republic in its war against the invading Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.
Firmus Piett, a human male native to Axxila, was an Imperial officer who served in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Lumas Etima was a male Human Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Separatist Crisis.

Zorba Desilijic Tiure was a Hutt crime lord and the leader of the Desilijic kajidic. One of few Hutts to possess hair—as a result of a genetic throwback—Zorba was the brother of Jiliac, Ebor, Ziro and Pazda, father of Jabba Desilijic Tiure, and grandfather of Rotta, Gorga and …

Jaster Mereel was a male Human born on the Outer Rim world of Concord Dawn. For years, Mereel served as a Journeyman Protector, one of the planet's respected lawkeepers, until the day when his strong morals led him to kill a corrupt superior officer.

W. Wald was a male Rodian who owned Wald's Parts after Watto passed the business to him on Tatooine and was a childhood friend of Anakin Skywalker when both were young enslaved workers. Wald spoke Huttese.
Mandalore the First was a Taung warrior who conquered a planet that he would name after himself. He and his Taung followers were originally from Coruscant and had settled on Roon.

Jodo Kast was a member of Alliance SpecOps who became a bounty hunter in the time of the Galactic Civil War. Kast wore Mandalorian armor similar to Boba Fett's, though he was not a Mandalorian himself.

Xamuel Lennox was a naval officer who hailed from a line of noble military men. Lennox detested the political maneuvering and betrayals among his colleagues in the Imperial Navy, but he became adept at deception to safeguard his position as captain of the Imperial Star Destroy…
Dannik Jerriko was an Anzati bounty hunter known as the Eater of Luck, and by others as Death.

Ajunta Pall was a male Human Jedi Master and the leader of the Dark Jedi who were exiled from the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic following the Hundred-Year Darkness. Upon his arrival on Korriban, he became the first Dark Lord of the Sith.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Maximilian Veers was a human male who served as a general in the Galactic Empire's army. In that capacity, he fought in the Galactic Civil War, which pitted the Galactic Empire against the Rebel Alliance.
Nahdonnis Praji was a Human male born to the wealthy House Praji on the planet Coruscant during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Kam Nale, also known under the alias "Elan Mak," was a Fluggrian male professional Podracer pilot who flew an outdated Kurtob KRT 410-C around 32 BBY, during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Cody, formerly designated CC-2224, was a male Clone Marshal Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic who commanded the 7th Sky Corps—including its renowned subunit the 212th Attack Battalion—during the Clone Wars.
Appo, whose clone trooper designation was CC-1119, was a clone trooper officer who served as a Clone Sergeant and later as a Clone Commander in the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.

Hal Horn was a Corellian survivor of the Great Jedi Purge who became a noted Corellian Security Force police officer. Born Valin Halcyon, the secret son of Jedi Master Nejaa Halcyon, he was apprenticed to his father, who died shortly after the Clone Wars.

Darth Andeddu, also referred to as the Immortal God-King of Prakith, was an ancient humanoid male who reigned as Dark Lord of the Sith and was dubiously thought of as the forebear of the "Darth" title.

Vix Fonnick was a Rutian Twi'lek Jedi who was the Padawan of the legendary Jedi Master Barnabas Vim. Fonnick wielded an indigo-bladed lightsaber. In 482 BBY, the two traveled to the mysterious world Angcord in search of the Echo Stone.
Kendal Ozzel was a human male officer who served the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire in turn.
Eugene Talmont was the Imperial Prefect of Mos Eisley spaceport. Following in the footsteps of his father, he was constantly assigned to backwater worlds and cities, due to his unremarkable past.
Camie Loneozner was a Human female who was a friend of Luke Skywalker at Anchorhead during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
TK-422 was the designation of a stormtrooper stationed aboard Death Star I during the Galactic Civil War.

During the Clone Wars, Tarkin returned to Republic service, taking a position in the Republic Military and commanding the Republic's efforts to defend Eriadu in the embattled Seswenna and Sluis sectors.
Arca Jeth was an Arkanian male Jedi Master with Sephi blood who served the Galactic Republic as Watchman of the Onderon worlds on behalf of the Jedi Order.

Durga Besadii Tai, self-styled His Great Obesity, the Lord Durga, was a Hutt and the successor of Aruk as head of the Besadii kajidic. Durga served as a vigo in the criminal organization Black Sun for a time, but after the death of the Underlord Xizor, he set out on his own.
Shada D'ukal was a deceptively decorative-looking mercenary from a mysterious militaristic order of female warriors known as the Mistryl Shadow Guard.

Kitster Chanchani Banai was a Human slave boy on Tatooine, and the best friend of Anakin Skywalker. After not seeing his smuggler father, Rakir Banai, in many years, Kitster gave up hopes of being rescued from Tatooine and instead hoped to one day be a majordomo for a wealthy …
Jonash Suul was a Human male who was the firstborn son of Denn Solo and Tira Gama Solo, the twin brother of Tiion Sal-Solo, and the father of Han Solo.

Thire, designated CC-4477, was a clone shock trooper who served as a clone trooper officer in the Coruscant Guard of the Galactic Republic and subsequent Galactic Empire, beginning his military service as a lieutenant in the Guard's diplomatic service branch before eventually …
Whie Malreaux was a Force-sensitive human male Jedi Padawan who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Rugor Nass was a Gungan male who served as the Boss of the Gungan High Council during the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo. At some point, Nass served in the Gungan Grand Army.

Gar Anstak was a Mairan Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Great Sith War. Recently from Maires in the Hapes Consortium, Anstak was shunned by his fellow Mairans, as all Jedi were by the peoples of the Consortium.
Lorana Jinzler was a Human female Jedi Knight, born on the planet Coruscant in 49 BBY, and was the former Padawan of Jedi Master Jorus C'baoth.

Guun Han Saresh was a Twi'lek male Jedi Knight best known for his exploits during the Great Hunt of 3993 BBY. A native of the planet Taris, Saresh was born into a rich and powerful family with a history of Force-sensitivity.
Salacious B. Crumb was a male Kowakian monkey-lizard who worked as a jester in the court of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure during the Galactic Civil War.
Evan Asani was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order.
Mammon Hoole, also known as (Indeterminate) Hoole after he dropped his first name, was a male Shi'ido from Sh'shuun.
Jorallen was a dark-haired Human male. A Jedi Knight with a dark past, he met Danni Quee during the Yuuzhan Vong War.

Rokur Gepta was a Force-sensitive Croke and the last Sorcerer of Tund. Born millennia before the Battle of Yavin, Gepta joined the Sorcerers in 5 BBY. After learning all that they had to offer, he killed them all, using a bioweapon to ravage the planet Tund.

A Rebel spy, Ensign Waldron infiltrated the Imperial base on Argavat and stole the Imperial Battle Codes. When the base commander realized the theft, the garrison was put under full alert, and Waldron was unable to escape.
Hoth Stuff was a fathier that competed in a fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.
Brenn Tantor was a young Human male from Garos IV who dreamed of becoming one of the Imperial stormtroopers who kept the peace on his homeworld.
Lemmet Tauk was a trainee at the Imperial Royal Guard Academy on Yinchorr and a close friend of Kir Kanos.
Crix Madine was a human male who led a commando unit of the Galactic Empire's military until he defected to the Rebel Alliance, where he served as a general.
URoRRuR'R'R was a skilled Tusken Raider hunter who once attacked Luke Skywalker as the latter was trying to find R2-D2 in the Jundland Wastes.
Deej Warrick was an adventurous Ewok warrior.

Shodu Warrick was an Ewok female from the Forest Moon of Endor. She lived in Bright Tree Village and was married to the Ewok warrior Deej Warrick, with whom she had four children: Weechee, Widdle, Wicket, and Winda, whom she raised to be considerate to others.
The Ewok Weechee Warrick was the oldest son of Deej and his wife Shodu. He had two brothers, Willy and Wicket, and a sister, Winda. Weechee was the love interest of Chirita.
Jai'galaar, also known simply as Jag and designated CT-55/11-9009, was a clone trooper captain who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Krystal was a Human male who served as a senator under the Galactic Empire of Palpatine. He represented the planet of Malastare in the Imperial Senate. The professional gambler and notorious womanizer Lando Calrissian once dated his daughter.
Beryl Chiffonage was a commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the height of the Galactic Civil War.
Aris-Del Wari, born Ludi Billane, was a Jedi youngling who lived in the era known as the Great Peace of the Republic.
Voli Quana was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order.
Winda Warrick was the youngest member of the Warrick family.

Like all clone troopers, Deviss was created on the planet of Kamino based on the genetic template of the human male bounty hunter Jango Fett, stood 1.83 meters and had tan skin. Deviss received training through the ARC program to prepare them for special missions.
Cort Davin was a male native of Concord Dawn. He served as a Journeyman Protector before he later joined the Cuy'val Dar.
Cos Dashit was the Emperor of the New Galactic Empire. His titles included Consul to the Supreme Tribunal.
Deathstick was a female Dathomirian assassin and daughter of the Nightsister Shelish, active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Tanis Mothma was a Human female politician who served as governor of Hanna City on Chandrila during the years prior to the Clone Wars. Her husband was an arbiter-general of the Galactic Republic and their daughter, Mon Mothma became the senator of the Bormea sector.
Danielle Kieran, known to her friends as Dani, was a hot-shot Corellian pilot, who believed herself to be Han Solo's illegitimate daughter.
Lord Slagorth was a Galderian member of the Galderian Slave Traders, and was tasked with setting up a base of operations in the Trebodar system.
Ta-mara Greenly was one of two sisters of Tag Greenley. She, like her other sibling De-hoff, dated Lando Calrissian.
De-hoff Greenly was one of two sisters of Tag Greenley. She, like her other sibling Ta-mara, dated Lando Calrissian.
Pel Talon was a Force-sensitive Human male Imperial senator who was in the lines to be promoted to the rank of Grand Moff under Emperor Palpatine's Galactic Empire.
Ch'thoqua was once a Tusken Raider from the planet Tatooine, until his entire tribe was wiped out by Imperial troops.
Selnia Trigg was a native of the planet Alderaan, a personal page for Senator Bail Organa and, through him, one of the earliest members of the Rebel Alliance.

Ne Thruska was a male Bothan pilot in the Rebellion with unparalleled skill. He was trained from an early age as a spy, as was the tradition of his race, and because of this he developed a sense of paranoia that rivaled most in the Alliance.

Nuubsal the Hutt was the slave pen overseer on board the Consolidations Unlimited starship Tarnta's Fang. He belonged to a clan which was on the losing end of an extended intra-Hutt conflict, its survivors were scattered throughout the galaxy.

Tarnta Bane was an opportunistic smuggler who formed the slaving group Consolidations Unlimited. He took advantage of the chaos caused by the Galactic Civil War, and gathered a small army of equally ruthless scum to carve out his own little criminal empire.
Delurin was a tall, powerfully built Human male. He was a Moff.
CSL (SEE eh sel) Danenberger was a Force-sensitive Human from the planet Kyrouac.

Cash Garrulan was a Twi'lek male who was once a former Black Sun Vigo until he became the most powerful crime lord on Murkhana. His hideout was located in the basement of an abandoned building to the south of Murkhana City.
Ana, was a female, who was accused of being drunk. When she was affected by Sense Force, she would rant about disturbances in the Force.
Mala Tinero was a Human female who lived on Gus Talon, a moon of Corellia, in 2 BBY. An apt mechanic, she lived and worked with her father, Rallo, who was a clandestine supporter of the Rebellion.

Kelly Vermillion was a Human-Orlak halfbreed of slight build, with red hair and light red fur on his extremities. He had pointy ears and a prehensile "nasty-looking" tail. He stood roughly five-and-a-half feet tall, or 1.67 meters.

Sheebla was a Gungan warrior-woman who was the true love of George R. Binks. Unfortunately, as she was infertile, he forced himself to marry another woman, as an heir was more important to him than love.

Spy 189, or Red as he was known to the Rebellion was a Proliferan operative sent by the Proliferan Empire to discover and evaluate other empires near them. During his travels, he learned much about Humans and the Rebellion itself.

Tyric was a Shaliz'Na from the forested planet of Shar'Ack who loved to play music. He was roughly 2.14 meters tall and very muscular with a twelve-foot wingspan, talon-like fingernails, black hair, and light down covering skin.

Nana was a member of the mysterious shape-changing race known as Homanans. She was able to change her shape to anything from the size of a Wookiee to that of an Ewok, but rarely changed her personality. She almost always seemed loving and carefree.
Karoly D'ulin was a member of the mysterious militaristic order of female warriors known as the Mistryl Shadow Guards.
Chanchaz Iryt was a male member of a sentient species who was Zhen Mirat's chief lieutenant and co-founder of The Fatal Visionaries.
Cyra Feliz was the wife of the free-trader Vazan Felix.
Tine Felix was the daughter of the free-trader Vazan Felix and his wife Cyra Felix.
Vazan Felix was one of the most respectable and likable free-trader in the galaxy.

He was born on the planet Tatooine to a family of moisture farmers, and grew up lonely and bitter. His physical differences made the heat from the planet's twin suns unbearable, which often kept him indoors and away from his siblings.
Ral Yekkiv was a Rebel and an associate of Roger Stern. He met with a group of rebels on Greyman's Planet when they came to meet with Stern.

Roger Stern was the owner of Stern Traders, as well as being a Rebel sympathizer. He was meant to meet with a group of rebels on Greyman's Planet but was unfortunately captured by the Empire when they discovered his rebel ties.

Lieutenant Wes Gevar was a Rebel ULAV pilot stationed at Karinda Outpost. He met with a group of rebels who came to the planet to deliver much needed supplies, but was shot by an Imperial biker scout and wounded so badly that he could not participate in the fight to the base, …

Fodesinbeed Annodue, better known as Fode and Beed, was a Troig celebrity podracing announcer. He appeared only at the most prestigious podraces, and commanded an excessive fee. Both heads acted as separate beings, with the red head named Fode and the green head named Beed.

Jade, codename Watcher, was a female Mikoan with piercing green eyes, long black hair, and an athletic figure. Every move she made was confident and hinted at the competence and training she has undergone.

Aran Starfire was a tall, lean Human with silver-red hair by the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was once a soldier in the Galactic Republic army, but retired to the planet Gellefon to escape the madness of the New Order.

He always wore the most regal attire, and his dress uniforms were always perfectly pressed, sparkling clean, and covered with every official decoration he ever received. His steel-gray hair, cold-gray eyes, and pale skin added to his intimidating appearance and mannerisms.

Taki was a member of the Rebel strike team sent to the forest moon of Endor to destroy the second Death Star's shield generator. She carried a portable comm jammer which stopped an Imperial AT-ST from reporting the strike team.

He dressed in the ground assault armor favored by AT-AT commanders. He looked like a formidable Imperial officer; however, while he was a good officer, he had no desire to die needlessly for the Imperial cause.

T'kyl was the chief Lucent navigator and scientist on the Crystal Web Station, though she generally delegated common navigation tasks to her staff. She was usually found wandering around the station, observing the different factions and races the station served.
Daran Tal was an ambitious individual who saw the potential of the Crystal Web Station, and whose careful planning and attention to details made his plan successful.

Moko Jax was the owner of Moko's Cantina on the Crystal Web Station. Although Moko was a Force-sensitive, he never learned how to tap into his potential abilities (and if asked, he'd scoff at the idea of "Jedi stuff," anyway).
Lianna was unfailingly polite but very firm in her dealings with both the new arrivals to the station and its permanent residents.
Klaar was a male Defel and the security chief aboard the Crystal Web Station.

Orta the Hutt was the "fringe" element that represented a consortium of "independent businesses" with interests on the Crystal Web Station in the negotiations to get a piece of Lucent technology in 4 ABY.
Taver Soren was just like many of the men recruited into the Galactic Empire.
Jedwar Seelah was a Human male, an explorer and scout in Mos Espa 32 BBY.
After the destruction of the Second Death Star, Jeckor found it harder and harder to obtain new crew for his capital ships, as most of the Imperial academies were shut down.
Tyanna Tymb was the Sullustan Top OpEx of the SoroSuub Corporation's Varada sector holdings.
Stridus Darkov was a male businessman alive during the time of the New Republic.
Kaevee was a female Padawan studying on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War.

Simon, known as Simon the Killer Ewok, was an Ewok with brown fur and black eyes. Simon wielded a staff weapon that fired devastating blaster bolts capable of quickly destroying buildings, beings, droids, and vehicles.
Dvakvar Grahrk was a Devaronian Jedi and user of the Dark side of the Force who hunted down Sith.
Alara Fax was the founder of Fax Ventures and a fierce rival of Tyanna Tymb.

Rodd was a male Human Senator of the Galactic Republic who represented Fondor and the Tapani sector until he joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 23 BBY and was replaced by Canny Mandary Bertar.

Fixit was a human male scrumrat of the White Worms gang on the Core Worlds planet Corellia. Around 13 BBY, he and the fellow human scrumrat Broon prepared to help raid a Corellia shipyard by taking watch shifts to monitor the facility, often taking turns with the Rodian scrumr…
Tamizander Rey was a Human commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Al, known as Big Al, was a male human who resided on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon in the later stages of the Cold War between the First Order and the Resistance. He sported a bushy mustache and was a regular at Aunt Z's tavern.

Vrox was the governor of Mandalore before the time of the Clone Wars. He was a secret supporter of Palpatine while he was still a senator, and comments by Fenn Shysa could be interpreted that Vrox was aware of his dual nature as a Senator and Dark Lord of the Sith.
Dessicus was the leader of the GenoHaradan faction on Nar Shaddaa.

Kara was a Force-sensitive medic training in the ways of the Jedi. She served on board the New Republic picket ship, which discovered the only remaining Outrider-class cruiser belonging to the Order of the Silver Jedi.
Bar Oplut was a male Jedi Knight and a member of the Order of the Silver Jedi.
Duron Veertag was a Human male who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 0 BBY.

Warkin was a huge, unkempt male Wookiee who didn't brush his hair and cared little for his appearance. He was easily provoked into Wookiee rage, and only Jedgar was able to keep him from lashing out randomly.
The Force Vampire, formerly known as Jedi Knight Tel Angor, was the result of the Order of the Silver Jedi's experiments into creating a living symbol of the light side of the Force.

Fahjay was a Force-sensitive individual who once saved Admiral Ackbar's life from two terrorists. He kicked the door open into the room in which Ackbar was being held captive and immediately saw one terrorist with a knife at Ackbar's throat and the other reaching for a switch …

Commander Darnak was in command of the Radra Surveillance Post on the planet Radra IV. He helped fight off a snowtrooper attack when a group of rebels came to get equipment from the base and later joined them in evacuating aboard the Starhound.
Of course, he was simply planning on leading the group of Rebels down to the hangar personally where he had set an ambush for them to be captured and imprisoned along with the others.

Bren Derlin was a human male officer of the Rebel Alliance. Bearing the rank of Major, Derlin served as the operations and security chief at Echo Base, the Alliance headquarters on the planet Hoth, under the command of General Carlist Rieekan.
Grond was a Human male member of the Alliance Military's 4th Squad, which was under the command of Corporal Jobin during the Galactic Civil War.

Mulchive Wermis was a Human male captain of the Star Destroyer Devastator while that vessel was the flagship of Darth Vader, and at times felt the grip of Vader's Force choke. Wermis was a coward, and Vader enjoyed tormenting him psychologically.
Harmon was a human male who served against the Empire with the Mykapo insurgents in Iron Squadron.

Aruteous "Rute" Gunnay was a male Neimoidian member of the Trade Federation, serving as an aide and adviser to Viceroy Nute Gunray and Settlement Officer Rune Haako during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Egot Pai-4-Yem, or The Boneman as he was often referred to as on Harridan, was a tall, almost skeletal humanoid with large, staring eyes and saggy, corpse-colored skin. He had a lisping voice which echoed deeply from his large, bony chest.

Mother Grotrugga was a Force-sensitive Gamorrean leader of the Nuns of G'aav'aar'oon. She appeared to be a typical Gamorrean female who was motherly (if it was possible to call a 200 kilogram, fanged, pig-like alien motherly), kind, and placidly calm.

A semi-sentient black fog–like creature was created by the Galactic Empire aboard the escort frigate–turned-laboratory Imperial Research Station 13 as part of experiments aiming to tap into the dark side of the Force.
Rooz was a Sarkan Lord who served as the Advisor to Queen Zil.

Sarkli was a Human male captain in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps during the Galactic Civil War. A member of the elite storm commandos, Sarkli was the nephew of Admiral Firmus Piett and one of the Empire's best spies, even finding audience with Emperor Palpatine.

Quintik Kahr, better known as "Big Quince", was an Outer Rim-based Sludir slaver and the brother of Omze'kehr Kahr. Before turning to slavery, he was a famous gladiator, fighting primarily in the pits of Loovria, using a force pike that he would carry for the rest of his life.
Reya was as a male Neimoidian baron of Cato Neimoidia in the decades following the Battle of Endor. A member of House Reya, he attempted to do business with Leia Organa, the leader of the Resistance.
Galen Torg was a Human male native of the planet Alderaan, who served as a military officer on his homeworld.

At this time, he was of very advanced years and appeared to be very thin and as wrinkled as Yoda. His appearance, however, conveyed his experience. He graduated from the academy at the top of his class and was already a captain by the end of the Clone Wars.
Slopper was a Saurian who worked for Sithless Leethe. He was not very intelligent however, and was rather easy to dupe if someone were to attempt it.

Sithless Leethe was a minor Saurian crime boss who occasionally ran scams for Jabba the Hutt. Unlike most members of his species, he wore flashy robes with sashes and did not have any visible weapons, though he always had a pair of knives up his sleeves.
Evram Lajaie was a Human commander of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 0 BBY, he was at the Alliance's base on Yavin 4.
"One-Arm" was the appellation given to the female wampa that Luke Skywalker encountered in the ice cave on Hoth in 3 ABY.

Mallatobuck, also known as Malla, was the wife of Chewbacca, the Wookiee co-pilot of the Corellian smuggler Han Solo. During the Imperial Era, Malla and her family were enslaved by the Galactic Empire. She was separated from her husband Chewbacca and her son Lumpawaroo.
A Jedi Knight active prior to 20,000 BBY, Roni von Wasaki was respected as both an able administrator and a skilled warrior.
Gammid was a member of Leshy Drobo's crew who was killed attempting to capture Roni von Wasaki. Drobo was not saddened by his death, as he considered Gammid to be incompetent.

Leshy Drobo was a bounty hunter around 20,000 BBY. He used freight hauling as a front for his hunting, and occasionally worked with another hunter, Gammid. His most notable catch was the Jedi Knight Roni von Wasaki although Drobo did not survive to collect the bounty.

Jowart Typok was once a member of the Interplanetary Charts and Surveys but was forced to leave due to Imperial cut-backs on exploration. He later praised these cut-backs for forcing him to discover the lucrative business of professional game hunting.
Jes Flon was Jowart Typok's follower and pilot of his stock light freighter for smuggling ivory. She wore a blaster pistol in a shoulder holster at all times.

Luna was Hakon deVille's secretary and bodyguard. She was tall, elegant, efficient, and completely loyal to Hakon. She also appeared to be his companion and was the only person onboard the Ananuru Express to hold a weapon, having a blaster in her handbag.
Wesson DeLameter was Hamnet's bodyguard and was always well-dressed and quiet. He accompanied Hamnet on board the Ananuru Express when the RNA brainwashing virus was up for auction.

Havas Rar was an employee of an arms manufacturer intent on acquiring the secret Imperial RNA brainwashing virus. He was sent with Quil Nathan when it was discovered to be up for auction on the Ananuru Express.
Dansra Beezer was a Human female native of the planet Alderaan who held the rank of corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 4 ABY.
Aunuanna was a Human woman living on Nar Shaddaa a few years after the Battle of Naboo. She was the mother of Aurra Sing.
A baby was a relative to the Force-sensitive human male Obi-Wan Kenobi prior to joining the Jedi Order.

Nilwoon was a corrupt Wookiee agent of a syndicate found on the planet Tatooine. He approached a group of Rebels to offer them 15,000 credits to rescue Maxine Baytor from Imperial custody with no questions asked.
Verral Kayrell was a member of the police force in Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. He was the police station's speeder bike mechanic and was sometimes seen in the cantina's of Mos Eisley.

Gror Pernon was a male Human who was the brother of Emperor Antbbianplourr III of Eiattu 6 and the grand uncle of Plourr Ilo. He was a member of the Priamsta and served as the Grand Duke. His son was Count Rial Pernon.
Deacon (or Deak) was a boyhood friend of Luke Skywalker who lived in Anchorhead on Tatooine.
Maxine Baytor was once a general in the Galactic Republic, during which time she participated in the Battle of Denubba.
Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka was an Ewok female who resided in Bright Tree Village on the Forest Moon of Endor. She was the daughter of the village chief, Chirpa, and she held the title of princess.
Sors Bandeam was a male Human Jedi Initiate enrolled in the Jedi Order's Temple academy on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.

Adonar Dellox was a Rebel and Chief Technician at Reginard Base on the planet Reginard during the Galactic Civil War. He was one of the commanding officers of the base and was known to be a determined man who preferred to work alone.
Buudro was an Imperial customs inspector found aboard Imperial Customs Frigate 517. He once boarded a ship orbiting the planet Reginard where he was escorted by two stormtroopers.

Tanya Madera was an Imperial spy who infiltrated the Rebel Alliance, becoming a Major who was the second-in-command of Reginard Base. She was in charge of the base's more mundane operations such as supply logistics, personnel, and schedules.

Kim Yeasson was the Junior Technician for the Rebel Alliance's Reginard Base during the Galactic Civil War. She supervised the X-wing technical crews and was a capable X-wing technician as well, often being found on the flight line repairing a starfighter.
Selnia was a female Human gambler who was once found on the planet Kessel. She was once hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter and paid her 100 credits per day.
Bolto was a Rodian gunman who was once found on the planet Bespin. While there he was hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter and paid him 50 credits per day for the work.
T'Sal was a Jawa "shuttle jockey" found on the planet Tatooine. They were once hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter and was paid 50 credits per day.
Rooarwaa was a Wookiee mercenary who was once hired by a smuggler on the planet Kashyyyk to serve aboard the smuggler's YT-1300 freighter. The cost for his services was 200 credits per day.
Aabatar was a male Mon Calamari smuggler who was once hired by another smuggler on the planet Dac to work on his YT-1300 freighter. Aabatar was paid two hundred credits per day for his services.
Thuugar was a Gamorrean "leg-breaker" who was once hired on the planet Gamorr by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter. The price for his services was 50 credits per day.

Huutar was a Human male who worked as a mechanic on the world of Corellia. He was once hired by a smuggler who owned a YT-1300 freighter; the price for Huutar's services was set at one hundred credits per day.

Yaawl was a Wookiee and Imperial fugitive who was once found on the planet Hoth. A Corellian smuggler with a YT-1300 freighter took him from Hoth, despite the fact that it meant the Galactic Empire was on their back more.
Hyobu Sulloran was a Human male who was one of many Force-sensitives captured for Emperor Palpatine to be trained as a Dark Side Adept.
Radaf Netbers was a captain in the military forces of Warlord Zsinj.
Windy Starkiller, otherwise known as Windom Marstrap, was a Human male, and a childhood friend of Luke Skywalker when he lived on Tatooine. He often spent time with Luke at Tosche Station.

Malfkla Yzu was a male Human and one of the thirteen Imperial warlords killed by Admiral Natasi Daala at Tsoss Beacon in 12 ABY. Under the Empire, Yzu was an admiral in the 15th Deep Core Reserve Fleet.

Kannen Doom was a noted Human female bounty hunter who aged at a far slower rate than normal. In the last years of the Galactic Republic, she favored form-fitting hot pink outfits with low necklines, but by the time of the Battle of Endor, she typically dressed in blue armor.
Yotts Orren was a Kadas'sa'Nikto guard who often worked onboard Jabba's sail barge, Khetanna. During the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon, he rode on the second Bantha-II cargo skiff.
After the loss of many skilled Imperial pilots during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Ryad gave up her political career to become a pilot.
Later, between the Earth-years 1942 and 1943, Jones embarked on an expedition to find the legendary "Sasquatch" in a jungle on behalf of a museum.

"Short Round," also known as "Shorty," was the Human companion of Doctor Indiana Jones. 126 years after the YT-1300 light freighter Millennium Falcon crash-landed on the planet Earth, Short Round and Jones undertook an expedition to the starship's ruins in search of the "Sasqu…

Zyix K'zzt was a Human male born into a family loyal to the Galactic Empire. While growing up he quickly learned obedience and how to serve the Empire, studying long and hard to please his parents as well as his teachers.

Stormtrooper Colonel TC-1289 was one of many stormtroopers produced for the Galactic Empire by Zyix K'zzt in a clone vat who would have simply become one of many normal, mindless drones if not for the fact that K'zzt was discovered to be a secret member of the Rebel Alliance b…
Although no one was able to prove it, Mother was a former smuggler who retired from smuggling when the Imperials made the business less cost-effective.
Annah Dublavviane was a scatterbrained female Jediboh Opera actress, part of the Tantrellius Theatre Groupe, and was the grand dame of Two Jedi Men From Baronis.
Bow was the name of a clone stormtrooper who served as a commander within the Galactic Empire's 501st Legion.

CT-3423 was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He was part of the 91st Reconnaissance Corps under Clone Commander Neyo during the Siege of Saleucami in 19 BBY.

Umwak was a Dulok shaman from the Forest Moon of Endor. Serving as the religious leader of the Dulok band ruled by King Gorneesh, he sometimes had dealings with the Dulok oracle Murgoob, and Morag, the Tulgah witch.
Devish was a male Human lieutenant of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War.

Widdle Warrick, also known as Willy, was a reckless young Ewok hunter from Bright Tree Village on the moon Endor. Widdle was the brother of Winda, Weechee, and Wicket W. Warrick, and the son of Deej and a female Ewok.

Nautag d'al' Gargan was the husband of Yarna d'al' Gargan. They had three children: Luka, Leia, and his namesake, Nautag. While raising their cubs in their home on Askaj, Nautag and his family were kidnapped and sold to Jabba the Hutt.
DS-61-3, nicknamed "Backstabber," was a Corellian Imperial TIE pilot, known for his viciousness in combat, and Darth Vader's right wingman in Black Squadron.
Mrp-Mrp Poo was considered the Lothario Smerg of the Quenk jazz scene. She hosted annual Vector Day parties at the Boulderdash terrarium.

One male member of King Gorneesh's tribe of Duloks on the Forest Moon of Endor was distinguished from his green-furred brethren by a yellow X that adorned his belly and chest, as well as by a white cloth that he often tied around his head.

Lilith was a Human female Jedi trainee who served the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic. When the Great Jedi Purge was initiated, she betrayed her fellow Jedi and joined the Galactic Empire.
Thorn Drumheller, also known as Willow Ufgood or Weazel, was a Nelwyn from Andowyne.
Sorsha was an individual from Andowyne and was the daughter of the Demon Queen Bavmorda and the good Prince Mikal Tanthalos of Tir Asleen whose fiery red hair she inherited.

Madmartigan was a male Human knight from Andowyne. The knight of Galadoorn disgraced himself by having an illicit love affair with a princess. He later took up a sword to fight Queen Bavmorda alongside his childhood friend Airk Thaughbaer.
Elora Danan was a female Daikini empress from Andowyne.
Seluss was a male Sullustan and smuggler who smuggled with his partner Jarril on Smuggler's Run when Jarril was killed in 17 ABY.
Misik was a Human male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout trooper. He was a deadly shot and helped develop Imperial speeder bike tactics.
Drelosyn was a Human male who served as a Scout trooper Corporal in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps.

Damien Tantrellius was a Jedi Knight who served during the Clone Wars. Following an incident that resulted in the death of future-Governor Zannen's wife, Tantrellius lost his memory, and subsequently took up a new career as an actor.

Manuel "Manny" Both-Hanz was a Human agent of the Rebel Alliance. He had a romantic relationship with Mon Mothma, the Alliance Chief of State, and died while trying to get the plans to the Death Star II to the Alliance.

"Aach" was the code name of a Human male who served as a Rebel agent during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 BBY, he informed Garm Bel Iblis of the Death Star plans. Directly answerable to Bail Organa, Aach was a special messenger that was only used for top-level Alliance business.
Remoh was a male Squidge and the den-brother of Otalp who lived long after the death of Luke Skywalker. His species was being oppressed by the Vindar.

Ony Bobissia was a Triffian who was on the planet Coruscant during the year 22 BBY. By that time, Bobissia had become a regular at the eatery Dex's Diner, and one day outside of the diner, the Triffian chatted with a Nuknog named Slyther Bushforb.

Tai was a Force-sensitive human Jedi Padawan who lived during the New Republic Era, having joined the Jedi Order under Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, Tai learned the ways of the Force alongside other students, including Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo.

DV-692 was a clone stormtrooper officer of the Galactic Empire who served in the 501st Legion during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 BBY, he was stationed aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator under the command of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.
Otalp was a male Squidge and the den-brother of Remoh who lived long after the death of Luke Skywalker. His species was being oppressed by the Vindar.

Karkan was a Tevellan male who worked at a bacta production plant on his species' homeworld of Tevel. After the First Order annexed Tevel and took control of the bacta plant, forcing the Tevellans to work at the threat of their children being harmed, Karkan contacted the Resis…

Falaem Onn was a humanoid member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic team called the Rebel Four. By 0 BBY, Onn and the team went on a mission to the Outer Rim planet Vatleria and confirmed the presence of an Imperial base there.

Grimgrim was a Wookiee who served as a member of a Rebel Alliance unit the Rebel Four during the Galactic Civil War. By 0 BBY, Grimgrim participated in an assault on a secret Imperial base on the planet Vatleria.

Soo Rcharrz was a humanoid member of the "Rebel Four," a team affiliated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They operated alongside the team's leader, F4-MF, and fellow members Falaem Onn and Grimgrim.
Dalla Solo, also known as Dalla Suul or Dalla the Black, was a Human male of Corellian ancestry who became a notorious pirate around the time of the Clone Wars.

Muzzle, also known as ARC-66, was a defective clone trooper who served as an Advanced Recon Commando in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Shuma was a displaced Hutt businessman on Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War.
Tolo Kad was a male politician from Onderon. He was the aide to King Ommin.
Tap was a young human male who lived in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, working as an assistant for the collector Dok-Ondar.

Jay-Jay Bin was the partial name of a Gungan that enrolled in Fett Club to become a Mandalorian. However, they were killed by the Mandalorian instructor, as they were ineligible to apply due to the seventh rule of Fett Club: "No Gungans. Ever."

Slabba Drewl was a chef captured by Corpo the Hutt. He was later rescued by Micah Giiett and Plo Koon. He was very short and had a blunt head with blue skin. He had small beady eyes and a large mouth.
Naroon Cuthus was Jabba Desilijic Tiure's majordomo for decades. When he finally retired, the Hutt crime lord ordered Cuthus's assassination, lest he spill secrets to Jabba's enemies.

Gregar Typho was a human male Naboo and a captain of the Royal Naboo Security Forces for Senator Padmé Amidala during the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars, ensuring the senator's safety at all costs.
Mara was a Jedi Master who was killed by droids on M4-78. She was the Master of the Twi'lek Jedi Tourath.

A male Kajain'sa'Nikto bounty hunter fought against Din Djarin in an attempt to capture Grogu, on the desert planet of Tatooine. He was accompanied by three other hunters; Biran Redben, a helmeted humanoid male and a small alien of the same species as Scrapjaw Motito.
This aged Human male controller served the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Echo Base on the planet Hoth in 3 ABY.

A Corellian pirate was part of the group that escorted Jabba the Hutt to Docking Bay 94 in Mos Eisley to confront Han Solo. Minutes prior he had been drinking in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, along with Boelo and Gela Yeens.

Darth Desolous was a male Pau'an Jedi Master prior to becoming a Sith Lord. Born around 3522 BBY, he studied Sith teachings and fell to the dark side of the Force, he was expelled from the Jedi Order.
Nyrat Agira was a human member of the Zealots of Psusan cult who was a patron of the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.
1047 was a Human male stormtrooper who served as a sergeant in the Galactic Empire's Desert Sands unit by 0 BBY.

Wes Janson was a human male pilot from Taanab who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War, Janson was a member of Rogue Squadron and participated in the Battle of Hoth as the gunner for Wedge Antilles.

The "Tipper" was a Corellian businessman-turned-hacker. He called himself "Tipper" because he had found a way to "tip" the contents of other people's bank accounts into his own. He founded the gang of the computer hackers known as the Skaak Tippers.
Chester was the short Rodian sidekick to Gorm Maldorf. Chester accidentally killed him by strangling him with wire in the Cage, and tried to blame Gorm's rival, Luke Skywalker.
Kaa was a Dark Jedi who was very close to her twin sister Lii. They were able to sometimes trick people into thinking that they were simply one individual.
Lii was a female Dark Jedi and the twin sister of Kaa. She was so similar to her sister that they were sometimes able to trick others into thinking they were simply one individual.
A member of an unspecified felinoid species with brown hair and yellow eyes, she was a proficient commando and a skilled slicer.

Torith was a male Grand Moff in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He became an important and powerful figure in the Imperial regime by taking control of sectors which were on the verge of joining the Rebellion and bringing them back into the fold of the Empire.
Abso Bar Binks was the son of Jar Jar Binks.
Spid was a Rodian bounty hunter who worked with a Human woman and a Whiphid.

Galle was a Clone Lieutenant who served in the the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 19 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Felucia and served alongside Jedi General Aayla Secura.
Tao was a Human male from the world of Shumari who trained as a Jedi Knight. He was part of a small group of Jedi that avoided Order 66 and the immediate decimation of the Jedi Order.

Voss Parck was an individual who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's navy, commanding the Venator-class Star Destroyer Strikefast. While leading a scouting party on an uncharted world, Parck encountered the Chiss warrior Mitth'raw'nuruodo.
Iguni was a Jedi Padawan around the time of the Clone Wars, having previously trained in Yoda's youngling classes.
Zeami was a female Near-Human Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Zoi was a male Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Gre'ento was a Human male who made his home on an unnamed forested planet, where he worked as an information broker.
Alema was a female Twi'lek who died at some point during the Republic Era. Between 32 BBY and 22 BBY, the Twi'lek Daesha did a ritual which woken up many spirits including Alema.
Broak Vessery was a male Human TIE fighter pilot who held the rank of colonel in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire.
Iona Retter was once a loyal servant of the Galactic Empire who eventually grew to see her belief in it shattered and so became a spy for the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic

Arundel was a Moff in the Galactic Empire who discovered that Iona Retter was a Rebel spy. It was because of this that she had to leave her position in Imperial Intelligence, and so she vowed revenge against Arundel.
Anselme Miclyne was a male Verpine who served as a technician aboard the Hearst, working for Freedom Galactic News. He was known among the rest of the crew for smoking cigars.

Elan Sel'Sabagno, also known as Elan Sleazebaggano, was a male Balosar death stick dealer on the planet Coruscant during the Separatist Crisis. A chance encounter with Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his mind tricks resulted in Sel'Sabagno deciding to take up a more honest life.
Tomas was a male individual who was one of the leaders of the Jaliss Group.
Polcyc was an Abyssin scavenger who was a member of the Wreckers, a loose affiliation of scavengers operating on the ice world Hoth.
Blackwing was a Nihil pirate serving under the Storm Jinnix in Pan Eyta's Tempest. Blackwing was killed by the Twi'lek mercenary Lourna Dee during the raid in the Abrion sector.

Gara was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Alongside Grand Master Yoda, Gara briefed the Jedi Mace Windu on the creation of coaxium ultra, a new form of coaxium, on the moon Ro Mira and the consequences if it were to fall into the hands of criminal organizations.

Annikin Starkiller was the son of Kane Starkiller and the Jedi-Bendu Padawan Learner to Luke Skywalker, as well as the protector and later, lover to the Princess/Queen of his home planet of Aquilae, Leia.
His wife was Queen Breha. She ordered General Luke Skywalker to take Leia to Ophuchi to gain the help of the Chrome Companies and place her daughter on the throne.

Bataal Bandu was a descendant of the early Sith/Dark Jedi cross-breeding experiments who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Part of the Sith Order who acted against Darth Vader, he delighted in spreading the Sith teachings to other cultures.
Roxi was a female member of the Gatherers at Savi and Sons Salvage in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. She used a hoverchair.

Lieutenant Atallo was a male officer in the Telos Security Force following the Jedi Civil War. He oversaw the Czerka landing bay Urban 38-3 on Citadel Station, and used his position to cover up the illicit Czerka weapons trade on the station.
Kane Starkiller was the Jedi father of Annikin Starkiller and his brother Deak Starkiller. His homeworld was Aquilae.
Dice Ibegon was a Force-sensitive Lamproid, a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and the lover of Lak Sivrak, whom she convinced to join the Alliance.
Carp was a Human male in the employ of Millennium Astro-Engineering. He was apparently an aide or an advisor to Zoltan Starkid.

Ranzar Malk, also known as "Ran," was a human male criminal who operated on the Roost space station. He was a former partner of bounty hunter Din Djarin, and continued to work after Djarin left his crew.

Yarith Figg was a lesser noble female from Alderaan and the wife of explorer Ecclessis Figg. Yarith met her husband on a luxury liner running along the Corellian Trade Spine, where Ecclessis ended up saving her life.

Whoever was a loyal Imperial captain stationed in the Interrogation Center on Selnesh under the command of Commander Caton. He was an alert, helpful, unchallenging man, but easily swayed by flattery, which allowed the escape of Gebnerret Vibrion.

Niclara Varnillian was a female human Alderaanian who joined the Imperial Navy. She was part of the operations crew that tested the Death Star superlaser on the planet Alderaan. The destruction of her homeworld did not affect her in the least.

Baz was a male human who served the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy as an ensign during the early years of its reign. He was assigned to serve on Sentinel Base, a construction project under the command of Moff Wilhuff Tarkin on a moon in the Outer Rim Territories.
Naia Sendar was a female Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic.
Weegee was a human male who lived on a planet in the Huru system where he mined farium. He was a friend of Kanina Nico.
Sarrissa Jeng was a human member of the Jedi Order during the Separatist Crisis. In 22 BBY, Jeng was one of the 212 Jedi who traveled to the planet Geonosis to rescue the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi.

Suuda was a male Hutt. Along with Moosh, he was one of four rival Hutt gangsters to reside on the planet Sleheyron in 3956 BBY during the Jedi Civil War. He was involved in an intra-planetary smuggling plot which culminated with the Jedi Revan being asked to assassinate Suuda.
Jonas Stern was a humanoid male who was a baron, and who served as a senator and ambassador in the New Republic in the years following the Battle of Endor.
Hap was a male Latero bartender and chef who operated Hap's Sap Tap on the forest planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.

In the Holy City on Jedha, the fugitive cyborgist used his ghastly medical techniques to produce more of the Decraniated from insurgent victims. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, Evazan and Baba were patrons in the Mos Eisley Cantina on Tatooine.
Keena was an individual who went to Screecher's Reach with Daal, Quinn, and Baython.

A Knight of the Sith wore a face mask and black robes and carried a red-bladed lightsaber. Flying a Banta Four starfighter in the Kessil system, he discovered and attacked Kane Starkiller and his sons Annikin Starkiller and Deak Starkiller on the Fourth Moon of Utapau.

Crispin Hoedaack was a functionary and the commander of the New Galactic Empire's attempt to annex the Aquilaean system. He was entitled Governor and First Lord of the Aquilaean System and Surrounding Territories.
Vantos Coll was a highly obese member of the Supreme Tribunal, in league with Crispin Hoedaack and Darth Vader as they plotted to take control of the New Galactic Empire.
Seig Darklighter was a Jedi, commonly believed to have led the Jedi Rebellion, though the real Jedi commander was Luke Skywalker.
Jommillia was a fierce Wookiee warrior on Yavin. Jommillia wore a plumed decorative helmet and armed himself with a battleaxe and spear.

Chuiee Two Thorpe of Kissel was the padawaan of Mace Windy. He was the son of Han Dardell Thorpe, and a graduate of the Intersystems Academy. He remained with his Master even after Windy was cashiered from the position of Warlord for the Alliance of Independent Systems.
Han Dardell Thorpe was a male head pilot of the famed galactic cruiser Tarnack. They were the father of Chuiee Two Thorpe, the padawaan of Jedi-Bendu Mace Windy.

The "Energizer Bunny" was a small male lagomorph-like creature that used an Energizer battery attached to his back to keep going and going. Around 3 ABY, the Sith Lord Darth Vader was sent by his master, Emperor Palpatine, to take the Energizer Bunny's battery.

Aay Zavos was a male member of the Galactic Traders Guild who served as an emissary to King Kayos for the Chrome Companies. He was partial to the Independent Systems in their struggle against the Galactic Empire because of the trade restrictions in the Empire.
Liane was a Human female handmaiden to Queen Kylantha of Naboo who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Jek Tono Porkins, nicknamed "Piggy," was a male human trader and pilot from Bestine IV. He decided to abandon his homeworld after the Galactic Empire moved in and built a new military base there, and he ended up joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
This "Jawa Hero" was a Jawa who greatly endangered the economy of its clan, but eventually managed to save it as it appropriated some valuable Imperial material.
This "Old Jawa" was the leader of the Jawa clan, an angry mechanic and a scarred warrior. The clan leader normally used a piece of mechanical equipment as a walking cane.
This scarred Jawa was a member of a clan who salvaged an X-wing starfighter and later managed to steal a TIE advanced starfighter from a trio of salvagers on Tatooine.
A moisture farmer hoped to purchase some droids from a Jawa clan only to learn that they were not able to sell him any, as one of their number had destroyed the entire stock of droids.
The disappointed moisture farmer's son was a male Human child who lived on Tatooine whose father was a moisture farmer.
The disappointed moisture farmer's daughter was the teenage daughter of a Human farmer on Tatooine. She was disappointed when her father was not able to purchase any droids from a clan of Jawas.

The disappointed moisture farmer's wife was the wife of a Human farmer on Tatooine. Along with the rest of the family, she was disappointed to learn that her husband had not been able to purchase any droids from a clan of Jawas.
This Rebel pilot was an X-wing pilot who crash-landed on Tatooine. When approached by Imperial stormtroopers, the pilot surrendered, but was killed nonetheless.

This Zabrak male salvager was a member of a group of scavengers who managed to salvage a TIE Advanced starfighter on Tatooine. He was planning to sell the fighter to Jabba the Hutt. Unfortunately for him and his associates, a Jawa stole the TIE fighter.

This Bith salvager was a member of a group of scavengers who managed to salvage a TIE Advanced starfighter on Tatooine. The group was planning to sell the fighter to Jabba the Hutt, and the Bith announced that he was going to use his share of the profit on alcoholic beverages.
This Rodian salvager was a member of a group of scavengers who managed to salvage a TIE Advanced starfighter on Tatooine.

x: Moradmin Bast was a human male bureaucrat and military officer who served as a general in the ground forces of the Galactic Empire, the successor state of the Galactic Republic.

This Sullustan Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. He fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge when Darth Vader killed him in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors. The Sullustan Jedi wielded a green lightsaber.

This Gran Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. He fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge when Darth Vader killed him in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors. The Gran Jedi wielded a yellow lightsaber.

This Twi'lek Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. They fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge when Darth Vader killed them in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors.
This bearded Human Jedi was a Jedi who had survived Order 66. He fell victim to the Great Jedi Purge in the Battle of Shumari in which Imperial forces clashed with a group of Jedi survivors.

Wicket Wystri Warrick (sometimes shortened to Wicket W. Warrick) was a male Ewok who served as a scout and warrior on the "forest moon" of Endor, a wild, temperate moon which orbited the massive gas giant of the same name.
A Human male captain served with the Imperial Navy, commanding an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer during the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY.

Hes Jor-Sharu was a Human Jedi archivist of the New Jedi Order. After the end of the Galactic Civil War, Jor-Sharu compiled a history of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fight against the Galactic Empire for the Jedi Archives in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when their te…

This stormtrooper was a Human with the Imperial Stormtrooper Corps during the early part of the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed aboard the original Death Star as part of the battle station's guard contingent in 0 BBY, just prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Kerri was a human female who lived on the planet Kenari with her brother Kassa. At a young age, Kerri was separated from her brother, who was taken offworld and later became known as Cassian Andor. Many years later, Andor still searched for his long-lost sister.

Huetrin Jones was a human who served as a captain and Flight Officer in the Resistance during its war against the First Order. Circa 34 ABY, Jones assisted Lieutenant Kaydel Ko Connix in evacuating the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar.
Sssiii was a male Slith of red coloration, weighing 60 kilograms. He was somehow obtained by the Galactic Circus and toured with them on a number of worlds, including Tatooine.
Riklon Tost was a male Iotran who served as captain of the Iotran Guard on Muunilinst during the Clone Wars. He was one of the few non-Muuns admited to the inner ranks of the IGBC officers.
Bob was a Human male stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire. Sometime between 0 ABY and 3 ABY, Bob stole the diary of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Luke Skywalker's best friend was a Force-sensitive childhood friend of Luke Skywalker and lieutenant in the Rebel Alliance who participated in the battles of Yavin, Hoth and Endor.

"Red Two" was the call sign of a male Human starfighter pilot who fought at the Battle of Endor. He piloted a Y-wing starfighter and shot down at least three TIE Interceptors, the first of which shot down Red Three.

Darth Homiiz was a Sith Lord with a rotund appearance, featuring tan skin covered in tattoos ranging from tan to purple coloring. On Homiiz's face, there were blue markings between the eyes, and an eye patch covering the Sith's right eye. Homizz also had a black beard and tail.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Conan Antonio Motti was a human male bureaucrat and military officer who served as an admiral and naval chief for the Galactic Empire, the fascistic successor state of the Galactic Republic.
Darth Phobos was a female Theelin Sith Lord who was born on the planet Korriban and lived thousands of years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars.
Zannen was the Imperial Governor of Peekoine. He resided in Landslasher-4.
Yuma Zannen was the daughter of Imperial Governor Zannen. She resided in Landslasher-4, on Peekoine.
Gamusha was the leader of the swoop gang, The Gutterwipes. He was good friends with Yuma Zannen.
Luke Starkiller was a human Jedi who wielded a yellow lightsaber.
Raik was the female Utai proprietor of the gambling den Raik's Parlor in the Coruscant Underworld during the High Republic Era.
Madame Kanta was a female Morse Rebel contact on the planet of Karlatt.

Bodo Linx was a Nuxan male who worked as an informant. The Galactic Empire killed his family, setting him against them. He met with Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Sana Starros on Barnahof, giving Organa the details for a contact of his on Brentaal IV.

A mercenary pilot served the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure in 4 ABY. In that year, he traveled to the Great Pit of Carkoon on the planet Tatooine to guard the execution of the Jedi Luke Skywalker. During the execution, Skywalker fought back and killed the pilot.

A male Weequay was employed by Jabba the Hutt. He was a guard on the first skiff during the Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon in 4 ABY, where he was killed by Luke Skywalker when the Jedi jumped back on the skiff.

Kjazhed-Uhl was a Human male stormtrooper stationed under Darth Vader in the Galactic Empire. Sometime between 0 ABY 3 ABY, Kjazhed-Uhl encountered his fellow stormtrooper Bob during a lunch break, where Bob revealed he had stolen the diary of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Samala Loené was a female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the lead-up to the Galactic Civil War. Assigned the callsign of Red Leader, she was the leader of Red Flight, a group of T-65B X-wing starfighters.

Rane was a Force-sensitive human witch within the coven of Mother Aniseya in a fortress on the planet Brendok. Serving as an ensign and an advisor, Rane attended the Rite of Ascension for Aniseya's twin daughters, Verosha and Mae-ho in 148 BBY.
The Mongo Beefhead Tribesman was a member of the nearly-extinct Mongo Beefhead Tribe from Tatooine. The tribesman, like the rest of the group, supported the Rebel Alliance.

This unidentified Rebel prisoner was captured during an Imperial assault on a Rebel Alliance outpost on Thaldo. She was freed from her cell by Luke Skywalker, and gave him an ID card that helped him reactivate the outpost's ion cannon so the Rebels could evacuate.

This pilot was on the planet of Tozeer when Luke Skywalker arrived to rescue C-3PO. The pilot traded with Skywalker for a part he needed to repair his A-wing fighter. In exchange, he gave the Rebel an item he needed to complete his mission.
Yoshi was a female individual who attended the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth during the Imperial Era.

Unda was a Jedi Hunter and bounty hunter. He was a lieutenant of the Jedi Hunter Anda and fought alongside him against the Jedi Lah Kara on an abandoned starship. Unda wielded an electrostaff and also used his round hat as a weapon.

Linder Kroford was a Morse from Karlatt who was sent to the planet Serob 6 for psychiatric treatment. Linder Kroford was one of the only living individuals, at the time of the Galactic Civil War, that knew the secret code to destroy the AI and the location of Temple Maudit on …
Tar'eelok was a Jedi Master. When Revan arrived at the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine in 3956 BBY, she was training her apprentice Garrum.
Fookooey was an announcer at Corpo the Hutt's extravagant culinary contests who worked alongside his partner, who he nicknamed "Doc."
Mosh Barris was an individual who served as a colonel in the Imperial Army. He was the senior troop commander aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Strikefast.
A Human was a senator in the Galactic Senate, during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. The Senator was still serving on Coruscant—the capital world of the Republic—in 32 BBY.
Lennox, also known as "The Rat", was a male Human thief who operated during the Galactic Civil War. Originally a teacher, Lennox was fired for sadism and turned to a career as a criminal.
Mitsurugi was a skilled swordsman from an unidentified world.
Taki was a Human female and a skilled fighter, who originated from an unknown world outside the known galaxy.
Darth Voren, originally known as Voren Renstaal, was a male Human who served Darth Revan's Sith Empire as a Sith apprentice.

Plo Koon was a Force-sensitive Kel Dor Jedi Master who served as a noble member of the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Wedge Antilles, known as TIE SS-2-5 during his time at Skystrike Academy, was a renowned human male starfighter pilot from Corellia who first served in the Imperial Navy as a TIE fighter pilot until defecting to join the rebellion.

Jango Fett was a famed Mandalorian human male bounty hunter and the clone template of the Grand Army of the Republic. Known as the best bounty hunter in the galaxy during the final years of the Galactic Republic, Fett was proficient in marksmanship as well as unarmed combat.

Mari Amithest was a Force-sensitive human female and a member of the Jedi Order as a child during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Hermione "Harmony" Bagwa was a female human who worked as a waitress alongside Wanda and FLO at Dex's Diner, an eatery owned by Dexter Jettster and located on the streets of CoCo Town, Coruscant. She grew up within Coruscant's underworld.

Fife was a Pyke male who served as the majordomo of Marg Krim and was a member of the Pyke Syndicate and Shadow Collective during the Clone Wars.
