A Human male guard was affiliated with the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the Sith Empire. The Republic guard served on the planet Corellia during the Battle of Corellia, which occurred in the year 3640 BBY.

Rendra Maex was a Human female who grew up on the planet Reuss VIII during Imperial rule of the planet. Her father spent his time and money helping the poor and homeless of the planet but Maex wanted just to leave the planet behind.
Nopul Etrefa was a male Kerestian mercenary who partnered with Rendra Maex.
Vakir'sa'jaina was a Nikto mercenary who befriended the Dressellian Oro Memis.
Oro Memis was a Dressellian mercenary who befriended the Nikto Vakir'sa'jaina.
Pole Svale was a minister who supported the Weequay ambassador Uli Aaregil.
Hondo Ohnaka was a male Weequay pirate and outlaw whose varied exploits garnered him notoriety and infamy throughout the galaxy.
Adi Gallia was a Force-sensitive Tholothian female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order and member of the Jedi High Council during the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era.
Bo-Katan Kryze was a Mandalorian human female princess born into House Kryze and was the Mand'alor during the New Republic Era.
Saponza was a male human from the sun-scorched planet of Tatooine who worked as a mercenary and had been part of the galactic criminal underworld for decades.

Tarfful was a male Wookiee chieftain and general who helped defend his native planet Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars. During the war, he led a band of Wookiees to answer a distress signal made by Chewbacca, who was imprisoned on the Trandoshan hunting grounds of Wasskah.

Denal was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic as a soldier in the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars. Denal served under Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and Clone Captain Rex during the war, including the Battle of Mimban and the mission to Skytop Station.

Hardcase was a Galactic Republic clone trooper during the Clone Wars that served under Clone Captain CT-7567 "Rex" in the 501st Legion. He served in the unit in multiple early engagements in the war, including at Benglor, Hisseen, and Mimban.

Poggle the Lesser, also known simply as Poggle, was a Geonosian male who served as the Archduke of the Stalgasin hive under hive-minded Queen Karina the Great, and as such served as the public face of the Geonosians during the Clone Wars.

Bib Fortuna was a Twi'lek male who lived on the desert planet Tatooine. He served as Jabba Desilijic Tiure's majordomo and chief of staff for decades, handling all of the day-to-day operations at Jabba's Palace, while secretly hating the Hutt and longing for a chance to kill h…

Lorth Needa was a human male who served as a lieutenant commander of a Carrack-class light cruiser, and later captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Avenger, a ship assigned to the Sith Lord Darth Vader's Death Squadron, during the Battle of Hoth.
Lolo Purs was a female Rodian politician and senatorial aide who served as the planet Rodia’s Junior Representative in the Galactic Republic Senate during the Clone Wars.

Tup, whose clone trooper designation was CT-5385, was a clone trooper who served in the 501st Legion of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Tup was considered a rookie when he began his service under Clone Captain Rex at the Battle of Umbara.

Owen Lars was a human male from the desert planet Tatooine who worked as a moisture farmer. He was the son of Aika and Cliegg Lars, and he became the stepbrother of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker when Cliegg married Anakin's mother, Shmi Skywalker.

Beru Whitesun Lars, born Beru Whitesun, was a human female from the planet Tatooine. She was married to Owen Lars, the stepbrother of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One, whose son, Luke, they raised after his father turned to the dark side of the force and his mother…
Shmi Skywalker Lars was a human female who lived in slavery on the planet Tatooine during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She gave birth to a son whom she named Anakin Skywalker.

Boss, designated RC-1138, was an elite clone commando sergeant who led the elite special forces Delta Squad during the Clone Wars, serving with commandos Fixer, Sev, and Scorch. Delta Squad, under Boss's leadership, participated in some of the war's most dangerous missions.
Aurra Sing, also known by the name "Nashtah," was a Force-sensitive female Palliduvan who left the Jedi Order to take up the life of a bounty hunter.

Barriss Offee, also known under the titles of "the healer" and "wise mother" later in her life, was a Force-sensitive Mirialan female who, during the Republic Era, was a Jedi Padawan who fell to the dark side of the Force during the period of the Clone Wars and was an Inquisit…
Reffe was an individual who lived on Level 3204 of the planet Coruscant, where he was neighbors with Anandra Milon's uncle.

Cham Syndulla, nicknamed The Hammer of Ryloth for his heroics during the Clone Wars, was a Twi'lek male who dedicated his life to being a resistance fighter and revolutionary leader during the Clone Wars and the early days of the rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

Cikatro Vizago was a male Devaronian crime lord who ran the Broken Horn Syndicate on the planet Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Vizago's operations included smuggling and extortion, with his rule backed by dangerous IG-RM bodyguard and enforcer droids.
Ephraim Bridger was a human male dissident during the height of the Galactic Empire from the Outer Rim planet of Lothal.
Mira Bridger was a human female dissident during the height of the Galactic Empire hailing the Outer Rim planet of Lothal who was an outspoken opponent of the rule of the Empire.

Cumberlayne Aresko, operating number: "LRC-01," was a human male who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire. In 3272 LY, Aresko held the title of Commandant and was stationed in Capital City, on the planet Lothal.
Taun We was a Kaminoan female administrative aide who served Prime Minister Lama Su during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Oruba was a male Hutt crime lord and a ruling member of the Grand Hutt Council during the Clone Wars. Oruba was born with a genetic defect that left his skin devoid of pigment, giving him a dissimilar look to most other Hutts.
Aayla Secura , a Force-sensitive Rutian Twi'lek female, was a Jedi Master during the waning years of the Galactic Republic, serving with distinction as a Jedi General during the Clone Wars.
Wolffe, formerly designated CC-3636, was a veteran Clone Commander who served in the Grand Army of the Republic with Jedi General Plo Koon during the Clone Wars.

Myles Grint was a human male who served the Galactic Empire for fourteen years after the end of the Clone Wars. Along with Commandant Cumberlayne Aresko, Grint was one of the commanding officers of Lothal, stationed in Capital City.

Kosh was a human male from Tatooine who served as an captain of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Kosh was stationed on his homeworld as the commander of the 68th Legion of the Imperial Army, the local garrison.
Tymo was a male Twi'lek and member of the Free Ryloth Movement. He was aboard a hijacked Imperial transport when he was Force choked to death by Darth Vader.
Abran Balfour was a moff of the Galactic Empire whose Star Destroyers often patrolled the Llanic Spice Run trade route in the Llanic system.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Rae Sloane was a human female dedicated to serving the Galactic Empire as a naval officer. She was instrumental in its survival in the aftermath of the Battle of Endor.
Zare Leonis was a male human Imperial cadet at the Academy for Young Imperials on the planet Lothal who worked as a spy for the rebels.
Arihnda Pryce was a Lothalite human female who served as the Galactic Empire's imperial Governor of the planet Lothal under the jurisdiction of Moff Stattata.

Luminara Unduli was a Force-sensitive Mirialan female Jedi Master during the final days of the Jedi Order. She commanded the 41st Elite Corps of the Grand Army of the Republic, and was the master of Padawan Barriss Offee.

Dhara Leonis was a Force-sensitive human female Imperial cadet at the Academy for Young Imperials on the planet Lothal approximately fourteen years after the rise of the Galactic Empire. She disappeared during her time at the academy.
Jai Kell was a human male politician who represented his homeworld, Lothal, in the New Republic Senate.
Wullffwarro was a male silverback Wookiee Chief who fought in the Clone Wars and was later taken as a slave by the Galactic Empire. He owned an Auzituck anti-slaver gunship.
Kitwarr was a male Silverback Wookiee born in 15 BBY. As a child, he was enslaved by the Galactic Empire. Liberated by the Spectres, he was friends with Ezra Bridger.
The Son, also known as the Brother, was a male Force wielder who resided in the ethereal realm of Mortis with his family, the Father and the Daughter.
Anandra Milon was a human from the planet Alderaan who had immigrated to the planet Coruscant by the time of her homeworld's destruction in 1 BBY.

A human male lived on Level 3204 of the city-planet of Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The man lived on the same level as their niece and nephew, Anandra and Santigo Milon, and the two childrens' parents, who owned an apartment on Level 3204.

A Herglic criminal lived on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan in 1 BBY, the Herglic was working with a Pau'an drug dealer, and the pair met with the young Alderaanians Anandra Milon and Santigo Mi…

A male Mon Calamari lived on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan, the Mon Calamari lived in a camp on Level 1782 of Coruscant.

A human male stormtrooper served the Galactic Empire on the planet Coruscant during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan, he encountered a pair of Alderaanian fugitives on Coruscant's Level 1997 and attempted to apprehend them.

A male human was born on the planet Alderaan but moved to the planet Coruscant, where he had two children with a another human Alderaanian. The family lived in an apartment on Level 3204 of Coruscant, a level inhabited by many other Alderaanian immigrants, in the year 1 BBY.
An officer of the underworld police visited a cantina on Level 1997 of the planet Coruscant several days after the destruction of the planet Alderaan.
Santigo Milon was a male human who lived on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Originally from the planet Alderaan, his family lived on Level 3204 of Coruscant.
Rig Nema was a Halaisi female Consular Jedi doctor who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars, the full-scale conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Clegg Holdfast was a male Nosaurian journalist for Podracing Quarterly and podracer pilot who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic, which took place during the Invasion of Naboo.
Ekelarc Yong was a human male who served as a lieutenant and starfighter pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Sev, also known by the designation RC-1207, was an elite clone commando who was part of Delta Squad during the Clone Wars. At some point, he and his fellow commandos were sent into an engagement from a Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry.

Mawhonic was a Gran male from the planet Hok who found fame as a podracer pilot, with his three eyes granting him an advantage over other racers. Flying a GPE-3130 Podracer, he participated in the Boonta Eve Classic race on the desert planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Zam Wesell was a Clawdite female bounty hunter who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. As a Clawdite, Wesell possessed the ability to physically alter her appearance—a power which she usually utilized to assume the visage of a human female.

Silman was a male human who served as a personal aide to Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum during his time in office. Prior to the Separatist Crisis, Silman accompanied Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas on a mission to Oba Diah.

Cauley was a human who served as an Imperial Navy ensign aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Ultimatum during the Gorse Conflict in 11 BBY, in which the Imperial cyborg Count Denetrius Vidian attempted to improve thorilide mining efficiency on the planet Gorse and its moon, Cynda.
Nibiru Chamas was a male individual who served as a commander in the Galactic Empire's Navy while he was in his forties.
Oked was a male bounty hunter. During the Clone Wars, he joined up with a syndicate of other bounty hunters in order to complete a job on the planet Quarzite.
Shaak Ti was a Force-sensitive Togruta female Jedi Master who served as one of the final members of the Jedi High Council before the Great Jedi Purge.

Boles Roor was a Sneevel podracer pilot from Sneeve who had won two Boonta Eve Classic podraces, which had taken place on the planet Tatooine. Roor later participated in another Boonta which took place during the year 32 BBY.

Joseph was a Bardottan member of the Bahk-tov Council during the Clone Wars. During this time Joseph was captured by the Frangawl Cult and imprisoned in a metal cage many meters above a large pit of lava.
Dexter "Dex" Jettster, nicknamed Dexi Jet, was a male Besalisk prospector and diner owner with a colorful background.

Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo was the accountant of the Grand Hutt Council during the Clone Wars. Gorga was the cousin of Rotta, nephew of Jabba, grand-nephew of Ziro and Ebor, grandson of Jabba's father, and the great-grandson of Mama and Papa.

Ody Mandrell was a male Er'Kit who hailed from the planet of Tatooine, home to the famed Boonta Eve Classic podrace. Mandrell eventually joined the sport of podracing, and acquired a team of pit droids that would go on to set podracing records while in his possession.

Angrigo was a male Duros assassin who was hired by Lieutenant Jenkes of the Galactic Empire's Security Bureau along with the Kratchell twins to kill the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk. However, he was instead killed by his target in Ake's Tavern on Lothal during a brief shootout.

Ferpil Wallaway was a male Xexto pawnshop owner and pickpocket who operated on the planet Lothal. He was the mentor of Ezra Bridger, a young thief and street urchin. He was selling tickets for "Gladiator Night," an illegal event hosted by "The Commissioner".

Borbig Drob was a male Houk who worked as a gladiator during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign and was declared champion of the contest known as the Stormblade Bloodfest on nine occasions.

Fives was an Advanced Recon Commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Due to his clone designation, CT-5555, short for CT-27-5555, he referred to himself as Fives.
Warjak was a male Feeorin who worked as a gladiator during the initial years of the Galactic Empire's reign and was declared champion of the contest known as the Outer Rim Carve-up on many occasions.

Hack Fenlon was a male senator of the Imperial Senate during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. After Gronson Takkaro, a Dug who owed Fenlon a large sum of money, escaped Imperial arrest in three star systems, Fenlon placed a bounty on his head.

Herdringer was a male lieutenant of the Imperial Security Bureau during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. Stationed on the planet Lothal, he was killed by his fellow lieutenant, Jenkes, who had him pushed in front of a speeder bus.

Mundokk was a male Trandoshan bounty hunter from the moon of Wasskah who worked during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. He held an Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate, but at some point it came into the possession of Bossk, another Trandoshan bounty hunter.

Alton Kastle was a human male journalist who worked as a broadcaster on HoloNet News on the planet Lothal during the Imperial Era. As a broadcast journalist, he helped spread propaganda for the Galactic Empire, including propaganda about Wookiees and local unemployment rates.

A stormtrooper with the designation TK-626 served the Galactic Empire on Lothal several years prior to the Battle of Yavin. TK-626 was a hardened school-bully who was specifically recruited by the Empire due to his aggressive tendencies.
Depa Billaba, a Force-sensitive human female native of the planet Chalacta, was a Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the final years of the Jedi Order.

In the years prior to the Battle of Yavin, this Stormtrooper Commander was stationed at an Imperial facility of landed TIE fighters on the planet Lothal. During one of his patrols, he encountered the Mandalorian explosive artist and rebel from the Ghost crew Sabine Wren.
Voorpee was a male voorpak on loan from the Naboo Zoo to the Coruscant Jedi Academy on the planet Coruscant circa 195 BBY.
Valen Rudor, operating number: "LS-607," was a male human TIE fighter pilot from Corulag in service to the Galactic Empire on Lothal five years prior to the Battle of Yavin as a Baron of the Empire.
Yogar Lyste, with the operating number LSM-03, was an officer of the Galactic Empire with the rank of lieutenant during the Imperial Era.

Tsoklo was a Rodian male who resided on the planet Lothal several years prior to the Galactic Civil War. Tsoklo served as factory worker, but also worked for the Galactic Empire as an informant who reported to Supply Master Yogar Lyste.
Maketh Tua was a human female that hailed from the planet Lothal, and was a graduate of the Imperial Academy.
Amda Wabo was a male Aqualish who worked as a weapons designer on the planet Garel during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
Jho, commonly known as "Old Jho," was a male Ithorian who operated a cantina known as Old Jho's Pit Stop on the planet Lothal fifteen years after the founding of the Galactic Empire.
Manchucho was a male Aleena from the planet Aleen who served as the King of Aleen during the Clone Wars.
Watto was a male Toydarian junk dealer and human trafficker who owned a junkshop in Mos Espa on the planet Tatooine.

Jenkes was a lieutenant with the Imperial Security Bureau on Lothal during the Imperial Era. During the fifth year of Emperor Palpatine's reign, Jenkes managed a gladiator arena on the planet of Nyriaan.

An Ugnaught salesman sold jogan fruits on Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In the years before Battle of Yavin, the Ugnaught, along with his Lothal astromech droid, were stopped by two stormtroopers.
Lom Pyke was a male Pyke who led the Pyke Syndicate, a powerful member of the crime families, during the Clone Wars. Pyke allied his Syndicate with the renegade Sith Lord Maul's Shadow Collective.

A male member of the Pau'an species lived and worked as a drug dealer on the planet Coruscant shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan in 1 BBY. On Coruscant's Level 1997, he and a Herglic partner met with the fugitive Alderaanian siblings Anandra and Santigo Milon.
An elderly human man operated the grill on a stall known as Hangra's Meat Shack on Level 2142 of the planet Coruscant shortly after the destruction of the planet Alderaan.

A human woman born on the planet Alderaan, she married a male Alderaanian and moved to the planet Coruscant. She and her husband came to live in an apartment on Level 3204 of the planet, and the pair eventually had two children, Santigo Milon and Anandra Milon.

A female droid mechanic lived next door to the Milon family on Level 3204 of the planet Coruscant by the time of the destruction of the planet Alderaan. Years prior to the destruction, she babysat the Milon's eldest child Anandra Milon.

Biggs Darklighter was a human male ace pilot who fought for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early days of the Galactic Civil War. He grew up on the desert world of Tatooine, where he became a close boyhood friend of Luke Skywalker.

Oola was a green-skinned Twi'lek female from a clan on the planet Ryloth. She was kidnapped by Bib Fortuna—majordomo of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure—who had her taught exotic dancing and told her many lies about the grandeur of Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine.
Lyn Me was a Twi'lek female dancer who performed with the Max Rebo Band at Jabba the Hutt's Palace, and sang vocals along with Greeata Jendowanian, Sy Snootles and Rystáll Sant.

Moreena Krai, sometimes shortened to just Mo, was a female human who lived on the planet Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. She and her family left the planet after the Empire condemned their farm and took the land from them.

A human male lived on the planet Lothal during the last years of the Galactic Republic's reign, and witnessed the organization transform into the Galactic Empire. On Lothal, he married and had two daughters, Moreena Krai and her younger sister, with whom he lived on his farm.
A human female lived on the planet Alderaan during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. She at some point in her life had a child, who married and had two children on the planet Lothal.
A human girl was born as the younger sister of Moreena Krai on the planet Lothal, where she lived with her family on a farm.

Oliver Novachez, nicknamed Ollie, was the younger brother of Roan Novachez, a boy from Tatooine was unexpectedly chosen to attend Jedi academy despite being rather older than the typical age at which students were admitted. Oliver was a young boy.
Gammy was a male Gamorrean who became the chef at the Jedi academy on Coruscant in Roan Novachez's second year of attendance there.

Skelly was a human male explosives expert who lived on the planet Gorse. A veteran of the Clone Wars, Skelly worked as an explosives expert in the thorilide mines of Cynda during the time of the Galactic Empire.
Hetto was a member of Myder's Mynocks, a division of the Gorse-based surveillance company Transcept Media Solutions. One of Hetto's colleagues and closest friends was the Sullustan Zaluna Myder.
Lal Grallik also known as Boss Lal was a female Besalisk manager of Moonglow Polychemical on Gorse and Cynda. She was married to Gord Grallik.

Okadiah Garson was a male human thorilide miner and owner of the bar called The Asteroid Belt on the planet Gorse. He took Kanan Jarrus under his wing, giving him a home and a place to work at his bar, as well as securing him a job as an explosives freighter pilot for Moonglow.

Zaluna Myder, nicknamed Zal, was a female Sullustan surveillance operator and the supervisor of Myder's Mynocks at Transcept Media Solutions on the planet Gorse. Myder was not married and had no children. She valued her work life over family, and felt as if work was her home.

Ruwee Naberrie was a human male and a member of the Naberrie family. He was the father of Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala. During his lifetime, his strongest ally in the Galactic Senate was Onaconda Farr of Rodia.
Jobal Naberrie was a human female from the planet Naboo. A member of the Naberrie family, she was the mother of Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala.

Palfa was a male Neimoidian who acted as director of the Cyndan Mining Guild during the time of the Galactic Empire. He was in charge of supervising the Guild's mining operations on Gorse's moon Cynda, which was rich in thorilide deposits.

Janyor, also referred to as Janyor of Bith, was a renowned male Bith painter, poet, and sculptor from Garel who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic, the reign of the Galactic Empire, and the rise and fall of the New Republic.
Yaun was a Human senator who represented Bureaucratosis in the Senate of the Galactic Republic on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
Mas Amedda was a Chagrian male politician who hailed from the planet Champala and served the chancelleries of Finis Valorum and Sheev Palpatine during the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era.

Lott Dod was a Neimoidian male politician who represented the Trade Federation in the Republic Senate during the final decades of the Galactic Republic Era. Dod rose to prominence after the ill-fated Eriadu Conference left a power vacuum in the Federation's leadership.

The "Jundland General" also known as "Tusken Chieftain" was a male Tusken Raider that lived on Tatooine. He built strategic bases for his Tusken brethren, and led various strategic attacks on settlements throughout his home planet.

Twazzi was a Frenk female bounty hunter who lived during the Clone Wars. Many years earlier, Twazzi's acrobatic skills earned praise from Finis Valorum, who at the time was the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.

Jennica Pierce was a member of the Rebel Alliance that held the rank of colonel during the Galactic Civil War. Before the Battle of Yavin, she was a moisture farmer on Tatooine, but the Empire's search for two droids destroyed both her family and her farm.

Ponda Baba was a male Aqualish thug who rescued Dr. Cornelius Evazan from a bounty hunter. The two formed a partnership and began to smuggle spice for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt, resulting in him becoming a wanted man.

Jan Dodonna was a legendary male human military officer from Commenor who served with the navy of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, within the navy of the Galactic Empire, and later, as a general in the rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

Kitmum was a female Wookiee Jedi who taught the Physical Education course at the Jedi academy on Coruscant during the time of Roan Novachez's attendance there. She put the students through an exhaustive course that was designed to test them to their physical limits.

Ramsis Dendup was a human male who served as the king of the planet Onderon during the Clone Wars, in which he tried to remain neutral. Dendup's vow for neutrality backfired, with the Separatists sweeping in and occupying the planet.

Zett Jukassa was a human male Padawan of the Jedi Order during the time of the Galactic Republic. He was present in the Jedi Archives, the Order's library within the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, in 22 BBY.
Cin Drallig was a Force-sensitive human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as Battlemaster and Chief of Security of the Jedi Temple during the Clone Wars.
Wat Tambor was a male Skakoan who was the foreman of the Techno Union, an executive of Baktoid Armor Workshop, and a general in the Separatist Droid Army.

San Hill was a male Muun and Chairman of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Clone Wars. He pledged the support of the Banking Clan to the Confederacy of Independent Systems and served as the financial cartel's representative on the Separatist Council.
Shu Mai was a female Gossam who served as Presidente of the Commerce Guild during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Passel Argente was a male Koorivar who was the Magistrate of the Corporate Alliance and a member of the Galactic Senate representing his homeworld, Kooriva, in the final days of the Galactic Republic.

Agen Kolar was a Force-sensitive Iridonian Zabrak male and was a Jedi Master in the era of the Galactic Republic. At his time in the order, he was considered to be a notable duelist, and sat on the Jedi High Council.
Saesee Tiin, a Force-sensitive Iktotchi male from the moon Iktotch, was a Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Stass Allie, a Force-sensitive Tholothian female, was a Jedi Master who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. She was also the cousin of Jedi Master and Jedi High Council member Adi Gallia.
Eeth Koth was a Force-sensitive Iridonian Zabrak male native to the planet Iridonia, who also held the title of Jedi Master within the Jedi Order.

Shi-Fara was a female Togruta Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant at the same time as Roan Novachez's attendance there. In her second year of attendance, she became the girlfriend of a fellow student, a Human named Pasha. She was a skilled droid creator.
Cronah was a male Zabrak Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. A skilled student, he was nevertheless a bully and troublemaker.
Gaiana was a Human female Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant at the same time of Roan Novachez's attendance there. She had already been training at the Academy when he came.

Bill was a male Sullustan Padawan who trained at the Jedi academy at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Like many other Bith, one of Bill's favorite hobbies was music. He was friends with Roan, Pasha, and Egon.

Tera Sinube was a Cosian male Jedi Master who lived during the height and later descent of the Galactic Republic. Sinube was the marshal of a Jedi outpost on Derra during the High Republic Era, and sat on the Jedi High Council sometime before the Invasion of Naboo.
Cyrus was a male Dathomirian Jedi Padawan who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. A skilled student, he was nevertheless a bully and troublemaker.
The mercenary Saponza and his partner ran a gang. The two established a base in the former's old homestead on Tatooine.

Pollux Hax was a male individual who served as the Minister of Information for COMPNOR for much of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's reign. He was tasked with keeping the journalists in check so their reports coincided with the Imperial propaganda.
Bacara, known also by his clone trooper designation CC-1138, was a clone trooper officer who held the military rank of Clone Marshal Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Fox, designated CC-1010, was a clone trooper officer who served as the Clone Commander of the Coruscant Guard during the Clone Wars.
Tu-Anh was a female Jedi Master who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic. She perished on Utapau toward the end of the Clone Wars while investigating a Separatist conspiracy.
Endente was a Sugi arms dealer who at some point made a deal with Governor Torul Blom and Count Dooku to provide the Confederacy of Independent Systems with a giant kyber crystal.
Mars Guo was a male Bardottan who participated in podraces during the reign of the Galactic Republic. The thin nosed Guo preferred a very large podracer which, despite its size, was rather fast.
Torul Blom was a male Pau'an politician who served as governor of Pau City on Utapau during the Clone Wars.
Dineé Ellberger was a human pilot who flew an N-1 starfighter as part of Bravo Squadron, specifically serving as Bravo Five, during the Invasion of Naboo.

Morad Sumar was a human farmer on Lothal, and an old friend of Ezra Bridger's parents. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, he struggled to keep his land from Imperial hands, refusing to sell it to them.

"LS-005" was a the callsign of a stormtrooper who served the Imperial Army. In 5 BBY, whilst stationed on the Star Destroyer Lawbringer, he was assigned by Agent Kallus to guard a cell containing Ezra Bridger.
Mr. Garfield was a male Dathomirian Jedi Master serving as an instructor at the Jedi academy at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's time of attendance there. Mr.

Garri was a male Toydarian who lived in Pau City on the planet Utapau during the Clone Wars. There, he operated an office building within the city where he was paid to allow a Separatist-backed arms deal to take place.

Gradd was a human male pilot who served as a commander in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. Late in the Galactic Civil War, he was assigned to the Devastator, one of the most prestigious Imperial-class Star Destroyers in the Imperial fleet under the command of Admiral J…

Porro Dolphe was a pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps. He flew in Bravo Squadron during the Invasion of Naboo as Bravo 2. A decade later, Captain Gregar Typho made Dolphe the lead pilot of the starfighter escort for the Royal Naboo cruiser.

Garven "Dave" Dreis, dubbed "Old Man" by the other pilots at Base One, was a male human and ace pilot from Virujansi who served as a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Nuvo Vindi was a brilliant yet insane male Faust scientist who was employed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Galus Vez was a Besalisk starship parts dealer who owned the space outpost Osisis Station during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Meena Tills, a Mon Calamari female, was the Galactic Republic senator from Mon Cala. She served with Tundra Dowmeia as Mon Cala's delegate to the Galactic Senate. By the end of the Clone Wars, Tills was part of the Delegation of 2,000 and signed the Petition of 2,000.

Marlo was a male Hutt born around 997 BBY that sat on the Grand Hutt Council, the leading governing body of the Hutt Clan on Hutta, during the Clone Wars, along with Jabba, Gorga, Arok, and Oruba. He was also a dealer in Zygerria's slave market.

Sango Rond was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Sarkos was an Assistant Vice Minister in the Galactic Empire's Ministry of Agriculture on Lothal, a woman with a rail-thin appearance.

Charko was a male Chagrian who led a gang of criminals known as the Sarlaccs on the planet Gorse. On several occasions the criminal unsuccessfully attempted to rob the pilot Kanan Jarrus, who broke the Chagrian's horn on the third attempt.

Droidbait, identified by the number CT-00-2010, was a clone trooper who served in Domino Squad, a clone cadet squad in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic.
A woman named Venta was the grandmother of Garri, a Toydarian who lived in Pau City on the planet Utapau in the Outer Rim Territories.

Greeata Jendowanian was a female Rodian who worked as a singer and dancer for the Max Rebo Band.

Sim Aloo was a human male businessman and bureaucrat who served as one of several advisers in Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's inner circle during the Galactic Civil War.
Moralo Eval, a male Phindian, was a criminal mastermind and serial killer active during the final years of the Republic Era.

Julia was a Force-sensitive Bardottan female and the Queen of the planet Bardotta. A member of the Dagoyan Order, one of her closest allies in the Republic Senate was Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks of Naboo. She was kidnapped by the Frangawl Cult during the Clone Wars.
Tiggs Leo was a Volpai who, during the Clone Wars, worked as the bartender at the Moshi Bar cantina on the planet Coruscant.
Sinrich was a male Snivvian bounty hunter who operated during the Clone Wars. He invented the holographic disguise matrix.
Dormé, formerly known as Dorra, was a human female handmaiden in the service of Senator Padmé Amidala during the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars. Dormé was her most devoted aide and confidant.

Leo Leonis was a human male agricultural scientist who worked for the Ministry of Agriculture of the Galactic Empire. He was married to Tepha Leonis and his daughter Dhara Leonis attended the Academy for Young Imperials on the planet Lothal.

O-Mer was a male Cerean Jedi youngling. Along with fellow younglings Kalifa and Jinx, he was captured on a training mission by Trandoshan hunters. The trio were deposited on the Trandoshan moon of Wasskah, where they were hunted for sport.

JTN-303 was a male stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire in the Imperial Army. He was stationed on Lothal on Grand Moff Tarkin's Imperial Star Destroyer, five years prior to the Battle of Yavin.

Sionver Boll was a female Bivall scientist contracted by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. A brilliant inventor and engineer, Boll was the head of her own laboratory that conducted weapons research and development for the Republic war effort.
Clu Lesser was a male Muun and spokesman of the Core Five, the leadership of the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

Mama was an elder female Hutt of the Hutt Clan prior to and during the Clone Wars. She was the mother of Ebor, Ziro, and Jabba Desilijic Tiure's father. She was also the grandmother of Jabba, and the great-grandmother of Rotta and Gorga.

Ebor was a male individual of the Tiure family, being the son of the Hutts Mama and Papa and the elder brother of Hutt crime lord Ziro Desilijic Tiure. Ebor was more well-mannered than his sibling, which Mama appreciated.

Nix Card was a male Muun who served as the InterGalactic Banking Clan's representative in the Galactic Senate. He also was the senator of his homeworld, the Outer Rim Territories planet of Muunilinst.
Vadoo was a bald, Sakiyan who was abducted by a group of Trandoshan hunters during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Okalin was a male Bivall who served Sanjay Rash, the reigning king of Onderon, as an advisor during the Clone Wars.
Sochek was a male Trandoshan hunter who was a member of Garnac's hunting guild. He was killed by Wookiees on the moon Wasskah.

Jira was a human female from Tatooine. At the time of the Naboo Crisis, the elderly Jira sold fruits, such as pallies, in the Mos Espa marketplace. She was a friend of Anakin Skywalker, then a nine-year-old slave boy.
Thorn was a clone shock trooper who held the rank of Clone Commander in the Galactic Republic's Coruscant Guard during the Clone Wars.
Phanuel was a musical artist who became a part of the Mon Calamarian diaspora scene around five years before the Battle of Yavin.

Papa was a male Hutt that became the husband of Mama, the father of Ebor and Ziro, the grandfather of Jabba, and the great-grandfather of Gorga and Rotta. He died at some point before the Clone Wars and was buried on the planet Teth.

Rodd Nertu was a male Rodian who lived on Lothal around five years before the Battle of Yavin. At some point, Nertu had a run-in with a squad of Imperial stormtroopers, but he was rescued by the young Ezra Bridger and the rest of the Spectres, though the Rodian was afraid of t…

Angmi Lihosh was a female human who lived on the planet Lothal in the year 4 BBY. Alongside Tsoklo and Lornto Teswam, she listened to a Ezra Bridger's broadcast denouncing the Galactic Empire. She later found herself at the mercy of Imperial stormtroopers.
Dorthu Santim was a male Ithorian. Around five years before the Battle of Yavin, he resided on Lothal.
Utani Xane was a Kallidahin male who served as a curator of Quarantine World III, a quarantined planet which housed the dangerous Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix.

Subsequently, a fleet consisting of three of Wurtz's Venator-class Star Destroyers and four Acclamator-class assault ships arrived above Christophsis under the command of Fleet Admiral Wullf Yularen and Yoda.
TK-421 was the designation of a human male Imperial stormtrooper who served on Lasan before he was stationed on the Death Star battle station.
Borkus was a male Sullustan who resided on the planet Abafar during the Clone Wars. There, he owned and cooked for his diner, Power Sliders, in Pons Ora.

Melee was a human female who lived in the spaceport Mos Espa on her homeworld Tatooine as a child. In 32 BBY, she visited the enslaved child Anakin Skywalker with several other children as he was working on a podracer that he planned to enter into the Boonta Eve Classic race.

Amee was a human girl who was born on the planet Tatooine in around 38 BBY. She was a close friend of the slave Anakin Skywalker and spent time socialising with him and his friends Wald and Kitster Banai.

After Rigosso greeted the bounty hunters at the planetary turbolift, which escorted Quarzite visitors below the planet's high-pressure surface, the Belugan major briefed the hunters on the mission and warned them of the dangers.

Gwarm was a male Weequay pirate who was second in command of the Ohnaka Gang, led by Hondo Ohnaka, that was active during the Clone Wars. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Gwarm formed and led his own gang.

Karina the Great was a Geonosian female who served as the queen of Geonosis and an ally of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. She reigned as the queen of the Stalgasin hive and Geonosis during the war.
"Gold Six" was the callsign of a clone trooper pilot who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Sanjay Rash was a human male monarch who ruled as King of Onderon during the Clone Wars. After taking the throne from his predecessor, King Ramsis Dendup, Rash gained the military support of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Silood was a Rodian male aide who worked for Senator Onaconda Farr during the Clone Wars. He gave the eulogy at Farr's funeral, after Farr was murdered by another aide, Lolo Purs.

Whorm Loathsom was a Kerkoiden general for the Retail Caucus, an organization loyal to the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. After winning several victories, he became a legend throughout the Core Worlds and the Inner Core.

Pluma Sodi was a young female Kage and sister of Krismo Sodi, the leader of the Kage Warriors. During the Clone Wars, the leader of her homeworld Quarzite, the Belugan Lord Otua Blank, sought her as his bride despite her young age.

Nakha Urus was a male Dug who served as the Doge of Malastare during the Clone Wars. He was waiting for the arrival of his fellow council members to sign a treaty between the Republic and the Dugs when the Zillo Beast attacked.
Daka, also known as Old Daka, was an elderly female Dathomirian witch and member of the Nightsister coven of witches who lived in the Nightsister lair on her homeworld Dathomir during the Clone Wars.

Knox was a male Nautolan Jedi Padawan who was the apprentice of Jedi Master Halsey during the Clone Wars. Alongside his master, he partook in the Republic defense of the Temple of Eedit, on the planet of Devaron.

Bene was a Force-sensitive human female Padawan of the Jedi Order who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In the waning days of the Clone Wars, Bene was killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader during the execution of Order 66 and the siege of the Jedi Temple.
Keri Belab was a female human from Lothal. Approximately five years before the Battle of Yavin, she became a target of the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers.
A red-skinned male Zeltron youngling was a member of the Jedi Order during the final decades of the Galactic Republic's reign.

Kleeve was a male Devaronian who served as a general in the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars. Toward the end of the war, Kleeve and his droids occupied the planet of Kaller, until the Galactic Republic troops led by Jedi Master Depa Billaba intervened.

Gamut Key was a Kalleran who served as provincial governor of the planet Kaller early in the reign of the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Grey, known also by the number CC-10/994, was a Clone Captain who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Assigned to Jedi General Depa Billaba, he was a Clone Commander in the general's battalions.
Styles was a clone trooper captain who served in the Galactic Republic's Grand Army under Jedi General Depa Billaba.

Nee Alavar was a Lorrdian senator of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. She became a member of the Delegation of 2,000, a group of senators concerned with the actions of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine during the war.

Amis was a Mandalorian human male cadet of the Royal Academy of Government on Mandalore during the Clone Wars. In the course of his academic career, he attended classes with several friends, including Korkie Kryze—nephew to Duchess Satine Kryze of the New Mandalorians.
Bolla Ropal was a male Rodian who served as a Jedi Master and Jedi General in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

Lyonie was a male Gungan who served as boss on the Gungan High Council during the Clone Wars. When the Galactic Republic needed aid against the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Mon Cala, the Gungan Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks persuaded Lyonie to send Gu…

Byph was a male Ithorian youngling who trained to become a Jedi during the Clone Wars. During the war, Byph and five other initiates were selected to travel to the planet Ilum and take part in the ritual known as the Gathering, where they would locate kyber crystals to use in …
Aks Moe was a Gran politician who served in the Galactic Senate during the waning years of the Republic Era.
Seek was a human male from the planet Tatooine. In 32 BBY, he and a group of friends visited the enslaved boy Anakin Skywalker in Mos Espa spaceport while Skywalker was working on a podracer.

Gubacher was a male Parwan engineer and doctor who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was an artificial intelligence specialist and operated a research and development lab in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, working closely with the Jedi in designing spy droids.

Pieter was a male Ming Po who served as Chieftain of Ming Po Town on the planet Carlac. During the Clone Wars he tried to remain neutral, but the Mandalorian Death Watch group made a base on Carlac and began bullying and kidnapping villagers from Pieter's town, greatly angerin…

Hay-Zu, who styled himself as the Big Hay-Zu, was a male Patitite native to the planet Patitite Pattuna. During the Clone Wars, he ruled over his species as a dictator, sending their children to fight his wars.
Yané, born Suyan Higin, was a human female, from the planet Naboo, who worked in the service of the Royal House of Naboo for a time.
Moteé was a human female. She served as a member of the Naboo Royal Handmaidens protecting Padmé Amidala during the final days of the Clone Wars.

Joy was one of five Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt inside the Wellspring of Life. She manifested as a being wearing a black robe and a cheerful mask, and acted in a manner befitting the emotional aspect she represented.
Confusion was one of five Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt inside the Wellspring of Life.
Rish Loo was a male Gungan minister who served as a member of the Gungan High Council during the Clone Wars.

Jaybo Hood was a ten-year-old human male who lived on the planet Iego during the Clone Wars. He was a mechanic who tinkered with Separatist battle droids and made them into his own army of personal servants.
Junn was a well connected human male criminal who used the self-styled title of lord and knew Princess Leia Organa of the planet Alderaan during her childhood.

Oon-ai was a human lieutenant who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, he became the adjutant of the Sith Lord Darth Vader at Grand General Cassio Tagge's command.

Gobi Glie, a male Rutian Twi'lek, was a political radical, balladeer, and revolutionary freedom fighter who took part in several rebel movements on his homeworld of Ryloth during the final years of the Galactic Republic and into the reign of its successor state, the Galactic E…
Ryoo Naberrie was a human female and the daughter of Sola Naberrie. She was also the maternal niece of Padmé Amidala, making her a cousin of Amidala's twins, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa.
Pooja Naberrie was a human female from Naboo whose mother was Sola Naberrie; she also had a sister, Ryoo. She attended the funeral of her aunt, Padmé Amidala, in 19 BBY.

The Unidentified Twi'lek pirate, was a male Twi'lek who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader during an attack on the pirate base where he was stationed.

The Unidentified Mon Calamari pirate, was a Mon Calamari who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. They were killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader during an attack on the pirate base they were stationed on.
The Unidentified Sullustan pirate was a male Sullustan who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader during an attack on his pirate base.
Onca was a male Ithorian bounty hunter who was in operation during the Clone Wars, together with his brother Bulduga.
Saw Gerrera was a human male Onderonian resistance fighter who, as a leading member of the Onderon rebels, fought against the Confederacy of Independent Systems on Onderon during the Clone Wars.

Zatt was a male Nautolan Jedi youngling who was a member of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. He participated in the gathering alongside: Petro, Gungi, Byph, Ganodi, and Katooni. The six younglings were led by Ahsoka Tano and instructed by Yoda.
Tryla was a female Ming Po who lived on Carlac during the Clone Wars. She was the granddaughter of her people's chieftain, Pieter.

Darts D'Nar was a male Zygerrian who worked with the Confederacy of Independent Systems and his homeworld's slave Empire during the Clone Wars. Allied with Count Dooku, he led Separatist forces to the planet Kiros and instrumented the kidnapping of a colony of Togruta.
This shuttle pilot was a male human who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, he was the pilot of the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle CZ-246.
Daultay Dofine was a Neimoidian Captain of the Trade Federation's Droid Control Ship the Vuutun Palaa during the Invasion of Naboo.
Atai Molec was the Zygerrian male Prime Minister to Queen Miraj Scintel during the Clone Wars. He was also captain of the Zygerrian Royal Guard.

Lagos was a Mandalorian human female cadet of the Royal Academy of Government on Mandalore during the Clone Wars. During her time at the academy, Lagos befriended Korkie Kryze—nephew to Duchess Satine Kryze of the New Mandalorians.
Gungi was a male Wookiee Jedi Padawan who trained to become a Jedi in the Jedi Order during the era of the Galactic Republic.

Numa was a Twi'lek female who lived on the planet Ryloth during the Clone Wars. As a youngling, the Separatists invaded her homeworld, and when they came to her town of Nabat, the townspeople were taken prisoner.

Orphne was a female Sollux who resided in the underworld of Aleen. A whimsical nymph who spoke in riddles, Orphne longed for balance on her world, and was capable of transforming into a shimmering cloud of pink light through the Force.

Roos Tarpals was a Gungan male who served in the Gungan Grand Army during the Invasion of Naboo and the Clone Wars. Prior to the Invasion of Naboo, he served as captain of a patrol in Otoh Gunga. After the Battle of Naboo, Tarpals was promoted to general.
Faro Argyus was a human male captain who served with the elite commandos of the Senate Guard during the Clone Wars.
Kalifa was a female human Jedi Initiate who once studied to become a Knight of the Jedi Order during the final years of the Galactic Republic.
Pablo was a Rodian male arms dealer who owned a pawnshop with his partner on the planet Nal Hutta during the Clone Wars.

Neeyutnee was a human female who served as the Queen of Naboo for much of the Clone Wars. After being elected as the successor to Queen Jamillia, she led her people through the Blue Shadow Virus crisis and other incidents.

Steela Gerrera was a female Onderonian human who lived on the planet Onderon during the Clone Wars. She fought with the Onderon rebels, and was their leader, taking the position from her older brother Saw Gerrera.

Jinx was a Twi'lek male Jedi Initiate from the planet Ryloth. During his Jedi training, he and two other Jedi younglings—Kalifa and O-Mer—went on a mission that saw them captured by hunters and taken to the Trandoshan moon Wasskah to be hunted for sport.
Mina Bonteri was a human female politician who represented her native planet Onderon and the wider Japrael sector in the Confederacy of Independent Systems Parliament during the Clone Wars.

Jiro was a male Weequay pirate who was a lieutenant in Hondo Ohnaka's Gang during the Clone Wars. Two years into the conflict, Jiro's ship was boarded by the renegade Sith Lord Maul and his brother Savage Opress, who demanded they give them their allegiance.
Morley was an Anacondan male native to the junk planet Lotho Minor who lived during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Kiera Swan was a female Weequay pirate-turned-bounty hunter in operation during the Clone Wars. Swan won the Obsidian Sphere twice.

This shuttle copilot was a male human who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, he was the copilot of the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle CZ-246, under the shuttle's pilot.
Agruss was a male Zygerrian enslaver and keeper of the Kadavo slave processing facility during the time of the Clone Wars.

A member of the Jedi Order flew a Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor with an astromech droid. At some point the starship crashed on the planet Vyndal, with the Jedi dead in the cockpit and the astromech destroyed.

Yeleb, also known as "Yeleb the Protector" or "Protector Yeleb," was a male human who settled on the planet Vyndal and joined a village built there. After finding a lightsaber, Yeleb was named protector of the village, and tried his hardest to defend its people.
Nossor Ri was a Quarren male chieftain active during the Clone Wars. Initially loyal to the Mon Calamari monarchy, he defected and led the Quarren Isolation League.
Liam was a Force-sensitive human Jedi youngling who trained in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during the Separatist Crisis. He was trained by Yoda, the Grand Master of the Jedi Order.
Wunka was an Ewok from Bright Tree Village on the moon Endor. During the Battle of Endor, Wunka and the other Ewoks sided with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Leektar was an Ewok elder of the Bright Tree tribe who lived in Bright Tree Village on the planet Endor.
Rystáll Sant was a female Theelin-human hybrid singer and dancer who worked for the Max Rebo Band. During the Galactic Civil War, she performed with the band in the palace of Jabba the Hutt.

x: Tech Mo'r was a male Bith musician who played an Ommni box as a regular member of the band Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes.
Tey How was a Neimoidian who served as a battleship pilot for the Trade Federation during its blockade and subsequent invasion of the planet Naboo.
Terr Taneel was a human senator for the Senex sector in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Colt was a Clone ARC Commander who served as the commanding officer of Rancor Battalion, along with Commanders Havoc and Blitz, during the Clone Wars, as part of the Grand Army of the Republic. He was killed by Asajj Ventress during the Battle of Kamino.

Naa'leth was a Dathomirian female. She was a member of the Nightsisters during the Clone Wars. She and her sister Karis aided Asajj Ventress in the attempt to assassinate Count Dooku on Serenno, which failed. Naa'leth was killed during the Battle of Dathomir.
Malé-Dee was a human male politician who served in the Senate of the Galactic Republic during the later stages of the Clone Wars.
Mak Plain was a male banker of the Muun species. He worked for the InterGalactic Banking Clan on Coruscant and Scipio, often acting as a liaison between the Bank and the Galactic Republic.

Tikkes was a Quarren senator who represented his homeworld Mon Cala in the Galactic Republic's Senate around the time of the Invasion of Naboo. He had been a businessman before joining the Senate and only became a senator to increase his own fortunes.

Cato Parasitti was a Clawdite female bounty hunter. During the Clone Wars, she was hired by Cad Bane to steal a valuable holocron from the archives of the Jedi Temple, which she managed by impersonating the deceased Jedi Master Ord Enisence and later Jocasta Nu.
Damono Deomaley was a short, male humanoid who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine shortly before the Battle of Yavin.

Gume Saam was a male Ishi Tib senator who represented the Techno Union in the Galactic Republic prior to and during the Clone Wars. During the conflict, he secretly furthered the interests of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Ciena Ree, known as LP888 in the Imperial Navy, was a human female First Waver villager from the planet Jelucan who fought for the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. She grew up as a friend of Thane Kyrell, a second-wave aristocrat.

Thane Kyrell, later designated AV547 in the Imperial Navy, was a human male from the mountainous and remote planet of Jelucan, an Outer Rim Territory that was annexed by the Empire eleven years before the Battle of Yavin.
Crost was a male Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during their attempt to assassinate Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Steen Borkas was a human male who worked for the Galactic Empire during the early years of its reign, serving on the Star Destroyer Perilous and then being stationed on the planet Ryloth.
Breehld was a human male who was the personal pilot of Imperial Moff Delian Mors, who controlled the planet Ryloth.
Erstin Deez was a human male who served in the Imperial Royal Guard, with the rank of sergeant and later major.
Drim was a male Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during their attempt to assassinate Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Davish "Pops" Krail was a human male from the planet Dantooine who served as a Y-wing pilot for the Rebel Alliance during the Battle of Yavin. Krail flew in Gold Squadron under the callsign Gold Five during the battle.
Pell Baylo was a male human who operated the Defiance Flight Training Institute for nearly fifty years, both under the Galactic Republic and its successor state, the Galactic Empire.
Bultar Swan was a Force-sensitive human female who trained as Jedi Master Plo Koon's Padawan before becoming a Jedi Knight.

Sar Labooda was a human female from the planet Chalacta who was orphaned by space pirates. She and her sister Depa Billaba were then rescued by the Jedi Mace Windu and joined the Jedi Order on the planet Coruscant.
Drua was a female Twi'lek who lived on Ryloth in a remote village settlement, along with her grandfather.

Murra was the wife of the Imperial Moff Delian Mors. In 18 BBY, she died in a transport accident on the planet Coruscant. Mors grieved her death for several years after her passing, choosing to adopt a hedonistic lifestyle and becoming apathetic toward her work as a moff.

Janus Greejatus was a human male official who served on the Ruling Council of the Galactic Empire. Prior to the Age of the Empire, he represented the office of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine at the homecoming of Poggle the Lesser on the planet Geonosis.

Sate Pestage was a human male official who served on the Ruling Council of the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, he served as a Senior Advisor of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine who sometimes acted as a bureaucrat, emissary, or a dignitary in Palpatine's name and one …

Kromer was the proprietor of the Bargoon Tatooni trading post in Mos Eisley on Tatooine. A few years before the Battle of Yavin, Han Solo visited her to acquire a replacement fulstar plate for the Millennium Falcon.

Itto Bipsmik was an Aleena Han Solo and Chewbacca met on Unagin a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin. She excused her two children for staring at Chewbacca because they'd never seen a Wookiee before.
Stim was a human male alive during the Clone Wars.

Uwa Pareece was a human female from the planet Alderaan who oversaw the Melodic Order, a group of Alderaanian musicians who had taken a vow to only have interaction with Alderaanians in order to preserve the cultural integrity of their music.

Jora Astane was a human female who held the title of Preserver in an enclave of Alderaanians on the planet Sullust. She led her collective and attempted to stay hidden after the destruction of Alderaan, when the Galactic Empire hunted surviving Alderaanians across the galaxy.

Hunter, formerly designated CT-9901, was a veteran Clone Sergeant who served as the commanding officer of Clone Force 99 in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars, fought between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Tundra Dowmeia was a Quarren who served as the senator of Mon Cala during the Clone Wars, replacing Senator Tikkes in the Republic Senate after his defection to the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Gord Grallik was a Besalisk security chief of the mining company Moonglow Polychemical on the planet Gorse eight years after the Clone Wars. He was married to the company's supervisor, Lal Grallik.

Crosshair, formerly designated CT-9904, was a veteran clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as part of Clone Force 99. Crosshair possessed genetic mutations that gave him exceptional eyesight and marksmanship skills.

Tech, formerly designated CT-9902, was a clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a member of Clone Force 99, also known as the "Bad Batch," and who later deserted the Galactic Empire.

Wrecker, formerly designated CT-9903, was a veteran clone commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as part of Clone Force 99. Due to genetic mutations, Wrecker was much larger and stronger than the average clone trooper.

Chi Cho was a Pantoran male politician and military leader who served as the Supreme Chairman of the Pantoran Assembly and the Exalted Ruler of the moon Pantora during the final decades of the Republic Era until his death during the Clone Wars.
Chubor was an Aleena Jedi General in the Clone Wars who led the Galactic Republic's effort to evacuate Mahran refugees during the Separatist genocide of their people.
Anger was one of five Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt on the Wellspring of Life.
Sadness was one of five Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt inside the Wellspring of Life.

Tivvy was a Sullustan male smuggler who lived on the planet Sullust. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, in 0 ABY, he led Princess Leia Organa of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, the rebel pilot Evaan Verlaine, and the astromech droid R2-D2 to Sullust's Alderaan Enclave.

Va Zhurro was a Jedi Master who was active in the last years of the Galactic Republic. At some point during the Clone Wars, a devastating three-year conflict that pitted the Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zhurro spent six months caring for refugees in…

Pok was a Twi'lek male who was a part of the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Eight years after the start of the Clone Wars, Pok led a team which hijacked and stole an Imperial transport carrying weapons from the Yaga Minor shipyards.

Fruun was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire in the Ryloth system five years after the end of the Clone Wars. Fruun served as a pilot in the Imperial Military, under the command of Colonel Belkor Dray.
Bornae was a young, light-skinned, human from the planet Alderaan. They lived in the Alderaan Enclave on the planet Sullust following their homeworld's destruction by the Galactic Empire.

Belkor Dray was a human male who served as an Imperial colonel on the planet Ryloth. Belkor, seeking advancement, secretly supported the anti-Empire Free Ryloth Movement in order to undermine his superior, Moff Delian Mors, for years committing treason against the Galactic Emp…
A Yalbec queen came into conflict with the Galactic Republic's Clone Force 99 while they were on Yalbec Prime, putting down an insurrection during the Clone Wars.

Maz Kanata, also known as Maz Kanata the Usurper, Kanata the Despoiler, Kanata the Benevolent, and Kanata of the Free Fleet, was a Force-sensitive female of an unknown species, who was born over a millennium before the brewing war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Phasma, a human female stormtrooper captain of the First Order, grew up as a member of the Scyre clan on the nuclear-ravaged world of Parnassos, where she became a formidable warrior, eventually becoming the clan's military leader.

The Fifth Brother was a humanoid male Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire several years before the Battle of Yavin. On the orders of the Emperor, Darth Sidious, the Fifth Brother was dispatched by the Sith Lord Darth Vader to hunt the growing rebellion against the Empire.

Mul Sanaka was a human who owned and managed the entertainment establishment Club Deeja in the city of Keren on the planet Naboo. During the Galactic Civil War, he employed the Melodic Order, a band of Alderaanian musicians managed by Uwa Pareece.

Quarrie was a Mon Calamari male who built a prototype B-wing starfighter on the remote planet Shantipole some time after the Siege of Lothal. After the B-wing was used in the blockade of Ibaar, Project Shantipole continued under Quarrie's supervision.
Janus Kasmir was a Kalleran male who lived as a scoundrel on the planet Kaller around the time of Order 66.
The Seventh Sister was a female Mirialan Inquisitor who served the Galactic Empire and operated as a Jedi hunter in the years before the Battle of Yavin.
Mixx was the name adopted by a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic, with the military rank of Corporal, during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Gha Nachkt was a Trandoshan salvage ship captain who worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the intergalactic Clone Wars.

Mala was a Twi'lek who lived in a remote, technologically primitive village on the planet Ryloth. Around eight years after the start of the Clone Wars, Galactic Emperor Darth Sidious, his Sith apprentice Darth Vader and Sergeant Erstin Deez of the Emperor's Royal Guard arrived…

Nashi was a male Hutt who served Jabba the Hutt of the Hutt Clan. Around eight years after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Nashi was sent as an envoy to visit Delian Mors, Imperial Moff of the planet Ryloth.
Mirsil was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.
Veraul was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.
Div was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.

The grandfather of Drua was a male Twi'lek native of the planet Ryloth. He lived in an isolated village with his granddaughter, during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Drua's grandfather took responsibility for Drua after her mother died.

"Bracchia" was the code name of a male Koorivar spy who worked for both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, he assisted Wilhuff Tarkin's anti-Shadowfeed operation on Murkhana.
Morit Astarte was a male human born to the Astarte line of Celanon during the last years of the Galactic Republic. He was the twin brother of Aiolin Astarte and had a yellow lightsaber.
Mar Tuuk was a male Neimoidian who bore the rank of captain in the Confederacy of Independent Systems' naval branch during the Clone Wars.

The Yuzzum male Wam Lufba, nicknamed "Bam," was born on the moon of Endor, but left on a visiting starship. He ended up being shanghaied into working as a pest exterminator at the palace of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.

Logray was a male Ewok from the forest moon of Endor who served as the chief shaman of Bright Tree tribe during the Galactic Civil War. At one point during the war, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, R2-D2, and C-3PO were brought to the tribe.

Janus Fhurek was a male human who served as the athletic director at the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences on the planet Lothal. With the academy's heavy focus on athletics, Fhurek was generally believed to hold more power and influence than even the Academy's headmaster.
Cylo was a humanoid male doctor who cybernetically enhanced himself into an immortal system capable of assuming another body when the previous one died.
Wuher was a human male from Tatooine who worked as a bartender at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.

Bob Hudsol was a male human who served as a sector commander and general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Hudsol was killed when his starship was destroyed during the assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks.

Pikk Mukmuk was a Kowakian monkey-lizard kept as a pet by Hondo Ohnaka alongside his brother Pilf. Pikk was a member of the Ohnaka Gang, helping Hondo Ohnaka to do his dirty work. At some point, Ohnaka lost Mukmuk and stated that he never truly appreciated him until he was gone.
Aiolin Astarte was a female human engineered and trained by Doctor Cylo to replace the Sith Lord Darth Vader as Darth Sidious' Sith apprentice.

Arkan, also known by the nickname Arkan the Shark, was a Human male who was the owner and "Supreme Executive Officer" of the Lucky Runner casino on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Galactic War, a position he obtained by first murdering his way into the casino and then murderin…

Snoke was a Force-sensitive humanoid male who ruled the First Order as Supreme Leader during the New Republic Era and was considered to be a enigmatic seeker of arcane lore who possessed a dark nature from the Unknown Regions.

Tralls was the Current Events teacher at the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences in Lothal's Capital City. As a teacher, Mister Tralls used his Current Events classes to promote propaganda defending the Galactic Empire's developmental projects.

Havoc was a Clone Commander and Advanced Recon Commando who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars as a member of Rancor Battalion. He served as part of the Galactic Republic's military leadership during the Battle of Kamino, in which he perished.
Simon Greyshade was a wealthy senator who represented the Vorzyd sector in the Senate of the Galactic Republic shortly before the onslaught of the Clone Wars, in 22 BBY.

Sana Starros, also called Sanisi by her family, was a human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was once a student at the University of Bar'leth, where she had a romantic relationship with Chelli Lona Aphra.
Thongla Jur was an Anx Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Karbin was a Mon Calamari commander born on the planet Mon Cala in the Outer Rim and a member of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Towards the end of the conflict, his starship was damaged, causing him considerable and untreatable injuries.

Bragh was a human male Purge Trooper commander who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Following the destruction of the second Death Star, he fought for Governor Ubrik Adelhard's remnant.

homeworld: Orphaned on Burnin Konn mining colony
x: Riley was a human female thief active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Riley and her younger sibling were orphaned on the mining colony of Burnin Konn.
Faylin was a human female who was part of the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Eshgo was a Twi'lek male who was part of the Free Ryloth Movement on the planet Ryloth during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Ubrik Adelhard was a human male officer for the Galactic Empire who served as the governor of the Anoat sector with the rank of Moff during the Galactic Civil War.
Ria Clarr was a human female analyst and geologist who worked for the Galactic Empire until she became a rebel after discovering lies behind Imperial propaganda.

Brask was a Trandoshan male active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Shortly after the destruction of the second Death Star, he operated a requisitions depot on the planet Burnin Konn, located in the Anoat sector.
This puffer pig belonged to the self-described galactic entrepreneur and gambler Lando Calrissian during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Lilly was a female Near-Human Jedi Padawan learner. She had pointed ears and a canine nose, but otherwise appeared physically Human. In Roan Novachez's third year at the Jedi academy, she was a new transfer student.
Jovan was a male human who served in the military forces of the Galactic Empire in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
TK-517 was the operating number of an Imperial stormtrooper who was stationed on Lothal a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Tulon Voidgazer was a human genius who was engineered and trained by Doctor Cylo to replace the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader as Darth Sidious' enforcer.
MaDall was a Zygerrian female who operated a small enslavement empire on the planet of Oon during the Age of the Empire.
Klaatu was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto gambler who worked for Jabba the Hutt repairing the crime lord's skiffs. Klaatu also took enjoyment in Jabba's executions by rancor in Jabba's Palace.

Toryn Farr was a human female who served as a communications officer in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Toryn and her sister Samoc Farr joined the Rebellion at a young age and became the best in their areas.

Ramset (nicknamed "Ramsy" by students) was an elderly Duros man who coached the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences' grav-ball team, the AppSci SaberCats. He lived in the Capital City of Lothal, an Outer Rim planet that was part of the Galactic Empire.

Gor was a roggwart whom Kaleesh General Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems kept as a pet during the Clone Wars. Gor guarded his master's fortress on the third moon of the planet Vassek; he was tended to by the medical droid EV-A4-D whenever Grievous was away.
In 4 BBY, a female human was enslaved as part of an empire of a Zygerrian named MaDall. As such, the human was forced to work in a quarry, under the surveillance of several Falleen taskmasters.
Kharrus was a Gran male politician who served as the senator of Kinyen in the Republic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was an ally of fellow Senator Padmé Amidala.
Turk Falso was a male Weequay member of the Ohnaka pirate gang. Falso was present when Hondo Ohnaka captured Count Dooku—leader of the Separatist Alliance—on Florrum during the Clone Wars.

Pilf Mukmuk was a Kowakian monkey-lizard member of the Ohnaka Gang. He also had a brother, Pikk. Mukmuk was responsible for stealing the lightsabers of Anakin Skywalker and Count Dooku, allowing the Ohnaka Gang to capture Dooku on Florrum during the Clone Wars.
El-Les was an Arcona male bounty hunter whom the Galactic Republic employed as a drill instructor for the Grand Army clone troopers after Jango Fett died.
Ox was a clone trooper who during the Clone Wars served under Lieutenant Trap in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company.
Pulsar was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic's Tango Company during the Clone Wars.
JJR-579 was a male stormtrooper in service to the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army. In 4 BBY, he was stationed on Grand Moff Tarkin's Imperial Star Destroyer, the Sovereign, based on Lothal.

Fissol was a male Ithorian bounty hunter who worked with the Gamorrean hunter Gowski. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the pair learned of a Jedi on the planet Lothal from a Duros bounty hunter and traveled there in order to claim the bounty on the Jedi.

Naria was a Twi'lek who resided in a remote village on the planet Ryloth. By 14 BBY, they were expecting a child. That year, Drua, a fellow villager, welcomed the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Vader to the village—unaware of their true identities.

Narmn was a green-skinned male Twi'lek from Ryloth who resided in a remote village. He stood guard for the village and was present when Drua—a fellow villager—welcomed Darth Sidious, Darth Vader and Erstin Deez to their village.

A female individual was the mother of the Twi'lek girl Drua, a child who lived on the planet Ryloth during the Imperial Era. The mother died in a winter season around 16 BBY, which left Drua an orphan, as the girl had never known her father.
Ion Papanoida was a Pantoran male who lived during the Clone Wars. The son of Chairman Notluwiski Papanoida, Ion was the brother of Chi Eekway Papanoida and Che Amanwe Papanoida.
Malakili was a human male from the planet Corellia who spent much of his childhood living in the slums of the moon Nar Shaddaa.

Taggart was a human who served as a captain and notable member of the Galactic Republic's elite Senate Guard during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Lassa Rhayme was a Pantoran female pirate who served as the captain of the Opportunity and leader of the Blood Bone Order during the Clone Wars.
Tace was a female human musician who was a member of the Melodic Order during the Galactic Civil War. She was also sister to Tula, an Imperial officer.

Paddy Accu was an elderly male human who lived on the planet Naboo shortly before the outbreak of the Clone Wars. He worked as the caretaker of Varykino, an island retreat owned by the Naberrie family in the Lake Country area of Naboo.

Hewex was a male human who served as a major in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Hewex led Imperial Navy Troopers alongside Colonel Dyer.

Merumeru was a male Wookiee chieftain and captain from the planet Kashyyyk. In the last days of the Clone Wars, he led a group of Wookiee warriors into battle against the Confederacy of Independent Systems on his homeworld.

Momaw Nadon, also known as "Hammerhead," was a male Ithorian who was exiled from his homeworld of Ithor as punishment for revealing the agricultural secrets of his species to the Galactic Empire in order to save the planet.
Kin Robb was a human female politician who represented the planet Taris in the Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

affiliation: Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart
x: Ephant Mon was a Chevin male from the planet Vinsoth who worked as a mercenary before deciding it was less dangerous to sell weapons as an arms dealer than it was to use them.
Po Nudo was a male Ualaq Aqualish who represented his homeworld of Ando in the Galactic Republic's Senate around the time that the Trade Federation invaded the planet Naboo.

Saelt-Marae was a Yarkora male who worked as an informant for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. He would pose as a merchant and uncover plots against the Hutt while at Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine.
Theron Nett was a human who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a rebel pilot in Red Squadron during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Orrimaarko was a male Dressellian who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Dreed was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a commander during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Dreed was tasked with hunting down Alderaanians who had survived the destruction of their homeworld of Alderaan.
An Alder-Espirion hybrid from the planet Espirion served as the captain of the starship Espirion Multi during the war between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance.
