Thea Novotin was a female individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Miur Poljunu was a male bioengineer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Handa Nobreg was a female scientist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Gerrick Lond was a male Ishi Tib who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Lond served the Hutt known as Jabba Desilijic Tiure by attending to guests in Jabba's town house on Tatooine.

Lina Graf was a young female human whose parents worked as frontier explorers. One day, Graf's parents were kidnapped by agents of the Galactic Empire, leaving her and her brother Milo alone on a remote planet.
Milo Graf was a human male who was the son of Auric and Rhyssa Graf, two frontier explorers who charted the unknown regions of Wild Space.

Adea Rite was a female human who served as Admiral Rae Sloane's personal assistant after the Battle of Endor. She was present during the abortive Imperial emergency summit on the planet Akiva. Rite was taken captive by New Republic forces during the Rebellion on Akiva.
Xomit Grunseit was a Falleen male and the leader of Black Sun during the Clone Wars, operating out of the Black Sun fortress on the planet Mustafar.
Kisha was a Human female dancer who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Riljcha Voruste was a male Quarren who served Belhata the Hutt during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Toedri was a male Quarren prefect who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, he was in some way involved with the Azure Cabal.

Sevox was a male human who lived on Andelm IV during the Galactic Civil War. His body rejected implants, so after he lost his eyes, he spliced into his protocol droid, I-7, as a means of vision. Sevox was friends with Zarro, a human girl, who ran errands for him.

Kai was a male human who served as a commander in the Galactic Empire following the Battle of Yavin. He was stationed aboard an Imperial Star Destroyer that traveled to the remote Outer Rim world of Andelm IV.

Bastian was a human male lieutenant and starfighter pilot of the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. He participated in the assault on Starkiller Base as a member of Red Squadron, a group of T-70 X-wing starfighters.
Kelemer was a Duros miner in the beetle caverns on Andelm IV.
Sova was a Human male corporal of the Galactic Empire who defected to the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kweeta was a male Rodian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
The First Order stormtrooper FN-417 was one of many deployed to the planet Takodana in 34 ABY to recover the Resistance astromech droid BB-8.
Reely Sugg was a male Chiss who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Shelish was a female Dathomirian and a member of the Nightsister coven of Dathomiri witches. She left her homeworld of Dathomir when she was young and thus consequently, she survived the slaughter of her sisters by the Separatist Droid Army leader General Grievous during the C…

Owacchi was a male Wookiee who used to be part of the Starhowl Pirates. When his comrades betrayed him, Owacchi joined the Nightsister Shelish, becoming her right-hand man and staying with her on the jungle moon Jhas Krill.

Seljin Kuric was a male Rodian major of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as the second in command and liaison between the Wookiee resistance and Rebel Alliance on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

TK-338 was a human First Order stormtrooper present at the Battle of Takodana during the early stages of the First Order-Resistance War. Another stormtrooper reported to TK-338 that the targets, consisting of Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Finn, were in custody.

Amrosio was a Nothoiin male who lived in the Anoat sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Able to wield the power of the Force, Amrosio became an acolyte of Xiath, a respected mentor to the reclusive Noble Court.

Izby was a female barghest who was the loyal and protective pet of Gwellis Bagnoro, an Onodone forger. Shortly before the Battle of Takodana, Izby and Bagnoro spent most of their time in the castle of Maz Kanata.

A chief ruled over a village of natives on the planet of Vyndal at some point between the Great Jedi Purge and the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. One day, he met Yeleb, a marooned human male who pretended to be a Jedi.

An alien boy was among the natives of Vyndal who lived in the village protected by Yeleb, a marooned human who posed as a Jedi. One day, they and their mother encountered Kanan Jarrus, a real Jedi who had been forced to land on Vyndal to repair his starship.
In the third year before the Battle of Yavin, a human male officer of the Galactic Empire liaised with Fenn Rau, the leader of the Protectors of Concord Dawn, on the third moon of Concord Dawn.
Heff Jofer was a male Bith Corellian collector who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Dool was a Human male officer of the Corellian Security Force who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Sheelya was a Human female who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was married with a member of the Corellian Security Force. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, Sheelya lost her house keys to some Greck thugs while her husband was in mission.
Millbarge was a Human male Dantooine collector who lived during the Galactic Civil War.
Drenn Zebber was a male Twi'lek who stayed on Yaivn 4 during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Sundre Korbeth was a female foreman who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Pelig was a male scout who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kalesh was a Hutt assassin who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Yosena Tule was a Human female captain of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and a tactical officer of the Wookiee resistance who operated on Kashyyyk during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Fawn Moonraiser was an elderly Human female who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Ren Parteun was a male Twi'lek who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Denbar was a Human male who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Kodo Kara was a male Twi'lek who was on board the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Blackguard during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Takouhi McCumber was a male Aqualish who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, he provided information about the Greck criminals to the Tyrena city councilmen Lyman Zavala.
Gipson Coloda was man criminal who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was the right hand of the crime lord Olag Greck.
Alasdair Bumbalough was a male criminal who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked for the crime lord Olag Greck.
Raglith was a male Sanyassan who lived on Endor with his fellow Marauders during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
A human served as one of the First Order's stormtroopers assigned to Starkiller Base. They reported a sensor trigger in Hangar 718 to Kylo Ren and sent additional troopers to investigate.

"Bogey" was the nickname of a Kwazel Maw that the Gungan Representative Jar Jar Binks encountered and befriended during a mission to Rodia in the Clone Wars. Bogey later played a key role in capturing the Trade Federation Viceroy Nute Gunray.

Gron was a Lasat male member of the Lasan High Honor Guard. After the near-extermination of his species, Gron rejected violence in his fight against the Galactic Empire, and along with Chava the Wise he searched for Lira San, a legendary refuge for Lasats.

Chava, also known as Chava the Wise, was a female Lasat mystic who survived the fall of Lasan at the hands of the Galactic Empire. She became a refugee and, along with former Lasan High Honor Guardsman Gron, was rescued from Imperial captivity by the rebel crew of the Ghost.
Ra Sara was a male Twi'lek criminal who worked as a jeweler in the Anoat sector during its blockade by the Galactic Empire, which they established following their defeat at the Battle of Endor.

Xuvi Ruun was a female Zabrak who lived in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. She had a background in diplomacy, allowing her to exude compassion and trustworthiness when speaking to people.
Swain was a young human female Imperial officer. At the time of the insurgency on the planet of Lothal, she trained under Kallus to become an agent of the Galactic Empire's Security Bureau.

Cogon was a male human who served as an officer of the Galactic Empire until he deserted a few years prior to the Battle of Yavin. Before he could defect to the rebels, he was captured by the Imperial Security Bureau.
Janard was a male human who lived on Mandalore during the Age of the Empire.
Lyman Zavala was a male Twi'lek politician who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he was a city councilmen in Tyrena.
Kune'Gunde was a male Quarren who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Pilar VanDeef was a Human male on Tatooine who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, he was abducted by the criminals of the White Thranta Shipping Company.

Kashi VanDeef was a Human female who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, her husband Pilar VanDeef was abducted by the criminals of the White Thranta Shipping Company.
Surlin Rolei was a Human male member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Taron was a male Trade Federation loyalist who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Aigorn was a female Trandoshan who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, she tasked a spacer with eliminating one of the medical staff from the White Thranta Shipping Company and steal medical data from the White Thra…
Begol Toulin was a male Bothan who lived in Mos Eisley, on Tatooine, during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Shan'ri Toulin was a female Bothan who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Shan'ri lived in Mos Eisley where she died after getting hooked on death sticks. Her father Begol later asked a spacer to enact revenge against a number of spice dealers.
Bognar was a male Bith who lived during the Galactic Civil War.

Keska' Cay was a male Ualaq Aqualish assassin who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, Keska' Cay worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Lyrissa was a Human female moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Dren Feelu was a Human male moisture farmer who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin, Dren requested a spacer with retrieving his harvester droid, a retasked LIN demolitionmech, that was stolen by Jawas.
Texe was a male individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Krosh was a female Zabrak Tatooine collector who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Goll was a Twi'lek male who served in the Free Ryloth Movement during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He helped hunt down Darth Vader and Emperor Sheev Palpatine when the movement destroyed the Star Destroyer Perilous and shot their shuttle down.

Roach was a human female and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company. She was recruited by First Sergeant Hazram Namir and Quartermaster Hober on her home planet of Haidoral Prime in 3 ABY.
The wife of Ubrik Adelhard, a male human who served as the Imperial governor of the Anoat sector, was murdered by the Kouhun, a secret order of assassins based on the planet of Mataou.

Elenzia was a female human and a member of the Noble Court, an assembly of exiled aristocrats whose ancestors ruled the Anoat sector in the pre-Republic times. She had a brother, who stayed with her for a time in her apartments in Cloud City.

Brother Cyst was a male Duros and a member of the Kouhun, a secretive and mystical order of assassins operating in the Anoat sector. A turquoise-skinned Duro, he had a gouged-out right eye and a humped back. He developed dozens of poisons for the Kouhun.
Line was a member of the Kouhun, a secret society of assassins that operated in the Anoat sector. At some point during the Iron Blockade, Line was asked to either kill or abduct an Imperial enslaver.

Dazur Dar, also known as the Data Broker, was a male Abednedo and a member of the mysterious Data Seekers. Like all his comrades, Dar bartered secrets like currency, but he also traded a vast number of rare items discovered in the Seekers' travels.

Ransolm Casterfo, later identified as Prisoner 876549C during his imprisonment, was a human male politician who served as a member of the Galactic Senate of the New Republic several decades after the Galactic Civil War.
Habbel was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Ndizz was a male Kubaz and a member of the Trade Spine League. Despite his unquivering loyalty to the League, he had tried to overthrow its leadership twice by the time of the Iron Blockade.
Vannotte was a female Ithorian who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Seripas was a diminutive Ssori male bounty hunter from Ssori Fragments, who wore a mechanical suit of armor to make him appear average humanoid size.

Ooblamon was a Kubaz thief who, alongside his apprentice Vermia, met with several Acolytes of the Beyond on the planet Taris in a business transaction, in which he sold them a lightsaber that he claimed had belonged to the Sith Lord Darth Vader, sometime after the Battle of En…

During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the father of Riley and her sibling was a miner on the Burnin Konn mining colony in the Anoat sector. When his children were still young, Anoat was poisoned by an industrial accident, and the news of this hit him hard.

A human male known as the Burnin Konn Champion was one of many individuals who came to the call to defend the mining world of Burnin Konn. He rose to prominence within the defenders, becoming a champion to the people of that planet.
Degno was a male Gran who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Anya Razar was a human female who trained at the Imperial academy on Arkanis. Born on Coruscant, Razar was an ambitious student who strongly desired to become a member of a secretive group at the academy known as the Commandant's Cadets.
Kain Apollyon was a musician who specialized in quenk jazz. Sabine Wren enjoyed listening to Apollyon's quenk jazz music, as well as that of Mooneyes.
Arno Xan was an Abednedo criminal who lived in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. Xan built a collection of stolen Imperial armors, which notably included a set of stormtrooper armor.

Yushyn was a Moyn male who worked as the boss of a Mining Guild Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery in the year 3 BBY. Staffed by Rodian employees, Yushyn's facility refined Clouzon-36 gas, which was used as fuel by the Galactic Empire.

The Purrgil King was a large male purrgil who led a group of purrgil. He was multicolored showing that he was the leader as well as bigger than the other purrgil in the group. He befriended Ezra Bridger and saved his life.
Magaloof was a criminal Leffingite male from the species' homeworld Almak who worked as a speeder thief on the planet Coruscant.

Yolo Ziff was a human male artist who flew for the Resistance during its conflict against the First Order. In 34 ABY, Ziff created propaganda for the Resistance, and he participated in the Battle of Starkiller Base, flying under the command of Black Leader Poe Dameron.
Cypress was a male human who served as a general in the ground forces of the Resistance, a paramilitary group founded by Leia Organa to monitor and oppose the actions of the First Order.

A male individual came to be the parent of the Twi'lek Numa, who was born four years prior to the Clone Wars. They, along with Numa and her mother, lived within a home in Nabat, a small city on the Twi'lek homeworld Ryloth.
A female individual was the mother of the Twi'lek Numa, who was born four years before the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Separatist Alliance.
Bedal Cerroux was a male individual from Eriadu who served as an Imperial cadet at the the Arkanis Academy.

Chan Harra was a female individual who served as an Imperial cadet at the Arkanis Academy. Tall and pale, she had an interest in joining the academy's secretive group of cadets known as the Commandant's Cadets, but had never received an invitation.

Ratch was a male Rutian Twi'lek scavenger and captain of the salvage freighter Raider. He recovered Asajj Ventress from her Ginivex-class fanblade starfighter after she was left to die at the Battle of Sullust.

A human male served as a pilot in the Galactic Empire approximately four years before the Battle of Yavin. He transported Zare Leonis from Lothal to Arkanis following Leonis's acceptance into the ranks of the Arkanis Academy.

Sixess was a female Mirialan who worked in the Shadow Market as a saboteur trainer for the Kouhun at the time of the Iron Blockade. She was skilled in the use of incendiary grenades, ion waves, mines, and sticky bombs.

Tigard Manes was a individual who served as a cadet for the Galactic Empire at the officers' academy on Arkanis. Manes was one of several individuals that Zare Leonis, who had infiltrated the academy in order to try to rescue his sister, met shortly upon arrival.
Sian Tevv was a councillor on the planet Sullust who was affiliated with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Shizu was a Hutt who built the Hutt Guard Droid RZ-4 prior to his death by 4 ABY. A dozen security chiefs had previously disappointed him, inspiring the Hutt to build RZ-4 as their replacement.
De Grom was an individual who served as a cadet for the Galactic Empire at the Academy for Young Imperials on Lothal.

Uhika was a female individual who served as a governor at some point prior to the Imperial lock down of the Anoat sector. When she was still alive, Uhika forced the Nikto Cult of Chak'ror to serve as her personal shock troops, threatening to have them annihilated if they refused.
Kinera Tiree was the daughter of the Imperial education minister Fondana Tiree on Lothal. She was a student at Phelarion School, an upper-crust school in Lothal's Capital City.
Nho Vantes was a paranoid black market merchant who was active in the Anoat sector during the Galactic Civil War.

Philo was a Gran male senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was one of the senators who opposed the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill and called a meeting in the lobby to discuss it, unaware that bounty hunters were in the Senate too.

Jakker-Sun was an Ithorian male senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. He was one of a small group of senators who wanted to stop a vote on the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill and attended a meeting of those opposed to the bill in the Senate Building t…

Dantum Roohd was a male human senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. During the war, Roohd was part of the Council of Neutral Systems, an outlier political wing of the Pacifist faction in the senate.

Zinn Paulness was a human male senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars. During the war, Paulness was part of the Council of Neutral Systems, an outlier political wing of the Pacifist faction in the senate, yet also displayed a hawkish attitude towards t…
Aurelant, a Draedan native to the aquatic world of Sesid, was born into a family with seventeen brothers and twenty-two sisters.

Draa was a clone trooper who served in the 41st Elite Corps during the Clone Wars. He took part in the Second Battle of Geonosis, under the command of Jedi Master Luminara Unduli and Clone Commander Gree, after the native Geonosians broke free from the Republic control that ha…

Finn Ertay was a Twi'lek female who served the Galactic Republic as a Jedi during the Clone Wars. Ertay and a Kajain'sa'Nikto Jedi encountered the brothers Maul and Savage Opress on a spaceport somewhere in the Outer Rim Territories.

Eekar Oki was a Mon Calamari male who served the Galactic Republic as a Jedi during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Oki was present in a meeting of members of the Jedi Order after they were contacted by Confederate General Grievous during his imprisonment of Jedi Master Eeth Koth, …

Rod was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Malastare, he served as the gunner for clone trooper pilot Goji, who deployed an electro-proton bomb prototype that was instrumental in the Republic's ensuing victory.

Goji was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Malastare, they flew a Y-wing starfighter and was responsible for deploying the electro-proton bomb, an experimental weapon that secured the Republic's victory.
Okuvim the Younger, colloquially known as Okuvim, was a Twi'lek female who served as a scout in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during its war against the Galactic Empire.

Magé was a governor of the Galactic Empire who worked as an administrator on the planet Allst Prime. When the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry attacked the Imperial outpost on the planet, the governor identified the company's starship and spoke about the rebels over her c…
Nordon was a male Twi'lek pilot who served his planet in Cham Syndulla's Free Ryloth Movement. He played a major role in the events following the Destruction of the Star Destroyer Perilous.

Kars Tal-Korla was a pirate who resided in Cloud City, where he became known as the "Scourge of Cloud City." When the Iron Blockade was established by the Galactic Empire, Tal-Korla was hired by Lobot to help apprehend Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard, although the pirate was …
Trella Bare'Ah was a female Twi'lek who worked as a dancer and was romantically involved with the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo during the Clone Wars.
Droogan was a male Khramboan vendor on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. They managed to swindle the protocol droid C-3PO out of thirty two credits when the droid was shopping for jogan fruit.
Roo-Roo Page was a female Gungan from Jan-gwa born before the Clone Wars. Unknown to most, Page was Force-sensitive.
Meymik was a male Chadra-Fan who had a criminal career in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. He claimed to have once been a personal enforcer of Jabba the Hutt, but these claims were fabricated.

Erudo Ro-Kiintor was a human male that served as the senior senator from Hevurion in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic, where Ro-Kiintor was part of the political party known as the Centrists which advocated a stronger central government and a powerful military in the Ne…

A crime lord operated a massive gambling den on Stenness in the years before the Galactic Civil War. The crime lord had a reputation for double-crossing spice smugglers, so the smuggler Han Solo devised a plan to rob the crime lord to get revenge.

A Lasat mercenary worked for Saw Gerrera and his Partisans during their campaigns on the planet Onderon around 18 BBY. A squad of Imperials, including Alexsandr Kallus, was sent to Onderon to deal with the rebels. This mercenary killed most of the unit, but spared Kallus.

Baela Tiwosh was a female Zabrak who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Shortly before the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, Tiwosh and two other Rebel operatives entered the sector but were unable to leave when the blockade began.
Mizel Pomdak was a young human and a member of the rebellion, a loose network of resistance fighters opposing the Galactic Empire.
Nymos Lyle was a male who served as the executive officer to Admiral Rae Sloane on board the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vigilance during the Galactic Civil War.

Wee Dunn was an infant Rodian male who lived on Rodia with his mother, Mahtee Dunn, during the Clone Wars. At an early age, he was discovered to be a Force-sensitive, and was to become part of the Jedi Order once he was old enough.

Mahtee Dunn was a female Rodian who lived on Rodia with her son, Wee Dunn, during the Clone Wars. Her son was a Force-sensitive, and he was to become a member of the Jedi Order once he was old enough.

Loubo, sometimes addressed as Lou, was a chef working at Plop Dribble's on Stobar. He was present when Savage Opress assaulted his human colleague Sassi, and attempted to intervene but was thrown back when Savage tossed her at him.
Bec Lawise was a Siniteen male politician who served as the Separatist Congress Leader in the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Thetis Quelton was a human female who owned the armor production company Quelton Fabrication on her homeworld Gilvaanen. Quelton was a great lover of history and hated the Empire for destroying it on many worlds.

Morq was a male Kowakian monkey-lizard kept as a pet by Milo Graf. He was fond of eating, and regarded clip beetles as a treat. One of his descendants, Noni was kept as a pet by Milo's grandson, Emil Graf.

The Mysterious Advisor was the title used by a female human who resided in the Anoat sector of the galaxy. She had a diplomatic background, preferring defense over offense, and at the time of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade, the advisor joined the crew of a young smuggler.

Nazgorigan was a male Jablogian trader and conman who operated on the planet of Thune, in Wild Space. Being overweight like all members of his species, he used to move about in a personal hover-saucer.

Max was a Twi'lek who fought for the Twi'lek Resistance during the Battle of Ryloth. During the initial stages of the Confederacy of Independent Systems' invasion of Ryloth, Max was one of the many Twi'leks who were massacred by Separatist forces.

Qin Yazal was the Poletec chief of a village on Skako Minor during the Clone Wars. Riding on the back of his keeradak, he attacked Clone Force 99's ship and captured Jedi General Anakin Skywalker in the mistaken belief that they had brought war to his planet.
Kurg Utal was male individual who served as an aide of the Black Sun crime lord Ziton Moj during the Clone Wars.
Jooli was a human noble who served as the chancellor and chamberlain of the planet Shu-Torun for around forty years. In 0 ABY, he served under Queen Trios and the Galactic Empire.
Dilanni was a male Felucian who served as a member of the farming community run by Casiss Midagatis on Felucia.

Cobb Vanth, also known as "the Marshal", was a human male who lived during the Galactic Civil War and subsequent New Republic Era. Once a slave, he rose to become marshal of Mos Pelgo on the planet Tatooine.

Sora Bulq was a Weequay Jedi who served the Jedi Order. Bulq trained Galdos Stouff as their padawan. After Obi-Wan Kenobi discovered that the Separatists had been building up their own droid army on Geonosis, Bulq and Stouff, along with 212 other readily available Jedi were di…

Antrot was an Abednedo tinkerer who served in the Rebel Alliance in the Galactic Civil War. He was one of several individuals that were part of team headed by Princess Leia Organa for a mission known as Operation Yellow Moon.

Oris Kyrell was a male human aristocrat from the planet Jelucan. He was married to Ganaire Kyrell and was the father of Dalven and Thane Kyrell. Oris was abusive towards Thane, though he took pride in Dalven as his oldest son.

Gowski was a male Gamorrean bounty hunter who worked with the Ithorian hunter Fissol. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the pair learned of a Jedi on the planet Lothal from a Duros bounty hunter and traveled there in order to claim the bounty on the Jedi.
Dontin Clydno was a male human who lived in the Anoat sector. He was a diplomat, and he wanted nothing more than to keep his wife and children safe from the Galactic Empire during the Iron Blockade.

Ganaire Kyrell was a female human Second-wave aristocrat from the planet Jelucan. She was married to Oris Kyrell and was mother to two sons, Dalven and Thane. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Ganaire sought to curry favor with the Empire.

Sib Canay was a male Neimoidian who served as an officer in the Trade Federation during the Clone Wars. He was in command of the blockade of Pantora, with the secret intention of forcing the moon to join the Separatist Alliance.

Lock was a clone trooper who held the rank of Clone Captain in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Commanded by Jedi General Eeth Koth, the Clone Captain led the Jedi Master's clone trooper unit by the time of 21 BBY.
Auric Graf was a male human who was married to Rhyssa Graf. Together, the two had worked as cartographers in Wild Space for fifteen years during the Imperial Era, producing maps of the vast area.

Rhyssa Graf was the wife of cartographer Auric Graf, and together they explored Wild Space. Rhyssa had two children, Lina and Milo, who affectionately referred to her as "Mum." While exploring an uncharted swampworld, Rhyssa and Auric were arrested by Captain Visler Aqorian Ko…

Dil Pexton was a male Sullustan who served as an agent for the Grafs, a family of cartographers in Wild Space. He helped the family establish deals for the maps and data they collected, and he assisted them in locating a remote, uncharted swampworld to explore.
NK-409 is the designation of Human pilot who was in service to the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

Kas unloDos was a male Ukian artist active at the time of the Clone Wars. A sympathizer of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, unloDos notably created 2,000 Senators, a piece of Confederate propaganda that described the alleged indifference of the Galactic Republic Senate …

Resinu Santhe-Caltra was a noble active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She was the cousin of the Sienar Fleet Systems illustrator Saespo Choffrey and married into the Santhe family, an influential family from the Outer Rim Territories astronomical object Lianna that …

Ansibella Dellu was an artist from Raxus Secundus. Dellu served as a student government official at Reena University, where she worked on a poster advertising a lecture series at the school by former Jedi Master Count Dooku, a harsh critic of the Galactic Republic.
Pocarto was a human male sergeant with the Galactic Empire who served as an instructor at the Empire's officers' academy on the planet Arkanis. He was a tall individual who appeared hatchet-faced.

Fatulaine was a male human who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire. At some point in his service, he was promoted to oversee activities in the Chroman Labor Pits; three days into his position, Fatulaine secretly began to free prisoners.

Detorkro Gaan was a male Zabrak who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Over the years, Gaan made a living through various combat-related occupations: he had been a pit fighter, gladiator, professional fencer, and a champion of the Hutt arenas.

An Imperial captain served the Galactic Empire and commanded the ship designated cargo transport 241. In 3 BBY, the ship docked at Horizon Base to pick up a supply shipment, and after departing, the rebel astromech droid Chopper inadvertently stowed away and later took over th…
During the reign of the Empire, an Ugnaught merchant operated a market stall selling droid parts on the Imperial refueling outpost, Horizon Base.

Dicer was a human female pilot who flew under the callsign Phoenix Six in 3 BBY. She was a lieutenant in Phoenix Cell, a fleet composed of A-wing starfighters, and operating under the command of Jun Sato.
Bev Plar was a Blarina merchant, operating on the planet Burnin Konn during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Kitomag was a Mon Calamari male, who joined the rebellious Alliance to Restore the Republic during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Seer Ban'kosh was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto and the leader of a strange and secretive cult. Ban'kosh once led dozens of followers, but was trapped in the Anoat sector by the Imperial blockade during a "pilgrimage." He ended up joining the crew of the Smuggler.

Alyla Cylone was a female Nothoiin and an operative of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She and two other Alliance operatives arrived in the Anoat sector shortly before the Iron Blockade went up in response to the Galactic Empire's defeat at Endor.

Elayah Mordu was a Nothoiin female who served as a lieutenant of the Bespin Wing Guard of Cloud City in the later stages of the Galactic Civil War. The only official hostage negotiator in the Guard, Mordu was impeccably honest, while most of her superiors had grown corrupt.

Huliasu was a male Nothoiin whose grandfather had been a member of the Noble Court. Several months into the blockade of the Anoat sector, the Galactic Empire suspected Huliasu of being a smuggler, and a team of Purge Troopers was sent to the planet of Anoat in order to kill him.

Duurgo Cadevon was a Rodian male and a member of the criminal Cadevon Family. He and his brother Boorgo crushed the leg of Riley, a young orphan turned smuggler from Burnin Konn, after she disagreed over payment while working for them.

Ganarho, nicknamed "the Exile," was a male Wookiee assassin who operated in the Anoat sector at the time of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade. One of the few assassins in the sector with skills to rival the secret order of Kouhun, he was known to stalk and
Skokare was a member of the Purge Troopers, a group of elite stormtroopers who enforced the Galactic Empire's rule in the Anoat sector on behalf of Governor Ubrik Adelhard, serving as an agent.

A Zabrak male bartender owned a bar on the moon Nar Shaddaa that had once belonged to his father. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker made a visit to the cantina seeking safe passage to Coruscant.
Gozetta was a female human who, like her father and her grandfather before her, worked as a big game hunter.

Tulia was a general in the military and officer corps of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. In her mansion on the planet Haidoral Prime, the Imperial governor Everi Chalis kept a series of statues depicting major figures in the Empire, including Tulia, the Sith Lord …
Lazar was a human individual who played for the AppSci SaberCats of the Junior Academy of Applied Sciences on Lothal.

Strulka was a male Advozse who lived during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. At some point in his life, Strulka joined the Republic Military, where he went on to become a decorated soldier, who favored taking the offensive in battle.

Colandrus was a male Tarsunt who represented the Suntilla system in the Senate of the Galactic Republic in the period between the Invasion of Naboo and the Clone Wars. One of the most influential delegates in the Senate, he was also one of the most corrupt.

Kolar Ludd, nicknamed the Depopulator, was a member of the Imperial Special Forces, a military unit of the Galactic Empire. He developed a notorious reputation for killing the inhabitants of entire villages and razing them to the ground.

Adwin Charu was a human male employee of the Red Key Raiders. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Charu was given the task by his employer of purchasing droids, weapons, and mining equipment from the Jawas on the planet Tatooine.
A human professor taught the Destroyer-Level Craft Operations class at the Royal Imperial Academy on the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Lorgan Movellan was a Weequay and the boss of the Red Key Raiders. He was described by Cobb Vanth as a thug and lowlife.
Beneda was a Thradian who lived on Thrad.
An Imperial officer was present on Nixus Hub 218 in 3 BBY. He led an operation to capture two Lasat refugees, Gron and Chava, after being tipped off by the pirate Hondo Ohnaka.
Brea Tonnika was a woman who was one of the Tonnika sisters, alongside her sister Senni.

Pade was a human male born on Uyter. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Pade was abandoned by his parents. Eventually, he joined a group of potential recruits heading to the Imperial Academy on Uyter. Pade's group was stopped short of the academy by New Republic soldiers.

Rav Horan was a human male cadet at the Galactic Empire's officers' academy on the planet Arkanis. He had a "wiry"' appearance. As a cadet at this academy, was a candidate to become an Imperial officer.

Niv Lek was a human male who served as a pilot in the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. He fought against the First Order during the assault on Starkiller Base piloting a T-70 X-wing starfighter.
Furillo was an individual that served as a pilot in the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. The pilot fought against the First Order in the assault on Starkiller Base.

Tabala Zo was a human female who lived during the era of the New Republic and the subsequent war between the First Order and the Resistance. Zo joined the Resistance; and was stationed at their D'Qar headquarters.

Guich was a human male officer who served in the Resistance as a Resistance Army Captain during its conflict with the First Order. In 34 ABY, Guich was stationed at the Resistance base on D'Qar. Per Admiral Ushos O.
Niriian was a Togruta female individual who served as a Science officer in the New Republic. She was in a romantic relationship with Ensign Deltura.

Zheela was a Rutian Twi'lek female who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Developing an affinity for working with droids, the Twi'lek eventually became a specialist in the field, overcoming her inability to speak by programming her robotic allies to recognize and o…
Teak Sidbam was an Aqualish who was sometimes mistaken for Ponda Baba, another member of that species.

Dillon was a famous Imperial hero of the Galactic Civil War whose activities had passed into history by the time of the First Order. Captains in the First Order's military wore an armband on their uniform commemorating Dillon.
Clyss Power was an admiral in the starfleet of the Galactic Empire who fought in the Galactic Civil War.

Aika Lars was a female human who lived prior to the Clone Wars. She was the first wife of the human Cliegg Lars, a moisture farmer from Tatooine. The two met on a Core World, where they fell in love, married, and parented a son, Owen.
Giran was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto who served in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine. He, along with Malakili, was very fond of Jabba's rancor, Pateesa.

The Presence was a female Sith who once commanded the weapon on the Sith temple on the planet Malachor. In 3 BBY, her voice was heard by Ezra Bridger when he used a Sith holocron to inadvertently activate the superweapon.

Chalmun was a male Wookiee and the owner of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine. Originally a street fighter, he swindled tourists on Ord Mantell until he had enough money to buy his cantina from the Vriichon brothers.

Sei Taria was a human who served as an aide to Finis Valorum during his time as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. Under Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine, Taria lost her position to Sly Moore in spite of her posterior attempt to join Palpatine.

Timon Medon was a Pau'an known as the Unifer of Utapau who unified the formerly independent sinkhole cities of the planet Utapau, which had previously warred occasionally for resources and territory but otherwise mostly ignored one another.

Valarian was a female Whiphid crime lady who operated on the planet Tatooine. She was the main competitor of the Hutt kingpin Jabba Desilijic Tiure. At some point, Valarian had her lover, a fellow Whiphid named J'Quille, infiltrate Jabba's palace to spy on her behalf.
Giles was an male Imperial cadet born by 18 BBY at the Academy for Young Imperials on the planet Lothal in 5 BBY.

In 4 BBY, this human male Imperial officer was sent to retrieve the prisoner Janard from a sinking freighter on the planet Quila. He and several stormtroopers confronted Janard and two rebels, Sabine Wren and Ahsoka Tano, who were attempting to rescue him.
The Ugnaught male Yoxgit worked selling tibanna gas to arms dealers in Cloud City on the planet Bespin.

OL701 was a TIE fighter pilot who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Hoth, OL701, along with CR978, JA189, and NA811, was sent into the Hoth asteroid belt to chase down the Millennium Falcon.
Kithaba was a Klatooinian male slave who worked as a skiff guard for the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.

Xavi Brightsun was a human male who lived in the settlement of Reestkii on the desert planet Jakku. When the settlement was overrun by Zygerrian enslavers sometime after the Battle of Endor, he and the other residents were rounded up and locked in the town hall.
Meta was a human female who served as a commodore in the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. She was stationed at the Resistance base on D'Qar during the Battle of Starkiller Base.

Kaplan was a human male who served as a colonel in the First Order. In 34 ABY, Kaplan was posted in a control room in Hangar Six on board the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Finalizer when it traveled to the planet Jakku in order to try and recover a portion of the map showing …
Pagetti Rook was a Weequay male who worked for the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure as a skiff guard on the planet Tatooine.
Mina Podia was a Jedi individual during the Clone Wars and was present at the Battle of Kashyyyk. Podia fought in the Battle of Kashyyyk alongside Yoda, Luminara Unduli, and Quinlan Vos.
Theo Meltsa was a human pilot in the Resistance Starfighter Corps. During the conflict between the Resistance and the First Order, Meltsa was stationed at the base on the planet D'Qar.
Oddy Muva was a male Abednedo technician and aspiring pilot who served the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. Muva undertook training to become a pilot during this period.

Peet Deretalia was a human who worked as a technician for the Resistance ground crew. During Deretalia's service, she became affectionate toward X-wing pilot Theo Meltsa, but she was too timid to introduce herself.
An individual was a male chef who worked for the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. He was acquainted with Resistance tech officer Peet Deretalia, who enjoyed his cooking.
Nower Jebel was a human male senator who represented the agricultural planet of Uyter in the Imperial Senate in the year 1 BBY.

Mususiel was a female Jedi who served in the final years of the Galactic Republic. When Order 66 was initiated by Darth Sidious at the end of the Clone Wars, Mususiel and three other Jedi hid in a Jedi shrine on Anoat.

Zubain Ankonori was a male Zabrak Jedi who served in the final years of the Galactic Republic. When Order 66 was initiated by Darth Sidious at the end of the Clone Wars, Ankonori found refuge in a Jedi shrine on Anoat with three others, Mususiel, Khandra, and Nuhj.

Khandra was a female human Jedi who served in the final years of the Galactic Republic. When Order 66 was initiated by Darth Sidious at the end of the Clone Wars, Khandra went into hiding in a Jedi shrine on Anoat accompanied by three others, Mususiel, Zubain Ankonori, and Nuhj.

Nuhj was a Kadas'sa'Nikto Jedi who served in the final years of the Galactic Republic. When Order 66 was initiated by Darth Sidious at the end of the Clone Wars, Nuhj and three other Jedi―Mususiel, Zubain Ankonori, and Khandra―hid in a Jedi shrine on Anoat.

"517" was an individual who served the Galactic Empire aboard its first Death Star battle station. Even as Luke Skywalker and Han Solo were infiltrating the station to try and free Princess Leia Organa from Detention Block AA-23, "517" was asked to report to scanner control.
"53" was an individual who served the Galactic Empire aboard the first Death Star, a planet-killing battle station.
"316" was an individual who served the Galactic Empire aboard the first Death Star battle station, a moon-sized superweapon.

Gormaanda was a female member of a four-armed species and a famed chef. At a young age, the Artiodac chef, Strono "Cookie" Tuggs, discovered ancient holovids of Gormaanda and was inspired to become a culinary artist, as he considered her to be a great galactic chef.
Hostis Ij was a Chandrilan male human who served as an adviser to New Republic Chancellor Mon Mothma during the last year of the Galactic Civil War.
Morfizia was a female Moragan and the wife of Morfizo.

This elder was a female member of the culture known as the Crèche, where they dwelled on Ovanis and protected an egg that they believed was vital to the fate of the galaxy.
Jlibbous was a notable chef from Zenn-La who was compared to great chefs such as Gormaanda.
Robbs Ely was a male Volpai who served as a sous chef under Strono Tuggs in Takodana Castle. He cooked meals through his own recipes, causing tension between him and Tuggs.

Voe Atell was a female senator who represented the interests of the Corporate Alliance in the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
Jintar Oarr was a wealthy human male from the planet Onderon. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Oarr fought against Governor Ubrik Adelhard's blockade of the Anoat sector.
Arek Emjon was a Bith male who lived in the settlement of Reestkii decades after the Battle of Yavin.
NY-112, or N-Y-One-One-Two, was a member of the Galactic Empire present on the planet Dantooine during the Battle of Yavin, shortly after the destruction of Alderaan.

Thaddeeus Marien was a Kitonak male who dwelt in the settlement of Reestkii on the planet Jakku decades after the Battle of Yavin. While Marien lived there, Reestkii was overrun by a group of Zygerrian slavers who rounded up the occupants and forced them into the town hall.
NO-718, or N-O-Seven-One-Eight, was a member of the Galactic Empire present on the planet Dantooine, inspecting the ruins of a rumored Rebel base shortly after the destruction of Alderaan.

A captain of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps graduated from an Imperial Academy and served with the military forces that the Sith Lord Darth Vader brought with him to the planet Shu-Torun in order to support the loyalist forces there in a civil war during the Galactic…

Edcel Bar Gane was a Roonan male Senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. He was senator during the Naboo Crisis in 32 BBY and remained in the position during the Clone Wars. He wore a dark blue velvet overcoat.

Hoff was a human who served as a captain in the Resistance. Hoff was killed in a crash on Taul soon after capturing O-MR1, a droid who had knowledge of where the First Order was holding the Resistance admiral Gial Ackbar.
Jom Jarusch was a Quarren/Mon Calamari hybrid who served in the cooking staff at Takodana Castle.

Davjan Igo was a male Trandoshan who had a background in comm repair and served as an all-purpose minion to the junk boss Unkar Plutt on the desert planet of Jakku. His name meant "burning one" in his native tongue.
Greer Sonnel was a human female pilot and the personal assistant of Senator Leia Organa. Sonnel was a racer who piloted a purple RZ-1 A-wing interceptor, the Ossifrage.
Shadow was the name given to a male veermok, one of the non-sentient primates native to Eriadu, observed by Wilhuff Tarkin during one of his visits to a hill called the Carrion Spike.

Zellit was an individual from the planet Eriadu. He was the cousin of Jova Tarkin. He often helped Wilhuff Tarkin and Jova in saving their Rodian hunting comrades from predatory creatures. He was later killed during a raid by a band of reptiles with poisonous saliva.
A scanning technician was stationed on the Relentless, an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer belonging to Admiral Kassius Konstantine, in 4 BBY.

The human Elenzia of the Noble Court, an assembly of exiled aristocrats, had a brother who stayed with her in her apartments on Cloud City, a floating city orbiting the Gas giant Bespin. He wandered into the lower levels of the city and became trapped by rogue mining droids.

Tiona Madee was a female Mirialan who had green skin, red hair and brown eyes. With a background in technical systems and preferring to attack through stealth, she had an unusually cheerful disposition.
A female freedom fighter with a strong sense of ethics, the mother of Bib'vena, a Rutian Twi'lek, passed this morality on to the child.

Scoggan was a male human who worked for the Crolute Unkar Plutt, a junkboss on the desert planet Jakku. Scoggan grew tired of working for Plutt, so he, along with the Trandoshan Davjan Igo, established a scheme to steal from their employer.

Rikard Lovas was a Kubaz male banker who regularly conducted business on the planet Jakku. Having fallen into gambling debts owed to the Irving Boys, Lovas formed a posse of droids and attempted to fake a bank robbery with his personal starship.
A Trandoshan warrior had been enhanced and trained by Doctor Cylo to replace Darth Vader as Darth Sidious' enforcer. He was controlled by the Cyberanimate.
Pendewqell, also known as Pen, was a male Ishi Tib who served in the crew of the pirate Sidon Ithano. He was killed by a group of reactivated super battle droids at Ponemah Terminal.
Toomata Wree, also know as Tooms, was a male Abednedo that was in the employment of Surat Nuat on the planet Akiva.
Resdox was a human male who held the rank of Vice Admiral in the Resistance. In the year 34 ABY, he was present in the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar.
Looda was the girlfriend of the Abednedo Toomata Wree. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Looda was in disagreement with her boyfriend about how much he should be working for Surat Nuat.

Rutar Nuat was a Sullustan male that was born on Sullust. After his brother Surat killed their parents, Rutar sought to take revenge on him, and his greatest ambition was to bring his brother down. He fought with his sibling from the shadows for years.
The Death Watch bomber was a male human, who was a member of the terrorist group Death Watch, during the Clone Wars.

1138 was a human stormtrooper who served in the military forces of the First Order decades after the Galactic Civil War. The trooper and members of the FN Trooper Corps participated in the attack on Tuanul, a village located on the planet Jakku.

Terex was a human male agent of the First Order Security Bureau, who had served as a stormtrooper designated TK-603 in the Galactic Empire prior before fleeing the New Republic following the Battle of Jakku, and became the leader of a crime syndicate on Kaddak known as the Ran…

Trinto Duaba was a male Stennes Shifter from Stennaros. An independent vagrant traveler about whom little was known, he was notably present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine, on that fateful day that Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi first met Han Solo and…
Viggen was a human who served in the military of the Galactic Empire. In the fourth year before the Battle of Yavin, he served as the commanding officer of an Imperial base on Imvur.

A male Mandalorian was part of the Death Watch during the Clone Wars. A right hand man of Pre Vizsla, the leader of the Death Watch forces based around the moon of Mandalore, Concordia, he was sent to Coruscant based on a suggestion by Count Dooku of the Confederacy of Indepen…

Daynar Corsh was a male human active in the Anoat sector of the galaxy during shortly after the death of Galactic Emperor Palpatine. A criminal, he was known to interrogate individuals for gang leaders and crime lords, getting information from difficult beings.
Ryden was a human who led a rebel cell headquartered on Imvur.
Linslo was a human member of Commander Ryden's rebel cell.
Joph Seastriker was a pilot from Gatalenta who served the New Republic as a lieutenant twenty four years after the Battle of Endor.
Arbo was a senator who represented the planet Coruscant in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic in 28 ABY. A member of the Centrist faction, Arbo was a notorious advocate of warlike policies.
Carise Sindian, once occasionally fashioned as Lady Carise Sindian, was a human female politician who represented the wealthy planet of Arkanis in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic.

Giller was a mustachioed man who served as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic in 28 ABY. A war veteran who who still wore his medals every day, he belonged to the Centrist faction, whose members advocated a stronger galactic government and a larger military.

Varish Vicly was a female Loneran who served as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic twenty years after its founding. She belonged to the Populists, a senatorial faction whose members believed individual planets should retain almost all authority.
Galen Walton Erso was a human male scientist and leading galactic authority on crystallography and energy enrichment.

Miggs McKane was a human who worked as a scavenger on the desert planet Jakku. While there, he at some point spent several hours negotiating with the scavenger Rey over a trade which resulted in Rey receiving hydrospanners in all eight standard configurations with spare power …

Fondana Tiree was the Imperial Minister of Education on Lothal during the Age of the Empire. She was the mother of Kinera Tiree, who attended Phelarion School. Due to her senior position, Fondana was well known to local government officials.
Ives was a female who served as a Communications Officer on board the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Vigilance during the Battle of Endor.
Fong was a light-skinned, dark-eyed, Human who flew as a pilot for the Alliance to Restore the Republic in their war against the Galactic Empire.

Kordi Freemaker was a member of the Freemakers. She was the second child of Lena and Pace Freemaker. She was the middle sister of Zander and Rowan Freemaker and was considered to be the leader of the family's operation.

Zander Freemaker was a member of the Freemakers. He was the first child of Lena and Pace Freemaker. He was the older brother of Kordi Freemaker and Rowan Freemaker. The Freemakers also had a B1-series battle droid named Roger, who served as a companion to them.

Rowan Freemaker was a Force-sensitive member of the Freemakers. He was the third child of Lena and Pace Freemaker. He was the younger brother of Zander and Kordi Freemaker. His best friend and long time companion was the modified B1-series battle droid Roger.

Dar was a Trandoshan male who was the son of Garnac, the leader of a hunting guild that hunted both sentient and non-sentient prey on the moon of Wasskah. During the year 20 BBY, Dar was on the verge of becoming an official member of the guild.
Zak Zaz was a male Mandalorian human doctor who worked at a New Mandalorian hospital in Mandalore's capital city of Sundari during the Clone Wars.

Tee Va was a Moogan male smuggler who led a smuggling ring in operation during the Clone Wars. Va once operated in Mandalore's capital city Sundari, diluting tea with slabin in order to double the amount he could sell and therefore doubling his profit.

Naare was a Force-sensitive near-human female Sith agent who was in league with the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, she was tasked by Darth Sidious and Darth Vader with locating the Kyber Saber.
Siddiq was a male human who worked as an importer at a shipping company in the New Mandalorians' capital city of Sundari on the planet Mandalore.

Ormes Apolin was an individual who served as the senator of Kuat in the New Republic Galactic Senate in 28 ABY. He was already a politician during the age of the Galactic Empire, the tyrannical regime that preceded the New Republic.
Zari Bangel was a human pilot who flew in the New Republic's starfleet and later for the Resistance.
Bevicard was a senator in the New Republic's Galactic Senate in 28 ABY. At around this time, a reception was thrown for him on the planet Coruscant, and Senator Leia Organa received an invitation.

Lika was a female Terrelian Jango Jumper who was captured during the Clone Wars, a conflict fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, by Trandoshan big game hunters, who transported her, along with several other prisoners, to the Trandoshan m…

Katt Mol was a Snivvian male who was captured by Trandoshan hunters during the year 20 BBY. Stranded in a cage on a Trandoshan freighter, Mol met the captured Jedi padawan Ahsoka Tano and—having learned what the Trandoshans planned to do with them—Mol explained to her their fate.

Ratter was a Trandoshan male big game hunter who hunted alongside a hunting lodge made up of other Trandoshan game hunters. Led by Garnac, the guild hunted both non-sentient creatures and sentient beings, the latter of which were captured and dumped on the moon of Wasskah.
Krovis was a commodore of the Galactic Empire and the superior of an Imperial heavy freighter crew during the Galactic Civil War.
Davits Draven was a human male who served as a general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Tag was a clone trooper pilot in the Republic Navy's Shadow Squadron.
Tai-Lin Garr was a male New Republic senator in the years following the Galactic Civil War, representing his home planet of Gatalenta during the New Republic Era.
Feleen was a politician who served in the New Republic Senate in 28 ABY. Feleen was a friend of the Loneran senator Varish Vicly.
Rinnrivin Di was a Kajain'sa'Nikto crime lord who led a powerful and dangerous cartel during the New Republic Era, operating from the planet Bastatha in 28 ABY.
Tosta was a Nikto magistrate on the planet Bastatha in 28 ABY. Tosta worked with another magistrate, Xun.
Xun was a male Nikto magistrate on the planet Bastatha in 28 ABY. Xun worked with another magistrate, Tosta.
Fatil was a blonde female who represented the Mid Rim world Orinda in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic.
Lema Eelyak was a human female who worked with the Resistance. She lived during the Cold War thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Anib Ney was a male Sullustan who represented Sullust in the New Republic Senate in 28 ABY. Ney was a member of the Populist party.
Ledaney was a male individual who served as an X-wing pilot in the New Republic Starfleet. At the time of the Napkin Bombing, Ledaney was in a relationship with a man from Corellia.
Mortan was the senator of Comra in the New Republic Senate in 28 ABY. Mortan was a member of the Centrist party.
A male human was the brother of the human Arliz Hadrassian. Hadrassian's brother served as a member of the Emperor's Royal Guard during the Galactic Civil War.
Arliz Hadrassian was a female human businesswoman who served in the First Order as an agent and had previous service in the Galactic Empire prior to its defeat at the Battle of Jakku.

Padric was a bearded male human who worked as a member of the Amaxine warriors in 28 ABY. At some point, Padric flew a BTL-A4 Y-wing on a course that brought the starfighter over a well-lit area. At this time, the man was considered a napkin bomber.

Orris Madmund was a male politician who served as the junior senator from Coruscant in the New Republic Senate in 28 ABY. A strident Centrist, Madmund blamed the rival Populist faction for the Napkin Bombing of the New Republic senatorial complex.
The father of Ransolm Casterfo was a male individual from the planet Riosa.
This female individual from the planet Riosa was the mother of Ransolm Casterfo.
A male individual from the Core Worlds planet Corellia was the romantic partner of Ledaney, a male New Republic X-wing pilot, in 28 ABY.
Teffer was a human individual that served as a pilot in the Resistance's Starfighter Corps at the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar.

Min Sakul was a human who served in the Resistance during their war against the First Order. Sakul was stationed at the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar during the Battle of Starkiller Base, and witnessed General Leia Organa sensing the death of her husband, Han Solo, throu…
The chief of staff to Count Jogurner was an individual who was injured during the Napkin Bombing.

Ruen was a male human who resided in the Wreck Belt of Lotho Minor at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Vrogas Vas, Ruen was approached by 0-0-0 and BT-1, droids working with Aphra, an acquaintance of Ruen.
Grecker was a male near-human member of the Closed that resided on the planet Carnelion IV approximately three years following the Invasion of Naboo.

The father of Hazram Namir was a human male who lived on the planet Crucival. He had formally fought clone troopers of the Galactic Republic back in the Clone Wars but retired from fighting after the Republic came out victorious.

The mother of the human Thara Nyende was a female individual who lived during the Imperial Era. In 2 ABY, Nyende, who lived on the manufacturing planet Sullust, enlisted in the Imperial 97th Legion in order to financially support her mother as well as her uncle and cousins.
The uncle of Thara Nyende was a human male who operated a cantina in the city of Pinyumb on the planet Sullust.
SP-113 was a human stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire's 97th Legion who was stationed at an Imperial Garrison in the planet Sullust's capital of Pinyumb.
SP-156 was the designation of a human stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire's 97th Legion on the planet Sullust.
Chirrut Îmwe was a blind human male born on the moon Jedha in 53 BBY. He used a uneti-wood staff and handmade lightbow in addition to being a master Zama-shiwo martial artist.

Baze Malbus was a human male born on the desert moon of Jedha fifty-three years before the Battle of Yavin. Once a devoted member of the Guardians of the Whills, Malbus became a freelance assassin during the age of the Galactic Empire.

Bodhi Rook was a human male from Jedha who served as a cargo pilot for the Galactic Empire prior to the Galactic Civil War. He graduated from the Terrabe Sector Service Academy, serving as a shuttle pilot after.

Nyessa was a Kyuzo female and the cousin to Grimshaw. Shortly after the Battle of Hoth, she met with representatives of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and asked them to aid in confronting the Imperial presence on Jaresh.
Reveth was a female Twi'lek mechanic who served in the crew of the pirate Sidon Ithano.
Na'Vrokk, known as "Squeaky," was a male Gamorrean who served in the crew of the pirate Sidon Ithano.

Paodok'Draba'Takat Sap'De'Rekti Nik'Linke'Ti' Ki'Vef'Nik'NeSevef'Li'Kek, also known as Paodok'Draba'Takat for short—and to most as Pao—was a male Drabatan who was born on the Outer Rim planet of Pipada in 31 BBY.

Bistan was a male Iakaru soldier who served as a corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Battle of Scarif, as door-gunner for an Alliance U-wing.

Scorza was a male Weequay pirate who once worked with the Delphidian pirate Sidon Ithano aboard the cruiser New Gilliland before betraying the crew to the Hutts. He later sought out the lost treasure of the Sith Lord Count Dooku.

Jeken was a male human who enlisted as a cadet in the Imperial Academy, the military training program run by the Galactic Empire. His ambition was to join the ranks of the white-armored stormtroopers, whom he thought were inherently superior to their clone predecessors.

Reann Tomvig was a human who initially joined the Imperial Academy, the military training program run by the Galactic Empire. However, upon meeting a band of rebels, she experienced a change of heart and turned on her fellow cadets, joining the fight against the Empire.
The Mayor of Shaketown was a tan-skinned human woman who lived during the Age of the Empire, serving as the mayor of Shaketown, a district on the Inner Rim planet Gorse.

Yunnarha was a Rutian Twi'lek female who worked as a negotiator for the Ivax Syndicate during the time of the Iron Blockade. She was considered a rising star and contributed significant profits to the Syndicate.
Chigo was a Rodian and an ally of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Even before being won over fully to the Alliance's cause, Chigo had run black market goods to dissident worlds for years.

Wudei Wadai was an Aqualish who served in the intelligence branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Wadai arrived in the Anoat sector with two other Alliance operatives.

Daxxus was a Blarina criminal who operated in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade. On one occasion, Daxxus deterred Imperials from inspecting their cargo by staining their face with berry juice and pretending to have the Anoat pox.
Sera was a female human who lived on the planet Carnelion IV during the war between the Open and the Closed.
Plitht was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto active in the Anoat sector during the Iron Blockade. He eventually joined the crew run by a smuggler who was themselves affiliated with the Uprising.

Easy Xiukhan was a female Zabrak who joined a crew run by a smuggler, assisting in all sorts of missions. The smuggler was part of the Uprising, fighting against the Galactic Empire in the Anoat sector at the time of the Iron Blockade.
Ghador was a male boss of the Ivax Syndicate. During the Iron Blockade, he attempted to secede from the Syndicate and found his own criminal empire on Zhanox.
Rykoff was a male cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials. He was assigned to squad LRC077, and was a member of Unit Aurek.

Maximian Ajax was a human male who served as a grenadier and sergeant in the Rebel Alliance during its war against the Galactic Empire. He was a member of the Thirty-Second Infantry before the group was obliterated.

Laparo was a Frigosian female who worked as a cryptosurgeon in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata. Along with her partner Thromba, Laparo offered cosmetic surgery to clients, including the criminal Ryn Biggleston.
Around 4 BBY, a Clawdite bounty hunter managed to infiltrate the Ghost crew by shapeshifting into the likeness of Garazeb Orrelios.

Lady Meateye was a female sadistic kidnapper who operated in the Anoat sector. Several months into the lockdown of the sector by the Galactic Empire, she abducted the son of a Noble Court chamberlain and demanded a ransom.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military

x: Barcel was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire's navy as a communications officer on the bridge of Prelate Verge's personal Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, the Herald.

Iania was a Twi'lek female who the Rebel Alliance Captain Micha Evon had feelings for when both of them were at school. Evon later remembered the Twi'lek as his first schoolyard crush in 0 ABY when talking to the young private Hazram Namir on the planet Vir Aphshire.

Fong Do was a Nautolan male who lived in the Coruscant Underworld during the Clone Wars. He was close friends with the bounty hunter, Castas, and frequently enjoyed drinking in bars across the galaxy.

Unkajo was a massive wampa with white fur and black eyes from the planet Hoth, located in the Hoth system of the Anoat sector. According to the Kouhun assassin Loathe, Unkajo was a beast that had grown old and powerful.

Zinn Toa was a male Nautolan child that was born during the time of the Clone Wars. He was kidnapped by the notorious bounty hunter, Cad Bane, at the behest of Darth Sidious, who had planned to use him, along with other Force-sensitive children, to create an army of dark side …
Jenni was a female human assassin who operated in the Anoat sector. Initially, she worked for the Galactic Empire.

Nim Mindbend was a criminal who operated during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At some point during the war, Mindbend was wanted dead for the act of kidnapping, theft and murder with a prize of 120,000 credits.
Silva was a student who attended the Jedi Academy at the same time as Roan Novachez.

Lodaka was a female Rodian Jedi Master. An unparalleled master of Form III/Soresu, the third form of lightsaber combat. She was also fascinated by the material properties of the various crystals used in lightsaber construction.

TK-462 was the operating number of a human male Imperial stormtrooper. A native of the planet Eriadu, he enlisted in an Imperial Junior Academy against his father's wishes following the death of his younger sister Xea at the hands of rebels during a botched attempt to steal ai…
Lassar, nicknamed "Jogan" after the fruit of the same name, was a veteran clone trooper who fought in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. After the
Xea was a female human from the planet of Eriadu. In the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign, she and her older brother lived with their father and mother, who maintained an air scrubber farm.
The mother of the man who became the Imperial stormtrooper TK-462 was a female human from Eriadu. She lived with her son, her daughter Xea, and her husband, who operated an air scrubber farm.
The father of the man who became the Imperial stormtrooper TK-462 was a male human who operated an air scrubber farm on Eriadu, where he lived with his wife, his son, and his daughter Xea.

An Imperial governor, who was a relative of Wilhuff Tarkin, ruled the planet Eriadu in 14 BBY. When Tarkin visited Eriadu after becoming the first Imperial Grand Moff, the governor awarded him the key to Eriadu City and held a parade in his honor.
A female Zygerrian ruled as the Queen of Zygerria in the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign.
During the Imperial blockade of the Anoat sector, Mercos joined the Smuggler's crew, who dispatched the Rebel on a variety of missions throughout the sector.
Hela was a female Nothoiin who served as the captain of Earl Alner's private guard. She favored melee combats and edged weapons.

Regmus was a male Nothoiin who served the Noble Court-in-exile of the Anoat sector. Once the captain of the Throneship Honorbound, he had lost it to the Galactic Empire by the time of the Iron Blockade, and sought to atone for his failure.
Durm Bormo was a male Abednedo scout who was active decades after the Battle of Endor. He worked with a team of adventurers on Jakku to discover the secrets of a crashed New Republic corvette.
Fira Bon was a human female soldier who was active during the New Republic Era.
Mhar'li was a human female pilot who was active decades after the Battle of Endor.
Tiras Or'un was a human male explorer who was active during the New Republic Era.
A Rodian male worked as a shopkeeper in a resettlement village on the planet Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

P'nll Vun was a Nautolan who lived in Reestkii on the planet Jakku. He was taken captive and detained in Reestkii's town hall along with the other residents when his village came under attack by Zygerrian slavers.

A male Hosnian was on the planet Hosnian Prime during the Cold War. In 34 ABY, approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor, the First Order fired the Starkiller Base superweapon at the New Republic capital, destroying Hosnian Prime along with its population.
Edern Lars was a human male from Tatooine. He was the son of Gredda and Lef Lars, and the younger brother of Cliegg Lars.

Khundu was a human male who served as a member of the Chromium Kings. During the Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, the Chromium Kings forces were attacked and defeated on the planet Burnin Konn by a smuggler associated with the Ivax Syndicate.

Luitt was a human male captain in service of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy five years after the end of the Clone Wars. He was an officer aboard the Perilous, flagship of Darth Vader and Emperor Sheev Palpatine, during their mission to Ryloth.

Nara was a bantha who lived on the desert planet Tatooine. During the Age of the Empire, former Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi lived among the bantha herd in which Nara belonged, and the Jedi considered them to be his family.

Dolo was a bantha who lived on the desert planet Tatooine during the Age of the Empire. Obi-Wan Kenobi, a former Jedi Master, lived among the bantha herd in which Dolo belonged, and the human considered the banthas to be his family.

Katrull was a Trandoshan who operated as an employer of smugglers during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Battle of Hoth, Katrull offered a job to Han Solo, but the human was reluctant and passed on the deal.
Loo Re Anno was a female Sibettan and a respected racer in the Dragon Void Run. Within the Dragon Void, she was acknowledged as both the greatest and eldest racer present.

Nierre was the last name of the father of the Nierre family, a human family that lived on the planet Jelucan during the reign of the Galactic Empire. They were the descendants of the first wave of settlers who had been exiled to Jelucan for remaining loyal to their king.

Ryn Biggleston was a female human who was partners with the Balosar BeeLee Amdas. After betraying and killing Amdas by poisoning her drink, Biggleston underwent a facial reconstruction performed by cryptosurgeons Thromba and Laparo in a lab rented from Maz Kanata on Takodana.
Thon was an Imperial officer who served in Rampart Station, a supply base for ships en route to the planet Geonosis.

Baird Kantoo was a human male who lived as a Jedi Master prior to the formation of the Old Republic. Kantoo sought to craft a weapon suitable for the Jedi, so he used his knowledge of the Force to forge several kyber crystals into a single blade, creating the Kyber Saber—the g…

Mercurial Swift, born Geb Teldar, was a human male bounty hunter who was active from the reign of the Galactic Empire into the early days of the New Republic. As a bounty hunter, Swift preferred working alone, even refusing a business proposal from veteran bounty hunter Dengar.
Graballa was a Hutt crime lord and cousin of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. During the Galactic Civil War, Graballa managed an ore mine in the Belgaroth asteroid field on behalf of his wealthier cousin.
Smiley was a nexu owned by the crime lord Graballa the Hutt.

Furlac was the Aqualish landlord of the Freemakers, a family of scavengers who operated a starship and repair business called Freemaker Salvage and Repair on the space station the Wheel. He had a difficult relationship with his tenants who were unable to pay their rent.

Bon Yoth was a male human who served in the Rebel Alliance before he argued with General Carlist Rieekan and left the Alliance. He was the contact of Princess Leia Organa on the planet Basteel in the mission known as Operation Yellow Moon.

Wick Cooper, also known as Mr. Cooper, was a wealthy customer of the scavenger family, the Freemakers. He lived in the Wheel's upper level and at one point owned an antique N-1 starfighter. Mr Cooper was annoyed when Zander took his ship on a joyride and wrecked it.

Grolt was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy five years after the end of the Clone Wars. He was described to be thin like a Whiptree and was an officer aboard the Perilous, flagship of Darth Vader and Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the mission to Ryloth.
The grandmother of Carise Sindian was a female individual from Alderaan. She often sang Carise the Alderaanian lullaby "Mirrorbright" when she felt nostalgic about her homeworld.

A tavern-keeper from Pamarthe was active during the time of the New Republic. He owned a cantina on Pamarthe. Greer Sonnel, a native Pamarthen, and Joph Seastriker entered the cantina when Joph claimed he hadn't been to Pamarthe in a while.
A pilot from Pamarthe operated during the time of the New Republic. During her later life, she was present at a cantina on Pamarthe where Greer Sonnel, a native Pamarthen, drank Port in a Storm.
Khione was a human female who served as captain of the Imperial Star Destroyer Shieldmaiden between the Battle of Hoth and the Battle of Endor.

At some point in time following the Battle of Jakku, a human Padawan hoping to join Luke Skywalker's new generation of Jedi was sent on a mission to the planet Tatooine from Skywalker himself to await a delivery from Han Solo.

Karsted was a human male who hailed from the planet Pamarthe. He was the former partner of fellow racer, Greer Sonnel, and the two split up after he cheated on her. After this, she attempted to ignore Karsted, much to his annoyance.

An individual served as an arbiter and crowned Lady Carise Sindian as the supreme governor of the planet Birren. They gave Sindian the traditional cloth-of-gold mantle and scepter to symbolize they would shelter and defend the people of Birren.

An individual served as Warden of the Treasures during the time that Lady Carise Sindian became supreme governor of the planet Birren. The Warden informed Sindian that she did not need to look through the previous governor, Lord Mellowyn's, things that day.
Ignacio Wortan, also known as Iggy Wortan, was a male Twi'lek who wanted to buy a Wroshyr wood frame from the scavenger family, the Freemakers. He came from the Core Worlds planet of Wortans.
Attiburra was a Wookiee Chief who hired the Freemakers to rescue his son Tantarra from a Trandoshan island fortress. In return, he gifted the Freemakers with a piece of wroshyr wood.

Tantarra was a Wookiee prince and the son of Chief Attiburra. He was held captive by Trandoshans before his rescue by the Freemakers. Tantarra then helped the Freemakers recover the third Kyber Saber crystal.

Durpin was an Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire following the Battle of Hoth alongside his fellow officer Plumestriker. The two commanded the Blockade of Kashyyyk and patrolled the Emperor Palpatine Museum on Naboo.

Plumestriker was an Imperial officer who patrolled the Blockade of Kashyyyk, the Emperor Palpatine Museum and Echo Base on Hoth with his partner Durpin. During the course of his duties, Plumestriker would encounter the scavenging Freemakers on several occasions.

Roonlo, or Roonlo the Stalker, was an Aqualish male criminal who harassed Riley, sending her monthly Muckrat Skulls prior to and throughout Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector. He and Riley's father had issues with one another.

Pentir Bephorin was the son of Givin mathematician and cryptographer Drusil Bephorin. When Drusil was captured by the Galactic Empire and forced to work for them she was separate from Pentir, who was left with his father and other siblings.
Durs was a member of the New Republic Special Forces who was deployed to the planet Akiva during the Rebellion on Akiva in 4 ABY.

Gazwin was an Uthuthma who spent time on the planet Jakku following the Battle of Endor. They were seated on a stall at Ergel's Bar in Cratertown when the human settler Corwin Ballast took a seat next to them.
Gor-kooda was a Herglic who served the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat as an enforcer on the planet Akiva.
Bokwarro was a Wookiee male pirate active during the reign of the Galactic Empire who was a member of the Starhowl Pirates. His preferred weapon of choice was a bowcaster.
