The Festering Shaman was a male Lurker shaman who lived on Anoat during Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector. He attempted, unsuccessfully, to prevent the Smuggler from partaking in the Waters of Change when sent to do such by Shelish.

The human male Rapace served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial officer on the planet Akiva. During the Rebellion on Akiva between the Empire and the New Republic, he was tricked into letting the former Imperial Sinjir Rath Velus into the communications station that he held co…
Tae Boon was a male Twi'lek who served as a second in command to Cham Syndulla of the Twi'lek Resistance during the Clone Wars.

Borgin Kaa was a human male from the planet Onderon who served as a mining baron on a moon of the planet Sevarcos. As an old man, he lived in Cloud City on the planet Bespin where he awaited an implant after suffering heart problems.
Kirratha was one of only a dozen Wookiees alongside Roshyk and Hrrgn who managed to escape from the planet Kessel after their species was enslaved by the Galactic Empire and put to work there.

Imra was a woman that the New Republic hero Han Solo and his co-pilot Chewbacca knew from their days as smugglers prior to the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Baash was a male Iktotchi bounty hunter who worked for Graballa the Hutt with his fellow partner, Raam. Under the leadership of the bounty hunter Dengar, he and Raam hunted Rowan Freemaker in order to obtain the Kyber Saber crystals.

Raam was an male Iktotchi bounty hunter who worked for Graballa the Hutt with his fellow partner, Baash. The two bounty hunters worked with the bounty hunter Dengar to hunt Rowan Freemaker in order to find the Kyber Saber crystals.

Amrashad was a general in the Rebel Alliance's military during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, during the Mid Rim Retreat, Amrashad died in the midst of a final effort to escort the Alliance Fleet from the Mid Rim.
Cantompa was a human male fleet trooper within the Galactic Empire's navy during the Galactic Civil War, serving on board the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Herald.
When the Artiodac chef Strono Tuggs wanted to host a cooking competition in the kitchen of the pirate Maz Kanata's castle, he had to convince the building's majordomo to allow him to do it.

Uzall was a cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials born by 18 BBY. Uzall was assigned to Unit Besh, a unit in the squad LRC077. During the beginning term at the academy, Uzall participated in a training exercise in the Well, a purpose-built training facility.

Ben Neluenf was the first great podracer born on the desert planet of Tatooine. At some point prior to the Invasion of Naboo in 32 BBY, Neluenf lost his life in a spectacular attempt to scale a broad, flat-topped mountain located between the Desert Plain and the Hutt Flats on …
Oskus Stooratt was a male human who was present in the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.
Blass Tyran was a male human who was present in the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.

Hobin Carsamba was an alien who worked as a scavenger on the planet Jakku in 34 ABY. Carsamba once joined a queue to trade with the junk dealer Unkar Plutt in Niima Outpost while the scavenger Rey dealt with Plutt at the front of the line.
Hoogenz was a Buktari who, alongside fellow Buktari Anonda, spent time in Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku during the reign of the New Republic.
Taryish Juhden was a human male who spent time in Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Bolivar Denai was a human male who spent time in Niima Outpost on the planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Tolomar Reez was a human male from the planet Nar Kanji who served in the criminal gang known as Kanjiklub under topboss Tasu Leech.
Jams was a male human who served as an officer in the Imperial Navy in the early years of Emperor Palpatine's reign.
Wi'ba Tuyll was a human male who spent time in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata on the planet Takodana around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

A human miner worked at a refinery complex on the asteroid Pressy's Tumble, which was owned by the First Order. He organized a strike due to the harsh living and working conditions on the mining colony.
Monn Tatth was a dark-skinned human male who spent time on the planet Jakku around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Janu Godalhi was a human male lawyer and security expert who worked with Jedi Master Plo Koon to drive pirates from the planet Teth. In 19 BBY, he attended a showing of the opera Squid Lake at the Galaxies Opera House on the planet Coruscant.
Varond Jelik was a human male who assisted Han Solo and Chewbacca in smuggling Rathtars for King Prana on Twon Ketee.

Victor Starspeeder, also known briefly as Kaa Vhin, was a Human boy from Naboo. Starspeeder had a Jedi father named Edward Starspeeder who went to the dark side, taking the identity of Krio Vin and skyhopper racing.
Golas Aram was a hover chair-bound Siniteen male who worked as a prison architect for the Galactic Empire and various other organizations.
Delan Vook was a male Pantoran pilot and racer in the Dragon Void Run.
Makarial Gravin was a female Koorivar gangster who worked for the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat on the planet Akiva shortly after the battle of Endor.
Estoc was a female human Imperial officer of the Galactic Empire, serving as a lieutenant and later as a commander.

Lomus was a cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials. Lomus was assigned to Unit Cresh, a unit in the squad LRC077. Lomus was part of a group-training exercise in the Well, a purpose-built training facility, but did not do well.
Leesub Sirln was a female Qiraash who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina shortly before the Battle of Yavin, conversing with others. Sirln had pale pink skin, purple eyes, and black hair.

O'Harlan was a female cadet in Lothal's Academy for Young Imperials. She was assigned to Unit Esk, a unit in squad LRC077. O'Harlan made it through the Academy's orientation training period, but then withdrew from the institution for unknown reasons.

Ohwun De Maal was a Duros male who worked as a freelance flight instructor and occasional smuggler. He owned and operated several docking bays in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine with his spouse, Chachi De Maal.

The Duros flight instructor Chachi De Maal was married to fellow Duros Ohwun De Maal. Together, the pair owned and operated several docking bays in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine, including Docking Bay 94.
Tekku Aylay was an elderly Twi'lek male who lived in one of the many subterranean camps occupied by his people during the Galactic Empire's occupation of their homeworld Ryloth.
Sweitt Concorkill was a Vurk senator for the Galactic Republic Senate and a renowned diplomat with a long career who joined the Delegation of 2,000 during the Clone Wars.

Lak Sivrak was a Shistavanen male who served the Galactic Empire as a scout and hunter. He at one point was a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine and left the establishment by a backdoor during a brawl.
Fi-Ek Sirch was a Kajain'sa'Nikto Jedi who was a member of the Jedi Order during the Fall of the Republic.
Arsad was a human female who worked as a doctor for the New Republic in a veteran's hospital in Darropolis on the planet Hosnian Prime in 5 ABY.

Terba was a male Ugnaught who previously worked at Reklam Station but was arrested after he tried to escape from the station. At some point after his arrest, Terba and the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka ended up in a prison on the planet Naraka.
Pablo-Jill was an Ongree male Jedi Knight that participated in the First Battle of Geonosis as a part of the Jedi assault team.
Rickert Beagle was an male Alderaanian Communications Officer on board the Sunspire, a frigate that was gifted to the Alderaan Flotilla in 5 ABY.
Pilkey was a male drink-slinger who owned a bar aboard the Imperial superweapon known as the Death Star prior to its destruction during the Battle of Yavin.

Brev was an orphaned male individual from Jakku, along with Gallius Rax—who was nicknamed Galli—and the girl Narawal. Along with the two other orphans, Brev observed a starship owned by Adviser Yupe Tashu land on the Plaintive Hand plateau on Jakku.

Narawal was a female orphan with one dead eye from Jakku. Along with fellow orphans Gallius Rax—nicknamed Galli—and Brev, she observed a starship owned by adviser Yupe Tashu land on the Plaintive Hand plateau on Jakku.

Mersa Topol was a female individual who resided on Jakku, and was the nurse in a settlement. She used ratty bindings to mend the wounds of scavengers and miners who came to her for succor. The bindings she used were sometimes also used as makeshift shoes.

Kolob was a human male who resided on Jakku as a monk and anchorite of the Anchorite sect. Prior to meeting Sheev Palpatine, the young Gallius Rax was warned by Kolob to stay behind and finish his chores, however Rax did not listen and instead snuck on to a starship in the Pla…

The Consecrated Eremite was regarded by the Anchorite sect to be an individual who resided on the Plaintive Hand plateau of the desert planet Jakku thousands of years before the Galactic Civil War, during the time that Jakku was supposedly a lush and vegetated place.

Maratelle was a female individual who was the wife of Brendol Hux, an Imperial officer who served as the commandant of the Arkanis Academy. At some point, her husband had an affair with a kitchen worker, which led to the birth of an illegitimate child named Armitage.
Cargin Eimalgan was one of the earliest ace pilots in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Starfighter Corps. By the time of the foundation of the New Republic, Eimalgan had died.
Herf was an Ithorian gangster who worked for the Sullustan crime lord Surat Nuat, who operated on the Outer Rim planet of Akiva during the Age of the Empire.

Bendu was a male Force wielder who resided on the remote planet of Atollon and claimed to represent the center of the Force, between the light side and the dark side. Bendu encountered Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus in 2 BBY.
Nilim Bril was a male Rutian Twi'lek who lived on Ryloth in the city of Nabat with his niece Numa.

Kivas was a Devaronian male who ran a starship repair shop outside Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Kivas repaired the Y 4 BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber belonging to Luke Skywalker, a rebel who crash-landed near the town.
Priban was a male Bith scientist who worked for the biotech company Kelen Biolabs during the Galactic Civil War.
Sakhet was a female Kupohan spy who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, often working with Bothan spies.
The son of the Kupohan spy Sakhet was a male spy of the same species who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, and often worked with other Bothan spies.

This stormtrooper was a human soldier who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, the trooper was stationed in Mos Eisley, a spaceport on the desert planet Tatooine.
Jorrin Turnbull was a male Imperial agent who died on the Sanctuary Moon of the planet Endor. Some time later, Sinjir Rath Velus borrowed Turnbull's identity.
Ruuf Waluuk was a male Kupohan mechanic who worked for Azzur Nessin in the city Tonekh during the Galactic Civil War. When the Desert Jewel arrived with Luke Skywalker, Waluuk worked on the starship.
Migg Birkhit was a male Kupohan mechanic who worked for Azzur Nessin in the city of Tonekh, a city on Kupoh, during the Galactic Civil War.
Barrisk Favvin was a male Gotal ISB agent. On the planet Kupoh, Migg Birkhit contacted him to meet somewhere due to the fact he had important information about Drusil Bephorin and his company.
Azzur Nessin was a male Kupohan who was also a former spy, and the owner of Nessin Courier & Cargo in the city of Tonekh on Kupoh during the Galactic Civil War. He was on the spylist given by Sakhet.

Genthaix Manslayer was a male criminal who used to hunt members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic for a living. By the time of the Imperial blockade of the Anoat sector, he had amassed a large collection of Alliance gear.

Duna Hilaris was a young male Devaronian who worked as a guide in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker landed on the planet. The Force sent him to look at an ancient temple in the middle of the Devaronian jungle.

Opato was a male Rodian who worked as a guide in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke Skywalker landed on the planet. The Force sent him to look at an ancient temple in the middle of the Devaronian jungle.
This female Devaronian was the mother of Farnay, and the wife of Kivas. She lived in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron and died a year before the Battle of Yavin.
Stradd was a commandant of the Galactic Empire who was captured by a team of New Republic Imperial hunters led by pilot Norra Wexley sometime following the Rebellion on Akiva.

Perwin Gedde was a human male officer of the Galactic Empire. With the rank of Vice Admiral in the Imperial Navy, he spearheaded one of the Empire's most brutal biological weapons programs, which included testing "ancient diseases" on subjugated worlds.

Edrio "Two Tubes" was a male Tognath mercenary pilot who flew alongside his eggmate, Benthic. The two shared the nickname derived from the breathing apparatus that allowed their Tognath physiology to process oxygen atmospheres.

Benthic "Two Tubes", also known simply as "Tubes," was a male Tognath mercenary pilot who flew alongside his eggmate and brother, Edrio. The two shared the nickname derived from the breathing apparatus that allowed their Tognath physiology to process oxygen atmospheres.

Nyall was a moff who served the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, officials representing the nascent New Republic formed a list of ranking Imperials they wished to have apprehended, on which Nyall was included.

Slussen Urla-fir Kal Kethin-wa Canker, also known as Canker the Red, His Venomous Grace, Keeper of Men and Killer of Foes, the Prince and First Son of Vorlag, Master Scion, or simply Slussen Canker, was a male Vorlaggn slaver during the Galactic Civil War.
Chorn was a male human who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper under the designation LD-22. Chorn was stationed on the planet Ryloth.

Porst was an old human male who was the owner of the depot in Tikaroo, a city on the planet Devaron. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Luke landed with his BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber near the town.

Oto Vans was a human male who served as a sergeant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At some point between the Battle of Yavin and the Battle of Hoth, Vans was asked by Colonel Jennica Pierce to assist the Tatooine rebel cell, and as such, the sergeant became involved i…
Rigger was a male pilot who was killed when his ship Streak crashed in a canyon and exploded. He was later remembered by Strater and his friends on the bar Serendipity.

Strater was a male human mercenary who worked for Gannis Ducain. He was bald, but had a tattoo of a Twi'lek on his forehead. Strater and his two partners went to the bar Serendipity to find the Millennium Falcon, owned by the notorious Han Solo.

A female individual was the mother of Armitage Hux. She was a kitchen worker who had an affair with Commandant Brendol Hux of the Galactic Empire, which resulted in the birth of Armitage. As a child, her son Armitage never got the chance to get to know her.

The grandmother of Sinjir Rath Velus was a human female. She was described by Sinjir as being considerably larger than any spider despite being fairly small, however despite this webweaver spiders were as big as her according to Sinjir.

Lug was a Trandoshan camera man during the Galactic Civil War. He was a friend of the journalist Tracene Kane. He perished when he was crushed by a fallen TIE fighter during a battle in the city of Binjai-Tin on the planet Nag Ubdur in 5 ABY.
Ur Ur was a male Tusken Raider whom former senator Johhar Kessen hired as a native guide while hunting a Rancor and a Krayt dragon on Tatooine.

t: Unidentified Small Craft Flight flight commander
x: A human flight commander taught the Royal Imperial Academy's Small Craft Flight course during the Age of the Empire. On one occasion, he set up a training exercise which involved the Imperial cadets flying speeder bikes through Reitgen Hoops in Galactic City.

Krel Noviip was a male Shozer. At some point, he was stranded on the gelid planet of Hoth for nearly a week, but managed to stay alive until the Data Seekers of the Anoat sector found him. Following the rescue, Noviip joined his saviors.

Hika Ten was a female human bounty hunter who operated in the Anoat sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Ten had been hunting bounties since the age of fifteen, and preferred to use exotic explosives.
Walfrey Solanse was a Nothoiin male who lived in the Anoat sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Rank was a human male innkeeper, the husband of Leera and the father of the girl known as Bug. He and his wife ran an inn on the Outer Rim planetoid Sídi.
"Misty" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps.

Kagi was an individual who held the rank of captain and worked for the Sith Lord Darth Sidious. Soon after he proclaimed himself Emperor of the First Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, Jedi Master Yoda confronted Sidious in a duel in the Senate Building's Galactic Senate Chamber on th…
Bivvam Gorge was a male human who worked for the Red Key Raiders, a Tatooine-based criminal syndicate led by Lorgan Movellan which rose to power following the death of Jabba the Hutt.

Issa-Or was a female Twi'lek who worked alongside the human Cobb Vanth as a law enforcer on Tatooine following the death of Jabba the Hutt. In 5 ABY, Issa-Or and Vanth rescued the human Malakili from Red Key Raiders, and they offered him a job in Freetown.

affiliation: Office of Imperial Promotion, Galactic Truth, and Fact Correction
x: The assistant of chief informational officer Ferric Obdur was a female individual with pale skin. She was present at a meeting between Obdur and Grand Admiral Rae Sloane concerning the matter of propaganda posters.

Rask Odai was a male Mon Calamari crime lord who operated on Lothal during the early years of the Galactic Empire's reign. As a front for his criminal activities, Odai used the Twin Horns Storage company, whose public face was a Devaronian underling named Cikatro Vizago.

Artemis Oophanoe was a Human boy who attended the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. A member of the school's Drama Club, Oophanoe's dark robes led some, such as Victor Starspeeder, to believe that he was secretly training to become a Sith Lord.

In the year 5 ABY, the human Bivvam Gorge and a fellow Red Key Raider found the human Malakili wandering into Red Key territory, so they chased the man down and demanded payment. However, Gorge and his comrade were killed by Cobb Vanth and Issa-Or, self-proclaimed law enforcers.

Hern Kaveen was a bearded Pantoran male who worked as a Staff Sergeant in the New Republic. Kaveen once informed Leia Organa and Chancellor Mon Mothma that Grand Vizier Mas Amedda had arrived on Velusia to surrender himself to the New Republic.
Mi'no Teest was a male human who was present in Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.

Vex was an individual who was part of the Kouhun, a secret order of assassins operating in the Anoat sector. Although he was one of the Kouhun's most skilled assassins, Vex ended up turning on his comrades and joined a murderous crew of pirates on the planet Hoth.

Slikartha was a doctor who worked for the New Republic. After the death of ex-Vice Admiral Perwin Gedde aboard the Halo, the Halo landed on Chandrila and Wedge Antilles told them that they should call down for droids to take Gedde's body to Doctor Slikartha, who would inspect …

deVores was a general in the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, Grand Admiral Rae Sloane was supposed to have a meeting involving troop movements with deVores, yet instead she lied and said that she had a meeting with Ferric Obdur in propaganda, but to Obdur Sloane stated that she had…
The wife of detective Erno was a female individual who left him for artists in the Teeno Village district of Coronet City, the capital city of Corellia.

Shreen was a female detective in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. She was killed along with other detectives including Mursey, during the Coronet City revolution, a revolution organized by the Acolytes of the Beyond.
Mursey was a detective in Coronet City, the capital city of the planet Corellia. Mursey was killed in the Coronet City revolution, a revolution organized by the Acolytes of the Beyond.
Splugorra was a Hutt for whom the Siniteen architect Golas Aram once designed a prison.
Hodnar Borrum was a male human who served as an officer in both the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic and its successor, the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire.

Kenner Loring was a human officer who served in the army of the Galactic Empire. After attending the Imperial Academy of Uyter, he came to lead the Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing and eventually held the rank of grand general by the late Galactic Civil War.
Brainee was a Siniteen associate of the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo during the Clone Wars.

Jado Starstrider was a male Nothoiin. By the time of the Iron Blockade, he and his twin sister Zenia were part of the Data Seekers society, whose members had rescued them from a fire on their homeworld of Nothoiin.

Trae Baratha was a female member of the Karthakk Group. She flew with Goll, a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, and Hera Syndulla to deliver gattis-root extract intended for native Twi'leks on Ryloth.

Amit Noloff was a male Quarren who was a prominent leader on Iego during the Clone Wars. He lived in Cliffhold. After the planet was sealed off by a Separatist laser field situated in its moons, Noloff began to despair, believing that it was caused by the "curse of Drol".
Gorgon was a Moff who was once hunted by Sinjir Rath Velus and Conder Kyl. Due to this, Velus and Kyl entered a relationship.
Crasher was a Clone Sergeant who oversaw the clone cadets of the Clone Youth Brigade during the Clone Wars.

Fang Zar was a male human senator who served in the Galactic Senate during the Clone Wars representing Sern Prime and its sector. Prior to the war's end, he was part of the Delegation of 2,000 out of concern over various amendments to the constitution.

This Imperial officer was stationed aboard the Imperial light cruiser Tellstar above Lothal in 4 BBY. After being informed by a technician that the astromech droid courier 264 was malfunctioning, he asked what was wrong with the droid, suggesting that the technician check its …

Fil, designation CC-3714, was a Clone Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic. He was assigned to recently promoted Jedi Knight Nahdar Vebb during the Clone Wars for a mission to recapture Viceroy of the Trade Federation Nute Gunray on the third moon of Vassek.
Meggin was a male Humanoid who worked on Skree, a space station.
Sata was an Umbaran female technician hired by Gozetta who temporarily worked alongside Lina and Milo Graf.
Rom was a Rodian male who worked as an enforcer for Twin Horns Storage on Lothal.
Sabo was a male Weequay Pirate who served as a member of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang during the Clone Wars.

Goru was a hulking Weequay male and a lieutenant of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. Goru, along with the pirate Jiro, betrayed Hondo Ohnaka when the renegade Sith Lord Maul began to assemble forces to attack Hondo's complex.
Shortly after the proclamation of the New Order, a young Imperial ensign served under Captain Visler Aqorian Korda III during his cataloging of gas giants in Wild Space.
Shalla Mondatha, professionally known as "the Shade," was a human female who operated as a bounty hunter.
Broadside was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron, a Galactic Republic starfighter squadron under the command of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, as Shadow Three.
Relva Jace was a human from Corellia who worked in the kitchen of Takodana Castle under the guidance of chef Strono Tuggs.

Damor Gregon was a human prep cook with a shaved head and massive beard. He worked for Strono Tuggs in the kitchen of Maz Kanata's Castle on Takodana for many years, becoming his longest tenured staff member.

Taquito was a Rodian pilot who lived during the last years of the Galactic Republic on the Outer Rim planet Iego. At some point during the Clone Wars, Iego was captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Sassi was a female human waitress at Plop Dribble's on Stobar during the Clone Wars. During this time, the Dathomirian Zabrak Savage Opress arrived at the restaurant, and began to choke Sassi.
Tagoo was a male Patitite scout and warrior during the Clone Wars.
Jimba was a female Patitite scout and warrior during the Clone Wars.
TK-429 Junior was the son of stormtrooper TK-429. He was considered a better shot by his parent.
Kerch Kushi was a male senator who served in the Separatist Senate during the Clone Wars.
Dono was a human female from Onderon who served the Onderon rebels during the Clone Wars.

Swoop was a clone trooper pilot who served with the callsign Blue Six, and later as Group Two Leader of Blue Squadron as part of the Galactic Republic Navy. He and the rest of his squadron were deployed in the Battle of Ryloth in an attempt to break the blockade.
Jan Dez was a male Rutian Twi'lek criminal on Coruscant, and acted as an associate to the Quarren Lauli Wahlo during the early Clone Wars.
Lauli Wahlo was a Quarren who lived in the underworld of the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars and owned a noodle shop called Galaxy Noodles in the planet's Slum district G17.
Higz was shot shortly thereafter, by a group of Dug gangsters, just as Bridger warned Higz and his comrade to take cover.
Rokeg was a male Dug and the leader of the Syvik Delegation, a pirate organization that was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Tuktee was a male Togruta from the planet Kiros.

Krix was a Trandoshan hunter and pilot during the Clone Wars. They were a member of a Trandoshan guild that captured sentient beings for the purpose of hunting and killing them on a game reserve on the moon Wasskah.
Goron was a Trandoshan male hunter who hunted sentient beings on the moon of Wasskah during the year 20 BBY as a member of a Trandoshan hunting guild.

Clutch was a male Trandoshan big game hunter who was a member of a hunting guild that hunted down sentient prey on the moon of Wasskah. During the year 20 BBY, Clutch served as a pilot for the guild's Trandoshan prisoner ship.
Smug was a Trandoshan male big game hunter who was a member of a hunting guild that operated out of the moon of Wasskah.
Horton Salm was a human male who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was the older brother of Keyser Salm, a pilot of Red Squadron.

Bandis Yong was an individual who once attended the Vocational School for Institutional Security and a friend of Jix Hekyl. Yong had some talent as a slicer, but also an over-inflated opinion of himself.

Joval Rykk was a male human who served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. By the time of the blockade of the Anoat sector, Rykk was a ten-year veteran of the Corps, and yet he did not feel any loyalty to his Empire or even his comrades in arms.
Several months into the blockade, Thosk joined the crew of the Smuggler, who sent him on a variety of missions across the Anoat sector.

Kespral was an Advozse male who ran errands for the Kouhun from time to time despite not being a member. During the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, he joined the crew of the Smuggler, who sent him on missions across the sector.
Lagon was a Trandoshan hunter and part of a group of Trandoshans that hunted down innocent beings for sport on Wasskah, a moon of Trandosha.
Morgo was a gray-skinned Selkath alive during the Clone Wars. Taken captive by a group of Trandoshan hunters, Morgo was held prisoner aboard their prisoner ship, the Vermin-Thrax, in 20 BBY.
Aramis was a human male who served Duchess Satine Kryze and was killed in a plot to assassinate Satine Kryze when his speeder's controls were compromised.
Luta was a Twi'lek female who served as the warden of the Megalox prison. She accepted bribes to allow visitors to visit the prison.

Daen Nark was a female Zabrak and the matriarch of the Blacklip Pirates. When the Galactic Empire blockaded the Anoat sector, she and her crew were trapped there. Nark reluctantly accepted that she had to make allies in the sector to survive.

Ramy was a Trandoshan big game hunter who was a member of a Trandoshan hunting lodge led by the hunter Garnac. During the year 20 BBY, new prey sentient prey was brought to the lodge's hunting reserve on the moon of Wasskah.

Gilas was a male Trandoshan big game hunter who was a member of a hunting guild helmed by the Trandoshan Garnac during the year 20 BBY. The guild's prey at times consisted of sentient prey kidnapped from around the galaxy which were then taken to the moon of Wasskah.

A member of the Noble Court was a contender for the throne of the aristocracy during the Iron Blockade, a time shortly after the Empire's defeat at the Battle of Endor in which the Empire locked down the Anoat sector so that its occupants could not learn about Galactic Emperor…

The mother of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure was a female Hutt. In his palace on Tatooine, Jabba forced the Askajian dancer Yarna d'al' Gargan to wear special makeup to hide her true beauty and make her look more like his mother.

Onurruka was a male Wookiee who peacefully resisted the Galactic Empire's early edicts, drawing public attention to the oppression of his people. Because of that, he was committed to an Imperial prison, where he spent two decades behind bars.
Stew was a clone gunner sergeant who served aboard the Galactic Republic Venator-class Star Destroyer Endurance under Admiral Shoan Kilian during the Clone Wars.
Verette was a male human admiral who served in the fleet of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War in 0 ABY.
Ilyenno was a male Mirialan who was the host of Cloud City's finest luxury resort. Due to his line of work, he was very well-connected, knowing every person of importance in the entire Bespin system.
Yeppau was a Toydarian who served as one of the Hutt crime lord Graballa's henchmen during the Galactic Civil War. He accompanied Graballa on his quest to find the Kyber Saber crystals.

Tucker was a clone trooper pilot who flew as Blue Five in the Republic Navy's Blue Squadron during the Clone Wars. He and the rest of his squadron were deployed in the Battle of Ryloth in order to break the blockade.

Slammer was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Navy's Blue Squadron during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Ryloth, he flew under Jedi Commander Ahsoka Tano as "Blue Three."

Kickback was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Navy. As part of Blue Squadron, with the callsign Blue Four, he and the rest of his unit were deployed in the Battle of Ryloth to break the blockade around the planet.
Axe was a clone trooper pilot who served within of the Galactic Republic naval forces' Blue Squadron during the Clone Wars.
Matchstick was a clone trooper who served in the Republic Navy as a pilot of Shadow Squadron under the call sign "Shadow Two" during the Clone Wars. Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano knew him by name.

Christina Starspeeder was a Human girl from Obroa-skai. She attended the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and was one of its top-performing students. Christina had a younger brother named Victor Starspeeder who began attending in a later year than her.

Neebo was a Jedi Master in the Jedi Order during the waning decades of the Galactic Republic. Neebo's lightsaber was later found by Jedi Master Kit Fisto in the castle of General Grievous, a well known Jedi killer.
A male human held the rank of admiral in the starfleet of the Galactic Empire. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, in 0 ABY, he was at the helm of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Harbinger.
"Shadow Ten" was the callsign of a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
"Shadow Seven" was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars as a member of Shadow Squadron.
"Shadow Twelve" was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron of the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.
"Shadow Four" was a clone trooper pilot who served in Shadow Squadron, a starfighter squadron in the Galactic Republic Navy.
FN-2112 was a stormtrooper in the First Order. He notably enjoyed spending time in a hot tub in the barracks inside Starkiller Base.
A male Imperial technician served aboard Sentinel Base.
Barsay was an Imperial pilot who flew with Nashtah Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Maysano was a wanted Lutrillian criminal who was active during the Clone Wars.

Gaelan was a male officer who served the Galactic Empire as a Vice Admiral in 5 ABY. He wanted to discuss fleet movements with Grand Admiral Rae Sloane, but she did not want to meet with anyone and lied that she had a meeting with General deVores about troop movements.
Icar Orliss was a male human from Alderaan. A teacher at a university, he survived the destruction of his homeworld by the Galactic Empire.
Hutch was a human male who lived on Onderon and joined the Onderon rebels against the Separatists during the Clone Wars. He was killed by Separatist battle droids during the Onderonian Civil War.

Suralinda Javos was a female Squamatan who lived approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor. Javos served in the New Republic Navy alongside Poe Dameron some time after the Battle of Endor, becoming acquainted and establishing a friendship with him.

Lozen Tolruck was a male human that served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War as a Grand Moff. In this position, he ruled as the governor of Kashyyyk, known as Imperial territory G5-623.

Albee Dewaw was the persona of an enormous hologram created to rule over the civilization on the planet Balnab. However, the figure was in fact being controlled by a group of DUM-series pit droids working from the wreckage of a crashed starship.

Bot was a male Duros who worked as a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At some point before the Dragon Void Run, in which Han Solo and Chewbacca took part, Bot was compromised and therefore compelled to kill Aran and other informants working for the Rebel Alliance.
Karz Damascus was a male ensign who served the Galactic Empire in 5 ABY. He was the shuttle pilot who flew Grand Admiral Rae Sloane to Chandrila for negotiations with the New Republic.

Februs Temmt was an Imperial officer who served as Admiral Rae Sloane's archivist during an Imperial summit on Akiva following the Battle of Endor. He was a small, brittle man. Sloane instructed him to refer to the meeting as the Imperial Future Council.

Imrie was a human male who served as a soldier in the Resistance during the conflict against the First Order. Imrie helped General Leia Organa, Finn, C-3PO, and BB-8 collect fuel, ammo, and Wookiee Cookies for the Millennium Falcon shortly before the Battle of Starkiller Base.

Lyra Erso was the human female wife of the scientist Galen Erso. During the Clone Wars, Galen was arrested while researching kyber crystals on Vallt and charged with espionage by Confederate loyalists. While in confinement, Lyra gave birth to their daughter, Jyn.

Trauma was an Advanced Recon Force Scout Trooper and Clone Commander who served the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Under the command of Jedi General Halsey, they led the Jedi Master's unit alongside Jedi Commander Knox.
Monnk was the Clone SCUBA trooper who served in the Clone Wars as a Clone Commander under the leadership of Jedi Master Kit Fisto.
A male human was the grandfather of Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin.
Urian Orlan was a male individual who served as an Imperial Rear Admiral under Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck around the time of the liberation of Kashyyyk.

Hogan Tinmar was a human who served as a sergeant in the Royal Naboo Security Forces. He worked for Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo early in the Clone Wars, where he often served as her speeder driver.
Stonk was a male Ithorian Senator who served in the Galactic Republic Senate during the Clone Wars.
Maya Phoenix was a female Togruta who attended the Jedi academy based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. She was known to be a hard and determined worker and was part of the school's drama club.

Punn Rimbaud was a female amphibian senator of the Separatist Senate. Rimbaud was present in the Senate chamber when Mina Bonteri made a plea with the other senators that peace talks should be proposed with the Galactic Senate.

The mother of Moralo Eval was a female Phindian who was killed by her son some time before the riot that occurred at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center. When asked by the authorities why he did it, Eval stated that he was "bored".
The sister of the bounty hunter Sugi, also the mother of Jas Emari, was a female Zabrak. Sugi's sister resided on Iridonia during the Clone Wars and was sent credits by her sister.
Zug Tassik was a male Trandoshan criminal operating during the Clone Wars. At some point during the war, Tassik was wanted dead or alive for mass murder, for a bounty of 300,000 credits.

Omar Toggs was a male Rodian criminal operating during the Clone Wars. At some point during the war, Toggs was wanted dead or alive on the charges of racketeering and extortion for the bounty of 75,000 credits.

Carshotta was a female Togruta who performed in Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder carnival act, alongside another Togruta performer. Her skin was rusty violet and a yellow circle with a maroon circle on her forehead. Curved over the top of the circle was a thin line.
Engle was a clone trooper pilot who served under Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi's command during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, Kenobi's fleet was attacked by a Separatist armada led by General Grievous.

Killer was a clone trooper pilot who served with Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet during the Clone Wars. They were one of several pilots who used a clone Z-95 starfighter when General Grievous led a Separatist assault on the Republic fleet.

Lerux Talley was a human who worked as a tinkerer in the bazaar of Niima Outpost on the desert planet Jakku. He worked with the scavenger Rey and told her that he was from the Core Worlds, although she suspected that it was a lie.
Bort was a male human mercenary who was active during the early Age of the Empire. At some point, he was hired by the big game huntress Gozetta.
Delih was a male Cerean who was in the employ of the big game huntress Gozetta.
The father of Kinera Tiree was a human male and was the husband of Fondana Tiree.

The brother of the Imperial cadet Giles was a male individual. In 5 BBY, he heard a rumor from his friend about a cadet at the Pretor Flats Academy on the planet Lothal who confessed to treason and was consequently taken into custody by stormtroopers.
Sandara Li was a female individual who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

A human male flew under the callsign "Phoenix One" four years before the Battle of Yavin. A member of Phoenix Squadron, a fleet composed of RZ-1 A-wing interceptors that operated under the command of Jun Sato, Phoenix One led the rest of the squadron during a mission to steal …

Rilo Tang was a human male who served as a gunnery officer in the Imperial Military prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. He was an eager officer who had a reputation as a kleptomaniac. On one occasion, he stole a particularly valuable ring from a Moff.

Tiquip was a Chadra-Fan male and the grandson of Shortpaw, the leader of the Trade Spine League. Two months after the Battle of Endor, Tiquip was marked for execution by the Purge Troopers of the Galactic Empire, but the Chadra-Fan was rescued by a young smuggler.
During the Galactic Civil War, an individual flew under the callsign Blade One four years after the Battle of Yavin.

Pollus Maksim was a human moff of the Galactic Empire who governed the planet Kuat's sector by 0 ABY. At some point, he wrote a foreword for the KDY Corporate Folder brochure welcoming investors to Kuat Drive Yards.

During the Rebellion on Akiva, the New Republic Special Forces soldier Jom Barell encountered a gunnery officer who was manning the turbolaser turret outside the Satrap's Palace in Myrra, the capital of Akiva.

Sharn was a high-ranking member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry. She served as second-in-command of the Braha'tok-class gunship Apailana's Promise, which escorted the 61st's CR90 corvette, Thunderstrike.

Hober was a male quartermaster in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, also known as Twilight Company, who served during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he was the recruiting officer for a recruitment drive on the planet Haidoral Prime.
Maediyu was a female individual who joined the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company, off of the terrestrial body Thession during the Galactic Civil War.

Twitch was a human female soldier who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, nicknamed Twilight Company during the Galactic Civil War. She was present with the company during its time on Bamayar and Dreivus.

After the fall of the Empire, underboss Rynscar, one of Gyuti's lieutenants, captured the bounty hunter Jas Emari, informing Emari that she would bring her head back to Gyuti. However, Emari instead convinced her to give information about the location of Han Solo.

Nyarla was a Hutt individual who had, at some point, left the criminal syndicate Black Sun. However, Nyarla eventually returned to Black Sun after the Hutts fell into disarray, and this information was relayed from underboss Rynscar to the bounty hunter Jas Emari.

Cora Vessora was a female witch from an unidentified planet. The Jedi wished for her to join their ranks, but she refused to join them or the Sith. The Sith retaliated by killing her loved ones while the Jedi idly stood by and did nothing.

Qarwell Krass was the son of Yileen Krass and Romwell Krass Junior, and the grandson of Romwell Krass Senior. Qarwell resided on the Hyborean Moon with his family, where his father worked at the black-site prison located there.
An individual was the apprentice of Jedi Master Chuang from a story that Yoda heard from his Master.
Vira Volk was the wife of Johan Volk, who by the time of the assault on the Kuat Drive Yards was a New Republic pilot. It was rumored that the two were resistance fighters on their homeworld.
Sowa Chuan, also known as Ilka, was a female Abednedo whom Agent Terex of the First Order Security Bureau employed as a servant aboard the Carrion Spike. Ilka served Terex his drinks.

Andrew was a Human male who served as a lieutenant in the Resistance 30 years after the Battle of Endor. He helped General Leia Organa, Finn, C-3PO and BB-8 collect fuel, ammo and Wookiee Cookies for the Millennium Falcon shortly before the Battle of Starkiller Base.
Durm Harmodius was an individual who served as the Senator of Chandrila in the New Republic's Galactic Senate in 5 ABY.
Johan Volk was a male individual who served as a pilot in the New Republic's Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. He was married to Vira Volk.
Tane was an individual who served as a captain in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War as part of the Combat Operations Planning. Tane took part in the assault on the Kuat Drive Yards.

Mack was a clone trooper pilot who fought for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The pilot was part of the diplomatic service within the Coruscant Guard.

Claith Bennis was a human male individual who was a member of the grav-ball team AppSci SaberCats at Lothal's Junior Academy of Applied Sciences during Zare Leonis's time on the team as center striker.
Lunker was a Gungan security captain on Naboo during the time of the Clone Wars.
The mother of Roo-Roo Page was a Gungan who lived in Jan-gwa city on Naboo during the Clone Wars.

The mother of the pirate Captain Hondo Ohnaka was a female Weequay. She taught him about taking hostages saying that one was good, two was better, and three was good business. She sold him when he was a child.
A Rebel pilot flew under the callsign of Blue Five during the battle of Vrogas Vas.
A Rebel pilot under the callsign Blue Three flew as part of Blue Squadron during the battle of Vrogas Vas.
A human male Rebel pilot used the callsign Blue Leader during the Battle of Vrogas Vas. During the battle the entire squadron was killed by Darth Vader.
A Rebel pilot flew under the callsign Gray Five was killed by Darth Vader during the battle of Vrogas Vas.
Kep-She was a Force-sensitive individual who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Master prior to the Clone Wars.
Pa Dua was a Rodian aide who, along with Tox Don, assisted Senator Onaconda Farr in the Galactic Senate of the Republic at the time of the Separatist Crisis.
Tox Don was a Rodian who, along with Pa Dua, served as an aide to Senator Onaconda Farr in the Galactic Senate of the Republic at the time of the Separatist Crisis.

Lekek Poost was a shifty, fast-talking Mon Calamari male who worked in the Anoat sector, acquiring items for a price. During the Imperial Iron Blockade of the sector, Poost joined the crew of the Smuggler and ran missions around the sector for them.
Odair Bel-Opis was a human male from the planet Corellia who served as the attaché to Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck during the Imperial occupation of Kashyyyk in the months following the Battle of Endor.
Viera Creel was a female human diplomat from Corellia. At some point prior to the death of Emperor Palpatine, she was sent to the Anoat sector to represent the interests of her homeworld there.

Melch, designated "Laborer 429," was a male Ugnaught slave laborer who worked on Reklam Station, an Imperial-controlled salvage yard located in the atmosphere of the planet Yarma, which recycled old Y-wing starfighters.
Rikarda was a human female who worked as a freighter captain during the reign of the Galactic Empire, piloting the light freighter Stellar Sun.
Si Pebi, an Aqualish arms dealer, was active in the Anoat sector of the galaxy while it was locked down by Governor Ubrik Adelhard of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade.

Moroff was a Gigoran male mercenary who was active during the Imperial Era. As a towering gunner, he sought out combat zones across the galaxy with the goal of selling his services to anyone who required it.
Marn Kel was a male Abednedo member of the Data Seekers who used his expert piloting skills to extract operatives from dangerous situations. He also trained other extraction specialists.

Zenia Starstrider was a female Nothoiin and the twin sister of Jado Starstrider. At some point before the blockade of their native Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire, she and her brother were caught in a fire on their homeworld of Nothoiin.

The Red Brine was an alias used by a male Mon Calamari warrior who served the Ivax Syndicate, in the Anoat sector. A real one-man commando squad, he served the Syndicate to the best of his ability by eliminating enemies with great efficiency.
Ango Croom was a Falleen male who led the Varluk Organization.
Norwich was an officer who served in the military of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War, with the rank of commander.

During the Clone Wars, BNI-393's master stayed on board a Venator-class Star Destroyer the Renown with BNI-393. Later the Renown was hijacked by battle droids and all crewmembers save for droids, BNI-393's master included, were killed.
"Backdraft" was the nickname of a male human TIE fighter pilot in the First Order. Backdraft served as a Special Forces pilot who flew one of the elite TIE/sf space superiority fighters.

Sorka was a female Artiodac who lived in the Anoat sector at the time of the Galactic Civil War. Despite her kind disposition, she served in the criminal Ivax Syndicate for some time, helping many people avoid the wrath of Voras the Hutt.

Ackmena was a human female who worked as the nighttime bartender in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Tatooine spaceport of Mos Eisley. She operated a "side hustle" with two local pickpockets, Kabe and Muftak.
Raddus was a Mon Calamari male from the planet Mon Cala who served as an Admiral within the fleet of the Rebel Alliance.

Droogan's grandfather was a Khramboan male. When the merchant Droogan haggled the droid C-3PO for credits, he relayed a supposed saying of his grandfather, "Don't watch your credits, watch your health".
A rebel trooper was on a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette belonging to Phoenix Cell when it was attacked by Maul, a former Sith Lord.
Eira Tay was a Sephi female engineer who served aboard the freighter Eclipse as a member of Krysiant Rheden's crew.

Alkhara was a fearless bandit who, at some point in history, appropriated the B'omarr monastery of Tatooine's Northern Dune Sea for his own use. He hired Tusken Raiders to murder members of the local police garrison. He then betrayed the Tuskens by having them executed.
Senni Tonnika was a woman who, along with her sister Brea, formed the Tonnika sisters, a duo of con artists. At some point, Senni and Brea helped an associate break out of prison.

Ayy Vida was a Twi'lek female dancer who was a frequent patron of the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant. She was enslaved by the crime lord Hat Lo, who forced her to entertain his clients, and she was friends with fellow Twi'lek Lunae Minx.

Achk Med-Beq was a human, present in the Outlander Club on Coruscant and conversing with Ayy Vida and Lunae Minx, when Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker showed up in pursuit of the changeling assassin Zam Wesell.

Hat Lo was a human crime lord who visited the Outlander Club on the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY with his enslaved consort, Ayy Vida. While there, he availed himself of the private bar of the Baath brothers, who owned the club, while Vida entertained his associates and clients.

Dannl Faytonni was a male human and a known associate of Achk Med-Beq. The two were present in the Outlander Club on Coruscant in 22 BBY when the Clawdite assassin Zam Wesell attempted to hide there to escape the pursuing Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker.

Omar Berenko was a famous and controversial human Naboo male tragic poet from the Mid Rim planet Naboo who lived during the High Republic Era. Berenko resided at Varykino, a lake retreat in Naboo's Lake Country, in an unconventional community of Naboo and Gungan outsiders.
Sta-Den Eekin was a Klatooinian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.

Khaat Qiyn was a female human Jedi who served in the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. In the years leading up to the Invasion of Naboo she apprenticed Bairdon Jace. At some point the two briefly encountered the Sith apprentice, Darth Maul.

The Earl of Vis was a male earl associated with Vis. They were the cousin of a king of the planet Naboo who ruled prior to the reign of Queen Padmé Amidala, which began in 32 BBY. The earl built a banqueting rotunda in Theed, Naboo's capital city.

Jafan was a male member of the Naboo, the human inhabitants of the planet Naboo. Jafan served as a general during the era of the planet's history known as the Time of Suffering, which was characterized by brutal wars between human city-states.

Elis Helrot was a Givin who worked as a pilot and spice smuggler. He spoke with the bounty hunter Bossk about the fugitive Imperial astromech droid 261 in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in the year 1 BBY.
Myo was a fight-loving Abyssin from Byss. An expert in survival techniques, Myo was a tough Abyssin with regenerative abilities.

Rycar Ryjerd was a Bimm weapons smuggler who spoke Jawaese. Ryjerd was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine, on the day that Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker met Han Solo and Chewbacca.

affiliation: Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart
x: Masse Goskey was a human male and the proprietor of Masse Goskey's Arms Emporium and Explosives Mart in Mos Eisley, Tatooine.
Het Nkik was a Jawa from Tatooine. Nkik was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina when Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker arrived in search of a pilot to take them to the planet Alderaan.

Garouf Lafoe was a human from Tatooine. A patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, he was present in the bar when Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker were forced into a brawl with Ponda Baba and Cornelius Evazan.

M'iiyoom Onith, also known as Nightlily, was a sharp-tongued H'nemthe female. In 1 BBY, Onith spent time in the back rooms of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

Merl Tosche was a male individual and the owner of Tosche Station, a power and distribution station located outside the city of Anchorhead on Tatooine. Because Tosche rarely visited, the station was supervised by Laze Loneozner, who spent most of his time there.
Feltipern Trevagg was a corrupt Gotal tax collector who operated in the Mos Eisley district of the planet Tatooine.

Starck was a human colonel in the ground forces of the Galactic Empire's military who had light skin. During the Battle of Hoth, Starck commanded the All Terrain Armored Transport walker Blizzard 4 of Blizzard Force, under the overall direction of General Maximilian Veers.
Eyvind was a human male who worked as a moisture farmer on the desert planet Tatooine during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Rake Gahree was an Imperial cadet at Skystrike Academy who was friends with both Wedge Antilles and Hobbie. He and his friends attempted to defect to Phoenix Cell with the help of rebel agent Sabine Wren.

Vult Skerris was a human male pilot who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's naval forces during the Imperial Era. As an Imperial pilot, he flew a TIE/IN interceptor with red markings and wore a TIE pilot flight suit with yellow stripes on the helmet and arms.

Goran was a human male officer that served in the Galactic Empire as an instructor. Two years before the Battle of Yavin, he held the rank of commandant, serving as flight instructor of the elite Skystrike Academy on Montross. Under his command was Captain Vult Skerris.

Bidlo Kwerve was a human or near-human employee of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure who competed against the Twi'lek Bib Fortuna for the position of majordomo to the Hutt and as a result ended up as an early victim of the crime lord's pet rancor, Pateesa, in Jabba's P…

Lef Lars was a human male farmer from Tatooine. He was the husband of Gredda Lars and the father of Cliegg and Edern Lars. He and his wife as well as Edern were buried next to each other near the Lars homestead.

Gredda Lars was a human female from Tatooine. She was the wife of Lef Lars and the mother of Cliegg and Edern Lars. She and her husband as well as Edern were buried next to each other near the Lars homestead.

The Sixth Brother, formerly known as Bil Valen, was a humanoid male member of the Inquisitorius. In the year following the end of the Clone Wars, the Sixth Brother, and the rest of the Inquisitors, hunted for Force-sensitive children as well as Jedi who survived Order 66.

Eleodie Maracavanya was a non-binary human pirate ruler after the fall of the Galactic Empire who led zher pirate crew to take control of the Annihilator, a Super Star Destroyer that once belonged to the Imperial Grand General Cassio Tagge, which was renamed to Liberty's Misrule.
The husband of Maz Kanata was a male individual. Prior to 34 ABY, he married Kanata and gave her a stone statue in her image, which she displayed outside of her castle on the planet Takodana.
This Jakku villager was a female human member of the Church of the Force, who lived in the Tuanul village on the planet Jakku.

Cietra was an individual who lived on the moon Raada in a house later claimed by Ahsoka Tano when she arrived there. She moved out of the house after getting married. Tano found the house in such a mess that she assumed Cietra couldn't have been much of a cleaner.
Kaeden Larte was a human female who was the older sister of Miara Larte, living as a farmer on the moon Raada.

Selda was a Togruta male cantina owner on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. His cantina became a frequent meeting place for the resistance against the Imperial occupation. Ahsoka Tano often confided in him during her time on Raada.
Fardi was a human male living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire. He was the head of a branch of the Fardi clan, and protective of his many nieces.

Hoban was a human male living on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire, and was the twin brother of Neera. After Imperial forces arrived on Raada, Hoban and Neera joined a resistance group organized by Ashla, a recent arrival on the moon.
The wife of Fardi was a human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire.
Chenna Fardi was a human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire.

Hedala Fardi was a Force-sensitive human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was four years old and the youngest member of a branch of the Fardi clan, a wealthy smuggler family on Thabeska.
Makala Fardi was a human female living on the planet Thabeska during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was a member of the Fardi clan, and the older sister of Hedala Fardi.

Vartan was a human male farmer who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. He was a farming crew lead, as well as a respected leader within the community. He took Kaeden and Miara Larte into his crew after they were orphaned.

Kolvin was a Rodian male who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. He was a member of the Raada resistance during the Raada Uprising. He was known as an agile climber and was picked on a mission to destroy AT-STs.

Malat's husband was a Sullustan male living on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. After the Empire arrived on the moon, a relative of his back on Sullust got him and his wife jobs, so he and Malat moved back there with their children.

Malat was a Sullustan female who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire's reign. When the Empire established a presence on Raada, Malat and her family decided to move back to Sullust, where a relative of her husband had gotten them jobs.

Neera was a human female who lived on the moon Raada during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Neera was the twin sister of Hoban. She was killed when the Sixth Brother ordered the location she was in to be shot up.
Jenneth Pilar was a human male Imperial officer who served the Galactic Empire during the first year of its reign.

Tibbola was a human male who lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. Sometime after the Empire arrived on Raada, Tibbola stood up to an Imperial officer and was executed by a stormtrooper in Selda's cantina.
Chardri Tage was a human male pilot who worked for Bail Organa during the first year of the Galactic Empire. His copilot was Tamsin.
Tamsin was a human female pilot who worked for Bail Organa during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was the copilot of Chardri Tage.
Seboca was a Dug holovid star from the planet Malastare. In 22 BBY, the Dug was entertaining Senator Bogg Tyrell while she piloted a speeder through the skylanes of the planet Coruscant.

This individual was a human who was present in the bar of Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet. They were seen talking to Grummgar as Finn left the castle with Sidon Ithano and Quiggold.
This individual was a human who was present in the bar of Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.
This bar patron was a female human who was present in the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana when the First Order attacked the planet.

A male Nothoiin officer within the Galactic Empire was distantly related to a baron of the Anoat sector's Noble Court. At some point during the Imperial blockade of the sector, he stated his intention to join the Noble Court, offering crystals as proof of his good faith.

Sor Cin'da was a male individual who operated as a code-breaker in the Anoat sector. At some point during the Iron Blockade, the Trade Spine League intercepted coded Imperial data, which only Cin'da could decode. However, he was known to be surly and wary of strangers.

A human man was a warlord in the Inner Rim. At one point, he was assassinated by the Knights of Ren. Later Rey, a Force-sensitive scavenger who hailed from Jakku, saw the assassination in a Force vision.

Isin was a male Advozse who, along with Kan Be and Papa Toren, helped Agent Terex in an attempt to storm Grakkus the Hutt's fortress at the prison Megalox. Their attempt failed when Poe Dameron's astromech droid BB-8 deactivated the prison's gravity field.
Harrgun was a male Wookiee who was killed during the liberation of the Wookiee homeworld Kashyyyk.

Roshyk was a Wookiee who alongside half a dozen other Wookiees including Hrrgn and Kirratha escaped from the planet Kessel after being enslaved by the Galactic Empire. After escaping the group began to work as mercenaries who cared little for the politics of the New Republic.
The father of Rush Clovis served as the personal attaché of one of the head Muun families in the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

Antoc Merrick was a human male ace pilot who served as a General in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 1 BBY, General Merrick participated in the Alliance's acquisition of the Galactic Empire's plans to their ultimate weapon, the Death Star, in the Battle of Scarif.

Zal Dinnes was a human female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She flew a T-65B X-wing starfighter under the callsign Red Eight in Red Squadron at the Battle of Scarif and died at the Battle of Yavin.
Krev was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement, a resistance movement that worked to free the planet Ryloth from the Galactic Empire.

Xira was a female Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement during their attempt to assassinate the Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine and the Sith Lord Darth Vader. Xira owned the data processing droid D4L1.

Domm Korgale was a male individual who served as an Imperial Vice Admiral under Grand Moff Lozen Tolruck at the time of the liberation of Kashyyyk. He served as commander of the Star Destroyer Dominion, until it was infiltrated by Han Solo and his team.

A non-binary agent of Black Sun followed the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano to a planet in the Thabeska system, where they attempted to recruit Tano for the criminal syndicate. Tano declined and fled in her light freighter, with their ship in close pursuit.
Qyp was a male Snee that traveled with the Nu-Cosian Bobbajo, a wandering storyteller of Jakku.

Trey Callum was a human male who served as a sergeant major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Battle of Hoth. He was formerly an Imperial officer who decided to join the Alliance, and served at Echo Base on the planet Hoth in 3 ABY.
Vangos Grek was a human pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Dervis was an individual who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. The major was part of the Alliance forces stationed in Echo Base on the planet Hoth when it was attacked by the Galactic Empire in 3 ABY.

Izak Anzio was a male ranger from the Outer Rim world of Agamar. Anzio dreamed of seeing the galaxy, prompting him to enlist in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Academy program, where he became friends with Kreel, a fellow enlistee.

t: Unidentified former sergeant of Task Force 99
x: A human individual lived during the Imperial Era. At some point, they became a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. By 2 BBY, they had come to serve as sergeant of Task Force 99—an elite stormtrooper unit.

A male individual lived on the Outer Rim world Chagar IX. They—along with a female individual—raised a human son named Kreel. Kreel's father was a fighter in the fighting pits on Chagar IX. By 0 ABY, when Kreel was six years old, his father was killed in the pits in front of him.

A female individual lived on the Outer Rim world Chagar IX where they fought in the world's fighting pits. They—along with a male individual—raised a human son named Kreel. By 0 ABY, Kreel's mother had been killed in the fighting pits.

"Cav" was the nickname of an Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Cav served as the squad's melee specialist, capable of attacking targets in close quarters combat.

"Aero" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Aero served as the squad's engineer, capable of repairing and hot-wiring vehicles for transport.

"Mic" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Mic served as the squad's slicer, capable of breaking into and decrypting enemy computer systems.

"Shrap" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Shrap served as the squad's demolitions expert, wielding a flamethrower and explosive charges.

"Zuke" was the nickname of a Special Commando Advanced Recon Trooper in Task Force 99, a squad within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps. Zuke served as the squad's muscle and heavy weapons expert, carrying a mortar on his back.

A Gungan criminal was active on the Smuggler's Moon, Nar Shaddaa, shortly before the skirmish in Grakkus the Hutt's arena. The Gungan gave information to the bounty hunter Dengar about the Wookiee Chewbacca.

Korin Aphra was a human male who lived during the Age of the Empire. He was the father of Chelli Lona Aphra, his daughter born in 24 BBY with his wife Lona Aphra, and Dellen Aphra. During the Clone Wars, Chelli and her mother moved away to Arbiflux, where her mother was killed.

Lona Aphra was a female human and the mother of Chelli Aphra. She gave birth to her daughter in 24 BBY. Lona split with Chelli's father Korin Aphra, taking Chelli to live on Arbiflux until raiders attacked their home.
Omus Krill was a male Zygerrian who served as a guard during the Clone Wars.
Jubnuk was a Gamorrean who served the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure at his palace on Tatooine.

Porcellus was a human who worked as the head chef in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine. Following the death of Jabba, Porcellus partnered with beastmaster Malakili to open the Crystal Moon Restaurant in Mos Eisley.
Dalraga de Cueravon was a propaganda artist in the service of the Galactic Empire. The artist, along with Janyor of Bith, created the pro-Imperial poster Imperius Unitada ober Totallex.
Weel was a male human who served as a lieutenant in the First Order Security Bureau. He was capable with a vibroknife.
The First Order stormtrooper FN-1044 was one of many deployed to the planet Takodana thirty years after the Battle of Endor to recover the Resistance astromech droid BB-8.

Alrrark was a male Wookiee from Kashyyyk who fought alongside his ruler, King Grakchawwaa, during the Clone Wars. After the war, enslavers raided Kashyyyk and tried to capture Alrrark, but he managed to fight his way to freedom and fled to the Outer Rim Territories.

Fbinti Fith was a Chadra-Fan female who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic's senate. After she retired, the Republic was replaced by the autocratic Galactic Empire, and Fith sought to quietly build local resistance against the new regime early on.

Adame was a human smuggler who was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Along with Selentia, Adame approached another smuggler, Han Solo, requesting to borrow his ship, the Millennium Falcon to travel to the Gomar sector as part of a mission on behalf of Leia Organa.

Selentia was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Along with Adame, Selentia approached the smuggler Han Solo requesting to borrow his ship, the Millennium Falcon to travel to the Gomar sector as part of a mission on behalf of Leia Organa.
Nowk Asil was a female Twi'lek racer who participated in the Dragon Void Run alongside their partner Sotna Reat.
Sotna Reat was a Twi'lek racer who participated in the Dragon Void Run alongside their partner Nowk Asil.

Tomine was a human who served as an officer of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. They interceded in the Dragon Void Run participated in by Han Solo, and attempted to arrest the racers for inciting unrest against the Empire.

Valent was a human officer who served in the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At the beginning of his military career, Valent attended the officers' academy on Uyter, along with Kenner Loring.
Nadem Naz was an individual who participated in the Dragon Void Run. During the race, Naz gave up and disqualified himself from the race.

Dorae was a female alien who was a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At some point, Dorae owned a rathtar which she intended to use to pay off debts, however the Wookiee Chewbacca killed it.
U'il was a Falleen female who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, and was a friend of Princess Leia Organa.

The grandmother of Loo Re Anno was a founding member of the Dragon Void Run. According to Loo Re Anno, her grandmother was a mapmaker first and foremost but also loved to fly fast. Unusually for her kind, Anno's grandmother did not want to fly alone.
Miwy Joy was a Twi'lek who fought for Cham Syndulla's resistance movement during the Clone Wars. Joy was killed with other Twi'leks by the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Samara was a Twi'lek who served under General Cham Syndulla within his resistance force during the Confederacy of Independent Systems' invasion of the planet Ryloth in the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
Luna was a Twi'lek who fought for Cham Syndulla's resistance movement during the Clone Wars.

Spudwee was a Twi'lek who fought for Cham Syndulla during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems' invasion of their homeworld. Spudwee was eventually killed and had their name carved in Aurebesh on a headstone just outside the Jixuan desert.

Silver was a clone captain during the Clone Wars. At the time of the civil war between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic, Silver served the latter as a clone navigation officer in the Republic Navy.

Kan Be was a male Kaminoan who, along with Isin and Toren, attempted to help Agent Terex storm Grakkus the Hutt's fortress in Megalox prison. Their plot was foiled by the Resistance starfighter pilot Poe Dameron and his astromech droid BB-8.
