x: Ferric Obdur was a human male officer who served the Galactic Empire. Originally a member of the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic, Obdur was placed in charge of the official media output during the transition into the Empire.
Soara Antana was a high-ranking Jedi Master of the Jedi Order in the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Tavris Bahzel was a Clawdite model and artist during the era of the Galactic Empire. They were known for experimental designs that challenged the notion of species identities. Following the rise of the Empire, they spent years assisting the Wookiee underground.

Santos Bel-Pak was a poet laureate of Kooriva and a professor emeritus at the Lebrasa Argente School for the Arts and Persuasive Sciences. He was celebrated for his mixed media techniques, blending kinetic choreography and procedural with chaos-based rendering techniques.

Ark Roose, known by the nickname "Bumpy" due to his aggressive nature during races, was a dim-witted male Nuknog podracer from the planet Sump. Using a Plug-8G 927 Cluster Array Podracer, he participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Venn Eowelt was a minister who worked in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. In 5 ABY, Eowelt was apprehended by the pilot Norra Wexley's team of New Republic agents, who had been tasked with capturing individuals that Republic officials wished to have detained.

Keong was a moff who served the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, Keong was placed on a list of Imperials that New Republic officials wished to apprehend. Not long after, Keong was captured by a team of New Republic operatives led by the pilot Norra Wexley.
Husklf was a Nimbanel male bartender who worked at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.
A male Nimbanel worked as a bartender at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, a spaceport located on the planet Tatooine.

Takeel was a Snivvian male who worked as a mercenary and was addicted to spice. He and his brother Zutton frequented Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine and were present in the cantina in 1 BBY when the local moisture farmer Luke Skywalker and the Jedi Obi-Wan K…

Naveela Betuine was a communications major from the planet Commenor who became a junior official in the Galactic Senate during the administration of Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum of the Galactic Republic.

affiliation: Ord Canfre Institute for Ethics in Art Criticism
x: Cepa Bonshu was a communications artist from the planet Riosa who was responsible for the creation of the art piece What Will You Do, which protested the Galactic Empire's use of forced conscription into their military on some worlds.
Angilar Bosh served as the art director of a leading advertising agency on Contruum before taking on lucrative freelance work for the Bureau of Ships and Services.

affiliation: Intergalactic Association of Amalgamated Droid Builders
x: Cosweg Budeesho was a veteran holographer and cartoonist who lived on the planet Ando Prime with his wife Seeja and their pet tooka, Yari.
Venthan Chassu was a member of SAGroup, the youth program of the Commission for the Protection of the Republic.
Ganamey Davloterra was the human female art director of the weekly newstack Chrono during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

Simeon Densend was a freelance repulsorcraft designer who lived on the planet Onderon during the Clone Wars, but relocated with his family to the galactic capital of Coruscant when Onderon seceded from the Galactic Republic to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Dashira Dobeq was a female sculptor and painter from the planet Ryloth who found residence in the court of Queen Breha Organa of the planet Alderaan after exhibiting her work at the Alderaan Academy of Fine Arts.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Byno Doubton was a fervent loyalist to the Galactic Republic who, with the patronage of fellow Eriadu native Wilhuff Tarkin, helped found the Commission for the Protection of the Republic (COMPOR).
Oba Dunimea was an outspoken sculptor, novelist and composer from the planet Alderaan who was one of the loudest critics of the Galactic Empire.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Coba Dunivee was a female art director and concept illustrator who worked for a Corellian holographic media conglomerate during the reign of the Galactic Republic and executed thousands of pro-Republic pieces of work during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent…

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Hamma Elad was a female artist and leading member of the Commission for the Protection of the Republic during the Clone Wars, the galaxy-wide civil war between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Veraslayn Kast was a human artist from the planet Mandalore. A supporter of the Death Watch splinter group and its leader, Pre Vizsla, Kast created art showcasing Mandalorian soldiers in action.

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Dasita Lyros was a human female fashion-holographer who became art director of the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. She found success in glorifying the Imperial Military in her work, despite never having set foot on a battlefield.
Yosyro Modoll was a Zeltron female who worked as an artist during the Clone Wars and was famed for the sensual illustrations she produced for semi-proscribed holo-periodicals.
Tantagru Motts-Danel was a Tarnab sandscribe who hailed from a colony on the desert planet Sriluur. At some point, he married the Weequay Gojuni Motts-Danel.

Gojuni Motts-Danel was a Weequay male artist who married the Tarnab sandscribe Tantagru Motts-Danel. During the final decades of the Galactic Republic's reign, the husbands gained prominence in the corporate art scene and were known for their holography and abstract art.

Gammit Chond was an Ithorian artist. Although he never traveled offworld, with some saying he never even ventured more than a day's walk from his house, Chond created a set of hand-drawn planetary maps based on many travelers' tales he had heard.
Amel Fortoon was an individual who, at some point, served as the Director of the Graf Archive on the moon Orchis 2.

affiliation: Commission for the Protection of the Republic
x: Donclode Onstruss was an independent HoloNet node operator who was recruited by the Commission for the Protection of the Republic after his transmissions and posting caught the attention of the Twi'lek senator Orn Free Taa.
Filris Parbert was raised on the planet Coruscant as a war orphan of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Moshenu Phobi was an Umbaran male who worked in the printing houses of the Plooriod Cluster and drew censure from the Galactic Republic for hiding anti-Republic messages within the official communications he worked on.

affiliation: Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic
x: Sannab Ro was a Xidelphiad female artist. During the Separatist Crisis, she created the The Military Creation Act propaganda poster for the Commission for a Safe and Secure Republic, encouraging individuals to vote in favor of the Military Creation Act.
Seeja was the wife of veteran holographer and cartoonist Cosweg Budeesho who was active during the Clone Wars. The couple lived together on the planet Ando Prime with their pet Tooka Yari.

Vanya Sha was a self-taught female cyborg artist who created the recruitment poster "Join the SAGroup"" for COMPNOR's Sub-Adult Group based on a concept by Imperial Minister of Information Pollux Hax during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Janray Tessime was a female artist who survived the destruction of her homeworld Alderaan in the year 1 BBY and spent the rest of the Galactic Civil War tending to the civilian population of the safeworld New Alderaan.

Yari was a tooka cat who lived during the Republic Era. During the Clone Wars fought between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, Yari was the pet of the veteran holographer and cartoonist Cosweg Budeesho, who lived with his w…

affiliation: Commission for the Preservation of the New Order
x: Chrigeld Tinnine was a male artist based on the planet Alderaan who volunteered his art to the Galactic Empire's Commission for the Preservation of the New Order including the propaganda poster Report Sedition, which encouraged Imperial citizens to report suspicious activity o…

Warrchallra was a Wookiee male wroshyr wood sculptor from the city of Kachirho on the planet Kashyyyk, who fought in the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Zutton was a Snivvian male who was an artist, as well as a highly-skilled bounty hunter for Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Tyyx was a green-skinned Rodian who made his living selling tips on podracing during the reign of the Galactic Republic.

Anj Rujj was a light-skinned, blond member of the gang of highly educated mercenaries known as the Thugs of Thule during the reign of the Galactic Republic. In 22 BBY, Rujj was in the Outlander Club in the Uscru District of Coruscant, capital of the Galactic Republic.

Galdos Stouff was the Jedi Padawan of the Weequay Sora Bulq. In 22 BBY, both were part of the Jedi assault team that traveled to the planet Geonosis to rescue the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi from Separatist execution.

Cane Adiss was a Yuvernian member of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire. He was present in Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine when the Wookiee Chewbacca was taken prisoner there, and also witnessed the capture of Princess Leia Organa after she freed…

In 22 BBY, Solokin Sakellar was the Grand Warden and absolute ruler of the University of Yabol Opa, a planet-wide university on the Colonies world of Yabol Opa. Sakellar owned a lodge on Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Republic.
Ecressys was the male governor of the Velcar sector under the Galactic Empire. He went rogue after the Battle of Endor as a warlord.
Wan Sandage was a Devlikk podracer from the planet Ord Radama who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

The Lady of Coins was a female individual who had dust-shrouded acolytes on the Outer Rim planet Crucival. Like other factions on the planet, she gave her own reasoning on why she wished to claim Crucival as her own.

Corlac, also known as TK-605, was a human male who served as a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire in the Battle of Jakku. After gunning down their corporal, Corlac and the stormtrooper Terex buried their armor and spent a year building an "Ugly" starship to escape Jakku.
Tambo was a male Valltii scientist who worked with Galen Walton Erso. "Tambo" was a day designation in Vallt.

Nurboo was a male Valltii scientist who worked at the Vallt Experimental Fusion Facility on the planet Vallt. At one point, Nurboo worked with Galen Walton Erso on experiments with kyber crystals. At one point, he requested that Jyn Erso be named after him.
Easel was a male Valltii scientist. "Easel" was a day designation in Vallt.
Cappandar was an alien who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry. By 3 ABY, he was one of the longest-serving members of the company.
Corjentain Malaqua was a female human member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who had known ties to the Sullustan resistance led by Nien Nunb.

An unidentified Bith musician performed a series of concerts on the planet Coruscant during the Clone Wars, playing a wind instrument similar to a kloo horn. A series posters were put up around Galactic City in order to promote the Bith's concerts.
Vifra was a human who served as an engineer in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, nicknamed Twilight Company.
Sax Hastur was a human who served as the commanding officer of Nashtah Squadron.

t: Unidentified Captain of the Royal Guard
x: During the mission to Ryloth in 14 BBY, a clone trooper served as the captain of the Emperor's Royal Guard, the personal security to Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine.

In 21 BBY, a member of the Death Watch was dispatched by the Confederacy of Independent Systems to sabotage a Galactic Republic cruiser in a shipyard, only to be discovered. He engaged the forces onboard and was captured.
Brin was the hero of the holodrama The Octave Stairway. The holo recounted the adventures of Brin, who along with his friends sought to return to his home, by ascending the fabled Octave Stairway.

Kourterel was a male individual who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. He had a child and a family on the astronomical object Vanzeist. In 3 ABY, Prelate Verge, a member of the Imperial Ruling Council, asked after the child.

The Imperial lieutenant Kourterel had a child. In 3 ABY, Prelate Verge, a young member of the Imperial Ruling Council, asked after the child and promised that a detail of stormtroopers would protect Kourterel's family from rebels on Vanzeist.
Eldra Kaitis, a Force-sensitive Rutian Twi'lek female, was a Padawan of the Jedi Order during the twilight years of the Galactic Republic.
"Scout Two" was a human male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic in their Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
Carver was a human male sergeant who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

The mother of Lyra Erso was a female human who lived on Aria Prime and worked as an artist. During the Clone Wars her mother's health began to fail and Lyra suggested to her husband Galen Erso that they relocate to Aria Prime.
The mother of Galen Erso was a female human and the wife of Galen's father. They lived in a poor neighborhood on the planet Grange, where she worked as a preschool teacher.

The father of Galen Erso was a male human. Erso's father worked as a merchant in a poor neighborhood on Grange. He died in a vehicular accident when his son Galen was enrolled in the Republic Futures Program on Brentaal.
"Scout Three" was a female individual who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic in their Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
Has Obitt was a male Dressellian who was a smuggler active during the reigns of both the Galactic Republic and the Galactic Empire. Obitt became a pawn of Orson Krennic in his schemes for power.
Gruppe was a female Valltii who served as a chieftain on the planet Vallt after the death of King Chai during the Clone Wars.

Chai was a male individual who served as King of the planet Vallt. Chai was killed during the Clone Wars when a coup on Vallt occurred. As a result of Chai's death, Marshal Phara ruled the Keep on the planet.
Phara was a female individual who served as a Marshal on the planet Vallt. During the Clone Wars, she contested the rule of the Keep with the incumbent monarch, King Chai.
Prakas was an individual who served as a commander within the Galactic Republic Navy during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Frist was an individual who served as a captain in the navy of the Galactic Republic, during the Clone Wars.

Oyanta was a male human who served as a Lieutenant in the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Oyanta accompanied Lieutenant Commander Orson Krennic to Geonosis to oversee the Geonosians production of the top-secret battle station.

Weng was a male individual who served as a major in the Galactic Empire. In the early years of the Empire's reign, Weng was to come from an administrative building to the Imperial research station on Hypori to brief a group of scientists on plans for where they would be reloca…
Rooni was a blue skinned male Valltii who worked for Zerpen Industries with Galen Walton Erso.

Reeva Demesne was a female Mirialan scientist who worked for the Galactic Republic and later the Galactic Empire, specializing in energy research. She was recruited by Orson Krennic and unknowingly aided in the research and construction of the Death Star's superlaser.
Woana was a female Dressellian who worked as a bar maid at the Wanton Wellspring, on the planet Rajtiri. Fellow Dressellian Has Obitt was attracted to her.

Dagio Belcoze was a male Iktotchi who worked as a computer engineer for the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Belcoze worked in Doctor Gubacher's artificial intelligence team that designed enhanced overseer droids to supervise the battle station labor force.

Ranos Yalli was a Nautolan who sometime after the end of the Clone Wars participated in an smuggling operation with a group of smugglers lead by Saw Gerrera—who later became known as the Partisans— to transport Separatist weapons to Samovar.

Arsha Lome was a female human who worked as a lawyer representing Samovar's mining conglomerate. During his time as a Adjutant General, Wilhuff Tarkin knew Lome and claimed she had as sharp a legal mind as he'd ever encountered.
The father of Jai Kell was a human male. During the Age of the Empire, he died a couple a couple of years before his son became a cadet of the Imperial Academy on Lothal.

Mart Mattin was the nephew of Commander Jun Sato and the leader of Iron Squadron. After his father died, Mattin took over leadership of the squadron. The Iron Squadron became the only rebel cell on the planet Mykapo and harassed Imperial forces there.

Gooti Terez was a female Theelin who served as member of Iron Squadron and later lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She opposed the Galactic Empire alongside her squadmates, Mart Mattin, Jonner Jin, and the astromech droid R3-A3.
Jonner Jin was a human male member of Iron Squadron, a local rebel cell based on the planet Mykapo. In 2 BBY, Jin and his fellow rebels were involved in a skirmish with an Imperial advance patrol.
Sato, or Mart's father, was the father of Mart Mattin, and the brother of Jun Sato, He was married to Mattin with whom he had Mart Mattin.

Cuata was a Pantoran male who was an expert on kyber crystals. Before the Clone Wars placed Mygeeto and Christophsis in danger, he did research on both planets that interested the scientist Galen Erso.

Marsabi was an individual who did research on kyber crystals. Marsabi's research was followed up to a degree by Galen Erso, however he was more interested in what Cuata had been doing on Mygeeto and Christophsis before the Clone Wars placed them in danger.

A human male Imperial officer served under Grand Admiral Thrawn and Admiral Kassius Konstantine during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The officer was stationed on an Arquitens-class command cruiser during a skirmish over the planet Mykapo.
Hatchet was a Weequay who was a enslaved in an Imperial mining facility on the planet Sevarcos. Hatchet was caught in the middle of a battle between the Empire and the New Republic.
A male Morseerian worked as a scientist for the Confederacy of Independent Systems along with Nan Pakota and Urshe Torr during the Clone Wars.
Urshe Torr was a male Morseerian who along with Nan Pakota and another Morseerian worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems as scientists during the Clone Wars.
Nan Pakota was a male Morseerian who along with Urshe Torr and another Morseerian worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems as scientists during the Clone Wars.
A male Koorivar served as a commander for the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

A Hutt was based out of Sy Myrthian space. In 19 BBY, concurrent to the conclusion of the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic, the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt worked for the Hutt.

Chasen Piian was a politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic. Around 1300 BBY, Piian granted a piece of grass land on Coruscant to the sole surviving members of the B'ankora species.

Roman Herbane was a male human who was the Director of the Helical HyperCom facility on Lokori. Herbane had an executive secretary, Li-Tan, that greeted the Erso family when they first arrived at the Helical HyperCom headquarters in Fucallpa.

Vasp Vaspar was a human male politician who represented the Taldot sector in the Imperial Senate. He was also a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and served as the Minister of Industry in the Alliance Cabinet, part of the Alliance Civil Government.

Tynnra Pamlo was a human female politician who represented her homeworld of Taris in the Imperial Senate during the Galactic Empire Era while also being a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Civil Government as Minister of Education.

Tivik was a human male who served as an informant for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, operating on Jedha as one of Cassian Andor's underground contacts to the insurgent group led by Saw Gerrera.
After Archduke Poggle the Lesser was killed on the Outer Rim planet Mustafar by the Sith Lord Darth Vader in 19 BBY, a new Geonosian archduke was appointed by the Stalgasin hive queen by 18 BBY.
Xosad Hozem was a Twi'lek male who became a resistance fighter during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Biyel Broan was a male Sullustan. He was a leader in Sullust's anti-Imperial Cobalt Laborers' Reformation Front until he was forced out due to his associations with criminals.
Donith Garbis was a dangerous crime lord and the patriarch of the Garbis family. In the few years that led to the Battle of Yavin, he and his family operated on the planet of Thune.
Salahi was a male individual who served as a professor and was the lead scientist of the Galactic Republic's Special Weapons Group during the Clone Wars.

Dajo Koda was a Dug who was present at the Wanton Wellspring on Rajtiri before the Campaign at Salient. Koda sat with a group of smugglers including the Dressellian Has Obitt, who Koda had known since before the Clone Wars.

Ribert was a human male smuggler from the planet Coruscant. While with his shipmate on Rajtiri sometime after the end of the Clone Wars, he and his shipmate were present at the Wanton Wellspring cantina in the city of Jibuto.

The shipmate of Ribert was a human male. Sometime after the end of the Clone Wars, the two were present at the Wanton Wellspring on Rajtiri where the two sat with the Nautolan Ranos Yalli and the Dressellian smuggler Has Obitt.

Rattle was a clone trooper of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army. After the Clone Wars ended and the Republic was turned into the Galactic Empire, clone soldiers were decommissioned and replaced by stormtroopers.

An individual served as the president of Helical HyperCom. A few months after the end of the Clone Wars, the scientist Galen Erso told the president that he would need time to think about accepting an offer to replace Roman Herbane as the chief operating officer of Helical's p…

Kiza was a Pantoran female member of the Acolytes of the Beyond. During the Coronet City revolution on Corellia in the months following the Battle of Endor, Kiza freed a fellow acolyte, Remi, from the Peace and Security station in the city.

Remi was a human male who was a member of the Acolytes of the Beyond. In 5 ABY, during a revolution staged by the acolytes in Coronet City on the planet Corellia, Remi was taken to the local Peace and Security station in the city by a detective named Erno, after he caught the …

Borgo was a baby Hutt initially brought into Freetown by members of the Red Key Raiders to be installed into the empty palace once owned by Jabba Desilijic Tiure in the months after the Battle of Endor.

Pash Davane, nicknamed Bash, was a human female who lived on the planet Skorii-Lei during the Galactic Civil War. At some point the Rebellion destroyed the primary industry on Skorii-Lei, causing Davane to go from being an engineer to lifting crates.
Davil was a male Xot who worked for Bidvel at a scrap pile on a remote planetoid in 3 BBY.
Bidvel was a Xot who operated a scrap pile on a remote planetoid with the help of Davil.

Hillat Temple was a human female pilot who flew for the Galactic Empire and later as a criminal in a criminal organization. She was the oldest child in a family whose military service record stretched back thousands of years. Temple graduated first in her class.

Toktar was a female individual who served as a comm officer in the New Republic Starfleet. Totkar was present aboard Home One after the Battle for Kuat Drive Yards and raised Chancellor Mon Mothma on a hologram who reported they had a new message from the Operator.

Mattin was the human mother of Mart Mattin, and the wife of Mart Mattin's father. Sometime during his lifetime, Mart began using his mother's surname. Mattin's favorite establishment on Mykapo was Harmon's bar.
I'dreth was a male Bith who fought in the Cargamalis Street Wars as a sniper. Afterwards, he traveled the Anoat sector during the Iron Blockade, seeking a vengeance only he understood.

Li-Tan was a female human who served as the executive secretary of Director Roman Herbane. During the Clone Wars, a battle was fought on Lokori between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and Galactic Republic in which Li-Tan was killed after sustaining fatal injuries.

A male human served as a superintendent at a Mandalorian school in the New Mandalorians' capital city of Sundari on the planet Mandalore. He became involved in a black market conspiracy during the Clone Wars.

Rikka Soto was a female human who lived in the Anoat sector during the Iron Blockade. When her parents, who were both Imperial officers, were shot for purported treason, she went on a vandalism rampage, getting herself arrested in the process.

Tomith Garbis was a male gangster and the son of Lord Donith Garbis, the patriarch of the Garbis crime family. In the few years that led to the Battle of Yavin, he and his family operated on the planet of Thune.
Niol was a male individual who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. Moff Delian Mors told Commander Karris
Piik was an individual who served as a Colonel in the Imperial Military and was stationed in Lessu on the planet Ryloth.

A male Toydarian merchant operated in Vashka City on the planet Vashka. During the mission to Vashka, Bazine Netal inquired about the latest baffleweave technology with the Toydarian and drove a hard bargain on a ripped gray and black shirt.

A human female served as an ambulance crew member and worked on the planet Vashka. During the mission to Vashka, the mercenary Bazine Netal stabbed herself with a syringe in the meat of her thigh which caused her to collapse.
Quawei was a individual from whom Pash Davane bought medicine in the Skorii-Lei Fish Market sometime after the Battle of Yavin.

Soo-Tath was a Cerean male representative of an organization that Doctor Aphra owed payment to for her collection of secondhand bolts. Sometime after the hijacking of the Executor, Soo-Tath encountered Aphra in Fulan Ro and asked if Aphra owed the first payment.

Ulbik Tan was a human criminal who teamed with the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra in 0 ABY to find a relic below the surface of the suspended mantle known as the Cosmatanic Steppes. Tan, though, backstabbed Aphra and left her dead.

"Red Four" was an individual and a pilot that flew under the callsign Red Four during the Galactic Civil War. The pilot was a member of Red Flight, a starfighter squadron in the service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A male individual was a pilot and flew under the callsign "Red Three" during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of Red Flight, a starfighter squadron in the service of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Jory was a male pilot that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime during the war, Jory was a member of the X-wing starfighter squadron Red Flight and flew under the callsign of Red Two.

Nari Sable was a female human who was a friend of Lyra Erso. Nari accompanied Lyra and her daughter Jyn to research kyber crystals on the Outer Rim world Alpinn. Nari was Lyra's maid of honor at her wedding and made Alderaan her home during the Clone Wars.
Ruescott Melshi was a human male who, growing up, came to resent the Galactic Empire, the successor state of the Galactic Republic.
Vanver Irving was a male individual who was a part of the Irving Boys and stole the Millennium Falcon along with their brother Toursant Irving.

Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod, more commonly referred to as Jo Jerjerrod, was a human male who served in the Resistance Starfighter Corps, commanding his own squadron during their conflict with the First Order.
Toob-Nix was a human male who served as the Sava of the University of Bar'leth in the Core Worlds during the Age of the Empire.

Dunstig Pterro was a human male captain in the Galactic Empire, who served as Director Orson Callan Krennic's personal aide in 1 BBY. This position had him piloting ST 149, a Delta-class T-3c shuttle that was used as a transport for the Director and his death trooper unit.

Weeteef Cyu-Bee was a male Talpini who served as one of the most destructive members of Saw Gerrera's Partisans on Jedha. The diminutive Talpini could hide easily among the taller beings that congregated in the Holy city.

Beezer Fortuna was a male Twi'lek who lived during the Age of the Empire. A cousin of Bib Fortuna, Fortuna was a member of the Partisans led by Saw Gerrera, and was on Jedha at the time of the Destruction of Jedha City.
Oolin Musters, known as Kennel while imprisoned by the Galactic Empire despite identifying herself to others as Nail, was a Blutopian female member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Malthegn was a captain within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy that was stationed in orbit around Ilum aboard the Gladiator-class Star Destroyer Hoplite. Malthegn was responsible for maintaining the blockade put in place around the planet.

Holenesh was a Jedi who discovered a strange anomaly in the Force, centered around a canyon on Ilum. Over time, the Jedi Order established a settlement in the canyon, named after Holenesh in memory of the first discovery.

During the Galactic Civil War, a male individual held the rank of admiral in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 1 BBY, the admiral was in charge of a fleet of starships, including the X-wing starfighter squadron Red Flight.
This individual was a human officer who served the First Order during its conflict with the Resistance. Serving under the command of Colonel Erich S.

This individual was a human male officer who served the First Order during its conflict with the Resistance. He was stationed in the primary fire control room of the Starkiller Base superweapon, under the command of Colonel Erich S. Datoo, at the time of the Hosnian Cataclysm.
Wona Goban was a human female pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who flew with Gold Squadron under the command of Gold Leader Jon Vander.

A Rebel X-wing pilot used the callsign of Red Twelve during the Galactic Civil War and served under Garven Dreis in Red Squadron. During the Battle of Scarif, he flew bravely, leading three of his wingmen on the first attack run on the Scarif Shield Gate.
Jaldine Gerams was a human female from the planet Fresia who authored advanced flight simulators and tirelessly practiced in them with the dream of flying a real starfighter.
In 1 BBY, Blue Squadron was scrambled to aid rebels stealing the Death Star plans on the planet Scarif.

Kado Oquoné was a human male who served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. During the Battle of Scarif, Oquoné was in command of the Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette Lightmaker.
During the Battle of Scarif, an Imperial gate officer wearing a captain's rank insignia plaque with a row of four blue squares worked on the Shield Gate above Scarif as part of Gate Control.
Farns Monsbee was a human who flew as a pilot for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Barion Raner was a human from the planet Ord Mantell who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a pilot. Flying as Blue Four in the Alliance's Blue Squadron, Raner was second-in-command to General Antoc Merrick.

Susina was a friend of Aphra during her studies at the University of Bar'leth. After Aphra's finding on the Abersyn symbiotes, Susina was excited about the quiescent state of the creatures and said they would devote their career to find what kept them in that state in Boothi XII.

Tanith Ponta was a human female who lived on the planet Skuhl during the Age of the Empire. After the death of her father, Ponta found solace in piloting the family's shuttle, helping her mother Akshaya run the family business and teaching her brother Hadder how to fly.

DT-5537 was the designation of a human death trooper that was part of Unit TI-23. Having undergone advanced training at a camp on Scarif and received classified augmentations, DT-5537 was proficient in demolitions, improvised weaponry, and guerrilla tactics.
Nesta Term was a self-proclaimed Lens of the Central Isopter, a death worshipping cult active during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Ralo Surrel was a human male pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early stages of the Galactic Civil War. A member of Red Squadron, he held the rank of major and often flew as wingmate to Red Leader Garven Dreis.
Harb Binli was a human male pilot from Eriadu who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. During the war, Cadet Binli served as Red Seven.

By 1 BBY, Dillems had downed or destroyed 180 enemy craft and was considered an ace. He attended a meeting in the Great Temple where the Alliance High Command refused to support a plan to steal the plans for the Death Star superweapon from the planet Scarif; however, after a g…

TK-32028 was the designation of a human coastal defender stormtrooper captain who was part of the Scarif Deployment. In 1 BBY, TK-32028 was part of the coastal troops stationed on Scarif to protect the citadel.
Rance Lojo was a male Ithorian who was rescued from Imperial forces by the Spectres. Following his rescue, the Ithorian was given shelter in the secret rebel settlement known as the Haven.

Vaneé was a human male attendant who served Darth Vader in the Sith Lord's castle on the planet Mustafar. According to a story told by Mustafarians, he was once an Imperial Inspector, was driven mad by lava fumes, and became an obsessive servant to the Dark Lord.

Voren Na'al was a human male historian who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the New Republic. Na'al served as a lieutenant in the military of the Alliance around the time of the Battle of Scarif.
Puck Naeco was a human male ace pilot who served in the Starfighter Corps of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early Galactic Civil War.

Tam Posla was a Milvaynian human male from the planet Milvayne. He became a respected lawman in the law enforcement known as the Milvayne Authority and eventually began investigating a rash of crimes by the criminal surgeon Cornelius Evazan and his partner Ponda Baba.
A high ranking member of the Milvayne Authority was the superior officer of the celebrated lawman Tam Posla.

Caysin Bog was a humanoid male from the high-gravity world of Teres Lutha Minor. He was blown apart in an insurgency strike on the moon Jedha, only to be surgically pieced back together by a surgeon calling himself "Roofoo." Bog was present in Jedha City in 1 BBY and witnessed…

The High Priest was a Lorrdian male who led the Brotherhood of the Beatific Countenance and gave up his name as part of his faith's renouncement of individuality. His followers referred to him only with a keening wail of a certain pitch.
Huika Siliu was the mother of Pendra Siliu, a girl rescued by Jyn Erso during an attack by the Partisans in Holy City on Jedha.

Capin Harinar was a male human who served as a major and a materials analyst in the Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service division of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the period leading up to the Battle of Yavin.
Silvanie Phest was a female member of an Anomid colony that converted to become Disciples of the Whills shortly before the Battle of Yavin.
Fassio Ablund was a human from the moon Jedha who acted as an informant for the Galactic Empire, providing information on resistance fighter Saw Gerrera's partisans.

According to Cassian Jeron Andor's Rebel Alliance file, which was of questionable accuracy because of the haze of war and covert missions, Andor's father was a human male who, during the Clone Wars, was killed at the Carida Academy during a protest against the increasing milit…
Stel was a male human criminal who came to be known as the Butcher of Brentaal IV after he committed atrocities at some point during the waning decades of the Galactic Republic.

Milton Putna was a human male lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, he was in control of the door of the vault of the Citadel Tower on Scarif. Due to his experience as a former librarian, Putna was familiar with the structure of the data storage system.

Bozeden Jeems was a human Imperial Security Bureau officer who served as Inspector General and oversaw the protection of the data vault in the Imperial Center of Military Research on the planet Scarif. His role made him aware of many of the Galactic Empire's secrets.

Sotorus Ramda was a male human general from Rine-cathe 111 in service of the Galactic Empire. He commanded the Scarif Deployment during the Battle of Scarif. He was relaxed in his duties as commander of the garrison on Scarif.

Criden Valdas was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as a lieutenant in the Imperial Citadel Tower on the planet Scarif, where he was a readiness officer who reported up to General Sotorus Ramda on matters of military technology management and contingency planning.
The chef who operated in the Spectres' secret hideout known as the Haven, was a male Human who offered to cook a celebratory meal, if one of the rebels brought him food to use as ingredients.

Warda Gojun, designated "HH-4413," was a human native of the planet Saleucami. By 1 BBY, he held the rank of sergeant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army and was stationed in Jedha City, where he served as a member of a tank crew commanded by First Sergeant Jimmon Arbmab.

Mytus Adema was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a lieutenant in the Citadel Tower on the planet Scarif. An ambitious man who disliked his superior officer, General Sotorus Ramda, Adema hoped to one day make a damning report on the general's behavior.
Jalice Andit was a human female mercenary from the moon Jedha who lived in Jedha City with her husband, Joali Andit.
Sirro Argonne was a human male scientist who served in the Galactic Republic's Ministry of Science before becoming an operations specialist in the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative.
Woan Barso was a human male who smuggled refugees out of Jedha City on the moon Jedha during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Stordan Tonc, nicknamed "Stordie," was a human male soldier that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a corporal during the Galactic Civil War. He joined the rebels after an uprising on his homeworld of Qemia 7.

The droid maker was a male Ugnaught who operated a droid shack in the secret rebel hideout known as the Haven. He constructed various droids for the Spectres, if given power cells and the proper parts.
Pedrin Gaul was a human male who flew as a Rebel pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, operating under the callsign Red Five.
Lornto Teswam was a female Human from Lothal. Approximately five years before the Battle of Yavin, she and her family became targets of the Galactic Empire.

Xev Xrexus was a human female who founded the Xrexus Cartel during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. Leading her cartel as its Boss-Mistress, Xrexus sold and distributed unlicensed combat automata from semi-legitimate manufacturers.
In 5 ABY, a slicer was hired by former New Republic general Han Solo to slice into the networks of the Galactic Empire.

TK-486 was the designation of a human Stormtrooper Commander in the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, TK-486 was stationed as a sandtrooper in Mos Eisley on the desert planet of Tatooine, where the soldier was once cornered by a trio of Jawas outside of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.
The bounty hunter Fissol had a local contact on the planet Lothal that was a male.
A male near-human served as a representative of Zerpen Industries on the Epiphany moon. He was hairless, had a long face, and wore tight-fitting purple clothing emblazoned with the company logo.
Narrin was a captain who served the Galactic Empire around the time of the mission to Ryloth. He replaced Major Borkas while the latter tried to save Moff Mors from an attack to her life.

Misurno was a male member of the Galactic Empire who had served as the copilot and teacher of Bodhi Rook on the Fentersohn run. Misurno had once shot rebels, pirates and Separatist holdouts in a starfighter and passed on these stories to Rook.
This Karkarodon was imprisoned in the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center.
Derren Flet was an architect who worked for Jabba Desilijic Tiure.

A Gran with pink skin and black eyes was among the bounty hunters hired by the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure to find his son, Rotta, when he was kidnapped by an unknown culprit in the year 22 BBY.

A student hoping to become an archivist in the Graf Archive on the moon Orchis 2 descended into the Shadow Stacks collection of unsorted objects beneath the archive in order to bring back an undiscovered treasure as part of his training.

The father of the Coruscanti man Rorak was a male individual. At some point by 4 ABY, they told their son several stories about the Clone Wars conflict, leading him to believe that the galaxy would always remain in a state of war.
The wife of troublemaker Ketticus Brayl lived together with him and their children on the planet Gorse during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
An Ithorian was a commander of a militia. In 1 BBY, the individual was present at the assembled Rebel Alliance briefing on Yavin 4.

Eli N. Vanto, known during his time with the Chiss Ascendancy as Eli'van'to and Ivant, was a human male who initially served as an ensign and later a commander in the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Gladstone was an individual who served as a captain in the Bespin Wing Guard. He took part in a joint Wing Guard-New Republic mopping-up operation in Cloud City following the liberation of Bespin.
The brother of Aurelant was a male Draedan from Sesid. He owned a company paid by the Galactic Empire to salvage accidentally launched escape pods and get them back in working order.

Nizuc Bek was a male human who was in the palace of the crime lord Jabba the Hutt prior to the Battle of Endor. Bek was hired by Jabba the Hutt to guard celebrities visiting Jabba's palace. He was assigned to protect Sy Snootles, the Max Rebo Band's lead vocalist.

Lumpawaroo, also known as Waroo or Lumpy, was a Wookiee male whose parents were Chewbacca and his wife Mallatobuck. During the Age of the Empire, Waroo and his species were enslaved by the Galactic Empire.
Mapo was a young refugee displaced by the Galactic Civil War. He and his parents lived on Golus Station above the Mid Rim planet of Golus during the Galactic Civil War.
A lieutenant served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic aboard the Remembrance during the Galactic Civil War.
Brockway was a lieutenant general in the army of the New Republic who led their ground forces during the battle against the Galactic Empire on the planet Jakku in the year 5 ABY.
Addar was a human member of the Church of the Force who traveled to the planet Christophsis to return a crate of kyber crystals originally grown there.

The mother of the human male Addar helped to found the religious group known as the Church of the Force. Like his mother, Addar became a member of the church, but unlike them, he did not share in its beliefs.

The mother of Mapo was a female individual. They and their partner were killed when the Galactic Empire bombed the refueling depot Golus Station during the Galactic Civil War. Mapo survived but was badly disfigured and ended up on an orphanage in Theed, the capital of Naboo.

Yuprin Arlo was a senator who represented the planet Hosnian Prime in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic. Arlo and Sondiv Sella, a councilman from Hosnian Prime, supported Chancellor Mon Mothma in her re-election bid against her opponent Tolwar Wartol in the year 5 ABY.
Ash-Streak was the nickname New Republic pilot Temmin Wexley gave to a male desert trooper he encountered during the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

Birt was a chubby Sullustan with a gummy smile who worked as a camera operator for the HoloNet News. In the year 5 ABY, he and reporter Tracene Kane filmed a statement from Chancellor Mon Mothma of the New Republic in the early morning on the planet Chandrila regarding allegat…
A spice-drunk Aybarian diplomat played Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian in a game of Six-Card Gizka Limit. During the game, Calrissian won a Rossmoyne Vitiator pistol from the diplomat.
A human male was the last Imperial sergeant on Cloud City after all of the others had either surrendered or been killed.

A Torphlusian senator represented their homeworld of Torphlus in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic. The senator was present in Izzik's, a restaurant located on the Senate temporary headquarters on Nakadia, around the time of the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.
Tabba Teldar was a human female who was the mother of the bounty hunter Mercurial Swift. Tabba lived in a house in Coronet City on the planet Corellia and was sometimes sent credits by her son.

Bushar was an Abednedo senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic. In the year 5 ABY, Bushar sat on the Committee for Imperial Reallocation and attended a meeting of the committee in the office of Chancellor Mon Mothma on the planet Chandrila.

Danassic was a female individual who by 5 ABY was married to Grand Moff Randd of the Galactic Empire. As her husband was not prone to humor, Danassic told him that she believed he only laughed once or twice a year.
Dann, a human male born on the planet Akiva, was the son of Senator Pima Drolley, who represented their homeworld in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic.

The father of Mapo was a male individual. They and their wife were killed when the Galactic Empire bombarded the fuel depot Golus Station during the Galactic Civil War. Mapo survived but was badly disfigured and ended up as a refugee on the planet Naboo.
The mother of Sinjir Rath Velus was a female human.
This male was the father of New Republic Ensign Ardin Deltura. Unlike their son, the man was a history buff, with their home having little furniture but stacks of books and heaps of maps instead.

Kateena was a child who lived in an orphanage on the planet Jakku. Sometime before the Battle of Jakku, Kateena became wayward after being wooed by Gallius Rax and found a purpose away from the faith of anchorite Kolob.

The mother of Kartessa was a female individual. She was part of a New Republic diplomatic delegation led by Senator Tia'dor Emshwa that traveled to the planet Ithor in 5 ABY during the last throes of the Galactic Civil War.
Kartessa was a Chandrilan female who joined Eleodie Maracavanya's pirate crew. She and her mother were traveling as part of Senator Tia'dor Emshwa's diplomatic mission to the planet Ithor.
The uncle of Stel was a male human who owned a repair shop on Lothal.
Groff was an individual that served the Galactic Empire as a Captain in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War, in command of the Star Destroyer Punishment.
A Zabrak male was a bartender, who owned a bar on the moon Nar Shaddaa which he passed on to his son before he died.
Trayness was a broad-shouldered human female who worked for the Red Key Raiders. In 5 ABY, Trayness participated in the skirmish in Freetown under the leadership of Lorgan Movellan.
A male clone trooper was present on Mandalore at the end of the Clone Wars. He fought in the Siege of Mandalore and was killed on the planet.

Yarra was a Female Twi'lek pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Near the war's end, Yarra participated in the Liberation of Kashyyyk and in the New Republic's climactic battle with the Galactic Empire in the Battle of Jakku, flying a BTL-A4 Y-win…

Jethpur was a male Quarren pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Near the war's end, Jethpur participated in the Liberation of Kashyyyk and in the New Republic's climactic battle with the Galactic Empire in the Battle of Jakku, flying as a member …
The uncle of Vazeen Mordraw was a male individual who lived in the remains of the old Talinn district on the planet Taris.
Erskin Semaj was a human male commander who served as an aide to Senator Mon Mothma in the Imperial Galactic Senate and in her rebellious affairs, secretly as an agent of Luthen Rael's Axis network.

Tyson was a human male pilot who flew under the callsign "Gold Three" for Gold Squadron, a starfighter squadron composed of BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bombers under the command of Captain Jon Vander. In 2 BBY, Tyson was killed during the skirmish in the Archeon Nebula.

"Gold Two" was the callsign given to a female human Rebel pilot serving under Captain Jon Vander in Gold Squadron. She was one of the squadron members who escorted Rebel Senator Mon Mothma's starship, the Chandrila Mistress, to an important meeting on Dantooine.

Gold Five was a human female pilot who flew in Gold Squadron in the rebellion. During a skirmish in the Archeon Nebula, Gold Five noticed that the Ghost was about to be shot down by Vult Skerris, so she came in front and sacrificed her life to save the entire crew, including S…

"Gold Four" was a human male pilot who flew in Gold Squadron in the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. In 2 BBY, he and his fellow pilots escorted Senator Mon Mothma's shuttle Chandrila Mistress into hiding.
Davin was a male Lasat who worked with Ephraim and Mira Bridger during the early stages of the rebellion.
Dunum was a human male who served as an officer of the Galactic Empire in the years prior to the Battle of Yavin.
Effor was a Verpine who worked at a gladiatorial arena during the Imperial Era.
Mattis Banz was a human male who was a member of J-Squadron, a training group within the Resistance against the First Order.
Alster Grove was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy. Grove was suspected to be involved in a plot to assassinate Darth Vader, and was summoned to Virkoi.
Rur was a Force-sensitive male human who lived long before the Galactic Civil War. He led the Ordu Aspectu, a splinter group of the Force-using Jedi Order that sought to achieve immortality.

Lorica Demaris was a Zeltron female who served in the Resistance against the First Order. Prior to joining the Resistance, Demaris was credited with destroying an illegal weapons cache, and her name became famous.
Dec Hansen was a human male scavenger from Ques, a swamp planet in Hutt Space. Hansen was an only child, so his mother built him a "brother," the droid AG-90.
Klimo was a Rodian who gave up his farming life to become a cadet in the Resistance against the First Order. He was recruited in 34 ABY, and he enthusiastically befriended fellow cadet Mattis Banz.
The mother of Riley and her sibling was a female human.

Bors was a Pamarthen pilot who competed in the Gauntlet, a starship race run by Han Solo. During the competition on Corellia, his ship was badly damaged while leaving a hangar, forcing him to drop out of the contest.

Sari Nadle was a human female who served as a cadet in the Resistance's J-Squadron, who was from the planet Baraan-Fa. Nadle had a giant stature, and as a result, her sweet nature was often overlooked.
This Barabel pirate was a member of a pirate faction who held members of the Trade Federation hostage, in 33 BBY. The pirate informed Darth Maul about Xev Xrexus and her auction of a Jedi Padawan.
Streaks was a girl with a lekku who was a member of the Anklebiter Brigade, a resistance cell consisting of children that operated in Coruscant's CoCo Town following the Battle of Endor.
Iggs was a red-headed boy with a cleft lip. He was a friend of the girl Streaks during the Galactic Civil War.
Dellalo Dayson was a female Special Forces sergeant in the New Republic who participated in the Battle of Jakku.
Tarrin Datch was an X-wing starfighter pilot in the Rebel Alliance's Rogue Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Jarret was a male human who, in his youth, worked as a contract killer for the Black Sun crime syndicate. Because of his brutality and lack of scruples, he was known as the Black Nail. At some point, however, Jarret decided to change his life and become a good man.

Boon, also known as "LT-319," was a human male controller and officer that served in the Galactic Empire's Information Office in 2 BBY during the start of the Galactic Civil War. He led a team of Imperial intelligence officers based aboard an IGV-55 surveillance vessel.

3-9 was a human listener who served the Galactic Empire's Information Office under the command of the controller LT-319. They were stationed aboard an IGV-55 surveillance vessel. One of their colleagues was an intelligence officer.

This human Imperial intelligence officer was stationed aboard an IGV-55 surveillance vessel during the Age of the Empire. They were a member of the Imperial Information Office and reported to Imperial controller LT-319.

TK-408 was the designation of a stormtrooper commander who served the Galactic Empire around the time of the Iron Blockade. Two months into the blockade, the trooper was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Nar Hypa, along with Captain Zaul and another unit leader, TK-412.

Odimas was a male Ithorian merchant who sold crystals in the Longstar Marketplace on the planet Burnin Konn, located in the Anoat sector, during the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the sector following the Battle of Endor.
Taslet Colb was a human pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic around the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War.

Effney was a military officer who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to the Battle of Jakku, Effney managed a kesium gas rig in the deserts of Jakku. The rig was manned by several slaves, including the New Republic operative Norra Wexley.
Vazeen Mordraw was a woman who played the role of bait in order for a team of Imperial hunters to capture the bounty hunter Mercurial Swift.

Merra was a human female native of the planet Akiva. Her mother, Senator Pima Drolley, represented their homeworld in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic during the waning months of the Galactic Civil War. She had one sibling, a brother named Dann.
Pima Drolley was a human female senator who represented the planet Akiva in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic. They were the mother of two children, Dann and Merra.
This snowtrooper commander served the Galactic Empire.

Dessard was a commandant who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed at a Wookiee child slave labor camp during the liberation of Kashyyyk. After the Wookiee slave Lumpawaroo escaped, Dessard and his men gave chase.

Uggorda was a Duros who was a member of the Church of the Force. She traveled to the planet Christophsis with four other pilgrims to follow the orders of Brin Izisca and return a crate of kyber crystals back to where they belonged.

Jumon was an Iakaru who was a member of the Church of the Force. He traveled to the planet Christophsis with 4 other pilgrims to follow the orders of Brin Izisca and return a crate of kyber crystals back to where they belonged.

Madrammagath was an Elomin who was a member of the Church of the Force. He traveled to the planet Christophsis with four other pilgrims to follow the orders of Brin Izisca and return a crate of kyber crystals back to where they belonged.

Tae Nunb was a Sullustan male. He accompanied smuggler and Cloud City Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian to the Anoat sector during the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade of the sector following the Battle of Endor.
Skraik was a male Sneevel crime lord who operated in Garel City, Garel. He led a gang of pint-sized sentients whom he forced to steal starship parts so he could sell them on the black market.
Gigi was a partially tamed female Gundark that the Sneevel crime lord Skraik used as a means of keeping his thieves in line.

This individual was a human officer who served the First Order during its conflict with the Resistance. The officer was stationed in the primary fire control room of the Command Center of Starkiller Base and helped oversee the charging of the superweapon.
Lunak was an alien individual who served the Rebel Alliance as a member of Rogue One alongside K-2SO, Jyn Erso, Senna, Dray Nevis, Ria Talla, and Jerris Kestal.

Lorvo Derigo was a male Aqualish citizen of Lothal, who was rescued from Imperial forces by the Spectres. Following his rescue, Derigo was given shelter in the secret rebel settlement known as the Haven.
The mother of Dec Hansen was a human female who created the droid AG-90 to be a "brother" to her son.
Jax Jerjerrod, the son of Tiaan Jerjerrod and the father of Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod, was a human male who like his wife, Jul Jerjerrod, was an officer of the First Order.
who was an accomplished pilot and a high-ranking officer of the First Order. She was married to Jax Jerjerrod and was the mother of Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod.
The father of Mattis Banz was a human male.
The mother of Mattis Banz was a human female.

Harra was a Hutt crime lady who operated on the swampy planet of Vodran, in Hutt Space. She made her fortune buying, selling and trading exotic creatures, including rancors, for other Hutts around the galaxy.

A pilot served in the Imperial Navy. In 2 BBY, shortly before the Rebel Alliance's establishment, the pilot accompanied Vult Skerris in pursuit of Mon Mothma, a traitor who had spoken out against the Galactic Empire.
A crewman was a human who served in the Rebel Alliance. In 2 BBY, at Chopper Base, the crewman attempted to prevent Ezra Bridger from stealing an RZ-1T trainer to go off on an unauthorized mission.
Bogg Tyrell was an Aleena female from their species' homeworld, Aleen, which they represented in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.
Vit Chuto was a male Rodian who was rescued from the Galactic Empire by the Spectres.
Jimnaj was a male human who resided in Haven on the planet Lothal.
Jia Elskni was a female human who was rescued from the Galactic Empire by the Spectres.

Jaidra was a female human who served as a major in the Imperial Military. When Governor Ubrik Adelhard established the lock down of the entire Anoat sector, Jaidra reckoned that he had lost his mind, and that his action would lead the sector's Imperials to their doom.
BK-298 was a female human who was a Rebel Alliance sleeper operative. Hypnotic suggestions ensured she believed herself to be a loyal stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire instead of a Rebel spy.

Marn was a woman who ran the orphan farm of Lund Gourley on Durkteel, at the time of the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance. She took care of her orphans who, in exchange, would work in the farm's hemmel fields.
This individual was a human male who served in the Alliance Fleet at the beginning of the Galactic Civil War.

An unidentified human served in the Alliance Military at the beginning of the Galactic Civil War. After Jyn Erso was freed from Imperial captivity by Extraction Team Bravo, the Rebel lead her through the Great Temple to bring her before the Rebel Alliance leaders.
Nioma was a female individual who served as a captain in the Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service. By the time of the aftermath of the Battle of Endor, she had been promoted to major.
Ossin Nandar was a male Gotal citizen of Lothal who was rescued by the Spectres and granted shelter in the Haven.

Vorhdeilo was a Culisetto female bounty hunter prior to the Invasion of Naboo. At some point, Vorhdeilo worked alongside fellow bounty hunters Cad Bane, Aurra Sing, and Troo-tril-tek to assist Darth Maul in tracking down and capturing Eldra Kaitis.
Calgriz was a male Quarren who went by the nickname Dirty Calgriz. Sometime prior to the Invasion of Naboo, Darth Maul arrived on Nar Shaddaa looking for information on the Crime lord, Xev Xrexus.
Tobias Beckett was a human male professional thief and gunslinger native to Glee Anselm who worked for the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate during the early reign of the Galactic Empire.
Troo-tril-tek, also known as Tek-tek, was a Chadra-Fan bounty hunter who worked with Darth Maul alongside Cad Bane, Aurra Sing and Vorhdeilo.
"Green Leader" was a human male pilot that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Woldar was a human male who served as a commander in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire where he served in Grand Admiral Thrawn's Seventh Fleet by 2 BBY.

Vienaris was a male individual who worked as a spaceport control officer before joining the Alliance to Restore the Republic. By the time of the Battle of Scarif, he served in the Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service and held the rank of captain.
Shaith Vodran was an individual who worked on the Death Star project, with the title of Engineering Operations Manager.
Mennis Duren was a member of a sentient species and had yellow skin, gray hair, and orange eyes. The alien was present on the Ring of Kafrene trading outpost in 1 BBY.

Meggone was a female individual who lived in the Holy City of Jedha in 1 BBY. Although she was part of a Force-worshipping cult that performed pilgrimages and smoke ceremonies, Meggone avoided getting too wrapped up in the particulars of her tradition.
Rai'sodan was a cyan-skinned male Twi'lek who, by 1 BBY, was part of Saw Gerrera's Partisans. Although young and slim, he was a capable fighter.
This individual was a human who was a pilot of the Lord Junn. They assisted Princess Leia Organa's mission to rescue Alderaanians in the galaxy by flying members of the Melodic Order.

The mother of Dav and Webb Taffral was a female who had two children with the farmer Glen Taffral, who lived on the planet Saleucami. Prior to the two meeting, Glen thought he would remain a bachelor and a simple farmer. She died prior to the rebellion on Akiva in 4 ABY.
Beckgam was a child from the Outer Rim Territories who ended up as a refugee orphan on the planet Durkteel, where he was taken in by an orphan farm near the settlement of Lund Gourley.
J'mi was a slight alien girl with a protruding doglike snout and mottled brown-and-white fur. She hailed from Regor-Mada, and ended up being recruited into the Resistance.

Dathcha was a Jawa who lived on the desert planet Tatooine. In 1 BBY, Dathcha led a group of Jawas in the Jundland Wastes, where they captured the astromech droid R2-D2. Dathcha was famous for taunting a krayt dragon and living to tell the tale.

A Rebel trooper served on Phoenix Cell's flagship, the Phoenix Nest, during the Battle of Atollon. After the order given by Commander Jun Sato to evacuate the ship, the trooper and his partner decided to stay with their commander.

Kit Valent was a human male who served as a pilot in Rogue Squadron. During the Battle of Hoth, Valent was the gunner for Zev Senesca's T-47 airspeeder under the callsign Rogue Two. Valent and Senesca both died when their airspeeder was shot down.

Kem Monnon was a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the two-year construction of Echo Base on the ice planet Hoth, engineers under Monnon's guidance cut many of the corridors, including those at the base's southern end.

The Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator pursued the Tantive IV and disabled it over the planet Tatooine. Smadis was then among those on board who took position at the port airlock and engaged Imperials stormtroopers there when they boarded the ship.
Pyparr was a human male officer who served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War, a pan-galactic conflict between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
A male Anacondan bartender worked in Trueping's around 20 BBY. He had no arms and legs, and so used his tail to distribute drinks to patrons, hanging from a rack over the cantina counter.
Sache Skareet was a human female soldier of the Resistance. She served the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order.

Kardue'sai'Malloc was a wily Devaronian male who served as a cruel army captain on his homeworld, Devaron. He later went into hiding under the alias Labria while on the run from his wicked past life, which had resulted in him having one of the largest bounties in the galaxy.
During the Reign of the Empire, a Duros bounty hunter was present in a bar on the planet Lothal shortly before the mission to rescue the Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus.

Pierson was a human who served as a Vice Admiral in the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. Late in the Galactic Civil War, Pierson served onboard the Ravager, one of the last Super Star Destroyers left in the Imperial fleet.

Fektrin was a male alien who served as a sergeant in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, commonly referred to as Twilight Company. On the planet Vir Aphshire, in 0 ABY, he handed the private Hazram Namir a report to hand to the company's captain Micha Evon.

Toshma Jefkin was a human male who served as a soldier in the Rebel Alliance's military and as a guard in the Alderaanian consular security. He was serving aboard the Tantive IV as its second officer in 1 BBY.
Antidar Williams was a human officer of the Judicial Forces of the Galactic Republic, training at the Judicial Academy on the planet Coruscant.
He informed Skywalker's companion, Han Solo, that the Jedi had not returned, then unsuccessfully attempted to dissuade Solo from leaving the base on a tauntaun to search for his missing friend.
Antha Mont was an old female Skup who drove the drift shuttle for an orphanage on Durkteel.

RK-242 was an Imperial stormtrooper who was stationed on Jakku shortly before the Battle of Jakku. He was among the Imperial forces that had relocated to the barren desert world under the orders of Counselor to the Empire Gallius Rax.

Colvett Valeria was a female human pilot and former lover of Obi-Wan Kenobi who served as a Lieutenant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Horox Ryyder was an Anx male who served as a senator for the Raioballo sector in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. Respected and loved by the entire Republic, he had a quiet and soothing demeanor and was well known for his patience and insight.
Fema Baab was a female human senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. Near the end of the Clone Wars, she was a steadfast supporter of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine.
Rethalow was a Frong who was a senator in the New Republic by 5 ABY.

Giddean Danu was a human male senator who represented Kuat in the Galactic Senate of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Prior to the war's end, he supported the Delegation of 2,000 out of concern over various amendments to the constitution.
Nank Tun was an Aqualish who served as an aide to Senator Po Nudo throughout the Clone Wars.
Cellheim Anujo served as an aide to Senator Tundra Dowmeia of the Galactic Senate toward the end of the Clone Wars.
Beytolim was a Pacithhip who, in 19 BBY, was present outside the Galaxies Opera House on the planet Coruscant while it hosted a performance of the Mon Calamari ballet Squid Lake.

Tolwar Wartol was a male Orishen senator of the New Republic. Prior to the Battle of Jakku, he was a political rival of Chancellor Mon Mothma, whom he regarded as weak and indecisive. He also had dealings with the Black Sun and Red Key Raiders crime syndicates.
Tanus Spijek was an Elom male spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic hired to carry messages between the planet Alderaan and the moon Yavin 4 during the Galactic Civil War.

A technician served under a unidentified officer in the blockade above Lothal. When Chopper, disguised as droid 264, arrived on the light cruiser Tellstar, he told him he was late and told him to plug in.
This human male served as a pilot in Phoenix Cell. He piloted the CR90 corvette Liberator when the ship was pulled out of hyperspace by Brom Titus' Imperial Interdictor.
A male Rodian worked as a fruit vendor in the settlement of Kothal on the planet Lothal in the year 5 BBY.
A human male served as a captain in the Rebel Alliance. When Green Squadron were sent to help Teralov under a blockade by the Empire, the captain participated in the mission.

Zil Topur was a Quarren with orange skin and blue eyes. In 22 BBY, Topur wore a crimson robe while attending a session of the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate in the main chamber of the Senate Building on the planet Coruscant where Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks propos…

Nyx Okami was a young mechanic who lived in the lower levels of Coruscant during the Clone Wars. During this time, he encountered and became romantically involved with former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano.
Ann Gella was a Twi'lek female from the planet Ryloth who was enslaved with her twin sister Tann Gella and sold to the Dug Podracer Sebulba by crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
An Imperial officer was stationed on Wilhuff Tarkin's Star Destroyer, the Sovereign, around 5 BBY. When the Ghost crew knocked out Bay 5, he informed Tarkin about it.

Ar'alani, born as Irizi'ar'alani and also known by her core name Ziara, was a Chiss female admiral who served in the Expansionary Defense Fleet of the Chiss Ascendancy nation during the Clone Wars and the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Vanto was a male individual from the Wild Space planet Lysatra who operated a shipping business. He and his wife had a son, Eli, who worked in the family in his youth and later entered the Imperial Academy on Myomar with aspirations of becoming a supply officer.

Vanto was a female individual from the Wild Space planet Lysatra who operated a shipping business. She and her husband had a son, Eli, who worked in the family in his youth and later entered the Imperial Academy on Myomar with aspirations of becoming a supply officer.
The uncle of Driller MarDapp was a male senior staff officer at the Royal Imperial Academy during the early stages of the Imperial Era.
The older brother of Clay Tanoo was a male individual who was arrested for being in possession of a rare variety of spice called scarn.

Sartan was an individual who held the military rank of Fleet Admiral within the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire, and served as the commanding officer of the Seventh Fleet until around the year 2 BBY as a member of the Imperial Navy's officer corps.

Iden Versio was a human female soldier who served in the military of the Galactic Empire. A TIE fighter pilot in the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Iden became Commander of Inferno Squad, an Imperial Special Forces commando unit assembled by her father, Admiral Garrick Versio, in…
Del Goren was a human male member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as a communications and sensors expert in Alliance High Command.

Bana Breemu was a human native of Humbarine, capital world of the Humbarine sector. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Breemu served as a senator in the Republic's Galactic Senate, representing the Humbarine sector.

Sephjet Josall was a human male who served as a Jedi Knight in Jedi Order. In 22 BBY, Josall was part of a Jedi assault team that Jedi Master Mace Windu led to the planet Geonosis to rescue Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had been captured by the Confederacy of Independent Sys…

Haal was an male Aqualish who served in the Resistance as a member of J-Squadron, a squadron of cadets training for the Resistance's Resistance Starfighter Corps around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.

Leeson Juben was a female human who served in the Resistance as a member of J-Squadron, a squadron of cadets training for the Resistance's Resistance Starfighter Corps around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Lufa Danak was a Neimoidian who served the Trade Federation during the reign of the Galactic Republic.

Eeusu Estornii was a female Senator in the Galactic Senate of the Republic. She was an ally of fellow Senator Padmé Amidala, and was one of the many mourners to attend her funeral on Amidala's homeworld of Naboo in 19 BBY, where Estornii with other senators in the procession b…

Rose Tico was a female human who served in the Resistance as a maintenance worker during their conflict with the First Order, whom Tico had hated since she was a child. Tico's older sister, Paige, was a gunner in the Resistance.
Ayer was a major in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps who served aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera as its Stormtrooper Commander.

Ela Tips was a worker living on Coruscant in 22 BBY. Wearing a navy bodysuit, a helmet and a breath mask, Tips was a patron in the Outlander Club, in the Uscru Entertainment District, in the last years of the Galactic Republic.

Elainye Pryce was a Lothalite human female who was the mother of Arihnda Pryce and the wife of Talmoor Pryce. Like her husband, she was part owner of Pryce Mining but by the time of the doonium vein discovery, her daughter was running the company.
Talmoor Pryce was a Lothalite human male who was the father of Arihnda Pryce and the husband of Elainye Pryce. He and his wife Elainye owned Pryce Mining while their daughter managed the mine.
Cal Alder was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the High Command of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Durteel Haza was a Delphidian male who spent time watching a fighting droid match in Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana in 34 ABY. He looked up from the game when Maz Kanata, the owner of the castle, shouted out to the smuggler Han Solo.

Lana Dobreed was a human who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In 32 BBY, they were in Mos Espa, a spaceport settlement located on the desert planet of Tatooine. Dobreed served as a podracer mechanic and wore dark-colored welding goggles.

Rukh was a male Noghri from Honoghr who served as the bodyguard and assassin of Imperial Admiral, later Grand Admiral Thrawn. Thrawn used Rukh's name as the override command for his sparring droids. Rukh was an excellent tracker and fighter with a strong sense of smell.
Nicanas Tassu was a human male who became a Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order and was notable for his skill in Force jumping.
Chon Actrion, also known as the "Architect of Freedom," was a famous Jedi Master at some point in the history of the Galactic Republic.

Veedaaz Awmetth was a humanoid politician who served as a senator of the Galactic Senate during the Republic Era. They were an ally to Senator Padmé Amidala, and were one of the many thousands of mourners to attend her funeral on Naboo in 19 BBY.
Cobb Sonbepol was a Gotal who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in the year 1 BBY.

Nar Hida was a Luptoomian human who left the planet Coruscant as a freighter tramper on board the AA-9 Freighter-Liner Jendirian Valley in 22 BBY. The freighter took off from Westport on Coruscant headed for the Mid Rim planet Naboo.
A Imperial officer held the rank of commander during the Blockade of Ibaar.
Waks Burr was an Ishi Tib who visited the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.
Ister Paddie was a human senator of the Galactic Republic who served in Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine's Loyalist Committee during the Separatist Crisis.
Nevil Cygni, also known by his alias Nightswan, was a male human smuggler and insurgent leader during the Imperial Era.

Jok Donassius was a human male who served as a Fleet Admiral in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy and Imperial High Command. During his service, he held command over Admirals Durril, Kinshara, Thrawn, and their respective task forces.

Garrick Versio was a human male who held the title of Inspector General and later the military rank of admiral in the Imperial Security Bureau, a law enforcement and intelligence agency of the Galactic Empire.

Malarus was a human female who served as a commander in the First Order around 34 ABY. She arrested the First Order Security Bureau Agent Terex after he undertook a rogue mission to destroy the Resistance.

Gideon Hask, nicknamed "Gid," was a human male native of the planet Kuat. During the Galactic Civil War, Hask served as a soldier and starfighter pilot before joining the ranks of Inferno Squad—an elite commando unit of the Galactic Empire.

Rum Sleg was a humanoid male bounty hunter who spent time at Mos Espa spaceport on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY. While at the spaceport, he passed by a DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid shortly before attending the Boonta Eve Classic podrace at the Mos Espa Grand Arena.

Rik Virgilio was a male human who served as captain of the Gozanti-class cruiser Blood Crow before being replaced by Filia Rossi. After researching on why Virgilio had been replaced, Ensign Eli Vanto could not find anything except that Rossi was very well connected.
Filia Rossi was a female human who graduated from the Imperial Academy on Raithal. She later replaced Rik Virgilio as captain of the Gozanti-class cruiser Blood Crow.
Bok Askol was a Pacithhip female from Shimia who worked as a podracer engineer. In 32 BBY, Askol was present in Mos Espa spaceport on the planet Tatooine to attend the Boonta Eve Classic podrace.

Dorovio Bold was a human female who flew as a Rebel pilot in the Starfighter Corps of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Fleet during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Bold had fair skin, brown eyes and black hair.

Kirak Infil'a was a male Jedi Master who was active between the High Republic Era and the final years of the Galactic Republic. Infil'a specialized in combat during his time as an active member of the Jedi Order.

Alfren Cheno was a human male commander in the Imperial Navy in the years before the Galactic Civil War. He commanded the Thunder Wasp during the battle over Umbara with his first officer Captain Thrawn.

Karyn Faro was a human female who served as a commodore in the Imperial Navy. During the years she served as Thrawn's second-in-command—first aboard the Chimaera, then with the 96th Task Force and eventually the 7th Fleet—she rose from a Commander to the rank of Commodore.
Eccos was a female Anx who was in charge of mining at Pryce Mining.

Ranz was a male soldier who served as a major in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He fought against the Galactic Empire in the Battle of Jakku, as the commanding officer of the Third Recon Group, a military unit in the ground forces of the New Republic's military.
Ulfor Bombaasa was a male human who was present outside the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru District of the planet Coruscant in the year 19 BBY during a performance of the opera Squid Lake.
