Opula Deget was a golden-skinned alien with brown eyes who was present outside the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru District of the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY during a performance of the opera Squid Lake.
Koyi Mateil was a wealthy Twi'lek duchess who was the wife of the old human Duke Teta. She secretly hoped for her husband to die so that she could inherit his fortune.
Teta was a human male duke who was married to the younger Twi'lek Koyi Mateil. Mateil secretly hoped for her husband to die so that she could inherit his fortune.

Juahir Madras was a human female who lived on Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During her time on the galactic capital, Madras befriended Driller MarDapp, the leader of Higher Skies Advocacy Group, and Arihnda Pryce of Lothal.
Arik Uvis was a human male individual from the Core who worked for the office of Governor Ryder Azadi.

Arim Meensa was an Imperial V-wing starfighter pilot who held the rank of Wing Leader in 14 BBY. He and his pilots were loyal to Colonel Belkor Dray, who governed Ryloth on behalf of Moff Delian Mors.
C'ai Threnalli was an Abednedo male pilot who flew in the Resistance Starfighter Corps of the Resistance during their war with the First Order.
Wright was a human female pilot who served as a lieutenant and flew in the Resistance Starfighter Corps during its conflict with the First Order.
Lomar was a male Senior Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy who served aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Chimaera as its senior communications officer for several years.
Jee Kra was a Moogan male industrialist who won Jedi Padawan Eldra Kaitis in an auction hosted by Xev Xrexus. As he attempted to leave Xev's hideout, he was killed by Darth Maul.

Supi was a green-skinned Twi'lek who served the corrupt Senator Orn Free Taa as a loyal aide. Supi had a bitter rivalry with another of Taa's aides named Pampy, and the two fiercely competed for his favor.
Dar Wac was a Rodian who served as aide to Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine in his office during the final years of the Galactic Republic.

Kalyn Farnmir was a human female bounty hunter who unsuccessfully tried to pin her crimes on her former partner, Cian Shee. In 22 BBY, Farnmir spent time with Shee in the Outlander Club in the Uscru District of the planet Coruscant.

Ophim was a male Imperial pilot who lived during the Age of the Empire. In 14 BBY, he served as Colonel Belkor Dray's pilot during Cham Syndulla's attempt to assassinate Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader.

Forch Gomou was a reactor tender working in 22 BBY on Coruscant. He wore a Burgundy Bodysuit. Gomou was a patron in the Outlander Club, in the Uscru Entertainment District, in the last years of the Galactic Republic. Gomou had black hair and brown eyes.
Agrippa Aldrete was a human male who at one point served as the senator of the planet Alderaan in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.
Wernad was a Trandoshan male who lived on Jedha. At some point during the Galactic Empire's occupation of Jedha, Wernad and his clutchmates were forced to work in the kyber crystal mines.

Kozem Pel was a Disciple of the Whills who edited the Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a collection that contained writings by spiritual figures as well as codes and mantras such as the Guardian's Mantra.

Karyn I'Yin was a female member of the Sisters of Sarrav who was quoted speaking about all things being bound to the Force in Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a compilation of writings on the Force edited by the Disciple of the Whills Kozem Pel.

Aurek was a pupil of the Central Isopter religious group and was quoted speaking about death in Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a compilation of writings concerning the Force edited by the Disciple of the Whills Kozem Pel.

Sajar Ohmo was a member of the nomadic enclave known as the Clan of the Toribota. Ohmo was quoted in Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a compilation of writings on the Force edited by the Disciple of the Whills Kozem Pel.

Oz Ladnod was a poet to the Royal Court of the planet Onderon whose work was included in Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a compilation of writings on the Force edited by the Disciple of the Whills Kozem Pel.

Mete Janvaren was an individual from the world Mirial who was quoted in Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a compilation of writings on the Force edited by the Disciple of the Whills Kozem Pel.

Dejammy Shallon was a female individual who served as a teacher and a priestess on D'janis IV. She was quoted comparing water to the Force in Collected Poems, Prayers, and Meditations on the Force, a compilation of material relating to the Force compiled by the Disciple of the…

Durril was a human male who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy and was present during the Batonn insurgency. Admiral Durril commanded the Imperial Star Destroyer Judicator of the One Oh Third Task Force during the Battle of Scrim Island.
Brento was a female individual who served as a captain of the Arquitens-class light cruiser Shyrack in the Imperial Navy. Brento was present during the Batonn insurgency.
Yelfis was a captain who served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Batonn insurgency. They commanded the light cruiser Tumnor.

B'asia was a young Togruta female who resided at the orphanage of Killi and Kaya Gimm in Jedha City. During the Galactic Empire's occupation of Jedha, Imperial stormtroopers raided Gimm's orphanage in search of contraband.

Althin was a Rodian male born on the moon Jedha to Steya and Tok, owners of a shop in Jedha City. Several weeks before his eighth birthday, Althin's parents were killed during an attack on the Galactic Empire by Saw Gerrera's partisans.

A female individual was the mother of Greer Sonnel. She and her partner once served within the military of the Galactic Empire as only two of many from the planet Pamarthe that chose to do so, but defected to instead fly for the Rebel Alliance after learning of the destruction…
Gem Sirrom was a human senator of the Galactic Republic's Senate, where Sirrom was an ally of fellow Senator Padmé Amidala.
Kaya Gimm was a female individual who during the occupation of Jedha ran an orphanage with her sister Killi Gimm, after having previously run a droid repair shop.

Denic was a female human pilot and mechanic who worked in a personally-owned garage at Jedha City a few months before the Battle of Yavin. It was rumored she used to be a smuggler in the Corporate Sector.
Melas was a Sarkan patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY.

Willrow Hood was a human gas miner who was a resident of Cloud City, a mining colony in the atmosphere of the planet Bespin, during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He worked at a gas mining operations center in the city but wanted a career in smuggling.

Delva Racine was a human high-fashion designer during the Republic Era. In 19 BBY, on the planet Coruscant, they were walking up the steps of the Galaxies Opera House with another human patron during a performance of Squid Lake when the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker ran past th…

Saylind Donels was a human male youngling of the Jedi Order's Bear Clan. In the year 22 BBY, Donels and other members of the clan were being trained in lightsaber use by Jedi Grand Master Yoda when Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi came to Yoda seeking advice on his inability to find…
Geezum was a Snivvian male who in 4 ABY was present in the palace of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure when the Jedi Luke Skywalker killed Jabba's rancor Pateesa.

Neb Creip was a human who served as a senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. Creip was an ally of fellow Senator Padmé Amidala and was one of the many thousands of mourners to attend her funeral in the city Theed on the planet Naboo shortly after the end of the Clone …
Perrili was a Xexto female smuggler who served as Captain of the bulk freighter Romary. She was also a Resistance contact in the galactic underworld.
Reece Tallent was a human male soldier who fought the Galactic Empire as part of Saw Gerrera's extremist movement.
Talwer was a male human Rebel soldier who fought against Imperial forces in 1 BBY. He was present aboard a rebel UT-60D U-Wing and was a member of the Massassi Group.

Idryssa Barruck was a human female soldier who worked in the fight against the Galactic Empire. When Saw Gerrera took in the eight year-old girl Jyn Erso, Idryssa brought her suitable clothes and taught her about health and hygiene, including menstrual health.

Akshaya Ponta was a human female cargo pilot that lived on the planet Skuhl. She was the mother of two children, Tanith and Hadder Ponta. When Jyn Erso was looking for transportation, Akshaya took her to Skuhl for the price of fixing her broken droid.

"Quickdraw" was the nickname of a human female TIE fighter pilot in the First Order. She served as a Special Forces pilot who flew one of the specialized TIE/sf space superiority fighters. Quickdraw had light skin and dirty blonde hair.

Neesh was a Rodian bounty hunter. When assigned to assassinate a bumbling bounty hunter named Greedo, he hired Spruch "Warhog" Goa to carry out the deed. Goa then encouraged Greedo to try and capture Han Solo on his own.

Sheckil was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Sheckil accompanied Darth Vader on his mission to Cloud City on Bespin, and was an officer in the unit attempting to capture Han Solo, Princess Leia and Luke Skywalker.

Tann Gella was a Twi'lek female with a twin named Ann Gella. The pair were from the planet Ryloth and were enslaved, with the podracer Sebulba purchasing Ann and Tann from the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Maoi Madakor was a human who served as a captain in the Judicial Forces during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
Zorahda was a female Lunnix who was a cell mate of Jyn Erso during her time spent in the Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on Wobani.

Dral was a male human who served a pirate faction. In 33 BBY, the faction attacked the Trade Federation who were using mining facilities on planet Kellux in the Kellux system, as Darth Maul entered the system to ensure his master's interests were protected he destroyed Dral's …

A female abersyn symbiote served as the Force-sensitive sentient queen of Ktath'atn. One day of each year, the Queen of Ktath'atn would open her citadel's doors to see visitors and grant favors in exchange for receiving the galaxy's most interesting oddities, which she feasted…
Beckles was an Ugnaught who worked at the Resistance base on D'Qar.
Fikk was a Saurin male who lived in Lund Gourley on the planet Durkteel.
Tchock was a Cerean male who lived in Lund Gourley on the planet Durkteel.
Golin was a Saurin who lived in the outskirts of Lund Gourley on the planet Durkteel. In 34 ABY, he left Durkteel to join Leia Organa's Resistance.

Bombinax was a male individual who served as a lieutenant to the force-wielding Queen of the planet Ktath'atn. As with all her subjects, he was infected with an Abersyn symbiote that was part of the hive under the queen's control.
Varroa was an individual who was a servant of the Queen of Ktath'atn. They were in charge of receiving each guest proposal during the Queen's reception.
Vespinax was an individual who was a servant of the Queen of Ktath'atn.
Jeeta was a Rodian bounty hunter who lived during the Age of the Empire and the rise of the New Republic.

A Rodian male was an associate of the Dowutin bounty hunter Grummgar. He was based at Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana. Following the Quest for the Kyber Saber Crystals, Kordi Freemaker tried to barter an ion projector for a Type A vector coil.
Rose was an individual from a caterpillar-like species. She had multiple arms.
Amilyn Holdo was a human female politician, military commander, and freedom fighter who served in both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Resistance.

"DJ," shortened form of "Don't Join," was the alias of a human male slicer who resided in the galaxy during the war between the Resistance and the First Order. An amoral thief, he spoke with a stutter and was also skilled at slicing into computer systems.

Paige Tico, nicknamed Pae-Pae by her sister, was a human female who served as a gunner on a MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 in the Resistance during their conflict with the First Order. She was the sister of Rose Tico, a Resistance maintenance worker.

Ma'kis'shaalas was a Kajain'sa'Nikto male Jedi Knight who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. He attended meetings at the briefing room in the Jedi Temple regarding updates on the Galactic Republic's war with the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Tanner Cadaman was a human senator who represented his homeworld, Feenix, in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic.
Sateen Vestswe was a human who served as an aide to Senator Bail Organa of the planet Alderaan during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic.
Hadder Ponta was a male who lived on Skuhl. He was the son of the cargo pilot Akshaya Ponta, and the brother of Tanith Ponta.

Hobisan Vandron was a distant relation to a member of the Galactic Empire's Advisory Council. Vandron revered Emperor Palpatine and was one in a generation allowed to paint the sovereign's likeness in official works of propaganda.

Rissa Mano, a Force-sensitive Devaronian, was a Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. In addition to her skills as a Jedi, Mano was a gifted pilot and engineer.

Zeehay Versio was a female who was the mother of the human Iden Versio. Zeehay was a premier artist who created propaganda posters for the Galactic Empire's Coalition for Progress, including the Young Imperials Can Reach The Stars which depicted Iden gazing up raptly at the st…
Pampy was a Rutian Twi'lek who served as a loyal aide to Senator Orn Free Taa of the Galactic Republic's Senate.

Korbus was an individual who was a member of the Acolytes of the Beyond in 5 ABY. Korbus was among two dozen Acolytes present on the planet Devaron shortly before they attacked a New Republic outpost on the planet.

Lalu was an individual who was a member of the Acolytes of the Beyond in 5 ABY. Lalu was among two dozen Acolytes present on the planet Devaron shortly before they attacked a New Republic outpost on the planet.

Yiz was an individual who was a member of the Acolytes of the Beyond in 5 ABY. Yiz was among two dozen Acolytes present on the planet Devaron shortly before they attacked a New Republic outpost on the planet.
Lexi Dio was a human who served as a senator for the planet Uyter in the Galactic Republic during the Separatist Crisis.

Rynscar was a Black Sun underboss who lived in the last years of the Galactic Empire. In 5 ABY, Rynscar ambushed the Zabrak bounty hunter Jas Emari and her New Republic boyfriend Jom Barell while they were visiting Nar Shaddaa to seek information about Han Solo's whereabouts.

Kertas was a female alien who was a rebel spy along with her twin Rismor. On the suggestion of General Davits Draven, Kertas and Rismor accompanied Captain Cassian Andor on a mission he undertook to the planet Wecacoe to extract Imperial security protocols.

Rismor was a female alien who was a rebel spy along with her twin Kertas. On the suggestion of General Davits Draven, Rismor and Kertas accompanied Captain Cassian Andor on a mission he undertook to the planet Wecacoe to extract Imperial security protocols.

Tobler Ceel was a Gungan male who served as the leader of the Gungan Grand Army and was the most experienced officer in its officer corps. He fought during the Battle of Naboo against the Trade Federation on his homeworld of Naboo in the year 32 BBY.
Spob Rydel was a male security officer stationed at a Peace and Security station in Coronet City following the Battle of Endor.
Erno was a male detective who worked at a Peace and Security station in Coronet City in the months following the Battle of Endor. He was divorced from his wife.

Urk G'lar was an Ongree male from the planet Coruscant, who during his childhood served as a member of the Anklebiter Brigade, a group of rebel children who opposed the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Waks Trode was an Ishi Tib who, in 19 BBY, was present in the Galaxies Opera House in the Uscru District of the planet Coruscant during a performance of the opera Squid Lake.

Honor Salima was a human native of the planet Coruscant. She was an officer in the Republic Navy and served as the commanding officer of the Coruscant Home Defense Fleet, a Republic planetary defense fleet, for a decade prior to the Clone Wars.
Musmuris Reetgeet was a Ranat who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Tia'dor Emshwa was an individual who served as a New Republic senator in 5 ABY. Emshwa led a diplomatic mission to the planet Ithor in order to win the Ithorians over to the new government.
TK-429 was a stormtrooper and the father of TK-429 Junior.

Becky Smoochenbacher was a resident of the Upper Ring section of the space station known as The Wheel during the Imperial Era. Smoochenbacher and fellow Wheel resident Zander Freemaker had romantic feelings for one other. However, neither of them believed the other felt the same.

Odin Nesloor was a human podracer mechanic with fair skin and brown hair. In 32 BBY, Nesloor was in the city of Mos Espa on the desert planet Tatooine during the build up to the Boonta Eve Classic podrace.
J'oopi Shé was a Force-sensitive Kadas'sa'Nikto from the planet Kintan who became a Jedi Master in the Technical division of the Jedi Order, the guardians of the Galactic Republic.
Triz Bukk was a female Zabrak who joined the Smuggler's crew during the Galactic Civil War.
Cadomaccus was a male Zabrak with Black and red skin and maroon eyes. A failed initiate of the Kouhun assassins, he waited on the desolate planet Mataou preparing a fortified position.
Mehedo Clynch was a human male who headed the Zenowai Crime Society in later stages of the Galactic Civil War.

Dazhda was a male Rodian who served as a Sergeant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Uprising. After the Clone Wars, Dazhda swore to never use a blaster again, but he found himself unable to ignore the Galactic Empire's increasingly despotic rule.
Ashmin Ek was a male individual who served as a New Republic senator for Anthan Spire in 5 ABY. He worked on several councils and caucuses including the Committee for Imperial Reallocation.

Dor Wieedo was a Rodian who served as the planet Rodia's senator in the New Republic Senate in 5 ABY. He was familiar with the Orishen senator Tolwar Wartol and worked with him on several councils and caucuses.
Grelka Sorka was an individual who served as the New Republic Senator for Askaji in 5 ABY. She ran a committee at the Galactic Senate and was acquainted with Senator Tolwar Wartol.

Nim Tar was a Quermian who served as a senator in the New Republic's Galactic Senate in 5 ABY. He had a long neck and a child. Tar was acquainted with Senator Tolwar Wartol and were often part of the same committees and caucuses.
Exim Panshard was a male Sith Lord who held the title of viceroy on a long forgotten planet. Panshard wore a mask made of meteoric metal which was strong in the dark side of the Force.

Fryoto was a Zabrak female who was imprisoned on Burnin Konn by Imperial purge troopers. The Empire had suspected that she and Zepasi were affiliated with the Trade Spine League and knew of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's death.

Webb Taffral was a male individual who was loyal to the Galactic Empire, despite having failed out of the Imperial Academy. He was the older brother of Dav Taffral, who had joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Dav Taffral was a male individual who joined the Rebel Alliance and later became a member of the nascent New Republic.
Lampay Fay was a Pau'an Male who served as aide-de-camp to Port Administrator Tion Medon of Pau City on the planet Utapau.
Denaria Kee was a Koorivar female who served as personal assistant and Chief Aide to Passel Argente, Magistrate of the Corporate Alliance.
Gragra was a Swokes Swokes female gorgmonger that worked in the marketplace of Mos Espa. She caught Jar Jar Binks when he tried to snatch a gorg from her stand without paying.
Teers was an Otolla Gungan female who served as a Rep on the Gungan High Council on her homeworld Naboo.

Ugloste was a male Ugnaught who operated the carbon-freezing chamber in Cloud City and froze Han Solo in 3 ABY. He was in charge on determining how to use carbon-freezing on humans, like Solo. Ugloste witnessed Solo being frozen and surviving the process.

Zephee was a female Ewok who lived on the moon Endor and gave birth to her second daughter during the construction of the second Death Star. She feared what the completion of the superweapon would mean for her children.

Grimraker was a human male scavenger active on Hoth during the Galactic Civil War. During the Uprising against Governor Ubrik Adelhard's Iron Blockade of the Anoat sector, he lent his services to a young smuggler, under threat of having his staging ground taken and his people …

The individual known as Den Handsome was a human male who was one of the galaxy's most prolific liars and accomplished thieves. It is not known whether he used his real name, or if Den Handsome was actually an alias.

Idalsa was a Twi'lek female doctor who was active during the Galactic Civil War. Her unorthodox approach to "industrial folk medicine" allowed her to convert substances as diverse as fuel, carbonite, and toxic sludge into useful medications.
Bren Quersey was a human male Rebel pilot who was a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.
Djas Puhr was a male Sakiyan bounty hunter active during the Age of the Empire. He was an associate of the smuggler Han Solo, and frequented Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on the planet Tatooine.
Salporin was a Wookiee warrior in the Kachirho Wookiee Militia in the Wookiee Army of the Galactic Republic.

Hollé was a human female who served as one of the handmaidens of the Royal House of the planet Naboo. Shortly after the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY, Hollé attended the funeral of Padmé Amidala, who had served as the senator for Naboo up until her death.
Mat Rags was a human who worked as a podracer mechanic on the planet Tatooine. In 32 BBY, they were present in the Grand Arena of the Mos Espa spaceport during the Boonta Eve Classic race.

Ding was a clone stormtrooper in service to the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars. As part of a garrison, Ding and fellow clone "Kicker" was assigned to clearing out Jedi artifacts from the Jedi outpost Brighthome in the Mid Rim.

Sheltay Retrac was a human from the planet Alderaan. Born to Alderaanian nobility, she served as the head of Senator Bail Organa's team of aides in the Alderaanian delegation of the Galactic Republic's Senate during the Clone Wars.

Kicker was a clone stormtrooper in service to the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars, and a former clone trooper of the Galactic Republic. Kicker was assigned to clearing out Jedi artifacts from a Jedi outpost in the Mid Rim, before it was attacked by the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Osh Scal was a Kallidahin who worked for the Archaeological Research Council as a technician on a dig site in the Polis Massa asteroid belt.

Hela Brandes was a human female who served in the Naboo Royal Advisory Council as Music Advisor under Queen Padmé Amidala. In 32 BBY, Brandes was present when Senator Palpatine contacted the Council only to lose communication.

Nik Sant was a male human who served in the military of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Sant was one of the most veteran scouts in the Rebel Alliance.
Maneeli Tuun was a Kallidahin male who was native to the Polis Massa asteroid field. Tuun spoke in sign language and was telepathic.
A female individual was the mother of New Republic lieutenant Norra Wexley. At some point, she tried to talk to Norra about life. Norra, however, ignored her mother and did the complete opposite.
Nels Deyland was a male individual who was a Senior Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy and served as the first officer to Captain Filia Rossi on the Gozanti-class cruiser Blood Crow.

Pyrondi was a female individual who served as a Senior Lieutenant in the Imperial Navy and served as the weapons officer on the bridge of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera under the command of the Chiss Commodore Thrawn.
A Vurk worked as a bartender for a bar on the Cosmatanic Steppes.
Umé was a human who served as one of the handmaidens of the planet Naboo's Royal House. In 19 BBY, Umé attended the funeral of Naboo's senator, Padmé Amidala, shortly after the end of the Clone Wars.

Carklin Ryoon was a Ssori gunner who was a member of Eleodie Maracavanya's pirate nation Sovereign Latitudes of Maracavanya. Ryoon was stationed aboard the Super Star Destroyer Liberty's Misrule, which had been commandeered by the pirates.
Domus Renking was a Lothalite human male politician who served in the Imperial Senate as the senator for Lothal during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
A young woman was a member of the Acolytes of the Beyond who traveled along with two other members to the planet Taris to purchase a lightsaber they believed belonged to Darth Vader.

Eternal Rur, also know as the Immortal Rur, was a disembodied conscious artificial intelligence based on the deceased male human Rur that was stored in the Rur crystal, the former computer core of the Ordu Aspectu's Citadel of Rur.
A Neimoidian male served as a member of the Trade Federation prior to the Invasion of Naboo. He was part of a crew stationed aboard the Lucrehulk-class Battleship above the planet Kellux.
Ivor Drake was a human from Kestos Minor who served as senator for the Kwymar sector in the Galactic Republic's Senate during the Clone Wars.

Eugroothwa was a Wookiee male who fought alongside the Galactic Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the latter's attempt to invade the Wookiee species' homeworld of Kashyyyk in the year 19 BBY.

Lachichuk was a male Wookiee Warrior who fought alongside the Galactic Republic against the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the latter's attempt to invade the Wookiee species' homeworld of Kashyyyk in the year 19 BBY. He had brown hair.
Vommb was a large Ithorian who worked for the Red Key Raiders. In 5 ABY, Vommb participated in the skirmish in Freetown under the leadership of Lorgan Movellan.
Yimug was a Gran who worked for the Red Key Raiders. In 5 ABY, Yimug participated in the skirmish in Freetown under the leadership of Lorgan Movellan.
Gweeska was a Rodian who worked for the Red Key Raiders. In 5 ABY, Gweeska participated in the skirmish in Freetown under the leadership of Lorgan Movellan.

Rylon was an Imperial sergeant who was stationed on Jakku shortly before the Battle of Jakku. They were among the forces that had relocated to the barren desert world under the orders of Counselor to the Empire Gallius Rax and punished stormtrooper RK-242 when he voiced the op…

Orr'UrRuuR'R was a Tusken Raider male who lived on the desert planet Tatooine in the Outer Rim. In the year 32 BBY, Orr'UrRuuR'R and several other Tuskens took up position on top of the Canyon Dune Turn portion of the Boonta Eve Classic podracing course and fired on the podrac…
Fox, also identified by his clone designation CT-0000/1010, was a loyal clone trooper who fought as a soldier in the Grand Army of the Republic throughout the length of the Clone Wars.

Silya Shessaun was a human female who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic's senate during the Clone Wars between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. She was an ally of Senator Padmé Amidala of the planet Naboo and attended her funeral.

Kela Neerik was an Imperial officer who held the rank of commander in the Imperial Navy around the time of the Battle of Yavin, and flew a TIE fighter within Black Squadron, an elite TIE fighter unit.
Margle was a Gran Special Forces soldier who served in the New Republic and participated in the Battle of Jakku.
Sid Uddra was a female human who served as a loyalty officer in the Imperial Security Bureau and was a mentor of Sinjir Rath Velus.

Koko was a male Narquois pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Koko participated in the Liberation of Kashyyyk and in the New Republic's battle with the Galactic Empire in the Battle of Jakku, flying an X-wing starfighter as a member of Phantom Sq…

Oko-Po was an Ithorian senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic in the year 5 ABY. Oko-Po was present on the Committee for Imperial Reallocation and attended a meeting of the committee in the office of Chancellor Mon Mothma on the planet Chandrila.
Lorrin was a senator who served in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic in the year 5 ABY.
Toursant Irving was a male individual who was a part of the Irving Boys and stole the Millennium Falcon along with their brother Vanver Irving.
Slim Jek was a Twi'lek male who served as a criminal advisor in the Duro sector, and later as an emissary for the Zenowai Crime Society in the Anoat sector.
Glen Taffral was a male farmer who lived on the planet Saleucami. He and a woman were the parents to the Rebel Alliance member Dav Taffral and the Imperial Academy dropout Webb Taffral.
Kaydera Kay was a human female street criminal who was active during the Galactic Civil War. Over time, she had mastered the skill of appearing and disappearing at will.
The grandfather of the Nothoiin male Huliasu had been a member of the Noble Court prior to Huliasu being rescued by a young smuggler from a group of Imperial Purge troopers.
A male human served as an admiral in the Galactic Empire's Navy.
Aga was a female human who served in the Galactic Empire.
Spohn was a Lieutenant Commander who served under Commodore Kyrsta Agate on the starship Concord. Spohn served during the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.
Sirai was a Pantoran who served as an ensign under Commodore Kyrsta Agate on the starship Concord. Sirai attended the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY. Sirai was responsible of the weapons.

Brin Izisca was a male pastor and philanthropist, as well as a leading member of the Church of the Force. He sent five pilgrims to the planet Christophsis to return a crate of kyber crystals back to where they belonged.

Gomm was a male human prisoner with a big head and thin body on the planet Jakku who worked at a kesium gas rig. After Norra Wexley and Mister Bones killed all the Imperial guards on that station he was rescued.
Nanz was a dark-haired girl who was a member of the Anklebiter Brigade which fought against Imperial forces on Coruscant.
Hoolie was a Bith and the twin of Jutchins who was a member of the Anklebiter Brigade which fought against Imperial forces on Coruscant.
Jutchins was a Bith and the twin sibling of Hoolie who was a member of the Anklebiter Brigade which fought against Imperial forces on Coruscant.
Wenchins was a human boy who was a member of the Anklebiter Brigade which fought against Imperial forces on Coruscant.
Avga Rosene was a Zuzabol member of the Resistance who worked as part of a fueling crew stationed at the Resistance base on the planet D'Qar around thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Kayana was a female human childminder on the planet Naboo. She worked at an orphanage for refugee children and took care of the orphan Mapo.
Borvo was a human male sniper and soldier who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Shara was a human female member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She served as a rebel trooper that, along with a blaster rifle, packed a missile launcher while on missions.

Rush was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was known to carry thermal detonators with him on missions. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, Rush was detained by Imperial troops on the planet Jedha.
Hossferin was a male lord of the Vandelae star system Hossferins who traveled to the planet Ktath'atn in order to try and meet with its queen.
Estorn was the Imperial governor of the planet Sammun.
The grandfather of Gozetta was a male human who like his son and granddaughter was a big game hunter.
The father of Gozetta was a male human who like his father and daughter was a big game hunter.
A local Makurth boss attacked a Ho'Din settlement on Moltok during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The Ho'Din requested Imperial muscle to avoid it turning into a full-fledged war.
A newly-hatched rathtar was owned by Dorae sometime prior to the Dragon Void Run. Dorae intended to use the rathtar to pay off important individuals but it was killed by the Wookiee Chewbacca.
A male alien hunter hunted rathtars on Twon Ketee, in 33 BBY.

Angel was a human male pirate aboard the freighter Dromedar. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Angel and other pirates, under the command of Nevil Cygni, deceived Thrawn, Eli Vanto and other crew members aboard the Blood Crow into boarding the Dromedar.
Corin was a male Pau'an mercenary who was active during the early stages of the Imperial Era. At some point, he was hired by the Big game hunter Gozetta.

A Rodian merchant sold Captain Thrawn a vulture droid part. Without the merchant knowing, Thrawn also learned that the merchant had an order for more vulture droid parts from an individual known as Nightswan.
The daughter of the civilian Corwin Ballast and his wife, Lynnta, resided in the city of Maborn on the Outer Rim world Mordal during the Galactic Civil War.
Driller MarDapp was a human male who lived on the planet Coruscant during the era of the Galactic Empire. During that time, MarDapp and Juahir Madras befriended Arihnda Pryce of Lothal.

Ghadi was a human male who served as the governor of the Tangenine sector in the Core Worlds during the reign of the Galactic Empire and was gave the rank of Moff, He had a bitter rivalry with Grand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin and tended towards paranoia regarding his position and per…
Culper was a human female who was an aide to Moff Ghadi. She met with Eli Vanto to offer him a position within the Imperial Military, in order to separate him from Thrawn.

Jakeeb was a male human technician aboard the Blood Crow. When aiding the stranded freighter Dromedar, he and fellow technician Layneo attempted to reinstate the hyperdrive aboard the vessel ready for transportation.

Layneo was a female human technician aboard the Blood Crow. When aiding the stranded freighter Dromedar, she and fellow technician Jakeeb attempted to reinstate the hyperdrive aboard the vessel to make it ready for transportation.

Xurfel was a senator who served in the Galactic Empire's senate. Around 12–11 BBY, she enlisted two of her newest bodyguards for training at the planet Coruscant's Yinchom Dojo, where they were trained by instructor Juahir Madras.

Brook was a human officer in the Imperial Security Bureau. He accompanied Thrawn, Eli Vanto, Wullf Yularen, and Roenton to investigate that Yinchom Dojo for anti-Imperial sentiments and possible rebel activity.

Roenton was a human male officer in the Imperial Security Bureau. He accompanied Thrawn, Eli Vanto, Wullf Yularen, and Brook to investigate that Yinchom Dojo for anti-Imperial sentiments and possible rebel activity.
Kaniki was a bodyguard for Senator Evidorn of the Galactic Empire. He was trained at the Yinchom Dojo by Juahir Madras.

Evidorn was an Imperial senator whose own bodyguard, Kaniki, attempted to assassinate them. This came after training and negative Galactic Empire sentiments were given to Kaniki from the Yinchom Dojo, under the leadership of Juahir Madras.

Gimm was a human male lieutenant and TIE fighter pilot in the Imperial Navy under the command of Thrawn. He participated in the Cyphar Incident. Eli Vanto later learned that he was one of the trouble-makers who assaulted Thrawn at the Royal Imperial Academy.
Nasling was a Imperial governor whose records were tapped into by the Higher Skies Advocacy Group for covert rebel activities.
The sibling of Soo-Tath was a Cerean who was a member of a syndicate. They were present in the Fulan Ro cantina shortly after the Twilight of the Ordu Aspectu.
This Purkoll citizen was a male Skakoan who was employed by Foreman Wat Tambor of the Techno Union. During the Clone Wars, the scientist worked at the Union's headquarters, Skako Minor.
Osteregi was a male who served as a lieutenant at the Myomar Academy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He found Eli Vanto to be one of the best cadets he had taught.
Tookie was a tooka cat who was owned as a pet by a girl on the planet Garel.

This Imperial officer was stationed onboard a light cruiser over Garel. He tried to stop Ketsu Onyo and Sabine Wren from escaping in a stolen shuttle, but the cruiser's tractor beam was destroyed when the shuttle, which the two women had rigged to explode, detonated near the c…

The father of Yonak was a male Rodian who served as the crime lord of the Son-tuul Pride criminal syndicate prior to the first attack on the Son-tuul Pride in 0 ABY. Yonak was later appointed leader of the Pride after his father's death.
Yonak was a Rodian male who was a member of the Son-tuul Pride. He was the successor to his father and held a grudge against Darth Vader and Sutha the Hutt for killing him.
Del Meeko was a human male native of Coruscant, the capital world of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

Seyn Marana was a female human who served the Galactic Empire. With an eidetic memory, Marana had a unique skillset that included proficiency as a cryptologist, the ability to speak 29 different languages, and a mastery in the surveillance field.
Thomas Toov was an aging human who, in hopes of extending his natural life, rarely ever left his stasis dome.
The father of Hadder Ponta was a human male who died when Hadder was a small child.
The stepfather of Captain was a male individual. He enslaved his stepson and eventually sold him to Kiretim.

Awls Ooteek was an Abednedo member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Prior to his capture by the Galactic Empire, Brentin Lore Wexley heard rumors of a secret Imperial base from Ooteek. He later mentioned this to Rae Sloane while on Jakku.
A female Aleena mother and her child were rescued by Ahsoka Tano from a cleaning droid on the planet Coruscant in 21 BBY.
The owner of the Tooka-cat Tookie was a female humanoid who lived on the planet Garel in the Outer Rim Territories.
Alorg was the leader of the Flesh Mongers pirates during or prior to 32 BBY.
Restos was a male governor of Batonn. He was being given aid by the Imperial Military to combat rebel insurgents on Batonn, that were being lead by Nevil Cygni.
Pintu Son-El was a Moyn male who lived on Coruscant during the Clone Wars. He was a moneylender and would often use rough tactics to get his payments back.
A scout was a prisoner of the Mud dwellers tribe on a planet in the Vagadarr system.
A male adolescent was a member of the Mud dwellers tribe on a planet in the Vagadarr system at the time Jedi Grand Master Yoda enacted a mission to the Vagadarr system.
The Great Mountain was a living mountain from a planet in the Vagadarr system.
Loris was a female human and the wife of Jarret.
This male human was the father of Tonk who repaired droids.
Ghana Gleemort was a Gamorrean guard who worked for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure in his palace on the desert planet Tatooine.
Melik Galerha was a Force-sensitive human who served as a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Odavia Anaru was a human A-wing pilot who single-handedly destroyed the Imperial AT-AT Hellhound Two on Jakku. She was posthumously awarded the Medal of Valor for her actions.

Barkin was an individual who was associated with the Pryce family on the planet Lothal. When Elainye Pryce was arrested on embezzlement charges, he attempted to have her released on bail while Elainye's daughter Arihnda Pryce went to meet with Senator Domus Renking.
Stormtrooper 4 was a male stormtrooper of the First Order. He often made mistakes and was regarded as an idiot.
Carlou Gendling was a male human who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy. With his task force, led by the Star Destroyer Foremost, he commanded the battle over Umbara.
Merri Barlin was a human ensign in the the Imperial Navy who served aboard the Gozanti-class cruiser Blood Crow.

affiliation: Future Imperial Leaders Military Preparatory School
x: Gleb was an Aqualish who served as headmaster of the Future Imperial Leaders Military Preparatory School on Vardos. She taught the notion that young Imperials didn't make friends, they instead made allies but more than colleagues. She also held the title of protectorate.

The brother of Anice was a male individual who was known to like chocolate. Whilst posing as a school student on a tour of a munitions factory on Anukara, Seyn Marana was offered a piece of chocolate by Anice.
The wife of Emoch Akagarti was a female individual.

The daughter of Emoch Akagarti and his wife was a female individual. She was present when members of the remnant Partisan cell called the Dreamers broke into her family's home to find evidence of his corruption.
The wife of Lux Bonteri was an Imperial female. At some point she had a daughter, before she eventually married Lux Bonteri.
The stepdaughter of Lux Bonteri was a female individual who was the daughter of Bonteri's wife. She eventually became a loyal member of the Galactic Empire.

Jarrod Kevin was a droid engineer who was allied with the Rebel Alliance team stationed on Coruscant. A talented engineer, his main accomplice was a droid named J4X-7, also known as "Jax." He made effective use of a set of vibro-claws.

Drokkatta was a Wookiee Warrior within the Rebel Alliance that was stationed on Coruscant. The Wookiee worked with a Cerean quartermaster named Ko-Tun Feralo and the Human droid engineer, Jarrod Kelvin.

Ko-Tun Feralo was a Cerean Rebel Alliance quartermaster and squad leader of a Rebel cell that was stationed on Coruscant. Her father, Sahm-Ken Feralo, was a senator in the Imperial Senate and spy for the Rebellion.
Wistran was the Imperial governor of the planet Denash.

Kthoo-Ra was a member of an alien species who was trained by the Xonti Brothers to be a gladiator for a full standard year into around 0 ABY. He was shot and killed by Krrsantan aboard the Sorca Retreat.

Dahna was a female Twi'lek who was the second in command of the rebel group known as the Dreamers. When she led the Dreamers Piikow, Nadrine, Ru Vushan, and Kaev on a mission to Otor's Hub, she decided to take in Seyn Marana, an Imperial agent who was undercover as a slave so …

Stassen Bine was an artist who illustrated the Galactic Empire propaganda poster We Fight, We Win. By the time of the Hosnian Cataclysm in the year 34 ABY, Bine's identity had not yet been identified, and it was theorized to be a pseudonym.
A human male was the brother of another brother whom this man led the Xonti Brothers gladiatorial enterprise with.
A human male was the brother of another brother whom this man led the Xonti Brothers gladiatorial enterprise with.
Jaccun Pereez was a male Imperial moff. His daughter, Famma, was engaged to the young Imperial Commander Yendiv Bensek.
Famma was the daughter of Imperial Moff Jaccun Pereez. She became engaged to the young Imperial Commander Yendiv Bensek.
The mother of Maediyu, a soldier in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, was a female individual.

An Ezaraa served as a member of the Dominion of the Ezaraa. Around 0 ABY, this Ezaraa was present in the Citadel of Ktath'atn on the planet Ktath'atn when doctor Aphra and Luke Skywalker traveled to visit the Queen of Ktath'atn.

Piikow was a Chadra-Fan who operated as a technician for the Dreamers, a successor group to Saw Gerrera's partisans. Piikow was forced to work at an Imperial factory while he believed his family was being held hostage.
Yendiv Bensek was a male Imperial commander who was to be married to Famma, daughter of Imperial Moff Jaccun Pereez.
Sind Reloran was a male individual who served as a groomsman to Yendiv Bensek at his wedding.

This individual was a moff of the Galactic Empire who was blackmailed by individuals. Shortly after their infiltration of the Dreamers, Inferno Squad were to undertake a mission to locate and neutralize the blackmailers but to also recover any evidence of the moff's indiscreti…

Oma Prumba was Gungan who participated in the ground portion of the Battle of Naboo as a Militiagung of the Gungan Grand Army. She later recounted her memories of the battle using Basic-Gunganese pidgin.

Udrai was a commander in the Galactic Empire's navy who served aboard the Star Destroyer Determination. After the destruction of the Death Star in 1 BBY, the commander told an Imperial squadron to come forward to ask for help if they had troubling thoughts.
Quesl was a human male individual who served as the Imperial governor of Botajef.

Sanz was a female who served as the Galactic Empire's governor of the planet Kintoni. She was present at the meeting where the select committee of the Imperial High Command ruled in favor of Lothal, granting the planet a contract to expand Imperial naval facilities.

Grayson was a male human pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He believed that his X-wing starfighter belonged to the scrap heap until the mechanic Zander Freemaker managed to remove the cracked coolant compensator from the craft's S-foils.
The twin sister of the Nightsister Talia was a female Dathomirian Zabrak hailing from the planet Dathomir, who was a part of Mother Talzin's clan.

Plor Wiskovis was a male human who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy near the planet Ansion. He and Thrawn found and arrested the pirates who stole the Tibanna gas from the freighter Dromedar.

Spenc Orbar was a male human Imperial cadet who attended the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant. His family had great influence over Coruscant and the Academy, resulting in him getting away with whatever he wanted.
Rosita Turuy was a female human Imperial cadet who attended the Royal Imperial Academy on Coruscant. She disliked aliens and sought to push the Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo out of the Academy.
Bokk Naarg was a Sullustan who fought alongside Saw Gerrera before the formation of the Galactic Empire and later as a member of Gerrera's partisans.

Sharima was a Pantoran female who was a member of Saw Gerrera's partisans. In 0 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Sharima attempted to defect from the partisans along with the Sullustan Bokk Naarg, claiming to have information on where the remaining partisans were gettin…

Alo Kortessi was a female Clawdite princess. In 4 ABY, the Rebel Alliance operative Kordi Freemaker impersonated her during a mission to obtain embersteel wings. The real Kortessi was arrested by stormtroopers, who mistook her for an impostor.

Keir Santage was a human male Rebel pilot who participated in the Battle of Endor. He was killed when his X-wing was destroyed by the lead pursuing TIE fighter inside the Second Death Star superstructure.
H'sishi was a female Togorian who owned the martial arts school Yinchom Dojo on the planet Coruscant. Her school trained bodyguards who worked for Imperial senators and government officials.
Wyan was a male individual who served as a major in the Imperial Army. He was the right hand of Colonel Mosh Barris who investigated a planet for smugglers when they came across an alien settlement.
A parent of Rake Gahree was a human. They had a partner, Gahree and one other child.
A human individual was the younger sibling of Rake Gahree.
Gahree was a male human and the parent of Rake Gahree. He had a partner and one other child.

Ojo was a male Nautolan who used to be a member of the Black Sun crime syndicate, along with Ketsu Onyo. He was apprehended by Sabine Wren and imprisoned before being rescued by her between 3 BBY and 2 BBY.
A human individual served as a lieutenant in the Navy of the Galactic Empire.

An individual served as an agent in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. For some time the agent met with Bokk Naarg, a Sullustan male who was attempting to defect from the partisans and who also claimed to have information on where the remaining partisans were receivi…

A rebel was dispatched by Senior Lieutenant Iden Versio before he could raise an alarm at the rebel base on Yavin 4 as she attempted to avoid detection after ejecting from her TIE fighter on the moon following the Battle of Yavin.

Awan Zek was a male human bounty hunter who lived in the galaxy. Awan was also known to work with two Rodian associates. He tried to settle scores with the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka but Hondo managed to escape with the help of the scavenging family known as the Freemakers.

Lar Kantayan was a human male who served as an agent in the Imperial Security Bureau. Prior to the destruction of Jedha City, Kantayan was sent by the ISB to infiltrate the Partisans, where he worked with Staven.
An individual served as the chief of naval intelligence of the Galactic Republic's Naval Intelligence.

t: Unidentified guild head of Kuat Drive Yards
x: An individual served as the guild head of Kuat Drive Yards, a vital vehicle manufacturer for the Galactic Empire during the battle for Kuat Drive Yards between the Empire and the New Republic.

Biz was a male Lurmen who was the chief of a Lurmen village on the planet Qalydon during the Imperial Era. He was the husband of Elan and the father of Maynar, who aided the Freemakers in liberating their village from the Galactic Empire.

Maynar was a young female Lurmen who lived on the planet Qalydon during the Imperial Era. Daughter of Elan and her village's chief, Biz, she helped the Freemakers in protecting their home from the Galactic Empire.
During the days of the Galactic Empire, a commander served in the Imperial Military, overseeing the command of stormtroopers in the fight against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A human served as the dean of the Shadow University. The dean attended the auction of the Rur crystal onboard the space station Sorca Retreat. They represented the Shadow University's winning bid, although they were killed in the chaos following the unleashing of the Eternal Rur.

Elan was a female Lurmen who lived on the planet Qalydon during the Imperial Era. She was the wife of her village's chief, Biz, and the mother of Maynar, who helped the Freemakers in protecting their home from the Galactic Empire.
Ymojin was an old female Lurmen villager who lived on the planet Qalydon. After the Freemakers arrived the planet, she speculated that they must have come for the marriage.

A rebel technician served under Commander Jun Sato as part of Phoenix Cell during the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Around 4 BBY, the officer participated in the Attack on Phoenix Squadron. The technician told Sato that a ship was coming in.
Anice was a female who attended a munitions factory on Anukara as part of a school trip sometime after the Battle of Yavin.

Wenda was a human woman with long, black hair and a cybernetic implant in her left eye. Wenda and her friend Bett were pirates who led a criminal gang. A year after the Battle of Jakku, Wenda and Brett met with the former stormtroopers Corlac and Terex.
Bett was a green–skinned humanoid woman with white hair and pointed ears. She was an associate of criminal Wenda, who lead a criminal gang based on Kaddak.

Nadrine was a human female who was a member of the Dreamers. She was an explosives expert behind the Dreamers' method of crafting suicide bombs looking like jewelry. She had a romantic relationship with Staven, the leader of the Dreamers.
Kaev was a human male member of the Dreamers. During a mission to Affadar to expose a corrupt Imperial leader, he was killed by stormtroopers when guarding the official's family.
Sadori Vushan was a male Kage who was a member of the Dreamers. He was the son of Ru and Halia Vushan, also members of the Dreamers.
Ru Vushan was a male Kage who was a member of the Dreamers. He was the father of Sadori Vushan, and husband of Halia Vushan.
Halia Vushan was a female Kage who was a member of the Dreamers. She was the mother of Sadori Vushan, and wife of Ru Vushan.
Wisper was the leader of the Ranc Gang. He served Wenda and Bett before transferring his allegiance to Terex in 7 ABY. After Terex joined the First Order, Wisper led the Ranc Gang.

Zumgi was a member of the Ranc Gang. They served under the leadership of Wenda and Bett before transferring their allegiance to Terex. Zumgi had a great deal of respect for Terex and regarded Wisper as a steward.

Brrang was a member of the Ranc Gang. He served under Wenda and Bett until the former stormtrooper Terex took over the group in 7 ABY. Brrang commanded the Carrion Spike and the Ranc Gang's fleet of "Uglies" during the Battle over a desert planet.
Corcillo was a male Human who served as an sergeant in Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Lexim was a male human who ran a hunting business on a forest planet. Around 4 BBY Garazeb Orrelios picked up Lexim's distress call, and he, Alyson, Wad, and Greve were attacked by gundarks.
Wad was a male human. Around 4 BBY he, Garazeb Orrelios, Lexim, Alyson, and Greve were attacked by gundarks at Lexim's hunting ground.
Horvins was a male trader who on the planet Jakku operated out of Bay Three in Niima Outpost shortly after the military regime First Order's attack on the village Tuanul in 34 ABY.
Alyson was a female human. Around 4 BBY she, the Lasat Garazeb Orrelios, Lexim, Wad, and Greve were almost attacked by gundarks at Lexim's hunting ground.
Greve was a male human. Around 4 BBY he, Garazeb Orrelios, Lexim, Alyson, and Wad were attacked by gundarks at Lexim's hunting ground.

Chanda Bethari was a member of Twilight Company and was a participant in the Battle of Hoth. Along with fellow soldiers Parko and Barritz, Chanda had been pinned down by an All Terrain Scout Transport on the edge of the battlefield.

Archex, formerly known as CD-0922 or Cardinal, and nicknamed "Emergency Brake," was a human male stormtrooper who held the military rank of Captain in the First Order. His skills were spoken of with high regard even by Supreme Leader Snoke.
Vi Moradi, also known by the codenames Starling, Amaka Kottu, Evette Harlo, Magpie, or Mother Hen was a human female spy who served the Resistance.

"Blue Nine" was an individual who served as a pilot in the Resistance as a member of Blue Squadron. During the Resistance's war with the First Order, Blue Nine participated in the Battle of Starkiller Base.
Keldo was a male human who was the brother of Phasma. The two ran the Scyre together, and while she was a warrior that came up with battle strategy, he was more inclined to be peaceful.

Foss was an admiral in the Imperial Academy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Emperor Palpatine informed Captain Voss Parck that Imperial cadet Eli Vanto and the Chiss Thrawn were to be admitted into the Royal Imperial Academy.

Parko was a member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry and was present for the Battle of Hoth. Parko fought along side Chanda Bethari and Barritz, and visited Bethari two days after the battle, who had been injured and was recovering in a bacta tank.

Barritz was a member of the Rebel Alliance and Twilight Company and was a combatant in the Battle of Hoth. Barritz fought alongside fellow troopers Parko and Chanda Bethari, and ultimately survived the battle.

Pomi Harchmak was a Lutrillian female who served as a coordinator responsible for opening deepwaves in Pryce Mining. She was accused of embezzlement by Senator Domus Renking and Arihnda Pryce in order to exonerate the latter's mother Elainye Pryce.

Jonne was an individual who worked as a Councillor during the rule of the Galactic Empire. After Arihnda Pryce demanded that Chesna Braker make repairs to apartment building she owned, Braker complained about Pryce to Councillor Jonne, who in turn complained to Pryce's employe…
Daisie was a female individual who was a tenant of Arihnda Pryce. When her leaking pipe broke Arihnda called her landlady to fix it.
Winmey Lenz was a human male from the planet Chandrila who served as a senator in the Imperial Senate.
LU-28 was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was present at the Great Temple on Yavin 4. In 1 BBY, LU-28 was instructed to report to maintenance level 4.

Fitz was the captain aboard the freighter Dromedar. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Nevil Cygni suggested it was Fitz or Toom who locked the hyperdrive aboard the vessel to prevent pirates accessing it and stealing the ship.

Kallon was a male Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement. He helped in the attack on the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Perilous which carried Darth Vader and the Emperor and when they crashed in Ryloth's equatorial forest, he assisted Cham …
Ryiin was a female Twi'lek from the planet Ryloth who worked as an escort. On one ocassion, an Imperial officer tried to fraternize with her.
Wapsbur was a colleague of Arihnda Pryce and effective civilian assistance officer who was taken for drug using.
Chesna Braker was a female individual who was a landlady on Coruscant. Arihnda Pryce confronted her for neglecting to repair a leaking pipe in one of her tenant Daisie's apartment blocks.
Nariba was a female human who worked as a reception staff member in Proam Avenue Citizen Assistance.
Alistar Sinclar was a human man who lived on the planet Coruscant. During the Imperial Era, he served as the manager of the Proam Avenue Citizen Assistance Office.

Osgoode was a human who served as a weapons officer in the Imperial Navy in the years before the Galactic Civil War. The Lieutenant Commander served aboard the starship Thunder Wasp during and after the battle over Umbara.

Hammerly was a human female who served as a chief sensor officer of the Imperial Navy in the years before the Galactic Civil War. She served under Commander Thrawn aboard the starship Thunder Wasp during the battle over Umbara as a Senior Lieutenant.
Ottlis Dos was a human male who was the personal bodyguard of Moff Ghadi. He was a student of Juahir Madras when he first met with Arihnda Pryce. Later he got her martial arts lessons.
Clay Tanoo was a male human colonist on the planet Cyphar who had training in plant genetics as well as in organic chemistry. His brother had taught him how to refine raw scarn into addictive spice.

Brigte Polcery was a female human colonist on the planet Cyphar. She was one of the three conspirators hired by Nevil Cygni to create dispute between the Afe clan and the human colonists. The real reason was that the Afe territory was full of spice called scarn.

Lenora Scath was a female human colonist on the planet Cyphar. She was one of the three conspirators who hired Nevil Cygni to help them smuggle spice called scarn the conspirators were digging from fields located on the area controlled by Afe clan.
Pord Benchel was a human colonist on the planet Cyphar and was the Mayor of the human territory.
Hem was a Phindian male, he was a senator in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate, he was the husband of Teeyr Hem.

Teeyr Hem, also known as Lady Hem was a Phindian female who was the wife of Senator Hem. In 15 BBY, Teeyr Hem met with Arihnda Pryce, who bought the Phindian a bottle of four-blend wine, after receiving the bottle, Pryce asked Lady Hem for her sympathy to the goals of Higher S…

Hartell was a female who served as a major in the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire. Following a meeting where the select committee of Imperial High Command granted Lothal a contract to expand its naval facilities, Governor Arihnda Pryce of the planet thanked Sen…

Zenoc was an individual who served with the Galactic Empire at the rank of colonel. She served as the commanding officer of space station Lansend Twenty-Six, a staging area for slaves for construction of the Death Star.

Yve was a human female officer who served as a Senior Lieutenant and Starfighter Commander in the Imperial Navy. Upon arriving at Botajef, the Chimaera was met by two CR90 corvettes and seven squadrons of V-19 Torrent starfighters commanded by Governor Quesl.

Kinshara was a male human who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy. Kinshara commanded the Imperial Star Destroyer Stalwart of the One Twenty-Fifth task force during the Batonn sector insurgency.

Simmco was a male individual who served Nevil Cygni on the Nomad starship near Batonn. When Cygni caught Eli Vanto and interrogated him, Simmco and five others checked Vanto's starship. He was killed by an explosion caused by Thrawn.
Shum Laudor was an individual who worked for the Galactic Empire, specializing in altering the appearances of others. His work, disguising spies of the Empire, was considered very convincing.
Adiana Caton served as the pilot of the Corvus, a Raider II-class corvette used by Inferno Squad during the Galactic Civil War. Weston Morro was Caton's copilot.
Weston Morro was the copilot of the Corvus, a Raider II-class corvette used by Inferno Squad during the Galactic Civil War. Adiana Caton was Morro's pilot.

Naylyn Bashan was an engineer in the Galactic Empire. Up until 0 ABY, serving under Del Meeko, Bashan copiloted Vessel 4240-C, a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle attached to the Imperial Star Destroyer Implacable.

This Spalexian was an individual who lived on the planet Spalex. During the Cold War, First Order forces led by an officer attempted to mine Spalex for its thorilide, succeeding where the Galactic Empire had failed, but were met by strong resistance led by this individual unti…

This individual was a human male officer in the First Order during their conflict with the Resistance. The officer led First Order forces to the planet Spalex where they intended to mine the planet for its thorilide.
Mummert was a male human who served as an admiral in the Galactic Empire. Early into the Imperial Era, Darth Vader tasked the admiral with deploying starships in the Hortolo system.
Gudry, also known by the pseudonym Mattai Daw, was a male human who served as an ISB agent in the Galactic Empire.

Talmege was a human male who served as a Major in the Imperial Navy. On the planet Batonn, Elainye Pryce, Talmoor Pryce, and Arihnda Pryce were stopped by two Imperial Navy Troopers who informed them that ISB Colonel Wullf Yularen had sent a team to find Arihnda and Gudry in t…
When Garazeb Orrelios was a child on the planet Lasan, he had a friend who was attacked by a creature in a underground cave. His elder brother saved him from the creature and was never seen again.
Mareena was a female Tholothian mechanic who lived on the river moon of Al'doleem.
Jogg was a male Tholothian mechanic who lived on the river moon of Al'doleem.
Colli was a male Tholothian who lived on the river moon of Al'doleem.
The sister of Colli was a Tholothian infant who lived on the river moon of Al'doleem.

When Garazeb Orrelios was a child on the planet Lasan, he had a friend. Before 4 BBY, Zeb's friend was attacked by a creature in a underground cave. His elder brother saved him and was never seen again.

Qi'ra was sold into slavery by Proxima to the slave dealer Sarkin Enneb, who eventually sold her to Dryden Vos, the public face of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn. Vos saw potential in Qi'ra and trained her personally before giving her the chance to take revenge on Enneb.

Lune Buscon was a human female Communications Officer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She served aboard the Consonance, a Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette that participated in the Battle of Scarif in 1 BBY.
Dayun was a member of the Imperial Navy's officer corps during the Galactic Civil War. He served as an admiral, commanding the Star Destroyer Implacable.
Rys Deksha was an Imperial Moff of Anukara. In 0 ABY, Deksha hosted General Ivel Toshan for a public ceremony celebrating the opening of a munitions factory.

Balder was a Dug male who was the leader of the Claw clan on the planet Parnassos. After helping Brendol Hux of the First Order onto a plateau after their emergency pod crash-landed on the planet, Balder pushed Hux aside and reached out to help a figure wearing white armor ont…

M'nevvus Leep was a male Bith. During the Galactic Civil War, Leep singlehandedly recruited three planets to the cause of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Although the Galactic Empire declared him dead eight times, the Bith kept coming back.

Kootaa was a male Kubaz who worked as a salesman in the Anoat sector during the Galactic Civil War. Half con artist and half brilliant diplomat, he passionately advocated for equal rights for all species, and defended the superiority of Kubaz cuisine.

Noru was a male Kyuzo warrior who belonged to the Data Seekers of the Anoat sector. He pushed himself to endure the Kouhun initiation trials so the Seekers would have someone on the inside to learn about the Kouhun society.

A male stormtrooper was on the planet Jeosyn during the Galactic Civil War. After attempting to stop members of the Dreamers from stealing supplies, the trooper was beaten and taken back to the Dreamers' encampment.

Ivel Toshan was a general who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 0 ABY, Toshan traveled to Anukara for a ribbon cutting ceremony to open a munitions factory, hosted by Moff Rys Deksha.
Jastin Vrayn was an ensign in the Galactic Empire and an assistant to Seyn Marana before she was recruited to join Inferno Squad shortly after the Battle of Yavin.

Kurjak was a Devaronian smuggler and the captain of the Fast Friend. In 0 ABY, shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Kurjak and his crew picked up Inferno Squad members Gideon Hask and Del Meeko, who were posing as brothers in order to infiltrate the Partisan remnant cell known a…
Jha Eka was a male lieutenant in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was the personal assistant to Admiral Garrick Versio.

Rudaga was a Dug merchant who owned an antique store on Otor's Hub. Like many of the merchants on the space station, he would deal in black market items, as well as slaves, and also spy for the Galactic Empire for additional income.

Semma Waskor was a female captain in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Waskor was assigned to be a "watchdog" for Inferno Squad agent Iden Versio, who had committed a false act of treason as part of a ploy to infiltrate the P…
This Tusken Raider was the sole surviving member of a village that was slaughtered by Darth Vader on the planet Tatooine. Following the slaughter, the Tusken Raider was discovered by another clan.

The father of Commodex Tahn was a male human. At some point before the last year of the Clone Wars Tahn's father died, prompting Tahn to leave Republic service and join the family trade as a mortician on Naboo.

Emoch Akagarti was the ephor of the continent of Pammur on Affadar. He and his government struck an alliance with the Galactic Empire to fund a mining operation on the planet, despite it having a detrimental effect on the quality of its water.

Taryai Akagarti was the son of Emoch Akagarti and his wife. In 0 ABY, he was present when members of the remnant Partisan cell called the Dreamers broke into his family's home on Affadar to find evidence of his father's corruption.
An individual was a sultan in the Mid Rim's Boz Pity system during the Imperial Era who had a daughter.

A female individual was the daughter of a sultan in the Mid Rim's Boz Pity system during the Imperial Era. As later claimed by the bounty hunter Sana Starros, between around 3 BBY and 0 ABY, the smuggler Han Solo carried out a scam on the daughter.
Tarrik was a majordomo who served the Organa family in their royal palace on the Core Worlds planet Alderaan.

Cinderon Malpe was an individual who represented Derella in the Imperial Senate. Malpe had close ties to Bail Organa and was invited to attend the Day of Demand held for Princess Leia Organa on Alderaan in 3 BBY.

Dalné was a human female born around 19 BBY who served as the Monarch of Naboo in 3 BBY. Although the kings and queens of the past actually ruled, Dalné's role was mostly ceremonial, as Naboo's concerns now rested in the hands of Emperor Palpatine's governor, Moff Quarsh Panaka.

The mother of Breha Organa was a human female from Alderaan. As was customary among Alderaanians, she introduced her daughter to pacifist values. Her husband remained onworld during her entire pregnancy and for several months afterwards.

A human female was the mother of Resistance spy Vi Moradi. While being interrogated for information about Captain Phasma's past, Moradi noted that Cardinal extended a straw on a bottle so that she could drink water just like her mother had when she was feverish while growing u…
Vala was a female human who was the mother of Siv. She died after she hit her head whilst dangling after falling from a rock spire.
This female human was the mother of Torben. When Torben told his mother that he wanted to stay in the Nautilus forever, she used to tell him that it was normal for the bird to love captivity

A human female was the mother of Gosta and a member of the Scyre clan on the planet Parnassos in the Unknown Regions. By 24 ABY, when General Brendol Hux of the First Order crash-landed on Parnassos, they had been dead for many years.
A tribal elder lived on a village on the planet Ikari.

A human male was the older brother of Torben. Torben fought and was killed by his brother when a group of Scyre led by Keldo caught up with Phasma, Torben, and Siv, who were helping General Brendol Hux get back to his ship after crash landing on the planet Parnassos.
This female human was the mother of Archex. At some point before the Battle of Jakku, Archex's mother died, leaving the young boy to be orphaned on the desert planet.
This male human was the father of Archex. When Archex's mother was pregnant with their son, Archex's father sculpted a carving of a happabore for Archex, though he never was able to meet his son.

A human male was the father of Phasma. When they were younger, Phasma's brother, Keldo, used to argue with his father and mother about how to deal with the raiders who sought to claim their ancestral home.

A human female was the mother of Phasma. When they were younger, Phasma's brother, Keldo, used to argue with his mother and father about how to deal with the raiders who sought to claim their ancestral home.
An individual was the younger cousin of Phasma, and a member of a small and weak family with its only territory directly surrounding the Nautilus on the planet Parnassos.
LE-2003, nicknamed "Elli," was a human female stormtrooper and personal guard of General Brendol Hux during the rise of the First Order. She was killed on the planet Parnassos.
PT-2445, nicknamed "Pete," was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
HF-0518, nicknamed "Huff," was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.
This female human was the mother of Kier Domadi. She was a professor at Archipelago University on Alderaan.

Torben was a human male who was a member of the Scyre clan on the planet Parnassos. He accompanied Phasma, Siv, Gosta, and Carr on a journey to return Brendol Hux of the First Order back to his ship that had crash-landed on the planet.
FM-0676 was a human female with dark eyes who was being trained by Captain Cardinal to be a First Order stormtrooper aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution.

FE-1211 was a human female who was training to be a First Order stormtrooper aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution. She was taught by Captain Cardinal, always scoring the highest scores in his intelligence testing and had a mean eye with a blaster.
Tedam was a major who was in charge of the Imperial forces on Wobani. Leia Organa met with him during a humanitarian mission to the planet.

A prime minister who served his homeworld, the Outer Rim planet Christophsis, lived during the Imperial Era. Several of Christophsis's officials, including the minister, aided an insurgent group fighting against the Galactic Empire.

Ress Batten was a female human from the planet Alderaan who served as a lieutenant aboard the Tantive IV. She accompanied Princess Leia Organa to Crait where they unknowingly came across a base being operated by Organa's father, Bail Organa.
This male human was the father of Kier Domadi. At Kier's memorial service, Kier's father stated that Kier had wanted to be a historian and that he would be with his heroes forever.

Harkos was a Nikto bounty hunter that operated in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories, close to the edge of Wild Space. He had a reputation for being a bounty hunter whose list many people did not want to end up on.

Barrow Oicunn was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the military of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, he was a hero of the Battle of Coruscant and his devotion caught the attention of Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine.

Bane Malar was a telepathic male bounty hunter who specialized in tracking those who escaped the Spice Mines of Kessel. In 4 ABY, Malar was present in Jabba's Palace during Eightyem's time as Jabba Desilijic Tiure's translator droid.

Chassellon Stevis was a human male from the planet Coruscant and whose mother was head of the Coruscant diplomatic legation. In 3 BBY, Stevis was a part of the Apprentice Legislature and was in the same pathfinding class as Leia Organa.

The mother of Chassellon Stevis, a human Imperial Apprentice Legislator from the Core Worlds planet Coruscant, was a female individual who lived during the Imperial Era. At some point, they became the head of Coruscant's diplomatic legation.
Suba was a human male lieutenant in the Imperial Navy who served as Chief of Security on board the Executor, flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader and the head of the Death Squadron fleet.

Sol Rivas was a human who served as a Lieutenant in the First Order. During the Battle of Starkiller Base, he accessed computer records which implicated Captain Phasma in the lowering of the superweapon's deflector shields.
TN-3465, known also as Pilot was a human TIE fighter pilot who served in the naval forces of the First Order.

FN-1728 was a human who served the First Order as a stormtrooper. The trooper briefly chatted with Captain Phasma while she was hunting for the alleged traitor Lieutenant Sol Rivas on Starkiller Base.

Zool Zendiat was a ruthless human treasure hunter. Founder of the Zendiat Collective, a thieving guild that traveled the galaxy aboard the starship Fortune, he made a name for himself by stealing valuable artifacts and selling them to the best bidder.
Emil Graf was a male human cartographer. He was the grandson of Milo Graf, who, along with his sister Lina, was involved in a series of misadventures early in the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Kier Domadi was a human male from the planet Alderaan who, alongside Princess Leia Organa, represented Alderaan in the Apprentice Legislature in 3 BBY.

Tri Tellon was a Pa'lowick female thief who was active in the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Born on the ecumenopolis of Coruscant, she had worked the CoCo Town area since she was a hatchling. At some point, she partnered with an old rogue called Magreda.
Magreda, or Mags for short, was a male thief who was active on Coruscant in the last decades of the Galactic Republic. At some point, he entered into a partnership with a Pa'lowick named Tri Tellon.

Noni was a female Kowakian monkey-lizard kept as a pet by Emil Graf. She travelled with her master across Wild Space aboard the scout ship Star Herald alongside the BB-series astromech droid BB-00 "Boo" and the monster droid, CR-8R "Crater." The crew shared stories together, o…
Krynodd was a Gabdorin criminal who lived on the desert planet Jakku.

A female Aleena was a scavenger on the desert planet Jakku in 34 ABY. A mother of two, she was looking for rations in Kelvin Ravine to help feed her family. When BB-8 was passing through the area to seek a ship off planet, she asked the droid for help in finding food.

Occo Quentto was a Chalhuddan who was the leader of the Chalhuddan people on their homeworld of Chal Hudda. They experienced five genders throughout their life and used pronouns that indicated their current gender as well as prior and future ones.
Tolteck was a male individual who was the owner of the private prison Starlag XIX.
Tonk was a male human who was the son of a droid repairman. After his father was taken away by Imperials, Tonk led a crew of insurgents against the Galactic Empire.

Churkk was a Gand from the planet of the same name. When Churkk was young, Churkk left the Gand homeworld, despite the fact that Churkk felt that the Gand should not leave Gand, eventually ending up on the desolate planet Parnassos.

Brel Ti Vorne was a human male miner who worked in a medicinal spice mine on Onoam, a moon of the Mid Rim planet Naboo, during the Imperial Era. As the working conditions in the mine deteriorated, Ti Vorne became disheartened and sought intervention from outside groups.

Gru was a humanoid waiter who worked at a bar on the moon Nar Shaddaa. When the human smuggler Sana Starros reluctantly went on a date with the scoundrel Lando Calrissian, Starros ordered food that she considered "garbage" on purpose, and, after Calrissian decided to leave, St…
This individual was a Krawg pirate in a group who operated in the Outer Rim Territories. The pirate's group was betrayed by Sana Starros and eventually captured by the Empire.
Baako was a male who was the brother of the Resistance spy Vi Moradi. At one point, he worked as an intern for the New Republic Senate on Hosnian Prime.

Bolander was a female who served as an officer in the First Order. When General Armitage Hux came aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution for a meeting, he and Captain Cardinal spoke in his father's old suite about Captain Phasma and her killing of Brendol.
FB-0007 was a human male who was training to be a First Order stormtrooper. He was taught by Captain Cardinal aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution.

Samoc Farr was a female pilot that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. She was the younger sister of Toryn Farr and participated in the Battle of Hoth with Rogue Squadron.

Obonn was a Shozer who served in the Resistance during its conflict with the First Order. Obonn was stationed at the Resistance base on D'Qar and was not fluent in basic, only being able to speak bocce.

A human female served as a TIE Fighter Pilot in the naval forces of the First Order. She flew under the callsign "Epsilon Six" thirty years after the Battle of Endor as a member of Epsilon Squadron, a Starfighter Squadron comprised of TIE/fo space superiority fighters.
Osky was a Saurin male member of a crew lead by Tonk.
Sybl was a human member of a crew lead by Tonk.
