Ubialla Gheal was a female who owned a club in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. Ubailla often did favors for the city's elites, so that she could rise in Canto Bight's social hierarchy.

Derla Pidys was a female Argiopid who considered herself the finest sommelier in the Corporate Sector. She visited a club in Canto Bight owned by Ubialla Gheal to purchase a bottle of wine. Her large head had four yellow eyes, two upper and two lower eyes.
Lexo Sooger was a Dor Namethian male who was the star masseur at Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in Canto Bight. Sooger used to be an Assassin.

Lula Sooger was a human female and the adopted daughter of the masseuse Lexo Sooger, who found her as a baby in a cargo container in an alley. He searched for her parents, but could find no trace of them; thus the Dor Namethian kept and raised the child as his own.
Sturg Ganna, also known as "Big Sturg," was a male Whippomorn gangster who operated in Canto Bight. Early in his life, he worked as a lawyer and holo-show host before turning to politics.

Siv was a human female member of the Scyre, a clan native to the planet Parnassos. She accompanied Phasma, Torben, Carr, HF-0518, PT-2445, LE-2003 and Gosta to help Brendol Hux return to his ship after he crash-landed it on their homeworld.

Thodibin, nicknamed Thodi, was a male Suerton who resided in Canto Bight and spent a night, along with his younger brothers Dodibin and Wodibin, gambling with Kaljach Sonmi. He preferred to go by his nickname Thodi.
Wodibin was a male Suerton who resided in Canto Bight and spent a night, along with his older brothers Dodibin and Thodibin, gambling with Kaljach Sonmi. His nickname was simply Wodi.
Dodibin was a male Suerton who resided in Canto Bight and spent a night, along with his older brother Thodibin and younger brother Wodibin, gambling with Kaljach Sonmi. He went by the nickname Dodi.
Kaljach Sonmi, or Kal, was a Heptooinian male who at some point encountered the Lucky Three in Canto Bight.

Anglang Lehet was a Caskadag male who spent more than a century in his trade as a criminal for the Cularin Syndicate. At some point Lehet spent a night in the casino city of Canto Bight with the vaporator salesbeing Kedpin Shoklop.

Kedpin Shoklop was a Wermal male who spent one hundred and two years in his trade as a vaporator salesbeing at VaporTech. He won a trip to the casino city of Canto Bight after being awarded Vaporator Salesbeing of the Year. It was his first vacation in a century.
An Aleena child and mother were rescued by Ahsoka Tano from a cleaning droid on the planet Coruscant in 21 BBY.

Reirin was a young female Tusken Raider who dreamed of proving herself to her people. She chafed at her clan's restrictions on women fighting, even though she was one of the best fighters in her clan.
This male Tusken Raider was the father of Reirin. Reirin day-dreamed about taking her father's gaderffii stick and wreaking bloody havoc.

Jot was a male Jawa. He was much shorter than most Jawas and enjoyed stories. He was originally responsible for collecting scrap, then later had himself demoted to wiping the memories of droids the Jawas obtained after he found a holoprojector he decided to call Storyteller.
Nera Kase was a female individual who served as the chief in charge of starfighter maintenance at the Great Temple on Yavin 4 in 1 BBY.
Ryland was a male Rebel sentry and Y-wing mechanic for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Col Takbright was a human male from Uquine who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Mulb was a male individual who lived in Tarkintown on Lothal.
Uyohn was a male engineer who served in the Galactic Republic's Futures Program on Brentaal before being hand picked by Director Orson Krennic to join Galen Erso's kyber crystal research team.
Sairgon was a male lieutenant in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, nicknamed Twilight Company, being second-in-command after Captain Micha Evon, also known as Howl.
Zab was a male individual who served as a sergeant in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company.
Von Geiz was a male individual who served as a Chief Medic in the 61st Mobile Infantry. He was fourth down the line of command after Captain Micha Evon, Lieutenant Sairgon and Commander Paonu.
A human served as sparring partner to Princess Leia Organa of the planet Alderaan when the latter skipped a lesson she was supposed to be taking on language study.

Pol Treidum was a male human who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire's military. In 1 BBY, he held the rank of lieutenant and was stationed aboard the first Death Star. A gantry officer, he helmed the command office that overlooked Docking Bay 327 alongside an aide.
Pamel Poul was a female individual who served as a station commander aboard the Death Star in 1 BBY.

A human philosopher hailed from the planet Alderaan. The Alderaanian once stated that joy could expel fear. By the time of the Imperial Era, the saying was known to the Alderaanian Princess Leia Organa, who quoted it to Kier Domadi in 3 BBY.

Dar'en was a Lupr'or who lived on the planet Luprora around the time of the Battle of Starkiller Base. They served as a guide for the First Order visitors Captain Phasma and TN-3465 during the hunt for Lieutenant Sol Rivas.
Jair'i was a Lupr'or who was the leader of the Lupr'or who lived on the planet Luprora around the time of the Battle of Starkiller Base.
Arane Oreida was a Zabrak female rebel. She had a distinct dislike of humans, but she notably worked with Saw Gerrera and his Partisans. Oreida also had a group of her own partisans.

During the Siege of Lasan, a male Lasat served in the Lasan High Honor Guard. He owned a J-19 bo-rifle. During the Siege, he fought Imperial Security Bureau Agent Alexsandr Kallus, and was defeated by him.
Moeseffa was a male individual who owned Moeseffa's Cantina on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system.

Harp Allor was a human female from the planet Chandrila who lived during the era of the Galactic Empire. Sponsored by Winmey Lenz, a Chandrilan senior senator, Allor became a member of the Apprentice Legislature in 3 BBY.
Sssamm Ashsssen was a Fillithar member of the Apprentice Legislature in 3 BBY. He participated in a pathfinding class organized for members of the Legislature by Queen Breha Organa of Alderaan.
Argus Tanzer was a young, human male who served as a bureaucrat on board the Alderaan Flotilla, a group of starships carrying the surviving natives of his homeworld Alderaan.

Eglyn Valmor was a human female from the planet Alderaan who came to serve as the regent administrator of the Alderaan Flotilla; a collection of starships that carried the surviving natives of her homeworld after it was destroyed by the Galactic Empire.
Janis Pol was an elderly, human female who served as a diplomat on board the Alderaan Flotilla, a group of starships carrying the surviving natives of her homeworld Alderaan.
Riyana Torr was a young human female who survived the destruction of her homeworld Alderaan in the year 1 BBY due to the fact she was offworld with her missionary parents at the time.
Teven Gale was a human male native of the planet Alderaan who survived his homeworld's destruction by the Galactic Empire in the year 1 BBY.

Plas Lelkot was the surgeon consul of the planet Hosnian Prime during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was arrested by the Empire for hiding Imperial refugees in his own chateau and sent to the prison of Ashmead's Lock on the planet Kashyyyk.
This individual was a female Ociock. She and her mother were imprisoned at Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817

The individual was a female Ociock who was the mother of an Ociock girl. Their family was imprisoned at Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on the planet Wobani during the time Jyn Erso was there.
A male Dowutin thug was present on the Five Points station during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
A male individual fathered a Kaleesh son named Qymaen jai Sheelal, who would later become known as General Grievous. The father taught Sheelal how to use a slugthrower, the Czerka Outland rifle.

A rebel trooper of Phoenix Cell was at Chopper Base on the planet Atollon in 2 BBY, when he was attacked by Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger. Ezra, under the influence of Dark Side hallucinations brought on by the former Sith Lord Maul, saw the trooper as Maul and attacked him.
A male Caldanian criminal was present on the Five Points station during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A Huloon beggar was present on the Five Points space during the reign of the Galactic Empire. After pick pocketing a male individual on the station, Jyn Erso gave the credits she had stolen to this Huloon.
A Kath male shopkeeper owned a shop on the Five Points station.

A female individual was the chieftess of the planet Inusagi. She owned a palace in the capital city of the planet. In 6 BBY, she was pressured into signing a treaty making her planet subject to the Galactic Empire.

Pharl McQuarrie was a human from the planet Ralltiir who fought in the Clone Wars as a prominent military advisor. He later served as a general in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War and his work aided in the retrieval of the Death Star plans.
Senjax was a human male Lieutenant Colonel who served as the official military correspondent for the Imperial Broadcast.
Cor Tophervin was a male individual who was installed as the governor of Inusagi in 6 BBY. He was a personal friend of Emperor Palpatine.

Sardis Ramsin, designated TD-7556, was a human male who served in the sandtrooper division of the Stormtrooper Corps, in the Galactic Empire's army.

Visaiya was a female human who served as an adviser to Her Majesty Breha Organa, Queen of Alderaan. As such, she would notably remind the queen of her schedule for the day. In truth, Queen Breha regarded her as more than just an aide, but as a friend.
Lintreyst was a male human who served as the Minister of Finance of Alderaan toward the end of Queen Breha Organa's reign.

Falena was a female human from Alderaan. By 1 BBY, she was the youngest attendant to Her Majesty Breha Organa, Queen of Alderaan. As such, she was allowed in the queen's apartments, where she would notably practice at her lute.

The wife of Raymus Antilles lived on the planet Alderaan around 1 BBY. She had two daughters with Antilles, but raised the children for long periods of time without her husband's presence due to his dedication as a captain in service to the Rebellion.
An individual was the copilot of the Tantive IV during its secret mission to Tatooine.
A male served as a bosun on the Tantive IV. After escaping the Battle of Scarif, the bosun relayed systems status information to Captain Raymus Antilles.

Sorschi was the wife of the human female Ackmena. In 1 BBY, Sorschi lived on Delkin Ridge on the planet Tatooine with Ackmena, who worked night shifts as a bartender at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the spaceport of Mos Eisley.
Laina was the daughter of Ryland, a trooper in the Rebel Alliance, and Fiona. She was born on a mining colony on a moon in the Outer Rim Territories where her parents worked.
The father of Dex Tiree was a male human.

Uncelta was a female individual who the Rodian Greedo loved, but she chose Han Solo over him. However, Solo loved and left her, breaking her heart.

This female human was the mother of Rebel pilot Biggs Darklighter. During Darklighter's final moments alive after his X-wing starfighter had been shot during the Battle of Yavin, he heard the call of his mother for dinner.

Wenton Chan was a male individual who served as a pilot in the Rebel Alliance's Red Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. Chan was not selected to participate in the Battle of Yavin and remained stationed at the Great Temple on Yavin 4 during the battle.

The father of Cost Niktur was a human male.
The mother of Cost Niktur was a human female.

Ali'ane was a female Lupr'or who lived in her home on the planet Luprora. They had a great granddaughter who wore a necklace salvaged from a Lupr'or starship.

Fiona was a human female who worked at an underground mining colony on an airless moon in the Outer Rim Territories. She was married to Ryland, and they had a daughter named Laina.

This prisoner was a Jawa who got on the bad side of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. The Rodian bounty hunter Greedo was hired to capture them.
Qeruru'rr was a male Tusken Raider from the same clan as Reirin. He was a friend of hers, and unlike most of the rest of the clan had no problem with allowing women to fight.
Kelemah was a male Mon Calamari who served as a maintenance technician in the Rebel Alliance. He mainly worked on starfighters, and took pride in his work.
Kanna was a Patrolian thief who was part of the Zendiat Collective, a criminal organization led by Zool Zendiat. Cunning and creative, he was constantly updating the Collective's weaponry.

Elyhek Rue was a human male who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a member of Red Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Bink Otauna was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. Han Solo once attempted to befriend both him and Tag Greenley, but eventually determined that the pair was too much of a colossal screwup to be worth hanging around with.

Bolvan was a male human who served as the gunnery captain aboard the Imperial Star Destroyer Devastator in 1 BBY.

Eron was a female individual active during the Imperial Era. Around 2 BBY, they and their female partner Rhee became aunts to the child Laina following her birth to the civilian Ryland and the human Fiona.
Rhee was a female individual who lived during the Imperial Era. Around 2 BBY, they and their female partner Eron became aunts to the child Laina following her birth to the civilians Ryland and Fiona.

Benis was a individual who served as a technician in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a member of the Massassi Group around the time of the Battle of Yavin.
Harge was an individual who served as a private in the Alliance to Restore the Republic and was stationed at the Great Temple on Yavin 4 during the Battle of Yavin.

Cianne was a female individual who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as the aide of Chancellor Mon Mothma.

Tiber Saxon was a Mandalorian male who served as the governor of Mandalore following the death of his brother, Viceroy Gar Saxon. During the Mandalorian Civil War against Clan Wren and House Kryze, Saxon deployed "the Duchess," mounted on a modified AT-DP.

Hark was a male Mandalorian human who served as a captain in the Imperial Super Commandos. Hark commanded the Imperial convoy that transported Alrich Wren but was ambushed by renegade Mandalorian and Rebel Alliance forces.

Tojnun was an artist. Associated with the Pre-Exile Masters, Tojnun influenced the Mandalorian warrior Sabine Wren as she developed her own artistic style. During the Mission to Mandalore in 1 BBY, Sabine helped to rescue her father, Alrich Wren, from Imperial captivity.
Allium was an alien professor. In 34 ABY, he was in the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata conversing with other patrons when the smuggler Han Solo arrived.
Jawa Pilot was a "frenemy" to Ewok Pilot, featured in the Ewok Pilot comics by Roan Novachez.
Wuz was a male starfighter technician in the Rebel Alliance. He worked under Chief Nera Kase. Before the Battle of Yavin, Wuz worked on Jek Tono Porkins' X-wing.

UV-8855, originally known as Frey, and later nicknamed "Warcry", was a human female who was a member of the Scyre and the daughter of Ylva and Keldo.
Ravi was a male individual who operated as a spice dealer on Mon Gazza. When Ravi heard word of Osmo Che's operations as a spice smuggler on Mon Gazza he placed a bounty on Che's head.
Omso Che was a male spice smuggler who operated on Mon Gazza. When word of Che's operations reached the drug kingpin Ravi he placed a bounty on Che's head.
Bilder was a Twi'lek male who was a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans. He typically worked in a crew with Xosad Hozem and Jari.
Jari was a Togruta male who was a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans.
Anophe Dengue was one of the Dengue sisters who were present in Takodana Castle in 34 ABY, when the First Order attacked Takodana.

This individual worked as a bounty hunter sometime before 1 BBY. They were successful at their trade, and as a result were able to afford high-quality weapons. They owned a set of Mandalorian armor and also owned an astromech droid, modified with two droid brains.

DT-F16 was a human female death trooper commander who, along with her squad, were tasked with guarding a large kyber crystal from the Jedha system for delivery to the Tonnis sector in Freighter 2716 to rendezvous with an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer helmed by Captain Slavin.

3-6 was a death trooper in DT-F16's squad who was tasked with protecting a large kyber crystal for transportation in a freighter from the Jedha system to the Tonnis sector, in order to rendezvous with Captain Slavin and his Imperial I-class Star Destroyer.
Mich Matt was an Ishi Tib male who worked as a technician on the planet Coruscant's central power generator. He was approached by the Galactic Empire, who attempted to hire him away from his job.

Frax was a male Kajain'sa'Nikto who lived in the galaxy. While being chased by TIE fighters on the planet Odona, Han Solo left him for dead in the Cordaxian Sea because the Millennium Falcon was holding two tons of Cordaxian ore.
Carr was a male human who was a member of the Scyre clan on Parnassos. He was part of the trusted soldiers who joined Phasma on her adventure in helping General Brendol Hux find his ship.

Selt was a smuggler who lived in the galaxy. She worked with Frax and participated in the attempt to kill Han Solo on Odona, but was killed by Frax after saying she and the team's droid would turn tail and run.

Wells was a human Imperial officer who served as a captain in the Imperial Navy. In 1 BBY, they were in command of the cargo ship designated Freighter 2716, which the Empire used to transport a large kyber crystal to the Tonnis sector.

Proach was a male Trandoshan who served as a foreman in the Mining Guild on the planet Lothal in 1 BBY. When the Spectres hijacked crawler 413-24, the foreman fought briefly against the Lasat Garazeb Orrelios before falling to his death.

This individual was an Imperial moff who maintained governorship in the Mid Rim. Prior to Ascension Week, Arihnda Pryce familiarized herself with a low-level journalist and the office manager of the moff as she attempted to rise the social and political ladders on Coruscant, a…

A Stormtrooper Commander of the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps was stationed on Lothal during the Galactic Civil War. He assisted the Sith Lord Darth Vader in hunting down a band of rebels that were trying to escape the planet.

A human male stormtrooper served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire during the early rebel uprisings. He was stationed on Lothal, where he and another stormtrooper were posted at the Imperial Complex.

A stormtrooper was stationed inside the Imperial Complex of Lothal's Capital City. He was speaking with his colleague about whether they would have chance in finding the Spectres before being knocked out by the Lasat Garazeb Orrelios, who surprised them.
This stormtrooper served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. Stationed on Lothal, he was guarding the entrance of the Imperial Complex during the Siege of Lothal.
This individual was an Imperial governor based on a prestigious Inner Rim system who was acquainted with Moff Ghadi and was in need of an assistant military attaché.
Blagg was an individual who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Military. In 1 BBY, the lieutenant was stationed in Detention Block AA-23 on the Death Star, the Empire's ultimate weapon.
Saurval was a member of the Partisans who in 1 BBY was killed during in a fight against Imperial forces on Jedha.
A human female individual served the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era and possessed the military rank of admiral.

Cost Niktur was a female human who grew up on Genhu. In 34 ABY, Ymmoss and Niktur were captured by the First Order and Harra who sent them to her stronghold on Vodran. When J-Squadron was captured on Vodran, Ymmoss and Niktur helped J-Squadron escape the stronghold.
Cyslin Myr, a Force-sensitive Mirialan was the Jedi Master who trained Padawan Mace Windu in the ways of the Force.

Kez Velaz was a male Jedi Master who, at some point during the Republic Era, was chosen to oversee the outreach program in the outreach temple on the planet Mathas, a world that had been suffering from the Niffin plague.
"Blackout" was the callsign of a human test pilot for the First Order's TIE/vn space superiority fighters during the war against the Resistance.
Drooz was a male individual who claimed to be a Jedi prophet and healer on the planet Mathas sometime after the Jedi Order established the outreach temple on the world.

An individual was the owner of the Kazerath device. At some point before the mission to Cato Neimoidia, the explorer Lor San Tekka petitioned him to allow him access to the device but the owner denied Tekka's request, preferring to keep it locked up in the Palace of Baron Paw …
Paw Maccon was a male Neimoidian baron of Cato Neimoidia in the decades following the Battle of Endor. A member of House Maccon, he owned large vaults, renting its spaces to clientele.
A male Aqualish was a cadet in the Resistance's J-Squadron.

A male scavenger was an individual who, prior to 20 BBY, was the first man Gallius Rax, future Fleet Admiral of the Galactic Empire, killed when he was a child on Jakku and was overseeing the construction of the Jakku Observatory.
Cabbel was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Imperial Navy and a controller aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Tyrant, a part of the Death Squadron fleet.

Jaahn Liddle was a human member of the Rebel Alliance. After the Battle of Yavin, Liddle traveled to the planet Tibrin as part of a diplomatic mission with fellow Rebels Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa and Tadd Marteens.

Tadd Marteens was a human member of the Rebel Alliance. After the Battle of Yavin, Tadd traveled to the planet Tibrin as part of a diplomatic mission with fellow Rebels Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, and Jaahn Liddle.

Omarlin Fisker was a fair-skinned human. In 34 ABY, they were among a group who gathered in the courtyard of the pirate Maz Kanata's castle on the planet Takodana in order to watch the destruction of the Hosnian system by the First Order's Starkiller Base superweapon.
Bargwill Tomder was a male Cloddogran with brown skin and hair. Tomder wore a red shirt with a vest over it and a brown hat.

Ledick Firest was a human male cold-weather soldier who served as a colonel in the military of the Rebel Alliance. In the year 3 ABY, Firest was with the Rebel forces stationed at Echo Base on the planet Hoth when the Galactic Empire attacked.
Hendri Underholt was a female human who served as an archivist and as an aide to Mon Mothma in the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Feldstrom was a male individual who served as a controller aboard the Vigilance during the Battle of Endor.
Heurys was a female who served as a controller aboard the Vigilance during the Battle of Endor.

Like all graduates of Imperial academies, this human male naval officer was trained in combat tactics and weapon readiness. Not just a crack shot with a blaster, the officer could also call down orbital turbolaser strikes to wreak destruction on Rebel bases.

This male was the father of the Canto Bight Police Department officer Brawg. He spent eighty years as a police officer in Canto Bight and told his son of the times when the Syndicate was active in the city.
Dorin Bell was a male human scientist who served the Galactic Empire. Around 6 BBY, Bell was the first target for Jyn Erso to assassinate on the planet Horuz.
Berk was a male human. He worked under the Zabrak Arane Oreida as one of her partisans during a mission on the planet Inusagi.
Brawg was a male individual and a corrupt police officer in the Canto Bight Police Department.

Tryki was a former Zabrak pirate who was arrested for attempting to board a First Order cruiser near Rakata Prime. Her starship was destroyed, but she escaped and eventually joined the Zendiat Collective, a criminal group led by Zool Zendiat.
Dasa was a human female who was the owner of the refinery on the planet Skuhl. When the Galactic Empire arrived and attempted to purchase her refinery, she refused.
Gowayne was a friendly Chagrian male restaurant owner who owned a diner in a town on the planet Skuhl. When Imperial stormtroopers arrived in the town, they took over the diner.
Crawfin was an individual who once chased a smuggler but lost track of him when the smuggler took his ship into Smuggler's Run—an asteroid belt in the Outer Rim Territories.
Bunt was a Gigoran male pickpocket who tried to rob Jyn Erso on the space station Five Points. Erso protected herself while Bunt and his partner escaped.

Lucka Solange was a female human Imperial colonel who served on the space station Five Points. She asked Jyn Erso to make fake credits to pay her debt to the casinos. Allehander Pso found the fake credits, and discovered Solange's involvement in the scheme.

Allehander Pso was a male individual who owned Pso's Palace on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. Pso was a gambling lord who also hired many individuals to extended work contracts, turning them into indentured servants and essentially slaves.

Greyjin Marscopo was a male individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After his duty expired, Pso sold him and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire.
Kiretim was a male individual who was the master of Captain after his stepfather sold him.

Captain was a male human enslaver who served Allehander Pso. He was a slave for a long time after his stepfather sold him. Captain's first master was the cruel Kiretim, and years later, Pso bought him.

Mathey was a male human enslaver who served Allehander Pso. He sold Pso's indentured service to the Galactic Empire, working on an Amarills-class freighter under the command of an individual known as Captain.
A male Flann was a prisoner at a stronghold owned by Harra the Hutt.

Annjin was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.

Kathlin was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the ship and rescued them.

Harvey was a female individual worker of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as enslaved individuals to the Galactic Empire.

Laurose was a the child of a worker who served Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. They were siblings with Efford. After their mom's indentured service duty expired, Pso sold Laurose and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire.

Blane was a worker's child of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After her mom's duty expired, Pso sold her and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.

Efford was a child born into slavery, owned by Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. They were siblings with Laurose. After their mom's indentured service duty expired, Pso sold Efford and the other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire.

Owlen was a worker's child of Allehander Pso on the Five Points space station in the Five Points system. After his mom's duty expired, Pso sold him and his other workers as slaves to the Galactic Empire. However, Jyn Erso captured the crew of the spaceship and rescued them.
Ylva was a member of the Scyre clan. She had a daughter with one of the clan's leaders, Keldo. They were the parents of the only child in the clan, Frey.
Sweetheart was a rocky three meter tall creature with three hands. She worked in a bath spa named V-333's Silken Parlor and would behave in a grotesque manner to her clients.
Bethava Rocwyn was a female human Imperial admiral who served in the Five Points system aboard the Star Destroyer Authority during the Imperial Era.

Risi Amps was a male Labbo wreck dealer who was a member of a group of rebels led by the Devaronian Blue. He lived on the planet Rumitaka, and in around 3 BBY, purchased a ship from Jyn Erso, which he noticed was full of fake codes.

Bardbee was a Rayeth male who was a member of Blue's partisans. He was captured by Imperial Admiral Bethava Rocwyn on the planet Uchinao and interrogated on the space station Five Points. He was eventually tortured and gave up his fellow Partisans before dying in the torment.

Blue was a Devaronian female who was the leader of a rebel team in the Five Points system. At some point in the Imperial Era, Jyn Erso was blackmailed by Imperial Admiral Bethava Rocwyn into infiltrating and spying on the cell.

Shawburn was a Krish male pilot and a member of Blue's rebel team in Five Points system. Blue and her group, along with Jyn Erso, who was an undercover agent of the Empire, brought food to the planet Watassay.
Burta was a female engineer and a member of Blue's rebel team in Five Points system. Blue and her group, with Jyn Erso, who was an undercover agent of the Empire, brought food to the planet Watassay.

Dwindun was a Ma'cella male who was a member of Blue's rebel team alongside his brother. Blue and her group with Jyn Erso, who was an undercover agent of the Empire, brought foodstuffs to the planet Watassay.

Yalla was a Mirialan cell mate of Jyn Erso in the Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817 on Wobani. She was aggressive and a rebel. She had other rebel friends in this prison. They caused a riot but the stormtroopers defeated the rebellion.

Egil was a male human who was the leader of the Scyre clan where Phasma lived on the planet Parnassos. He was the oldest man of the clan, dying at the age of 40 which was 5 standard years longer than the average deathrate. He trained Phasma and Porr prior to 22 ABY.

Porr was a male human who was a member of the Scyre clan where Phasma lived on the planet Parnassos. He wanted to be the new leader, so he murdered Egil in his sleep and broke the main law of the clan.

Gosta was a female human who was a member of the Scyre and one of Phasma's warriors on the planet Parnassos. She joined Phasma, Torben, Siv, Carr, Brendol Hux, and three stormtroopers on a mission to get Hux back to his ship where he could call for help.

Krin Kallibin was a celebrated jockey that participated in fathier races. He was spotted by Kedpin Shoklop near the main entrance of the Canto Casino Hotel during his visit to Canto Bight. Riding the fathier Vermilion, Krin Kallibin won first place in at least two races.

Thamm was a tiny male Troglof from Troglofa who worked in Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica as a croupier. During the Cold War he managed a Hazard Toss table during a night shift at the casino when the Suerton Dodibin entered into a winning streak while playing at the table.

Leema Kai was a Jinata Security officer and commander of the Opportunity who led Project Resurrection operations on Athulla. At some point, Kai flew a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber. He was killed when his modified N-1 starfighter was shot down by Iden Versio.
The Master Codebreaker was a human male codebreaker who had an association with the Pirate Queen Maz Kanata and a love for gambling.

Seylon was a guardian who served the Arratu. They encountered Phasma and her team in 24 ABY. After the Arratu's death, Phasma and her team escaped from Arratu Station and killed the guardians who were in charge.
Justinian was a criminal who served the Arratu at Arratu Station on the planet Parnassos. Justinian was killed by Phasma when they attacked them in 24 ABY.

This male individual was the father of Resistance pilot Tallissan Lintra. Lintra learned the basics of piloting from behind the controls of an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor that was used by her father as a cropduster on their farm on Pippip 3.
Temiri Blagg, a Force-sensitive human male, was a child who lived a forlorn existence working as a stable hand in the Canto Casino during the First Order-Resistance War.

Wranderous was the most famous wrestler and fighter in Arratu Station of the planet Parnassos. Wranderous was a hulking and vicious individual, possessed of enormous physical strength and skills in unarmed combat.

Vrod was human male who was the ringmaster and the leader of the guardians in Arratu Station. He had black skin and a white left hand. He helped Phasma and his fellow what they did if they want to got food from the Arratu.
Trypto Buball was an alien male agricultural baron who grew wealthy due to the vast space-fungi farming colonies that his family owned.

Defancio Storsilt was an alien that was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Defancio had brown skin and gray hair. Defancio was the owner of the racing fathier Hy-Stepping. According to Bargwill Tomder, Storsilt owned almost all of the fathiers in Canto Bight.
Sosear Latta was an alien that was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Sosear had black eyes and gray hair.
Neepers Panpick was an alien private detective who operated in the city of Canto Bight during the Cold War between the First Order and the Resistance.
Snook Uccorfay was a rich alien male who worked as a raconteur. In 34 ABY, he spent time in Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Edmo Ectacle was a Moldwarp male with gray hair and brown skin. In 34 ABY, Ectacle was in the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight and watched other patrons play at the game tables before speaking with Derla Pidys on one of the casino's balconies.

The Prime Jedi was an individual who was active during the Dawn of the Jedi era. Doing so while following an early version of the Jedi Code, the individual became the first Jedi to ever use the Force.
Oniho Zaya was a human male child who worked as one of Bargwill Tomder's stable hands at the fathier stables in Canto Bight.
Yasto Attsmun was a Ungrila male tyrannical baron from Listehol who was the head of Attsmun Cybernetics and owned the yacht Undisputed Victor.
Parallela Grammus was a female Lukovel who lived in the galaxy. In 34 ABY, Parallela and her twin sister of Rhomby Grammus, were present in the Canto Bight casino
Rhomby Grammus was a female Lukovel who lived in the galaxy. Rhomby and her twin sister, Parallela Grammus, were both present at the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY.

Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion, also known simply as The Countess, was a female Idalowd who was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY. Around 34 ABY, she was the Countess of Canto Bight and was a partial owner of Zord's Spa and Bathhouse.
Hue Tico was a male human who was the father of Paige and Rose Tico with Thanya Tico.
Thanya Tico was a female human who was the mother of Paige and Rose Tico with Hue Tico. She flew an ore digger for the Central Ridge Mining Company.

Torbi was a human female who was the child of Siv and either Torben or Keldo. She was born and raised by Siv in a Con Star Mining Corporation facility, Calliope Station, for the first ten years of her life.
This female individual was in the Canto Bight casino in 34 ABY where she sported a Nova Sundari-style hairdo.

Moden Canady was a human male who served as a naval officer in both the Galactic Empire and the First Order. During the reign of the Empire, Canady commanded the Star Destroyer Solicitude of the Imperial Starfleet.
Jaycris Tubbs was a human male who served as a pilot in the Resistance during the evacuation of D'Qar.
Larma D'Acy was a human female who served as a commander in the ground forces of the Resistance, a paramilitary group founded by Leia Organa to monitor and oppose the actions of the First Order.
Brother Letrun Pay was an alien male who spent time in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.

Loatha Sommover was a brown-skinned alien who spent time in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY. Sommover wore a neural wave relaxer helmet, a black coat and a ring that was both a comlink and a piece of decorative jewelry.
Glowen Faquidde was a white-skinned member of a humanoid alien species who spent time in the Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.

Saile Minnau was a human male who served as a Resistance fleet guard during the war against the First Order. After the fleet was destroyed following the Battle of D'Qar in 34 ABY, the survivors evacuated to the planet Crait to make a last stand.

Riva Rosetta was a human female who served as a technician in the fleet of the Resistance during their war against the First Order. She wore brown overalls with a brown belt, black boots and orange helmet including an insulated ground crew headset.
Guila Angira was a human male lieutenant in the Resistance fleet during their war against the First Order.

Idrosen Gawat was a human male who after retiring from the planetary defense force of the Mykapo system, came to serve in the Resistance navy as captain and executive officer of the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus during the war between the Resistance and the First Order.
Poldin LeHuse was a human male First Order TIE Fighter Pilot who served in the armed forces of the First Order during their war with the Resistance, in 34 ABY.

SC-4044 was a human stormtrooper who served as an instructor to new troopers aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Absolution. Captain Cardinal, another stormtrooper involved in the training of First Order soldiers, was a friend and colleague of SC-4044.
Lusica Stynnix was a human female junior officer who held the rank of lieutenant in the First Order Navy during the First Order-Resistance War.

Peera Maso was a female human who served in the military branch of the First Order. Holding the rank of gunnery chief, she worked on the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, the flagship and headquarters for the First Order.

Brun Obatsun was an individual who served in the military branch of the First Order. Obatsun worked on the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, the flagship and headquarters for the First Order, acting as one of the flagship's gunners.
Rumitar Shay was a human male officer who served in the military branch of the First Order, holding the rank of Petty Officer.

Ansiv Garmuth was a human male officer who served in the First Order Security Bureau. Holding the rank of colonel, he served aboard the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, the flagship of Supreme Leader Snoke and headquarters of the First Order.
Edrison Peavey was a human male captain in the First Order Navy during the war against the Resistance.

Tritt Opan was a male human who served in the naval forces of the First Order. Holding the rank of captain, he was among the staff of General Armitage Hux, and acted as his hitman to kill anyone who might pose a threat to the general, with some of his devices including a fake …

Lank Paze was a human male who served in the naval forces of the First Order. Holding the rank of Petty Officer, he was part of General Armitage Hux's staff. He reported the transmission of Poe Dameron to Hux. His commemorative armband read "Hal," designating him as squad leader.

Suday Bascus was a human who served in the the naval forces of the First Order during its war against the Resistance. He acted as Warrant Officer under Captain Moden Canady aboard the Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix during the Battle of D'Qar in 34 ABY.

The First Guard was an Elite Praetorian Guard who served as a bodyguard of Supreme Leader Snoke, ruler of the First Order. Equipped with segmented plate armor and an electro-bisento, the First Guard eschewed ranged weapons in favor of melee combat.
The Seventh Guard was an Elite Praetorian Guard who served as the personal guard of Supreme Leader Snoke, leader of the First Order. The guard wielded vibro-arbir blades.

The Third Guard was an Elite Praetorian Guard who served as a personal guard of Supreme Leader Snoke, leader of the First Order. While serving the Supreme Leader, the Third Guard used a Bilari electro-chain whip.
The grandmother of Kaljach Sonmi was a Heptooinian female who, by the time Sonmi traveled to Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica, was long gone.

Minn's mother was a Devaronian female director of hospitality at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. After Kaljach Sonmi won a duel against Orisha Okum and give a big tip to her daughter, she hired Kal as a floorwalker in the casino.

The Porg Stowaway was a porg male from the ancient planet Ahch-To who hid away aboard the Millennium Falcon, along with at least three other porgs before the Battle of Crait. During the battle, the stowaway got in the way of Chewbacca's piloting.
Karlus Stee was a fair skinned human male with black hair, who worked as a croupier at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Ronith Blario was a human male who was a pilot for the Resistance fleet during their war against the First Order. He was a reckless rookie who flew an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor. He shared the last name with another Resistance pilot named Ataphen Blario.
Stomeroni Starck was a human male who flew as an T-70 X-wing starfighter pilot and Flight Officer in the Resistance fleet. He served as Blue Two.
Jober Tavson was a human individual who held the rank of Lieutenant and served as the pilot for the personal Upsilon-class command shuttle of Kylo Ren, Supreme Leader of the First Order.
Derham Boyce was a human male who served as sergeant in the ground forces of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.
Nossit Cicer was a human male who served as major in the Resistance during their war against the First Order.
Geno Namit was a human male who served as a captain in the naval forces of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.

This male individual was the father of Resistance Commander Larma D'Acy. After the New Republic demilitarized, despite it having no effect on their home, D'Acy's father was one of the loudest individuals to question the decision, going as far as calling it a shortsighted one.

Slowen Lo was a male Abednedo who resided on Canto Bight. He made a fortune selling driftwood sculptures and lived on the beach in the coastal city on the desert planet Cantonica. In 34 ABY, Lo saw Finn and Rose Tico illegally land and abandon their ship on a Canto Bight beach.

Alcida-Auka was a Lanai female who served as the matron of the Caretakers of Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To. In the year 34 ABY, she encountered the former scavenger Rey in the Jedi village on the island.
Cobel Tansirch was a male human soldier who served as a sergeant in the Resistance during their war with the First Order.

Hesper-Inguza was a fish gutter who lived on the planet Ahch-To. As a male Lanai from Temple Island, he was a member of the group known as the Visitors, which was a fishing and hunting fleet of handcrafted vessels that spent most of its time traveling across the ocean to other…

Grebe-Korora was a male Lanai porter who resided on the planet Ahch-To. Hailing from Temple Island, he was a member of the group known as the Visitors, along with all the other male members of his species from the island.

Arashell Sar was a human female child who worked as a stable hand—one of several street urchins abandoned on the planet Cantonica and employed by Bargwill Tomder—at the fathier stables in Canto Bight. Her fellow stable hands included Temiri Blagg and Oniho Zaya.

Auk-Waimanu was a Lanai male who served as the captain of the Visitors, a group consisting of the male Lanai population of the Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To. The group spent all of their time fishing and hunting while traveling across the ocean to other islands.
Corm-Kairuku was a net-maker for the Visitors, a group consisting of all of the male Lanais from the population inhabiting Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To.
Terna-Gentu lived on Temple Island on the planet Ahch-To and served as one of the Caretakers, a group consisting of all of the female Lanais on the island.
Nodin Chavdri was a human male member of the Resistance where he served as a shuttle and transport pilot.

Thomkins Watam was a human male who worked as a chauffeur in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He wore an all black uniform including boots, pants, gloves a shirt and a belt along with a formal pointed chauffeur's hat.
Jhat was a Palandag musician. The Palandags were naturally musical due to their powerful exolungs, so Jhat was a leading f'nonc horn performer.

Flufto was the nickname of a batch of cloned and customized tookas owned by the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra. Aphra cloned over sixty of the creatures in a laboratory on the Outer Rim planet Son-tuul.
Dobbu Scay was a Khamarill gambler from Emkhamarill who was present in the Canto Casino on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.
Gherd was a male nanak owned by Harra the Hutt that helped J-Squadron escape the stronghold.
Xim, also known as Xim the Despot, was a male tyrannical warlord who lived in a time long before the reign of the Galactic Empire and the First Order.
The 14th Atrisian Emperor, otherwise known as the 14th Emperor of Kitel Phard, was an individual who served as the fourteenth Atrisian Emperor of the Core Worlds astronomical body Atrisia.
Ubbla Mollbro was a boisterous female Xi'Dec opera singer who spent time in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. Her presence was due to her search for a hatching partner.
Stepheden Thaldree was a human male who served as an officer of the Canto Bight Police Department in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Sommel Atandu was a human male who served as a sergeant of the Canto Bight Police Department in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Govi was an Ishi Tib who served as the Mariod of the planet Tibrin. On behalf of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, Leia Organa met with Govi and another Ishi Tib official to rally the planet to their cause.

Davin Bryce was a human who served as a captain who commanded the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Stormbringer. A battalion of stormtroopers subdued rebel Luke Skywalker and decided to take him to the Stormbringer so Bryce could interrogate him.

Armo Malou was a male alien who worked as head barkeeper at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. In the year 34 ABY, he was present in the casino when the Resistance operatives Finn and Rose Tico entered.
Pemmin Brunce was an Ongidae male who was the head of security for the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Hhex was a Palandag musician who played f'nonc horn in a band alongside fellow Palandags Jhat and Dhuz. Around 34 ABY, the trio played in the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Dhuz was a Palandag musician who was part of the house band alongside fellow Palandags Jhat and Hhex for the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. All three members of the band played f'nonc horn gas bags.
Pinrado Noza was a jockey who rode fathiers at the Canto Casino's racetrack in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Wayulia Tagge-Simoni was a human female baroness who prospered under the reign of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine as a notable figure in the Galactic Empire.
Wolfid Dorna was a human male who was arrested by the Canto Bight Police Department and locked in one of the cells in the Canto Bight police headquarters on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.
Torreb Savato was a human male who was arrested by the Canto Bight Police Department and locked in one of the cells in the Canto Bight police headquarters on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.
Jio Loster was a human male who was arrested by the Canto Bight Police Department and locked in one of the cells in the Canto Bight police headquarters on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.

Daxo Ecloss, also known as "Odds", was a human male who was arrested by the Canto Bight Police Department and locked in one of the cells in Canto Bight police headquarters on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.
Soburi Hannemtin was a fair skinned human male with black hair, who worked as a croupier at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Olvin Teeps was a human male who was arrested by the Canto Bight Police Department and locked in one of the cells in the Canto Bight police headquarters on the planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY.

Salaka Kuchimba was a human male who served as a soldier in the army of the Resistance during their war with the First Order. He wore a green uniform jacket and tattered combat cap along with a brown scarf, brown pants and brown boots.

Arca Yroca was a human male jockey who rode fathiers at the racetrack in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. In around 34 ABY, he rode in a race on the crime lord Sturg Ganna's fathier Kessel Runner and in another on the fathier Hoth Stuff.
Shuma Kalamo was a human male jockey who rode fathiers at the Canto Casino's racetrack in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Ro was an officer in the starfleet of the Galactic Empire who fought in the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the First Order, Ro's prowess had passed into history, and the commemorative armbands worn by sergeants of the First Order's military bore the officer's name in Aureb…

Hal was an officer in the starfleet of the Galactic Empire who fought in the Galactic Civil War. By the time of the First Order, Hal's prowess had passed into history, and the commemorative armbands worn by squad leaders of the First Order's military bore the officer's name in…
"Colonel" Guswan Askreeth was a cyborg with many body parts replaced with repurposed components, including an FX-8 trunk and a 2-1B surgical droid arm.

Jotis was an individual who served as a Vice Admiral in the navy of the Resistance during its war with the First Order. Jotis was in command of the Vakbeor-class cargo frigate Vigil during the evacuation of D'Qar.

Thelan was a male member of the royal family of Isobe. He and his sister Althea were the children of Lord Hallux. At some point, Thelan started a smuggling ring dealing with the secret and illegal exporting of tynzo crystals, the source of Isobe's wealth.

Althea was a female member of the royal family of Isobe during the Imperial Era. She and her brother Thelan were the children of Lord Hallux. She developed a brief relationship with Jun Sato, a human from Mykapo who had joined the renowned crystal processing school on Isobe.

Hallio Bas was a male Skakoan from the planet Skako Minor. They made an agreement with the Galactic Empire to bring them looters on Skako Minor. Around 3 ABY, Bas worked as a guide for the criminal syndicate known as Son-tuul Pride to lead them to the workshop on Skako Minor.

"Salty" Sharp was a human male soldier who served as a sergeant in the army of the Resistance during its war against the First Order. After surviving the First Order's Battle of Oetchi, he was amongst the Resistance personnel who managed to reach an outpost on the planet Crait.
Cova Nell was a human female who served as a transport and starfighter pilot in the naval branch of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.
Koo Millham was a human female who served in the Ground Logistics Division of the Resistance during their war against the First Order.

Bryce was a human who served as a colonel in the army of the Galactic Empire. They accompanied Darth Vader and a team of snowtroopers to Tython, following a lead regarding the Rebel Alliance base provided by Doctor Chelli Aphra.
The Count was the husband of the royal Countess Alissyndrex delga Cantonica Provincion, and was rarely seen in public.
Edon Kappehl was a fair-skinned human male bombardier in the Resistance's Crimson Squadron during their war against the First Order.

Spennie was a female from Coruscant who served as a member of the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron. She served as the tail gunner of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Cobalt Hammer during the evacuation of D'Qar where she was killed by First Order forces.

A human pilot served in the Resistance fleet during their war against the First Order. In the year 34 ABY, during the Battle of Oetchi he piloted a U-55 orbital loadlifter, and, after witnessing the destruction of two other transports at the hands of the Supreme Leader's Star …
Finch Dallow was a human male bomber pilot who was a member of the Resistance's Cobalt Squadron. He was formally part of the New Republic and flew for the New Republic Scout Service.

A human male pilot served in the Resistance fleet during their war against the First Order and held the military rank of captain. In the year 34 ABY, during the Battle of Oetchi, he piloted the Nebulon-C escort frigate Anodyne.
CZ-1076 was a human stormtrooper of the First Order.

In 19 BBY, a soldier was a human male member of a group of Mandalorians seeking to return to ways of violence and war known as the Death Watch. This particular soldier took part in a mission to Jabba's Palace and the takeover of Mandalore, among many of his fellow Mandalorians.
Stattata was an Imperial Moff who served as Governor of the Lothal sector at the time of Senator Leia Organa's formal request for Imperial compensation regarding a rebel mission on Lothal.

Alois Akrone was a human male who served as a pilot in the Galactic Empire before the Galactic Civil War. A student at the Imperial Academy, he was friends with Sax Hastur and Poul Ashanto on Prefsbelt.

Poul Ashanto was a pilot who served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. A student at the Imperial Academy, Ashanto was friends with Sax Hastur, with whom they were best friends, and Alois Akrone on Prefsbelt.
"Bruiser" was the nickname of a pilot who served in Banshee Squadron. He was present at the bar "Zero Angle" in the flying base of the Oversector.
Chan was a TIE fighter pilot who served the Galactic Empire as a member of Nashtah Squadron. They participated in the Battle of Portocari and was among the pilots that perished.

Artur Essada was a human male who served as a pilot in Nashtah Squadron of the Galactic Empire. Following the Battle of Portocari in 0 ABY, he, along with other surviving members of the squadron, came to the Zero Angle cantina on the Bright Jewel Oversector Flight Base.
Riggs was a pilot who served in Nashtah Squadron of the Galactic Empire. He participated in the Battle of Portocari and was among the pilots that perished.

Awgree was the pet sheffi of Gatha Elbaphay, a patron of Canto Casino in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. In 34 ABY, the sheffi was present along with its owner when Resistance soldiers Finn and Rose Tico went to the Canto Casino in search of the Master Codebreaker.

Sacritte was a Governor of the Galactic Empire. After the Empire informed the galactic populace that a supposed mining disaster was the cause of the destruction of Jedha City, when in fact it was a test for the new superweapon, the Death Star, Governor Sacritte conducted an in…
Gatha Elbaphay was an alien patron of the Canto Casino in the coastal city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.
Streamdrinker was a senator who represented Tynna in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic and was a member of the Delegation of 2,000.
Shea Sadashassa was a senator who represented Herdessa in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic and was part of the Delegation of 2,000.

This individual was a human male on the planet Lothal who owned neks. He grew up in Kinpany Gap, and when the area was mined by the Galactic Empire, he found a job providing security for an orchard's droid pickers.
Judder Page was a human male who served as a sergeant and later lieutenant in the Special Forces of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Frorral was a female corporal in the Special Forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Sister Six was a female Xexto assassin who came to join a crew of mercenaries led by Chelli Aphra. Tasked with recovering memories of Aphra's superior, they traveled to Skako Minor to search the workshop of Wat Tambor.
Denard Philo was a male Nautolan living on Coruscant during the Cold War.
Dorus Pyne was a male Human living during the Cold War. He resided on Tatooine in 3643 BBY.

Zorek was a female Human citizen of the Eternal Empire living during the Galactic War. A member of the Knights of Zakuul, following the Coronation of Empress Vaylin she was hand-picked by her to join the new Horizon Guard.

Finnilus was a lieutenant who served in the intelligence branch of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Finnilus was tasked with analyzing ballistics testing and reports after the Primtara incident, an attack on the Primtara outpost by an alleged Imperial SCAR unit.

Axvering was an individual who served as a Chief Investigator in the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire. At one point, Senator Bail Organa wrote a response to an inquiry to Axvering in regards to a missing UT-60D shipment.
VC-2123 was a human stormtrooper of the First Order who was liked by Wanten. VC-2123 was killed by a tawd owned by Harra the Hutt.

Misha Vontoba was a female individual who led a band of nomads on the planet Jakku. Around the time of the Hosnian Cataclysm, the nomads came across the wrecked New Republic corvette Starlight Wanderer, which had crashed during the Battle of Jakku many years earlier.

This individual was a Theelin male who worked as a mechanic and was held captive on Freighter 2716 by the Galactic Empire to work on a secret project. They were freed from captivity by a group of rebels and joined the Rebel Alliance.
An Ithorian lived during the Imperial Era. They worked as a technician, and were captured by the Galactic Empire to work on a secret project.
Anna Seertay was a female individual who served as a colonel in the Rebel Alliance's Pathfinders during the Galactic Civil War. She was killed during Operation Cobalt prior to the Battle of Endor.

Catta Dionize was an individual who served under Madame Travia Chan, leader of the Atrivis Resistance Group during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. In 5 BBY, Dionize sent a letter from Generis Station to Senator Mon Mothma on behalf of Chan.

Travia Chan was a female individual who served as the leader of the Atrivis Resistance Group. Catta Dionize, on behalf of Chan, wrote to Mon Mothma of the Alliance in 14 AFE, agreeing to become allies and fight against the Galactic Empire.
Berretic was a lieutenant who served under General Sotorus Ramda. Before the Battle of Scarif, Ramda sent Berretic a request listing loaned equipment and troops that he wanted back.
Toben was a male individual who was a member of a band of nomads active on the planet Jakku that were led by Misha Vontoba.
Corbo was a human male who lived on the planet Haidoral Prime. In 3 ABY, he signed up to the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, with the planets Imperial governor, Everi Chalis, also defecting.

Briala was a member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire. The Mirialan Lylee Anaraku heard her calling AT-ST walkers "stalkers" and caught onto using the name.
Lylee Anaraku was a Mirialan male who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, also known as Twilight Company, during the Galactic Civil War.

Cait was a member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. She served as a Forward Air Controller for the company, directing their X-wing starfighters to their targets.
Wyron Serper was a male human who served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic as the senior controller of the command center in the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth.
Zord was the owner of Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in Canto Bight on Cantonica.
So-Hem was a captain in the Rebel Alliance's military who served aboard the starship Sixmoon in the Alliance Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Gar was a human male who, after Order 66 and the following Great Jedi Purge, aided Chief Librarian Jedi Jocasta Nu in her efforts to preserve what was left of the Jedi Order and was based in Nu's new school.

Darien Whit was a Force-sensitive child from Alderaan whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66. After Darth Vader captured Jedi Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu, Imperial shock troopers of the Galactic Empire searched Nu and discovered the memory crystal.

Devin Hvitur was a Force-sensitive child from Bespin whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66. After Darth Vader captured Jedi Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu, Imperial shock troopers of the Galactic Empire searched Nu and discovered the memory crystal.
Scape Loewig was a Force-sensitive child from Cathar whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66.
Alaytia Taverre was a Force-sensitive child from Kessel whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66.

Kris Elioup was a Force-sensitive child from Eadu whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66. After Darth Vader captured Jedi Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu following a duel in the Jedi Temple, Imperial shock troopers of the Galactic Empire searched Nu and discovered the me…
Shifting Sands was a fathier stallion owned by Sturg Ganna, and whose sire and dam were Virtuous Velocity and Imperial.

Kessel Runner was a fathier colt owned by Big Sturg Ganna. Kessel Runner was born to a sire and dame named Hydian Dreams and Distant Star in 31 ABY. He participated in fathier races at Canto Bight racetrack.

Mynock Minute was a fathier colt owned by Ubbla Mollbro. Mynock Minute was born to the sire and dame Doonium Strike and Take Flight in 31 ABY. He participated in fathier races at Canto Bight racetrack.
Dokar Venas was a male individual who served the criminal gang the Strus clan on the planet Jakku around the time of the outbreak of the First Order-Resistance War.
Jax Torani was a male individual who was a member of a group of nomads led by Misha Vontoba that were active on the planet Jakku.
Annali Bissa was a Force-sensitive child from Corellia whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66.

Nik Lowe was a Force-sensitive child from Mustafar whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66. After Darth Vader captured Jedi Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu following a duel in the Jedi Temple, Imperial shock troopers of the Galactic Empire searched Nu and discovered the m…
Jacque Porte was a Force-sensitive child from D'Qar whose name was in a memory crystal after Order 66.
Divis Scaldz was a human male that lived in the galaxy.
Medjay Milesius was a male Human living on Coruscant during the Cold War.
Setali Dexsoreco was a female Human captain of the Death's Claw pirate gang living during the Galactic War.
Vezok was a male Selonian living on Corellia during the Galactic War. During the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY he was captured by the Imperial forces, leaving behind some explosives.

Paonu was a commander in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company. He served as naval captain on the company's CR90 corvette, the Thunderstrike, and was third down the line of command in Twilight Company.
Mzun was an alien who served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry, better known as Twilight Company. After Sergeant Fektrin's death in 3 ABY, Mzun took charge of Fektrin's squad.
TK-5648 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served on the Star Destroyer Stormbringer when it was destroyed by the Ishi Tib fleet.
Time for Flatcakes was a deaf and blind male racing fathier sired by Kreegah who was kept at the Canto Bight racetrack on the planet Cantonica.
Wol Kessix was a male individual who served as an agent of the Resistance around the time of the Hosnian Cataclysm.
Joris was a Heptooinian female who worked at the currency exchange desk of the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Ganzer was a male bartender at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He was a close friend of fellow employee Kaljach Sonmi and witnessed him defeat the gambler Orisha Okum in a game of pazaak.
Orisha Okum was a Zeltron female, professional gambler who worked for the crime lord Sturg Ganna in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Valis of Kuhlvult was a Kuati diplomat who was the first owner of the Libertine, which Valis originally christened as the Steadfast. The Libertine was eventually owned by Korfé Bennux-Ai until it was stolen on Cantonica by DJ, an amoral criminal and slicer.
Korfé Bennux-Ai was a male individual who purchased and then owned the custom Star Yacht Libertine. He was an arms dealer who sold starfighters.

Bak Rychuk was a human male pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Lieutenant Rychuk flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Two with his astromech droid, Zeetoo-Zeetoo.
Yancee Drai was a human female pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Captain Drai flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd One.
Olee Beasco was a Twi'lek male pilot who served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Beasco flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Four.
Noblesse Eiram was a human female pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Eiram flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Five.
Hopeata was a Rodian pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Hopeata flew as part of Shepherd Squadron under the callsign Shepherd Three.
Ektol Traz was a human male who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy. He commanded the Imperial Interdictor-class heavy cruiser Spectral.
Swaja Malon was a male Rodian who worked as a mechanic in Mos Espa on Tatooine.
Adan Mose was a human male who assisted Han Solo and Chewbacca in smuggling Rathtars for King Prana on Twon Ketee.

Fossil, known as "the Old Lady" by the bomber crews of the Resistance, was a female Martigrade who served as the commanding officer of the Resistance's StarFortress unit that included Cobalt and Crimson Squadron.

Aisha Freitas was a senior analyst within Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Freitas was in an argument with Colonel Haxen Delto on an unverified intelligence report about another rumored Death Star.
Juhrah Yanai was a female human who was in Takodana Castle on Takodana during the destruction of the Hosnian system by Starkiller Base.
Vurluha was a female Twi'lek who was a youngling training at the Jedi Temple.

Chukha-Trok, also called Chukha, was an Ewok that lived on the moon Endor, who participated in a hunting expedition with Ra-Lee and Chirpa. Chukha-Trok set a trap that Ra-Lee and Chirpa drove the boar-wolf they were hunting into.
Scolder was a Dowutin that lived in the galaxy.

A Weequay pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he served the gang as a scout on the planet Felucia. During an operation on the jungle world, the scout laid prone on a ridge overlooking the a nysillin farm that the gang were extorting.

The human monitor of First Order General Armitage Hux was on the bridge of the Star Destroyer Finalizer during the Battle of D'Qar. They were the one who intercepted Poe Dameron's message as the pilot contacted Hux from Black One.

Karris was an Imperial Commander who reported to Moff Delian Mors, the Commander of the Imperial Forces on Ryloth. He served under her when the rebel YT-209 freighter Eclipse undertook a smuggling run into Ryloth. Despite their efforts, the rebels eluded Imperial capture.

A pirate was part of the k'Jtari group. By 0 ABY, the pirate taught the human smuggler Sana Starros a hand-to-hand combat technique that consisted of using an arm to hit an individual on the back of their neck.

An Ishi Tib pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. The pirate was skeptical of Hondo Ohnaka's leadership skills and intelligence, as when told to attack a nearby ship, the Crucible, they commented that they believed Hondo was not going to "mess" with Jed…

A Force-sensitive Kajain'saNikto male served as a Jedi under the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, the Jedi, alongside fellow Jedi Finn Ertay, encountered two Zabrak brothers, Maul and Savage Opress, at a spaceport in the Outer Rim Territories.
This Weequay pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. This pirate helped to capture Count Dooku for Hondo Ohnaka, and was later present at a Weequay banquet.

Ben Teene was a human male pilot of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Bolide during the Evacuation of D'Qar. He spotted incoming First Order starfighters approaching the Resistance Bomber squadrons and advised the rest of the unit.
The father of Commander Zhou was a male individual who served the Galactic Empire and was the superior of his son.
This pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. At some point, General Grievous invaded Florrum for revenge against Hondo Ohnaka, who had held Count Dooku captive.
A human monitor who served the Resistance as a tactical officer was aboard the MC85 Star Cruiser Raddus during the evacuation of D'Qar.

Phi was one of the children of Resistance pilot Jaycris Tubbs. At the time of the Evacuation of D'Qar in 34 ABY, Tubbs' flight helmet was inscribed with Phi's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, Ted and Stella.

Ted was one of the children of Resistance pilot Jaycris Tubbs. At the time of the Evacuation of D'Qar in 34 ABY, Tubbs' flight helmet was inscribed with Ted's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, Phi and Stella.

Stella was one of the children of Resistance pilot Jaycris Tubbs. At the time of the Evacuation of D'Qar in 34 ABY, Tubbs' flight helmet was inscribed with Stella's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, Ted and Phi.
Casca Panzoro was a commander in the united resistance movement Bravo Rising at the time of the Atterra campaign. She was the grandmother of fellow resistance member Reeve Panzoro.
Reeve Panzoro was a member of the united resistance movement Bravo Rising at the time of the Atterra campaign. He was the grandson of fellow resistance member Casca Panzoro.
Ghoel was a Wol Cabasshite male who resided in Jabba's Palace on Tatooine during the period of the Galactic Civil War.
Atenna Olypo was a Rutian Twi'lek who negotiated smuggling routes near the neutral world Arthuria during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Karté was a female human who served as a handmaiden to Senator Padmé Amidala. During the Clone Wars, she was impersonated by the Clawdite bounty hunter Cato Parasitti, who stole her robes and locked her up until she was found by authorities.

Noka was a male Trandoshan enslaver who was part of an acquisition crew working for the Xonti Brothers. He led a mission to Kashyyyk to capture Wookiees for their superiors. However, the Wookiee Krrsantan had set a trap for them and killed all of the hunters except for Noka.

Kryndal was a human male who served in the Rebel Alliance's special forces, receiving four months of training for the role. In 3 ABY, he was stationed at the Alliance High Command's secret base on the planet Hoth.

Malkhan was a warlord and leader of the Malkhanis, a clan on the Outer Rim planet Crucival, during the Imperial Era. Giving his own reason why he should control Crucival, Malkhan and his clan led an insurrection on the planet.

Kreegah was a male fathier who sired the fathier Time for Flatcakes. By 34 ABY Time for Flatcakes had started participating in fathier races at the Canto Casino and Racetrack in the city Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica.

Salju was a human female who was the proprietor of Black Spire Station, a filling station and repair shop in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu that serviced vehicles ranging from landspeeders and swoop bikes to small vessels.
Mawdo Larrth was the Ithorian owner of Cladtech, a factory on the Inner Rim world of Gilvaanen, which manufactured stormtrooper armor components during the Imperial Era.

Oosha Choi was a human who was a detective for Canto Bight's Police Department. Unlike many police officers from the Department, Choi was an honest detective leading him to earn a reputation of sucker.

"Static", known by their title "Omega Ace," was the nickname of a human First Order ace pilot from Omega Squadron, a squadron of TIE/fo space superiority fighters. They were a part of the military of the First Order.
"Null" was the callsign of the human First Order ace pilot from Epsilon Squadron, a squadron of TIE/fo space superiority fighters. They were a part of the military of the First Order.

Saespo Choffrey was an artist who worked for Sienar Fleet Systems. He was the cousin of Resinu Santhe-Caltra, and networked his family relations into a successful illustration career as part of the arms and drive manufacturer.

Val was a female human criminal who worked with fellow outlaw Tobias Beckett during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Val was a no-nonsense and occasionally prickly woman who was a crack shot with a blaster rifle.

Dryden Vos was a near-human alien male who served as the public face of the crime syndicate Crimson Dawn during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He owned the First Light, and possessed a large quantity of wealth as Crimson Dawn's figurehead leader.
Annaz was a female Falleen gangster who was part of the Malandro syndicate on the planet Tangenine. Her syndicate extorted places like the farm owned by Remba and Kelven.

Kelven, referred to as Ada by other other members of his family, was a male farmer who lived on Tangenine. He and his lover Remba had two children, Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien. The family owned a farm but were being extorted by the Malandro syndicate.
Remba, referred to as Ama by other members of her family, was a female farmer who lived on Tangenine and owned a farm with her lover Kelven and the rest of her family, Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien.
Julien, nicknamed "Ju-ju" by his sister Lauren Mel Coelho, was a male individual who lived on Tangenine. He was born to Remba and Kelven.

One Zillo Beast was believed to be the last member of its kind. In 21 BBY, it was awoken by an electro-proton bomb used by the Galactic Republic during the Battle of Malastare, against the Confederacy of Independent Systems' battle droid army.

Jinsol was a member of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Following the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, the 61st were making repairs to their CR90 corvette, the Thunderstrike, on the planet Ankhural.
Norokai was a veteran of the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry who joined the company prior to its campaign on the planet Vir Aphshire.
Dixnet Dat was a female journalist for the Undervine during the Galactic Civil War.
Shadday Potkin was a human who served as a Jedi Master within the Jedi Order, the guardians of the Galactic Republic.
The father of Jek and Shaeeah Lawquane was a male who was the partner of Suu Lawquane and the father of her children.

Bhada Cha was a human male bounty hunter who was the husband of Ramat Cha and the father of Chanath Cha. In 19 BBY, shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire, Bhada, Ramat, and Chanath attempted to claim a bounty placed on the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Ramat Cha was a human female bounty hunter who was the wife of Bhada Cha and the mother of Chanath Cha. Shortly after the rise of the Galactic Empire, Ramat, her husband Bhada and Chanath attempted to claim the bounty placed on the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Snet Groot was a male human arms dealer who sold arms to the Separatists during the Clone Wars. Because of that, Senator Padmé Amidala of the Galactic Republic believed that the arms dealer was likely to hire a bounty hunter to disrupt her scheduled meeting with Arthurian dele…
Selder Psalm was a human that had a base on the planet Coruscant with known ties with the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic.
Dobretz was a pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Dobretz was killed during a battle between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire.
Vermeil was an Imperial TIE/rp Reaper attack lander pilot during the Galactic Civil War who held the rank of major. At some point, Vermeil performed a maneuver near the Scarif Shield Gate.
Ebenn Q3 Baobab was a human author and linguist who wrote the Easy Ubese Phrase Book. Baobab served as a dignitary for the Royal House of Naboo.
Tiggs Kaiga was a female Faust who served as the flight surgeon for Cobalt Squadron on D'Qar. She was tall and skinny and known to not have a sense of humor.
Etta was the mother of Hue Tico, who in turn was the father of Paige and Rose Tico.
Derrida was a Ketton assassin active during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
A male individual was the brother of the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla. He died by 19 BBY, while he was still young. A design on the Syndulla family Kalikori was included to memorialize him.
Storm was the father of Hue Tico, who in turn was the father of Paige and Rose Tico.
Fyzen Gor was a Pau'an male gangster who was the creator of the Phylanx Redux Transmitter. He was a medical student at Prasteen Braak, the most esteemed med school in Pau City on the planet Utapau.
Mayvlin Trillick was a female human bounty hunter and librarian who crossed paths with the Wookiee Chewbacca and rebel spy droid K-2SO.
A female scout served under Caluan Ematt in the Rebel Alliance's Shrikes recon unit during the Galactic Civil War. Prior to that, the scout had been a member of Saw Gerrera's Partisans.
Dume was a mysterious and abnormally large male Loth-wolf who shared the birth name of Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus—Dume.

LS-261 was the designation of a human male stormtrooper who was stationed in the Imperial Complex on Lothal during the era of the Galactic Empire. He and another stormtrooper were left to guard a drugged Hera Syndulla after she had been interrogated by Governor Arihnda Pryce.
Glahst Ombra was a Defel mercenary who was hired by the Son-tuul Pride criminal syndicate to undertake a mission to recover the memories of the syndicates leader, 0-0-0, around 1 ABY.
