Mishru was a male soldier who lived on the Outer Rim planet Crucival. During the Imperial Era, they were recruited by the human soldier Hazram Namir to join his band. In 1 BBY, the band was invited by the Galactic Empire to help defend Crucival's transmitter tower.

Tar was a male soldier who lived on the Outer Rim planet Crucival during the Imperial Era. They joined a band of soldiers led by the human Hazram Namir. In 1 BBY, the band was recruited by the Galactic Empire to help defend Crucival's transmitter tower from Rebel Alliance forces.
Myan was a diminutive Sullustan male who worked in the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility on the planet Sullust. He and a number of other workers from the facility were patrons of a cantina.

Rekya was a female inspector on the planet Nakadia. They were the chief inspector of the team of Nakadians who searched New Republic Senator Tolwar Wartol's ship for restricted agricultural products when it was revealed that Chancellor Mon Mothma had smuggled a pta fruit aboar…

LS-515 was a human female scout trooper that served the Galactic Empire. While patrolling an Imperial excavation site centered around the Lothal Jedi Temple, LS-515 and her speeder wing-mate LS-412 were ambushed by the Spectres rebel group.

LS-412 was a human male scout trooper that served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. In 1 BBY, he and his comrade LS-515 were knocked out by the rebel Garazeb Orrelios while patrolling the perimeters of the Lothal Jedi Temple.
Veris Hydan was a human male who served the Galactic Emperor Palpatine as an adviser. He also served as the minister of the Ministry for Antiquity.
Morai was a female convor with spiritual ties to the Daughter, a Force wielder from Mortis. She appeared in various depictions of the Force wielders alongside the Daughter.
The White Loth-wolf was a Force-sensitive white Loth-wolf from the planet Lothal. He led a pack of Loth-wolves and was able to travel through time and space.
Shin was a male Duros who served as a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.
Joon Strephi was a human who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Corin Ferro was a human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Zorta Bingan was a human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Tomas Azoras was a human male who served as an officer in the Imperial Officer Corps in the early days of the Galactic Empire.
Dors Urtya was a Mon Calamari who served as Grand Admiral of the Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet, Regent of Mon Cala, Dual Protector of the Two People, and Warden of the King in exile.

Jer Croteau was an individual who served the Galactic Empire with access codes to Imperial systems at Level 1A1, which gave Croteau access to the highest levels of the Imperial Executive Building on Coruscant.
Aya-Glon was a twelve-year old Lew'elan who befriended Luke Skywalker when he came to her homeworld to study her people's knowledge of the Force. She owned a wind-truster named Deek-Deek.
Tigo-Lee was the name given to a female wind-truster who was the personal mount of Kailla-Glon-Vow, a Lew'elan elder.

aroraDeek-Deek was the name given to a three-year-old wind-truster who was the personal mount of the Lew'elan Aya-Glon. Deek-Deek was killed when a bolt of lightning struck her while she and her owner flew through a storm.
Coni-Co was the name given to a young wind-truster who was the personal mount of the Lew'elan Tonn-Glon. Luke Skywalker rode the wind-truster while attempting to circumvent the globe of Lew'el.
Tonn-Glon was a twelve-year old Lew'elan who was the twin brother of Aya-Glon.
Kailla-Glon-Vow was a Lew'elan elder who was the grandmother of Aya-Glon.

Zhios was an Imperial Navy Trooper serving aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Herald. During Captain Tabor Seitaron's time on the ship, he gained respect for Zhios and another Navy trooper called Cantompa.

This male Sullustan was the father of Surat and Rutar Nuat. He was described by Surat as being a soft and pliable man. After he found out that Surat had killed his mother, Surat's father attempted to hit Surat. Surat in response cut his throat with kitchen cutlery.
Gilad Pellaeon was a human male from the planet Corellia who served in the Republic Navy and later as a captain in the Imperial Navy.

Jacen Syndulla was a Force-sensitive male human-Twi'lek hybrid who was born during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He was the son of General Hera Syndulla and the late Jedi Knight Kanan Jarrus, and the grandson of Twi'lek revolutionary leader Cham Syndulla.
Goneril was a First Order Navy adjutant who served under Captain Moden Canady aboard the Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix during the First Order-Resistance War.

926 was a human stormtrooper who served the First Order during its war with the Resistance. During his time aboard the Mega-class Star Dreadnought Supremacy, 926 encountered Finn—an ex-stormtrooper who once served with 926 in Batch Eight.

A female Lanai was the mother of Alcida-Auka, the matron of the Caretakers on the planet Ahch-To. At some point before the Battle of Crait, this Lanai had served as the matron of the Caretakers and eventually passed on the title and its responsibilities to Auka.

Tunga Arpagion was a male Clawdite shape-shifter agent who was known to be a professional actor and impersonator. He was recruited by the Alliance to Restore the Republic for a mission they undertook on Mon Cala.

Albus Marinith was an Imperial officer who served as Flag Captain of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Chimaera, the flagship of Grand Admiral Thrawn. An old and reliable Imperial Navy officer, Marinith was handpicked by Thrawn himself, becoming a close colleague.

Zizi Tlo was a Candovantan Resistance ace pilot. In 34 ABY after war broke out between the Resistance and the First Order, Tlo flew an RZ-2 A-wing interceptor in the Battle of D'Qar. She was killed over D'Qar when her starfighter was blown to pieces by First Order TIE fighters.

Eskil Abon Santhe was the Imperial governor of the Outer Rim planet of Garel. Santhe was widely known to accept bribes from several criminal organizations, including the Black Sun and the Broken Horn Syndicate, allowing them to operate on Garel with impunity.

A Jedi scout, whose name was lost to history, used Force-assisted hyperspace navigation to discover the remote planet Ilum thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin. The scout reported Ilum as a great resonance, but did not find any sentient life or ruins on the planet.
Zarda was a human male who served in the Imperial Navy as a captain during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Ferren Barr was an Iktotchi male fallen Jedi who sought to avenge the Jedi Order by overthrowing the Sith-ruled Galactic Empire.

The Tenth Brother, formerly known as Prosset Dibs, was a Force-sensitive Miraluka male member of the Inquisitorius during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Prior to the rise of Emperor Palpatine, Dibs held the rank of Jedi Master during his time in the Jedi Order.

Rantu was a human who served as a major in the Galactic Empire during the early stages of its reign. Rantu, along with Colonel Bergon and Commander Jordo, were assigned to Governor Wilhuff Tarkin to discourage growing tensions with Mon Cala.

Jordo was a human male commander in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. Sometime after the rise of the Empire, Jordo was the Imperial Security Bureau officer responsible for the Outer Rim world of Mon Cala, and when tensions between the Mon Calamari monarchy and th…
Telvar was a human who represented the Galactic Empire as ambassador to Mon Cala during the early years of Emperor Sheev Palpatine's reign as part of the Imperial Diplomatic Corps.

Bergon was a human who served as a colonel in the Galactic Empire during the early stages of its reign. In 18 BBY, Bergon, along with Imperial Security Bureau Commander Jordo and Major Rantu, assisted Governor Wilhuff Tarkin in military operations on Mon Cala.

Yago was a male veteran of the Imperial Starfleet. In 34 ABY, he was an officer holding the rank of captain in the First Order on board Supreme Leader Snoke's Mega-class Star Dreadnought, the Supremacy.

Jerserra was a Dathomirian female who was taken from Dathomir and trained by an Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire. She wielded a red double-bladed spinning lightsaber. She eventually killed her master and became a mercenary in search of more power.

Mosep Binneed was a Nimbanel male who worked as an accountant for various criminals throughout his life. During the Galactic Civil War, he spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley in the year 1 BBY.

Odar Firn was a male who worked as an executive in Sienar Fleet Systems, having joined the company during the Clone Wars after Sienar had secured a contract for the manufacture of starfighters for the Galactic Republic.
Suhlarla Tug was a female Duros that captained the freighter Verdant Dawn throughout the Corellian Trade Spine, and made constant transport runs between the Core Worlds and the Outer Rim Territories.

Dicsato Smi was a male who operated a market in the Tann Province on Ryloth during the Clone Wars and then during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During the Clone Wars, Smi struggled to keep his corner market stocked and customers satisfied.

Zanyo Arak was an individual who was assigned by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo to pilot a starfighter for the Resistance during the evacuation of their base on D'Qar. During the early part of the battle, Arak led a starfighter flight to protect Cobalt Squadron's bombers.
Haddeen Bissel was a male individual who served as a technician and crew chief for the Resistance's Starfortress unit.

A Chadra-Fan male youngling was chased away by an Aleena vendor sometime between 5 BBY and 1 BBY on the planet Ord Mantell. The child later stole the human Jyn Erso's kyber pendant. After fleeing from Erso across rooftops, the child was eventually caught by Erso.
This individual served as the flight engineer of the Resistance bomber Cobalt Hammer during the evacuation of D'Qar.
This individual was a female Aleena merchant living on the planet Ord Mantell during the Imperial Era.

The white Loth-cat acted as a guide to Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger when he returned to his homeworld of Lothal on three occasions. On the first occasion, Ezra was seeking a prisoner named Ryder Azadi who knew his parents Ephraim and Mira Bridger.

Tan Hubi was a male human who was the Imperial Moff of the Calamari sector. In order to free King Lee-Char from imprisonment, Leia Organa and her team planned to kidnap Hubi so they could use his bio-signature to access the King's prison on Strokill Prime.
Miré was a human female handmaiden from Naboo who served Queen Padmé Amidala. She wore green velvet robes.
The human Liana Merian served as an aide in the delegation representing the planet Alderaan in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic during the Naboo Crisis in 32 BBY.

Vennie was a female individual who during the Atterra campaign served as the pilot of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 Crimson Cutter. On occasion Vennie flew in an a-wing starfighter as an escort for the bombers.
Kaiden Scorbo was an individual who was assigned by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo to pilot a starfighter for the Resistance during the evacuation of their base on D'Qar.
Cat was a Nefrian male who served as the flight engineer of the MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber Cobalt Treasure during the Atterra campaign.

Sa'Kalla was a young Drabatan singer who spoke out against the Galactic Empire's tyranny by 1 BBY. In retaliation, the Empire blockaded her home planet of Pipada and held her in captivity, where she was tortured. A movement was organized in her name that opposed the Empire.
This officer was a human male in the Galactic Empire's Officer Corps was involved in a conspiracy against Darth Vader in the early reign of the Empire.

Rexa Go was a human female mercenary equipped with a AJ^3 cyborg construct who served the crime lord 0-0-0 after he took over control of the Son-tuul Pride. She accompanied doctor Chelli Aphra to attack an Imperial settlement on Someilk, which they incinerated.
Bythen Forral was a male officer who served as a captain in the navy of the Galactic Republic aboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Vensenor during the Clone Wars and was a starfighter ace.

Leeya was an empress who allied her dominion, the Regency Worlds, with the Galactic Empire. Due to the alliance, the Empire granted moderate taxation and permitted the Regency Worlds a degree of sovereignty.

Yewl was a human commander who was in command of Hivebase-1, an Imperial Tarkin Initiative research and development space station. He led Imperial forces when Hivebase-1 was infiltrated by the Son-tuul Pride, who sought to recover the memories of 0-0-0.

Bini was an alien officer in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War who served as a senior crewmember aboard the Lucrehulk Prime, a rebel flight school, under the command of General Hera Syndulla.

Punfor was a human who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire around 1 ABY. They were stationed at an Imperial settlement on Someilk in the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories and was killed when the settlement was destroyed by a group of mercenaries.
A human male served as a major and commanded a brigade in the First Order during their war against the Resistance.

Thespus-V was a female who died at some point before the mutiny on Mon Cala. After her death, the Clawdite Tunga Arpagion understudied her for a week and took on her role for a week before anyone noticed that he had done so.

An Ottegan was a senator of the New Republic's Galactic Senate in 5 ABY. During Liberation Day, a day of celebration held on the planet Chandrila to mark the liberation of rebel prisoners from Ashmead's Lock on Kashyyyk, the senator was in a hall of the Old Gather-House, a his…

A Sith witch led Sith forces during the Great Scourge of Malachor, a battle fought between the Jedi Order and the Sith Empire between around 5000 BBY and 1032 BBY, millennia before the Cold War, a period of risen tensions between the First Order and the New Republic after the …
A clone sergeant served in the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.
Argus "Six Eyes" Panox was a six-eyed Azumel male who lived in the galaxy during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was present during Lando Calrissian and Han Solo's first sabacc game.
Gola Chall was a female deep-cover resistance recruiting agent that served as a proctor at the Galactic Empire's Vensenor Flight Academy located onboard the Venator-class Star Destroyer Vensenor.

A young male cadet was enrolled at the Galactic Empire's Vensenor Flight Academy and caught the attention of Commandant Bythen Forral and Proctor Gola Chall after demonstrating the characteristics of a famed starfighter ace pilot, as well as being popular among cadets at the I…
Thermoculus Krisintvolt Scissorpunch, also known simply as Therm Scissorpunch was a male Nephran from the planet Nepotis who lived in the galaxy for more than three centuries.
Enfys Nest was a human woman who led the Cloud-Riders, a band of rebel pirates who fought the crime syndicate Crimson Dawn and supported the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
A Weequay was a pirate captain during the reign of the Galactic Empire that discovered the Gigorans after many surveys of the planet Gigor by the Galactic Republic found it to be uninhabited.

Pol Ipol was a human male who was a detective for Canto Bight's Police Department. Unlike many police officers from the Department, Ipol was an honest detective, which led him to earn a reputation as a sucker.

Moloch was a male Grindalid who lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. As a member of the Corellia-based White Worms gang, he made sure none of Lady Proxima's scrumrats worked against the Grindalid matriarch.

A human male served as a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. He was stationed aboard an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer when the astromech droid R2-D2 boarded the ship to rescue his friend, the protocol droid C-3PO who was being held captive aboard t…

Karjj was a Crocin spacer active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Facing financial and marital troubles alike, he was also an enthusiastic player of the sabacc game, which he enjoyed despite frequently losing money in it.
Roz was a female Flurrg who lived on Takodana.
Lazslo was a human who served as a head mechanic in the Resistance.
PD-528 was a human male who served as an Imperial stormtrooper on the Death Star. He owed thirty-five credits to fellow stormtrooper TD-110.
SB-3709, nicknamed "Patch," was a human male stormtrooper who served the First Order.

A Senate Commando was the pilot of Palpatine's executive shuttle during the Zillo Beast incident. During the incident, the involved Zillo Beast caught the H-2 executive shuttle, and Anakin Skywalker used his lightsaber to cut it in half, causing all aboard the shuttle to fall …
A male Twi'lek child was on Onderon during 20 BBY and was in the Malgan Market with his mother when he was intrigued by a fruit.

Rio Durant was a four-armed Ardennian pilot who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Durant carried out dangerous missions alongside the scoundrel Tobias Beckett for years and was good-natured and up for any challenge.
Agarne was a male soldier who served as a sergeant in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. He was a member of the New Republic's Third Recon Group and took part in the Battle of Jakku.

A governor served the Galactic Empire on the Outer Rim planet Pipada. By 1 BBY, a movement was formed for the Drabatan singer Sa'Kalla, who was captured and tortured by the Empire for protesting its rule.

Jerdon Bly was a human male who worked as an arms dealer during the Cold War between the Resistance and the First Order. Like many, he sold to both sides of the war, but unlike others was very cavalier and open about it.

A human male worked as a guard onboard the Undisputed Victor, a yacht owned by Baron Yasto Attsmun. In 34 ABY, the guard was on duty on the yacht while the baron hosted a party onboard it on the planet Cantonica.
Vestry was a female Quermian who worked as a pit boss at the Canto Casino. She was considered tall for her species.
Kruno was a male alien belonging to a reptilian species. He died in an explosion on Ammon IV.

Verla, a Force-sensitive human female, was an acolyte of the fallen Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Unlike Barr's other disciples, Verla's connection to the Force made her a candidate for Jedi training.
Daren was a human male who during the Clone Wars was rescued from two B2-series super battle droids by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker.

Rebb was a human who lived during the Imperial Era. Witnessing the Empire's forces firsthand, Rebb and their partner Stell decided to resist its rule in the hope of a better life and joined the disciples of the Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr.
Kaasha Bateen was a Rutian Twi'lek female master strategist in the Free Ryloth Movement who was good with a blaster.

Florx Biggles was a male Ugnaught mechanic that loved droids. After Lando Calrissian was attacked by his own protocol droid DRX-7, Calrissian recruited Biggles to travel with him and Kaasha Bateen onboard the Lady Luck to find the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.

Peekpa was an Ewok female hacker for the New Republic, tech genius, and a superfan of the Wookiee Chewbacca after he saved the life of her sister during the Battle of Endor. She frequently operated a datapad.

Taka Jamoreesa was a non-binary Alderaanian human pilot and aspiring scoundrel. About two years after the Battle of Jakku, Jamoreesa was in a crew with Han Solo and Lando Calrissian trying to thwart Fyzen Gor's plot to take over the galaxy using the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.

The gran of Lauren Mel Coelho was a human female. After her parents, Remba and Kelven were killed by the Malandro syndicate leader Annaz, Lauren and her brother Julien lived with their gran for a few years until she died of a fever.

A Duros male was the original owner of the Serendipity. During Han Solo's Cyrkon Extraction, Delia Leighton who now owned the ship, noted that when she worked as a barmaid at a cantina on Lothal, the Duro drank by himself and often told her stories when things in the cantina w…
Primco Farg was a human bounty hunter whom Lando Calrissian was acquainted with, and didn't care much for, at some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Faztoon was an Ithorian who was an old friend of Lando Calrissian. Calrissian encountered Faztoon on Weigh Station Karambola, and called out to the Ithorian, who replied with a wave.
Prita Sven was a female, who at one point was a regional administrator in the Galactic Empire, later becoming Vice Grand Administrator of stormtrooper recruitment.

Frapsen was a male Fromprath musician who played a batanga. Whilst at the castle of Maz Kanata on Takodana around 3 BBY, he played a song about missing Dathomir. Shortly after, he took down a Trandoshan bounty hunter outside of the castle.

A human male prisoner was incarcerated on the planet Wobani in 1 BBY. While being transported on a worker's convoy, the prisoner's transport came under attack by a Rebel Alliance strike team, who sought to liberate another prisoner named Jyn Erso.
In 18 BBY, a human lieutenant of the Galactic Empire served aboard the Sovereign, and reported to Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.
A male Neimoidian guard was stationed aboard a Lucrehulk-class Battleship in the Blockade of Pantora. He was responsible for guarding a detention block aboard the vessel.

Will Scotian was a human male who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a pilot during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. He survived the Battle of Hoth and continued flying after being recruited into Red Squadron by Wedge Antilles and Wes Janson.
Vermilion was a fathier that participated in fathier racing at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the casino planet Cantonica.

A Sullustan male served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a technician during the Galactic Civil War. The technician was tasked with extracting a code from an ID10 seeker droid utilized by Commander Iden Versio of the Galactic Empire's Inferno Squad.
Beena was a young female Twi'lek whom Lando Calrissian entertained in Cloud City, along with an entire diplomatic brigade of young Twi'leks.
Zil was a female Sarkan and the queen of Sarka at the time of the Galactic Civil War. She had gray-colored skin and a bulky frame yet but a small head, which sported blue eyes.

Roron Corobb was an Ithorian Jedi Master who, alongside the Togruta Jedi Master Shaak Ti and a clone task force, helped to protect Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine from Separatist General Grievous when Grievous stormed Galactic City in an attempt to kidnap Palpatine during t…
A female Ewok was the sister of the slicer Peekpa. During the Battle of Endor, the Wookiee Chewbacca saved the life of Peekpa's sister, causing Peekpa to become attached to the Wookiee.

A human male rebel trooper was a veteran of the Battle of Hoth, in which he lost one of his legs. Two years after the Battle of Jakku, the trooper was present on the Grand Promenade of the Rebellion in Hanna City on Chandrila and asked Lando Calrissian and Kaasha Bateen if the…

Amaiza "Maiz" Foxtrain was a human who worked as a pirate and a smuggler during the Galactic Civil War. She was an associate and ex-girlfriend of Jaxxon, who regarded her as a "class act" and sought to impress her, until she double-crossed him.

Moggee was a member of a sentient species who was part of the criminal trio known as the Gatto Gang alongside Sylvestarr and Ziggee. During the Imperial Era, the trio owed money to Duke Blazor of Black Sun and was subsequently hunted by the bounty hunter assassin droid IG-88.
Ziggee was a member of an unknown species that was part of the Gatto Gang. Later this individual was captured along with the rest of the gang by the assassin droid IG-88.
Sylvestarr was a member of an unknown species that was part of the Gatto Gang. Later this individual was captured along with the rest of the gang by the assassin droid IG-88.

An individual was an agent of the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the Imperial Era. Around 3 BBY, an auction for a device known as the Phylanx Redux Transmitter was held by the Wandering Star criminal syndicate in the city Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica, …
Lallani was a silky-voiced Quarren crime lady who was a rival of Jabba the Hutt. She employed a gang of Mandalorian mercenaries. She had a hand in slavery operations.

Krull was a male individual who served as a captain in the New Republic Defense Fleet in 7 ABY. He was stationed aboard the flagship Tribulan Vort in a blockade of the sector where Substation Grimdock was located when a crew including Lando Calrissian and Han Solo were leaving…

Seven-Seven Dirgeos, formerly known as Ruas Fastent, was a male human who served as an admiral in the Galactic Empire prior to the Battle of Yavin. A few years before the battle, he was given an honorary discharge and was shoved into an Imperial asylum on Grava.

A clone trooper serving as one of the Galactic Empire’s first stormtroopers was stationed aboard the Jedi space station Brighthome in 19 BBY. The soldier led several other clone troopers against a perceived Jedi, who was in reality Sith apprentice Darth Vader.

Viz Moshara was a Cosian pirate who was captain of the Radium Destrobar. He and his fellow pirates attempted to protect Substation Grimdock from the New Republic army. He was killed when his ship crashed with another pirate ship under the command of Fyzen Gor.
Sometime before 7 ABY, a famed Zabrak smuggler exported Lee romay from the planet Mon Cala. Eventually the Lee romay were illegally sneaked onto Chandrila.

Bragthap was a bartender who worked at the castle of the pirate Maz Kanata. Around 3 BBY, he put a bubbly concoction in front of Kanata as she sat next to the smuggler Han Solo when he visited the castle as he waited for Sana Starros to show up with the cargo she needed his he…

Brantis Mo Fresk was a pilot who lived during the New Republic Era and owned a ship known as the Vorantis. In 7 ABY, he participated in the Karee Blockade Clutch, where he beat the starship Brightfox.

An unaffiliated Talz smuggler lived during the Imperial Era. When an auction for a device known as the Phylanx Redux Transmitter was held by the Wandering Star criminal syndicate in the city Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica around 3 BBY, the smuggler attended and …

Quay Tolsite was a male Pyke capo who administered the Pyke Syndicate's operations on Kessel. He was a ruthless individual who enslaved several sentient beings, including Wookiees, to work as miners at the spice mines of Kessel in order to acquire spice for the Pykes.
Rebolt was a young human male criminal who worked for the notorious White Worms gang. He was part of the scrumrat portion of the gang and at one point was considered for the role of Head Boy.

Mozeen Parapa was a male Frizznoth crime lord who was leader of the Parapa Cartel. Around 3 BBY, he was kidnapped and smuggled aboard the Millennium Falcon in a package by Sana Starros so she could use his tech-lords, which Starros claimed were second-to-none, to learn where t…

Crytan was a professor of Fyzen Gor at Prasteen Braak, a medical school in Pau City on Utapau. Crytan often said that dire, bloody circumstances gave birth to innovation, something that Gor remembered after attaching an arm that had belonged to his friend Greesto Ftrak onto a …
A female served as a waitress at Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel in the Core Worlds around 3 BBY.
Arty-Ba was an alien who worked at the Dex Acquisitions Depot on Meor Ain.
Kazuda Xiono, nicknamed "Kaz," was a human male military pilot and later Resistance spy who served in the years following the conclusion of the Galactic Civil War.
A Twi'lek male child was present in the Coruscant Underworld with his mother in 19 BBY.

PB-106 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who served aboard the first Death Star. He relieved fellow soldier TD-110 of his rifle and escorted the trooper to command with the rest of his unit, as ordered by a Moff.

MG-26 was a loyal human male stormtrooper who served alongside TD-110. He was deployed on the planet Lothal, with his unit backing TD-110's. MG-26 also served aboard the first Death Star, where he met TD-110 on his way to Detention Block AA-23.
Tuuma was a male Hutt who served as the captain of the Wayward Current.
Feroph was an Imperial TIE/rp Reaper attack lander pilot during the Galactic Civil War who held the rank of captain.
"Vizier" was the callsign for an Imperial TIE/rp Reaper attack lander pilot during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, Vizier proceeded to do a flight maneuver while flanked with two TIE Strikers.

Purpruff was a Gigoran who served as a corporal in the Vapetailers unit of the Rebel Alliance Special Forces. During the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire, she traveled to the planet Hoth while scouting for a new location for the Alliance's headquarters.

A female human was the sister of HoloNet News reporter Calliope Drouth. At some point before Drouth attended the Imperial Ball in the Imperial Palace on Coruscant, she wore an ivory dress to her sister's wedding.

Greesto Ftrak was a Pau'an male who was a student at Prasteen Braak and a classmate and friend of Fyzen Gor. He and Fyzen were kidnapped by a group of Pau'ans he thought were members of the Wandering Star crime organization.

Tan Yuster was a human who was the Padawan learner of the Zabrak Jedi Master Agen Kolar. The two were among the Jedi assault team that accompanied Mace Windu on the mission to Geonosis that started the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.
Rekias Nodo was a reptilian male criminal and mechanic who ran a shipyard on a jungle planet, stripping down stolen starships for parts.

Distant Star was a female fathier that mated with the male fathier Hydian Dreams, resulting in the birth of the fathier Kessel Runner around 31 ABY. By 34 ABY, Kessel Runner competed in a fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica.
Palabee was a female individual who was the sister of Nipaltoo. At some point, Palabee was taken from her home by members of the Jedi Order to become a Jedi and to have a new and better life.

Beris Ford was a minor gangster who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. By 9 BBY, he was captured by the bounty hunting duo Zuckuss and 4-LOM, and was kept prisoner aboard their starship, the Mist Hunter, for weeks.

Auromae Iselo was a male Melbu bounty hunter. Possessing a strong sense of justice, his frustration with the number of political targets he was assigned by the Galactic Empire inspired him to pursue and punish violent criminals, joining Enfys Nest's Cloud-Riders gang as a vigi…
This female individual was the mother of and Nipaltoo and Palabee. At some point before Order 66, Palabee was taken by members of the Jedi Order.
Alfons Allsing was an individual who, around the time of the Mid Rim Retreat, served as a minister in the Galactic Empire's civil government.
Ander Rendrake was an individual who served as a lieutenant in the military of the Galactic Empire around the time of the Mid Rim Retreat.
Nipaltoo was an individual who served fallen Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr as one of his six acolytes. As a child, their sister Palabee was taken in by the Jedi Order.

Lemnos, also known as Lem, was a mechanic who was an acquaintance of Captain Hera Syndulla of the Spectres. During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, Lemnos worked as a mechanic at the Fekunda Outpost under Commander Zhou and his stormtrooper squad.
Burl was a human worker at the Fekunda Outpost under Commander Zhou and his stormtrooper squad. He was also a contact for the early rebellion.
Ractivelle was an individual who served as a corporal in Stardust unit, a Rebel Alliance Special Forces unit.
Mersh Pellus was a male human scientist who served as a "boffin" aboard the Resistance starship Ninka, under Admiral Amilyn Holdo, during the war against the First Order.

Bonadan Star was a fathier who raced at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on Cantonica, a planet in the Outer Rim, in 34 ABY. During that year, they were owned by Pakkerd Racing and ridden by the jockey Turcotte Bel Mont.
Zhou was a human commander who served the Galactic Empire at the Fekunda Outpost. He led the effort to acquire the outpost's resources for Imperial supply lines.

Darth Atrius was a male Sith Lord who lived during the time the Sith were plentiful and powerful. He wielded two crossguard lightsabers. At some point after the Battle of Yavin, the smuggler Sana Starros recovered his pair of crossguard lightsabers.
Vee was a Pamarthen pilot who competed in the Gauntlet on Corellia. She dropped out during the middle of the race.
Prizzi was a Livorno female who served as the queen of Livorno.
Kootan was a male Trandoshan enslaver who was part of an acquisition crew for the Xonti Brothers. Led by Noka, the five Trandoshans went to Kashyyyk where Krrsantan set a trap for them.
Orvek was a human who became a disciple of the fallen Jedi Padawan Ferren Barr after their home was demolished by the Galactic Empire following its founding in 19 BBY.

Stell was a human who lived during the rise of the Galactic Empire. After Stell and their partner Rebb witnessed the Empire's forces firsthand, the two decided that they could not raise their children under its control.

Ganjira Rell was a female leader in the Strus clan on Jakku during the Cold War. Rell favored the use of a high-powered blaster rifle at the time when the Strus clan came into contact with a group of nomads over the Starlight Wanderer.
Brana Tsaro was mercenary leader on Jakku during the time of the Cold War. She was betrayed by the Strus clan after saving a family they were trying to intimidate.

Tann Atar was a leader in the Strus clan on Jakku during the Cold War. Atar favored the use of a vibro-ax at the time when the Strus clan came into contact with a group of nomads over the Starlight Wanderer.

Hodeka was a male leader in the Strus clan on Jakku during the Cold War. Hodeka favored the use of a disruptor at the time when the Strus clan came into contact with a group of nomads over the Starlight Wanderer.

Stationed on the planet Lothal, a stormtrooper was tasked to hunt down a Rodian fugitive named Tseebo. During the search, he was with another stormtrooper, who was searching for the Spectres during the Empire Day celebration.
Garudda the Hutt was a Hutt present at Fey's Cantina, where he offered people bounty hunter-related quests. At some point, the cantina's owner, Fey Zara, had enough of Garudda and kicked him out.

Master Shar Seff was a Kel Dor present at Fey Zara's cantina, where he often instructed new and aspiring patrons and offered tutorials and quests for the holotables. Shar owned old military texts and was considered sage and a cunning tactician.
Tezzie was a female Pantoran visitor to the Canto Casino. She had blue skin and played Zinbiddle with Kaljach Sonmi early in the evening. She was a construction heiress and had three grandchildren.

An Ungrila male crime boss was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Some time after the Battle of Yavin, this crime boss made a deal with the infamous smuggler Sana Starros to buy a pair of ancient lightsabers that were once wielded by the Sith Darth Atrius.
Elder Iasento was a Mimbanese tribal leader who was armed and trained by the Galactic Republic's 224th Division during the Clone Wars in order to battle Separatist invaders of his homeworld, Mimban.
Bin Essada was a male individual who served as the Imperial Moff of the Circarpous sector of the galaxy's Expansion Region.
Xodell was a human male Imperial officer who served as a commander in the military of the Galactic Empire. He was part of the 224th Imperial Armored Division and participated in the Mimban Campaign.
Weazel was a human male thief turned freedom fighter from the planet Tatooine who lived in the last days of the Galactic Republic and during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Contispex I was an individual that served as a chancellor who perished by 10 BBY. That year, Contispex's ashes were held in arks aboard the First Light, the personal star yacht of Crimson Dawn crime lord Dryden Vos. Vos considered the arks among his most prized posessions.

Doelsor Triggant was an individual who served as a Moff of the Galactic Empire. By 10 BBY, Triggant had gifted crime lord Dryden Vos—head of the Crimson Dawn syndicate—a Taozin grub, which Vos kept on display in the study of his personal yacht, the First Light.
TK-5861 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. As such, the trooper was equipped with the standard armor and weapon of the Stormtrooper Corps.
Vell Brank was a human male Imperial fleet officer in the Galactic Empire's navy where he served as a Second Lieutenant.

Staz was a human male major that served in the Galactic Empire's 224th Imperial Armored Division. He led the division during the Mimban Campaign. During a battle, he was killed by an explosion as he yelled orders to his troops.

Drawd Munbrin was a human male recruitment officer who held the military rank of naval captain and chief in the Galactic Empire. By 13 BBY, Munbrin was stationed in Coronet Spaceport, where he encountered the future smuggler Han. Munbrin gave Han the surname Solo.
Danith Nodar was a human female who served as a corporal and Imperial swamp trooper in the Galactic Empire's 224th Imperial Armored Division during the Mimban Campaign.

This human male was the father of the saboteur Val. Due to Val being fiercely guarding about her past, the only information that Tobias Beckett had been able to get out of Val was that her father was a musician and that she was named after the valachord.
Mattiso Trodu was a human male who served as a medic and a sergeant in the Galactic Empire's 224th Imperial Armored Division during the Mimban Campaign.

Denwade Banevans was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as a range trooper captain on the planet Vandor. He led the stormtroopers tasked with the protection of the conveyex train lines on Vandor, and was one of the toughest officers stationed on the world.

Glaucus was a Octeroid male who was also known by the nicknames "Big Guy" and "Big Eye". In 10 BBY, Glaucus spent time watching matches of sabacc in the Lodge on the planet Vandor and witnessed matches between the smugglers Han Solo and Lando Calrissian.

Needles was a male individual who was a friend of Han Solo. According to Solo, Needles was the best street racer on Corellia. At some point before 10 BBY, Needles attempted to pull a dangerous maneuver whilst driving a vehicle, but it failed and he was killed.
Aemon Gremm was a male Hylobon who served as captain of Dryden Vos' security forces. He died on Savareen when Enfys Nest attacked his team and broke his neck.

Toht Ra was a male Hylobon who served as member of Dryden Vos' security forces, working as an attendant aboard the First Light. Ra confiscated all weapons brought aboard the yacht by guests. He carried a percussive cannon and vibrocutlass in case of trouble.

Crev Bombaasa was a well-cultivated human who worked as a shipping executive on the planet Corellia. He bribed local law enforcement to stop them from investigating violent attacks against his business rivals, but he faced greater scrutiny under the Galactic Empire.

Kilmo was a male member of an alien species active in Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In the year 13 BBY, Kilmo encountered fellow criminal Han Solo and left him with bruising beneath his left eye.

Ralakili was a male human who ran the droid fighting pits in the Lodge on Vandor. Ralakili was a loathsome rascal who had hated droids since his planet was ravaged by General Grievous during the Clone Wars.

Loru Denholt was a human female emigration officer in the Corellian Security Forces. She, along other CorSec officers, served as an extension of Galactic Empire on Corellia, as an emigration officer she had direct contact with the Imperial Security Bureau Surveillance division.
Keela Hevis was a human female emigration officer in the Corellian Security Forces.

Falthina Sharest was a human female emigration officer in the Corellian Security Forces. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, CorSec became an extension of the Imperial forces on Corellia, and she served as Lead Transport Security Officer in Coronet Spaceport.

The Princess of the planet Kessel was a female individual who was a member of its royal family. By 10 BBY, the con artist Tak attempted to rob the princess, which resulted in Tak becoming enslaved by the Pyke Syndicate as a miner in the spice mines of Kessel.
Yaruba was a male individual who ruled as king of the planet Kessel from at least 19 BBY to at least 10 BBY.
This male individual was the father of Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. After asking Han Solo if he was close with his old man, Calrissian said that he wasn't close with his dad.

This female individual was the mother of Enfys Nest and belonged to a long line of women who fought to protect the galaxy. She was leader of the pirate gang known as the Cloud-Riders and wore a distinctive set of armor and a mask that she later passed down to her daughter.
Chates was a human male who became a scrumrat in the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia after his father was killed by muggers.

Bansee was a human female member of the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. She caught the eye of the gang's leader, Lady Proxima, for being the best rat catcher amongst the scrumrats her age and was made Third Girl.

Jagleo was a human female who worked as a dancer before becoming a member of the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. She worked as a thief for the gang and fought using a self-invented style of martial arts that made use of her balance and coordination.

"Tunnel" Toli was a human who as a child served as a member of the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. He earned his keep in the gang by slipping into utility wiring trunks and patching into power and data grids in order to keep the gang connected to the rest of the planet.

Hallon was a human male who as a child served as a scrumrat in the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. He worked as a thief for the gang, as his small sized allowed him slip through spaces where older thieves could not fit.

Cosdra was a Twi'lek female who served as a loyal member of the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. She worked as a sentry for the gang's den in Coronet City, and in 13 BBY, she was present when the scrumrat Han escaped from the gang's leader, Lady Proxima.

LeKelf was a human male who served as a loyal member of the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. He worked as a sentry for the gang's den in Coronet City, and in 13 BBY, he was present when the scrumrat Han escaped from the gang's leader, Lady Proxima.
Syke was a human male member of the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. He and Rebolt were the favored thugs of the Grindalid senior gang member Moloch, who encouraged competition between them.

Taomat was a Sibian hound owned by the White Worms gang on its homeworld Corellia. It was the favorite hound of the thug Syke, who hoped to one day set it on his rival Rebolt and end their competition for good.

Dobarn Tren was a Barbadelan male priest of the Sacred Way. He traveled to the planet Corellia to try and aid the poorest citizens of Coronet City but chose to leave the planet after local law enforcement came to incorrectly suspect that he was involved in the black market.
Pashevir Duine was a male human who worked as an engineer for the Sublights Products Corporation during the Imperial Era.
Tak was a Coruscanti human male con artist who was a slave working at the spice mines of Kessel by 10 BBY.

Baxin Winstoll was a male human who served as a senate page in the Galactic Empire until he was rounded up during a crackdown of suspected traitors. He was then put to work in the spice mines of Kessel, under the oversight of Capo Quay Tolsite.

Gafferky Lenzwin was a male salesbeing for Hyrotii Assembly Services who traveled to Coronet City on the planet Corellia during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was a nervous hypochondriac and could not wait to leave the city due to the high pollution levels.

HarrGick was a male Ugor who worked in a factory owned by Ubrikkian Industries in Coronet City on the planet Corellia. After more than a decade of service, he was laid off in 13 BBY when the Galactic Empire took over the factory.
The Enchantress was a Force-sensitive human female from the planet Ushruu. A worshipper of the Vathyr, she used her slaves to contruct a temple of fear in the side of the chasm it resided in.

Sagwa was a Wookiee male who was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire in the spice mines of Kessel. After years of toil, Sagwa was freed by Chewbacca and participated in a break-out, escaping alongside Tak and other slaves.
Tsuulo was a Rodian male from Coruscant who became a scrumrat in the White Worms of Corellia.
Gorji Sandem was a human male medic who served in the 224th Imperial Armored Division and was responsible for rescuing the wounded on the front.

Aurodia Ventafoli was a female human bestselling recording artist who performed on the First Light in 10 BBY. The singer, who was billed as Chanteuse of the Stars, was in high demand and frequently toured, which made it rare for her to settle in one place for too long.

Bellows was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic who later worked with the Clan Assembly. After suffering severe head trauma just before Order 66 was issued by Chancellor Palpatine, Bellows was discovered by Lira Hardin.

Korso was a human male criminal who provided muscle for Tobias Beckett's gang. He helped Beckett to infiltrate the Imperial Army fighting on Mimban and steal an Y-45 armored transport hauler for a heist on Vandor in exchange for passage off the planet.
Gillen Finders was an Imperial Army trooper who fought on the planet Mimban in the 224th Imperial Armored Division.
Bokret Humphreys was a Imperial Army trooper who served on Mimban. He was heavily injured by Mimbanese guerillas during combat in the Circarpous sector and was rescued by Medic Gorji Sandem.
Senna was a Gigoran male from the planet Gigor who was, along with others from his homeworld, enslaved by Zygerrian enslavers whose actions were sanctioned by the Galactic Empire.

Kara Safwan was a human female who worked as a spy for the criminal Rang Clan. In 10 BBY, she attended a party on board the First Light, the yacht of Dryden Vos, a crime lord of the Crimson Dawn syndicate which she had been hired to gather intel on.

Luleo Primoc was a musician who performed on the First Light in 10 BBY. The tiny Gallusian was a chart-topping singer with hits such as "Your Love is Gravy" and "Carve Your Name in My Heart" in the years before the Clone Wars and was also known for starring in a series of holo…
Crodit was a Dwuni male who was enslaved with his brother Blawz during the reign of the Galactic Empire and served as a miner in the Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel.

Dava Cassamam was a Elnacon female from the world of Nacon who was a deep cloud-miner on gas giant planets and was a keen sabacc player. She was present during Lando Calrissian and Han Solo's first sabacc game.

Tyrus Meori was a human who served as an admiral in the Imperial Navy. He was promoted to admiral after he won victories at Hargawi and Narrant Shoals. After the Mon Calamari began a mutiny, he was in command of a blockade of the planet Mon Cala.

Diles Anevi was the human governor of the Expansion Region during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, he met with Dryden Vos, leader of the Crimson Dawn criminal organization, aboard Vos's yacht, the First Light.

Boshti Anilee was a Twi'lek who trained at the Dette Lawnic Dance Academy on the planet Alderaan with their partner, Hado Gwin. The couple then joined the competitive circuit and won trophies in three sectors.
Clariah was a female Nautolan and old acquaintance of Lando Calrissian. She had a son, named Jiandy.

Hirang Birren was a Nithorn male who worked as a cruise ship talent scout and spent time on the yacht First Light in 10 BBY. While aboard, he began singing along with performers Aurodia Ventafoli and Luleo Primoc in his own guttural birdsong.

The father of Chates was a male individual. He worked as a farmer and at some point traveled to Coronet City on the planet Corellia with his son. When the pair visited a bank in the city, Chates' father was killed by muggers.
Yorsh Manted was an employee of the Mining Guild who was sent to patrol the criminal Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel in order to make sure the guild got its cut of the profits.
This mid-range jockey reserved a booth at the nightclub of Ubialla Gheal. She cancelled his reservation to make space for the sommelier Derla Pidys.

Kristiss was a female Petrusian who led a group of resistance fighters and smugglers against the Galactic Empire on Kullgroon. Kristiss and her crew worked together on freeing her father, Rythus, and other slaves at the Imperial outpost on Kullgroon.
Pysk Lila was a Mon Calamari female who served the Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet as a captain of the Star Cruiser Aurora Flare.

Batcha Hunaris was a human individual who worked as a guard for a fueling depot on Orinda before becoming a member of the Cloud-Riders rebel gang. While he was a member, the Cloud-Riders attempted to steal a shipment of coaxium from the Galactic Empire on the planet Vandor.

Jabbat was a male Grindalid who served as Head, the lead child of the White Worm criminal organization on the planet Corellia. At some point he disappeared resulting in the position being opened up to members of the gang including Han, Qi'ra, and Rebolt.

Fasca Tiradé was a male Zilkin who was the chief engineer onboard the Ninka. He worked with Rose Tico and other engineers to learn how to use her baffler on the U-55 orbital loadlifters in order to mask their engine emissions.

Gibs Nibbet was a Sullustan who served the Resistance as first officer aboard the bunkerbuster Ninka. After being assigned to the Ninka, Resistance technician Rose Tico was told by Nibbet that the ship could crack open a small moon.
This individual served as the territorial moff of the Arkanis sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
D'Lina was a female socialite Fosh, a bird-like species.
Rakan was a male socialite who belonged to a reptilian species.
Arann Jahr was a well-known male mercenary who was considered to be dangerous. He fathered a Devaronian daughter named Kada.

Chrodber was a male individual who served as the Count of Serenno. In 10 BBY, Chrodber was a guest aboard Dryden Vos' yacht First Light, and during his time aboard the ship, the server Ottilie had a tray of quanya reserve intended for Chrodber.
Bims Torka was a male spacer who was supposed to deliver a shipment of Knockback Nectar from Jakku to Wuher at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina.

The Scrapper was a male second-hand trader in the Tatooine spaceport of Mos Eisley. One day Kabe took Lirin Car'n's kloo horn which was obtained by Myo and later stolen by Muftak to the Scrapper's store selling it. He bought it but later sold it to the bounty hunter Djas Puhr.
TK-450 was a male human stormtrooper who served the Galactic Empire. TK-421 sent MSE-6-G735Y to deliver a scanner servo to TK-450 at Docking Bay 228 on the Death Star.

Iduna was a male dianoga who lived in a swamp on Vodran. He wanted to mate with fellow dianoga Omi, yet was rejected by the potential suitor, who then fought and defeated Iduna through her Force-sensitivity.
Neda was a female eopie who lived on Tatooine and was owned by Obi-Wan Kenobi. She died when one night a desert storm caught her.
Reezo was a Rodian male who devoted his life to Corellia street racing. He was the older brother of Tsuulo.

Darton Bailey was a male starfighter technician in the Rebel Alliance. He worked under Chief Nera Kase. If there was a problem with the engines of a Y-wing, Bailey could typically fix it in a few minutes.
Ohley was a starfighter technician in the Rebel Alliance. They worked under Chief Nera Kase. Ohley with the other crew chiefs Benis and Wuz were watching a map of the rebel assault on the Death Star.

This male individual was a gunner of the Rebel Alliance. He served under Captain Miara Larte, and was offworld when his homeworld of Alderaan was destroyed. He was present in the Great Temple on Yavin 4 in 0 ABY for the Royal Award Ceremony.
Naley Frifa was a multi-talented outlaw tech and tattoo artist who was a patron of the Lodge on the planet Vandor in 10 BBY.

Tchaiko, known as "Tchaiko the Hand" was a male Nothoiin. Once a low-level functionary in the Noble Court of the Anoat sector, he grew tired of that stifling life and chose to become a daring robber and raider.
Mikral was a male Rodian who had expertise in commando training. During the Iron Blockade, he could often be found at the Shadow Market of Cloud City.
The "Queen of Vipers" was a masked criminal who was active in the Anoat sector at the time of the Galactic Empire's Iron Blockade.
Ardwyl Hercho was a human female Warrant Officer and adjutant, who in 10 BBY, was dispatched to Corellia.

Odeffro Msern was an Imperial ground crew member stationed on Mimban in 10 BBY, who held the rank of specialist. As part of his duties in flight control, Msern used flashing sticks to direct air traffic.
Zuzanu Latt was a light-skinned human who served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Fleet Trooper corporal.
Aydn Boship was a human who served the Galactic Empire as a TIE fighter pilot and lieutenant.
Lorn Bal was a male individual who served as an agent in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau and was based on the Hutt Space planet Toydaria, where he led a contingent of Imperial forces.
Debnu was an individual that served as Irrica the Hutt's majordomo of the Gorensla kajidic.

Red-Eye Dren was a male Sullustan that operated deep within the cantina district of the Kwenn Space Station as an infochant, or information broker, for criminal organizations. He had cybernetics, notably two red cyborg eyes that could change brightness.

He was regarded as a gregarious noble, and was described as shrewd and fair. He was able to skillfully avoid allying himself with any of the Hutt Clan kajidics, but he did not ignore the Hutt criminals either, and it was not rare to hear that he deployed the Riar Royal Guard a…
Sibos Tammis was a human male captain who served in the First Order during the First Order-Resistance War. Tammis was one of the commanding officers during the Battle of Oetchi.

Faa-Char was a Mon Calamari individual that served as the commander of the Mon Cals. Although the Alliance to Restore the Republic had a good relationship with the Mon Cals, the Rebel Alliance was not yet able to convince the bulk of the Mon Cals to join the fight against the …

The Tynnan Saltbite was the commander of Deep Fathom, an intelligence-centric resistance group. When the group was known as Deep Current, they were able to leverage the Tynnan skill for bureaucracy in order to collect an abundance of information on deployments and shipyard car…
Iothene Jacontro was a Kerestian male who worked as a big game hunter during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Powlo was a Lasat male who by 13 BBY lived in a lair in Coronet City on Corellia. He became friends with the White Worms scrumrats Han, Qi'ra, and Tsuulo. He had peach-colored skin, gray hair, and white eyes with irises that glowed.
A Wookiee was infected by a abersyn symbiote on Ktath'atn and slaughtered half the village there at some point before the mission to Ktath'atn undertaken by Doctor Aphra and Luke Skywalker.
Pallaris Ven was a Resistance pilot who flew as Blue Four in Blue Squadron during the Battle of Starkiller Base. During the battle, Ven and their astromech droid BR-BA were killed.
Sara Bel-Sun was a Resistance pilot who flew as Red Two in Red Squadron during the Battle of Starkiller Base. During the battle, Bel-Sun and her astromech droid, P4-99 were killed.
A Mon Calamari fought against the Galactic Empire during the invasion of Mon Cala as a commander. Throughout the conflict, the Mon Calamari reported to Admiral Raddus.
A dog belonged to the Sith Lord Darth Maul. In 0 ABY, Maul constructed the Darth Star for his Sith Master Emperor Palpatine aboard an Imperial Executor-class Star Dreadnought.

This Rodian male was the father of Tsuulo and Reezo. They were also the husband of Tsuulo's mother. They and their wife were killed by a speeder being piloted by an enraged Besalisk who had just lost his job.
Vowail the Hunted was a male Zabrak who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire in order to seek redemption.
Margo was an Imroosian female who was part of Dryden Vos' concierge aboard First Light in 10 BBY when the yacht traveled to collect stolen coaxium from Tobias Beckett and his crew.
"Convict 2317" was the designation of an alien prisoner of the Galactic Empire held aboard the wreckage-prison Accresker Jail during the Galactic Civil War.
Wildfire, formerly designated CT-1701, was a clone trooper that served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.
Brushaun was an Ungrila male individual who lost two thousand credits to Lando Calrissian in a card game in Canto Bight. He believed that Calrissian cheated him and tracked the gambler to Batuv.

Rythus was a male Petrusian who worked at the Imperial outpost of Kullgroon. After the Galactic Empire enslaved the workers at the outpost, Rythus contacted his daughter Kristiss and informed her that the stormtrooper security force was turning over in three days and that whil…

Kelko Dev was an alleged alien ruler who was depicted by the notorious doctor and smuggler Cornelius Evazan around 1 ABY, while disguised as a shapeshifter named "Lopset Yas" using a pluripleq, a rare bioengineered creature.

Sandewar Mandewar was an alleged alien who was depicted by the notorious doctor and smuggler Cornelius Evazan, who was posing as a shapeshifter named "Lopset Yas" using a pluripleq, a rare bioengineered creature.

Krysguld Dartis was a human male who worked as a lookout in his home village on the planet Savareen. His tongue was cut out by the Crimson Dawn syndicate when he and the other villages stood up to them; however, he was still able to maintain an effective silent communications …

Taraja Cuttsmay was a human female who served as a seer for her home village on the planet Savareen and provided them with blessing. Her tongue was cut out by the Crimson Dawn syndicate when she and the other villages stood up to them.
Hallro was a human male child who worked for the White Worms. He offered Qi'ra some extra food after she had been promoted to Head.

Ballia Noaddo was a human executive of the Corellian Engineering Corporation who resigned over the amount of Imperial influence at the company. In 13 BBY, she was one of many unhappy citizens of the planet Corellia trying to leave via the Coronet Spaceport.

Jannitha Xoczuko was a Czerialan female droid programmer who worked for the Corellian Engineering Corporation. She lived on Corellia with her family, but was unhappy with the conditions of the military industry. She planned to move back to her homeworld Czerialus.
Waria Junus was a female Education Regent from Kor Vella, assigned to investigate truancy among Coronet City youths.
Melanah Sal Graeff was a human Sienar Fleet Systems development executive who held the title of Viceprex.

Collum Woslo was an Imperial mudtrooper part of the 224th who held the rank of Lieutenant in the army and a 224thSGT. He was a known brawler in his class at Myomar Academy, which earned him less desirable military deployments.

Fey Zara was a Twi'lek keeper of Fey's Cantina, where she assisted new patrons at the holotables and offered people cold refreshments as well as tutorials and quests for the holotables. She was assisted by the protocol droid B7-N5.

Alayus Bolandin was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the 224th Imperial Armored Division of the Galactic Empire during the Mimban Campaign. Following the death of Major Staz, Bolandin was given a field promotion to the military rank of captain by General Falk.

Sharlu Greslin was an Imperial mudtrooper who held the rank of corporal. He was unable to afford tuition at Shey Tapani University, and opted to serve a second tour in the military in exchange for a scholarship.
Wesger Odry was a human male who served as a corporal and Imperial swamp trooper in the Galactic Empire's 224th Imperial Armored Division during the Mimban Campaign.
Ottilie was a human who worked as a server for guests on board Crimson Dawn crime lord Dryden Vos's yacht, First Light.

Beedo was a Rodian who was under Jabba Desilijic Tiure's employ on Tatooine. Shortly before the Battle of Yavin, Beedo accompanied Jabba to Docking Bay 94 in Mos Eisley and was near the Millennium Falcon as Jabba and the smuggler Han Solo conversed.
Jake Farrell was a male human who served in the Galactic Empire as a flight instructor until he retired, and eventually joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Kirroo was a Wookiee who was being held captive by the Galactic Empire on the planet Corellia. He was rescued by Han, Qi'ra, and Tsuulo. Kirroo worked for Jenra.

"Jenra," also known as "the Engineer," was a female individual who worked for the Galactic Empire on a secret project of theirs. After designing a deflector shield she realized the value of her creation and defected.

Shrindi Meille was a master chef who was employed by Dryden Vos, a crime lord of the Crimson Dawn syndicate. Prior to Vos's death in 10 BBY, the criminal had Meille prepare spectacular dishes for guests aboard his Nau'ur-class yacht, First Light.
An individual was a programmer who worked as an employee of the company Industrial Automaton. They reprogrammed the LOM-series protocol droid 4-LOM.
Askroh was a crime lord who lived in Cloud City on the planet Bespin. He assisted Lando Calrissian with a plan to scare Jiandy out of his dream for a life in crime.
Meeta Cors was an individual who served during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire in the nascent Rebel Alliance.

Javor Tallensia was an individual who was a lieutenant governor in the Galactic Empire, when actually, he was an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, providing intel to Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service.

Striate Cruch was an individual who was a governor in the Galactic Empire. In actuality, Cruch was an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, providing intel to Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service.

Sarchen Snyle was an individual who was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. Snyle, however, was actually an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, providing information to Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service.

Tarn Innis was an individual who was a major in the Galactic Empire. Innis, was actually an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, providing information to Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service.
Kerri Lessev was a Galactic Empire major who secretly served as an operative of the Rebel Alliance's Intelligence Service.

Ilo Jev was an individual who served as a colonel in the Galactic Empire. Jev, however, was an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, providing information to Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service.

Vin Northal was an individual who was a colonel in the Galactic Empire. Northal, however, provided information to Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service, as they were actually an operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

This Kajain'sa'Nikto was a male Nikto guard working for the Hutt crime lords on the planet Nal Hutta during the Clone Wars around 21 BBY. The guard captured the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen, and tortured Kenobi for information about his two partners.
Harisha Gulan was a unit technician assigned to the droid pool that was part of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Massassi Group on Base One on Yavin 4.
A Nikto senator was present on Coruscant during the Clone Wars.
This Kajain'sa'Nikto pilot worked for the Hutt crime lords on the planet Nal Hutta during the Clone Wars around 21 BBY.
A Weequay male served as a member of the Ohnaka Gang, led by another Weequay, the pirate Hondo Ohnaka during the Clone Wars.
A burly Weequay pirate served in the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars.
A Weequay pirate was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars.

Hardhear was a Chadra-Fan male who worked as a tracker with his grandson Sissian during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The pair were hired by Governor Wilhuff Tarkin to help him track down the Sith Lord Darth Vader on the planet Chandar's Folly.
Chussido was a Rodian female native to the planet Rodia who served as a member of Enfys Nest's Cloud-Riders gang.
Waydurk was a Mimbanese who joined Enfys Nest's Cloud-Riders during the the Imperial Era. Waydurk participated during the skirmish on Savareen.
Gelan Yees was a Sabat who served in the Cloud-Riders under the command of Enfys Nest. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Yees participated in a skirmish with Crimson Dawn on Savareen.

Faddera Rabar was a Dyplotid pirate who was a member of the Cloud-Riders, a pirate gang led by Enfys Nest during the reign of the Galactic Empire. As a member, Rabar participated in a skirmish on the planet Savareen.

Callixido Ryss was a human who was part of the Cloud-Riders. Ryss had a strong competitive streak and would challenge Moda Maxa to races during raids. Moda's older sister Tayshin Maxa uneasily suspected Ryss' antics were a sign of his attraction towards her.
Susaut Volupicite was a horned alien with gray hair, brown skin and brown eyes. In 10 BBY, Volupicite spent time on the planet Vandor in the drinking establishment known as the Lodge.

This moisture farmer was a human male who was present in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine when the bounty hunter Boba Fett traveled to the cantina seeking information about the pilot who destroyed the Death Star.
Vylla Tendeil was a beguiling female alien who spent time in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in around 34 ABY.
Rylou Watmill was a male human who lived and worked on Lothal. Approximately five years before the Battle of Yavin, he became a target of the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers.
Dynym Quid was an alien that spent time in the Canto Casino in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in 34 ABY.
A Xendekian was the planetary leader of the Xendekian people.
This Geonosian female served as a queen on the planet Geonosis during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The queen was part of efforts to sabotage the Empire's construction of the Death Star.
Siroc was a Pastorian male who served as king of the planet Pastoria at the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
Squill was a Pastorian male who served as a colonel to King Siroc. He commanded an attack on a transport carrying Siroc's closest rival.

The rival of King Siroc was a male individual who had a claim to the throne of Pastoria. Knowing the First Order would eventually arrive on Pastoria and that his rival would try resist them, Siroc aimed to be the one to attempt to negotiate with them.
Dezmoont, also known as The Moont or just Moont, was a ranking security guard for the Vesustrian hotel and casino on the planet Cantonica during the year 34 ABY.

Groff Fordly was an alien podracer pilot with sizable gambling debts. The slicer DJ was known to bet on Fordly, and the two had a chance meeting in a casino on the planet Cantonica that led to both of them being arrested by the local authorities.

Jorka Edy was human male who owned the Coruscant Hotel and Casino on the planet Cantonica. He held a disdain for Canto Bight Police Department officers, and kicked out the detectives Oosha Choi and Pol Ipol when they were interrogating one of his customers, a slicer called "DJ…
An individual served as an informant for the vigilante Tam Posla during the latter's hunt for the criminal surgeon Cornelius Evazan around 1 ABY.
Flestic Crupp was a bulky Rodian arms dealer and criminal who led a small gang of other Rodians in the Cantonica system.

"Denel Strench" was a fake identity created by the slicer known as "DJ" that had the personality and reputation of a big time gangster. Despite not existing, Strench was taken very seriously by the inhabitants of the casinos and hotels on the planet Cantonica.
Reeshee Irway was an Arkanian brain-gangster who was eventually arrested for sandship licensing violations.
A Zabrak female served as a dealer for the holographic card game Eclipse in the Coruscant Hotel and Casino on the planet Cantonica.
Mettic was a human lieutenant who served the Galactic Empire at Fekunda Outpost under Commander Zhou.

J. K. Burtola was a human male who joined the Jedi Order at a young age and as a Jedi youngling trained as a member of Bear Clan. In 22 BBY, he and his clanmates received lightsaber training from Jedi Grand Master Yoda in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
Sol Charless, nicknamed "Li'l Sol," was a young Snivvian who lived in Lund Gourley on the planet Durkteel. He was often bullied by Fikk, a male Saurin.
A Mandalorian was a captain in the renegade Sith Lord Maul's Mandalorian super commandos during the Clone Wars after the death of Pre Vizsla.

A Sakiyan was active during the Clone Wars, operating a TR-RL3 Terrapin-class bulk tanker. In 20 BBY, they were present on the planet Stobar near Plop Dribble's when Savage Opress onto his ship during the search of his brother Maul and demanded that he take him along.
An Imperial officer served aboard the Executor during the Battle of Endor. The Imperial officer died when Arvel Crynyd crashed his RZ-1 A-wing interceptor into the ship's bridge.

A clone navigation officer served aboard the Endurance during the Clone Wars. After the Venator-class Star Destroyer was sabotaged by Boba Fett, he stayed onboard the doomed starship with Admiral Kilian and Clone Commander Ponds as it crashed on Vanqor.
In 19 BBY, a Mandalorian police officer was active when the Shadow Collective, a large force of combined criminal gangs, attacked Mandalore.
Duja was a human female who was a close friend and former handmaiden of Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo.

Kimmund was a human male Stormtrooper Commander who was the head of a unit within the 1st Legion. After the Battle of Atollon, Kimmund accompanied Darth Vader aboard the Chimaera when the ship was sent to Batuu to investigate a disturbance in the Force sensed by Emperor Palpat…

Xoxtin was a female Senior Lieutenant who served as the Chief Hangar Master aboard the Chimaera. Her family was one of Coruscant's elite and so few naval officers dealt with her when she did things her own way on the Chimaera.
Agral was a male individual who served as the helmsman aboard the Chimaera after the Battle of Atollon. He held the rank of lieutenant.
Janott was a male individual who served as a bartender at Oga's Cantina in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.

In 19 BBY, when Amidala's former handmaiden Duja started investigating the Separatist presence on Mokivj, Solha ordered assassins to kill her on the planet Batuu to keep knowledge of the droid factory's existence and his plans safe.
Pira Ten was a human female who lived on Crucival. In 4 BBY, she was a part of the Opaline Creed and became close to a man named Hazram Namir, known as Umu Seven at the time.
Keffan was an individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Empire. At some point, he was robbed outside a bazaar on the Outer Rim planet Crucival.
A human male born on the planet of Serenno was the brother of the Serennian Duke Solha and the duke's sister.

A human female Serennian hailing from the Outer Rim Territories planet Serenno was the sister of Serennian Duke Solha. Following Solha's secession from the Galactic Republic, he joined Count Dooku's Confederacy of Independent Systems.
During the Imperial Era, Duke Blazor of the Black Sun criminal syndicate was owed a large sum of money by the Gatto Gang trio of criminals.

A Jedi of the Jedi Order lived centuries before the reign of the Galactic Empire. The Jedi was infected by gundravian hookspores and eventually died. The Jedi's corpse, along with their Penumbra-1 shattersprite, ended up inside the wreckage-prison Accresker Jail.

A female comm tech served in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry. She was an expert with transmitters who enjoyed drinking as well as writing obscene poetry together with the rebel trooper Hazram Namir during late, dull nights.

Umu was the second son of the Hieroprince, an individual in the religion of the Opaline Creed, a faction on the Outer Rim planet Crucival. By 4 BBY, Umu's name was given to at least seven individuals in the Creed, including Hazram Namir, who went by the name Umu Seven.

An individual served the Galactic Empire as a senior adviser to Emperor Palpatine. Sometime after the Battle of Atollon, the individual was the senior adviser on Mid Rim affairs. The family of Imperial Senior Lieutenant Xoxtin was a close friend of the adviser.

Cimy was a human male from Mokivj who worked maintenance at the factory the Confederacy of Independent Systems took over. During the Clone Wars he, along with his brother Huga and friend LebJau, ran into Padmé Amidala who had crashed onto the planet.
Huga was a human male from the planet Mokivj who was a maintenance worker at Duke Solha's Separatist droid factory.

An individual was the warden at Accresker Jail. Shortly before the attack on a pirate station, he was defrosting a Bor to assist the interrogation officer's failed attempts to break a prisoner known only as Joystick Chevron.
An individual was a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. They assisted an interrogation officer at Accresker Jail, most notably interrogating the female prisoner known as Joystick Chevron.

An interrogation officer served at Accresker Jail. They most notably interrogated the prisoner known as Joystick Chevron with a lieutenant. Being unsuccessful at first, the officer then used a Bor to get to her and she revealed the presence of gundravian hookspores in the jail.
A Chadra-Fan rebel was a member of the Sullustan resistance, a rebel cell that began operations on the planet Sullust during the Galactic Civil War.
Kala Tanto was a Rebel Alliance combat engineer who held the rank of sergeant. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, the engineer bragged about turning an Imperial fortress into rubble.

Sarlee Jax was a female individual associated with the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca. While at the bar Urrett's Marque on the planet Coruscant, Jax provided Solo with information about the Aloo family.
Goldie was a pet tooka owned by Alinka Aloo.

DeBoer was a female individual who worked as an executive officer for the First Order Navy.

Grayla Stindy was an alien who spent time in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in around 34 ABY. Stindy walked past the entrance to the Canto Casino arm-in-arm with an Abednedo companion.

Nandan Roty was a human male officer of the Canto Bight Police Department. In around 34 ABY, he was playing a game of cards in the jail of the Canto Bight police headquarters when he and two of his colleagues were attacked by the astromech droid BB-8.

Barb Mentir was a male Weequay pirate that was part of Hondo Ohnaka's pirate cartel. During a Galactic Republic mission to Florrum, Mentir and Turk Falso conspired against Ohnaka to take the spice meant for ransom for themselves.

Najeema Boddee was a male Gungan from Naboo who moved to Tinnel IV along with his family. During his childhood, he met the human Jothan Tiaan Jerjerrod, and they became best friends. Later he and his family were sent back to their homeworld by Jax Jerjerrod.

Take Flight was a female fathier that mated with the male fathier Doonium Strike, resulting in the birth of the fathier Mynock Minute around 31 ABY. By 34 ABY, Mynock Minute had participated in a fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica.

Kay Karno was a female Pantoran cadet who served in Phoenix Squadron, the starfighter squadron of Phoenix Cell with the callsign of Phoenix Six. During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire, Karno was instructed by Fenn Rau, although she was resistant to his training.

Hado Gwin was a Twi'lek male who spent several years training at the Dette Lawnic Dance Academy with his partner Boshti Anilee. The couple then joined the competitive dancing circuit and won trophies in three sectors.

Fatimah Nurii was a female that served in the Galactic Empire as a Captain and sub-commander. Born on the planet Commenor, she attended the Imperial Navy Academy on Prefsbelt IV, originally aspiring to be a litigator for the Imperial Navy's office of the barrister advocate.
The Executioner was a male Devaronian bounty hunter active during the time of the Galactic Civil War. He had red skin and a scarred face.

Almudin was a human male who served as a commodore in the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, Almudin was part of a military tribunal and oversaw the court martial of Imperial cadet Han Solo, who had disobeyed orders during an attack by raiders on Onyx Squadron, which he was flying in…
Ubbel was an individual who served as the Flight Leader of Onyx Squadron in the Galactic Empire under the callsign Onyx Leader.
Nodlia, born as LebJau was a human male electronics and maintenance factory worker in the Mokivj droid factory led by pro-separatist and former member of the Galactic Republic, Duke Solha on Mokivj.

Dvorad was a Pantoran criminal who operated on the planet Hovun IV. Tobias Beckett and his crew undertook a heist to acquire Dvorad's supply of blank ID chips, during which Dvorad was killed by a creature that attacked his ship.

Jarek Yeager was a human male mechanic who owned a repair shop on the Colossus during the era of the New Republic. A former rebel pilot, commander, and veteran of the Galactic Civil War, Yeager once served with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
In 14 BBY, an Imperial officer served as the commander of the Secutor-class Star Destroyer Conquest, command ship of Vice Admiral Dodd Rancit.
A purple Duros worked as a fight commentator. Between 4 BBY and 1 BBY, the duros commentated on gladiator droid fights at an arena.
