During the Imperial Era, a Shnivvian worked as a gladiator droid fight commentator at an arena. Between 5 BBY and 1 BBY, the Snivvian co-operated with Duros to provide a real-time commentary on a duel between the astromech droid C1-10P and "The Unwinder," a droideka champion i…

Codo Keburr was a male Thisspiasian with a white beard. Sometime during the Imperial Era, he, Killaen Chamat, and Omi Vass searched a temple on Malian for a holocron. Keburr was wounded by a guardian droid.
Killaen Chamat was a male Vurk. At one point, during the Imperial Era, he had a Force vision, leading Codo Keburr and Omi Vass to search a temple on Malian for a holocron.

Omi Vass was a female Tholothian. At one point, during the Imperial Era, she, Killaen Chamat and Codo Keburr searched a temple on Malian for a Sith holocron. Vass used the Force to subdue the guardian droid, and then once inside the temple, drew her red-bladed lightsaber.
The father of Mayvlin Trillick was a male individual.
The mother of Mayvlin Trillick was a female individual.

Neeku Vozo was a male Kadas'sa'Nikto mechanic who served as a member of Team Fireball on the Colossus. He later befriended an undercover Resistance spy, Kazuda Xiono, during his mission on the Colossus to investigate First Order influence.
Z'Vk'Thkrkza, commonly known as Aunt Z, was a female member of the Gilliand species who lived on the ocean planet Castilon during the era of the New Republic.
Fastid Barancul Karambola was a male Crolute who was the owner of Weigh Station Karambola.

Tamara Ryvora, nicknamed "Tam," and later designated DT-533, was a human female mechanic from Kuat who served as a member of Team Fireball on the Colossus, a refueling station in the Outer Rim Territories.

Lyttan Dree, or Cadet 541-145, was a male human who served as a cadet and second-in-command in Onyx Squadron in the Galactic Empire under the callsign Onyx 2. Unlike most cadets, Dree was good friends with fellow cadet Han Solo.

Rigfu Urcolla was a Bufopel male patron of the Canto Casino in the coastal city of Canto Bight on the desert planet Cantonica in the year 34 ABY. During a mission undertaken by Resistance members Finn, Rose Tico, and BB-8, he angrily slammed the table he was gambling at.

This Rodian female was the mother of Tsuulo and Reezo. She was also the wife of Tsuulo's father. She and her husband were killed by a speeder being piloted by an enraged Besalisk who had just lost his job.
Phel Starros was a human male who was the twin brother of the bounty hunter and smuggler Sana Starros.

A human male was an Alderaanian consular security soldier, better known as a fleet trooper. At the end of the Battle of Scarif, he downloaded the Death Star plans onto a datacard and attempted to bring it onto the Tantive IV.
The father of Najeema Boddee was a male Gungan.

The grandmother of Neesha Tor was a female Twi'lek.

Bor Ifriem was a bor of the Mairan species used by the Galactic Empire for interrogations. Around 1 ABY, the bor was used to interrogate Chelli Aphra, an inmate of the wreckage-prison Accresker Jail.

A female individual was the wife of the Gran Garsa. Sometime during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Garsa met with Captain Raymus Antilles, and while Antilles handed Garsa a datapad, he asked Garsa to give their wife his best.

Aksind was a human male stormtrooper who held the rank of sergeant under Commander Kimmund's command during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

This Advanced Recon Force trooper served as a commander early during the Clone Wars. The Clone Commander, along with a fellow lieutenant, was tasked with tracking down Jabba Desilijic Tiure's son, Rotta who was kidnapped by bounty hunters.
A Clone Captain was a human clone trooper officer who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.

A female Sarkan was the great-great-great-grandmother of Queen Zil. At some point before the Galactic Civil War, she freed Zil's great-great grandfather from a tower of the Sarkan palace after he was jailed there by rioters.

A male Sarkan was the great-great-grandfather of Queen Zil. At some point before the Galactic Civil War, he was jailed in the Sarkan palace by rioters, but was later freed by Zil's great-great-great grandmother.

Drav was a human male stormtrooper who held the rank of sergeant in the 1st Legion, the personal legion of the Sith Lord Darth Vader. Serving closely alongside Commander Kimmund's troops, Sergeant Drav fought against the Grysks at Batuu during the era of the Galactic Empire.
Tephan was a human female stormtrooper who served in Darth Vader's First Legion as a member of Commander Kimmund's unit. She acted as a pilot to the unit's transport, the Darkhawk.

Viq was a human stormtrooper who held the rank of sergeant in Darth Vader's First Legion during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The sergeant became involved in the conflict with the Grysks while serving with Commander Kimmund's unit.

Sampa was a human male stormtrooper and member of Commander Kimmund's unit in the First Legion. During the Galactic Empire's rule, Darth Vader's personal legion was deployed to the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories.

Podiry was a human male stormtrooper in Darth Vader's First Legion during the Imperial Era. He served under Commander Kimmund's command in the Galactic Empire's first battle with the Grysks over Batuu.
Jid was a human male stormtrooper who served with Commander Kimmund's unit in the First Legion of the Galactic Empire.
Lucky was a beloved pet of the Kadas'sa'Nikto mechanic Neeku Vozo. Lucky died at some point, after which Vozo ate the pet and found him delicious.

Azool Phantelle was an Ortolan criminal and the brother of the musician Maximilian Rebo. During the reign of the Galactic Empire, Phantelle once swindled several of the inhabitants of the Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

Finwej was a male slicer. Sometime between 32 ABY and 34 ABY, the smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca acquired First Order codes from Finwej in order to steal a data archive from the trader Mek Nu'Tiv, as he was the only slicer they could afford to pay.
Torra Doza was a human female pilot who lived on the Colossus, an aircraft refueling station located on the Mid Rim Territories world of Castilon, during the era of the New Republic.
Murkel Kev was a member of the Zakku Rain Cartel who fought against Lando Calrissian on the planet Kullgroon.
Cantor Zain was a member of the Zakku Rain Cartel. Cantor Zain fought against Lando Calrissian on the planet Kullgroon.
Kawal Tane was a member of the Zakku Rain Cartel. He fought against Lando Calrissian on the planet Kullgroon.
Siswan was a member of the Zakku Rain Cartel. He fought against Lando Calrissian on the planet Kullgroon.
Nokk was a Trandoshan female who worked as a hunter with her husband Winloss. In her clan, Nokk was talented at hunting, and her elders saw promise in her abilities.

Squoxx was a male Rutian Twi'lek hunter who worked for King Prana. He rivaled the hunters Winloss and Nokk. After Chelli Aphra hired him to incapacitate the Shadowfang Beast around 1 ABY, Squoxx secretly aimed to kill it, believing Aphra wanted to own the creature.

Rohr was a commander in the New Republic military who ordered corporal Camerand Argell to publicly escort a garrison of Imperial officers and stormtroopers who were captured on Coruscant to the holding area on Chandrila.
Winloss was a hunter and the husband of Nokk. He also carried an NN-14 blaster pistol.
Chakobi Sanwright was a human male Imperial Army trooper who served as a corporal in the Galactic Empire during the Mimban Campaign as a member of the 224th Imperial Armored Division.

During the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire a female operative served the Alliance to Restore the Republic on Vulpter.
Ro Thran was a Gran who worked as a hunter for hire. At one point, he captured a bull krykna for the Tyn Syndicate.

Pehk was a male Geonosian hunter who was famous for being the first individual to headbutt a gundark. He was one of the hunters hired by Doctor Chelli Aphra to save her from the Shadowfang Beast, which had consumed her during her visit to the temple on the planet X3-299-11 aro…

Lexa Tcheil was a female human Jedi youngling that was part of the Jedi Order's Bear Clan shortly prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
During the Galactic Civil War, a human male ensign served in the Imperial Navy on the Razor-class frigate Kreuge's Revenge.

Alva Brenne was a human female who served in the Galactic Empire as a colonel and Chief Imperial Architect. She was responsible for transforming the Imperial Palace from its former identity as the Jedi Temple of the old Jedi Order.

Roggo was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire. Roggo was assigned to accompany Colonel and Chief Imperial Architect Alva Brenne on her trip to Mustafar. The colonel had been assigned to design a fortress for Darth Vader on the planet.
Brookish Boon was a Sy Myrthian female from Sy Myrth who spent time outside the Galaxies Opera House on the planet Coruscant in 19 BBY.

Graf Zapalo was a human who served as the Master of Sciences in the Naboo Royal Advisory Council during the Fall of the Republic. As a minister of the council, he was responsible for advising the monarch of Naboo and guided public policy on the planet of Naboo.
Guanta was a male Wookiee warrior who lived on the planet Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.

Lufta Shif was a human female who served as the Education Regent of the Naboo Royal Advisory Council during the Fall of the Republic. As a minister she was tasked with advising the monarch of Naboo and guiding public policy throughout Naboo.

Hugo Eckener was a human male who served as Chief Architect in the Naboo Royal Advisory Council during the Fall of the Republic. As a minister, he advised the monarch of Naboo and guided public policy on Naboo.
Cat Miin was a Gossam who served as Presidente Shu Mai's aide during the Separatist Crisis and the subsequent Clone Wars as a member of the Commerce Guild and Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Ko Sai was a Kaminoan who was a chief scientist during the Fall of the Republic. When Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi was given a tour of the Tipoca City Military Complex by Prime Minister Lama Su and Aide Taun We, Sai was supervising a group of clone cadets.
Dznori Xam was a Kallidahin technician who worked on a dig site run by the Archaeological Research Council in the Polis Massa asteroid belt.
Selif Xam was a Kallidahin who worked in the research facility on Polis Massa shortly after the fall of the Galactic Republic and the rise of the Galactic Empire.

Attichitcuk was the father of the Wookiee Chewbacca, who when introducing himself to Han Solo, referred to himself as "Chewbacca, son of Attichitcuk." He and Chewbacca's mother lived in the city of Rwookrrorro on the planet Kashyyyk.

The father of Tivoche Bilure was a Corellian human male who lived on the planet Corellia in a working-class Coronet City neighborhood that never received any attention from the authorities. His family lived in poverty and never had enough credits to buy sufficient food.
Zzzs was a Southern Mustafarian member of Father Kkkt's clan on the planet Mustafar. In 14 BBY, Zzzs and Kkkt saw the arrival of Darth Vader's ship on the planet.
Backed by an army of Mustafarians riding on native lava fleas, Kkkt led an assault on Fortress Vader in 12 BBY.
Dash Rendar was a male smuggler and mercenary who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. During his travels, he encountered the Wookiee Chewbacca and fellow smuggler Han Solo.

Hype Fazon was a Rodian male pilot from Rodia who served with Ace Squadron, a team of highly skilled starfighter pilots tasked with the defense of the Colossus refueling station during the era of the New Republic.
Freya Fenris was a human female pilot who served with Ace Squadron, a team of starship racers that also flew defense for the Colossus platform. Fenris' personal starfighter was the Red Ace.

Griff Halloran was a human male pilot who served with the Ace Squadron during the era of the New Republic. Prior to his time flying defense for the Colossus refueling station, he served as a TIE fighter pilot in the Imperial Navy.
Despite his efforts, however, Major Vonreg was forced to break off his attack and return to Starkiller Base where he reported to Captain Phasma.

Imanuel Doza was a human male captain of the refueling station Colossus during the era of the New Republic, and had prior served as a captain in the Galactic Empire around the time of the Battle of Endor before deserting.

Astrid Fenris was a human female from Yir Tangee who worked as a smuggler during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, Fenris spent time on the planet Vandor where she ran a scam that involved exporting Vandor ice and selling it as valuable R'alla mineral water.

"Midnight" was the nickname of a human male ace fighter pilot of the First Order who flew under the callsign Omega Leader and commanded Omega Squadron, a TIE/fo space superiority fighter squadron that served in the First Order starfighter corps.

"Muse" was the callsign of a human pilot who flew a TIE/fo space superiority fighter for the First Order. She led Epsilon Squadron, a squadron that served in the naval forces of the First Order military.
Tivoche Bilure, also known by the nickname "Midnight," was a Corellian human male. He served as bartender at the Lodge on the planet Vandor in the time of the Galactic Empire.
Tayshin Maxa was a human female who served as a member of the Cloud-Riders during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Lexi, also known as just Lex, was a human female who served as a scrumrat for the White Worms gang on the planet Corellia. In 13 BBY, she snatched a piece of stolen loot from one of the younger scrumrats to give to Lady Proxima, leader of the gang, herself.
Kalit was a Jawa male who was present in the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's palace on the Jawa's homeworld of Tatooine in 4 ABY.
Moda Maxa was a human female who served as a member of the Cloud-Riders during the reign of the Galactic Empire. She was the younger sister of Tayshin Maxa.
Nebit was a Jawa male who served as chief of a tribe of Jawas from the planet Tatooine. The Jawa's combed the planet's deserts in a sandcrawler for lost droids or technology that they could sell.

Grist was a female Ikkrukkian Prime Minister. When Ikkrukk was attacked by the First Order and internal Ikkrukk First Order sympathizers, Grist sent out a distress call, hoping to get the attention of the Resistance.

Baroosh Pawk was a member of the Cloud-Riders during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He hailed from a world that was brutalized by criminal syndicates and joined the Cloud-Riders, a group of pirates led by Enfys Nest whose own worlds had suffered the same.
This female individual was the mother of Chewbacca and the mate of Attichitcuk. She and Attichitcuk lived in the city of Rwookrrorro on the planet Kashyyyk.
Cal Kestis was a Force-sensitive human male who became a Jedi Knight during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Au B'ree was a Devaronian worker at the Fekunda Outpost when it came under the control of Commander Zhou and his stormtrooper squad.

Silvasu Fi was a Namara member of the Cloud-Riders during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, Fi and the other members of the group traveled to the planet Savareen in order to try and take possession of a shipment of coaxium fuel.
Pruno Jant was a human who was a member of the Cloud-Riders rebel gang during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Meorti was a human female that served as an engineer in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. During the assault on the Mako-Ta Space Docks, she repaired C-3PO in the hangar of the Republic, General Jan Dodonna's flagship.
Regineer Teed was a member of the Cloud-Riders during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Robus was a human male slicer who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was killed by a stormtrooper aboard the Executor.
Flix was a male Gozzo who ran the Office of Acquisitions on the Colossus with his partner Orka.
Orka was a male Chadra-Fan who ran the Office of Acquisitions on the Colossus with his partner Flix. Of the pair, it was Orka who took care of negotiations.
Lark and Jonk, nicknamed the twins, was a Danzikan who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Rorna was a female Devaronian mercenary, who worked to Kars Tal-Korla to catch Borgin Kaa and make gain access to the apartment's access panel, which was on the same network as Adelhard's personal access panel.

Ohlos was a human male officer of the Custom House of Cantonica on the spaceport of Canto Bight. After Kedpin Shoklop arrived to the planet Cantonica, where his prize was a two week all expenses paid vacation to Canto Bight, Ohlos stopped Kedpin with encountered problems, the …

Lorala was a human, female police officer on the spaceport of Canto Bight. After Kedpin Shoklop arrived to the planet Cantonica, where his prize was a two week all expenses paid vacation to Canto Bight, Ohlos stopped Kedpin with encountered problems, the first of which that he…
Stinky Qal was crooked contractor who was a friend of Cularin Syndicate assassin Anglang Lehet. Qal drowned decades before 34 ABY.

Altovan was an employee of Canto Casino Hotel. When Kedpin Shoklop found his way to the Canto Casino Hotel, it was Altovan who checked him in. Upon doing so however, Kedpin had realized his luggage had been stolen.

Gven was a male masseur in Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in the city Canto Bight. A tiny individual about the same size of a Wermal's foot, Gven had blue skin and pseudopods that had strength which belied his stature.
Laz Lazzaz was a human male VaporTech quality inspector and the boss of Kedpin Shoklop. A lazy and very cruel man, his uncle was the main inspector.
Alabash was a human male police officer in the Canto Bight Police Department under the command of the cruel and corrupt officer Brawg.

Uk was a female Klatooinian henchwoman of the Old City Boys criminal organization. The organization hired Anglang Lehet to kill a corrupt police officer. But after he refused it, Uk and her team went to hunt him down.

Calla was a human, female from the planet Naboo, who went to Canto Bight as a tourist, but soon lost all her money and, unable to leave, took a job as a hotel receptionist. Later she became the Grammus sister's servant after she lost a gamble against Rhomby Grammus.
Casual Retort, or simply Retort for short, was a fathier that participated in fathier racing at the Canto Casino and Racetrack on the casino planet Cantonica.
Hard Luck was a fathier stallion, owned by Defancio Storsilt, who was injured in a race by Pinrado Jozo. Lula Sooger, a young orphan, took care of the fathier after the accident.
Pinrado Jozo was a male jockey in Canto Bight.
Oble Rumb was a masseur and a colleague of Lexo Sooger at Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in Canto Bight.
Maby Sagedo was an alien masseur and a colleague of Lexo Sooger at Zord's Spa and Bathhouse in Canto Bight.
Garrac was a male antiquarian of Garrac & Sons. He gave what was declared to be a real piece of the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station to Sturg Ganna.
Targalla was a chef at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Minn was a young Devaronian female croupier and a colleague of Kaljach Sonmi at the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Jace Rucklin, later designated DT-798, was a human male racer who lived during the era of the New Republic.
Hffrr was a male Agarian who helped the Graf family escape Imperial captivity on the planet Agaris.
Rooth was a female Yarin visitor to the Canto Casino. She played Zinbiddle with Tezzie and Kaljach Sonmi early in the evening. She had fertilizer factories.
Zefin Tuzo managed a resort casino on Marquinn. After encountering the smuggler Han Solo on Lynos IV, she began working with Vullen Candroon to kill him.
A Mandalorian construction worker used to hit on the pilot Taka Jamoreesa on Strata Seven.
Pyre was a human male who served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Army of the First Order as an officer and Stormtrooper Commander during the era of the New Republic.

Hrchek Kal Fas was a male Saurin droid trader active during the Galactic Civil War. Fas was at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina when local farm boy Luke Skywalker and Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived looking for a pilot to bring them to the planet Alderaan.
Barpa was a Besalisk male veteran who was a good friend of Lando Calrissian.
During the rise of the Galactic Empire, an Imperial ensign was on Corellia.

Poppy Delu was a male Toydarian fortune-teller on Frander's Bay. In 7 ABY, she and her assistant Svindar used the divination technique Vazaveer on Han Solo, unaware that Solo and Lando Calrissian were conning them and stealing the Original Dozen.
Borkus was a male Trandoshan merchant on Batuv who sold fabrics. He sold ameron skin to Lando Calrissian.

Nettic Whain was a male officer who served the Galactic Empire on Carida. By 10 BBY, he had achieved the rank of captain at the Carida Academy, where he served as commanding officer to Sergeant Triosa Broog.

Triosa Broog was a human female officer who served the Galactic Empire on Carida. By 10 BBY, she had achieved the rank of sergeant and was stationed at the Carida Academy, where she served as training officer to Cadet Han Solo.
An Ithorian bartender was working at a cantina in the Bilbousa Bazaar on Nal Hutta during the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Sansizia Chreet was a female human codebreaker who served as a droid trainer at Ralakili's Droid fighting pits at The Lodge on the planet Vandor. She was hired by Ralakili to bypass the safety protocols on droids to turn them into fighting machines.

Fugas Fandita was a male Gotarite who served the Mining Guild as an iridium miner. He was previously condemned to a 12-year sentence in the Spice mines of Kessel, where he saw the deadly and terrifying spider creatures that prowled the depths of the mines.

A Twi'lek female girl was enslaved by Queen Miraj Scintel of Zygerria during the Clone Wars as a waitress. During the mission to Zygerria, she served drinks to Scintel and the slave dealer Lars Quell, who was actually the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker disguised.

Sarkin Enneb was a male alien enslaver who purchased Qi'ra from Lady Proxima on Corellia around 13 BBY, after a failed escape attempt with fellow scrumrat Han. He later sold Qi'ra to Dryden Vos. Enneb was eventually hunted down and killed by Qi'ra.

Hamato Xiono was a human male politician from the planet Hosnian Prime. During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic, he had not served on either side; however, he eventually served as a senator in the New Republic Senate b…
Thom Hudd was a human male thief who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a lieutenant during the Galactic Civil War.

Jamman was a Duros who flew as a rebel pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, Jamman flew with Red Squadron, operating under the callsign Red Three.
Graysom was male Hoopaloo informant for the Rebel Alliance. After his ship was possessed by an unknown entity, he was rescued by Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus.

In 14 BBY, an Imperial officer served as a liaison officer for Moff Wilhuff Tarkin's task force during its ambush of the Carrion Spike. During that incident, the officer was stationed on the force's CC-7700 frigate.
Hemi was a Mon Calamari who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic aboard the MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser Republic, under the command of General Jan Dodonna.

Athex was a human male who served as a spy in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Sometime prior to the Battle of Scarif, Athex led a rebel intelligence mission to the planet Mustafar with the droid K-2SO.

Jak Sivrak was a Troig male who lived during the era of the New Republic. Sivrak served as the announcer of the races that were held on the Colossus refueling platform on the ocean planet of Castilon.
Synara San was a female Mirialan who served as a member of Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang during the era of the New Republic.
Din Djarin, also known as "the Mandalorian," or simply "Mando," was a human male Mandalorian warrior during the era of the New Republic.

Skritt was a Peasle male who was a technician in the crew of Lina Graf. A nervous individual, he was able to roll up into a ball when he was afraid. Along with the rest of Graf's crew, Skritt was aboard the Auric when it was forced to land on Mustafar.

The mother of Forsythia Jin was a female human who at some point served as the queen of Hynestia. After her death, the crown was left in dispute and Jin did all she could to ensure her claim to the throne was the only one.
A Neimoidian envoy was a male Neimoidian involved in the Trade Federation's blockade of Pantora, being stationed on board the Droid Control Ship orbiting the moon along with Sib Canay.

Grox was a male Lasat who led a pirate crew aboard a cruiser during the Galactic Civil War. At one point he lost one of his eyes, which he replaced with a cybernetic eye. Grox's pirate crew regularly sold scavenged goods to the Tech Masters, who paid well for their work.
Sissian was a male Chadra-Fan who worked as a tracker with his grandfather Hardhear during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Freerago, nicknamed Free, was a Gamorrean male and the owner of Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel. He was a friend of the chef Strono Tuggs, who thought Freerago's diner served the best Fritzle Fries in the galaxy.

An individual was a comm officer for the First Order. In 34 ABY, they were stationed at Starkiller Base—the First Order's superweapon built into the planet Ilum—when Major Elrik Vonreg exited hyperspace in his TIE/ba interceptor near the base after being away on a mission.
Nine-Seven Saquanz, or 9-7 Saquanz was a Quarren who served Fyzen Gor's Brotherhood of Wire and Bone on the moon Grava in 7 ABY.

Braket Twelve-Twelve, or Braket 12-12 was a human male, who served Fyzen Gor's Brotherhood of Wire and Bone on the moon Grava in 7 ABY. He had a pale face, that was ratcheted with scars, an empty eye socket and a corruption of stitches and filth where his nose should've been.
Hugh Sion was a human male New Republic Starfighter Corps pilot active in 34 ABY during the Cold War between the militant First Order and the New Republic.

Bolza Grool was a male Klatooinian gorgmonger on the Colossus—a refueling station on the planet Castilon. It was common for Grool to throw racers who had dodged their commitments off the side of the Colossus platform head first.

Grevel was a male Aleena who lived on the Colossus during the era of the New Republic. He was a regular patron of Aunt Z's Tavern. At some point, he cheated on a game of holo-darts against Kazuda Xiono, who did not pay him back.
Mia Gabon was a human pilot who served the New Republic in the Starfighter Corps of the New Republic Defense Force during the Cold War with the First Order.

Vullen Candroon was a male Pau'an gangster who was active during the Imperial Era. Candroon was hired to work with Zefin Tuzo to track down Han Solo and Chewbacca after an incident on Lynos IV. Candroon lured the pair to a resort casino on Marquinn in an attempt to kill them.
Rinetta Gan was the human female Princess of the planet Hynestia and the daughter of Queen Forsythia Jin.
The mother of Zel Gris was a female Lynna and told her daughter stories of how the Breeze Globe, Rain Globe and Solstice Globe saved the planet Livno III.

Jooks was a female Theelin who resided on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon in the later stages of the Cold War between the First Order and the Resistance. She was a regular at Aunt Z's tavern.
Bela Elar was a Twi'lek female pilot with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the war against the Galactic Empire, and flew with Red Squadron.

Oga Garra was the female Blutopian proprietor of Oga's Cantina, a drinking establishment in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu, and was also the local crime boss. Garra was an orphan who was raised by the Hutts.
Forsythia Jin, also known as the "Assassin Queen," was the human female Queen of the planet Hynestia and the mother of Princess Rinetta Gan.
Zel Gris was a female Lynna from the planet Livno III who served as the strategy instructor to Princess Rinetta Gan of Hynestia.

Darth Shaa was a female humanoid Sith Lady with the title of Dark Lord of the Sith. After hearing of a Force-sensitive sculptor named Momin who had been imprisoned by his people, Lady Shaa went to free him, and made him her apprentice.

A male individual was the father of the humanoid Momin. They, along with their partner and child, lived in a home. At some point between around 1100 BBY and 1000 BBY, they encouraged their partner to acquire a rada-cat who became known as Flitta.
Flitta was a female rada-cat that was killed by Darth Momin when he was a child.

Darth Krist-Ov was a Sith Lord featured in one of actress Risha Synata's tragic plays. Performed in the Cirius system for Galactic Republic senators during the Clone Wars fought between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the play featured a humanoid actor…
Peel was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Peel served in the 212th Attack Battalion under Clone Commander Cody and Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Momin's mother was a humanoid female who was the mother of the future Sith Lord Darth Momin.
Bweena was a female Quarren who was present at the Frozen Kova cantina on the planet Hynestia. She played Sabacc with Lando Calrissian and Zel Gris.

Lanzarota Malco was a female human who lived on Savareen in the Pnakotic Coast village on the Pnakotic Coast. Her tongue was removed during a raid of the Crimson Dawn because her village tried to rise up against this criminal syndicate.

Nod was a male Snivvian criminal who lived on the Colossus on Castilon. He was regularly seen with his brother Narb at Aunt Z's Tavern, the Colossus marketplace, or watching the usual races that took place.
Narb was a male Snivvian that lived on the Colossus on Castilon. He worked for the Aleen Grevel in the betting of the races on the Colossus.

Damici Stalado was a human who believed that physical shape was arbitrary. While undergoing deep-tissue regrafting and splice therapy in 10 BBY, she attended a party on board the First Light, the private yacht of the Crimson Dawn crime lord Dryden Vos.
Kragan Gorr was a male Quarren pirate who operated during the New Republic Era. Gorr led the Warbird gang and secretly worked for the First Order.
Hallion Nark was a nervous male Neimoidian who was a spy for Kragan Gorr's pirate gang during the era of the New Republic. Nark was a male Neimoidian with brown eyes and green skin.

Skreek was a Trandoshan male who was a member of Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang during the era of the New Republic. He flew with Gorr and several other pirates during an unsuccessful attack on the Colossus refueling station.
Egdir was a male Ithorian who resided on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon during the era of the New Republic. He had black eyes and light brown skin

Glem was a male Rodian who worked at the loading docks on the Colossus refueling station on the Outer Rim planet of Castilon during the era of the New Republic. During a triple dark storm, he warned Kazuda Xiono of a possible pirate attack.

Zalla, also known as the Emerald Witch, was a female alien individual who was gifted with abnormal powers. Her sister, Queen Bellan of Rendel, imprisoned her due to her powers. Zalla escaped, overrunning the planet with plants and driving Bellan away.

A male Valltii served as lead rider for a group of Valltii riders during the Clone Wars. The Valltii had been an acquaintance of Galen Walton Erso and even had tea with the scientist. Two weeks after that meeting between him and Dr.

Karamu was a Barbadelan pilot who worked alongside the L-1 tactical droid SV-3. He was tricked by Bellan into delivering a statue to Rendel, but his ship crashed and he was captured by Zalla, whose plants caused him to age severely.

Bellan was the queen of Rendel. After becoming queen, she imprisoned her sister Zalla, thinking she would use her powers to overthrow her. Zalla managed to use her powers to escape, overrunning Rendel with plant life.
Bbbl was a Northern Mustafarian who was part of a clan led by Father Kkkt. In 14 BBY, Bbbl was part of a scouting group sent to investigate the crash site of a fiery object on the planet Mustafar.

Sssp was a Northern Mustafarian who lived on Mustafar during the Imperial Era. During that time, Sssp was part of a scouting group sent to investigate a nearby crash site their clan leader, Father Kkkt, was anxious about.
Jitt was a Jawa that lived and served as a Chief Mechanic on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.
Yani was a Gotal resident on the Colossus.
Orthog was an alien male dock worker on the Colossus.
Marcus Speedstar was a human male and the brother of Jarek Yeager. Speedstar was known as one of the most famous racers in the galaxy, and had won the Five Sabers three times.

Lin Gaava was a human female who lived during the era of the New Republic. She worked as a mechanic on Jace Rucklin's team, on the Colossus platform on Castilon. Gaava had red hair, blue eyes, and light skin.
Gorrak Wiles was a male Sullustan who lived during the era of the New Republic. He worked as a mechanic on Jace Rucklin's team at the Colossus on Castilon. He had black eyes and light skin.
Garma was a female Arcona who lived on the Colossus refueling station during the era of the New Republic. She had yellow eyes and blue skin.
The wife of Jarek Yeager was a female human. At some point, she was photographed with her husband and daughter on Batuu.

A human female was the daughter of the racer Jarek Yeager and his wife. The daughter was killed around 20 ABY, along with their mother, in an accident during a racing event in which their father raced alongside his brother, Marcus Speedstar.
Ra-Lee was a female Ewok who lived on the Forest Moon of Endor. Sometime after the year 1 BBY, she was married to Chirpa, chief of the Bright Tree Village.
Opeepit was a Frigosian male who lived on the Colossus refueling station during the era of the New Republic. He was the station's sole janitor.
Makrit was a male Ewok from Endor. He served as the shaman of the tribe that lived in Bright Tree Village, under Chief Buzza, with Logray as his apprentice.

Tooms was a male Hassk pirate who served as a member of Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang during the era of the New Republic. He assisted them during an attack on the Colossus. During the battle, a disturbance occurred over the comm channel and Tooms was put off by the sound.
Bludlow was a male Rodian. While on the Weigh Station Karambola, he and a group of fellow Rodians viciously beat Sardis Ramsin, who was claiming to be a bounty hunter.
Zo Ryda was a Mon Calamari admiral and a good friend of Lando Calrissian.

Daine Jir was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War as an Imperial officer. Jir served under the Sith Lord Darth Vader aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator during the hunt for the stolen Death Star plans in 1 BBY.

Barpotomous Drebble was a male individual who owned the Dancing Goddess idol, an important Godoan spiritual artifact, before it was stolen. When he reported the theft to authorities, he maintained that he acquired the statue legally.
A Coruscanti man was the father of the human Tanivos Exantor Divo, who was born on Level 3215 of the planet Coruscant during the reign of the Galactic Republic.
Frandu, also known as The Rodian, was a male Rodian pilot who served in the New Republic Defense Fleet and the New Republic Pilots Commission.
Tibbs Ospe was the owner of The Lodge on Vandor. He was a scout for the Commerce Guild before he opened his business.

This Mandalorian police captain served in the Mandalorian Guard during the Clone Wars. As a Mandalorian police captain, he was charged with law enforcement duties at the Sundari shipping docks, and was held captive by members of the Shadow Collective during the takeover of Man…
Sev Cataban was a human veteran and a good friend of Lando Calrissian.
Svindar was a male human and an employee of the Toydarian fortune-teller Poppy Delu.
Korrg was a worrt and the pet of the pilot Taka Jamoreesa. Onboard the ZV-9 freighter Vermillion, Korrg served as pest control.

Karasshki was a Wookiee elder, who was a leader of the planet Kashyyyk. In 7 ABY, she hired Han Solo and Lando Calrissian to find a mysterious serial killer the Wookiees knew as "The Long Man" who has been kidnapping and killing young Wookiees.
Twyla was a female Hynestian and a member of the Hynestian Royal Guard who arrested Lando Calrissian for illegally smuggling purple glandis flower juice onto the planet Hynestia.

Yudrish Sedran was a Galactic Republic senator who represented the planet Chalacta in the Galactic Senate. He was investigated by the Coruscant Security Force after accusations were made that he was receiving bribes from the criminal Pyke Syndicate.

Aro N'cookaala was a Gungan security guard at the prison moon Substation Grimdock. He was stationed in Administrative Sector 44-B when Han Solo visited the prison to gather information about Fyzen Gor and the Phylanx Redux Transmitter.

Magernon was a human who served as a sergeant in the Galactic Empire and the head of the Substation Grimdock prison. After the Battle of Jakku he received amnesty and got the prison facility. He hired all of the elite stormtroopers to his facility.
Krynbalt Kyr was the first Grand Zigoth of the planet Utapau over an eon ago.
A Dulok lived on the forest moon of Endor. The Dulok utilized a spear.

A Weequay pirate frequented the Moshi Bar during the Clone Wars. He worked for Hondo Ohnaka's pirate gang. While talking with the Nautolan Fong Do, the Weequay was the first to notice that they were being spied on by the Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano.

Gorben Frak was a male bounty hunter who was hired by the Droid Gotra to get the Phylanx Redux Transmitter. He had a huge head with a tusk-encircled face, a mane of squirming tentacles, and thick fingers.

Batik was an Ithorian bounty hunter and a member of the team of Gorben Frak, who was hired by the Droid Gotra to get the Phylanx Redux Transmitter. The group found it on board the Millennium Falcon, but the Parapa Cartel attacked them.

MuNu was a Zabrak bounty hunter and a member of the team of Gorben Frak who were hired by the Droid Gotra to get the Phylanx Redux Transmitter. They found it aboard the Millennium Falcon but the Parapa Cartel attacked them. MuNu was killed by a member of the Parapa Cartel.

Oenti was a male human cargo Inspector who worked on the Outer Rim planet Batuu in 19 BBY. He worked with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, who shipped supplies through a cantina at Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.
Cli Pastayra was a male Pau'an criminal and a member of the criminal organization Wandering Star on the planet Utapau. By around 17 BBY, he found and smashed Fyzen Gor's droid army and captured him.
Beelnak was a member of Wandering Star criminal organization.
Nova was a female Human assassin active during the Galactic Civil War. Her activities earned her the enmity of the Rebellion.
Venisa Doza was a human female pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance and the Resistance, and the wife of Captain Imanuel Doza and mother of Torra Doza.

Pace Freemaker was a male human mechanic from Corellia who was R0-GR's first master. He was the husband to Lena Freemaker, father of Kordi, Zander and Rowan Freemaker, and paternal grandfather of Moxie Freemaker.

Buggles was a male voorpak owned by Torra Doza, a resident of the Colossus platform on the planet Castilon. He remained close by his owner Torra's side though she normally kept him in her room. Buggles was involved in a few low stake adventures aboard the Colossus.
Criakan was a Southern Mustafarian who lived on Mustafar. He led an attack on the fortress of Darth Vader, but was killed by the Sith Lord.

Renza was a Hutt criminal who was active during the time of the Galactic Republic through to the era of the Galactic Empire. The Hutt was considered to be both humorless and a monster. Rebel Alliance Commander Lina Graf faced and defeated Renza, while the smuggler Jaxxon T.
In 14 BBY, an Imperial technician served as a comm specialist on the Sentinel Base station in the Outer Rim Territories.

affiliation: Hosnian Prime Academy of Law Enforcement
x: Exantor Divo was a human male that served as a police commissioner on Hosnian Prime.
A contact for the Resistance was searched for by Poe Dameron and BB-8. While attempting to locate the contact, they visited the swamp planet Neijaia, but instead encountered the native species.

Kori Ong was a human male native to the swamp planet Neijaia. Between 32 ABY and 34 ABY, they met the pilot Poe Dameron and the droid BB-8 while the boy was undertaking "The Walkabout," their tribe's rite of passage.
Akar Duel was a Duros who lived on Lotho Minor. He created many junk droids from droid parts, forcing them to serve him with the use of restraining bolts.

Blysto Noxton was a human male avant garde holovid artist who in 10 BBY attended a party aboard First Light, the star yacht of Crimson Dawn's leader Dryden Vos while the ship was moored on the planet Vandor.

Andressa Divo was a human female member of the Divo family, daughter of Tanivos Exantor Divo and mother of Exantor Divo. During the Galactic Civil War, she served the Galactic Empire as an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau.
This Mandalorian police captain served in the Mandalorian Guard of the New Mandalorian government during the Clone Wars.
Sedra Hoxin was a constable of the prefect's office of the Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

Isquik Tors was a Quarren male pirate from Lamaredd. In 5 BBY, he was captured by the bounty hunter Boba Fett, who transported him to the planet Coruscant in his starship Slave I and handed him over to the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau.

Jyrom Ottdell was an admiral of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy and Imperial Officer Corps. In 1 BBY, Ottdell was murdered using poisonous zolall extract, causing Agent Andressa Divo to begin an investigation into the group known as the Malkite poisoners.

A skilled Drabatan served as a mechanic on staff at the Resistance base on the Outer Rim planet D'Qar during the Cold War between the New Republic and the First Order. The mechanic was one of many Drabatan keeping the memories of totalitarianism by the Galactic Empire alive.

Eila was a Force-sensitive human female, and the younger sister of Kel. She occasionally saw visions of the future in her dreams. In 34 ABY, she and Kel escaped their homeworld of Tehar after First Order forces led by Kylo Ren massacred their village including their family.

Kel was a human male, the older brother of Eila. In 34 ABY, he and his sister escaped their homeworld of Tehar after First Order forces led by Kylo Ren massacred their village. Kel and Eila fled to the Colossus platform on the planet Castilon.

Zodu Onglo was a Pau'an male criminal with connections to the Wandering Star syndicate. They were arrested on the planet Coruscant in the year 7951 C.R.C. following a botched attempt to sell stolen weapons.

This male Ugnaught worked as a vendor in the marketplace of the Colossus platform on Castilon, selling food. He was generally unpleasant with his customers, refusing to allow them to purchase more than one bowl of his wares. The vendor had a bushy grey beard and a peg leg.

An elderly Muun was present on Scipio when Rush Clovis took over the banking clan and became the leader of the organization. The Muun expressed their gratitude to Clovis for his actions after the formal arrest of the Core Five.
During the Galactic Civil War, a human served as an ensign of the Galactic Empire. They accompanied Darth Vader and an Imperial major to Accresker Jail.

Moxie Freemaker was a female human, the daughter of Zander Freemaker and Becky Smoochenbacher and the niece of Rowan Freemaker and New Republic Senator Kordi Freemaker. She served as a private and mechanic within the Resistance during their war against the First Order.
Bonipa was a female human who served the House of Organa during the era of the Galactic Empire, and was stationed aboard the Tantive IV under Captain Raymus Antilles.

Qensog was a Herglic male contact acquainted with the Nuxan Bodo Linx who resided on Brentaal IV. When Sana Starros took Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker and Han Solo to meet with Bodo, he gave Organa the contact's details.

Markona was a human male who served as the Thane of Clan Markona, an isolated community on the moon of Hubin. He met the rebels Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo, who crash-landed on the moon.
Kanina Nico, designated cadet 803-308, was a human female who served as a cadet for the Galactic Empire at Carida Academy, the Imperial Naval Academy on the planet Carida, alongside Han Solo.

Beilert Valance, also known as Valance the Hunter, was a human male bounty hunter. Born into slavery on Chorin, Valance became a miner like his father. He grew up idealizing the Galactic Empire, which he later left his homeworld to join, under designation Cadet 404-913.
Tamu Dree, designated Cadet 542-146, was a male human who served as a cadet in the Galactic Empire alongside twin brother Lyttan.

This individual was a pirate in Kragan Gorr's pirate gang. This pirate participated in the attack on the independent refueling station known as the Colossus, and uttered a high-pitching, whooping war cry as the Warbirds charged into battle.

A human male border officer was a member of the Milvayne Authority law enforcement agency, working at a spaceport on the planet Milvayne. Around 1 ABY, he asked the rogue archaeologist Chelli Aphra and the assassin droid Triple-Zero for identification and authorization documents.

Gunda Mabin, also known as Gunda the Terrible, Buccaneer of the Blazing Claw, Mabin the Dread, and Captain Long-Tusk, was a female Aqualish pirate queen during the Age of the Empire who led the Blazing Claw.
Gallandro was a male individual who served as the boss of a crew that pulled a heist. He had worked as the Corporate Sector Authority's hired gun.

Prexo was a human male cyberneticist professor who created the auto-surgeon. He mentored Rajam Nuss, who later commended his expertise to Chelli Aphra and 0-0-0. After 0-0-0 killed Nuss, he and Aphra sought out Prexo to remove the proximity bombs inside them.
Jad Bean was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as an Imperial Navy Trooper on board the Death Star II superweapon during its construction in the Endor system.
Junus was a captain of the Galactic Empire who commanded the garrison assigned to Fortress Vader, the personal residence of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader, on the volcanic planet Mustafar.

Platt Okeefe, nicknamed Oakie, was a human female who escaped slavery and became a famous smuggler, freedom fighter, and entrepreneur. Born on Brentaal IV, she lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Okeefe once came in possession of the Smuggler's Guide.
The Lupr'or Ali'ane had a great granddaughter who lived during the First Order-Resistance War. She possessed a necklace that was salvaged from an abandoned Lupr'or starship.
Toonbuck Toora was a female Sy Myrthian senator in the Galactic Senate during the final decades of the Galactic Republic, representing her homeworld of Sy Myrth.

Drell was a male Weequay pirate who was part of the Warbird gang. He was contacted by one of their spies, Synara San when she wished to speak with their leader, Kragan Gorr. San later helped smuggle Drell and fellow pirate Valik onto the Colossus to kidnap Torra Doza.

A male individual was the father of the human Tamara Ryvora. He was a famous racer on the planet Kuat and traveled with his daughter from system to system, competing in races. Her father's occupation inspired Ryvora to leave her homeworld to pursue a racing career.
Snarl was a male Hassk pirate who served as a member of Kragan Gorr's pirate gang during the era of the New Republic.
Leoz was a Nikto pirate in Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang.
Tula Markona was a human female who lived on the isolated moon of Hubin with her father, Thane Markona. She gave a tour of the clan's community to Luke Skywalker and Han Solo.
A female was the wife of Thane Markona, and was a field technician. At some point, she died whilst on a mission and was buried on the moon Hubin in the family plot along with Thane's parents.

Varé Malago was an individual who perished on the desert planet Jakku after standing on the loose end of a TIE bomber's power trunking while its solar panels were still collecting power. Despite the trunking being covered by several centimeters of sand, it set Malago on fire.

Vizam was a Kajain'sa'Nikto male who served as weapons master for the crime lord Jabba the Hutt. Between 8 BBY and 2 BBY, Vizam contacted the criminal Corbus Tyra to let him know that Jabba was offering a million credits for someone to steal an urn containing the ashes of the …

Baskol Yeesrim was a Gran from the planet Malastare who represented the Gran Protectorate in the Galactic Senate of the Republic. Yeesrim was part of the same Malastare delegation with Senator Aks Moe, who represented the Congress of Malastare.
Sadao Emtri was a Zabrak male who served as a colonel in the Imperial Security Bureau during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Oplock was an Esral'sa'Nikto male mechanic who worked as part of the racer Marcus Speedstar's team alongside the astromech droid R4-D12.

Mixie was a rib-cat owned by the con artist Loonoo. One of several rib-cats belonging to Loonoo, Mixie resided in his apartment in the Corellian Sector on Nar Shaddaa and subsisted on rats while their owner was away on long cons.

Th'er was a female individual who was the Priestess of Wood on Bri'n. At some point before the Invasion of Naboo, a conflict arose between her people and the Metal Clan, resulting in the Jedi Order sending Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi to Bri'n to find a peaceful resolution.

Ashes was a rib-cat owned by the con artist Loonoo. One of several rib-cats belonging to Loonoo, Ashes resided in his apartment in the Corellian Sector on Nar Shaddaa and subsisted on rats while their owner was away on long cons.

Molly was a rib-cat owned by the con artist Loonoo. One of several rib-cats belonging to Loonoo, Molly resided in his apartment in the Corellian Sector on Nar Shaddaa and subsisted on rats while their owner was away on long cons.

Smokey was a rib-cat owned by the con artist Loonoo. One of several rib-cats belonging to Loonoo, Smokey resided in his apartment in the Corellian Sector on Nar Shaddaa and subsisted on rats while their owner was away on long cons.

Grish was a rib-cat owned by the con artist Loonoo. One of several rib-cats belonging to Loonoo, Grish resided in his apartment in the Corellian Sector on Nar Shaddaa and subsisted on rats while their owner was away on long cons.
Shen Kanton was a male individual who was the son of D'Lina. He designed the luxury train Exas Jewell.

Rrrn was a Southern Mustafarian who lived on the planet Mustafar during the Imperial Era as a member of a clan led by Father Kkkt. In 14 BBY, Rrrn was part of a scouting party sent to investigate an object that had crashed on the planet.

Doallyn was a Geranite male hunter who served the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. In the year 4 ABY, Doallyn was present in the court room of Jabba's Palace on the planet Tatooine when the rebels Leia Organa and Chewbacca arrived in the palace, with Organa disguised as the b…

Senin Vant was an Utai who served as air commodore of the Utapau Skyforce on the planet Utapau. Vant piloted a Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter and in the year 19 BBY, helped to re-fuel the Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi when he arrived on Ut…

Rin Praji was a male noble of the influential and wealthy House Praji, who won an auction for a Jedi holocron belonging to Cin Drallig. Praji paid several million credits for the holocron, which was sold on the planet Denon.

Namua was a Nautolan male who lived on the Colossus platform in 34 ABY. He sold fruit at the Colossus marketplace. He had an inquisitive personality, and was present for several major events on the station.

Tryphon Leo was a male Volpai who worked as a freelance smuggler during the reign of the Galactic Empire. After ingratiating himself at the castle of the former pirate Queen Maz Kanata, he managed to obtain a book that contained the locations of Kanata's treasure caches.

A vendor sold antiques at the Colossus marketplace on Castilon. When Torra Doza, daughter of platform owner Captain Imanuel Doza, took an interest in an object he was selling at his stall, he attempted to raise the price from five to twenty credits, causing her to lose interest.

A female was the grandmother of Tula Markona. At one point she was a member of the Jedi Order but left after falling in love with a roguish stranger. Eventually they settled on Hubin and had a son whom she taught all she knew.

Grubs was a human from Mokivj who worked maintenance at the factory the Confederacy of Independent Systems took over. During the Clone Wars, Grubs helped to send the messages of Padmé Amidala, who had crashed onto the planet.

Dorstren was a human male stormtrooper who served in the 1st Legion, Darth Vader's personal legion, under Commander Kimmund. During the Imperial Era, Dorstren was involved in the Galactic Empire's dispute with the Grysks, a conflict he ultimately survived.

Elebe was a human male stormtrooper in the First Legion during the rule of the Galactic Empire. During his time with the personal legion of the Sith Lord Darth Vader, Elebe served with Commander Kimmund's troops as they fought against the hostile Grysks in a conflict that he u…
The grandfather of Tula Markona was a male who Tula described as a "roguish stranger". They met a Jedi who fell in love with them, leaving the Jedi Order to settle on Hubin.

Boroklif was a captain who worked for the Separatist Alliance in 19 BBY. Serving aboard the freighter Larkrer, Boroklif and his crew shipped supplies to a secret Separatist factory on the planet Mokivj from a transfer point on the Outer Rim world Batuu.
Palter was a human who worked for the Confederacy of Independent Systems in a droid factory on the planet Mokivj under the Serennian Duke Solha in 19 BBY during the Clone Wars.

Warm Face was a female rib-cat who was found by Skrrll on Nar Shaddaa outside Bammy Decree's Spacebarn on Nar Shaddaa. After attacking Loonoo and stealing the Smuggler's Guide, Skrrll found the small rib-cat rubbing against their boot.

The leader of the Metal Clan was an individual that sought to destroy the trees of Th'er on Bri'n. After negotiations with Th'er and Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn failed, the leader and the forces of the Metal Clan pursued them, but failed to prevent their escape aboard a shuttle.
Brutux was a hushstalker that belonged to Skrrll. The rib-cat Warm Face reminded Skrrll of Brutux.
Beppi was a human from Mokivj who worked maintenance at the factory the Confederacy of Independent Systems took over.
Mundu was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Resistance during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.
Vipke was a human male technician who served the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Clone Wars he served in the the Mokivj droid factory under Duke Solha on Mokivj.

Zek Peiro was a Force-sensitive human who was considered by many to be the best thief for hire on the planet Coruscant. His reputation caught the attention of the Sith Lord Darth Maul, who believed Peiro's thieving skills to be the result of untapped Force abilities.
Tordich Envlo was a near-human male mechanic who served on board an independent freighter during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Gil was a hunter who was hired by Wilhuff Tarkin to hunt the Sith Lord Darth Vader on Chandar's Folly. They were killed as Vader began picking the group off.
Yerga was a human hunter who was hired by Wilhuff Tarkin to help hunt Darth Vader on Chandar's Folly. After Vader began picking the hunters off, Yerga was killed by him.
Reginald Danfillo was a senior terrain trekker, silver leaf, fullbloom cluster, of the League of XenoExplorers.

Vulaada Klam was a young human female who lived in the lower levels of the planet Milvayne during the time of the Galactic Empire. Having lost both of her parents, Klam had only the qaberworm Gurtyl for company, and was forced to live as a scavenger.

Gurtyl was a female qaberworm who was the pet of Vulaada Klam. When Klam and her family were thrown into the undercity of Milvayne, Gurtyl helped Klam survive on her own. Chelli Aphra and 0-0-0 encountered Gurtyl and Klam, who attempted to take the assassin droid for scrap.

Jek-14, or Jek, was a Force-sensitive human who took refuge on the isolated scrapyard planet of Zoh. Using his connection to the Force, he built himself a new life and loyal droid companions, including BL-OX, the EV-series droid N-3RO, and the MSE-6 series repair droid Fixer, …

"Sticky Fingers," also known as Pickpocket 8, was a Rybet thief who was a member of the Razzi Syndicate, led by Latts Razzi. At some point by 10 BBY, Sticky-Fingers stole the Smuggler's Guide from Lando Calrissian after the Esoomian brawler Bumblethunk beat up Calrissian.

The father of Vulaada Klam was a human male. After the Rebellion arrived on their homeworld, Klam's parents took her and their pet qaberworm, Gurtyl, to Milvayne, a planet promoted by Imperial propaganda. However, he had been in a speeder incident in his past.

The mother of Vulaada Klam was a human female. They and their family moved to Milvayne to escape the Rebellion on their homeworld. At the processing center where they had to stay, the family in the tent beside them disliked the smell of their pet qaberworm, Gurtyl.

Tyro Viveca was a hunter who specialized in rare animals. Before traveling on a Ugor starship to Kashyyyk for three days to kill a terentatek, this individual stole Maz Kanata's Smuggler's Guide from Dexter Jettster in the Rasher's Rest cantina on Athus Klee while the Besalisk…
Kablo was an individual who was on the planet Corellia before Han Solo enlisted in the Galactic Empire.

Dezine Krisso was a human female who was one of a class of schoolchildren that was kidnapped whilst on a field trip to Oba Diah and enslaved at the spice mines of Kessel. By 10 BBY, Krisso's hopes of seeing her family again had begun to dwindle.

Sablix Veen was a human female fashion designer and model who in 10 BBY attended a party aboard First Light, the star yacht of Crimson Dawn's leader Dryden Vos while the ship was moored on the planet Vandor. She hoped her appearance at the party would boost her career.

Tregga was a human male Chak-root smuggler from Oslumpex V during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 10 BBY, He was on the ice-covered planet Vandor, where he was present in the saloon known as the Lodge when the human outlaws Han Solo and Lando Calrissian first met over a g…
Dhowar Repareed was a human male who worked as an air traffic controller in a village on the Pnakotic Coast of the planet Savareen.
Kenholdt Ransard was a human male who was the spiritual leader and distillate maker in his home village on the planet Savareen.
Vamasto Maja was a female human who was one of the oldest of those lived in the Pnakotic Coast village on the Pnakotic Coast on Savareen. She was the supervisor of rebuilding of the refining plant.
Domthro Rus was a male journalist for the Undervine during the Galactic Civil War.

Bar the Rotter was a male Duros forger and member of the Church of Infinite Perception who had a drinking problem and lived in the Cellar of Penitence on the planet Florrum. He owned a polished stone that he used for meditation on the church's teachings.
Marnia Un'la'na was a Twi'lek ace pilot who worked as a First Order informant. In 34 ABY, she traveled to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus to participate in the All Aces Battle Royale race.
Blawz was a Dwuni male who was enslaved with his brother Crodit during the reign of the Galactic Empire and served as a miner in the Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel.

Yirpa Garajon was a human who lived on the planet Savareen in a village on the Pnakotic Coast. They had the task of concluding landing rights and trade agreements with all who landed at the Bis Refinery.

Tarubo Bunzo was a Dyplotid, male trade representative of Astantu Distillery of the Ring of Kafrene. He had brought his finest samples to convince Dryden Vos to work with him. Bunzo was present in the First Light when Han Solo met Qi'ra again.
Zara was a princess on the planet Townowi. She had two younger brothers, Oeta and Puck.
Bumblethunk was an Esoomian brawler designated as Prowling Thug 36 in the criminal Razzi Syndicate under crime lord Latts Razzi.
Krastic Tarta, also known as the "Proliferating Horror", was the slavemaster of the Arkanian Dawn.
Carabba was a male pirate captain who lead the Blazing Claw when the Aqualish Gunda Mabin served them as a cabin pup.
This Kowakian monkey-lizard was a back-stabbing and greedy bounty hunter who, sometime after the male Wookiee Chewbacca temporarily escaped enslavement, turned him over to the Galactic Empire.

Meecha Odon was a young female Twi'lek who was a prisoner of Nodo. Odon worked for Nodo and was later freed by Han Solo and Chewbacca. Solo and Chewbacca got Odon several barrels of rhydonium as fuel to get back home.
Luko Oorn was the administrator of the Inyusu Tor mineral processing facility on the volcanic world Sullust.
A human female pilot served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
"Green Leader" was a human male pilot that served in the early rebellion during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
"Green Five" was a human male pilot that served in the early rebellion during the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
An individual served as the commander of a Imperial garrison, the 975th Battalion, that was stationed at an Imperial installation on Eadu in 1 BBY.
Dwoogan was a female chef aboard the Wayward Current. Before she was a chef, she was a pilot for the Galactic Republic.
Tosan was a Zygerrian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic following the Battle of Naboo.

Pjolan was an Ithorian who made deliveries for several criminal syndicates, including Black Sun, the Hutt Clan and the Pyke Syndicate, stealing cargo from all of his jobs. Pjolan was an acquaintance of Han Solo, and occasionally visited Corellia.
Jarwen was a cadet at the Galactic Empire's Carida Academy. During a training exercise, Jarwen's TIE fighter was hit by a cannon, causing it to explode.

Yurib Nakan was a male human flight instructor at the Galactic Empire's Carida Academy. He oversaw the training of TIE fighter pilot cadets, including future Rebel Alliance General Han Solo. During the mission on Qhulosk, Nakan led the fighter wing into battle.

Clatriffe was a female Togruta archaeologist who led an excavation on the Mid Rim planet Dallenor. She discovered a Jedi holocron, and the Jedi Council sent Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to verify and retrieve it.

Hudso Shaku was a Fosh native of Dallenor and the leader of the Krypder Riders on the planet Dallenor. When a Jedi holocron was uncovered on the planet, Shaku and the Krypder Riders wished to steal it.

Redy was a female engineer and Myth Buster. She studied at the University of Coruscant and worked on the most advanced starship in the Imperial ship-yards and even showed a Grand Moff around the yard.
Neelda was a Rodian male bounty hunter. Along with the duo Tiver and Rinn and the esteemed hunter Jango Fett and his son Boba Fett, Neelda was hired to return a runaway Twi'lek to her father.

Rinn was a Gand bounty hunter who worked with the Chadra-Fan Tiver. Along with the Rodian Neelda and the human Jango Fett, the pair was hired to capture a runaway Twi'lek who was trying to flee her father with her lover, Griph.

Tiver was a Chadra-Fan bounty hunter who worked with the Gand Rinn. Along with the Rodian Neelda and the human Jango Fett, the pair was hired to capture a runaway Twi'lek who was trying to flee her father with her lover, Griph.
Johnair was a Dowutin who was present on the planet Corellia by 13 BBY. He agreed to a speeder race against the human scrumrat Han of the White Worms syndicate in order to win 10,000 credits.
Mr. Growly was a Gran male who owned the business Growley's on the planet Corellia at some point by 13 BBY, during the Imperial Era. They eventually hired the human Pace to work on speeders for them.

Bibo was a juvenile male rokkna adopted by Neeku Vozo in 34 ABY. After winding up on the Colossus after being caught inside a wrecked Z-95 Headhunter from the Karavian Trench of Castilon's ocean that was salvaged by Synara San, Vozo was taken with the creature immediately afte…
Griph was a Falleen who fell in love with a Twi'lek female by 23 BBY. The Falleen's lover intended to run away from her father with them.

The uncle of the Falleen Griph was a male individual who had connections to the Black Sun criminal cartel. In 23 BBY, Griph, who wanted to join the Black Sun, was at a cantina on the planet Ord Mantell with their Twi'lek lover.
The father of a Twi'lek hired the bounty hunter Jango Fett to bring her back after she ran away to join the Black Sun with the Falleen Griph.
A Twi'lek female wished to run away from her father and join the Black Sun with her lover Griph. Her father hired the bounty hunters Jango Fett, Neelda, Rinn, and Tiver to return her.

Guattako the Grim was a male warlord on the planet Oosalon during the reign of the Galactic Republic. He was the leader of a Hutt funded army of kidnapped children who he had corrupted into terrorists, and had them kidnap 26 more children for him during the chancellorship of S…

Ne'eda Frip was the female crime lord leader of Ne'eda's Stalwarts and the owner of Neral's moon. As undisputed ruler of the moon, Ne'eda operated from a penthouse at the top of Ne'eda's Tower, the largest gaming palace on the moon, which many high-end clients visited to play …
Snappy was a male porg which resided on the Millennium Falcon. Named by the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, Snappy had a predictable tendency of lunging for fingers which strayed too close.
Kolac Pru was a Kaminoan male who worked as a freelancing scientist on the black market.

Sluncan was a Gigoran who worked as the personal bodyguard of Jayyar Lu-wehs. In addition to accompanying Lu-wehs, Sluncan kept hold of Lu-wehs' valuables as a safety precaution. Sluncan wore a translating vocoder, and he had cream-colored fur and yellow eyes.

The Second Sister, formerly known as Trilla Suduri, was a Force-sensitive human female and a member of the Inquisitorius during the early reign of the Galactic Empire. Prior to the rise of Emperor Palpatine, Suduri held the rank of Jedi Padawan during her time in the Jedi Order.

t: Unidentified New Mandalorian Minister of Finance
x: This Mandalorian female was the Minister of Finance in the New Mandalorian government. Her duties fell to oversee financial matters of the government, and had a seat in the Mandalorian Government Council.
The mother of Bibo was an adult female rokkna. As an adult, she was large enough to be capable of destroying the Colossus platform by herself.
Punter was a male Chadra-Fan who worked on Gunda Mabin's Blazing Claw flagship Bloody Bones. He woke the captain to tell her that the ship was leaking Coaxium due to a leak in the reactor.

Lubo was a Castilon gorg that had brown and green skin and light blue eyes and lived on the planet Castilon. In 34 ABY, the human Kazuda Xiono obtained the gorg aboard the planet's Colossus |station and named him Lubo.

Laan Tik was a Kajain'sa'Nikto member of the Jedi Order who served as a Jedi General of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

Bitey was the pet Castilon gorg of the merchants Flix and Orka, so named because he tended to think people's fingers were food and bite them. The Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono acquired Bitey as food for Flix and Orka. However, the two merchants adopted him as their pet.

Kel Dhast was an agent in the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. During this time, Dhast conducted a surprise inspection reviewing security systems and prisoner cells.
Nel Frel was a Sullustan who was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who served as the captain of the Stellar Crawler, a modified YT-2400 light freighter.

Trey Trellen was a human male who served as a commander in the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Throughout his career in the ISB, Trellen was a well-known officer, and wrote several ISB manuals.

Kav Poen was a male agent of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau stationed on the Ring of Kafrene. Poen caught Rebel Alliance agent Gregor Lojan in the act of spying, and ordered stormtroopers to chase Lojan.
Gregor Lojan was a male Balosar who was a spy in the Rebel Alliance's intelligence branch. During the Galactic Civil War, he was on the Ring of Kafrene where he managed to steal Imperial data.
Yrica Quell was a human female X-wing starfighter pilot who, during the final months of the Galactic Civil War, served in the New Republic Starfighter Corps as leader of Alphabet Squadron.

Teal was a fifteen-year-old girl who traveled aboard the Wayward Current to Canto Bight. She aided the stowaway woman Flux by feeding her rations and helping her escape the ship undetected when it arrived on Canto Bight.
Kluleyeke was a male insectoid Lord who partly owned the Mining complex on The Deep. He had mandibles that made his consonants sound grating while he spoke.
U'rum was a Tectozin captain who worked for Lord Kluleyeke and Lady Eekee in The Deep.
Eekee was a female humanoid Lady who partly owned the Mining complex on The Deep.

Awglk was an ancient Mist-Weaver who, alongside Shareen and Wkk'e, became trapped in an exogorth an eon before the New Republic era. Awglk, alongside their fellow Mist-Weavers, wove themselves in a cocoon to slow down time and survive inside the exogorth.

Wkk'e was an ancient female Mist-Weaver who, alongside Awglk and Shareen, became trapped in an exogorth an eon before the New Republic era. Wkk'e, alongside her fellow Mist-Weavers, wove themselves in a cocoon to slow down time and survive inside the exogorth.
Naldy was a male individual aboard the Wayward Current.
Flux was a female stowaway aboard the Wayward Current on a trip to Canto Bight. She was a believer in the Tide.

Flix's mother was a female who had a home on the celestial body Talivar. In 34 ABY, the Gozzo Flix, his partner the Chadra-Fan Orka, and their pit droid G-LN visited Flix's mother for a day, though Flix expressed disdain about going.

The father of the Gozzo Flix was a male individual. Upon returning to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus after a visit to his mother in 34 ABY, Flix claimed to his business partner, Orka, that his father was part-Gungan.

Teroj Kee was a Keteerian male who worked as a First Order operative. For several years, he pretended to work for the Mining Guild while trying to steal from the Office of Acquisitions on the supertanker fuel depot Colossus, but was thwarted by the store's owners, Flix and Orka.

Terrib Igmusk was a Keteerian who worked as a hotel concierge for Canto Casino and Racetrack on the planet Cantonica. In 34 ABY, Igmusk was present in the casino while Resistance agents Finn and Rose Tico searched for the Master Codebreaker there.

Fiddich, also known as Patchwork Fiddich, was a male pirate who served under Captains Carabba and Gunda Mabin as part of the Blazing Claws. He attempted to lead a mutiny against Mabin during her search for Maz Kanata's treasures but was killed by her quickfire.

A Devaronian male bail bondsman operated a bail bonds office in the lower levels of Coruscant's Galactic City. He offered jobs to bounty hunters during the Clone Wars. Asajj Ventress accepted the bounty posting on the fugitive Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, from the bail bondsman.

The spice dealer Tach Drud ran a spice den out of a curio shop on Level 3321 of the planet Coruscant. The Coruscant Security Force was led to Drud's den after they captured and interrogated a spice-addled holo-star who cooperated in exchange for keeping their name out of the h…

Puffy was a male porg that lived on the Millennium Falcon after the Battle of Crait. Puffy was named by the Weequay pirate, Hondo Ohnaka after his fondness of blue puff cubes. Hondo used the snacks to train the porg into releasing the pirate from a cell.

Tarados Gon was a Force-sensitive Klatooinian who served as a Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order. In 22 BBY, Gon was part of the assault team led by Jedi Master Mace Windu that traveled to the planet Geonosis to save Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi from execution by the Confederacy of I…

Loonoo, also known as Honest Loonoo, was a criminal fixer and con artist who lived on Nar Shaddaa. He worked as second in command to Gallandro. He assisted in the theft of the Codeleach from the Varcinius Repository, but abandoned his former crew shortly after.

Tuska was a male Mon Calamari who worked with Tobias Beckett and his gang to steal from a conveyex on Cato Neimoidia. He was tasked with climbing the Bride's Talon and checking to see if there were any escorts for the conveyex.
A massive female fyrnock lived on the planetoid PM-1203 located in the Anaxes asteroid belt as the leader of her pack.

Fel Trech was a Force-sensitive human male who was stranded on the planet Dathomir during the Age of the Empire after surviving a crash landing. Trech was the only survivor of the crash, and as such, became mentally ill with survivor's guilt.
Randus Codille was a human who served as an officer in the Canto Bight Police Department. In the C.R.C. year 8010, Officer Codille visited a crime scene and investigated a disabled valet droid.
Heethra Fansoff was an individual who served as the commissioner of the Canto Bight Police Department by the C.R.C. year 8010.

This male Nikto was a criminal who was active during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, he drove a speeder for the bounty hunter Cad Bane and his group, helping to capture the protocol droid C-3PO and the astromech droid R2-D2 before returning them after Bane extracted information fro…

Quia was a female humanoid alien soldier whom Warlord Guattako recruited into his army at a young age. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, Guattako slaughtered several teachers and kidnapped their respective twenty-six students as recruits.
Valik was a female Palliduvan pirate who was a member of Kragan Gorr's Warbird gang.

A male individual was the father of the Mirialan pirate Synara San. When Synara was questioned by Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono about her skills with a blaster, she claimed that her father taught her how to shoot while hunting on the Outer Rim planet of Vanqor when she was a child.
Vic was a human male who resided on the Colossus refueling station on Castilon during the Cold War between the Resistance and the First Order.

Shareen was an ancient human female Mist-Weaver who, alongside Awglk and Wkk'e, became trapped in an exogorth an eon before the New Republic era. Shareen, alongside her fellow Mist-Weavers, wove themselves in a cocoon to slow down time and survive inside the exogorth.

A male cyborg Rodian slave worked at the Crimson Dawn ore hub on Athus Klee. He was rescued from the mines by Dexter Jettster, who planned on reporting the operation to the Senate Council of Labor Abuses on Coruscant.

Rael Averross, a Force-sensitive human male, was a Jedi and the Lord Regent of Pijal during the era of the Galactic Republic. Trained by Jedi Master Dooku, Averross took a less strict approach to the ways of the Jedi Order.

M'lindi was a human who lived on Milvayne. They overwatched propaganda shown by the Galactic Empire, much to the disliking of their partner. When they told M'lindi to change the channel, M'lindi found a frequency showing a live feed from the eyes of the assassin droid 0-0-0.
This clone navigation officer served as a Clone Captain in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
This clone navigation officer served as a Clone Commander in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
This stormtrooper served as a commander in the First Order's Stormtrooper Corps during the Cold War.

Rolt was a Gotal male who lived on the Colossus, and a regular of Aunt Z's tavern. When the First Order occupied the Colossus, Rolt was initially happy with their presence, but was later arrested and taken away by several stormtroopers for loitering past curfew.
This clone navigation officer served as a Clone Commander in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

This clone pilot served as a Clone Captain in the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance. The clone pilot served in the Republic Navy and piloted a Consular-class cruiser.
A clone sergeant was a male clone trooper who served in the Galactic Republic as a sergeant during the pan-galactic Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance.

Jak'zin was a Togorian Jedi who served the Jedi Order. By 42 BBY, while a Jedi Initiate on the planet Coruscant, he was friends with fellow initiates Gheyr and Krrsish, a Trandoshan and a Wookiee respectively. At the Jedi Temple, he met Jedi Masters Yoda and Dooku.

Kap Klyp was a Sullustan who acted as a representative of the SoroSuub Corporation. Klyp met with Count Dooku on Sullust, giving him a tour of the city, during which Dooku was recognized by the Jedi Knight Jak'zin.
CS-515 was a human male stormtrooper sent to the Colossus platform when the First Order began to occupy it. He was knocked unconscious by the child refugees Eila and Kel.

CS-812 was a human stormtrooper who served the First Order during the waning months of the New Republic Era. A member of CS-Squad, CS-812 held the rank of sergeant by the time of their deployment to the Colossus platform, located on the planet Castilon, in the year 34 ABY.

398 was a human stormtrooper who served in the First Order. They were one of the many troopers stationed on the Colossus refueling station, and accompanied Sergeant CS-812 to chase down CS-515, who Commander Pyre believed to have erratic programming.
