The grandfather of the human mechanic Tamara Ryvora was a male individual who worked in an Imperial weapons factory. In 34 ABY, Ryvora told the Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono and the mechanic Jarek Yeager about her grandfather's occupation and how it had assisted her family.

Poli Dapatian was a Force-sensitive human who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. In the Republic Era, he served on the Jedi High Council and trained a Padawan. Dapatian continued to serve on the Council for several years, garnering renown and respect from his colleagues.

Kirames Kaj was a Togruta female politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic in 40 BBY. Around this time Qui-Gon Jinn was offered a seat to replace the retiring Jedi Master Poli Dapatian on the Jedi High Council.

A Padawan of the Jedi Order was a Force-sensitive individual who lived during the Republic Era. At some point by 68 BBY, the Jedi trainee resided in the Order's crèche on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant as a youngling, alongside fellow Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn.
Endicott was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

M'Kae was a human who served as a communications officer in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War against the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was stationed on board the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Avenger and served in the crew pit on the starship's bridge.

An individual served as the commander of the Batonn insurgents Scrim Island stronghold. They initially defeated the Galactic Empire's attacking One Oh Third Task Force with smart utilization of the island's energy shield and ion cannons, but was later forced to surrender by th…

Diva Funquita was a Theelin female who worked as an assistant to the Hutt criminal Gardulla Besadii the Elder. She accompanied Gardulla to view the Boonta Eve Classic podrace on the planet Tatooine in 32 BBY.

Bewil was a human who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire during its war against the Rebel Alliance. In 3 ABY, he was part of the forces serving under Sith Lord Darth Vader that occupied Cloud City over the planet Bespin in order to capture the Jedi trainee Luke Skywalker.

Akko was a human male smuggler who led a small gang. He worked with Han Solo and Chewbacca in a scam on Garel, and later encountered them on Balnab shortly after Solo assisted the Rebel Alliance with the Cyrkon Extraction.
This alien was a member of a mouthless species and a resident of the Colossus. He wore a special suit which fed him nutrients. He was often seen resting at Aunt Z's Tavern.
Chl'parr was a Chelidae maintenance worker on the Colossus platform on Castilon.

Vil'pak was a Chelidae who worked in maintenance on the Colossus on Castilon. Vil'pak was responsible for catching Kel and Eila as they jumped out of the Colossus Engineering Level to evade Pyre and his stormtroopers.
Tierny was a human female who served as an agent in the First Order Security Bureau during the conflict between the First Order and the Resistance.
Okma was a human who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's Coalition for Progress division. During the Galactic Civil War, he served aboard the IGV-55 surveillance vessel Enduring Pride.

A Grand Vygoth of the Wandering Star was a male Pau'an who held the title for a long period of time. Around 231 BBY, during the High Republic Era, an undercover Pau'an agent of the Galactic Republic posed as a member of Wandering Star and met with the Tarnab criminal Arathab F…
Ormeddon was an individual who served as a Grand General in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

Ellé, originally named Elleen, was a human female who served as an aide to Governor of Naboo Sio Bibble. During the early stages of the Clone Wars, she became one of Senator Padmé Amidala's handmaidens, upon which she changed her name.

Versé, formerly known as Versaat, was a human female who was the niece of Mariek Panaka, a captain in the Royal Naboo Security Forces and the wife of Captain Quarsh Panaka. Versé was recommended by Panaka to join Senator Padmé Amidala's new cohort of Handmaidens.
Neriston was a Siniteen male slicer. He was part of the Gullet Gang in the Terrabe sector. He was later employed by Gallandro for the Varcinius Repository vault job.

Thinner Prokov was a criminal hired by Gallandro to participate in the Varcinius Repository vault job. Their job was to put rumors out on the communication networks that there was a large criminal market for artisanal gasses.
Zabaka was a female Toydarian who ran Toydarian Toymaker toyshop in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu.
Bina was a female Amani from Utapau who ran the Creature Stall in Black Spire Outpost, which she filled with creatures that she collected from around the galaxy and brought to Batuu.

Savi was a human male who was the owner of Savi's Workshop, where the Gatherers guided Force-sensitives in lightsaber construction and an associate of Lor San Tekka. Savi disguised the establishment as a salvage store to hide it from the First Order.
Mubo was a male Utai and the proprietor of the Droid Depot, a droid construction store in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

Kat Saka was a fourth-generation Batuuan human who operated Kat Saka's Kettle in Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. Like others in her family, Kat was a farmer and grew Surabat grain on her farms.

Mariek Panaka was a female human who served as a high-ranking officer in the diplomatic wing of the Royal Naboo Security Forces. She was the wife of Captain Quarsh Panaka, who served as captain of the guard for Queen Padmé Amidala.

Réillata was a human female from Naboo. Born around 51 BBY, she twice served as the monarch of her people, the Naboo. The first time was a two-year term in around 36 BBY, when Padmé Amidala—a future queen of Naboo herself—was still a young girl.
A human female was the niece and handmaiden of Queen Réillata. In 28 BBY, she attended Réillata's second coronation at the Theed Royal Palace, and as her aunt descended a set of stairs, she followed.

Lis Mohles was a Frenk assassin who was wanted by the Galactic Republic. When Confederacy of Independent Systems spies on Clabron discovered that Grand Minister Stin planned to side with the Republic in the Clone Wars, they sent Mohles to assassinate him.

Stin was a Clabronian that served as the Grand Minister of Clabron. After he decided to side with the Galactic Republic in the Clone Wars, organizing a meeting with Senator Padmé Amidala, he was killed by Lis Mohles, an assassin working for the Confederacy of Independent Syste…

Tarmin was a Clabronian who held the position of Second Minister on Clabron. After Grand Minister Stin was assassinated by the Separatists when he showed desire to ally with the Galactic Republic in the Clone Wars, Tarmin took his place, and was convinced by Senator Padmé Amid…

The Ender was a massive creature that lived on Cianap. She destroyed the civilization of the native species, forcing them to live a primitive life underground. After Darth Vader landed on the planet during a nearby battle, he awoke the Ender, and killed her after a long fight.
Mira was an inhabitant of the planet Cianap. After Darth Vader killed the Ender, Mira heard that another native witnessed the fight.
Oshadam was a senator who represented the planet Naboo and the Chommell sector in the Galactic Senate.
Caelor Gaans was a male humanoid who represented Bromlarch in the Galactic Senate. After seismic activity damaged the planet's aqueduct system, Gaans went to the Galactic Senate for help.
Kooib-s Guvar was a humanoid female holojournalist for a prestigious newsnet on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. Aside from her main job, she also wrote for a tabloid to earn extra credits.

Kelma was a female individual born around 54 BBY who served as the governor of Karlinus. After the Trade Federation blockaded Naboo, she sent an agricultural transport to deliver grain to the planet, but the ship was diverted to Enarc.
Tonra was a human male who served as a sergeant, and later a captain, in the Royal Naboo Security Forces. He fought during the Trade Federation's Invasion of Naboo.

Daneska Varbarós was a human female pilot in the Royal Naboo Security Forces, and the successor to Ric Olié. She served Senator Padmé Amidala, former queen of Naboo, during her time in the Galactic Senate.

A Targappian female served as the senator of Targappia in the Galactic Senate. After hearing negative news stories regarding Senator Padmé Amidala of Naboo, the Targappian met her at a gathering for new senators, speaking to her with disdain.

A human male served as a senator in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate, representing the Urce sector. In 28 BBY, they argued against the Ithorians' motion to make a map of a hyperspace route running through the Lesser Plooriod Cluster public.
An Ithorian hailed from the planet Ithor and lived during the Republic Era. By 28 BBY, they represented their homeworld in the Galactic Republic's Galactic Senate.
Eema was the chief councillor of Bromlarch's council.

Ninui was a liaison to Councilor Eema of the Bromlarch Council. When several Republic senators, including Padmé Amidala, Mina Bonteri and Rush Clovis, visited Bromlarch to view the damage caused to its aqueduct system, Ninui assisted them.
Corin was a male guard in the Royal Naboo Security Forces, serving Senator Padmé Amidala under Captain Mariek Panaka and Sergeant Gregar Typho.

Bakkar, nicknamed "the Butcher," was a human who owned the restaurant Ronto Roasters in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu. A big fan of podracing, Bakkar originally hailed from the planet Tatooine and came from a family that worked as butchers for four generations.

Jayyar Lu-wehs was a male human, and the son of a weapons merchant. He often visited Dhandu 3, always traveling with his Gigoran bodyguard Sluncan. Luh-wehs owned a deposit box in the Undervaults of Gwongdeen, keeping the key with his bodyguard.
Lorana was the female human owner of The Labyrinth, a cantina on Kelada.

Makkeer was an Azumel pirate who was a member of the gang led by Captain Gwarm. When Gwarm wished to search for the supposed lost treasure of the pirate queen Rane Mahal, his crew pretended to chase Makkeer into The Labyrinth on Kelada.

Rane Mahal was a female pirate referred to as a pirate queen. At some point, Mahal and her crew became stranded on Sakreen, so she sent out several NP-unit servo-droids, tricking others into believing that one held the location of Mahal's lost treasure.

Mahjo Reeloo was a human female and self-proclaimed scoundrel. Originally one of two clones created to serve the rogue Kaminoan scientist Kolac Pru, she came to regret doing so and left, while her fellow clone continued to assist Pru in her absence.
"Evil Mahjo" was the nickname of a clone of Mahjo Reeloo, created by the Kaminoan Kolac Pru. She assisted Pru after the original Mahjo regretted her actions and left.

Trunc Adurmush was a male Pakiphantos criminal who led a gang that consisted of other members of his species. He encountered Han Solo, Chewbacca, Hondo Ohnaka, and Mahjo Reeloo on Dhandu 3, and later on Gwongdeen.

Tjepo Juibop was a male Delphidian who led the Hackjackers, a crew of starship thieves that operated near Maz Kanata's castle on Takodana. He kidnapped Han Solo and Chewbacca, stealing their ship, the Millennium Falcon, which he intended to break down for parts.
Ruk was a male Keredian who was a member of the Tech Masters. The Tech Masters ruled over the planet Trionak, keeping it a secret for centuries.

CS-227 was a First Order stormtrooper stationed on the Colossus platform on Castilon shortly before the Hosnian Cataclysm. He and two other stormtroopers were on duty in the station's control room after it had recently been sunk by Resistance personnel.
Mirack was a male Nephran who was part of a pirate crew led by Grox.

A female individual was the great-grandmother of the Naboo human female Dorra. By 28 BBY, she had taught her great-granddaughter how to carve. That year, Dorra began serving as a handmaiden to Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala and took on the name Dormé.

This human female was the mother of Tsabin, who later took the name Sabé after she became a handmaiden of Queen Padmé Amidala. By the time Amidala served as Naboo's senator four years later, Sabé noted that her parents no longer called her Tsabin.

This human male from Alderaan was the father of Breha Organa. When Organa's mother was pregnant, her father stayed onworld during the entire pregnancy and for several months after she had given birth.
Rito was a Ghular slave on Qhulosk. Rito and several other Ghulars encountered Han Solo and his fellow cadets in Carida Squadron during the mission on Qhulosk, saving them from several Qhuloskians.
A Force-sensitive Mikkian served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

During the chase, the Falcon hid in the Hoth asteroid field and then escaped Imperial sensors by landing on the command tower of the Avenger. After the Star Destroyer's captain, Lorth Needa, ordered the Falcon be tracked, Nemet informed him that the vessel had vanished.
A Stormtrooper Commander holding the rank of corporal served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.
This stormtrooper served within the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps.
Xoddam Lothipp was an individual who served as the Deputy Director of the Graf Archive during its restoration effort.
The father of Jayyar Lu-wehs was a human male who worked as a weapons merchant.
"Mustache Guy" was a human male who got shot while TD-H4 was selling a data cube.

Xersko was a male bounty hunter. On Hynestia, Xersko was hired by Queen Forsythia Jin to track down Zel Gris, locating her in the Frozen Kova cantina. After the queen and her Hynestian Royal Guard arrived in the cantina, Xersko departed.

Jeskian Veldar was a female bounty hunter who worked for various criminal cartels. Lando Calrissian owed Veldar money, and she followed him to Neral's moon to get it back. Calrissian managed to escape with the help of Rinetta Gan.
Zim Azul was a Lynna male who led the people of Livno III. He was present when the Solstice Globe was returned to Livno III by Lando Calrissian, Rinetta Gan and Zel Gris.

Wyllys was a male Hynestian who was a member of the Hynestian Royal Guard. Forsythia Jin, Queen of Hynestia, assigned Wyllys to guard Rinetta Gan, but the princess was able to trick him and escape to Livno III with Lando Calrissian, L3-37 and Zel Gris.
The Gran Kovali was the oldest kova on Hynestia. The death sentence for criminals on Hynestia was being fed to the Gran Kovali.

Harido Kavila was a Rodian who created works of Rodian Theater. The Anomid Jedi Council member Alxa Kress was fond of Rodian theater and taught Jedi Master Mace Windu how to perform Kavila's works in the Rodian tongue.

Alxa Kress was a male Anomid Jedi Master who at one point served in the High Council of the Jedi Order. He had a fondness for Rodian Theater, and even taught Mace Windu how to perform the works of Harido Kavila in the native Rodese.

Bant Eerin was a female Mon Calamari Jedi Master who served in the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. She was one of Obi-Wan Kenobi's oldest friends at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. She was involved in a test for Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker.
Grynask Sanberge was an Anomid male who led the Nova Crime Syndicate. As part of a test for Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu posed as Sanberge.
Jaspara was a male Ryn with white hair and gray skin who was the Baron Administrator of the space station known as the Wheel during the Republic Era.

Triss Terasu was a male Ortolan informant who worked in the Cosmo Lounge cantina on the Wheel. Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker paid him credits in exchange for information on the location of Grynask Sanberge.

Or-Tar was a male human who served as an ore-duke of Shu-Torun, holding the title of lord. As part of a mission to take down Shu-Torun as an economic strike against the Galactic Empire, Leia Organa and her team kidnapped Or-Tar, who was impersonated by the Clawdite shapeshifte…
A Lepi attended a shockball match at Ashton Stadium aboard the Wheel on the day that the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan Anakin Skywalker came to investigate Grynask Sanberge.
After the rebels were escorted outside, an army of native Ewoks attacked the Imperial forces at the bunker, causing the structure's doors to be sealed close.

Tylux was a human male who served as the commander of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Bellicose. He failed to capture a spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and feared Darth Vader learning the truth, having previously witnessed him Force choke several Imperial Navy …
Pitina Mar-Mas Voor was a human female born in 44 BBY. Her family married her off to a senator when she was eighteen but she was able to later orchestrate his suicide and inherited his position.

A male human spy served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He and the protocol droid Exo escaped the Star Destroyer Bellicose of Commander Tylux with stolen plans to an Imperial factory.

A Rodian lived during the Republic Era. In 28 BBY, the Rodian was present in the nightclub Caraveg on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant when the Naboo man Captain Tonra and former Naboo Royal Handmaiden Sabé visited the club to meet with Galactic Republic Senator Padmé Amidala.

Izal Garsea, also known as Izzy, was a female individual who lived with her parents on the Outer Rim planet Batuu during the New Republic Era. When she was five years old, her family decided to leave the planet abruptly.

Julen Rakab, also known as Jules, was a human male who lived on the Outer Rim planet Batuu. During his childhood, he was best friends with a girl named Izal Garsea, until one day when he was six years old, Izzy and her family left Batuu abruptly.

Chazzar was an individual who served as a captain in Phoenix Squadron. Flying an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor, she led the squadron, including Mandalorian Protector Fenn Rau and Cadet Kay Karno, in combat against Imperial TIE fighters.
A male individual was a scientist who accidentally created the Triple-Zero protocol personality matrix.

Lene Kostana was a Force-sensitive Altiri female Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order prior to the Invasion of Naboo. Her mission for the Order involved finding and studying ancient Sith relics, in preparation for their eventual return.
Polnichk was a male soldier who served as a Corporal in the New Republic Special Forces. He, along with several others were selected to rescue New Republic pilot Captain Wedge Antilles from Akiva.
Wioslea was a female Vuvrian who was a terrestrial vehicle sales merchant. Like others of her species, she had a large head with dual tentacles and eyes in multiple shapes and colors.
Bendoh was a Force-sensitive human that Jedi Padawan Luke Skywalker came across when leading Imperial drones away from a rebel refueling station.

Mrs. Nereno was the wife of Rodian rebel nurse Able Nereno. During the Battle of Endor, Nereno served aboard the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Redemption and whilst he was treating a patient, one of the ship's oxygen converters exploded near his post.

Rendal Panzoro was an Atterran human male who served as a pilot in the Firestone Islands Guards on the planet Atterra Bravo. He was the father of Reeve Panzoro and the son of Casca Panzoro. Rendal was killed by the First Order after they blockaded the Atterra system.
This male individual was the son of Lady Comali, and served as a guard for Queen Trios of Shu-Torun. At some point, he died protecting Trios.

Comali was a human female who held the title of Lady on Shu-Torun. Her son was a guard for the planet's monarch, Queen Trios, but was killed, with Trios claiming he had died protecting her from terrorists.

A human male served as the Grand Marshal to Queen Trios of Shu-Torun. When the planet's security systems were locked down by a team of rebels led by Leia Organa, Trios demanded that the Grand Marshal explain what was happening.

Shenda Mol was a notorious Falleen bounty hunter and assassin. She collected her bounties by sabotaging passenger ships, detonating explosives in public areas, or even by releasing a virus on one occasion.

Endo Frant was a human male who hailed from the planet Alderaan born at least twenty years after 64 BBY. Frant moved to Coruscant for his education, eventually serving in the Galactic Empire as a gunner on board the Death Star.
Ellias Gorlin was the director of the Buckell Center in Coronet City on Corellia.

Jeela Brebtin was a human female who served as a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire. As a lieutenant, she served in Dark Squadron as Dark Two, under the command of Dark One Beilert Valance, between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.
Zin Graw was a human female TIE fighter pilot who served as a Flight Officer in Squadron Five of the elite 204th Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire.

Ganem Kahi was a human male TIE fighter pilot who served as a Flight Officer in the Galactic Empire's Squadron Five of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. He came from five generations of pilots who had served the Galactic Republic.
Teso Broosh was a human male TIE fighter pilot who held the rank of Second Lieutenant Commander in the Squadron Five within the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire.

Jannah, formerly known as TZ-1719, and also known as "Boss," was a human female and former First Order stormtrooper. As a stormtrooper, her first mission, under Captain Shikra, turned into the Merchant Uprising, where Jannah was forced to kill civilians on Brel.

Klaud was a Trodatome male mechanic who worked during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. Hapless and helpful, Klaud was initially brought into the Resistance by mistake, but he happily began assisting with their mechanical needs.

Gable Karius was a human male who served the Galactic Empire as an officer of the Imperial Navy, holding the rank of admiral. A cyborg, Karius had both his right arm and the left half of his face replaced with cybernetics.
Cere Junda was a Force-sensitive human female Jedi Master who mentored Padawan Cal Kestis in the ways of the Force during the rise of the Galactic Empire.
Prauf was an Abednedo male who worked as a starship engineer on the planet Bracca in the years before the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Carasynthia "Cara" Dune was a human female Alderaanian who was a seasoned warrior and a marshal of the New Republic.

Greef Karga was a human male and former disgraced magistrate before becoming an agent of the Bounty Hunters' Guild and Guild Master of the Nevarro Hunters following the collapse of the Galactic Empire.
Gideon was a human male warlord that led a remnant of the Galactic Empire during the early era of the New Republic and was known for his role in the Great Purge of Mandalore.

Penn Pershing was a human male doctor and clone engineer affiliated with a remnant of the Galactic Empire during the New Republic Era. By 9 ABY, Pershing and "the Client" placed a bounty on Grogu in hopes of acquiring him.

Hennet Kayn was a Gotal who spent time on the planet Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. In the year 1 BBY, Kayn was in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the Mos Eisley spaceport when the bounty hunter Greedo confronted the smuggler Han Solo in one of the establishment's booths.
Rafa Martez was a human female who, along with her younger sister Trace, lived on Level 1313 on the planet Coruscant during the waning days of the Galactic Republic.
Trace Martez was a human female pilot, mechanic and smuggler from the planet Coruscant who lived during the final days of the Galactic Republic and the early Imperial Era.

affiliation: Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research
x: Brierly Ronan was a male individual who served as a colonel and the assistant director in the Galactic Empire under the Imperial Military Department of Advanced Weapons Research.

Wanbo was a Hutt that led the Hutt Cartel on Teth in 40 BBY. He operated out of a palace. Known for his stupidity and heavy spice habit, Wanbo acquired his position due to nepotism, and it was well-known that his human majordomo, Thurible, was truly in charge on Teth.

Thurible was a male human who lived on the jungle planet Teth. He served as majordomo for Wanbo the Hutt, whom he handled all of the day-to-day operations of his master's palace for. Thurible was seen as the real power on Teth due to Wanbo's stupidity and large spice habit.

Pax Maripher was a human male involved with illegal gemstone trading with his partner Rahara Wick. Maripher survived an attack by Delphidian pirates when he was only five years old by hiding in an equipment hatch, but everyone else onboard, including his parents, were killed.
Darth Wrend was a legendary Sith Lord who fought against the Jedi Order and was believed dead, only to return and fight them once again.

Ameé was a female individual who was born on the Mid Rim planet Naboo around 54 BBY. In 40 BBY, they began serving as the Queen of Naboo for the Royal House of Naboo after their predecessor, Queen Ekay, left the position.

Rahara Wick was a human female who worked as a jewel thief with Pax Maripher. She was born into slavery for the Czerka Corporation on Hosnian Prime, but later escaped on Ord Mantell. While on the moon of Pijal, the two thieves encountered the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi.

Elio was a Jedi Master who served as a member of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Around 68 BBY, the Master was sent to the world Shurrupak to assist in a battle and traveled there in a shuttle alongside fellow Jedi Master Dooku and his Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn.

Halin Azucca was a human female who led the Opposition, a performance art troupe on the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal. Azucca and the performers' aim was to inform the Pijali of the problems facing Pijal through political art.
Meritt Col was a human female who served as a Sector Supervisor for the Czerka Corporation, also commanding the Czerka Corporation cruiser Leverage.

Deren was a human male who served as the captain of the royal guard of the Inner Rim planet Pijal. In 40 BBY, when Princess Fanry planned a revolution to stop the influence of the Czerka Corporation over Pijal, Deren was obligated to assist her.

Fanry was a human female princess who hailed from the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. Born in 54 BBY as a member of the Pijali monarchy, she lived within the Pijali palace near the world's capital city during her childhood.
Orth was a human female politician who served as first governor of the Inner Rim Territories planet of Pijal, and previously as minister for the Pijali monarchy.

Lamia was a female individual who was the distant cousin of the human Pijali Crown Princess Fanry. In 40 BBY, they were present on the Inner Rim planet Pijal shortly after Fanry's coronation as queen ended in an unsuccessful revolution against the Czerka Corporation, a company…

Nim Pianna was a Force-sensitive Tholothian female member of the Jedi Order who trained under Jedi Knight Rael Averross as a Jedi Padawan during the Republic Era. During her first year of training, her Master helped her refine her lightsaber combat skills.
Jape was a Jedi Padawan who lived during the Republic Era and was apprenticed to a Jedi Master specializing in the astrophysics field by 41 BBY.

Prie was a Force-sensitive individual who lived during the Republic Era. As a Jedi youngling, she resided in the Jedi crèche on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant alongside her friend Obi-Wan Kenobi, a fellow Jedi youngling.

A Jedi Master of the Jedi Order lived during the Republic Era and specialized in the field of astrophysics. By 41 BBY, they began training the Jedi Padawan Jape and formed a strong bond with their student.

A Jedi Master of the Jedi Order lived during the Republic Era and took the youngling Prie as a Padawan at some point between 49 BBY and 41 BBY. He specialized in forming Force-bonds with animals and unarmed combat, gaining praise for his work throughout the galaxy.

Kreeda was a Segredo female, who, by the time of the Clone Wars, was the last of her species. Using her ability to appear invisible through psychic camouflage, Kreeda hid a group of individuals on the planet Retta, allowing them to escape the conflict of the Clone Wars.
Flebek was a Meftian who served as a general in the military of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
The court jeweler of the Inner Rim planet Pijal served the Pijali monarchy during the Republic Era. In 40 BBY, she helped the Pijali Princess Fanry choose a crown for her coronation.

Shakara Nuress, also known as "Grandmother," was a human female who held the rank of colonel and was the commander of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing of the Galactic Empire. She had previously served in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars.

Soran Keize was a human male who held the rank of colonel, serving as an ace pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, informally known as "Shadow Wing." He acted as a mentor for many of his fellow pilots, and led the fighter wing with respect for the respons…

Tonas was a human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Two weeks after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, the pilot helped defend TIE/sa bombers during the devastation of the planet Nacronis.

Barath was a human TIE fighter pilot who flew as part of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. As part of a squadron led by Captain Nosteen, Barath took part in a genocide on the planet Nacronis.
Shana was an alleged human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing who Lieutenant Yrica Quell claimed to have flown with during her time in the unit.

Gratloe was a human male admiral who served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. Gratloe was in command of the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Celerity, and decided to create his own Imperial faction in the Kudo system.

Tong was a supposed human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. When Lieutenant Yrica Quell defected from the Empire on the planet Nacronis in 4 ABY, she attempted to cover up her role in a genocide on the planet, claiming in a falsified repor…
After the Battle of Hoth during the Galactic Civil War, a captain was in command of the Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier Summit.

Venga Liss was an Aqualish male that worked for the Gillanium Syndicate, being the son of the syndicate's leader, "The Underlord." At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, Venga attempted to steal an Imperial Lambda-class shuttle while on a jungle planet, prompti…
Kendoh Voss, nicknamed the Scourge of Serenno and the Thief of Tandhor-Six, was a human female from Serenno.
Dar Champion was a human male who was elected the District Advocate for the planet Lanz Carpo. He was the former boyfriend of Princess Leia Organa, whom he had met during regent training.
Agnon was a human male officer who held the rank of First Lieutenant in the armed forces of the First Order.
Remex Io was a Clawdite male who worked in the Kendoh Gang led by Kendoh Voss. During the New Republic Era, he worked alongside Voss and Wooro to pull a job on the planet Batuu.
During the Imperial Era, a human male captain of the Galactic Empire hired the bounty hunter IG-88 to capture Venga Liss. Instead, IG-88 killed Liss and opted not to cash the bounty with the captain.
Wooro was an Aqualish male who worked in the Kendoh Gang alongside Kendoh Voss and the Clawdite Remex Io.
A human male served as a stormtrooper sergeant in the First Order military, acting as an officer in the elite 709th Legion.
Arnold was an adopted child of a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Bilf was one of the several children born to a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Gerf was one of the several children who was born to a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Jeef was one of the several children who was born to a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Flip was one of the several children who was born to a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Blip was one of the several children who was born to a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Brit was one of the several children who was born to a female Imperial officer who took a vacation on the planet Irff.
Cady was a human female enslaved by the Czerka Corporation during the Republic Era. At some point, the company brought her into the service of the Pijali monarchy on the Inner Rim planet Pijal.

Reckly was a human from the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal who lived during the Republic Era. A Pijali musician trained to play the drums, Reckly chose to join the Opposition, a political performance troupe led by Halin Azucca that protested the signing of the Governance T…

Bajjo was a human performing artist from the moon of the Inner Rim planet Pijal who lived during the Republic Era. She was a member of the Opposition, a Pijali political performance troupe led by Halin Azucca.
Elissiar was a politician who was affiliated with the Galactic Republic during the Republic Era. In 40 BBY, the Republic Supreme Chancellor, Kirames Kaj, chose not to run for reelection.
A human female Imperial officer served the Galactic Empire. At some point, she took a vacation to the planet Irff.

The Ottegan Leader was the leader of an Ottegan enclave on the planet Arthon. After the enclave assisted the explorer Lor San Tekka with mapping the location of lost Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, the Resistance attempted to evacuate the Ottegans.
During the Imperial Era, a human male doctor served the Galactic Empire onboard the Death Star. The doctor served the Sith Lord Darth Vader as his personal medical caretaker.

During the Imperial Era, a human female nurse served the Galactic Empire on board the Death Star under the supervision of a doctor. They both served the Sith Lord Darth Vader as his personal medical caretakers.
Genzhor was a humanoid doctor who was an expert on sarlaccs. He worked in the preserve on the planet I'vorcia Prime with his assistant Ooris.

Ooris was the humanoid assistant of Doctor Genzhor, a sarlacc expert, while he worked on the planet I'vorcia Prime during the Imperial Era. However, they betrayed the doctor, resulting in Genzhor's death.

The parents of Pax Maripher were humans who died during an attack on their ship by Delphidian pirates while on the border of Wild Space sometime before or in 55 BBY. The only survivor of the attack was their son Pax, who was raised by protocol droids for the next fifteen years.

Kaluub Akjee was a male Snivvian criminal who was the subject of a bounty and went to Kalarassi Five to hide. The IG-88 assassin droid IG-88 went to assassinate Akjee, but was shot and beheaded in the ensuing conflict.
"The Underlord" was an Aqualish male who was leader of the Gillanium Syndicate and the father of Venga Liss.
Osika Kirske was a Vollick warlord on the planet Rattatak. Kirske ordered the death of the Jedi Knight Ky Narec, capturing the Padawan Asajj Ventress, forcing her to serve as a gladiator in an arena.

Bry was a Hoopaloo male thief who worked with fellow criminals Jorkat and Velek during the Republic Era. At a celebration on the planet Serenno in 90 BBY, Bry stole a purse from the Serennian Lady Jenza.

Jorkat was a male Karkarodon criminal. When one of his fellow criminals, the Hoopaloo Bry, attempted to steal from Jenza, daughter of Count Gora, Jedi initiate Dooku saved the young Serennian and her brother Ramil, attacking the criminals with an electroblade and chasing them …
Restelly Quist was a female individual who held the title of Chief Librarian of the Jedi Archives sometime before the Clone Wars.

Yula Braylon was a female Jedi Master who initially served as a Jedi seeker, searching the galaxy for initiates to recruit into the Jedi Order. During her years as a seeker, Braylon had a son named Arath Tarrex, who became an initiate at a young age.

Jenza was a Serennian female, the daughter of Count Gora and Countess Anya, and the younger sister of Dooku and Ramil. Gora abandoned the Force-sensitive Dooku to be found by the Jedi Order, becoming a Jedi initiate.
Tavetti was a Bivall male senator who represented Protobranch in the Senate of the Galactic Republic.
Anya was a Serennian female, the lady of House Serenno, and the wife of Count Gora during the reign of the Galactic Republic. As consort to the Count of Serenno, Anya held the title of Countess.
Gora was a Serennian male, the head of House Serenno and Count of Serenno during the late High Republic Era.
Ekay was a female individual who served as a queen of the planet Naboo, which was governed by the Royal House of Naboo. She was familiar with Jedi Master Rael Averross and Senator Sheev Palpatine.
Jor Aerith was a female Mirialan Jedi Master who sat on the Jedi High Council during the Republic Era. She trained Gretz Droom as her Padawan.
Gretz Droom was a Jedi Master who sat on the Jedi High Council during the Republic Era. As an initiate, Droom was chosen from Heliost Clan to be the Padawan of Master Jor Aerith.
Dorrel was a male Bith Jedi Master stationed on Hoth during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Yola was a female Miraluka Jedi Master stationed on Carrick Station during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Yola served as a Jedi Consular and combat instructor.
Serenno was a male member of House Serenno. At some point during his life, the Serennian led a victorious charge against the Sith Empire which ruled over Serenno.
A human male was the father of the Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas. He lived on the planet Minashee. When their son was found to be Force-sensitive, they gave him to the Jedi Order to be trained as a Jedi.

Darth Caldoth was a Force-sensitive Duros male Dark Lord of the Sith. At one point, Darth Caldoth wrote a book titled The Bestiary of Darth Caldoth, which mentioned various Sith warbeasts such as the veergundark.

Darth Krall, originally known as Radaki, was a Force-sensitive Vollick during the Old Republic-era. A former Jedi Master of the Jedi Order, Radaki became part of what was later known as the Lost Twenty and was seduced by the dark side of the Force as a result of his belief tha…
Bulgeski was a Sallichen male senator who represented Salliche in the Galactic Senate during the era of the Galactic Republic.
Eorn was a female Miraluka Jedi Master stationed on Tython during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Eorn served as a Jedi Consular and combat instructor.
Oo'ob, also known as Oo'ob the Apostate, was a Gigoran Jedi Master who lived over 1000 years before the time of the Galactic Empire.

Zingo Gabnit was a blue-skinned alien bounty hunter. After developing a reputation as an aggressive hunter, he lost his standing among the Bounty Hunters' Guild by killing hunters who were chasing rebels and became the target of a 100,000 credit bounty.
Turfitch was a human male who worked with the bounty hunter Zingo Gabnit. On Carajam, Turfitch and Gabnit meet the bounty hunter Boba Fett while stealing shards from a woman.
Talagian was a Gran male and Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. He was stationed on Voss during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire.

Velek was a female Askajian criminal who worked with Jorkat and Bry. After Bry attempted to steal from the Serennian Jenza, daughter of Count Gora, during a festival on Serenno, the Jedi initiate Dooku confronted them with an electroblade, scaring the criminals away.
Diva Shaliqua was a half-Theelin female singer enslaved by Jabba the Hutt. She was one of his favorites and accompanied him to events. She often wore revealing outfits, which Jabba was fond of.
Ketas was a Solodoe male who served as an ambassador for talks with the Plinovian species, held on Station Zeta, over the terraforming of Plin Minor.

Tanu was a Solodoe who acted as the Chief of Security aboard the cruiser of Ambassador Ketas. During negotiations with the Plinovians on Station Zeta, the Jedi diplomat Arath Tarrex stole Ketas' seal of office, using the Force to make Tanu delete the security recordings and fo…

Raz Fellidrone, callsign XD-Forty-Five, was a male Republic Intelligence operative who captured Jenza, the sister of Count Dooku, posing as the portmaster of Carannia Spaceport at his office. He was killed by Asajj Ventress, Dooku's Sith apprentice, who was sent to find Jenza.
Thrar was a Lepi racer who represented Coachelle Prime in the forty-eighth annual Dragonfire Air Rally.

Karr Nuq Sin was a Force-sensitive human male from the planet Merokia who sought to discover his connection to the Force in 32 ABY during the New Republic Era. He was the grandson of J'Hara and the great-grandson of former Jedi Padawan Naq Med.

Arath Tarrex was a male Jedi initiate during the Republic Era. Arath often conflicted with Dooku when they were younglings (the two were part of the Hawk-Bat Clan), as he was jealous of Dooku's intellectual and combative superiority over him.
Rusl-Kwin was an individual who served as a chief in the Galactic Empire. Sometime during the Imperial Era, Rusl-Kwin clogged the toilets on Level Two which was located on Imperial installation.
Fafifeth was a rebel who died in the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Zlarko was a rebel who died in the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
L'ry Ap'Lton was a rebel who died in the early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Jezri was a rebel who died in the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Voov was a rebel who died in the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Neithi was a rebel who died in the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Shir-Lax was a rebel who died in the Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire.

Darth Sakia was a fictional female Dark Lord of the Sith created by Jedi Master Lene Kostana, hoping that it would make Jedi Initiate Dooku remember a Force vision that he had seen when he broke into the Archive of Forbidden Artifacts, an artifact collection located in the pla…

An exogorth lived on an asteroid in the galaxy's Agoliba-Tu system during the Galactic Civil War. Long before the time of the New Republic, three members of the Mist-Weaver Force-based order—Shareen, Awglk, and Wkk'e—entered the exogorth and cocooned themselves inside; with th…
Darth Kroan was a humanoid Sith Lord who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Kroan had yellow eyes, gray skin, and a bald head.

Darth Inexor was a humanoid Sith Lord who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Inexor had red eyes, gray-green skin, and a completely cybernetic body save for their head.

Klias Teradine was a Zeltron male Padawan of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. A proud and arrogant apprentice, Teradine trained alongside fellow Padawan Tylera Yorrick under Jedi Master Cibaba on Alaris Prime.
Loje Nella was a shadowy Riorian female who was a member of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure's court.

Kuru was an Arcona swoop racer. During the Rion Swoop on the planet Rion, Kuru encountered the smuggler Han Solo, who was competing in the event, and collaborated with other racers, including Makta, to sabotage him and turn him over to the Galactic Empire for a bounty.

Makta was a Twi'lek female swoop racer. She worked with Kuru during the Rion Swoop race, targeting the smuggler Han Solo, who Kuru hoped to hand over to the Galactic Empire in return for the bounty placed on him.

Wyl Lark was a human male Polynean politician who represented the planet Polyneus in the Galactic Senate of the New Republic and a starfighter pilot who, as part of the Hundred and Twenty, served the Rebel Alliance and later, the New Republic Defense Force, in the Galactic Civ…
Wittin was a member of Jabba the Hutt's court on Tatooine. In 4 ABY, they were present in Jabba's Palace when Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa attempted to rescue Han Solo from carbonite.
Ylra was a female Theelin who met Tamu Dree on-board a Pantolomin cruiser. After a short courtship, she married him.

Nysad was one of many Kajain'sa'Nikto in the service of Jabba the Hutt. He was aboard the Khetanna at the Great Pit of Carkoon, and was killed in the ensuing fight between Jabba's forces and Luke Skywalker's allies during the Rescue of Han Solo in 4 ABY.
Mana was a Jedi Master who lived during the Republic Era and trained Ky Narec as their Padawan.
Zang Arraira was a Jedi initiate who lived in the Republic Era. She trained in the Hawk-Bat Clan under the supervision of Jedi Master Tera Sinube. Sinube later took Zang as his Padawan in 86 BBY.
Fozec was a human male who worked as a guard at the palace of the crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure on the planet Tatooine.

Stallo was a human who resided on the planet Carajam between 2 BBY and 4 ABY. They fought against the gang known as the Xan sisters and received a bounty on their head under the alias of "Tal Joben." At one point, the bounty hunter Boba Fett claimed the bounty on the criminal …

Roz Fantanine was a male Fantanine who held the position of Magnate Imperium within the Ben Diffle Fantanines. His nephew, Kako Fantanine, was the administrator of a mining colony owned by the Fantanines.

Kako Fantanine was a male Fantanine who administrated the operation of a Fantanine mining colony. His incompetence led Roz Fantanine, who wished to remove Kako from power without causing an incident among their species, to offer Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian of Cloud Ci…

This Padawan was a human male Jedi of the Jedi Order and trained under a Mikkian master. During the Clone Wars, the Padawan and his master were on the jungle planet of Ledeve to look into the world's Jedi Temple, although they were confronted by Grievous, a Separatist cyborg g…
Kyossk was a Kyuzo soldier in Guattako's army.
Kairos was a female humanoid individual with mauve chitinous plates, deep-set eyes, and thin black lips, who piloted a UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft in the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron.

Keeve Trennis was a human female Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. Originally the Padawan of the Trandoshan Jedi Master Sskeer, Trennis rose to the rank of Jedi Knight in 232 BBY after saving a city of diminuitive Ximpi on the planet Shuraden from space-farin…
Radorm was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order, who attended an annual Jedi Initiate tournament that was held underwater.

Yepa was a female individual who served as an assistant in the portmaster's office at Carannia Spaceport. When Asajj Ventress broke into the office to speak with Raz Fellidrone, she used the Force to send Yepa to get caf in Saffia, over one hundred kilometers away.

Glute was a male Crolute criminal with extensive cybernetics. He was affiliated with the Razorclaw Gang, but fell out of favor with the gang's leader. Glute was hired by Republic Intelligence agent Raz Fellidrone to capture Jenza, sister of Count Dooku.
Enric Pryde, also known by the callsign Steadfast, was a human male officer who held the military rank of Allegiant General in the First Order during the First Order-Resistance War.

Zorii Bliss, also known as Zorii Wynn, was a human female native to the frigid planet Kijimi. She was the leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. During the war between the First Order and the Resistance, Bliss was neutral, and she spent time in Kijimi's Thieves' Quarter.
Nath Tensent was a human male pilot who served in Alphabet Squadron of the New Republic, flying a Y-wing. He had an easy demeanor, but was a determined survivor, wishing to outlive even his squadron.

Pira was a Bivall female doctor in the Tabor Hospital on Protobranch. She was trapped in the hospital when a solar storm disabled the planet's technology, but was rescued, along with several younglings, by the Jedi Padawans Dooku and Sifo-Dyas.
Rralla was a male Wookiee youngling who was inside the Tabor Hospital on Protobranch when a solar storm hit the planet and disabled its antigrav platforms.
A Prime Minister served the planet Protobranch during the Republic Era. The Prime Minister was present when a solar storm hit the planet, causing its floating cities to fall to the ground.
Volkan was a female nurse in the Tabor Hospital on Protobranch. When a solar storm caused the antigrav platforms of the planet to collapse, Nurse Volkan was in charge of a group of younglings.
Apina was a youngling who was in Tabor Hospital on Protobranch when the planet was hit by a solar storm that disabled its technology, including the antigrav platforms that held the cities in the air.
Cuhoon was a male Fluggrian youngling who was in Tabor Hospital on Protobranch. He was unable to walk, and had to lie on a diagnostic hovercot.

Vylip F'alma was a Northern Mustafarian male who was the lore master of his clan. He was eventually imprisoned in Fortress Vader. He helped ZO-E3 and a smuggler escape Vader's castle and told them of the Bright Star.

Chass na Chadic was a Theelin female who served as a pilot for multiple groups, starting with the Cavern Angels, and eventually joined the Rebel Alliance's Hound Squadron, where she flew a A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter, during the Imperial Era.
Lutin Hollis was a male human who served as a pilot in the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps.

Erdan was an enslaved human that lived in the city of Mos Espa on the desert planet Tatooine. A towering individual with black hair and tanned skin, his face was marked half in white and half in black as a symbol of his ownership.

"Avenger" was a human pilot for the First Order during the war against the Resistance. At some point, while leading two TIE/fo space superiority fighters, Avenger flew a TIE/vn space superiority fighter and passed by a white celestial body's atmosphere.

"Recoil" was the nickname of a human pilot for the First Order during the war against the Resistance. At some point, Recoil piloted a TIE/vn space superiority fighter while above a white-colored world, and entered a confrontation with an enemy, resulting in the latter party be…

The "Corvax descendant" was a human smuggler who was the captain of the starship Windfall, accompanied by the droid ZO-E3. The smuggler was unknowingly Force-sensitive and was a descendant of Lady Corvax, an ancient resident of the planet Mustafar.
Oro Dassyne was a Koorivar warrior who defended the Corporate Alliance and their assets with the red-armored Koorivar Fusiliers under their command.
Gallo rallied a massive army to destroy the ancient fortress city Spearhead, the home of the rogue Boss Rogoe and the remaining holdouts against Gallo's united Gungans.
Tiny was a dianoga that lived inside the plumbing of a water dispenser in the market of Black Spire Outpost on the Outer Rim planet Batuu.

Toothy was a dianoga pup that was purchased from the gangster Jabba the Hutt by the collector Dok-Ondar in 1 BBY and kept within a specialized tank in his store, Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities, on the Outer Rim planet Batuu.
Selbie was a human female hostess who worked at a cantina on the Inner Rim planet Pijal. During the Republic Era, the Pijali woman made the acquaintance of Rael Averross, Pijal's Jedi lord regent.
Scrapjaw Motito was a diminutive Manjtoo scavenger who lived on the planet of Jakku approximately thirty years after the Battle of Endor.
Kel'Cy was a human female who worked as an inventory specialist for Hondo Ohnaka at Ohnaka Transport Solutions in Black Spire Outpost.

A Pau'an was a major in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. After a rebel squad, led by Luke Skywalker, attacked the Imperial Refining Platform M36, an Imperial Star Destroyer attacked the rebel forces.

Greez Dritus was a Latero male who lived during the end of the Galactic Republic and into the Imperial Era. He was captain of the Stinger Mantis, a luxury yacht with controls customized for piloting with his four arms.
Radley was a rebel pilot, he died after getting shot by Vader's TIE Fighter after a rebel outpost in Jamiri was invaded a starfighter factory on an Imperial supply moon.

A human male was in Coruscant and hiding under a sewer grate watching his father be interrogated by stormtroopers. After getting caught the stormtroopers shot his dad and he felt disappointed in himself because he had the shot but failed to shoot them.

Caern Adan was a male Balosar former financial journalist who served as an agent in both the intelligence branch of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and its successor in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Nasi Moreno was a female pilot in Riot Squadron, flying an A-wing for the Rebel Alliance and eventually the New Republic. Moreno fought the Galactic Empire at the Battle of Endor, and assisted her squadron in its mission to accompany the frigate Hellion's Dare for reconnaissance.

Sata Neek was an Ishi Tib male who served in the New Republic's Riot Squadron. Neek fought in the Battle of Endor and continued to serve in Riot Squadron until the Attack on the Hellion's Dare, where he was killed by pilots of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Rununja was a Duros female who held the callsign Riot Leader in the New Republic's Riot Squadron. She led the squadron following the Battle of Endor and was eventually killed by forces of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during an attack in the Oridol Cluster.
Ginruda was a humanoid individual who was an emissary for the Entropian Hive Trading Council. They had a snout, a reed-like body with suction-tipped fingers, and skin the color of regurgitated bread.

Fadime was a Nikto female who was a pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. She flew under the callsign Hound Six. During the Attack on the Hellion's Dare, Fadime helped defend the frigate as they fled into the Oridol Cluster.
Ansil was a pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. They were killed by forces of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing while defending the Hellion's Dare in the Oridol Cluster.
Aries was a A-wing pilot in Riot Squadron, a squadron that served both the Rebel Alliance and the New Republic. At some point during Aries' service to Riot Squadron, the pilot was killed.

Braigh was a Rebel Alliance pilot in the squadron of Nath Tensent. During an attack on the Trenchenovu shipyards, Braigh attempted to sell out her squadron to the Galactic Empire in return for her life, but was killed by Imperial TIE fighters.
Canthropali was a pilot in a Rebel Alliance squadron led by Nath Tensent. They were killed in an attack on the Trenchenovu shipyards by Imperial TIE fighters.

Shol Mordeaux was a Rebel Alliance pilot who served in the squadron of Nath Tensent. During an attack on the Galactic Empire's Trenchenovu shipyards, Mordeaux was shot down and killed by TIE fighters.

"Char" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, nicknamed as such by the pilots of the New Republic due to the carbon scoring on their TIE fighter.

Creel was a male individual who commanded the Rebel Alliance Riot Squadron during the Imperial Era. Sometime prior to the skirmish above the planet Jiruus, which occurred several weeks after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Creel retrieved what he assumed were orders that his com…

Ferris was a pilot in a Rebel Alliance squadron led by Nath Tensent. When an attack on the Galactic Empire's Trenchenovu shipyards went wrong, Ferris attempted to eject from his starfighter, but was killed.

Heater was a pilot in Riot Squadron of the New Republic. He was a distant cousin of fellow Riot Squadron pilot Kamala and the son of Imperial Colonel Barson Nestroph. Heater was killed by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing after the Battle of Endor.
Kamala was a pilot in the New Republic's Riot Squadron. She was killed by the TIE fighter pilots of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing in the Oridol Cluster.

Kreskian was a Chadra-Fan male captain in the New Republic. He commanded the EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Hellion's Dare, which was attacked by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing above Jiruus shortly after the events at Endor.

Lexei was an individual who held the rank of general in the Rebel Alliance. The pilot Nath Tensent led his squadron in the Battle at Trenchenovu on the Galactic Empire's Trenchenovu shipyards, six months prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, in order to earn a favor from Lexe…
Merish was a pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. He flew an A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter until he was killed during the Attack on the Hellion's Dare.
Barson Nestroph was a male colonel in the army of the Galactic Empire. They were the father of Heater, a pilot in the New Republic's Riot Squadron.

Nex was a pilot who flew an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor in Riot Squadron, a squadron that served the Rebel Alliance, and later, the New Republic. While serving Riot Squadron, the pilot was eventually killed.
Jothal Gablerone was a human male who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing as the squadron leader of Squadron Four.
Len Okero was an elder on Polyneus. Wyl Lark, a New Republic pilot from Polyneus, believed that Okero would be the first to know in the event of his death.
Pesalt was a pilot in the Rebel Alliance squadron of Nath Tensent. Pesalt died in an attack on the Galactic Empire's Trenchenovu shipyards when they attempted to outmaneuver TIE fighters and crashed.
Samran Phesh was an individual who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing as the squadron leader of Squadron Six.

Piter was a human TIE fighter pilot in a squadron led by fellow pilot Nath Tensent as a part of the Galactic Empire. Piter's squadron ran a criminal enterprise in the Outer Rim, but when the Empire discovered what they were doing, they all defected to the Rebel Alliance in 1 BBY.
Rassus was a male individual who served as a major in the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, Rassus served under Colonel Shakara Nuress aboard the Star Destroyer Pursuer.

Rawn was a male pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. They were killed by the TIE pilots of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing in the Oridol Cluster, during their attack on the New Republic frigate Hellion's Dare.

Eno Cordova was a human male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a scholar and archaeologist with a deep interest in the ancient civilizations of the galaxy. As a mentor, Cordova was responsible for training Cere Junda and was also a close friend and ally of Qui-Gon Jinn.

A human male was the brother of New Republic Intelligence agent Yrica Quell. Whilst trying to recruit Nath Tensent to the New Republic on Entropian Hive, Quell drank brandy and noted that one of her brothers had taught her to appreciate it.

A human male pilot was the father of New Republic Intelligence agent Yrica Quell. Whilst trying to recruit Nath Tensent to the New Republic on Entropian Hive, Quell drank brandy and noted that it was her father's drink.

This human female was the mother of New Republic Intelligence agent Yrica Quell. Whilst trying to recruit Nath Tensent to the New Republic on Entropian Hive, Quell spotted a YT-2400 light freighter not too different from one her mother had flown.
Madrighast was a male colonel in the military of the Galactic Empire who commanded the starship Unyielding.
Neosephine Calorda was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire whom the members of Hound Squadron, a A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter squadron in the New Republic, were taught to fear.
"Tails" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War.
Alyord Smythe was a human TIE fighter pilot and captain in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Denn Maskar was a human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Holding the rank of first lieutenant, Maskar was one of twelve TIE pilots who were loaned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Sanction for an anticipated Rebel Alliance attack.
Samnel Peers was a human TIE fighter pilot and second lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Sonogari was a male pilot in the New Republic's Riot Squadron with the callsign Riot Seven. He was close to the fellow pilot Wyl Lark, and he became the unofficial flight instructor to the young pilot.
Reeka was a female pilot who was the second-in-command of the Rebel Alliance squadron of Nath Tensent. Reeka had a face full of scars and at one point, threatened to disassemble Tensent's droid, T5.

Rorian was a pilot in Nath Tensent's Rebel Alliance squadron. He participated in the squadron's attack on the Galactic Empire's Trenchenovu shipyards. While trying to escape TIE fighters, Rorian's engines overloaded and he was killed.

Quaysail was an Ualaq Aqualish pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. She was killed by the forces of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing in the Oridol Cluster while attempting to defend the frigate Hellion's Dare.
Rep Boy was a male pilot who served aboard the New Republic's EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate Hellion's Dare as a part of Riot Squadron.
Togue was a pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron who was killed while defending the frigate Hellion's Dare in the Oridol Cluster by the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Yeprexi was a female pilot in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. At one point, fellow Hound Squadron pilot Chass na Chadic stole Yeprexi's ship and crashed it into a bog, but Yeprexi never told any of their superiors about the incident.
Glothe was a pilot in Hound Squadron of the New Republic. He was killed by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during an attack on the frigate Hellion's Dare.
Shroi was an individual who served as a corporal in the New Republic. They were a crew member on board the bulk freighter Buried Treasure.

Stanislok was a pilot who held the callsign Hound Leader in the New Republic's Hound Squadron. Stanislok was a steady and cautious pilot, and during an attack on the frigate Hellion's Dare, the pilot was killed by the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Skitcher was a scrawny male pilot in the New Republic's Riot Squadron. When the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing pursued the frigate Hellion's Dare through the Oridol Cluster, Skitcher was one of the last survivors of his squadron, but was nevertheless killed.

Gannory was a male Cerean who owned Gannory's Cantina on Mrinzebon. Vryant, a former Imperial, ran a gang in the area that threatened to burn his cantina down if he did not help them set up travelers so they could be mugged.
Narlowe was a junk dealer that lived in Tinker-Town on Mrinzebon.
Brorn was an individual who lived above the tram stop in Tinker-Town on Mrinzebon, along with Shonessa.

Vryant was a human male gang leader on the world of Mrinzebon. He had formerly been a part of an Imperial Army garrison. Vryant had served six years on Herdessa and two years in the trenches of Phorsa Gedd before he was assigned to Mrinzebon.
This female individual was the mother of Riot Squadron pilot Sonogari. At some point before the attack on the Hellion's Dare, Sonogari became estranged from his mother.

This female individual was the aunt of Riot Squadron pilot Wyl Lark. After spending time with Sonogari following his induction into Riot Squadron, Lark told Sonogari of his concerns for his aunt and uncle.

This male individual was the uncle of Riot Squadron pilot Wyl Lark. After spending time with Sonogari following his induction into Riot Squadron, Lark told Sonogari of his concerns for his aunt and uncle.
Nette was a female resident of the Gavana Orbital space station along with her mother during the Galactic Empire's rule.
Malvor was an individual that served in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy and Imperial Officer Corps as an admiral.

Senchiko was an individual that served as a Moff in the Galactic Empire. In the weeks following the death of Emperor Palpatine during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, a male Imperial who had witnessed one of Palpatine's sentinels deliver orders for Operation: Cinder to start advi…
Hirodin Nasli was a human TIE fighter pilot who flew in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Pune Zignat was a male Aqualish who served as a weapons technician for the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the Defense of Maridun, Zignat worked under General Lok Durd as he was testing the new Defoliator Deployment Tank.

Pors Tonith was a Muun financier who had maintained strong ties to the InterGalactic Banking Clan. By the time of the Clone Wars, Tonith allied himself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems and their naval forces as an officer.

Dua Ningo was an elderly Sullustan that operated as an admiral for the Commerce Guild's Sullustan Home Guard, in which he was tasked with overseeing defense of the Sullust sector and interests that belonged to SoroSuub Corporation.
Horn Ambigene hailed from the Tydane system, from which afterwards he was responsible for leading an anti-Galactic Republic militia during the Republic Era for a number of decades.

This human male individual served as the Galactic Empire's Minister of War at some time. At some point, the minister visited a starfighter factory on an Imperial supply moon when it was attacked by starfighters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Stornvein was a male individual who served the New Republic as an aide to General Hera Syndulla. Some weeks after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, he delivered a report to Syndulla aboard the Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship Lodestar and informed the general w…

Royen was an individual who served as a moff in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. After the death of Emperor Palpatine at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Royen's fleet was cut off from Imperial support near the Red Hand Cluster and, as such, became a de facto Im…
The mother of the girl Nette was a female individual who owned an apartment on the Gavana Orbital space station.

A scientist served in the Galactic Empire's Tarkin Initiative. At some point they defected from the Empire and later spoke with New Republic General Hera Syndulla when she tried to find a scientific solution to a problem presented by the atmosphere of Pandem Nai.

Ragnell was a female sergeant who served as an engineer and mechanic aboard the New Republic's Lodestar. At one point, Imperial defector Yrica Quell asked Ragnell to paint her new squadron's starfighters with the Alphabet Squadron insignia.
Bangroft Casas was a human male ensign in the Galactic Empire, who was stationed the tibanna gas mining station above the planet Pandem Nai.

Preartes was a male lieutenant in the Galactic Empire who served aboard the cruiser-carrier Aerie. After pursuing the New Republic frigate Hellion's Dare through the Oridol Cluster but failing to prevent two of the pilots from escaping, Preartes took it as a personal failure, …
A male Verpine operated as a smuggler during the Galactic Civil War. The smuggler was contacted by former Imperial forces on the planet Abednedo, who requested to be discreetly transported offworld.

Lindon Javes was a human male member of the Rebel Alliance and later the New Republic Defense Force. Ascending the ranks of the Alliance by hunting Imperial starships, he found he excelled in commanding and led several successful missions, later being given command of Vanguard…
This male individual was the uncle of Lundi. He owned a hunting lodge on Lokud 7.
This female individual was the aunt of Lundi.
"The Harch" was the nickname of a Harch who ran a crew aboard the space station Whitedrift Exchange, offering work and residence.

Agias Rikton was a male individual from Corulag who served as an engineer aboard a Gozanti-class cruiser in the Imperial Navy. After the Battle of Endor, the cruiser's crew was caught by the Rebel Alliance, and Rikton escaped aboard an escape pod.
Mayus was a male individual who worked as an engineer aboard the New Republic cruiser Lodestar. While checking on his Y-wing, Nath Tensent briefly spoke to Mayus, asking about his family.

Jems was a male engineer aboard the New Republic cruiser Lodestar. While working aboard the Lodestar, Jems was reassembling a centuries-old protocol droid as a hobby. Nath Tensent greeted Jems as he made final checks on his Y-wing, asking about the protocol droid.
Narston was a female engineer who operated for Colonel Shakara Nuress of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing at the planet Pandem Nai, working with the orbital tibanna mining crews.
Nagry was a female ensign in the Galactic Empire. She served Colonel Shakara Nuress of the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing on the Orbital One space station above the planet Pandem Nai.
Meriva Greef was a human female sergeant in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, serving as ground crew aboard the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Pursuer.
Xion was a human TIE fighter pilot who flew a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Nosteen was a human male TIE fighter pilot who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War. Commanding a squadron, he appointed Lieutenant Yrica Quell as his second-in-command.
Hastun was a human pilot who flew a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter for the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Klevin was a male individual who worked as a hauler in a dig-rig crew on Vernid. When one of the workers in the crew, "Devon Lhent," who was a former major in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, was confronted by two New Republic Intelligence officers who attemp…

Nanchia was a female individual who worked on Vernid as a rigswoman in a dig-rig crew. In a cantina on Vernid, she got into a disagreement with one of her coworkers, "Devon Lhent," a former Imperial TIE fighter pilot and major in the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing who was living …
Vi'i'che was a male individual who worked as a cranksman in a dig-rig crew on Vernid. He had wide eyes and a beard of tendrils that was festooned with gold rings.

An individual formerly served as the captain of the Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Pursuer. After the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing's participation in Operation: Cinder, the fighter wing had been left without orders and Colonel Shakara Nuress informed the captain to fall back, …

This individual was the Imperial governor of the planet Pandem Nai. After the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing's participation in Operation: Cinder was over, they fell back to Pandem Nai half expecting to find it overrun by local revolutionaries.

Maxim was a male human who served as a sergeant in the ground forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While the Alliance was headquartered at Echo Base on the gelid planet of Hoth, Maxim was tasked with finding tauntaun to train as mounts.
An individual served as the commander of the New Republic's Hail Squadron around the time of the battle in the Haldeen sector.

The grandfather of the engineer Agias Rikton served alongside clone troopers by the time of the Galactic Empire. He recounted it to Rikton during the engineer's upbringing on the planet Corulag, stating that it taught him what mattered was heart.

A human female was the mother of New Republic pilot Nath Tensent. Whilst thinking of his old squadron, who had been wiped out by Shadow Wing, Tensent recalled a rule that his mother had raised him with and still lived in his heart: when someone attacked your family, you punch …

This clone served as a clone trooper pilot in the Grand Army of the Republic. During their service, he piloted an AT-TE in the 501st Legion, serving under the command of Clone Captain CT-7567 "Rex" and Jedi General Anakin Skywalker.
A Nikto was the Great Grand-Nikto of the Kadas'sa'Nikto mechanic Neeku Vozo. They lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire and witnessed its stormtroopers being not very nice to Niktos.

Var-Whill was a noted Jedi crystallist who lived prior to 19 BBY. In the aftermath of the Corsair Wars, Var-Whill was recruited by the Jedi Master Oo'ob to modify lightsaber technology and create the sniper rifle called the Farkiller.
Sumistu was an officer in the First Order.
Ophi Egra was a human female villager in Tuanul.
Quinar was an individual who lived on the planet Jakku in 34 ABY.

Ozeer Tenzer was a male mercenary sent on Twon Ketee by Regent Solculvis to stop Han Solo and his crew from hunting rathtars. He wore a set of white and red armor similar to that of the Galactic Republic's clone troopers and the Galactic Empire's stormtroopers.
Croll Jenkins was a human male who assisted Han Solo and Chewbacca in smuggling Rathtars for King Prana on Twon Ketee.
Trentus Savay was a human male resistance worker. At one point he was on D'Qar and was given permission to utilise resistance terminals.
Zylas was a human female mercenary hired by Varond Jelik to help Han Solo and Chewbacca capture Rathtars for King Prana.
Tarsus Valorum was a politician from House Valorum who served as the first Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic following the fall of the Old Republic by 1032 BBY.
This male farmer was the father of Julen Rakab. A year after Jules' friend Izzy left Batuu, a drought occurred on Batuu, resulting in a fire that spread through a forest and series of houses.

Esu Rotsino was a female politician who served within the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic as senator for her homeworld, the agriworld Abrion Major, prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance.

Ahr was a human male Moff and governor of the Esuain sector in the Mid Rim who commanded a Venator-class Star Destroyer in the Galactic Empire's navy. Along with the Sith Lord Darth Vader, he was assigned to neutralize a threat on Namzor around 2 BBY.
Warba Calip was a Force-sensitive human female who grew up on Jedha, four blocks away from the Temple of the Kyber, where she went to listen to the Guardians of the Whills.

Varg was a Clawdite male and ex-bounty hunter employed by Dok-Ondar as a "fixer" in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, which brought him into conflict with the Kendoh Gang as they attempted a theft from Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities.
A Human male Imperial Advisor with a purple robe was one of six who accompanied Galactic Emperor Palpatine to the second Death Star in 4 ABY.

Oni Jass was a humanoid male individual sent by Regent Solculvis to capture Rathtars for him and prevent Han Solo from bringing the Rathtars to King Prana. He used twin blaster pistols, as well as detonators.
Gaff Kaylek was a Duros Mercenary who wore a breath mask. Kaylek was sent to Twon Ketee by Regent Solculvis to stop Han Solo and his crew from hunting rathtars.
A human female bartender worked in Takodana Castle in 34 ABY and managed a coffee machine in the castle.

Foga Brill was an individual who worked for the Galactic Republic Judicial Department's Office of Criminal Investigations. During the Clone Wars between the Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, Brill served as the office's Director of Investigation.

Piar Nagelsa was an officer in the Kerkoidian Defense Forces of the planet Kerkoidia. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Nagelsa joined the Confederacy alongside the Kerkoidian Defense Force, in which the officer led…

A Wookiee bartender worked at a cantina located in the capital city of the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. By 40 BBY, the Wookiee worked alongside Selbie, one of the establishment's hostesses.

L9-7240 was the designation of an Imperial scout trooper stationed on the planet Kashyyyk in 14 BBY. While fighting Partisans led by the rebel Saw Gerrera, the trooper was carried in an All Terrain Armored Transport crossing the River of Origin.
Balanhai Savit was a male human who served the Galactic Empire as one of the twelve Grand Admirals in the Imperial Navy.
Haveland was a female individual who was a moff in the Galactic Empire and, during the Imperial Era, acted as the governor of the Esaga sector after her father had held the position prior.

Chio Fain was an Ardennian male slicer who operated during the time of the Galactic Empire. After a failed job, Fain lost his partner, Rone, at the hands of the Empire, which made him eager for revenge.
Gita was a human agent of the Rebel Alliance during the Imperial Era who originally hunted animals on the astronomical object Mytar.

Honnah was a Gamorrean tracker who worked with the bounty hunter Beilert Valance in hunting down Darth Vader during the Imperial Era. Upon returning to her home in Fuacha, she discovered that her family had been slain by the Empire, earning her resentment for the regime.

Drak was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems between 22 BBY and 19 BBY. He served under Jedi Padawan Leh'ahnyo Vas and her Master.
Leh'ahnyo Vas was a female individual who was a Jedi Padawan during the Clone Wars. The clone trooper Drak served under Vas' command.
FN-3761 was a human male stormtrooper in the First Order's FN Trooper Corps. Along with FN-2187, FN-3761 was assigned to janitorial duties on Starkiller Base.

Praltal was a Gungan from the small city Shoril on the planet Naboo. During the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, he sympathized with the Confederacy and served as one of its agents on Naboo.
Holaq was a Weequay who had worked with the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. In 1 BBY, Holaq chatted with the Aqualish Uro while on the world Fikari.
Uro was a Ualaq Aqualish associated with the Hidden Hand criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. In 1 BBY, Uro talked with the Weequay criminal Holaq on the world Fikari.
Val Isa was a Jedi Master in the Jedi Order who was notorious among the Jedi for repeatedly deciding to learn other aspects of the Force, therefore becoming a Padawan multiple times.

Quadoro was a Weequay pirate who worked with Hondo Ohnaka and Dok-Ondar during the Imperial Era to steal a relic from the Temple of the Kyber. The pirate was shot in the chest by a guardian after inquiring about why he had to walk at the front of the group.
Anolo was a Muun and a Vice Chairman of the InterGalactic Banking Clan on Mygeeto during the Imperial Era.

Ariana Surabat was a plucky female explorer who flew the starship Ravenstar with her crew. She founded the planet Batuu in the Outer Rim Territories. The Surabat River Valley on Batuu was named after her.

AD-2508 was the designation of a human stormtrooper in the 709th Legion of the First Order. During the First Order's occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, AD-2508 was stationed in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

CF-8011 was a human stormtrooper who served in the 709th Legion of the First Order military regime. CF-8011 was stationed on the Outer Rim planet Batuu during the First Order's occupation there in 34 ABY.
