Kordus Vrak was a Shistavanen male explorer. Despite the appearance of his species, Vrak was often gentle and calm. Vrak was one of several crew members hired by Fionn Tucat and Romina Foss for an expedition to the abandoned moon of Lupal.
Cavrolo Sys was a Togruta male hired by the explorers Fionn Tucat and Romina Foss for an expedition to the long-abandoned moon Lupal.

Fionn Tucat was a human female explorer. Along with her associate, Romina Foss, and a hired crew, Tucat led an expedition to the abandoned moon of Lupal, despite the perilous results of all previous explorers who visited the moon.
Borzul was a one-eyed Lasat male in the crew of the explorer Fionn Tucat, hired for a mission on the moon of Lupal.
Romina Foss was a female individual who was the associate of the explorer Fionn Tucat. The two hired a crew in order to mount an expedition to Lupal, a long-abandoned moon.

Kira Vantala, according to legend, was a dark-skinned female Jedi who wielded a bright blue lightsaber. During the Imperial Era, she travelled to an orphanage on the planet Gaaten after hearing of Force-sensitive children being taken by a phantom.
Tara Rashin was a Quarren female pirate who led a cell of the Guavian Death Gang. She had a sinister reputation for spreading fear and intimidation by means of terrorizing ships and hijacking cargo.

Seezelslak was an Azumel male bartender who ran Seezelslak's Cantina on the planet Batuu. While he did not have many customers, Seezelslak had a penchant for storytelling, including a favorite involving the local Jedi temple, Yoda and a Padawan named Ady Sun'Zee.
A droid repair technician was active during the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

Zeldin was a Dathomirian female Nightsister. According to legend, Zeldin was chosen to use Nightsister magick to infiltrate the mind of the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth, who had stolen a pod containing a dead Nightsister from Dathomir.

Bran Ath'Morath was a legendary Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. At some point between around 5000 BBY and years before 1032 BBY, the Sith Lord Darth Caldoth attacked the Jedi temple on the moon Bathoris, killing many Jedi.

A human male impostor of the Rebel Alliance operative Luke Skywalker lived in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, he boasted in a cantina about his alleged exploits of destroying the Death Star, hoping he could fool bar patrons and be hired as a pilot.
Davim Ak was a male individual who ran the Civilian Defense Force in the settlement on the moon Yavin 4, holding the title of lieutenant.
Guz Austin was a male officer of the Yavin 4 Civilian Defense Force.

Robhar Dern was a male officer of the Civilian Defense Force on the moon Yavin 4 who had once worked with former Rebel Alliance pilot Shara Bey. Accompanied by Guz Austin, Dern visited the home of Bey's husband Kes Dameron after his son, Poe, crashed his mother's A-wing.
Fontis was a Devaronian male bartender that ran Gully's, a cantina in the settlement on the moon Yavin 4.

Elia Litte was a female officer of the Yavin 4 Civilian Defense Force. After Poe Dameron was brought into the Yavin 4 Defense Force station, Litte let him out due to his connection to his father, Kes Dameron.
Chant Osman was a female officer who was a reservist in the Yavin 4 Civilian Defense Force.

Sela Trune was a human female officer of the New Republic Security Bureau. Trune had a vendetta against the criminal gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi after they were responsible for deaths of her family.

Zeva Bliss was a human female criminal who led the gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi after taking control of the group from Zarah Bliss. Unlike Zarah, Zeva was able to unite the Spice Runners into a truly united force. Zeva was also the mother of Zorii Bliss.
Gaithel was the younger brother of the New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune, residing on Yungbrii.

Ledesmar was a Zabrak female mercenary. Formerly a slave of the Pyke Syndicate, Ledesmar escaped with a Moraysian cruiser and its crew of droids, also managing to acquire the helmet of Zeva Bliss, the leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

Tomasso was a human male individual who was a high-ranking member of the criminal gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. However, he was eventually accused of becoming an informant passing information on to the New Republic, and was killed by the gang's leader, Zeva Bliss.

An individual was the high commander of the Zualjinn Syndicate criminal organization. Tomasso, a member of the rival Spice Runners of Kijimi, was sent under the guise of a diplomatic mission to the planet Quintil, where he instead killed the high commander.

A humanoid male individual served as a leader in the Zualjinn Syndicate. On the planet Quintil, the leader and a group of Zualjinn soldiers attempted to find Tomasso, a member of the rival Spice Runners of Kijimi who had killed the syndicate's high commander.

Zatticha was a Kyuzo female criminal who was an associate of Tomasso, a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. After Tomasso and several other Spice Runners were captured by the Zualjinn Syndicate on Quintil, he sent out a distress signal.
Alfris Sotin was a Fiumarian male smuggler and slaver. Sotin offered a deal to the Spice Runners of Kijimi on Ankot Station, but instead betrayed them to the Guavian Death Gang.

Smaatku was a Gordelian male warlord who resided on the planet Guat'a. He was a rare exception of his species, building a strong organization on Guat'a while being in league with the Osako pirates. He was killed by the Spice Runners of Kijimi during a heist.

Tarand Crowe was a male smuggler and pirate who was active during the time of the New Republic. He was one of the criminals gathered by Zeva Bliss, leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, under the guise of a summit on Kijimi, where Bliss intended to eliminate her criminal alli…

Caryn was a human female smuggler and fence who operated during the Galactic Civil War and the subsequent time of the New Republic. She was invited to the Kijimi summit by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, who intended to kill her guests.

Adlerber was a skittish Arcona dealer who worked with the Kubaz Monigallgh. The two were invited by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi to a summit on Kijimi, where Bliss secretly intended to kill the criminals present.
Alugomes was an Iakaru spice dealer active during the time of the New Republic. The dealer was invited by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi to a summit on Kijimi.

Civian Bain was a Rodian criminal who operated during the era of the New Republic. Bain was one of numerous criminals invited to the Kijimi summit by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, who intended to kill the guests present.

Gezlar was a Chagrian male guard who worked for the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Gezlar was present at the Kijimi summit, where lead Spice Runner Zeva Bliss gathered numerous criminals in order to execute them.

Sarb Iltage was an Abednedo criminal active during the time of the New Republic. Iltage was invited by Zeva Bliss of the Spice Runners of Kijimi to a summit on Kijimi, where the Abednedo spoke with the pirate Woan Barso.

Jarv was the bartender of the establishment known as Rugova's on the planet Guat'a. While attempting to infiltrate Rugova's to steal from the warlord Smaatku, Spice Runners of Kijimi Zorii Bliss and Poe Dameron distracted a guard by claiming that several Dressellians were atta…

Tolo Mandah was a individual who served as the head of New Republic Intelligence. She contacted New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune to put an end to her vendetta against the Spice Runners of Kijimi.

Monigallgh was a Kubaz female criminal who was the partner of the Arcona dealer Adlerber. She and Adlerber were invited to the Kijimi summit by Zeva Bliss, leader of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, under the guise of forming alliances in the criminal underworld.

Pheeb was a Sullustan female operative of the New Republic Security Bureau. She was present in the central operations of a New Republic Security Bureau space station, where officer Sela Trune requested to see the prisoner Marinda Gan, a member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi.
Von Tante was a male thief who resided in Kijimi City on the planet Kijimi, and was a contact of the smuggler Tarand Crowe.
Vishar Koss was an Ovissian representative of the planet Krystar in the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

Queb was an Ovissian male who served as the regent of the Galactic Republic-aligned planet Krystar. Queb was secretly working with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, holding numerous clone troopers prisoner and selling them to a Trandoshan hunter.
A Trandoshan hunter was active during the Clone Wars, purchasing clone troopers that had been held prisoner by Regent Queb of the planet Krystar.

Ufsa'mak'ro, better known by his core name Samakro, was a Chiss male who served as the first officer of Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo aboard the Chiss Ascendancy cruiser Springhawk. He held the rank of merit adoptive of the Ruling Ufsa family.

Che'ri was a Force-sensitive Chiss female who served as an ozyly-esehembo within the Chiss Ascendancy. Thalias was her caregiver, or "Momish" while she served on Mitth'raw'nuruodo's ship. She liked to draw on her questis and later with colored graph markers.

Mitth'urf'ianico, also known by his core name of Thurfian, was a Chiss male of the Mitth family who served, at various points in his life, as an Aristocra, Syndic, Syndic Prime, and Patriarch for that family.
Mitth'ali'astov, known by the core name of Thalias, raised as Al'iastov, was a Chiss female Caregiver and former Force-sensitive sky-walker.

However, the Chiss also learnt more and more about him, Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" uncovered the attempt to cover up the attack on the Paccosh, and later uncovered the occupation of the Rapacc system by Yiv, and later met the general himself at the Vak Combine's…

Qilori was a Force-sensitive male individual associated with Uandualon who was a Pathfinder navigator. He used a sensory-deprivation headset to connect to the Great Presence in order to navigate through hyperspace.
Jayko was a human male smuggler. He traveled with the navigator droid Arch-E, and previously worked with the Gamorrean Tan. After retiring, Jayko published the book A Smuggler's Life.

Tan was a Gamorrean male who worked with the smuggler Jayko. After Jayko retired from being a smuggler, he wrote the book A Smuggler's Life. Jayko mentioned Tan in the book, leading the Gamorrean to become famous.
A human served as one of the First Order's stormtroopers assigned to Kylo Ren's flagship the Steadfast.

Buccel Trune was a human male who fought alongside the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War and later became the father of the New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune.

The mother of New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune was a female individual who resided on the Trune family farm on Yungbrii. Trune was close with her mother, and found it difficult to leave to join the New Republic.

The father of Civilian Defense Force officer Elia Litte was a male individual. When releasing Poe Dameron, teenage resident of Yavin 4, from custody and back to his father after Dameron crashed his mother's A-wing starfighter, Litte told him to be thankful of his father's loya…

A human male soldier served in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War. Around 5 ABY, while the company was deployed on the planet Troithe, he and half a dozen other soldiers talked with some pilots from the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron.

A Mon Calamari soldier served in the New Republic's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War. During the 61st's deployment to the planet Troithe around 5 ABY, the soldier and half a dozen other infantry met with some New Republic pilots.

A male guard served the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. During the Kijimi summit, in which lead Spice Runner Zeva Bliss intended to execute numerous criminal allies and enemies, the guard was stationed at the Dai Bendu monastery.
A male guard worked for the Spice Runners of Kijimi, a smuggler gang that operated on the planet Kijimi.

A male individual served as a lead guard in the smuggler gang known as the Spice Runners of Kijimi. The guard was in charge of holding several criminals prisoner during the Kijimi summit, in which lead Spice Runner Zeva Bliss gathered numerous allies and enemies in order to ex…

A female medic worked on the planet Kijimi. After deserting the Spice Runners of Kijimi during the Kijimi summit, an injured Poe Dameron was directed to the residence of the thief Von Tante by the smuggler Tarand Crowe.

A male individual was, according to legend, the owner and wearer of a mask, operating long prior to the year 29 ABY. The mask wearer sought immense power and influence, manipulating powerful individuals in order to do so.

Slokin was a male ambassador and collector of ancient treasures, possessing a vast repository within his estate. According to legend, Slokin purchased a mask from the Ithorian collector Dok-Ondar, and was granted visions of its original owner's exploits and manipulations.

A male king supposedly ruled long before the year 29 ABY. The king secretly made a pact with an enemy of his, not wishing for his subjects to know. A mask-wearing man became aware of this, and used his knowledge to blackmail the king into providing him with a title and land.
A male ambassador represented the planet Hadros. According to legend, the ambassador feared losing his position over information pertaining him that was not known to the public.

A female politician held the title of Madame Secretary long before the year 29 ABY. According to legend, the politician was poisoned by an influential mask wearer, who proceeded to take her role and power.

Gorson was a male government official who was the superior of the ambassador Slokin. According to legend, Slokin, having been granted visions of the exploits of a man by the mask he wore, followed the mask wearer's actions, poisoning Gorson.

A young male individual supposedly served as a footman to a mask wearer, an influential man who gained power and fortune through criminal exploits. While the young footman aided his master's crimes, he eventually grew jealous of the man's power, and killed him, stealing his mask.

Potniss was a male advisor to Ambassador Slokin. According to legend, Slokin exploited visions given by a mask he purchased to gain power and influence, with Potniss aiding his schemes. However, Potniss eventually grew tired of serving Slokin, and killed the ambassador.

Alger Denholm was a human male officer of the Galactic Empire who served aboard the Star Destroyer Exactor. Supposedly, Denholm was promoted after his superior, Lieutenant Marsden, was killed by Darth Vader, but began to see visions of Marsden.
Marsden was a male Imperial officer who held the rank of lieutenant aboard the Star Destroyer Exactor. According to legend, Marsden was killed by Darth Vader, who used the Force to choke the officer.

A male individual served as the captain of the Star Destroyer Exactor in the Galactic Empire. Supposedly, after both Lieutenant Marsden, and then his replacement, Alger Denholm, were killed by Darth Vader, the captain was responsible for promoting an Imperial officer to fill t…
Saul Toten was a male Imperial officer who served on the Star Destroyer Exactor. He was supposedly promoted to replace Lieutenant Alger Denholm, who was killed by Darth Vader.

Nil Idyth was a male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. According to legend, Idyth was thought to be a modest and upstanding Jedi, but only remained as such by burying his darker emotions within an amulet.
Sol Mogra was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. According to legend, he was the former Padawan of Jedi Master Nil Idyth, and acquired his master's amulet after his death.

Kjus Androth was a male Jedi of the Jedi Order. According to myth, Androth, along with Petano Dreth, was enlisted by Jedi Knight Sol Mogra for assistance in seeking out a mysterious figure rampaging throughout the Coruscant Underworld.

Petano Dreth was a male Jedi of the Jedi Order. Supposedly, Dreth and Kjus Androth were enlisted by fellow Jedi Sol Mogra, who required assistance in finding a mysterious individual causing terror in the Coruscant Underworld.
Douglas Sunvale was a human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era who served as the marshal of the Jedi outpost at Port Haileap.
Honesty Weft was a human male born around 244 BBY, the son of the Dalnan ambassador Weft. He was present aboard the starship Steady Wing, headed for the Starlight Beacon.
Weft was a human male who served as an ambassador for the Dalnans. He was married to a Corellian woman, with whom he had a son, Honesty Weft.

Nym was a Feeorin male pirate who led the pirate band known as the Lok Revenants. Near the end of the time of the Galactic Republic, Nym and his band of pirates operated on the Rimward end of the Corellian Run and along the Llanic Spice Run hyperspace routes.

A Trandoshan male hunter operated during the Clone Wars. During that time, the Trandoshan hunter kidnapped the young Force-sensitive Wookiee Yiprukk from his family in the city of Rwookrrorro on the planet Kashyyyk.
Iak Wal was a Mandalorian male who served as the landing pad director in the city of Ronion on the planet Mandalore.

Aloen Dresk was a Force-sensitive male individual who was in some way affiliated with the salvage operations for The Oteroan Sky. When a salvage expert retrieved a shard of the Nardithi Cluster, Dresk felt a connection with it through the Force and stole it.
Yeel Dresk was a male descendant of Aloen Dresk who eventually inherited Aloen's fragment of the Nardithi Cluster and hired Quek Rai to add it to the statue Tragic Hope.
Quek Rai was a famous Corellian sculptor who lived in the city of Tyrena. Adept with the Force, she used its visions to shape her sculptures.

Walisi was a Toydarian merchant who bought and sold rare objects, such as the statue Tragic Hope, and operated Walisi's Elegant and Exotic Artifacts. Soon after announcing that he planned to sell the statue, however, Walisi disappeared.
Vorlip was a Chiss female who held the rank of Junior Captain in the Chiss Defense Force and commanded the Tomra.

Mafole was a Chiss female who served as the fourth caregiver of the sky-walker Al'iastov, a young girl who navigated the space outside of the Chiss Ascendancy government's borders using the ability of Third Sight.
Wrecker was a Toydarian mercenary who was hired to kidnap Walisi and steal the statue Tragic Hope. A stubborn haggler, Wrecker was the leader of a band of mercenaries.
"Boss" Trelon was the leader of Jerserra's agents based on Toydaria.

Irrica the Hutt was a Hutt member of the Gorensla kajidic. She led the clan's operations in the Toydarian city of Riar, and was very concerned when Walisi, a Toydarian merchant affiliated with the kajidic, disappeared.
Freff was a Dathomirian Zabrak and a member of the Nightbrothers of Dathomir. He and the other members of his tribe served the Nardithi Nightsister Jerserra.
Prior to the rise of the Galactic Empire in 19 BBY, a captain served in the Trade Federation aboard an exploratory starship.
Krynthia was a human female and the daughter of the Grand Leader of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.
Cadeliah was a human female born to two heirs of rival crime syndicates—Krynthia of the Unbroken Clan and Khamus of the Mourner's Wail Syndicate.

Kin Dragen was a non-binary member of the group known as the Dragens. By 3 ABY, they had a conversation with the House of Tagge scion Ronen Tagge during which, according to Ronen, they said something "terribly rude" about his aunt—Lady Domina Tagge.

Song was a Duros mercenary served in the mercenary unit of Ronen Tagge, scion of the House of Tagge. The Duros and several other mercenaries were sent by Tagge to pursue Doctor Eustacia Okka, who Tagge wished to use to find the legendary Rings of Vaale.

Tucker was a Mon Calamari who served as a mercenary in a unit that worked for House of Tagge scion Ronen Tagge. Tucker, alongside several other mercenaries, was dispatched to find Doctor Eustacia Okka as part of Tagge's search for the artifacts known as the Rings of Vaale.
Nal Henol was a female Toydarian that served as the administrator of Bog Bay, a collection of landing pads located in the Toydarian city of Riar and run by the Gorensla kajidic.

Pravon was a Weequay who led a team of enforcers loyal to the Gorensla kajidic. He had extensive cybernetic implants, which included a cybernetic voice box that allowed him to greatly increase the volume of his voice.
Twitch was a clone trooper who served with the Galactic Republic's 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.

Slim was a clone trooper of the Galactic Republic. Early during the Clone Wars, Slim was on the planet Kamino, and got into a fight with the trooper Heater, who had previously deserted from the Grand Army of the Republic.

"Youngster" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Youngster flew a TIE fighter during combat alongside other TIE fighters near planet Coruscant.

"Wampa" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Black Squadron, the pilot flew a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter under the callsign Black Eleven during the Battle of Yavin.

Chiraneau was a human who served in the Navy of the Galactic Empire and worked as a Rear Admiral and an advisor to Fleet Admiral Firmus Piett. The Rear Admiral was a part of both the Navy's officer corps and starfighter corps, piloting a VT-49 Decimator.

Zertik Strom was a human individual who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Strom flew a TIE Advanced x1 and at one point landed in a hangar. Strom also served as an administrator who was considered pitiless.

Maarek Stele was a human individual who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Stele flew a TIE Advanced x1 and at one point was in a docking procedure from a hangar bay.

Gorgol was an individual who served as a pilot and engineer within the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At one point during the Clone Wars, Gorgol flew a Nantex-class starfighter while on Geonosis but was shot down.

Berwer Kret was an individual who served as a pilot and Hive Guard captain within the Confederacy of Independent Systems' Stalgasin Hive Guard. At one point during the Clone Wars, Kret flew a Nantex-class starfighter in space alongside two vulture droid starfighters.

Chertek was an opportunistic Geonosian who served as an ace pilot within the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic, which lasted from 22 BBY to 19 BBY.

Ralchio Nervi, born Ralchio Sargan, was a human male who served in the navy of the Galactic Empire. The son of Vilola Sargan and Cacique Jans Coorsa of a clan of Confederacy of Independent Systems sympathizers on Gall, Nervi was Force-sensitive.

"Nath Alico" was the alias used by a human female spy of the Rebel Alliance's Intelligence division while undercover as a lieutenant in the task force commanded by Captain Ralchio Nervi of the Galactic Empire.
Ravik was a male individual who served the Galactic Empire as a Grand Moff and controlled the Tolonda Oversector.

Darrus Jeht, a member of the Jedi Order, was a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. At the Battle of Kromus and the Battle of Cularin, events occurring at some point between 22 BBY and 19 BBY, Jeht was the commanding officer of the Galactic Republic's Maelstrom-class battle cru…
Trask was a female Lannik who served as a sergeant in the military forces of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Gorth was a Rodian who served on the CR90 corvette Candor as an officer in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Between around 2 BBY and 4 ABY, Gorth was present on the starship when it was attacked by an Imperial-class Star Destroyer.

This Zillo Beast was worshiped by the Benathy, a warrior species that saw the beast as their god and protector. It was awoken by the battle between the Benathy and the First Order. The Force-sensitive warlord Kylo Ren killed the Zillo before it could destroy his forces.

"Teaok" was the name assumed by a male human warrior who served in the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars against the Galactic Republic. The warrior was part of an elite unit that shot down Jedi General Weren Dal over the planet Dathomir towards the end of the war.
Gremla was a Toydarian who lived in a village near Arnel, and the twin of Grax. Grax and Gremka made a living by farming annra plant and leading expeditions into the nearby swamps.
Grax was a Toydarian who lived in a village near Arnel, and the twin of Gremka. Grax and Gremka made a living by farming annra plant and leading expeditions into the nearby swamps.
Boyse was a moff within the Galactic Empire during its reign. Moff Boyse commanded a blockade of the planet Scipio from his flagship, the Exchequer.
Jaxsinne Tamm was a female individual who served in the military intelligence of the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, holding the military rank of commander.
Erle Hovlinn was a male individual who served as a Lieutenant Colonel in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.
Racetrack was a clone trooper who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. During the war, Racetrack deserted the Grand Army of the Republic, but was later brought back to Kamino.

Sync was a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Sync deserted from the Republic, but was returned to Kamino, placed in a squad of troopers who had defected, led by Heater.

Charlie was a clone trooper in service to the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. At some point in the war, Charlie deserted his squad, but was returned to Kamino, where he was assigned a squad with several other clone deserters led by "Heater." Charlie believed that his …

Thorn was a human agent in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. Following the Battle of Endor, Thorn infiltrated the fledgling New Republic, discovering intelligence on the secret Project Starhawk and in need of extraction.

Lira Wessex was a famous human female starship designer who was a part of the Galactic Empire. A daughter of the well-known starship designer Walex Blissex, she and her group designed the Venator-class Star Destroyer which was used by the Galactic Republic.

Kierah Koovah, nicknamed "Gunny," was a Mimbanese pilot who served as squadron leader of the New Republic's Vanguard Squadron. During the Galactic Civil War and following the Battle of Endor, Koovah fought against the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron.
Dodson Makraven, callsign "Night Beast," was a human TIE fighter pilot who flew as part of Obsidian Squadron under the callsign of Obsidian Two.
Ja'fosk was a Chiss male who served as a Supreme Admiral within the Defense Hierarchy Council of the Chiss Ascendancy.

Wevary was a Chiss male who served as a colonel in the Chiss Ascendancy, commanding Taharim Academy. He spearheaded a campaign that accused Cadet Mitth'raw'nuru (Thrawn) of cheating on a patrol craft simulator test proctored by Senior Cadet Irizi'ar'alani (Ziara).
Kiwu'tro'owmis, core name Wutroow (pronounced /wuːˈtɹɑːʔoʊ/), was a Chiss female who served as a Senior Captain in Picket Force Six as the first officer aboard Admiral Ar'alani's Vigilant.
Tumaz'mor'diamir, core name Azmordi, was a Chiss male who served as a Lieutenant Commander and helm officer aboard the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet vessel Springhawk.
Elod'al'vumic, known by her core name Dalvu, was a female Chiss who served as a Mid Commander aboard the Chiss Ascendancy heavy cruiser Springhawk.
Frangelic was a Garwian male who served as the Second Defense Overlord within the Garwian Unity. Years earlier, during the Stivic incident, Frangelic was a Security Officer.

A Grysk male known as "Jixtus" was the coordinator of the Grysk forces who sought the destruction of the Chiss Ascendancy. Like the rest of his warlike species, he led a Grysk fleet from his flagship, the Shatter-class WarMaster FateSpinner.
Mitth'ras'safis, also known by his core name Thrass, was a Chiss male syndic of the Chiss Ascendancy's Syndicure and held the rank of cousin within the Mitth family.

Uingali foar Marocsaa was a Paccosh male and a member of the Marocsaa subclan. He and a group of Paccosh met with Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy. He represented the Paccian Governance. Uingali owned a partial schematic of the Kilji picket cruiser Hammer.
A Paccosh male acted as a spokesman for a group of his species when meeting with Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy.

Prack was a male Pathfinder navigator dispatcher who worked with the Navigators' Guild. Several years before 19 BBY, a member of the Chiss species came to the Navigators' Guild's Guild Concourse 447 space station to hire a navigator for their Chiss diplomatic cruiser's diploma…
Irizi'stal'mustro, known as Zistalmu, was a Chiss male who served first as an Aristocra and later as a Syndic of the Irizi family within the Chiss Ascendancy's Syndicure.

Boadil'par'gasoi, known by his core name Ilparg, was a Chiss male ambassador of the Boadil family. Ilparg was meant to represent the Chiss diplomatic mission to Urch, the capital and homeworld of the Urchiv-ki species with whom the Ascendancy had a treaty.

Droc'tri'morhs, core name Octrimo, was a Chiss male of the Droc family who served as a Mid Commander and pilot aboard the Vigilant, a Chiss Ascendancy Nightdragon man-of-war commanded by Admiral Ar'alani.
Obbic'lia'nuf, known by the core name Biclian, was a male Chiss who served as a Senior Commander aboard Admiral Ar'alani's Vigilant as a sensor officer.

a: The One They Could Not Kill

x: The Chiss Ocpior was a member of the Chiss Droc family who held the rank of Senior Commander and served in the Chiss Ascendancy nation's Expansionary Defense Fleet, serving aboard the patrol cruiser Parala.

Proslis was a Garwian envoy of the Garwian Unity nation in the Unknown Regions. In 19 BBY, Chiss Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo, core name "Thrawn," and Caregiver Mitth'ali'astov "Thalias" required passage to the Vak Combine nation's capital planet Primea, undetected and und…

Mitth'oor'akiord, known by the core name Thooraki, was a Chiss male who held the title of Patriarch of the Mitth family. Thooraki invested time in recruitment for the Mitth, seeking out and arranging for invitations to be offered to talented prospective family members.

A Void Guide served in the Navigators' Guild as a Void Guide during the Nikardun Destiny's conquests. He was hired by some Paccosh refugees to escape the Nikardun, however, when he arrived at a rendezvous point where another warship was supposed to meet them, all Paccosh died …

A male human pilot was present on the planet Tamsye Prime working transport at the time of the Imperial attack on the planet. The man had already setup contacts to escape and thus had some semblance of a plan.
A Pantoran was employed by the Jedi Temple on Coruscant at the time of the bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar. Injured in the attack, the worker was taken to a Temple medical bay.

Hound was a clone trooper pilot who served in the Galactic Republic's Navy. Born on the planet Kamino from the genetic template of bounty hunter Jango Fett, Hound had tan skin and stood at 1.83 meters (6 ft) tall. Hound fought in the Clone Wars against the Separatist Alliance.

Morrit Ch'gally was a Jedi Master who served as a recruiter in the Acquisition Division of the Jedi Order. Ch'gally served in the Army of Light during the Jedi-Sith War and was also the founder of the Jedi Sentinels.
Civé Rashon, known by the callsign "Howlrunner," was a human TIE fighter pilot who led the elite Obsidian Squadron and piloted a TIE/ln space superiority starfighter as Obsidian Leader.
Mithel, nicknamed "Mauler," was a human individual who served a pilot in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Starfighter Corps, flying as Black Two within Black Squadron.

Rhymer was a human individual who served as a major and TIE fighter pilot within the Imperial Starfighter Corps of the Galactic Empire. He flew a TIE/sa bomber as part of Scimitar Squadron under the callsign Scimitar Leader.

Ranulf Trommer was a human male who served as an Imperial pilot of the Galactic Empire, serving within its Imperial Starfighter Corps. Trommer was equipped with the standard Imperial pilot uniform and gear and flew a TIE/sa bomber. He had black hair and light skin.

"Rampage" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot who served within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, Rampage flew a TIE/rb heavy starfighter, and at one point was attacked by two X-wing starfighters above a blue celestial body.
A Chiss woman served as the caregiver to the sky-walker Ab'begh while she was stationed on the Vigilant.

Ab'begh was a female ozyly-esehembo. By the age of eight, she was stationed aboard the Chiss Defense Force warship Vigilant, where she was watched by a caregiver. Che'ri—the sky-walker aboard the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk— considered her to be a "whiner."
A personnel officer served the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. He initially attempted to prevent Mitth'ali'astov from boarding the Springhawk, until he was overridden by Syndic Mitth'urf'ianico.
A syndic represented the Clarr family in the Chiss Syndicure. He once served on a tribunal that investigated Senior Captain Thrawn's actions during the attack on the Paataatus.
A Chiss syndic represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Droc family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.
A Chiss syndic represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Ufsa family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.
A Chiss syndic represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Plikh family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.

A syndic represented the Irizi family in the Chiss Syndicure. They once served on a tribunal that investigated Senior Captain Thrawn's actions during the attack on the Paataatus. The syndic questioned Admiral Ar'alani's defense of Thrawn's actions.

Ahhav was an individual who served in the Mining Guild as a pilot during the Galactic Civil War. At one point, Ahhav flew a TIE/mg Mining Guild starfighter and fired upon purrgil in vengeance after having survived a previous encounter.
Cohbo'rik'ardok, known by the core name "Borika," born as Kivu'rik'ardok with the core name "Vurika," was a Chiss female.
A Chiss of the Chiss Ascendancy's Ufsa family served as the captain of an excursion liner owned by the Boadil family, before 19 BBY.

A Chiss emissary served the Chiss Ascendancy. The emissary was one of several sent by the Chiss ruling body of the Syndicure to speak with the Unknown Regions Paataatus Hiveborn nation after they began to press against Chiss territory.
Thistrian was a Chiss male who was a member of the Chiss Ascendancy nation's Mitth family. By 19 BBY, he served as the family's Speaker in the Chiss Syndicure, the Ascendancy's ruling body.
"Nana" was the name assumed by a Chiss female who was the wife of Syndic Irizi'stal'mustro, core name "Zistalmu," of the Chiss Ascendancy nation's Irizi family.
Mimott was a Garwian dame who designed clothing worn at remembrance parties. Mimott operated a sewing machine to create elaborate historical costumes of the Garwian culture.
A Force-sensitive female Chiss was born around 44 BBY. In 35 BBY, when the Chiss was nine years old, she served as the Chiss patrol cruiser Parala sky-walker navigator.

A female member of the Vak species served as the curator of an art gallery on the Vak Combine nation's capital planet Primea. She wore a loose-fitting tunic-skirt and a sash across her chext decorated with a double row of carved wooden pins.
A male Chiss foreman worked at a bluedock space station located over the Chiss Ascendancy planet Csilla.
Jonus was a human male who served as a TIE fighter pilot captain in Scimitar Squadron, a squadron in the Imperial Navy's Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War.
A female soldier served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, she was stationed at Echo Base, the Alliance High Command's secret base on the ice planet Hoth.
An alien served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the rebel was stationed at the Alliance High Command's Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

A captain served in the army of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, the captain took part in the assault on the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry at the Inyusu Tor mountain on the manufacturing planet Sullust.
A Mirialan served as an ensign in the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry during the Galactic Civil War, operating aboard the bridge of the CR90 corvette Thunderstrike.

Tam Blackstar was a human male who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire. As a member of the Imperial Starfighter Corps, he wore a standard Imperial pilot uniform that had yellow stripes, and flew a TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter.

Rexler Brath was a human male who served as a TIE fighter pilot within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Starfighter Corps. As a pilot, Brath wore the Imperial pilot uniform and flew a TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter. Brath had light skin, brown hair, and a mustache.

The man was present on the planet Haidoral Prime when the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry fought the Galactic Empire in 3 ABY. During the 61st's recruitment drive in the central plaza, the man volunteered to join.

Ulic Qel-Droma was a male Jedi Knight whose life was recounted in the quasi-historical Qel-Droma Epics. According to the myths, after Qel-Droma's Master was killed by the Krath, Qel-Droma volunteered to infiltrate and destroy the Krath.
Teta was a mythical warrior empress of the planet Koros Major, who, according to the Qel-Droma Epics, led a conquest of the Koros system.

Nareen Cale was an Ithorian Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order at the time of the Jedi-Sith War. Cale altered war reports following the war's conclusion to indicate that the planet Auratera was a "total loss" and would be environmentally dangerous for centuries.

Ooroo was a male Jedi Master whose existence was mentioned in the legendary Qel-Droma Epics. According to the myths, Ooroo managed the Jedi Praxeum on the planet Ossus, training the Jedi Odan-Urr there.

Skavak was a con artist who lived and died long before the time of the Galactic Empire. A number of maps that alleged to depict the long-destroyed Great Jedi Library on the planet Ossus circulated around the black market, many of which traced back to Skavak.

T'alla was a Neti female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order, according to the Qel-Droma Epics. Hailing from the forest moon of Ossus, T'alla supposedly constructed gardens at the Great Jedi Library on that planet.
Kanrii was a male Ximpi who encountered Jedi Padawan Keeve Trennis while she was undergoing her Jedi Trials on Shuraden.

Alor Keto was a male member of the Keto family who ruled as the Emperor of the planet Empress Teta during the Imperial Era. Keto's rule lasted several decades, but was weak and ineffectual, and Keto himself was a puppet of the Mining Guild.
Eara Lota was a female member of the monarchy of the planet Empress Teta. The niece of Emperor Alor Keto, Lota was the rightful heir.

Satal Keto was a male individual who, according to the quasi-historical Qel-Droma Epics, was a leader of the Krath, a dark side cult formed on the planet Empress Teta by corrupt noble descendants of Empress Teta.
Palso Thern was a human male who served as a B-wing pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Clausito was a Wookiee warrior aligned with the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. On the Wookiee homeworld of Kashyyyk, for several months prior to the battle there in 19 BBY, the capital city of Kachirho's militia—of which Clausito was a leader—consulted with Jedi Mast…

Darth Kallomena was a female Sith Lord living during the Galactic War. Some time after stopping the Children of the Emperor, the Barsen'thor came into contact with Kallomena while pursuing Torwin Vehl on Bothawui.

Amand was a human male who was the king of the planet Molos. During the Galactic Civil War, King Amand led an uprising on Molos against the Galactic Empire's garrison, and joined with the Rebel Alliance.
Angor was a commandant at the Corulag Military Academy, an Imperial Academy run by the Galactic Empire on Corulag, a planet in the Core Worlds.
A male member of the Chiss Ascendancy's ruling Irizi family was the grandfather of Chiss Admiral Ar'alani of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. They were an avid collector of art.

Malor Phiatt was a male individual who served as a Special Agent within the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire. During the Imperial Era, Special Agent Phiatt worked with Kilmera Skale, who posed as a Jedi Knight to capture Jedi who survived Order 66.
Neer was a Sith Lord who was active some time prior to the Cron Supernova. He crafted a gauntlet as an anonymous gift to send to a powerful Jedi who served as the Jedi Watchman of the Corbos system.
A male Jedi served as the Jedi Watchman of the Corbos system. Having lost friends during conflicts with the Sith, the Jedi was anonymously gifted a gauntlet of power.
Blaise Zirkonn was a Force-sensitive human female from the planet Naboo who served as an agent of the Inquisitorius.

Zerala Dinn was a Force-sensitive human male from the planet Naboo who worked as a con artist operating in Theed. Dinn formed a partnership with Blaise Zirkonn, another Force-sensitive who served as an agent of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius.
A Chiss served as an ambassador of the Chiss Ascendancy and was sent to the homeworld of the Unknown Regions Scofti species, Bardram Scoft, by 19 BBY.
By 19 BBY, a Chiss served in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet and held the rank of captain of a Chiss Ascendancy diplomatic cruiser.

A Chiss female served as a shuttle pilot for Supreme General Ba'kif and Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy when the two investigated the wreckage of a refugee starship that suffered an attack in the Dioya system.

A Garwian male held the rank of general in the Garwian Unity. The general attempted to manipulate Senior Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy into revealing the tactical weaknesses of the Lioaoin Regime by claiming that arriving Lioaoin vessels were attacking So…

A Chiss instructor taught at the Chiss Ascendancy's Taharim Academy on the planet Naporar by 19 BBY. The instructor quoted the saying, "The sky is always darkest before just before it goes completely black." Both Admiral Ar'alani and Senior Captain Kiwu'tro'owmis, core name "W…

A Chiss male held the title of Aristocra in the Chiss Ascendancy's Irizi family. The Aristocra served as a representative for Cadet Irizi'ar'alani when she became involved in a hearing at the Taharim Academy for the supposed cheating of Cadet Mitth'raw'nuru in a simulation.
Varko Grey was a human male ace pilot who led the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron as Titan Leader with the military rank of captain.

A pilot served in the New Republic's Starfighter Corps during the Galactic Civil War. Following the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, they flew a T-65B X-wing starfighter in combat above the planet Var-Shaa, where they and their fellow freedom fighters destroyed the Galactic Empire's …
"Titan Three" was a human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron under the callsign Titan Three.

Emory was a male individual and the husband of Varko Grey, leader of the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron. Despite the dangers faced in the Galactic Civil War, Grey managed to survive battle after battle, much to Emory's relief. Emory worked on Kuat.

Gor Koresh was an Abyssin male gangster, gambler, and entrepreneur who hailed from the planet RTK111. He organized gladiator matches at his honky-tonk arena on RTK111 and hunted Mandalorian remnants for their beskar armor during the New Republic's reign.

A Trial-born member of the Chiss Ascendancy's Mitth family completed the Trials to elevate their status in the family during the lifetime of Patriarch Mitth'oor'akiord, core name "Thooraki." During the Trials, the Trial-born crossed a three-meter-wide channel of water by stack…

Talonbane Cobra was an ace pilot who was a part of the Black Sun crime syndicate and flew a M3-A Scyk interceptor. Cobra fought in the Battle of Tansarii Point Station against Car'das smugglers, but was eventually defeated, allowing the smugglers to turn the tide of the battle.
Janeth was a female individual who served as a sergeant in the military of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Belaya Rist was a female individual who was the CEO of CryonCorp and was also a Rebel Alliance sympathizer.

Mila was a human fortune-teller who lived at Takodana Castle on the planet Takodana by the time of the First Order-Resistance War. Mila used the ancient, historically forbidden Bakurat card deck to tell fortunes.

Keyan Farlander was a human male who served as a rebel pilot within the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Farlander was present at a briefing aboard the Alliance flagship Home One shortly prior to the Battle of Endor.

Qort was an Aloxian male Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. As a child, Qort was left at the doorstep of Maz Kanata, and was taken care of by Kanata and Sav Malagán before being sent away to the Order.
Krix Kamerat was a human male who lived on Trymant IV during the High Republic Era, the best friend of Zeen Mrala.

Zeen Mrala-Talisola was a Force-sensitive Mikkian female who lived during the High Republic Era. Raised in a commune of the Elders of the Path, she was the best friend of Krix Kamerat and the owner of a pet cru named Cham Cham.

Bandit Billie was a female thief who at one point owned the Smuggler's Guide. Stealing the Guide from Tobias Beckett in Zarra on Cato Neimoidia after switching packs with him, Billie recounted several of her heists in the logbook, including one where she hired several Taurill.
Skreech was a Hoopaloo male who worked for the criminal and mechanic Rekias Nodo at a shipyard on a jungle planet. The Hoopaloo also worked as a chef aboard Nodo's yacht.
Rana Kant was a Duros Jedi Master of the Jedi Order and a member of the Jedi High Council. She was the Master who trained Stellan Gios.
Elzar Mann, nicknamed the "laserman" by those on the Galactic Frontier, was a human male Jedi Master during the High Republic Era.

A Trandoshan was the leader of a criminal group that was active during the time of the Galactic Republic. In around 32 BBY, the Trandoshan criminals were present at the auction of the Jedi Padawan Eldra Kaitis, hosted by the crime boss Xev Xrexus.
Tel Trevura was a Zabrak male who flew a Jumpmaster 5000. At some point, he engaged in a battle involving a RZ-1 A-wing interceptor and a TIE/IN interceptor.
Burnium Ro was a male warlord who operated out of a stronghold on the Mid Rim planet Ikkrukk during the Imperial Era. He used rhetoric and imagery associated with the Nihil raiders of old.

Pak was a human male who was the younger brother of the assassin Just Lucky. Due to Pak's poor financial situation and subsequent detriment to his health, Tagge family scion Ronen Tagge approached Lucky, offering to make a deal with him.
A female individual was the mother of Cassian Jeron Andor. She died when Andor was still young.
Gralm was a human Imperial officer who held the rank of colonel in the armed forces of the Galactic Empire in the time following the Battle of Endor.

Shen was a human male pilot who served in the Galactic Empire's Titan Squadron following the Battle of Endor. Due to numerous injuries, he was equipped with cybernetics and was required to keep his flight helmet on at all times.

Havina Vonreg was a human female pilot of the Galactic Empire and a member of the Vonreg family, an aristocratic family. Vonreg served in Titan Squadron tasked with hunting down the New Republic's Project Starhawk.

Rella Sol was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire. The child of former Imperial senators, Sol was a politically savvy loyalist. Sol served in Titan Squadron following the Battle of Endor. She was a very loyal member of Titan.
Gracalia Vatara Sienar, known as Grace, was a human female pilot in the New Republic's Vanguard Squadron.

Skahvi Renlow was a Togruta pirate and smuggler captain active during the Imperial Era who preyed upon Imperial Forces, particularly prison ships, traveling across hyperspace routes. The Togruta owned the BT-900 bulk transport Icarii-7.

Willard Waylin was a human who served as a mechanic in the navy of the Galactic Empire. After graduating Arkanis Academy, Waylin found his fascination with Imperial design and eidetic memory made him an unparalleled mechanic.
Amos was an individual who served as a captain within the naval forces of the Galactic Empire. Amos was in command of a fleet that protected Desevro, and led it from his flagship, the ISD Tormentor.
Dela was a female who was the sister of Lindon Javes. At some point, they were killed during hazardous maneuvers. By 4 ABY, they were mentioned on Javes' Imperial record.
Nevar Yalnal was a Ranat with brown hair and black eyes. In 1 BBY, Yalnal spent time in Mos Eisley spaceport on the desert planet Tatooine.

Tawss Khaa was a Nimbanel with reddish-brown hair, fair skin and black eyes. In 1 BBY, Khaa was seated in a booth behind the Qiraash Leesub Sirln and the Lutrillian Ownellco at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

affiliation: Swarm transmission recovery and processing unit
x: Maela was a human from the Deep Core planet Vulpter. As she began her service with the Galactic Empire, she worked with Lorem, Azier, and Dirjo Harch on Project Swarm in the swarm processing center. Maela herself had the ability to deploy tens of thousands of probe droids.
The father of Gracalia Vatara Sienar was a male individual.

Chase Wilsorr was a human male who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Originally from Takodana, Wilsorr joined the Alliance to aid in the fight against the Galactic Empire.
Deena Lorn, designated TK-27342, was a human female stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire.
Emon Kref was a soldier who held the rank of private in the Rebel Alliance. Kref was present during the Battle of Hoth against the Galactic Empire.
Parazeen Parapa was a Frizznoth male affiliated with the Parapa Cartel. Assisted by the Chief Editor Droid TK-7, Parapa wrote a profile on the bounty hunters 4-LOM and Zuckuss.
Lancek Trevoras was a Toong alive during the Clone Wars.
Amara Kel, nicknamed "Shadow," was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire as Theta Four in Theta Squadron. She was more commonly referred to by her fellow pilots by her nickname.

Tal Veridian was a female resident of Cloud City on Bespin during the time of the Galactic Empire. She regarded herself as Lando Calrissian's second-in-command, and was present after several members of the Rebel Alliance escaped from the city along with Calrissian, leaving its…

Corwi Selgrothe was a holojournalist who turned to creating propaganda for the Rebel Alliance. Formerly a reporter for the Imperial Press Corps of HoloNet News, Selgrothe was recruited by the Galactic Empire with a number of other journalists after the fall of the Galactic Rep…

A Kupohan worked at the Denon-based restaurant Sakhet's Noodles in 0 ABY, when rebel operatives Luke Skywalker and Nakari Kelen visited the noodle hut in search of intelligence services from Sakhet, the restaurant's owner.

Murra was a female tauntaun. She was one of several tauntauns utilized by the Rebel Alliance on the planet Hoth. Murra was used as a mount by Han Solo in his search for Luke Skywalker just before the Battle of Hoth.

Jailyn Cirri was a female resident of Cloud City and the daughter of the Tibanna gas tycoon Jai Cirri. She had a love for fashionable clothing and was inspired by Princess Leia Organa of the Rebel Alliance.
Carl Ashon was a male human who served in the Galactic Empire as a garbage worker on the Star Destroyer Avenger.

Torro Sbazzle was a Devaronian female Executive Chef who worked for Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian of Cloud City. Calrissian requested that Sbazzle cook for Darth Vader when the Sith Lord visited the city.
The master of the BB-series astromech droid JB-7 was a kind individual. In 34 ABY, he upgraded all of the droid's vital parts, including its photoreceptor, arc welder, and welding torch.

Hannevik was a human individual who served as an officer in the Galactic Empire. Alongside Beldin and Ellian Zahra, Hannevik received instruction from Governor Wilhuff Tarkin while rising through the Imperial Academy, having originally been selected by Tarkin due to a lack of …
Beldin was a human officer of the Galactic Empire. Beldin, along with fellow Imperials Hannevik and Ellian Zahra, rose through the Imperial Academy under the instruction of Governor Wilhuff Tarkin.
Razian was a Besalisk from whom the Rebel Alliance was buying supplies from on Rion after the Battle of Yavin. Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, and Chewbacca were sent to negotiate for the supplies.

In 34 ABY, the master of the C-series astromech droid C9-78 allowed the droid a day to leave Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu, where the droid had dwelt for some time without ever leaving the outpost.

Reebak, originally nicknamed Brown Eyes, was a female tauntaun on Hoth. Prior to the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY, she was rescued from a fall by Sergeant Maxim and trained as a mount for the Rebel Alliance.

Derantus was an individual who served as a governor of the Galactic Empire. At one point during the Imperial Era, Derantus hired the Trandoshan Feresk Tssat to retrieve a piece of artwork, but when Derantus showed Grand Admiral Thrawn, it was discovered to be faux.
Nerlisha was a Chagrian female dockmaster who oversaw the hangar of the Navlaas Triad's Station Daralto.

Relkin was a human male officer of the Galactic Empire. Losing the Socorro Sunset Grand Prix cost Relkin the chance at being admitted into the Imperial Starfighter Corps, and he instead served in the Logistics Division.
Ownellco was a Lutrillian that spent time in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in 1 BBY.

A man was in the planet Sullust's capital Pinyumb during the Galactic Empire's lockdown of the city in 3 ABY. They were at a public bathhouse with a number of injured citizens when the rebels Nien Nunb and Hazram Namir arrived to help out.
A lieutenant served in the Galactic Empire's garrison on the planet Sullust. In 3 ABY, he briefed some stormtroopers at the garrison on the indications of the Rebel Alliance threat to Sullust.

A male ensign served in the Galactic Empire's navy aboard the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Herald during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, he greeted Captain Tabor Seitaron when the latter was summoned there by the Star Destroyer's owner, Prelate Verge.
Nom Lumb was a Sullustan bounty hunter who owned a JumpMaster 5000. At some point, he entered into a fight with a M12-L Kimogila heavy starfighter while in his Jumpmaster 5000 and on the run.

Hedrian was a human male pilot of the Galactic Empire. He served alongside his other brothers, in the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War. His sister Havina Vonreg served in Titan Squadron.
Jerus Jannick was a human Palace Guard of the Royal Naboo Security Forces, which served the Royal House of the planet Naboo.
An individual was a Stationmaster at Fostar Haven in 0 ABY. They allowed the Rebel Alliance to have a presence there.

Lila Nervi was a female individual of the influential Nervi family who married Ralchio Sargan, allowing Ralchio to enroll in the Rengali Imperial Naval Academy and become a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's 14th Sector Fleet.

"Talus Leader" was an individual who served in the New Republic's Talus Group aboard a CR90 corvette. Using the callsign Talus Leader, they participated in the Battle of Yavin Prime against the ISD Victorum after the Victorum attacked a New Republic medical convoy.
Klick, designated GC-1000, was a clone trooper pilot who served the Galactic Republic as a member of the Republic Starfighter Corps.
Wamoth was a Tarlafar who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Wamoth watched a sabacc match between Han Solo and Lando Calrissian. When Han Solo seemingly won, Wamoth shook hands with him.

Vera Beroya was a human female Mandalorian foundling who later served as the chieftain of Clan Awaud after the supposed death of her adoptive father, Nam Beroya during the Imperial Era. By the time she became a chieftain, Vera was considered young and battle-hardened.
Nam Beroya was a Mandalorian human male who was the chieftain of the Old Mandalorian Clan Awaud during the Imperial Era.

Avin Solus was a Mandalorian individual who was a warrior of the Old Mandalorians. Avin adopted his son, Kad Solus, when Kad warned Avin and the other Mandalorians that they were entering a trap laid out by the slaver Nok.

Kassav Milliko was a Weequay male individual who was one of three Tempest Runners in the pirate organization known as the Nihil during the time of the High Republic. He commanded the corvette New Elite.
Gwishi was a Aqualish male pirate who held the rank of Strike in Kassav's Tempest within the Nihil. He had three eyes, having lost his lower right eye, with the area covered by blue scar tissue.

Klinith Da was a human female pirate who held the rank of Strike in Kassav's Tempest within the Nihil during the High Republic Era. Klinith and fellow Nihil pirate Gwishi were dispatched to sabotage the starship Steady Wing as it left the outpost of Port Haileap.

Bell Zettifar, known to the charhound Ember as Home Friend, was a human male Jedi Knight during the High Republic era. He was the Padawan of Jedi Master Loden Greatstorm and served at the Elphrona Outpost.

Jora Malli was a Togruta female who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During this time, Malli was a member of the Jedi High Council, and was the master to Padawan Reath Silas.

Ember was a female charhound owned by the Jedi Padawan Bell Zettifar during the time of the High Republic. Ember accompanied Zettifar while he was stationed at the Jedi outpost on the ore planet of Elphrona, often wandering the world's iron hills.

Nib Assek was a human female Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. She took the Wookiee Burryaga Agaburry as her Padawan, learning Shyriiwook in order to better educate him in the Force.

Ady Sun'Zee was a Mirialan female Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. After Sun'Zee sent a distress call to the Jedi Council, it was answered by Jedi Master Yoda. Ady Sun'Zee wielded a standard blue lightsaber.

An Arcona bounty hunter operated during the Imperial Era. He wore beskar armor. The bounty hunter attempted to take the bounty placed on fellow hunter Beilert Valance by the Unbroken Clan syndicate, locating Valance on the Spur Orbiting Market space station.
Todd was a male individual who lived sometime before the Battle of Yavin. Meia at one point suggested Leia Organa take him to a prom.
Keb was a male individual who lived sometime before the Battle of Yavin. Leia Organa at one point considered taking him to a prom and dating him.
Meia was a female Human who lived sometime before the Battle of Yavin. She was one of Leia Organa's twin sisters, along with Jeia, Teia and Zeia.
Jeia was a female Human who lived sometime before the Battle of Yavin. She was one of Leia Organa's twin sisters, along with Meia, Teia and Zeia.
Teia was a female Human who lived sometime before the Battle of Yavin. She was one of Leia Organa's twin sisters, along with Meia, Jeia and Zeia.
Zeia was a female Human who lived sometime before the Battle of Yavin. She was one of Leia Organa's twin sisters, along with Meia, Teia and Jeia.
Bunky was a male endangered womp rat adopted by Harmony. It died sometime before the Battle of Yavin.
A Clone Commander served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A human male Imperial officer served aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Eviscerator during the Galactic Civil War. The officer communicated Inferno Squad with Admiral Garrick Versio during the Battle of Endor.

t: Unidentified Advanced Recon Force Scout Trooper officer
x: A clone trooper officer served as an Advanced Recon Force Scout Trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems as a clone paratrooper. The clone paratrooper participated in the Battle of Utapau as a member of the 7th Sky Corps.

t: Unidentified clone naval commander (Kaliida Shoals Medical Center)
x: A clone trooper officer served as a clone navigation officer with the military rank of Clone Commander in the Republic Navy during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
An clone trooper officer served as a clone medical officer in the Republic Military during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.
Joenn was a mechanic in the Rebel Alliance. In 3 ABY, she served at Echo Base, the Alliance's base on the ice planet Hoth.

An individual was the captain of a GR-75 medium transport which was holding survivors from the destruction of Alderaan. The Alderaanian refugee convoy was heading to Fostar Haven when they were intercepted by Captain Lindon Javes of Helix Squadron who were sent to destroy them.

"Echo Five" was a pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. After the destruction of Alderaan, they served under the callsign Echo Five for Echo Squadron and participated in a battle at Fostar Haven, flying an X-wing.
The sister of Gracalia Vatara Sienar was a female individual.

A Sakiyan individual was an agent at a posting agency. Ezra Bridger and Bossk were on a mission to the posting agency to gain access to the Imperial Enforcement DataCore. Bossk paid the agent to get through.
Marchion Ro was a male Evereni who held the title of Eye of the Nihil in the days of the High Republic.
Jordan Smythe was a male being who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Alliance's stay at Echo Base on the planet Hoth, Smythe was stationed as a tauntaun handler.

Taanti was a Weequay male proprietor that worked as a bartender at a cantina in Freetown. After the Battle of Endor, the Mining Collective attacked the cantina, killing the townsfolk inside. Taanti escaped with the help of Cobb Vanth, who later liberated the town.
Jo was a human female resident of the town of Freetown on Tatooine following the fall of the Galactic Empire.

A human male villager resided in the Tatooinian town of Mos Pelgo during the New Republic era. Following the Galactic Civil War, he bore witness to a feud between the people of his village and a group of indigenous Tusken Raiders.

A Twi'lek male doorman worked at the Carnita arena when the Mandalorian Din Djarin visited to see the Abyssin gangster Gor Koresh. The doorman let Djarin in, but later helped Koresh's assailants fight the Mandalorian after Koresh attempted to steal Djarin's beskar armor.

Solls was a male Elomin who served as in the military forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Solls served under Sergeant Janeth when he was a rookie and scouted an area along with his commanding officer.
"Bug" was the nickname of a human girl from the planetoid Sídi, the daughter of innkeepers Rank and Leera.

Kakan was a Mustafarian boy who lived at the beginning of the Imperial Era. He was fascinated by the Jedi, and when he heard that a Jedi Knight had apparently come to Mustafar, he headed out alone to the lava mine, where he heard the Jedi had been seen.

Falta was a Dathomirian witch who lived in the final years of the Republic Era. Belonging to no clan, she was renowned for her skills at making magical objects, and lived in a hut on the far side of the swamp near the Nightsister fortress. She had owned a few rancors.

Yenna was a Dathomirian Nightsister who lived in the final years of the Republic Era. A creation of the clanless witch Falta, Yenna was made of clay, shells, and other materials. The witch Falta took Yenna in as a daughter.

Lellis was a male Mustafarian miner who lived at the beginning of the Imperial Era. While working in the Klegger Corp Mining Facility in 19 BBY, Lellis saw the boy Kakan being chased by a dark figure wielding a lightsaber.

A Gamorrean fighter was present in an arena in a warehouse district fighting with another Gamorrean in 9 ABY. Gor Koresh bet on the other Gamorrean to win in the next minute. Koresh then stood up and shot the Gamorrean with his DB-41 sporting blaster pistol.

An admiral served as an Imperial officer within the Galactic Empire by the time of the ambush at the Zavian Abyss during the Galactic Civil War. As a commanding officer, they were in command of the Battlegroup Echelon during the Skirmish at Merisee when they were captured.

Giggek was a Mustafarian male who lived on the planet Mustafar during the Imperial Era. Following the Battle of Endor and the death of the Sith Lord Darth Vader in 4 ABY, Giggek convinced his friend Tuttel to journey within Vader's fortress together and destroy it with explosi…

Tuttel was a Mustafarian male who lived on the planet Mustafar during the Imperial Era. Following the Battle of Endor and the death of the Sith Lord Darth Vader in 4 ABY, Tuttel and his friend Giggek entered Vader's abandoned fortress with the intent to destroy it, despite the…
Kaiska was a tooka owned by the Blutopian crime boss Oga Garra.
Seward was, according to a tale from the Mustafarian Lellis shortly after the Battle of Endor, a moff who served in the Galactic Empire's High Command.

Kra-Ka was a pet xandank owned by the Mustafarian elder Lellis. Shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Lellis overheard his nephew Tuttel speaking with his friend Giggek, who was plotting to destroy the fortress of the recently deceased Sith Lord Darth Vader.
"Frog Lady" was the nickname of an amphibious female Querm Rybet who was escorted by Din Djarin.

"Doctor Mandible" was a male Reepayto who was a regular at the Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina on Tatooine. In 9 ABY, he was playing a game of sabacc against Peli Motto until the bounty hunter Din Djarin walked in looking for Mandalorian coverts and interrupted the game.
Carson Teva was a human male captain who served in the Rebel Alliance and later within the Adelphi Rangers of the New Republic Defense Fleet Starfighter Corps flying a T-65B X-wing starfighter.
"Frog Man" was the husband of Frog Lady who lived during the New Republic Era. He was a male Querm Rybet who found a home on the moon of Trask where he told his wife to come.

t: Unidentified Blue Coral Divers Clan witch
x: A Dathomirian witch of the Blue Coral Divers Clan from the planet Dathomir, once traded colorful shells to the clanless witch Falta. The shells were used by Falta in the magick ritual in which she created her daughter Yenna.
Ichor was a black-furred male tooka owned by the Dathomirian witch Falta.
Darth Siberus was, according to legend, a female Sith who froze herself in carbonite. She shared her name with the Sith artifact known as the Hand of Siberus.
Leera was a human female innkeeper, the wife of Rank and the mother of the girl known as Bug. She and her husband ran an inn on the Outer Rim planetoid Sídi.

A Manjtoo bounty hunter was an ally of a Kajain'sa'Nikto raider. In 9 ABY, along with the Kajain'sa'Nikto and another raider, the alien ambushed the Mandalorian Din Djarin but was defeated and killed by him.
A bounty hunter was a part of the Bounty Hunters' Guild by 9 ABY. After the hunter failed to capture a target, the bounty hunter was refused more holopucks by the Guild agent Greef Karga.
Smeep was a thwip featured in a story told by Bobbajo while he and other residents of his town were imprisoned by Zygerrian enslavers.
Myette was a human girl who lived in the town of Reestkii on Jakku when it was raided by Zygerrian enslavers.

affiliation: Swarm transmission recovery and processing unit
x: Azier was an individual who served the Galactic Empire, working in the transmission recovery and processing unit for Project Swarm, the Empire's search for the base of the Rebel Alliance using thousands of probe droids.

affiliation: Swarm transmission recovery and processing unit
x: Dirjo Harch was a member of the Galactic Empire's transmission processing unit for Project Swarm, searching for the Rebel Alliance using probe droids. By the time that he worked on Project Swarm, Harch was new to Imperial service and had not yet been able to climb up the ranks.

affiliation: Swarm transmission recovery and processing unit
x: Lorem served in the transmission recovery and processing unit of Project Swarm, the Galactic Empire's search for the headquarters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Believing she could both work and have fun, she kept up a constant stream of chatter with her colleagues.

Raysi Anib was a Mirialan author who wrote the book Be Your Best Self. Chase Wilsorr was inspired to leave his homeworld of Takodana to join the Rebel Alliance on Yavin 4, and continued to use Anib's teachings to give himself confidence.

Harlize Dana was a female individual who held the rank of lieutenant in the Rebel Alliance. Dana served in the kitchens at the Rebellion's Echo Base on the planet Hoth and had multiple people serving under her, including Chase Wilsorr.
Barlon Hightower was a male pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Hightower was recruited by Wedge Antilles into the rebuilt Red Squadron following the Battle of Hoth.

Cinda Tarheel was a female pilot who served the Rebel Alliance. She was known for her temper, and as a result was grounded by General Carlist Rieekan on Hoth, with Wedge Antilles saying it was because everyone feared she would fly her T-47 airspeeder into a mountain.
Ix Ixstra was a female pilot of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. At Echo Base on Hoth, Ixstra spent two weeks in the brig for hitting a Pathfinder over the head with a meal tray.
Penn Zowlie was a recruit of the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
Tomer Darpen was a male pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic who had a reputation for his shady actions.

Lastok, designated TK-7834, was a male Imperial AT-AT pilot who served in Blizzard Force during the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY. He was the designated pilot for Blizzard 1, the AT-AT of General Maximilian Veers, along with the gunner TK-5187.

Riba was a female tauntaun and daughter of Murra. She was one of several tauntauns utilized by the Rebel Alliance on the planet Hoth. She was pregnant with taunlets when she was killed and eaten by a wampa.
Sunsbringer was a corporal in the military forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. She was stationed at Echo Base and worked in the command center.
Tian Karmiya was an Ilohian human female who served in the Imperial Navy of the Galactic Empire. Karmiya studied at the Carida Academy, where she received prime marks.
A droid manufacturer resided on the planet Vulpter during the Imperial Era, designing Arakyd Industries Viper probe droids for the Galactic Empire within a factory on the planet.

An individual was a member of a family that resided on the astronomical object Argo-6, all of whom maintained miniature farms in their mouths. At some point, the individual visited a molecular dentist.

Lekaki was a Ximpi that lived during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, Lekaki encountered fellow Ximpi Kanrii and Jedi Padawan Keeve Trennis at the meedles, a formation of tall rocks, on the planet Shuraden, while Trennis was undergoing her Jedi Trials.

Merven Getter was a Mirialan that worked as a third-class scantech aboard a monitoring station in the Hetzal system. His job entailed monitoring ships in the system and making sure they followed their planned routes and logging the starship traffic.
Vel Carann was an individual who was a second-class scantech aboard a monitoring station within the Hetzal system.

Sella was a female Twi'lek bartender who worked at a cantina on the Rooted Moon of Hetzal Prime during the High Republic Era. She had scarlet skin and wore intricate lacings on her lekku that she had designed herself.
Illoria Daze was a Hetzalian gill-singer who hailed from the Outer Rim planet Hetzal Prime. She was able to vibrate her vocal apparatus to sing melodies in a six-part harmony.
Rak Jaren was a Human male who worked as a bounty hunter. He was a refugee from his homeworld of Subterrel. Nicknamed "Shadow Hunter," Jaren had a companion named Kellic.

Marinna Reynolds was a pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance. Receiving training at the rebel base on the moon Yavin 4, Reynolds worked in the kitchen with fellow trainees Chase Wilsorr and Oriss Khan, teaching the former about different foods from the soon-to-be-pilot's home…

Siri Tachi was a member of the Jedi Order during the late Republic Era. Known to Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, Tachi ate a midday meal with him at the Jedi Temple, and Kenobi thought about touching hands with her under the table, which led him to think he deserved punishment fro…

Koska Reeves was a human female Mandalorian who was a member of the Nite Owls. Several years after the Great Purge, Reeves was on the moon of Trask, where she helped steal an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser alongside Lady Bo-Katan Kryze, Axe Woves, and Din Djarin.
Axe Woves was a human male Mandalorian Nite Owl from the planet Mandalore who served with the Nite Owl-staffed Mandalorian resistance during the New Republic's era.

Tribus was a human male captain who served in a Galactic Empire remnant led by Moff Gideon. He commanded an Imperial Gozanti-class Assault Carrier, which was attacked above the moon Trask in 9 ABY by four Mandalorians led by Bo-Katan Kryze.

Aron Polstak was a male pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. After the evacuation of Hoth in 3 ABY, Polstak was Commander Wedge Antilles' first selection for the reformed Red Squadron.
Opolito was a Mon Calamari who worked at a port on the estuary moon of Trask. He watched the Mandalorian Din Djarin's gunship the Razor Crest descend to the surface and fall into the water.

A Mon Calamari server was a worker at the Trask harbor inn at a port on the moon Trask. In 9 ABY, the server saw the Mandalorian Din Djarin to his seat and provided confirmation, upon payment of Calamari Flan, that other Mandalorians had been present at the port, also serving …
Zeffren Ecka was a human who was the minister of the Hetzal system during the High Republic Era. The leader of the entire star system, Ecka resided in Aguirre City on the planet Hetzal Prime.

Daan was a counselor to Minister Zeffren Ecka of Hetzal Prime. During the Great Hyperspace Disaster, the curly-haired man alerted Minister Ecka of the development and worked with Ecka's other advisors, Zaffa, Keven Tarr, and General Borta, to discuss a course of action.

Pevel Kronara was a male human admiral of the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition, commanding the Third Horizon heavy cruiser starship during the High Republic Era. Kronara commanded a Republic fleet during the Battle of Kur against the Nihil pirates.
Zaffa was a Devaronian female Hetzalian government counselor to Minister Zeffren Ecka of the Outer Rim Territories' Hetzal system.
Keven Tarr was a human male technician and slicer who worked for the Ministry of Technology on the planet Hetzal Prime.

Borta was a human who served as the security chief of the Hetzal system during the High Republic Era, holding the rank of general. Borta continued to lead the security division even after cuts made by Minister Zeffren Ecka reduced his division to a tenth of its former size.

A male trader lived on the Rooted Moon of Hetzal Prime during the High Republic Era. When Minister Zeffren Ecka ordered the Hetzal system evacuated due to a swarm of hyperspace anomalies that threatened the system, the trader kindly offered to take as many people as possible a…
Gersolik was an Ugnaught female sous-chef in Cloud City of the gas giant Bespin, working for the Devaronian chef Torro Sbazzle there.
Finial Bright was a Nautolan who served as a captain in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He commanded the Longbeam cruiser Aurora IX.

Peeples was an ensign, and later lieutenant, in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He was a member of a species that possessed a proboscis, a high-pitched and reedy voice, at least nineteen eyes, and a unique understanding of humor.
Innamin was a human who held the rank of Petty Officer, and later Chief, in the Republic Defense Coalition, as well as being an engineer by training.
Andry Ked was a Alderaanian human soldier in the Rebel Alliance. Ked fought and was wounded during the Battle of Hoth against the Galactic Empire.

Tru Veld was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order by the time of its destruction in 19 BBY. At one point, they were involved in an incident at the reflecting pond within the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant that included fireworks.

A human male deck officer served in a Galactic Empire remnant led by Moff Gideon, holding the rank of lieutenant. He served on a Gozanti-class Assault Carrier, which was attacked above the moon Trask in 9 ABY by four Mandalorians.
TS-4068 was the designation of a human male who served in the Imperial Army during the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

A human male freighter pilot served in a Galactic Empire remnant led by Moff Gideon, holding the rank of lieutenant. He served on an Imperial Gozanti-class Assault Carrier, which was attacked above the moon Trask in 9 ABY by four Mandalorians led by Bo-Katan Kryze.

Mideyean was a female Slitherette that traveled with Bobbajo, a wandering storyteller of Jakku. Once, while trapped by a group of Zygerrian enslavers in a building in Reestkii along with the people of the village, Bobbajo spun a fantastic yarn of how Mideyean and the other ani…

An Aqualish worked as a virus technology programmer before later becoming a scavanger on the desert planet Jakku. The Aqualish acquired the Tanandra Frullich computer program, which would later be acquired by Scoggan and Davjan Igo.

The father of the Rebel Alliance soldier Emon Kref was a male general in the Koshagan People's Movement, a group of freedom fighters who led an uprising against the ruling class of the planet Koshaga for many years.
