Su Torka was a soldier who served in the Rebel Alliance's army and was stationed at Echo Base on the planet Hoth. Working with soldiers like Private Emon Kref, Torka used a rifle that jammed regularly during the Galactic Empire's invasion of Hoth in 3 ABY.

Cally Pon was a soldier who served in the Rebel Alliance's army, stationed at Echo Base on the planet Hoth. During the Galactic Empire's invasion of Hoth in 3 ABY, Pon used an A280 blaster rifle that constantly overheated.
TK-5187 was a gunner who served as part of Maximilian Veers' Blizzard Force during the Battle of Hoth.
Te'Ami was a female Duros Jedi Knight who lived during the High Republic Era. She piloted a Jedi Vector during the effort to save the Hetzal system during the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

Queeg was a male Quarren boatman who offered to take Din Djarin and Grogu to meet more Mandalorians on his trawler. However, he betrayed them en-route by throwing the Child into the maw of a hungry mamacore and attempting to drown Din so he could scavenge his beskar armor.
Shai Tennem was a Bith male who was the administrator and overseer of the construction of the Starlight Beacon space station.

Mikkel Sutmani was an Ithorian male Jedi Knight in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Sutmani piloted a Jedi Vector during the combined Jedi and Galactic Republic effort to rescue the Hetzal system from debris, alongside the Vectors of fellow Knights Te'Ami and Nib A…

Joss Adren was a human male individual who, alongside his wife Pikka, worked as a contractor aboard the Starlight Beacon during the space station's construction. He was a project manager who specialized in getting large projects completed successfully.
Pikka Adren was a human female contractor and the wife of Joss Adren during the High Republic Era, who she worked alongside during the construction of the Starlight Beacon space station.

Fedall was a male Quarren who was the brother of the boatman Queeg. He sought revenge on the Mandalorian Din Djarin, whom he believed had killed his brother when he went aboard the boatman's since sunken boat on the moon Trask.

A human male security officer served in a Galactic Empire remnant led by Moff Gideon, holding the rank of lieutenant. He served on an Imperial Gozanti-class Assault Carrier, which was attacked above the moon Trask in 9 ABY by four Mandalorians led by Bo-Katan Kryze.
Sy-O was an exogorth that lived a solitary life in the "Big One" asteroid within the Hoth asteroid belt. Sy-O was over one billion years old by 3 ABY, which was young for an exogorth.
Rajin was a miner who worked in Cloud City on the gas giant Bespin. Around the time the Galactic Empire occupied the planet, his son was born. He was also a bad jazz musician.
"Clipper" was the nickname of a male TIE fighter pilot who flew as Theta Eleven in the Galactic Empire's Theta Squadron.
"Dawn" was the nickname of a female TIE pilot who flew as Theta Thirteen in the Galactic Empire's Theta Squadron.
Obrax was a male lieutenant who served in the Imperial Starfighter Corps. During 3 ABY he commanded Theta Squadron.
"Shockwave" was the nickname of a TIE pilot who flew as Theta Twenty-Two in the Galactic Empire's Theta Squadron.

Kondra was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Alliance Military. By 3 ABY, he succeeded officer Aeliar and agent Gita's position at the rebel outpost on the jungle planet Lowik, where he married Yuralla Vega, an immigrant from the planet Chorin.

A male Vurk was a card player in the pub Winker's on the planet Verzan. He won against Chass na Chadic and he wanted her A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter as the prize. After Chadic refused to, he wanted to get it the hard way, but a stranger shot him with a stun.

An individual was the apprentice of Supreme Leader Snoke a mysterious, enigmatic figure powerful with the dark side of the Force, who was secretly an artificial genetic strandcast created by the Sith Lord Darth Sidious and his followers.

A human male security officer served in a Moff Gideon's remnant of the Galactic Empire, operating at the command center at a base on the planet Nevarro. Around 9 ABY, he noticed that the security feed for the shuttle bay went down and attempted to contact the shuttle bay.
TK-147 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served in a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, operating at a base on the volcanic planet Nevarro.
5387 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served as part of a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, being stationed at a base on the volcanic planet Nevarro.
5389 was the designation of a stormtrooper who served with a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, stationed at a base on the volcanic planet Nevarro.
A Mimbanese worker served as a mechanic for the Magistrate Greef Karga while also being a spy for Moff Gideon's remnant of the Galactic Empire.
A male human student attended a school on the planet Nevarro, where his cookies was once stolen by the Mandalorian foundling Grogu.
Gann was a queen of Corellia centuries before the Galactic Civil War. They were mentioned in a Corellian traders' song that was the favorite drinking song of Jothal Gablerone.

Cervil the Uncanny was a Jedi who fought in the Sith Wars. She left behind testimonies about the use of lightwhips—a lightsaber variant with a flexible blade—to defend against Sith Lords using the Forbidden Forms.

Elia Kane, designated TK-2755 under the Galactic Empire and as Amnesty Officer G68 under the New Republic, was a human who served as an Imperial officer for the Galactic Empire, a comms officer in the Imperial Remnant under Moff Gideon, and later a spy.

In 9 ABY, a lava meerkat was saved from being beheaded and eaten by a gang of Aqualish by Marshal Carasynthia Dune in the former Mandalorian covert on Nevarro. The creature showed affection to Dune, who gave it something to eat and assured it of its safety.

Murell was a member of the Rebel Alliance who worked as a tauntaun handler at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. Due to the limited number of handlers, Murell's rotation prevented the handler from having time to both visit the mess hall and get enough sleep.

Baesoon was a member of the Rebel Alliance who worked as a tauntaun handler at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. Due to a shortage of handlers, Baesoon's rotation kept the handler from having time to both get enough sleep and attend the mess hall.
Howlrunner was a human TIE fighter pilot of the Galactic Empire. She served in Theta Squadron, where she flew as Theta Seven.

A Rutian Twi'lek female worked as an agent of the Bounty Hunters' Guild on Carajam during the Galactic Civil War, providing information to Guild bounty hunters regarding their bounties and processing monetary transactions between clients and hunters.
A Twi'lek female was the niece of Gruyver and a member of the Children of the Empty Sun cult. She enjoyed fixing things and speedbiking.
A man was the father of Gaiana. He was noted to have been sick for at least a year. One time Roan Novachez's mother asked how Gaiana's father was doing and Roan said he was doing a lot better.
This female was the daughter of Gruyver. He eventually left her and her mother.
A female was the mother of Gruyver's daughter. Gruyver left them and his daughter years before.

This male was the father of Palal Seedia and her twin sister. Seedia once promised her father that she would take care of the family estate, but she broke the promise by leaving the estate in the care of her sister.
The twin sister of Palal Seedia was a human female. Palal once promised her father that she would take care of the family estate, but she broke her promise and left the estate to her sister.
"Flameskull" was the nickname of a TIE pilot who flew as part of Theta Squadron under the callsign Theta Eighteen.
Seb Astro was a human male Bespin Wing Guard in Cloud City working under Lando Calrissian as his top guard.
A human male scientist worked with a remnant of the Galactic Empire led by Moff Gideon, operating at a laboratory in the planet Nevarro's Imperial base.

The man was the father of Pasha. He worked at the Obroan Institute for Archaeology studying Jedi artifacts. When Roan Novachez came to visit, Pasha's father showed them some of his Jedi artifacts in his office.
A captain commanded the New Republic's battleship Temperance around 5 ABY.
A Weequay was enslaved by a Hutt. Before his execution, he sang a ballad of his life.
Father Kashevon was a priest who created the Day of Atonement. Chass na Chadic was heard about him when she was young.

Rainn Poras was a member of the Rebel Alliance who was stationed at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. He told the kitchen worker Chase Wilsorr to be quiet when Wilsorr kept Poras awake one morning.

Kilmera Skale was a female Force-sensitive criminal active during the Imperial Era. Working with Imperial Security Bureau Special Agent Malor Phiatt, Skale posed as a Jedi Knight to entrap Jedi who had survived Order 66.

Kharrek was a male bounty hunter who operated during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, after Lady Domina Tagge, head of Tagge Corporation, placed a bounty on the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra, Kharrek partnered with the assassin Just Lucky in order to apprehend her.
Beol De'Rruyet was a human male who was the founder of De'Rruyet Industries, operating from the planet Midarr.

Drake was a human pilot who flew for the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy. Around 2 ABY, during the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Avenger attack on a deep space installation fellow pilot Amara Kel heard someone screaming over the comm.
A human male served as a coastal defender stormtrooper squad leader in the Scarif Deployment of the Galactic Empire during the Battle of Scarif.

Lapin Tagge was a non-binary human who was part of the powerful family the House of Tagge. They were the cousin, secretary, and aide to Lady Domina Tagge, head of the family's Tagge Corporation. They reported to Tagge aboard her flagship, Acquisitor.

Jepha was a human bounty hunter active during the Imperial Era. After Domina Tagge of the House of Tagge placed a bounty on the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Aphra, Jepha was one of several hunters who attempted to capture her on Arveesh Station, alongside Uleen'Arael.

Lang was a human male mercenary who worked for Morgan Elsbeth, serving as the Magistrate's Captain of the Guard in the city of Calodan on the planet of Corvus. He had a long history of loyalty bought by credits.

Morgan Elsbeth was a Force-sensitive human female Nightsister, starship designer, and industrialist who was instrumental in the construction of the Imperial Navy during the reign of the Galactic Empire and a dedicated follower of Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Wing was a human male who lived in the city of Calodan on the planet of Corvus. The city came to be ruled by the ruthless Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth who attempted to give the population employment with the Galactic Empire.

Rav Naaran was a Force-sensitive human male who used the dark side of the Force. Naaran was imprisoned since the Clone Wars. His dark side influence spread throughout the Mount Tellec plateau. He possessed a red-bladed lightsaber.
Sendak was a communications officer in the Rebel Alliance who was stationed at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

Oriss Khan was a soldier in the Rebel Alliance who served during the Galactic Civil War. Having training at the rebel base on the moon Yavin 4, Khan worked at a kitchen with fellow trainees Marinna Reynolds and Chase Wilsorr, teaching the latter about different foods from the …
Serenity Meeks was a deck officer in the Rebel Alliance who served at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth.

A human male prisoner was held captive in the city Calodan on the planet Corvus. He was used as a bargaining chip by Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth to prevent the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano from attacking the city.

Tristan Melthabi was a doctor in the Rebel Alliance who worked at the medical facility at the Alliance's Echo Base on the planet Hoth. During the Galactic Empire's attack on Echo Base in 3 ABY, a cave-in at the corridor to the medical facility trapped Melthabi and three medtechs.
L'cayo Llem was a male humanoid soldier in the Rebel Alliance, serving as part of the Alliance's army in the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Ceret was a trans non-binary Kotabi Jedi Knight, and the bond-twin of Terec. Both twins were stationed at the Starlight Beacon space station during the High Republic Era.
Terec was a trans non-binary Kotabi Jedi Knight and the bond-twin of Ceret. Both twins were stationed at the Starlight Beacon space station during the High Republic Era.
Porter Engle, known as the Blade of Bardotta, was a male Ikkrukkian Jedi Master and cook who lived during the High Republic Era.

A clone trooper officer served as a unit commander in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems as part of the 41st Scout Battalion of the 41st Elite Corps.
Thene Kross was a Zabrak criminal male arrested by the New Republic, and serving thirty years on Oovo 4 for grand theft starship and resisting arrest.

A human male gunnery officer served in Moff Gideon's remnant of the Galactic Empire, operating aboard Gideon's light cruiser. When the cruiser destroyed the gunship Razor Crest on the planet Tython in 9 ABY, the gunnery officer reported a direct hit to Gideon.
Torbill Danzin was a Tusken Raider male who was serving a twenty-five year sentence in Sunspot Prison for the attempted kidnapping of a senator.
Reegor was a Lepi male and one of Jaxxon T. Tumperakki's many cousins.
Chargutt Lo was a Gamorrean who was serving a fifteen year sentence on Garen IV for aggravated assault.
Carto Deeves was a male criminal who was serving a thirty-five year sentence in Wobani Penitentiary for the assault of a New Republic officer.
Borbin Todds was an Aqualish with black eyes who was serving a twenty-five year sentence on Jubilar for harboring a wanted fugitive.
Vorg Alsum was a Shydopp criminal who served a five year sentence on the Delrian Prison Planet for stealing a speeder.
Ty Yorrick, formerly known as Tylera Yorrick, was a female Tholothian Force-sensitive monster hunter and saber-for-hire who lived during the High Republic Era.
Nilox Cabin-Roves was a human male who was serving a twenty year sentence in Sunspot Prison for the forgery of New Republic credits.

Biran Redben was a human male criminal who worked in a gang as a thief during the New Republic Era. At some point, he was arrested on charges of medical malpractice and was sentenced to serve fifty years on Tamazall for his crimes.
Scurto Tobbs was a human male criminal who was serving a 45-year sentence in the Karthon Chop Fields, for transport of class 4 contraband.
Pretts Rulato was a human male criminal who was serving a 50-year sentence on Clak'dor V for manslaughter and industrial negligence.
Gapgrin Dozito was a Manjtoo criminal who was serving a 25-year sentence on Selnesh for attempted shipjacking.
Yath Endidee was a Quarren criminal who, by 9 ABY, was arrested by the New Republic for attempted murder and resisting arrest and was serving a 40-year sentence on the planet Virujansi.
Avrac Kefundee was a criminal who was serving a 25-year sentence in the Wobani Penitentiary for aggravated assault of a New Republic officer.
Sart Juloss was a Hassk criminal arrested by the New Republic and imprisoned on Selnesh, where he was serving a twenty-five year sentence for shipjacking.

M'dwello Di was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who was serving a 30 year sentence on Tamazall for space piracy. The criminal's profile in the New Republic prison registry was one of several that Marshal Carasynthia Dune looked at from her office on the planet Nevarro in 9 ABY while searchi…
Ghosla Fular was a Mon Calamari criminal who was serving a 30-year sentence in Sunspot Prison for forgery of local currency.
Unga Toba was an Aqualish who was serving a twenty-five year sentence on Lola Sayu for unlawful computer access.

A human male Stormtrooper Commander served in a Galactic Empire remnant led by Moff Gideon. In 9 ABY, the officer held the military rank of captain and, along with his detachment, were dispatched by Gideon to the planet Tython to capture the Force-sensitive infant Grogu.
Sethro Dagri was a criminal who was serving a seventy year sentence on Megalox Beta for murder and extortion.
Torbill Danzin was a human male who was serving a twenty-five year sentence in Sunspot Prison for the attempted kidnapping of a senator.
A codebreaker was hired by the InterGalactic Banking Clan to crack codes for the trade wars against the Hutts.
Jan was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Cody was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.

In 3 ABY, a male wampa lived with a clan in a cave system that became Echo Base. The establishment of Echo Base threw out the clan while the wampa was out hunting, forcing the wampa to relocate to another cave on his own.

Kell Tolkani was a naturalist that served the Alliance to Restore the Republic on the planet Hoth. He chose the place of where Echo Base was to be established, and chose to remain on the world following the Battle of Hoth in order to study its wildlife.
Tev was a male geologist who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was a member of a species that possessed fur and a compact frame.
Fumo was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Valin Hess was a human male general from the planet Coruscant who served in the Imperial Army of the Galactic Empire and later in the Imperial Remnant.
"Echo Leader" was a pilot that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
"Anvil Leader" was a pilot that served in the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Geode was a Vintian male who acted as the navigator of the transport starship Vessel alongside the pilot Leox Gyasi and copilot Affie Hollow. He resembled a tall, dark gray, flinty, flaky rock.

Pra-Tre Veter was a Tarnab male Jedi Master and a member of the Jedi High Council who lived during the High Republic Era. Alongside Yoda and Xo Lahru, Pra-Tre served as one of several active Grand Masters of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Leox Gyasi was a human male pilot who worked for the Byne Guild during the High Republic Era. He flew the starship Vessel, assisted by his co-pilot Affie Hollow and navigator Geode.

Estala Maru was a Kessurian male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Maru was the Jedi head of operations aboard the Starlight Beacon, a space station on the frontier of the galaxy that served as a symbol of unity between the Jedi and the Galactic Repub…
Affie Hollow was a human female who operated for the Byne Guild as the co-pilot of Leox Gyasi aboard the starship Vessel. Hollow was the adopted daughter of Scover Byne, the leader of the Guild.

Kym was a Chagrian Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era. A friend of Reath Silas, she attempted to cheer him up during the farewell party thrown before he departed Coruscant for the Starlight Beacon space station.

Orla Jareni was an Umbaran female Jedi Master and Wayseeker during the time of the High Republic, operating independently of the Jedi High Council. As the Padawan of Jedi Master Laret Soveral, Jareni was involved in the Eiram–E'ronoh crisis.
Cohmac Vitus was a human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, renowned as both a scholar and mystic. He was formerly the Padawan of Master Simmix.
Dez Rydan was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He had golden skin and black hair.

Laret Soveral was a female human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. She was the Master of Jedi Padawan Orla Jareni. Laret and her Padawan, alongside Master Simmix and Padawan Cohmac Vitus, were involved in the crisis between Eiram and E'ronoh.
Simmix was a Fillithar male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was the master of Padawan Cohmac Vitus, who viewed Simmix as a kind master.
Scover Byne was a female Bivall who was the owner of the Byne Guild, an organization that handled shipping throughout the Galactic Frontier during the High Republic Era.
Thandeka was a human female who was the queen consort of Eiram during the High Republic Era, and was married to the queen regnant, Dima.
Dima was a female individual who ruled as the queen of the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. She was married to Queen Thandeka, her consort.
Cassel was a Pantoran male who served as the Monarch of the planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. He was often seen as unintelligent.
Cham Cham was a male cru that was a pet of Zeen Mrala, a Force-sensitive Mikkian. When Mrala was a young child, she relied on Cham Cham and her friend, Krix Kamerat, to keep her safe and be with her.
Torban Buck, nicknamed "Buckets of Blood," was a Chagrian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order as a healer during the High Republic Era.

Bibs was a Bravaisian Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era. A member of the class of Padawans training aboard the Star Hopper, Bibs was, along with the rest of the class, dispatched to aid Trymant IV when it fell under threat from the Great Hyperspace Disaster.
Janex was a Pantoran female Dalnan who was part of a delegation that was to be sent from Dalna to meet with the Galactic Republic at the Starlight Beacon aboard the Steady Wing.
A female controller served in remnants of the Galactic Empire on planet Morak in 9 ABY.
A Human male Juggernaut pilot served in a remnant of the Galactic Empire on the planet Morak in 9 ABY. Driving the HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport Juggernaut Five with another Juggernaut pilot.
Lathe was a Kajain'sa'Nikto male who worked in the criminal empire of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
Sean was a human male Jedi Padawan who lived during the High Republic Era.
Jamie Brasson was the president of Begamor during the High Republic Era in 200 BBY. Rising up to power, Brasson acquired a seat on the Galactic Senate and earned respect from most other senators.
Mostima was a human female Jedi Master who was active during the High Republic Era. Around 203 BBY, she took on a Padawan named Sean.
A Chiss female was the former caregiver of sky-walker navigator Al'iastov. At some point they told Al'iastov not to complain about her feelings.
A Lioaoi was in command when the Chiss spaceship Springhawk visited the Lioaoin heartworld.
The Rutian Twi'lek female was an individual enslaved to fellow Twi'lek male Bib Fortuna, an ex-majordomo who had assumed the throne of his late master, the crime lord Jabba the Hutt.
Marino Pomana was a Latero male who worked as the Head Chef at President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor
Wes was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Jorad Mainos was a human male pilot who served in Moff Gideon's Imperial remnant of the Galactic Empire.

Mott was a human co-pilot who served in the Galactic Empire, being aboard the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station when it destroyed the planet Alderaan in 1 BBY. After the Empire was fractured into remnants, he operated with a remnant led by Moff Gideon.
Jamint was a female Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. She was one of the aunts of Lonaste.

A human scout trooper served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 2 BBY, he was stationed on the planet Ryloth, where the Imperial occupation clashed against the Free Ryloth Movement, a Twi'lek insurrection group led by Cham Syndulla.

An Aristocra represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Mitth family on the planet Avidich. Around 39 BBY, the Aristocra met with the former sky-walker navigator Al'iastov on Avidich, and brought her into the family, and she adopted the name Mitth'ali'astov, core name "Thalias." Aroun…

A Chiss female was a member of the Chiss Ascendancy's ruling Irizi family and the aunt of Admiral Ar'alani of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. They enjoyed sewing projects while Ar'alani—known as Irizi'ar'alani, core name "Ziara," in her youth—was growing up.
A Chiss speaker represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Irizi family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.
A Chiss speaker represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Plikh family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.
TK-62 was the designation of a stormtrooper who was on the Ring of Kafrene.
XX-25900 was the designation of an individual who served the Galactic Empire and was stationed on the Ring of Kafrene.
Rak was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.
Jenks was a human male soldier for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. During the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance and the Galactic Empire, he fought Imperial troops on the moon Jedha.

Restin was a Alderaanian human scientist of the Tarkin Initiative. Following the Disaster and the Battle of Yavin, Restin vowed revenge against the Sith Lord Darth Vader for the loss of their family on Alderaan.
Baudu was a male mechanic who lived in Cloud City on Bespin when the Galactic Empire occupied the planet. At that time, he was relatively young, though his hair was graying.

Nok was a Thalassian male enslaver. The human child Kad was born enslaved to Nok while the slaver was expanding his operations on the planet Tatooine. When Kad was five years old, a local crime lord hired the Mandalorian mercenaries of Clan Awaud to destroy Nok's operation.

Skragg was a Weequay pirate captain who led the regrouped Ohnaka Gang during the time of the Galactic Empire. When the Rebel Alliance transport Spirit of Jedha became stranded at Terminus, Skragg and the Ohnaka Gang attacked the vessel.

Tromak was a Gran worshipper of the Elders of the Path and a leader in the Council of Elders who held the title of Elder. As a young child, Tromak was a Little in the Force cult the Path of the Open Hand, watched over by Marda Ro around the time she met Kevmo Zink.
A Mandalorian was a gatekeeper on the planet Begamor. He served Jamie Brasson at the latter's Presidential manor.
A Mythrol worked as a chef at President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor.

"Squawk" was a nickname given to a Quarren Galactic Republic agent as a joke by Jedi Master Mostima. The Quarren lived during the High Republic Era, aiding the Jedi in their mission to unveil the corruption of Jamie Brasson, the president and senator of the planet Begamor.

Humphris was a Human male pilot of the First Order who was assigned to Commander Wanten's fortress on Vodran during the Cold War. When the Resistance's J-Squadron's shuttle took off, his was one of the three sentinel shuttles to intercept.

A Twi'lek female worked as a chorus girl for the Hutt Clan during the Clone Wars. Following the Grand Hutt Council's imprisonment of Ziro the Hutt, the chorus girl and two others gave a performance for the Council along with the singer Sy Snootles.

"Echo Two" was a pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. After the destruction of Alderaan, they served under the callsign Echo Two for Echo Squadron and participated in a battle at Fostar Haven, flying an X-wing.

"Echo Three" was a pilot who served in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. After the destruction of Alderaan, they served under the callsign Echo Three for Echo Squadron and participated in a battle at Fostar Haven, flying an X-wing, where they assisted in the re…

A Mandalorian male served as a Mandalorian Protector under Protector Fenn Rau on the third moon of Concord Dawn during the Imperial Era. The Mandalorian had distinct Mandalorian armor compared to their comrades.

The mother of a young Force-sensitive Wookiee male named Yiprukk went around asking if others had seen her son after he had been kidnapped by a Trandoshan hunter. She had a blaster shot in her arm meaning she could not join in for the seach for her son.
The mother of Victor and Christina Starspeeder lived on Obroa-skai. She was in a relationship with Edward Starspeeder but then left him because of his relationship with the Dark side of the force.

Russell was a Human male who was in a relationship with a woman and helped raised her two children in Obroa-skai. He would drive Victor and Christina Starspeeder to their Jedi academies and cook food.
Mary was a Cerean student who attended the Jedi academy on Coruscant.
Xo Lahru was an Anx male who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

Ephru Shinn was a Mon Calamari who served on the Jedi High Council in 232 BBY. She participated in a debate about Jedi interference in military matters regarding the Nihil threat, where she opined that as Jedi involvement in such matters had only ever complicated such situatio…
Pan Eyta was a Dowutin male who was one of the three Tempest Runners in the Nihil marauder group. As a Tempest Runner, Eyta commanded a Tempest and the starship Elegencia.

Lourna Dee, born Lourna'dee and known by the code Unit 4978/7179 and the pseudonyms Inun and Sal Krost, was a Twi'lek female from the planet Aaloth who held the rank of Tempest Runner in the marauder organization known as the Nihil.

Asgar Ro was a male Evereni who held the title of Eye of the Nihil in the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. A son of Shalla Ro and an Evereni male, he eventually had a son named Marchion Ro.

Mari San Tekka was a Force-sensitive human female hyperspace prospector and member of the San Tekka clan. At the age of six, while traveling with her family, San Tekka gained the ability to locate the Paths, unconventional routes through hyperspace.
Jeni Wataro was a female Chagrian who served as the chief aide to Senator Izzet Noor of Serenno during the High Republic Era, where she abused her position to spy for Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro.

Dent, formerly known as Ultident Margrona, was a human who held the rank of Cloud in Lourna Dee's Tempest of the Nihil pirate organization. Dent led an operation to kidnap the Blythe family from Elphrona in order to ransom them to wealthy relatives on Alderaan in 232 BBY.

Ottoh Blythe was a human male miner. Living in a homestead on the Outer Rim planet Elphrona with his family, Ottoh and his wife Erika had relocated out of the Core Worlds in search of a simpler lifestyle for themselves and their children, Ronn and Bailen.
Rah Barocci was a human Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During the Great Hyperspace Disaster, he assisted in the effort to save the Hetzal system from hyperspace debris.
Lio Josse was a Jedi of the Jedi Order. In 232 BBY, they were part of the Jedi's effort to help the agriworld Hetzal Prime and its system during the Great Hyperspace Disaster.
Rohmar Montgo was a Jedi of the Jedi Order. During the Great Hyperspace Disaster in 232 BBY, they were part of the Order's efforts to assist the agriworld Hetzal Prime and its star system.
Bailen Blythe, nicknamed Bee, was a female human who was the daughter and younger child of Ottoh and Erika Blythe, born around 241 BBY.
Odabba was a Shistavanen who was the captain of the freighter Arbitrage for Garello Technologies on the planet Ab Dalis during the High Republic Era.

Larence Garello was a male individual who was the chief executive of the midlevel materials research and manufacturing company Garello Technologies, based in the Keftia district of the planet Ab Dalis.

Indeera Stokes was a female Tholothian Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. She was one of four Jedi stationed at the Elphrona Jedi outpost in 232 BBY, along with Jedi Masters Loden Greatstorm and Porter Engle, and Greatstorm's Padawan Bell Zettifar.

Matari was a red-furred male targon that was owned by Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic. Matari and his twin, Voru, accompanied the Chancellor at all times. Like his sister, Matari was named after one of the ancient gods of Coruscant.

Voru was a yellow female targon owned by Lina Soh, Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. Voru accompanied Soh everywhere she went alongside her twin, Matari. Like her brother, Voru was named after one of the ancient gods of Coruscant.

Norel Quo was a Koorivar who acted as the primary aide to Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic. Quo had pale, unpigmented skin, an unusual trait among his species. He eventually began serving as Vice Chair.

Izzet Noor was a human male politician who served in the Galactic Senate as the senator for the planet Serenno during the High Republic Era and acted as a Galactic Republic spokesperson for much of the Outer Rim Territories.
Jeffo Lorillia was a Muun male who served as the Secretary of Transportation in the Galactic Republic's Republic Transport Bureau, working under Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh.

Asaria was a Trandoshan member of Lourna Dee's Tempest and a Strike working under Cloud Ultident Margrona during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, she was a member of a team sent to the planet Elphrona to capture the Blythe family so they could be held for ransom.
Zagyar was a male member of the Nihil marauder group who held the rank of Storm in the Tempest of Lourna Dee. He wore a mask with large, curling horns over the ears and white slits for eyes.

Blit was a member of the Nihil, possessing the title of Strike in the Tempest of Lourna Dee. She served under the Storm Zagyar. Zagyar and his crew, including Blit, were part of the Nihil force that attacked a Garello Technologies convoy escaping Ab Dalis.
Kisma Uttersond was a Chadra-Fan male doctor. At some point, Uttersond attended medical school though it left him in debt.
Zaviel Tepp was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Arkoff was a Wookiee Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. The Wookiee Jedi served on the remote planet Banchii, working with the Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi and several Padawans.

Freyta Smyth was a Twi'lek pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Smyth became a member of Starlight Squadron, serving as a T-65B X-wing starfighter pilot during Operation Starlight against the Galactic Empire.
Mural Veen was a human female Eriaduan politician who was the Planetary Governor of the planet Eriadu during the High Republic Era.
A female individual was the daughter of a family that owned a tower farm on the Rooted Moon of Hetzal Prime during the High Republic Era.
Ada-Li Carro was a human female Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era.
Keaton Murag was a human Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. He served as the marshal of the Naboo temple.
Teri Rosason was a human female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, holding a seat on the Jedi High Council.
Adampo was a Yarkora Jedi Master of the Jedi Order and a member of the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era.

Palo Hidalla was a renowned Jedi architect of the Jedi Order. Alongside the Galactic Republic's finest, they designed the Starlight Beacon space station—including its Jedi temple—and inspired other engineers and specialists to participate in the project.

Maree was a woman who was the mother of Garello Technologies' chief executive, Larence Garello. During the High Republic Era, he named one of the company's starships, Maree's Diligence, after his mother.
Wet Bub was a Gungan slicer who worked for the marauder organization known as the Nihil during the High Republic Era. Bub served as a Storm under the Weequay Tempest Runner Kassav Milliko.

Belial was a Devaronian male who held the rank of Cloud in the marauder organization known as the Nihil. Serving under Lourna Dee's Tempest, Belial worked at the monitoring station aboard his commander's eponymous cruiser.

Venn was a male crewmember of Solar Array 22-X in the Hetzal system at the time of the Great Hyperspace Disaster. He was injured when the space station was struck by a piece of hyperspace debris, and fell unconscious while trapped with his colleague Sheree.
Eldie Starros was a female member of the Starros Clan and the great-grandmother of the human scientist Avon Starros.

Caden Starros was a male member of the Starros Clan during the High Republic Era. According to a family story told to his great-granddaughter—the human scientist Avon Starros—by 232 BBY, one of Caden's enemies stole his ship and left him stranded on a minor moon.

A male individual was the father of the human scientist Avon Starros. Prior to Avon being sent to the outpost Port Haileap on the planet Haileap by her mother—the Galactic Republic senator Ghirra Starros—by 232 BBY, Avon's father left the family to chase a dream of mapping hyp…

Fej was an employee of the Droid Depot. After a droid repair technician dropped cargo on Batuu following an attack by the Guavian Death Gang, Mubo replaced them with her, refusing to fire her. She was apparently a friend of the technician.

An individual was a Jedi Master in the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era when the Mirialan Vernestra Rwoh was a Jedi youngling. By 233 BBY, he was considered by Rwoh to be one of the older Jedi Masters, and died while in the middle of meditating.

Sylwin was a female Jedi Master stationed at a Jedi temple on the planet Batuu during the High Republic Era alongside her Padawan, Ady Sun'Zee. She was killed when the Ancient Sith Runestone they'd brought to the temple was inadvertently activated.

Gann was an Imperial officer of the Galactic Empire that held the military rank of admiral. During the Imperial Era, rebel agent Ahsoka Tano was tasked with assembling a strike force to capture the ruthless and hated Admiral Gann at their retreat on a distant world.
Dent was a human who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Dent worked aboard the second Death Star during its construction along with Bevelyn.
Attaman was a human who served under Lourna Dee as one of her lieutenants on her eponymously named cruiser as a part of the raider group the Nihil.
Ram Jomaram was a human male Jedi Knight who lived in the Valo Temple, on the planet Valo, during the High Republic Era. He was the Padawan of Ongree Jedi Master Kunpar Vasivola.
Ronn Blythe was a human male who lived during the High Republic Era. Born around 245 BBY, he was the son of Ottoh and Erika Blythe, and the older brother of Bailen.
The father of Zachary O'Halleran was an entrepreneur. He got Principal Mar demoted from Coruscant Jedi Academy and also got Mr. Zefyr fired once he started to notice his son's nonsense.

Marcus Augur was a pilot for the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. During the cleanup efforts of the Great Hyperspace Disaster's subsequent hyperspace debris Emergences in 232 BBY, Augur was on board a Longbeam cruiser with fellow pilot Beth Petters as they attem…
Beth Petters was a Republic pilot during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, Petters participated in cleanup efforts for the Great Hyperspace Disaster and its subsequent hyperspace debris Emergences.
Erika Blythe was a female human miner who was the mother of Bailen and Ronn and the wife of Ottoh Blythe. She and her husband had a homestead on the planet Elphrona.

Shesslaria was a human female skip tracer who was a member of the Interstellar Collections Limited and the credit recovery division of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. Her Undervine nullstring was 049x88108.
During the Imperial Era, an Anx informant operated on the planet Garel and reported to the former Jedi Ahsoka Tano.
Fezmix was a Bonbrak male who worked with the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram in his garage in Lonisa City during the High Republic Era. Jomaram considered him to be rowdy.
A Pantoran Assembly Representative was a politician and representative of the Pantoran Assembly, the governing body of the moon Pantora, a member of the Galactic Republic.
Kraz was a human male who inhabited the Tuanul village on Jakku.
Croz Danoc was a male mercenary sent to Twon Ketee by Regent Solculvis to stop Han Solo and his crew from hunting rathtars. He wore a set of gray and blue armor.

A Chiss female Patriel of the Chiss Ascendancy's Mitth family handled the family's affairs on the planet Rentor, around 39 BBY. Around that year, she was to meet and evaluate Kivu'raw'nuru, core name "Vurawn," a Rentor native who was a candidate to join to the Mitth.
Wen Delphis was the leader of the Sixth Kin criminal organization, operating out of the South Stretch Worker's District in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Remy was a Sullustan male smuggler. During the Imperial Era, Remy acquired a Path engine, a specialized hyperdrive utilized by the Nihil marauder operation during the High Republic Era.

The Ottegan First was a member of an Ottegan enclave on the planet Arthon. After the enclave assisted the explorer Lor San Tekka with mapping the location of lost Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, the Resistance attempted to evacuate the Ottegans.

Leric Schmireland was an explorer affiliated with the University of Coruscant. Around 532 BBY, Schmireland was commissioned by the Galactic Republic to catalogue planets, departing Coruscant with a team.
Kara Xoo was a female Quarren member of the Nihil. By the time of the Battle of Kur, she held the rank of Storm in Kassav's Tempest, commanding her own unit.

Epsilon 5 was a male stormtrooper of the First Order who piloted a TIE/fo space superiority fighter. Epsilon 5 participated in an attack on the Ottegan-populated world of Arthon, where the starfighter was one of two that escorted Kylo Ren's command shuttle.

Starstriker was a Dalnan diplomat who was a member of a delegation sent to attend the dedication of the Starlight Beacon space station. Starstriker attended dinner onboard the starship Steady Wing after it departed the planet Haileap.

A female individual was the wife of Ambassador Weft of the Dalnans, and the mother of Honesty Weft. A Corellian, she lacked the aversion to space travel and exploration that characterized most of Dalna's inhabitants, and it was her idea for Honesty to accompany his father on a…

Pere was an individual who served as a member of the Nihil pirates during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, Pere was part of a Storm led by the Quarren female Kara Xoo within the Tempest led by the Weequay male Kassav Milliko, and served aboard Xoo's ship, the Poisoned Barb.

Gravhan was a Chevin who worked for the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. Gravhan was an extremely strong individual who served in the Tempest under direction of the Weequay Kassav Milliko, where he held the rank of Storm and led his own team.

Dellex was a female cyborg who served as a Storm for the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. She always thought of herself as ugly and because of this, spent all of her money on shiny mechanical upgrades to make herself more beautiful.
Chiri was the name given by the Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros to an orange-furred handsy that lived on the jungle Outer Rim moon Wevo during the High Republic Era.

An urchin resided on the planet Corellia during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, he tried to rob the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra of her belt as she spent a night outside the crash pad of the smuggler Sana Starros.
Bellon was a Devaronian chef serving at Jamie Brasson's estate during the High Republic Era. He had a fiery temper, and committed over ten murders in the Begamor underworld.

Losha was a Loth-cat owned by the human Vukorah during her time operating as a bounty hunter. Around 3 ABY, Losha and the rest of Vukorah's tookas accompanied her when she made her way to Kirkeide Station to register for work with the hybroid Syphacc.

Lily Tora-Asi was a human female Jedi Knight who lived during the High Republic Era. Alongside her former Jedi Master, Arkoff, and her Padawan, Keerin Fionn, Tora-Asi was stationed on the remote planet Banchii, where she trained the Jedi younglings Nima Allets and Viv'Nia Nia'…
Hill Purpura was a human male who held the rank of commander in the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Blanch Sproull was a human mechanic in the Alliance to Restore the Republic, holding the rank of private. Sproull left the mining planet where they resided to join the Rebellion, believing in its cause.

When Jayko was running from Tan because he thought that he would hurt him, Tan finally caught up to Jayko and told him he wasn't going to hurt him because he got him famous, then he asked him to sign his book for his sister.

Deelguh was a male Rodian assassin and rogue Jedi who previously served the Jedi Order during the early Galactic Republic. As a Padawan, he trained alongside Taradon of Corellia, before Deelguh betrayed the Order and amassed several forces to raid kyber crystals.
Taradon, also known as Taradon of Corellia, was a male human Corellian who served as a Jedi Knight and ace during the early Galactic Republic.

Tobar Ka-Teen was an Ithorian male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Shortly after being named a Jedi Master, Ka-Teen was captured by the Black Sun bounty hunter Kallyx the Piner, and was tortured for weeks.

Faron was a male Rodian smuggler who was the drinking buddy of Willrow Hood. Hood repeatedly asked Faron for a job, and eventually Faron gave Hood a camtono that he was responsible for bringing to the planet Batuu.
Bexley was a being who flew a cloud car in Cloud City on Bespin. After Darth Vader arrived on the planet, she told Willrow Hood of his arrival.

Needa Kame was an Iktotchi Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the Republic Era. Around 900 BBY, Master Kame took a leave of absence from active duty in order to meditate and study the Force on the moon Iktotch.
Oorrl Morm was a male Ithorian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order, native to Ithor. Master Morm served on the Jedi planet Ossus, where he discovered a rare pontite crystal in the caverns on the planet.

Laqasa Trill was a female Devaronian Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who was a Jedi seeker and hunter. As a hunter, she followed an ecologist philosophy of only targeting overpopulated game species or predators targeting sentients.
A Gamorrean fighter fought another fighter in Carnita arena in 9 ABY. Gor Koresh bet on this fighter to win the fight but the fighter wasn't doing good.
"Echo Support" was a pilot that served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Sunnari Khall was a female Mirialan who served as the captain of the YT-1300 light freighter Deadnettle.

An individual served as the regional boss of the Haxion Brood criminal syndicate at the Ordo Eris asteroid base. By 14 BBY, the individual had been imprisoned by the Galactic Empire, which allowed Sorc Tormo to establish himself as the new regional boss.
Nan Hague was a female human information broker and member of the Nihil who lived during the High Republic Era. She joined the pirate organization along with her parents when she was a child.

The female Trandoshan Doshanalawook, later also known as "Chainbreaker," was a famous Wookiee liberator active during the Galactic Empire's Occupation of Kashyyyk. Chainbreaker's identity was kept secret and it was assumed by most that she was a Wookiee.
Moshra was a member of the Purge Troopers, a group of elite stormtroopers who enforced the Galactic Empire's rule in the Anoat sector on behalf of Governor Ubrik Adelhard, serving as a lieutenant.
Tel'kap was a Chadra-Fan scholar with an interest in economics and politics. Tel'kap found the Iron Blockade both disturbing and fascinating.

Giktoo Nelmo was a Lurmen Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. When the Jedi Cohmac Vitus and Orla Jareni brought back four statues which appeared to be dark side artifacts, Nelmo led a ritual in the Shrine in the Depths intended to purify the statues al…

Poreht La was a Lasat Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. An expert on ancient Force techniques, La was chosen alongside Giktoo Nelmo and Tia Mirabel by the Jedi High Council to assist in a ritual intended to purify a set of four statues brought to the …
Tia Mirabel was a human Jedi Master and archivist of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. As an archivist, Mirabel knew more about Force artifacts than anyone else in the Order.

Vishla was a member of the Byne Guild who ran a crew that utilized the starship Rushlight Equinox during the High Republic Era. She was a friend of Leox Gyasi, the captain of the Byne Guild transport Vessel.

Sylvestri Yarrow, nicknamed Syl, was a human female pilot and hauler who lived during the High Republic Era. The daughter of Chancey Yarrow, Sylvestri inherited her mother's starship, the Switchback, at the age of eighteen after Chancey's apparent death in a Nihil attack.

Shoja Ko was a human male crime lord of the Zenowai Crime Society during the Iron Blockade in the Galactic Civil War. Eventually a young smuggler was hired to kill the emissaries of the Zenowai Crime Society, which included Shoja.

Kosimas was a male Nothoiin who lived on Anoat. During the Iron Blockade, he tried to escape Earl Alner's rule, and was rescued by Corto Belrake and a young smuggler. He was later imprisoned on Pujool by Imperial purge troopers, and rescued again by the Smuggler.

Ela Radodan was a female officer of the Galactic Empire who held the military rank of lieutenant and was part of the Imperial forces left on Cloud City after the Duel on Cloud City. Her lover, Tal Veridian, was a rebel sympathizer.

Kelos was a male officer of the Galactic Empire that held the military rank of commander after the Duel on Cloud City. He served in the Imperial Military as part of the Imperial forces left on Cloud City.

The father of the Nihil pirate Nan was a male individual. When his daughter was young, he and his entire family joined the pirate organization. A friend of the Zabrak commander Hague, Nan's father said that he was as good a strategist as he had ever known.

Hague was an elderly male Zabrak who was a member of the Nihil pirate organization. An experienced commander, Hague took the young girl Nan as his student and ward after her parents, friends of Hague's, were killed in a raid.

Untabros Munkh was a Ugnaught male scrap dealer who lived in the Anoat sector during the Iron Blockade of the Galactic Civil War. He would often encounter the young smuggler leader of the Anoat Uprising.
Lillia Nahana was a human female spy who inhabited the Anoat sector. She was considered a master of disguise due to her ability to hide in plain sight.
Sheree was a human female who was one of eight crewmembers of Solar Array 22-X, a solar collection station located in the Outer Rim Territories' Hetzal system.
Mack was a member of Lourna Dee's Tempest and a Strike working under Cloud Ultident Margrona during the High Republic Era. Mack was also present at the Raid on Elphrona in 232 BBY.

Buggo was a male member of Lourna Dee's Tempest and a Strike working under Cloud Dent during the High Republic Era. He was the husband of Dent's second cousin. Buggo was present at the Raid on Elphrona in 232 BBY.
Ozgurk was a male Ugnaught who worked for Bohento Splinth during the Iron Blockade. Eventually a young smuggler, who was searching for Bohento, fought and killed Ozgurk.
Mama Scope was a Mirialan female sniper who inhabited the Anoat sector. She was considering a formidable leader, and one of the Rebels who served the longest in the sector.
Roen Torcher was a male bounty hunter active on Anoat during the Iron Blockade. Eventually a young smuggler was hired to kill the emissaries of the Zenowai Crime Society, which included Roen.
Ug'zok was an Ugnaught male tactician who inhabited the Anoat sector. He was considered an expert with personal energy shields, mines, and security systems.

Jonas Viron was a human male who served in the military of the Galactic Empire around the time of the Iron Blockade. Eventually a young smuggler, who was attacked by a Purge Team on Anoat, killed Jonas in the fight.

Zepashi was a Zabrak who was imprisoned on Burnin Konn by Imperial purge troopers. The Empire had suspected that he and Fryoto were affiliated with the Trade Spine League and knew of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine's death.

Corleque was a human who served in the Imperial Navy with the rank of admiral. In 3 ABY, Corleque and Administrator Sly Moore led a force of three Imperial II-class Star Destroyers while undertaking a mission assigned by Emperor Palpatine to kill the Sith Lord Darth Vader in R…
Kalo Sulman was an Artiodac who lived on the planet Sedri Minor, in a small agricultural colony that grew Vratixia renanicus.

Good Princess Chaia of Alderaan was a fairy tale character appearing in some songs and rhymes taught to younglings across the Core Worlds. Like the Ithorian pirate Bluebrow, Chaia's character was fictional, but rooted in fact.
A human male criminal who wore a red scarf was one of many people stranded at the Amaxine space station in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

Bo Bahaahaa was a Gotal who, along with Klen Hoofber, was in a standoff with IG-88. IG-88 claimed to have a bounty on Ba Bohaahaa, mispronouncing the Gotal's name to mislead Hoofber, who believed that in betraying and stunning Bahaahaa would share the bounty with IG-88.

Klen Hoofber was a Gotal who was with Bo Bahaahaa when they encountered the assassin droid IG-88. IG-88 told them there was a bounty on "Ba Bohaahaa" and he was taking that target dead or alive, not both beings.

Devo was a Valon Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple. In 231 BBY, they and other Jedi welcomed security forces sent by the Galactic Republic arriving for the world's Republic Fair.

Shonnatrucks was a Valon Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple. In 231 BBY, they and other Jedi greeted Galactic Republic security forces prior to the world's Republic Fair.
Kunpar Vasivola was an Ongree male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era, stationed at the Valo Temple on the planet Valo. He possessed chin tentacles.
Lege was a Valon Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order in the Outer Rim planet Valo's Jedi temple. In 231 BBY, they and other Jedi helped prepare for the world's upcoming Republic Fair.
Neeto Janajana was a male Sullustan who served as the co-pilot of the starship Switchback, alongside Sylvestri Yarrow.
Chancey Yarrow was a female human scientist, trader, and pirate who lived during the High Republic Era.
Velko Jahen was a Soikan female who served as an aide to the Galactic Republic head of the Starlight Beacon space station during the High Republic Era.
A human served as the captain of a luxury liner during the High Republic Era. He wore a satin-and-fur cloak and sported a goatee.

Li Yu was a human who led the Silver Knights. Served by a droid assistant named White, Li was a native of the largely independent Aakaash system of the Oplovis sector who was motivated by financial profit.

During the High Republic Era, a Rodian acquired a set of sacred idols from a primitive planet. The Rodian, who apparently had aims to be worshipped as a god, hired the starship Vessel, crewed by Leox Gyasi and Geode, to transport himself and the idols to the planet.

Nevakka was a Wookiee male infant lived during the High Republic Era. When hyperspace travel was being permitted again in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, the child and his parents traveled aboard the passenger starship Journeyman when it departed Cerea.

t: Unidentified captain of the Ranoraki family's personal guard
x: A individual served as the captain of the Ranoraki family's personal guard, protecting their compound on Hetzal Prime.

A pilot served in the Resistance during its war with the First Order. In 35 ABY, this pilot served under the callsign Alpha Three in the climatic Battle of Exegol, where the pilot was shot down and killed.

A pilot served in the Resistance during its war with the First Order. In 35 ABY, this pilot served as under the callsign Delta Leader in the Battle of Exegol, where the pilot was shot down and killed.
A pilot served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during Galactic Civil War with the Galactic Empire.

Fhaen was a officer of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army. During the Galactic Civil War, Fhaen held the military rank of lieutenant and commanded a company of stormtroopers on New Valis fresh out of the Imperial Academy.

Ette Shi'lou was a female officer of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Alliance Army. During the Galactic Civil War, Shi'lou held the military rank of captain and commanded a platoon of the Marine Corps for several years.
Torret was a Pamarthen pilot who competed in the Gauntlet, a starship race run by Han Solo on Corellia.
Heiwei Akrone was a human male TIE pilot who served as a commanding officer in the Galactic Empire's Banshee Squadron. His brother, Alois Akrone, was also a pilot.
Weller was a member of the Galactic Empire who served as a Wing Officer on Imperial-class Star Destroyer Solar Storm.
Masil Veit was a human male lieutenant who served as a communications officer in the Galactic Empire aboard the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Executor.
A lieutenant served the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era, stationed onboard the cruiser Third Horizon as a bridge officer.
The queen of the Geonosian Stalgasin hive appointed a new archduke after Poggle the Lesser was killed.

A Dug worked on the Galactic Republic's Republic Security Zone Monitoring Satellite 777B-Alpha during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, the Dug was on monitoring duties when an Emergence spurred by the Great Hyperspace Disaster occurred.

A Kel Dor gambler was present at the establishment Winker's on the Cerberon system planet Verzan during the New Republic's campaign in the system. The Kel Dor and another gambler, a Vurk, attempted to scam the New Republic pilot Chass na Chadic of her B-wing starfighter.
An Aleena operated a combination soup stand and illicit comm station on the planet Catadra during the time of the New Republic's campaign in the Cerberon system.
A male individual was the nephew of a smuggler who moved supplies for the Galactic Empire in the Cerberon system during the time after the Battle of Endor.
Nan Moyou was the youngest daughter of Nan Holi. She held a company position from the age of fifteen.
Nan Qianyu was the head of the Nan Ming Capital company during the High Republic Era.
Nan Holi was a member of the Land & Sky Corporation. Nan extensively studied the Force and was cautious for his life, however, he was eventually murdered in 200 BBY.
Jaun was a major in the New Republic's military during the Galactic Civil War, serving in General Hera Syndulla's battle group.
Chloa was a human female who lived in the city of Tavuu on the planet Radhii at the time Emperor Palpatine was reported dead and the second Death Star was destroyed.
Liswarr'arindoo was a Wookiee who traded a bottle of Kowakian rum for the Trandoshan Doshanalawook's cracked egg.

A female Cerean was a member of the Rebel Alliance who was imprisoned by Imperials on the planet Radhii. She and other four members escaped and hide in the Zoess, a large forest near the city Tavuu. The Imperials hired Gorlan Seba to help them find them.

Ho'ror'te was an admiral of the New Republic Defense Fleet who served during the Galactic Civil War. During a New Republic High Command meeting, in 5 ABY, Ho'ror'te spoke of the sacrifices of the Unerring and its escorts undertook to destroy a conspiracy that had been orchestr…
Riccarn was a human stormtrooper who served in the Sith Lord Darth Vader's personal legion, the 501st Legion.
Ella was a human stormtrooper in the 501st Legion, the Sith Lord Darth Vader's personal legion. The trooper served in a fireteam alongside fellow stormtroopers Riccarn, Tig, Xander and Deena Lorn.

Xander was a human stormtrooper who served in the 501st Legion, the personal legion of the Sith Lord Darth Vader. The trooper was part of a fireteam with fellow stormtroopers Ella, Riccarn, Tig and Deena Lorn.

A female individual was the fiancée of Kendal Ozzel. She had loyalties to an anti-Imperial rebel force and attempted to recruit Ozzel to her side, though he had already decided his loyalty was to the Empire. Thus, their wedding was called off, and they never saw each other again.
An Aeosian healer hailed from a village on the Outer Rim planet Aeos Prime. By 34 ABY, the healer and many other Aeosians were killed when the First Order attacked the village.
A male individual came to be the father of the Palliduvan Aurra Sing, though she never knew him.

A Sullustan was the subject of a bounty for the bounty hunter Boba Fett in 3 ABY after the Sullustan broke a contract with Jabba the Hutt. Whilst in pursuit of the Sullustan, Fett was summoned by Darth Vader for a new job, and passed his current job to a rookie.

A male rookie bounty hunter was on the payroll of Jabba the Hutt in 3 ABY. After fellow bounty hunter Boba Fett was summoned by Darth Vader for a new job, he passed his current bounty, a Sullustan who had broke a contract with Jabba, onto the rookie.

Oultovar Misk was a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, commanded the freighter Diamond Tor in a convoy that operated under the protection of the Yomo Council, a faction which had broken away from the Empire.

Ghordansk was a pilot who flew in the New Republic's Flare Squadron. Along with the rest of the squadron, Ghordansk accompanied Starfighter Commander Wyl Lark to investigate a damaged Imperial convoy.

Bartol was a human boy who lived in an agricultural colony on the planet Sedri Minor during the High Republic Era. He had friends named Reff and Julus. Bartol encountered Jedi Knight Keeve Trennis in a field of Vratixian barley while she was investigating there.
Reff was an individual known to the human boy Bartol who lived in a colony on the Outer Rim planet Sedri Minor during the High Republic Era.

Julus was a Rodian male who lived on Sedri Minor during the High Republic Era. He was a friend of Bartol, who considered him funny. Julus was eventually taken by Drengir who had infested the planet, becoming one of four colonists to disappear.

Kalen was a delegate of the Galactic Senate during the reign of the Galactic Republic. During Kalen's first visit to the Republic capital planet Coruscant, where the senate was based, he jumped into an open-topped air taxi while late for an appointment, becoming a famous excep…

FS-451, was a human male stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. Along with Deena Lorn, he was selected to escort Darth Vader to Cloud City. FS-451 was a cruel individual, which disturbed fellow stormtrooper, Deena Lorn, who soon defected.

Tig was a human female stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. She was knocked off a platform in the Cloud City carbon-freezing chamber by the Wookiee Chewbacca before Captain Han Solo was frozen in carbonite, though she was unharmed.

A Zabrak once encountered Kes Dameron during his time out in space. The Zabrak claimed to be a Jedi, though Dameron was unsure if the Zabrak had been telling the truth. Dameron later told his son Poe a story of the encounter.
A male individual was the brother of Titan Squadron pilot Rella Sol. When the Imperial Senate was dissolved, Sol's parents, who were both senators, sent their signets to Sol and her brother.
Vap Tomulus was a human male individual who represented the bounty hunters Zuckuss and 4-LOM when the two claimed to be starting a charity foundation for orphaned children.

Chen Yao was the corporate president of Fire, a space station and city of the Aakaash system. Born to great wealth, Chen lacked the ambition and scheming nature of Zhang Jincheng, a general district manager of Fire.

A clone trooper served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars and fought in its first military conflict, the First Battle of Geonosis, as part of the first batch of combat-ready clone troopers created on Kamino.
"Dragon head" was a pirate and the leader of the Blue Dragon band.
Soontir Fel was a human Imperial Starfighter Pilot who became a Baron of the Empire and led the elite Imperial TIE Interceptor squadron Saber Squadron.

A Nihil sniper lived during the High Republic Era. A humanoid individual with red skin and black tattoos, the sniper wore grey pants and boots with kneepads and a green sash, as well as shoulder armor, a bandolier and a breathing mask.
An alien male individual served as a member of the Nihil marauders, within the crew of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's ship, the Gaze Electric.
Brashan was a governor of the Inner Rim planet Fedovoi End and a member of the Yomo Council, a breakaway faction from the Galactic Empire after its defeat at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.
Tuluh was a general in the Yomo Council, a faction that broke away from the Galactic Empire after the latter's defeat at the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY and took control of the planet Fedovoi End.
Coora was an individual who served as a cadet within the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War.
Heirorius was an male who served as a lieutenant within the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, which was part of the loyalist forces of the Galactic Empire.
Njock was an individual who served as a major within the Galactic Empire, serving on Fedovoi End. When the Yomo Council usurped the Empire, Njock claimed to have protested the split from the Empire.

Nisteen Arvad was a female individual who served as a commander and executive officer to the captain of the New Republic Star Destroyer Deliverance. During a sabotage of the Deliverance, Arvad was temporarily missing whilst sabotage droids wreaked havoc on the ship.
Starzha was a female pilot who served as a squadron commander of Squadron Two within the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, which was part of the loyalist forces of the Galactic Empire.

Armenauth was a male pilot who served as a squadron leader of Squadron Four and held the military rank of captain within the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, which was part of the loyalist forces of the Galactic Empire.

Bordanivaux was a female governor who served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Being in charge of the planet Chadawa, she split her government from the Empire by 5 ABY. Around that year Colonel Madrighast and his forces fled to Chadawa after taking many losses.
Si-Flachitt was a general within the New Republic's military leadership who led a division in the New Republic Defense Force during the Galactic Civil War.

Essovin was a Trandoshan female pilot who flew in the New Republic's Flare Squadron as Flare Leader. Along with the rest of the squadron, Essovin accompanied Commander Wyl Lark to investigate a damaged Imperial convoy.
According to a story told by Acolyte of the Beyond Vaneé, Cranwell was a human and the assistant to scientist Restin of the Tarkin Initiative.

Jaith Omir was a human male pilot who flew in the New Republic's Hail Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, he flew a BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber under the callsign Hail Three.

Jiona was a female pilot who flew in the New Republic's Hail Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, she flew a Y-wing under the callsign Hail Ten during a battle with the 204th Imperial Fighter Wing over the planet Chadawa.
Genni Avremif was a male pilot who flew in the New Republic's Hail Squadron during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, they flew a Y-wing under the callsign Hail Six during the Hunt for Shadow Wing.
Boyvech Toons was a veteran pilot who flew in the New Republic's Hail Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Irizi'in'daro, known by her core name Ziinda, was a Chiss female who served as a Senior Captain in Picket Force Six of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. The commander of the warship Grayshrike, Ziinda was the most driven and focused officer in Admiral Ar'alani's fleet.
Evroes'ky'mormi, core name Oeskym, was a Chiss male who served the Chiss Ascendancy as the weapons officer aboard the Vigilant, commanded by Admiral Ar'alani.
Korgan was a Trandoshan hunter. The Trandoshan led a hunt on a village of Wookiees on the planet Kashyyyk during a Life Day celebration at some point by the year 32 BBY.
Brennonn was a Wookiee who resided on the planet Kashyyyk. She became friends of the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn sometime between 68 BBY and circa 58 BBY, when he was still a Jedi Padawan.
A male bounty hunter was the ally of Biran Redben and a group of two other hunters, a Kajain'sa'Nikto and a short alien similar in appearance to Scrapjaw Motito.

"Spitsy" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, nicknamed as such by the pilots of the New Republic due to the characteristics of their flying that distinguished them from other TIE pilots.

"Brew" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, nicknamed as such by the pilots of the New Republic due to the characteristics of their flying that distinguished them from other TIE pilots.

"Dizzy" was the nickname of a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing, nicknamed as such by the pilots of the New Republic due to the characteristics of their flying that distinguished them from other TIE pilots.
Lourgh T'oknell was a Morseerian male pilot who held the rank of lieutenant in the New Republic's Flare Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Itina was a pilot who held the rank of lieutenant in the New Republic's Wild Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
Hellip was an fleet commander who served in the New Republic's fleet during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Thren was a male individual who was one of Yrica Quell's several brothers. In 11 ABY, he lived in Santrapei, and sent his sister, who was living in a house on Spirana, a bottle of brandy.
A female individual came to be the mother of 204th Imperial Fighter Wing pilot Palal Seedia and her twin sister.
A female pilot from the planet Polyneus left their homeworld to join the Rebel Alliance as part of the Hundred and Twenty.

Tareesh was a man who was involved with Senator Wyl Lark during the reign of the New Republic. In 9 ABY, they briefly met Chass na Chadic and Yrica Quell, pilots who had served with Lark in the New Republic's Alphabet Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.

Zephyr was a human male Elder from the planet Polyneus.. In 5 ABY Wyl Lark contacted Zephyr after leaving Chass na Chadic in the hangar after the skirmish at the Circus of Mortal Appetites to express his desire to return home and relayed General Syndulla's assurances that the …
A female Imperial served as the commander of the starship Panaka as part of the Coruscant blockade in 5 ABY.

Gargovik was a human TIE fighter pilot in Squadron Three of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the New Republic. In 5 ABY, Gargovik was one of Captain Wisp's TIE pilots based on the bulk freighter Yadeez.
Garthun was a Trandoshan pilot who flew in the Rebel Alliance's Riot Squadron. Garthun was one of fellow pilot, Wyl Lark's first comrades in Riot Squadron during the Galactic Civil War.
A Mizi male served as the captain of a starship that hauled cargo during the time of the High Republic Era.

A Mizi individual lived during the High Republic Era, serving on a Mizi starship that carried cargo. The Mizi's vessel was one of several that were left stranded in a star system after the Great Hyperspace Disaster led to the closure of hyperspace routes.

Prima Wessex was a female human information broker who worked for the Whisper Network. She authored an entry in the logbook known as the Smuggler's Guide, where she recounted an encounter with Sam Kenzie on Hosnian Prime.
A stormtrooper served as a cold weather assault stormtrooper and Stormtrooper Commander with the military rank of captain within the 501st Legion.

Shalla Ro was an Evereni female of the Ro family who led the Nihil pirate group as the Eye of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. She was the daughter of the Nihil's founder, and had a son named Asgar Ro with an Evereni male. Asgar later fathered his own son, Marchion.

Durge was a fearsome male Gen'Dai bounty hunter who was active during the Clone Wars and Imperial Era. Durge was involved in the war by working for the Confederacy of Independent Systems against the Galactic Republic.

An Ortolan bartender worked on the planet Dol'har Hyde. She once met the Sullustan smuggler Remy and was not impressed by him unwisely bragging to a roomful of smugglers about one of his finds, which the bartender regarded as a common piece of junk.

Hadrios was a male pilot of the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, Hadrios was assigned to General Hera Syndulla's task force as part of the Deliverance starfighter wing, which was tasked with hunting the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.
Zak Arranda was a human who, along with Tash Arranda, encountered a cult and a mysterious artifact after sneaking off to investigate a cave.
Tash Arranda was a human who, along with Zak Arranda, encountered a cult and a mysterious artifact after sneaking off to investigate a cave.

An Anzellan crewmember worked on the Solar Array 22-X in the Hetzal system in 232 BBY. The Anzellan was knocked unconscious after a piece of the Legacy Run collided with the station. Captain Finial Bright found the Anzellan, and moved the crewmember to the Aurora IX.

A Falleen guard served the criminal organization Black Sun during the Clone Wars. The guard was captured on Mustafar by Quinlan Vos and Asajj Ventress during a turf war with the rival organization Pyke Syndicate.

Xaime was a soldier of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was stationed at Echo Base on Hoth at the time of the Imperial attack on the base. Xaime and another trooper, Anita, entered into a relationship during their time on Hoth.

Anita was a soldier of the Alliance to Restore the Republic who was stationed at Echo Base on Hoth at the time of the Imperial attack on the base. Anita and another trooper, Xaime, entered into a relationship during their time on Hoth.
Kong Zhang was a Hutt that was secretly in league with the Land & Sky Corporation.

Xia Yan was a member of the Security Bureau, a branch of the Land & Sky Corporation. When the Jedi Master Mostima and her Padawan Sean traveled to the Aakaash system to investigate the death of Nan Holi, Xia detained them and told them to drop their investigation.
An Ping was the leader of red apricot squad of the Silver Knights.
Lu Nan was the female sniper of the Silver Knights' red apricot squad. She had short black hair. Sean considered her to be a peerless shot but a poor Cook.
Xu Bo was the medic of the Silver Knights. In 200 BBY, he was thirty-seven years old but was noted to look closer to seventy-three due to his drug problem.

Zhuang Yuanying was the mechanic of the Silver Knights' red apricot squad. She had a shy and gentle personality and wore a large hat to hide her horns in order to pass for a human. She also had seven WB-35 mechanic droids that helped her with ship maintenance.
Zhang Jincheng was the manager of the space station Fire during 200 BBY.
A scout was a male human, and a member of the Mandalorian Guard who served the New Mandalorians during the Clone Wars. Around 21 BBY, he was sent to spy on a base of the Death Watch on Concordia.
Shymon was a human female TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. In 5 ABY, the fighter wing was pursued by New Republic forces led by General Hera Syndulla.
Oslord was a Jedi Master who was active during the High Republic Era. Master Oslord was responsible for teaching younglings in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
An individual was the manager of Dark Sky district six.
An individual was the manager of Dark Sky district nine.
A human served as a general in the Galactic Empire's Military. During the Imperial Era, the general was stationed on Darth Vader's Venator-class Star Destroyer.
Reeta was a Rodian who lived during the High Republic Era. By 232 BBY, they lived on the Outer Rim planet Sedri Minor as part of a colony with their partner Neeso and the two's son, Julus.

An Imperial major was second in command Darth Vader searching the rebels on the planet K43. When the Kakrans attacked Vader and his stormtroopers he ran away to their shuttle. Later he was choked by Vader for his cowardice.

The Kakran grandmother was the matriarch of the Kakran rock people of the Wild Space planet K43. A gigantic female of the species who is the size of a moon, she travels the galaxy with her people looking for peaceful places where she can rest.

This Imperial lieutenant was a human who served in the Imperial Military. After the mission, when a squad of Death troopers destroyed a Rebel laser cannon, they wanted to execute the three survivors because of their commander's death.

Eridan Wesyse was a male COMPNOR bureaucrat appointed by the Galactic Empire as editor-in-chief for the Coruscant newsroom of HoloNet News, to replace Mandora Catabe due to her anti-Imperial views, as part of increasing propaganda pressure on the press and media.

affiliation: Land & Sky corporation board of directors
x: Nan Qiwen was an elderly member of the Land & Sky Corporation board of directors' secretariat.

Ariole Yu was a human male who served as a lieutenant in the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis. He was romantically involved with Just Lucky, an assassin who undertook jobs for the Sixth Kin for some time.
Alfar Sholt was human who was the owner of multiple casinos in the city of Canto Bight. Sholt often bought up the debts of others, subsequently forcing them to work in the casinos.
Egga was a member of the Nihil pirates who held the rank of Strike in Lourna Dee's Tempest, serving under the Cloud Ultident Margrona.
Rel was a member of the Nihil pirates who held the rank of Strike in Lourna Dee's Tempest, serving under the Cloud Ultident Margrona.
Taquana was a member of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing during the Galactic Civil War.

Tulana Tuluith was an individual who died by the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY. While the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing fought a New Republic starfighter wing at the battle, the pilots on each side called out names of their lost comrades over an open comm channel, T…
Kalvan Oliq was an individual who died because of the New Republic by the time of the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.
