Kharulu Neen was an individual who died as a result of the New Republic's actions by the time of the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.
Perush-anon Seedia was an individual who died at the hands of the New Republic by the time of the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

Darita was a human female who served as a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. She was with Shadow Wing during the Battle at Chadawa and was killed during the Battle of Jakku.
Fra Raida was a human female who served as a TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing.

Alchor Mirro was a male engineer who served in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. An elderly ground crew chief of Shadow Wing by the time of the Battle at Chadawa, he had tried to retire three times before the Battle of Endor already.

Conna Dew was a human Elder from the planet Polyneus. She was an Elder of Cliff, the birthplace of New Republic pilot Wyl Lark. Lark had called Dew his friend since he'd been fourteen years old, ever since she had caught and scolded Lark for spying on a stranger's wedding feast.

A male from the planet Polyneus was the former caretaker of Conna Dew. According to her, some time after the Battle of Jakku but before 11 ABY, this male had decided to become a Sun-Lama at the age of ninety-nine.

Sliblis was a male individual who served in the Galactic Empire's navy aboard the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Ravager during the Galactic Civil War. In 5 ABY, the Ravager was stationed with much of the Empire's loyalist forces at the planet Jakku.

Strannos was a member of the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing who served during the Galactic Civil War. While sleeping, Strannos tended to snore, a noise which the engineer Alchor Mirro always shut out by sleeping with a pillow over his ears.
Ern was a human from the planet Polyneus who lived in Ridge. By the time of Wyl Lark's return to Ridge some time after the Battle of Jakku but before 11 ABY, Ern had died.

Yanda was a human from the planet Polyneus who lived in Ridge. She used to carry cider to the houses of Ridge herself but by the time of Wyl Lark's return to Ridge some time after the Battle of Jakku but before 11 ABY, she sent children to do it instead.
Stam Groundling was a human from the village of Tor on the planet Polyneus. They were one of the Hundred and Twenty Polyneans that were sent to fight the Galactic Empire.

A vizier of Emperor Palpatine in the Galactic Empire, this individual orchestrated a conspiracy, which was destroyed by Admiral Ho'ror'te under great sacrifices of the Unerring and its escort ships shortly before the Battle of Jakku in 5 ABY.

Calioc was a Duros female and a fan of podracing. She was the benefactor of the podracer Korlen Skimmer during the Galactic Civil War but became fearful of her her investment in Skimmer when the Galactic Empire took an interest in Skimmer.

A male individual was the husband of Darita, a TIE pilot and captain in the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing. Darita was killed during a battle, around 5 ABY. That year, Darita's husband was stationed with Imperial loyalist forces on the planet Jakku.

Dhina was a Cathar female who worked as a comscan officer aboard the New Republic Imperial-class Star Destroyer Deliverance. She worked aboard the command bridge and answered directly to General Hera Syndulla.
Lorrir was a human Imperial Starfighter Pilot who flew a TIE Interceptor at Brentaal IV during combat against T-65B X-wing starfighters and held the military rank of lieutenant.
Netrem Pollard was a pilot who flew a B-wing starfighter under the callsign Dagger Leader.

Kantam Sy was a non-binary human Jedi Master during the High Republic Era who was once the Padawan of Grand Master Yoda and later taught their own apprentice, Lula Talisola, whom they rescued on Naboo while on a walkabout from the Jedi Order.
Omega was an enhanced human female clone, created from the genetic template of the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett, who lived in the years following the Clone Wars.
Far-ji was a Boss of the criminal organization known as the Screaming Talons during the Galactic Civil War. In that period, Far-ji had a feud with other gangs.

Kyja Cho was a noble and art thief during the Galactic Civil War, a galaxy-wide conflict between Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Cho was the owner of a rare krayt dragon pearl, which held an auction for on her sail barge, the Azure Sunset.

A Hutt trader of the Hutt Clans dealt in the vratixia renanicus barley near the galaxy's Periphery. In 232 BBY, the Hutt bought a shipment of vratixia renanicus from Sedri Minor, an isolated agriworld of the Periphery, and traveled with the shipment aboard a transport through …

Gork was a male Rodian who was gambling when Clariah's son Jiandy asked to gamble with them. After Jiandy won and the others lost many credits, Jiandy thanked Gork and called him "uncle." Gork claimed that he had never seen the child before but the others started to beat him up.
Nicobar was a human male who served as an Imperial Navy ensign aboard an Imperial defense station in the Nuvar system.

Rodor Keen was a human male who served as the Galactic Republic head of operations aboard the Starlight Beacon space station. He worked alongside Jedi Master Estala Maru, though the two's similarly hands-on natures led to tension between them.
Okana was a female Ovissian who worked as a junior nurse aboard the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon when it began operations.

Ghal Tarpfen was a Mon Calamari female who held the rank of Chief as Head of Security at the Galactic Republic's Starlight Beacon space station. Born on the waterworld of Mon Cala, she served as part of the Mon Calamari Guard but left when her lover, King Shenrick, betrayed her.

Gino'le was a male Anacondan doctor who served as the Chief of Medical Operations on board the Galactic Republic space station Starlight Beacon. He outfitted himself with cybernetic limbs in order to better care for patients.

The father of Velko Jahen was a male Livtak Soikan. Originally fighting for the Livtak Union in the conflict encompassing Soika, he defected to the Gagic Alliance after realizing they were planning something he disapproved of.
The mother of Velko Jahen was a female Gagic Soikan. Her daughter with a Livtak defector inherited the typical coloration of a Livtak.

Lira Hardin was a female native of the astronomical object Gall. Long before the Separatist Crisis, Hardin left her native Gall for the Judicials of the Galactic Republic, where she was trained as a combat engineer, becoming a part of the Republic's 9th Engineering Battalion.

Jans Coorsa was a male native of the planet Gall, in which he ruled as Cacique of a small clan of a few thousand in the years preceding the Clone Wars. His people acted as supervisors in factories, where they made parts for capital ships produced by Rothana Heavy Engineering.
Morlimur Snugg was a Snivvian superintendent who worked aboard the InterGalactic Banking Clan's Cybloc Transfer Station.

An Ewok was one of the prospective candidates considered by Count Dooku and Jango Fett as the prime clone for the Grand Army of the Republic. He wore a traditional Mandalorian buy'ce helmet over his traditional Ewok hood.

An Ortolan pirate was a member of the Nihil. The pirate worked at the battle rink onboard the baseship Gaze Electric, and in that capacity met Krix Kamerat and Tromak when they were forced to compete in the games there, asking which one would ride a bogaranth and which one wou…

The Great Progenitor was the first of the Drengir, a species of sentient carnivorous plants. Around 2500 BBY, the Drengir formed an alliance with the Sith, and for a time they worked alongside each other, until around the same year when the Sith trapped the Great Progenitor ab…

OrbaLin was a Ugor male Jedi Master and archivist during the High Republic Era. Serving aboard the Starlight Beacon space station, OrbaLin led the autopsy of a Hutt trader whose corpse had been found on a derelict starship after a Nihil attack.

Myarga Anjiliac Atirue, known as Myarga the Benevolent, Myarga the Merciless, Myarga the Blessed, or Myarga the Beautiful, was a cyborg Hutt female who represented the Hutt Cartel during the time of the High Republic Era.
A male actor played the Sith Lord Darth Krist-Ov in a play with actress Risha Synata, who portrayed a Jedi.

Meggal was a captain in service to the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, the captain commanded a Longbeam cruiser during efforts to rescue victims of the Great Hyperspace Disaster and subsequent hyperspace debris Emergences, working in a team with the…
Feyn Gospic was a human who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War, holding the military rank of colonel within the Massassi Group.
An individual was the second cousin of the Nihil Cloud Dent. By 232 BBY, they were married to Buggo, a male Strike who served under Dent's command, which led her to consider Buggo family of a sort.

Zoovler Tom was a male Ugnaught who held the rank of Storm in Lourna Dee's Tempest of the Nihil during the High Republic Era. Cloud Ultident Margrona reported to him when the raid she was leading on Elphrona began to go sideways due to Jedi intervention.
Fur-Bite was a member of the Blazing Claw pirate group that sailed under Captain Gunda Mabin on the Bloody Bones.

Tu-Wane Jipps was a Volpai musician who was a gambling partner of the criminal Tobias Beckett. He came to owe Beckett a favor after some nasty business on Malkii and also fell into debt with the Hutts.

Glunge was a Gloovan bounty hunter active during the Galactic Civil War. Around 0 ABY, he worked with fellow bounty hunter Takvax and the swoop racers Kuru and Makta in order to try and claim a bounty on the smuggler Han Solo during a swoop race on the planet Rion.
Csap'ro'strob, known as Apros, was a Chiss male who held the rank of Mid Captain aboard the warship Grayshrike, serving as the first officer of Senior Captain Irizi'in'daro.

Takvax was a gray-skinned alien bounty hunter who was an associate of the swoop racer Kuru. In around 0 ABY, the pair were on the planet Rion when they encountered the smuggler Han Solo, who had a large Imperial bounty on his head.
Scram was a Gloovan gangster who led the Scram Gang during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire.
Kiren was a non-binary mechanic who worked in Cloud City on Bespin alongside their coworker, Baudu. The trio of Kiren, Baudu, and their friend Tal Veridian were opposed to the Galactic Empire.
Coduyo'po'nekri, also known by the core name of Yoponek, was a Chiss male of the Coduyo family and the betrothed of Yomie. Yoponek was a student of history.

Xodlak'phr'ooa, also known by the core name Lakphro, was a male Chiss individual who served as a rancher. Lakphro was married to Lakansu and the pair had a daughter named Lakris. The family lived in Redhill province on the planet Celwis.
Xodlak'uvi'vil, also known by the core name Lakuviv, was a Chiss male who served as a Councilor within the Chiss Ascendancy on the planet Celwis.
Exum Jermit was a Muun who served as Second Vice Chair of the InterGalactic Banking Clan and frequented the Malastare Hunting Club, who would treat them lavishly for their loyalty to them.
TK-9102 was the designation of a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire.

Sheravin was a human who held the rank of admiral in the Galactic Empire. When Beol De'Rruyet, founder of De'Rruyet Industries, planned to unveil a replicated Nihil Path engine, Sheravin contacted Lady Domina Tagge of the Tagge Corporation on behalf of Emperor Palpatine, warni…

Di'reni was a Twi'lek female bartender and owner of Club Lazuli in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. The Twi'lek's club was under the protection of the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis.

Koz was a human criminal who operated in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He owed a large amount of money to the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis; as a result, Delphis sent one of her lieutenants, Ariole Yu, and the sniper Just Lucky, to conf…

A Hoopaloo lived during the High Republic Era. Between 241 BBY and 231 BBY, he worked alongside the monster hunter Ty Yorrick in a job on the Outer Rim planet Alzoc III. During the job, however, the Hoopaloo betrayed Yorrick and stole part of her arsenal.

A stormtrooper deserter was a former stormtrooper who deserted the Galactic Empire during a mission on the planet Aleen. He joined another stormtrooper deserter and resided on Nothoiin where they looked after an Aleena child.
Jherl was a human boy who lived in the city of Mock on the planet of Cerosha. He was killed by the Dark Wraith.
KT-1138, nicknamed "Kaity" and "Kaitlyn," was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order under General Hux.
A knight was stalked by Ry Nymbis on a night world. Nymbis choked the life from her and took her weapon to create his own.
Elad Zhalto was a male Duros who lived on Bespin and owned the Azure Den, an underground gambling spot on Cloud City.

A pirate was a member of a pirate gang that fought a battle in the Mirrin sector against the New Republic's Rapier Squadron. When Rapier Leader, Poe Dameron was captured he was sent to the pirate for interrogation.

The father of Affie Hollow was a human male who was in indentured servitude to the Byne Guild and its leader, Scover Byne. He was in a relationship with Hollow's mother, and the two of them piloted the starship Kestrel's Dive for the Guild.

Haplif was a telepathic male Agbui who served the Grysk Hegemony operative "Jixtus." Haplif possessed a talent for reading and analyzing cultures, which he proudly utilized in service to his employer.

Chaf'pri'uhme, core name Afpriuh, was a Chiss male who held the rank of Senior Commander in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. He served aboard the heavy cruiser Springhawk under Senior Captain Thrawn as weapons officer.

Laknym was a Chiss male of the Xodlak family who served the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, holding the rank of Lieutenant Commander. He served as a plasma sphere specialist aboard the Springhawk, a heavy cruiser commanded by Senior Captain Thrawn.
Erighal'ok'sumf, known by his core name Ghaloksu, was a Chiss male of the Erighal Great Family who held the rank of Senior Commander in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet.

The Magys was a female individual who held the title of Magys, ruling over her people. When her world was devastated in a civil war orchestrated by Haplif of the Agbui under the orders of the Grysk "Jixtus," the Magys and two hundred refugees escaped.
Xodlak'oo'nifis, core name Lakooni, was a Chiss female who was the Patriel of the planet Celwis, a stronghold of the Xodlak family. Lakooni held the rank of blood within the Xodlak family.

Xodlak'ji'iprip, core name Lakjiip, was a Chiss female of the Xodlak family who served as a Senior Aide to Councilor Xodlak'uvi'vil on the planet Celwis. She and Lakuviv were caught up in Haplif of Agbui's scheme to draw the Chiss Ascendancy into a civil war.

Yomie was a Chiss female of the Coduyo family and the betrothed of Coduyo'po'nekri. She and Yoponek embarked on a wandering year prior to their final education, choosing to travel the Chiss Ascendancy.
Ragon was a Besalisk doctor who had a history with Boba Fett, a bounty hunter. In 3 ABY, Ragon was working on Nar Shaddaa and assisted Fett with containing Han Solo in carbonite.
Wyrmen Lictor was a pit warrior who operated on Nar Kanji. Lictor was a successful warrior who, once she climbed to the top of the ranking, remained there as champion for a long time.
Irizi'emo'lacfo, core name Ziemol, was a Chiss male who held the title of Speaker in the Chiss Ascendancy's Chiss Syndicure, representing the Irizi family.

A female individual was the mother of human male historian and Resistance member Beaumont Kin. During Kin's involvement in the First Order's blockade of the planet Kashyyyk in 34 ABY, Kin claimed to Resistance pilot Daz Crano that his mother and father told him he was useless,…

A human male served as an Imperial stormtrooper on the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station. As the battle station entered firing range for its superlaser upon Yavin 4, the location of a hidden Rebel base, the stormtrooper was heading to his station.

Ceeril was a male Skembo who served as the Ambassador of Rion during the High Republic Era. While being treated for injuries at the Starlight Beacon space station, Ceeril attempted to frame some members of the Hassarian species, who were rivals of the Skembo, in an assassinati…
Cah Norne was an individual in charge of an engineering section onboard the Galactic Republic-Jedi Order space station Starlight Beacon.

A female Medoslean patient was being cared for at the Starlight Beacon's medcenter in the aftermath of the Great Hyperspace Disaster. While being treated by Doctor Gino'le and junior nurse Okana, the patient had a violent negative response to something she was administered.
Jjan was the leader of the Morubas Crime Family. In 19 BBY, Jjan captured Maul, leader of the Shadow Collective.

Krantz was a human member of the Morubas Crime Family. In 19 BBY, the Shadow Collective criminal alliance launched an attack on the Morubas stronghold after the family poisoned the Shadow Collective's leader, former Dark Lord of the Sith Maul, and took him hostage.

A Mon Calamari individual with orange skin and eyes was present in Dac City on the planet Mon Cala, wearing beige clothing. In 34 ABY, a Quarren sabotaged a shuttle that several members of the Resistance were planning on using to leave the planet.
A Quarren male saboteur sabotaged a shuttle on the planet of Mon Cala. The Quarren also served as the personal assistant to Chadkol Gee.
A shock trooper quartermaster served in the Coruscant Guard of the Galactic Republic's military branch during the Clone Wars.

A humanoid Jedi Master served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. At the end of the conflict, the Jedi was stationed in Tipoca City, the capital of Kamino, the planet where the Grand Army of the Republic's clone troopers had been created.

Ciddarin Scaleback, nicknamed "Cid," was a Mantellian Trandoshan female information broker, smuggler, and businesswoman whose career in the galactic underworld spanned the Galactic Republic Era into the early days of the Imperial Era.
Jonny the Sting was a pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.
Skullicon was a pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. The fighter was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.
Bigbot was a male pit warrior who operated on Nar Shaddaa. He was killed by Boba Fett as part of a mission to kill Wyrmen Lictor.
Edmon Rampart was a human male who held the rank of Vice Admiral in the Galactic Republic, and later Galactic Empire shortly after its formation.
Fauja was a female Aleena merchant who lived on the planet Saleucami at the beginning of the Imperial Era.

A clone trooper was involved in an altercation with the genetically altered clone Omega as well as the members of Clone Force 99. Like all clone troopers in the Grand Army of the Republic, this trooper was cloned from the template of Jango Fett.
A Snivvian male individual made an attempt to leave the planet Saleucami shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.
A Tah'Nuhnan individual lived on the Mid Rim planet Tah'Nuhna. Prior to the First Order's attack on the planet, the Tah'Nuhnan reflected on all the Tah'Nuhnan people had done.
ES-01 was the designation of a human male Elite Squad Trooper, one of the first conscripted soldiers of the Galactic Empire recruited via Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart's Project War-Mantle.
ES-04, also known as Firebrand, was the designation of a human female Elite Squad Trooper who served the Galactic Empire during the early days of the Imperial Era.

A human male refugee was promised transport off the planet Onderon by Saw Gerrera's Partisans. When CT-9904's elite squad hunted down and destroyed the Partisans camp, he asked the refugees for information. The refugee told him he that he had no information.
Udi Dis was a Talortai male who served the Nihil marauder organization. Having left his home of Talor, Dis had once been a soldier, carrying wingblades that were his only possession from his home.
Kufa was an elderly female Evereni who was a cousin of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro. She had tattoos on her face that resembled the lightning-bolt symbol of the Nihil marauder organization.

A human female fighter was part of Saw Gerrera's group of Partisans stationed on Onderon at around 19 BBY. While escorting a group of refugees off Onderon, her group was ambushed by CT-9904's Elite Squad, who were there to wipe out Gerrera and his Partisans.
Enowyn was a flight mechanic who dated Davin Novachez at Pilot Academy.
Sunshine was a tauntaun female that was kept at Echo Base on Hoth and was ridden by Jordan Smythe.
ES-02 was the designation of a human female Elite Squad Trooper who was recruited into the military of the Galactic Empire in its early foundation by Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart.
ES-03 was the designation of a human male of the Galactic Empire who was recruited early in its foundation by Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart.

Lenka Mok was a human female who was the Cruise Director aboard the MPO-1400 star cruiser Halcyon during the First Order-Resistance War. A cheerful individual and lover of adventure, she was inspired by the efforts of those who sought to bring peace to a tumultuous galaxy.
Sammie was a human male mechanic who served aboard the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon during the First Order-Resistance War.
Harman Croy was a human male lieutenant who served in the military of the First Order during its war with the Resistance.

The Fixer was a human male criminal who operated during the First Order-Resistance War. A smooth-talking schemer and intellectual, the Fixer used his charms to convince others to assist him in his illicit enterprises.

A genderless Sabetue individual accompanied Kilmo on Corellia to purchase coaxium from one of Lady Proxima's White Worms, the human male Han Solo. When Solo attempted to scam the group, the Sabetue tried and failed to prevent the human from fleeing.
Sandro Alimander was a male musician who lived in the galaxy during the First Order-Resistance War, embarking for the first time aboard the MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon.

A human male fighter was a member of the Partisans shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. Serving under Saw Gerrera, the fighter was one of many rebels who refused to accept the Empire's rule and went into hiding in Onderon's jungle.
Frosif was a female Agbui "mid-ager" aboard the Agbui starship on Celwis. She was Shimkif's daughter, and posed as the daughter of Haplif.

A female individual was a resident of the planet Nacronis. She was offworld when the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing destroyed the planet during Operation: Cinder, becoming a survivor of the genocide, which eradicated the population of Nacronis, including members…
A female individual was the director of the Reconciliation Project, an effort undertaken by the New Republic following its defeat of the Galactic Empire and the end of the Galactic Civil War.
Hadiss the Vaulted, also known simply as Hadiss, was archduke of the Stalgasin hive, a Geonosian hive on the planet Geonosis.
Eegrig was a Dathomirian Zabrak and a member of the Nightbrothers of Dathomir. He and the other members of his tribe served the Nardithi Nightsister Jerserra.

Ral Garas was a male Ishi Tib who served as an advisor to King Amand of the planet Molos. After the Battle of Yavin, with the support of the Rebel Alliance, Garas helped plan an uprising on the planet with the help of the Alliance sergeant Trask.
Raspar Six was a Sullustan depot manager who oversaw a refueling depot located in Ro Station on the moon Pantora.

A male Gran trader lived on the moon Pantora at the beginning of the Imperial Era. The fugitive clones Hunter and Echo visited his shop to sell some items for credits, but the merchant was not interested in the pyro denton explosive Hunter offered.
Vam Targes was an Aqualish engineer who operated during the High Republic Era. He was famed as an engineer, but had a reputation as being a strict taskmaster.
Isabalia was a female who lived in Cloud City on Bespin in the year 3 ABY. She idolized bounty hunters like Boba Fett, and was romantically interested in Joy Iya.
A female Pantoran vendor sold fruit in the central marketplace of a Pantoran city at the beginning of the Imperial Era.

Joy Iya was a female resident of Cloud City on Bespin in 3 ABY. A service worker who was concerned with workers' rights, she began organizing a citywide work stoppage to get the attention of Baron Administrator Lando Calrissian and other beings in charge of the city during the…

Caviness Thorn was a humanoid bounty hunter who led the Caviness Thorn crew. Around 5 BBY, Thorn took a bounty on the smuggler Han Solo and attempted to kill the smuggler on the planet Abregado-Rae but was thwarted by Solo's friend, the cyborg bounty hunter Beilert Valance.

Thaneespi was a Mon Calamari who served in the fleet of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 4 ABY, Thaneespi was first officer of the MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser Home One while present at a briefing shortly before the Battle of Endor.
Halka Four-Den was a female individual who served as an expert commander of a Galactic Republic Alpha Team during the Republic Era.

Ruggle Schmong was a Sullustan male shipwright who developed the idea of funneling energy generated by a starship's propulsion systems back into its weapon systems of batteries, where it would be reutilized by the vessel.

Deland Tyerell was an Aleena and the son of the podracer Ratts Tyerell, who was killed during the Boonta Eve Classic in 32 BBY. After his father's death, Deland founded the Ratts Tyerell Foundation, an organization dedicated to exposing the dangerous aspects of podracing.

Mett Habble was a human who served in the Royal Naboo Security Forces. They died when Senator Padmé Amidala's ship was destroyed by Zam Wesell upon arriving to Coruscant so Amidala could vote on the Military Creation Act.
Porla was a Hutt male who lived on Boonta. Prior to becoming a pirate, the Weequay Hondo Ohnaka served Porla as a cupbearer and adviser.

Ryle Torsyn was a human who served as a pilot in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. While in the rebel base on the planet Dantooine, he discovered an Imperial tracking device in a delivery of equipment, which led to the base being evacuated.

Maxiron Agolerga was a human male who was Pontifex of the Brotherhood of Cognizance. In 22 BBY, he was one of only around twenty hermits in the order and became the first Pontifex to legitimise a marriage in over 300 years when he secretly officiated the wedding of Jedi Anakin…

Adar Tallon was a human individual that served with distinction in the armed forces of the Galactic Republic and subsequently as an officer of the Galactic Empire prior to his defection to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
a: Father of the Old Republic Navy

x: Gustab Wenbus was a fearless alien racer who started the modern age of podracing around a century before the Galactic Civil War by entering himself into an event on the planet Malastare with a super-fast podracer designed by the rogue mechanic Phoebos.

Sian Holt was a human female high-end private detective who operated during the High Republic Era. She was enlisted by Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic to investigate a mystery with ties to the Jedi Order, encountering the Jedi Emerick Caphtor, who was undertaking …
Emerick Caphtor was a human male Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Caphtor was tasked with investigating the mysterious death of Loden Greatstorm on the planet Grizal.

Bokku was a Hutt who served on the Grand Hutt Council of the Hutt Clan during the Imperial Era, operating from a lair in the Outer Rim Territories. He employed Gamorreans, Bith, a Nikto, and a Klatooinian. He also had regular contacts in the Galactic Empire.
A male Zygerrian worked as the auctioneer for the Zygerrian Slave Empire's Royal Slave Auction in 20 BBY, at which he introduced the 50,000 enslaved Togruta from the Kiros system to the crowd.

Boz was a tauntaun who was the offspring of Murra, a tauntaun that was kept by the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Echo Base on Hoth. Leia Organa mentioned Boz to Murra while Luke Skywalker was lost in Hoth's wilderness.

Arno was a tauntaun who was the offspring of Murra, a tauntaun that was kept by the Alliance to Restore the Republic at Echo Base on Hoth. Leia Organa mentioned Arno to Murra while Luke Skywalker was lost in Hoth's wilderness.

FwittsinPru was a Troig spokesperson for the Obroan Oddsmakers. In a report made by the news organization Cynabar's InfoNet, FwittsinPru spoke on the behalf of the Obroan Oddsmakers and criticized the Alliance to Restore the Republic, blaming the Alliance for a mission which i…

Keelak was a tauntaun cow who was part of a herd of tauntauns that were captured and domesticated by the Rebels of Echo Base on Hoth. She eventually challenged Murra, the matriarch of the herd, for a leadership role, though their fight was eventually broken up by Leia Organa.

Pombo was a member of a herd of tauntauns that were captured and domesticated by the Rebel Alliance forces on the planet Hoth. Pombo was present when the herd's matriarch, Murra, was challenged by Keelak, another tauntaun in the herd.
Muchi was an adolescent female rancor owned by crime lord Jabba the Hutt. At some point, she was captured by Zygerrian enslavers and taken to the Mid Rim planet Ord Mantell.
Raney was a Zygerrian male who was the leader of a group of Zygerrian enslavers who operated on the planet Ord Mantell shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.
A boy was a Tusken Raider who belonged to a tribe and lived in a village on the planet Tatooine. According to legend, the boy was taken from his mother's arms by the krayt dragon, Krayt.

A female Tusken Raider was a warrior who belonged to a tribe and lived in a village on the planet Tatooine. According to legend, the warrior made it her destiny to find and kill Krayt for the destruction it caused.

A human was the father of Serj Ukkarian, and a passenger on the freighter Legacy Run, one of thousands of colonists moving to the Outer Rim Territories.They were in the twelfth division with their wife during the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

The mother of Serj Ukkarian was a female human. Along with their partner and son, they were one of thousands of colonists traveling to the Outer Rim Territories aboard the freighter Legacy Run when it was destroyed in the Great Hyperspace Disaster.

A female individual was the mother of Ruen, a human male who was a skilled technician. Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra came to know Ruen, claiming that the technician would be willing to sell his mother into enslavement to fund a project.

Hawser was a pirate and member of the Blazing Claw, serving under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as part of the crew of the Bloody Bones. Hawser participated in a raid against a Ghtroc star yacht on the Atrian Merchants' Causeway.
Puckwale was a pirate of the Blazing Claw. Puckwale served under the pirate queen Gunda Mabin as the navigator of the Bloody Bones.
Ratty-Ratty was a thief who was a member of Bandit Billie's crew. She participated in several of Bandit Billie's heists.

Reina Sarapinia was a duchess who met Lando Calrissian at the chance parlor on Makem Te. She left a card for him where she wrote a short note promising that she would always cover for his escapes. Calrissian however never received the card.
Mama Annie was a female custom spice chemist. Han Solo and Chewbacca were introduced to Mama Annie by Sonniod.
Wrollanppf, also known as One-Eyed Volant the Eviscerator, was a female Wookiee gladiator who was among the enslaved combatants at the Grakkus Arena on Nar Shaddaa.
Tova was a tauntaun and an old friend of Murra who was part of a herd of tauntauns that were captured and domesticated by the Rebels of Echo Base on Hoth.
A tauntaun female was the matriach of the herd which her daughter Murra later led.

Gallin Crae was a human male lieutenant in the Sixth Kin criminal organization, led by Wen Delphis. Highly loyal to Delphis, Crae was also the mentor of both Just Lucky and Ariole Yu, having trained them since they were young.

Ebann Drake was a human male arms dealer who led an arms-smuggling ring on Kaderin. He was a distant cousin of Lady Domina Tagge of the Tagge Corporation, whose company was privately involved with Drake.

A Falleen male was captured by a group of Zygerrian slave traders in 19 BBY. He, along with a human and a female Falleen child were kept by the slavers in the ruins of Old Ord Mantell City on the planet of Ord Mantell, overseen by the Zygerrian leader, Raney.

Habria was a female individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a commander. Along with Kell Tolkani, she was part of a team that scouted the planet Hoth in order to determine if it would be a suitable location for a Rebel base.

Ryssle was a female individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a meteorologist. Along with Kell Tolkani, Ryssle was part of a team that scouted the planet Hoth in order to determine if it would be a suitable location for a Rebel base.

Boonda was a reformed male Hutt criminal who held Rebel Alliance sympathies and operated a shipping business with his YT-2000 Light Freighter, the Vo Granee Droi, after failing to graduate from the Corulag Military Academy.
Luca was a smuggler who held Rebel Alliance sympathies and owned the YT-2000 Light Freighter Faithless.

Dana "Deke" Galvason was a female tramp freighter captain from Bakura who owned the YT-2000 light freighter Bakuran Blade, which she used to help the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Galvason was one of the few who had clearance to fly through the Deep Core Security Zone.
A female individual was the mother of Kendal Ozzel. They lived on the planet Carida.
This human male was the father of Kell Tolkani. He worked in a senior position in Incom Corporation.
This human female was the mother of Kell Tolkani. She worked in a senior position in Incom Corporation.
A female ambassador was sent by the Galactic Empire to the homeworld of the Contessa, whose family ruled the planet and turned the ambassador away.

A female was a commanding officer of the Galactic Empire. She was present on the planet Haruun Kal when ground forces led by Lieutenant Canonhaus. The commanding officer of the Imperial ground troops ordered a march to a lake thirty kilometers away.
This Korun boy was present on the planet Haruun Kal when Imperial Forces, led by Lieutenant Canonhaus, a occupied the planet. He met with the lieutenant while he drank from a Lammas.
Bon Tapalo was a male member of the Royal House of Naboo who served as king of the Naboo culture on the planet Naboo.

This human male was a TIE fighter pilot who flew with Amara Kel. Later he was moved in a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle as a pilot, but after one month he led himself back, because he missed the rush and the excitement.

Carter was a human male student who attended Coruscant Jedi Academy the same time as Roan Novachez. He also chastised Roan Novachez for kicking the dodgeball to Gaiana and also introduces the food fight, which made Gammy cry fearfully.

Stybla'rsi'omli, core name Larsiom, was a Chiss male who held the rank of Junior Commander in the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. She served as the comm officer of Admiral Ar'alani aboard the Chiss Ascendancy Nightdragon man-of-war Vigilant.

Pilton was a female Lannik Jedi Master who was the math and history teacher at the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's three years of attendance. She was shocked when Cronah complained to her about Roan Novachez drawing a note to Gaiana.
Jax was a human male pilot who lived on Tatooine and knew Roan Novachez. He attended Pilot Academy with Reg. After his spring break, he and Reg got to ride the new starfighter, J-47.
Reg was a human male pilot who lived on Tatooine and knew Roan Novachez. He attended Pilot Academy with Jax. After his spring break, he and Jax got to ride the new starfighter, J-47.
Adam was a human male who lived on Tatooine and knew Roan Novachez.

Gondrin Upal was a Kajain'sa'Nikto tramper who traveled on board the AA-9 Freighter-Liner Jendirian Valley while it transported refugees from the planet Coruscant to the planet Naboo during the Separatist Crisis in 22 BBY.

Kaycee Kollenz was a human freighter tramper who traveled on board the AA-9 Freighter-Liner Jendirian Valley while it transported refugees from the planet Coruscant to the planet Naboo during the Separatist Crisis in 22 BBY.
Si-Yy was an exogorth who took part of the meeting with other exogorths. Si-Yy brought Unark worm's on its stomach.
To-X was an exogorth who took part of the meeting with other exogorths. To-X brought Pylat birds on its stomach.
The Ghost Wookiee was said to be an angry Wookiee ghost who lived on the planet Kashyyyk and attacked travelers.

Albert, also known as Albert the Hutt, was a Hutt professor who wore circular glasses. Around 196 BBY, the student news group The Padawan Observer made several announcements on a Duoday in the fifth issue of their 1012th volume.
A chef worked onboard the Alliance to Restore the Republic MC80 Star Cruiser Home One. According to Wedge Antilles, the chef was surprisingly good.
Gub Vendo was a male Aqualish Jedi Knight who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Nori Ha was a Kaminoan Jedi who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Keff D'irst was a Bith artist who had an art gallery in the Coruscant Gallery of Modern Art in 194 BBY.
Leo was a Human male padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Plitch was a Shistavanen padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Shari was a padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Hugh was a Duros padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Ruki was a Zabrak padawan who visited the Jedi academy within the Jedi Temple on Coruscant during Roan Novachez's third year of attendance.
Ketch was a male Weequay who was a regular patron of Cid's Parlor on Ord Mantell. He was usually seen in the company of the Ithorian Bolo.

Rutallaroo was a male Wookiee who lived during the Imperial Era. He was a famous military engineer in Torukiko, who turned a fleet of catamarans into assault ships and designed and directed a three-year covert operation aimed at driving the Galactic Empire out from the planet …
Maromaka was an outlaw Wookiee who belonged to a secret network, and worked to get fugitive Wookiees to a safe place on Kashyyyk.
Tossonnu was an outlaw Wookiee who belonged to a secret network, and worked to get fugitive Wookiees to a safe place.
The Gibbering Gran of Gibraal was an Gran criminal who was caught by the Trandoshan bounty hunter Bossk.

x: This male individual was the bouncer in Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel. He was present when Parazeen Parapa wrote a profile on the bounty hunters 4-LOM and Zuckuss.
Beeznusa was an old male Dug waiter in Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel. He had only one eye and a star map tattoo on one of his legs.
Pratkak was a Sver guest in Freerago's Satellite Diner and Motel. Zuckuss thought that he died before.
Zafeen was a Frizznoth female who was a member of Parapa Cartel. She had a love affair with Parazeen Parapa while they hid in Mar Kalapa's compound.
Beebatee was a Frizznoth male who was a member of Parapa Cartel. He was a cousin of Parazeen Parapa who he grew up with
Wikivv was a female Chiss pilot of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet who served as the Grayshrike pilot and helm officer under Senior Captain Irizi'in'daro. She held the rank of Mid Commander.
Vimsk was a female Chiss member of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet who served as a sensor officer on the Grayshrike under Senior Captain Irizi'in'daro.
Shimkif was a female Agbui agent of the Grysk Hegemony who accompanied Haplif on his mission to infiltrate the Chiss Ascendancy. Shimkif was the mother of Frosif and posed as the wife of Haplif.

Lakbulbup was a male Chiss individual who was the cousin of the rancher Lakphro. Lakbulbup lived on the planet Naporar with his wife Dilpram, a biological scientist. Lakbulbup worked at the Expansionary Defense Fleet headquarters on Naporar.
Lakansu was a female Chiss who lived on the planet Celwis with her husband, the rancher Lakphro, and their daughter, Lakris.
Lakris was a young female Chiss and was the daughter of Lakansu and her husband, the rancher Lakphro. Lakris lived on the planet Celwis.

Bet'nih was a Force-sensitive female Chiss who served as an ozyly-esehembo within the Chiss Ascendancy. During the Nikardun campaigns, she served as the navigator for the Chiss heavy cruiser Grayshrike under the command of Senior Captain Irizi'in'daro.
Dilpram was a Chiss female and biological scientist who lived on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Naporar with her husband, Lakbulbup.

Yokado was a Chiss male who served as Patriarch of the Coduyo family, one of the Forty Great Families of the Chiss Ascendancy. He once met Xodlak'uvi'vil "Lakuviv," a Xodlak family Councilor based on the planet Celwis.

Lakwurn was a Chiss male of the Xodlak family who served the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet, holding the rank of Lieutenant Commander. He was stationed aboard the Grayshrike, a heavy cruiser commanded by Senior Captain Lakinda, and worked as a hyperdrive technician.

Soomret was a Chiss woman who served as the caregiver to the sky-walker Bet'nih while she was stationed on the Grayshrike. Because of her tardiness and casual nature toward her duties, Senior Captain Lakinda and Mid Commander Wikivv considered her a poor caregiver.

Fsir was a Watith captain who captained the freighter Saltbarrel. In 18 BBY, the Grysk operative known as "Jixtus" hired the captain to attack the Chiss heavy cruiser Springhawk to prevent its commander, Senior Captain Thrawn, from stopping a plot to cause a civil war in the C…
Slobber was a male Growzer with black and brown skin that was owned by the Chiss Rancher Xodlak'phr'ooa "Lakproh" and resided on the Chiss Ascendancy planet Celwis.
Colm was a male human who served in the Galactic Empire as a garbage worker on the Star Destroyer Avenger.
Peet was a male human who served in the Galactic Empire as a garbage worker on the Star Destroyer Avenger.
This human female was the mother of the Imperial garbage worker Peet.

This human female was the deck officer on the Star Destroyer Avenger. She ordered the garbage worker Carl Ashon and his team to clean up and throw to the space that Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft which landed on Avenger before.

Mitth'iv'iklo, core name Thivik, was a Chiss male of the Mitth family who served as a Senior Aide to the family Patriarch on the planet Csilla. He wore a jacket with a sunrise family crest of the Mitth family.

Vonzel was an old male smuggler. He taught Jaxxon T. Tumperakki when he became a smuggler that one should never ignore ordinary creatures, especially droids, and never seem desperate, especially not when you are.
This female was a spokesbeing of InterGalactic Banking Clan. She tried to dispel the rumors on HoloNet that a robbery had taken on the planet Scipio.
This male Ugnaught was a technician in Cloud City. Jaxxon T. Tumperakki asked him for help on where to find Platform Nine Ninety-Seven, but he gave false information.

Corovene Manakor was a male Troglof Bank employee who worked for the InterGalactic Banking Clan in the Scipio system. He participated in the robbery of the planet Scipio, but only because he promised to raise money to free Najiba.

This female Troglof was the wife of Corovene Manakor. After her husband participated in the robbery of the planet Scipio, they had to escape somwhere. They then visited Landonis Balthazar Calrissian and asked him to help them to get to the planet Lysatra.
This individual was a Petrusian gunrunner who agreed to take Corovene Manakor to the planet Lysatra.

The mother of Torro Sbazzle was a female Devaronian. She once wanted her daughter to take over the management of the family's herbal business, but became upset after Sbazzle proved to be more interested in traveling and cooking.
Kalhar was a famous Mantellian Savrip who worked as a brawler and gladiator.
Staven Kremmos was a starship designer who worked on Naboo. He was dispatched by King Ars Veruna to oversee the design of the J-type 327 Nubian starship.

Recnelo Cott was a female Ugnaught who worked in the tibanna gas mines and lived apart from her clan in Cloud City on Bespin in the year 3 ABY. She had an apartment on Level 121 where Isabalia rent a room.
A Gamorrean debtor lived in Cloud City and in the year 3 ABY owed a debt to the Duros Elad Zhalto. Duros hired Isabalia to beat out the debt.
Na'Tala was a female who lived in Cloud City on Bespin in the year 3 ABY. She worked in Azure Den underground gambling spot and secretly she is a part of Joy Iya's movement.
Moloste was a female Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. She was one of the aunts of Lonaste.
Temarit was a female Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. She was the oldest aunt of Lonaste.
Donsat was a male Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. He was the uncle of Lonaste.

Amigast was a Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. He was the head of the largest Ugnaught clan of the Miners' union. He lived the city with his clan, when the Imperials occupied the city.
Mirsame was an Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. Mirsame's aunt said the gas traders knew that the Imperials will come to Bespin.
Sallat was an Ugnaught who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. Sallat was a member of Lonaste's clan.

Lonaste was a female Ugnaught miner who lived in Ugnaught Town on the planet Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. From the intercepted messages and warnings, she concluded that the Galactic Empire would take control of the city.

Beetase was a female Ugnaught miner who lived in Ugnaught Town on Bespin during the Galactic Civil War. She was the cousin of Lonaste. When the Imperials took control of the city, she helped Lonaste to find a spaceship with which their whole clan could escape from Bespin.

Darth VaGhal was a Human female Sith Lord who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. VaGhal had yellow eyes; black, braided hair; light skin; and black markings on their face and forehead.

Darth Tigran was a Zabrak Sith Lord who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Tigran had yellow eyes, straight shoulder-length black hair, green-yellow skin, horns, and Sith tattoos on their face.

Darth Nix was a Human female Sith Lord who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Nix had yellow eyes, light-colored skin, short black hair, and light blue Sith tattoos.

Nexus Wan was a Human Jedi who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Wan had white eyes, light skin, and black hair shaven on one side with a long braid falling down her back.
Gareth Lorca was a Human Jedi who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Lorca had brown hair, brown eyes, and light skin.

Bix Creo was an alien Jedi who was active during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire between 130 ABY and 138 ABY. Creo had brown-gray skin, black eyes, and black facial hair. Black tattoos were also featured on the Jedi's forearms and head.
This individual was a descendant or clone of the Sith Lord Darth Maul. He lived during the reign of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire, well over a century after Maul's time.

A junk dealer sold ship parts. Sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, they sold an ion engine regulator to the Spectres, but it malfunctioned causing some problems on the Ghost, but the astromech droid Chopper fixed it.

A female Gand engineer was captured by the Galactic Empire. Sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, she was forced to build a new Imperial ship model titled the Blackburn. The Spectres later rescued her and changed the blueprints for the Blackburn into a drawing of a bantha.

A Quarren male spy from the planet Dac worked for the Spectres. Sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, the Quarren stumbled onto something big, but was caught by the Galactic Empire and was placed in the Imperial detention center. The Quarren was eventually saved by the Spectres.

The Paataatus male Prince Militaire ruled the Paataatus Hiveborn government when it was under control of the Nikardun species, who threatened the prince with death if the Hiveborn did not cooperate with them.
Tropos was a woman who lived during the Galactic Civil War, garnering a reputation for making those who failed her disappear, along with the victim's loved ones.

Diona was a Twi'lek female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. During the ongoing conflict between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, she was stationed on the Republic's Carrick Station.
Jai Cirri was a male resident of Cloud City and a rich Tibanna gas tycoon. He was also the father of Jailyn Cirri. He loved splendor and he was a passionate gambler.
Neshee was a male resident of Cloud City and a famous fashion designer of the shop The Lioness in Cloud City. He designed dresses for noble and aristocratic people, including Jailyn Cirri.

Dresh Lipson was a Human male pilot and smuggler. He was an employee of the rich Tibanna gas tycoon Jai Cirri. He liked to gamble and had romantic feelings for Jailyn Cirri, Jai's daughter. When the Imperials occupied Cloud City, Lipson asked Jailyn escape with him from Bespin.

Sh'nar Qwasba was a Siniteen female scientist and professor who served as the president of the Galactic Agricultural Alliance during the High Republic Era. Qwasba attended the Agricultural Alliance's annual meeting on the Starlight Beacon space station.

Prot Xan was an Amani male member of the Galactic Agricultural Alliance during the High Republic Era. The Amani was one of 106 scientists who attended an annual meeting of the Agricultural Alliance on the Starlight Beacon space station.
Yomo Vrex was an Ithorian scientist in the Galactic Agricultural Alliance during the High Republic Era. He attended an annual meeting of the Alliance hosted aboard the Starlight Beacon space station.

A female individual was a member of the Junk Mavens who resided on the junk moon Quantxi during the High Republic Era. The Junk Maven and a comrade came across members of the Nihil marauder organization on Quantxi, including its leader, Marchion Ro.

A Junk Maven resided on the junk moon of Quantxi during the High Republic Era. When the Nihil marauder organization stationed some of their number on Quantxi as part of a plan to lure the Jedi Order into a trap, the Junk Maven and a companion approached them.

Yathros Condorius the First was a human male beggar who thought he was the king of Bespin and he turned Cloud City from a gas miner's watering hole to a galactic paradise. He thought Landonis Balthazar Calrissian was his evil regent.

Darbus Mizz was a human male Bespin Wing Guard who worked for Landonis Balthazar Calrissian. When the Imperials occupied Cloud City he got an order from Lando to bring Yathros Condorius the First to a safe place.

t: Unidentified Imperial officer (Yathros Condorius the First)
x: This human male was an Imperial officer who was present when Bespin was occupied by the Empire. He found and wanted to execute Yathros Condorius the First, but Darbus Mizz shot him.
Or'toona Fleenk was male artist, who lived in Cloud City. He helped transcribe, print and post the proclamations of Yathros Condorius the First.
A human male was the brother of Darbus Mizz. He was killed while the Imperial forces occupied Cloud City.
This human male was the father of Yathros Condorius the First. He was killed on his spaceship Life's Little when Yathros was a child.
Zeechay was a queen who granted Yathros Condorius the First the blessings of the Angels of Iego. It is unknown whether the queen was real or fictional.
Nubarron was a non-binary Jedi Master of an unidentified species who served as the Shipmaster and quartermaster of Starlight Beacon during the High Republic Era.

Furball was a female nexu that was owned and trained by a human resident of the planet Ruusan. When the bounty hunters Beilert Valance and T'onga visited Ruusan in search of Valance's former mentor, Nakano Lash, the nexu and several residents attacked them to defend Lash.
This Twi'lek baby was the newborn son of Rajin.

This male was a miner who worked in Cloud City on the gas giant Bespin. He was the friend of the miner Rajin. Around the time the Galactic Empire occupied the planet, he was arrested by stormtroopers. He could speak for hours about organizational rules.

Tom was an alien individual who participated in a competition against the Sullustan Bill and another alien around 196 BBY. At some point during the competition, the three stood behind podiums displaying their accrued points.

A male individual was, according to a story of the Starros Clan, the enemy of Caden Starros, the great-grandfather of the human female Avon Starros. According to the story, the man stole Caden's ship and left him stranded on a minor moon.

This male was an officer of the Galactic Empire who held the military rank of ensign after the Duel on Cloud City. He was part of the Imperial forces left on Cloud City. His commander, Ela Radodan, called him Fool #204 because he was expendable.

Brougg was a Rodian Mining Guild operative who lived in Cloud City on Bespin when the Galactic Empire occupied the planet. At that time, Brougg and other operatives were attacked by Tal Veridian and his team, hit them unconscious and took their dresses.

A Nightsister lived on Dathomir. She was killed during the Battle of Dathomir in 20 BBY, becoming a spirit. When Maul and Jedi Padawan Ezra Bridger drank a potion to restart their force bond, the spell woke up a group of Nightsister spirits.

A survival instructor taught Honesty Weft on Dalna. One of the lessons the instructor taught the boy was that finding higher ground was a good idea, something Weft remembered when he was stranded on the jungle moon Wevo, although he was frightened of heading into the dark, thi…

Klaus Vandangante, known under the alias "Doc," was a male Corellian technician. At some point during the Imperial Era, he helped the smuggler Han Solo hot-rod the hyperdrive of the Millennium Falcon to a highly illegal Class 0.5, in order to pay off his debt to him.

Ruby was a female zardimallo that was considered highly valuable shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire. She was stolen by the Rhokai gang due to the lizard's value, before the Devaronian criminal Roland Durand hired information broker Cid to deliver her to him.
A humanoid male scrapper worked for the Scrapper Guild on the junk-strewn planet Bracca following the formation of the Galactic Empire.

A male archaeologist was the father of the Ithorian collector Dok-Ondar. Ondar's father was previously a gardener on Ithor until they became archaeologist. During or prior to 0 ABY, the Ithorian's father and mother died.

A Falleen female child was captured by a group of Zygerrian slave traders in approximately 19 BBY. She, along with a human and a male Falleen adult, were kept by the slavers in the ruins of Old Ord Mantell City on the planet of Ord Mantell, overseen by the Zygerrian leader, Ra…
Essara Till was a pilot who served in the Royal Naboo Security Forces' Bravo Squadron under the command of Ric Olié, and piloted an N-1 starfighter. Around 32 BBY, Till was killed.

Arven Wendik was a human who served as a lieutenant and pilot in Bravo Squadron of the Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps. After the planet Naboo was invaded by the Trade Federation in 32 BBY, Wendik flew in an N-1 starfighter as Bravo 3 during the Battle of Naboo.

A Dianoga was present on Bracca during Clone Force 99's mission to remove their inhibitor chips. It inhabited the murky waters that sat beneath the wreckage of a decommissioned Venator-class Star Destroyer.

A Pantoran vendor was present in Ord Mantell City on Ord Mantell during Clone Force 99's stay on that planet. Wrecker and Omega would purchase Mantell Mix from them as a treat for successfully completing missions.
Tomaas Azzameen was a male individual who was a member of the Azzameen family. He was the father of at least four children, including Galin and Ace. Tomaas owned the YT-2000 Otana.
Galin Azzameen was a male individual who was a member of the Azzameen family and the eldest son of Tomaas Azzameen.
Ace Azzameen was a male individual who was a member of the Azzameen family. He was the youngest son of Tomaas Azzameen, and owned a droid named MK-09.

Sentinel was a human male stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. As a trooper, Sentinel was the last survivor of three of his regiments. Following the fall of the Empire, Sentinel continued to operate, creating the on-stage persona of someone unwilling to accept defeat.

Howzer was a human male clone who served as a clone trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic and eventually as a stormtrooper in a battalion of the Imperial Army with the military rank of Clone Captain, shortly after the Galactic Republic's reorganization into the Galactic Em…

Kalandra was a female individual who attended the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth during the Imperial Era. Not long after the human female Chelli Lona Aphra began her doctorate program at the university in 11 BBY, she became lovers with Kalandra.
Mi'ala Frenoc was a member of the Resistance during its war with the First Order. After operations controller Kaydel Ko Connix was promoted to lieutenant, Frenoc was promoted into her vacant role.
Algron was a Quarren male pirate who was the leader of a pirate gang that operated on Noaxson during the First Order-Resistance War.
Lannix was a Palliduvan male pirate who operated on Noaxson during the First Order-Resistance War.
Corrin was a Human male pirate who operated on Noaxson during the First Order-Resistance War.
Tozzo was a human pirate who operated on Noaxson during the First Order-Resistance War.
Korana was a Weequay pirate who operated on Noaxson during the First Order-Resistance War.
Paka was a Kyuzo male pirate who operated on Noaxson during the First Order-Resistance War.
CT-8508 was a clone trooper and later stormtrooper who was created on the planet Kamino and served the Galactic Empire during its reign.
Rogwa Wodrata was an important Holwuff senator of the Galactic Republic's Senate who supported the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Separatist Crisis.
A human man resided at Five Points station in the Outer Rim Territories. The man, born around 31 BBY, was about ten years older than the fugitive slicer Jyn Erso.

Augara Jowil was an Otolla Gungan who was bandleader of the Great Municipal Band alongside Beezar Pert. In 32 BBY, they were amongst the Gungans who gathered in the Gungan Sacred Place on the planet Naboo after the Trade Federation invaded the world.

affiliation: Joint Chiefs of the Imperial Military
x: Ferno was in the briefings with other high-ranking officers prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, and later participated in the Defense of Kuat, where he was captured by the New Republic.

Evroes'pu'titor, known by the core name Oesputi, was a Chiss male farmer. His Evroes family got into a dispute with the Xodlak family of the Chiss Great Families, which Mitth family Syndic Mitth'urf'ianico was called to resolve.
A pilot of the TIE Fighter Epsilon Nine was a male First Order TIE Fighter Pilot. During the Cold War, this pilot encountered Han Solo, who was piloting the Eravana.

Lony Coleema was a Force-sensitive female grand-engineer who was part of the Order of the Sight Voltaic. Coleema disliked being addressed by droids as "Mistress Coleema," instead asking to be called "Sister."
A wandering Jedi seeker discovered that nishalorite stones could be used as kyber crystals some time before the fall of the Jedi Order in 19 BBY.
Belk was a male criminal who was a member of a crew led by the Abednedo Telsla. He frequently squabbled with fellow crewmember Fleecs.

A'Shar Farless was a human captain in the military of the Galactic Empire. While Farless was training at the Arkanis Academy he learned that the older cadets planned to turn in the younger cadets for trashing a port even though the younger cadets were ordered to.

Fleecs was a Weequay who was part of a crew led by the Abednedo Telsla. She often got into arguments with fellow crewman, Belk. After taking over Tomarian's Annual Festival of Light Gala at his theater, Telsla sent Fleecs to go search for anyone else in the theater.
Talsma was a human captain. Around 21 BBY, when Senator Padmé Amidala exited a starship in a hangar on the planet Naboo, the captain was present to escort the senator to her residence.

Telsla was an Abednedo criminal and the leader of his crew. He worked alongside Belk and Fleecs in taking over Tomarian's theater during the Tomarian's Annual Festival of Light Gala. Tomarian owned Telsla credits but Tomarian didn't have the credits for him.

Rawlson was a Togruta with orange skin and red-striped montrals. Around 21 BBY, Rawlson attended Tomarian's Annual Festival of Light Gala at Tomarian's theater on the planet Naboo with the Twi'lek Wellsley.
Wellsley was a Twi'lek with teal skin. Around 21 BBY, Wellsley attended Tomarian's Annual Festival of Light Gala at Tomarian's theater on the planet Naboo with the Togruta Rawlson.
Tomarian was a human male who owned a theater and held the Tomarian's Annual Festival of Light Gala. During the gala, a criminal crew broke in and used gas to subdue everyone at the gala.
Deva Lompop was a Shani female bounty hunter, marauder, and mercenary who operated from the time of the High Republic into the Imperial Era.
Loreth was, according to legend, a female Theelin archaeologist.
A stormtrooper deserter was a former stormtrooper who served under the Galactic Empire. During a mission on the planet Aleen, the stormtrooper committed an act that led him to desert the Empire.

A stormtrooper deserter was a former stormtrooper who served in the Stormtrooper Corps of the Galactic Empire. During a mission on the planet Aleen, the stormtrooper committed an act that would lead them to desert the Empire along with two other stormtroopers.

A wampa on the ice planet Hoth tried to attack Coruscant Jedi Academy students and teachers while on a field trip. Cronah thought the wampa was their physical education teacher Kitmum, but Roan realized that Kitmum wasn't on the field trip.
A male captain served the New Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. He commanded the former Imperial Star Destroyer Deliverance, flagship of General Hera Syndulla.
Eliimy was a female Hutt who was allegedly the wife of Jabba Desilijic Tiure.
An human male served within the ground forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic with the military rank of captain.

A Dalnan individual served as the governor of the Outer Rim planet Dalna during the High Republic Era and was a member of the world's government. According to the Dalnan Honesty Weft, the governor had experience of dealing with the Nihil pirates.
Facee was a female Twi'lek who worked with Kova, Roz, and Hatto West. During the Imperial Era, the quartet robbed Baron Serk with the help of the Toydarian merchant Nel Henol.
Roz was a male Human pilot who worked with Kova, Facee and Hatto West. During the Imperial Era, the quartet robbed Baron Serk with the help of the Toydarian merchant Nel Henol.
Hatto West was a male human who worked with Kova, Roz, and Facee. During the Imperial Era, the quartet robbed Baron Serk with the help of the Toydarian merchant Nel Henol.
Serk was a baron. A team of five criminals—Hatto West, Kova, Nel Henol, Roz, and Facee—robbed the baron's home during the Imperial Era.

The Great Leveler, or simply the Leveler, was a powerful Nameless that had the ability to overwhelm Force-sensitives and nullify their connection to the Force. The creature possessed claws, moving on four legs.

Rhil Dairo was a human female reporter for GoNet during the High Republic Era. She was requested by Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic to cover the Republic Fair on the planet Valo on the Galactic Frontier, assisted by her cam droid, T-9.

Larep Reza was a Kalleran male who served as the Vice Chancellor under Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh of the Galactic Republic. A rising star in the Galactic Senate, Reza was seen to be the most likely to succeed Soh, and was the subject of many gossipvids.
Zeetar, nicknamed Zeet, was a Talpini male who was one of three Tempest Runners in the Nihil marauder organization, elevated following the death of Kassav Milliko at the Battle of Kur.
Scarspike was a Crocin who held the rank of Cloud in the Nihil marauder organization. He typically spent more time abusing the crew of his Cloudship than planning his raids.

Briscol was a male yubal belonging to the family of Lakphro, Lakansu, and Lakris on the Chiss Ascendancy world of Celwis. Lakris once zapped Briscol with her lure stick, causing him to "walk funny" for two days.
Tyvokka was a Wookiee Jedi Master who was an esteemed member of the Jedi High Council. Tyvokka took the Kel Dor Jedi Plo Koon on as their Padawan.

Sarn Starbreaker was a Gloovan male who held the rank of Cloud in the Nihil marauder organization, serving within the Tempest of Pan Eyta. Starbreaker and his Cloud led an attack on the Cyclor Shipyards above the planet Cyclor, attempting to destroy the starship Innovator.

Caratoo was a grizzled Kerk who led a band of mercenaries during the High Republic Era. The former Jedi Ty Yorrick joined Caratoo's band, and one of the first things that he had taught her was to know where her limits were.
Mantessa Chekkat was a Kuranu female inventor. She and her daughter, Klerin, attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo, hiring the mercenary Ty Yorrick to protect them.
Vaadu was a Phindian senator who represented Phindar in the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.

Digrenara was an individual who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic at some point before the woman Lina Soh was elected Supreme Chancellor around 234 BBY. According to the reporter Rhil Dairo, Digrenara did a lot for the Republic during their time as chancellor.

Samera Ra-oon was a female Valon who resided on the planet Valo during the High Republic Era. When the Galactic Republic hosted the Republic Fair on Valo, Ra-oon held the role of coordinator, tasked with organizing the celebration.
Tia Toon was a Sullustan male senator who represented Sullust in the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.
Shrent was a Chiss male who held the rank of Mid Commander aboard the warship Grayshrike, serving as the communications officer of Senior Captain Irizi'in'daro.

Elarec Yovet was a Togruta female queen who served as the Regasa of Shili during the High Republic Era. Regasa Yovet additionally had the titles of Supreme Huntress of the United Tribes and Ruler of Togrutas.
Cibaba was an Azumel Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Stationed on Alaris Prime, Cibaba trained the Tholothian Padawan Tylera Yorrick, as well as her friend Klias Teradine.

Nwo was an elderly Quarren male and retired pilot who was present on Valo for the Republic Fair. When the Nihil attacked the festivities, Nwo was onboard the Innovator, a state-of-the-art exploration vessel which was landed on a floating dock in Lake Lonisa.

Ratko was a Ozrelanso bodyguard who was hired by Sullustan Senator Tia Toon prior to the Republic Fair on Valo. Despite Ratko's profession being obvious by his large and imposing build, Toon claimed that he was merely a secretary.
Kresto was a Serennian man hailing from the Outer Rim planet Serenno who lived during the High Republic Era. By 231 BBY, they had taken on the title of Count of Serenno.
Brisbane was a Jedi Master who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By that time, they had become widely respected among Jedi ranks.

Idrax Snat was a Neimoidian male who was the captain of the Valo Security Force, operating in Lonisa City on the planet Valo. Jedi Master Elzar Mann, who was stationed on Valo for the upcoming Republic Fair, saw Snat as humorless and incompetent.

Avi Singh was a human male senator who served in the Senate of the Confederacy of Independent Systems and resided on its capital planet Raxus Secundus after the collapse of the Separatist state before fleeing into hiding.
Bragg was a human female who served as a Captain in the Galactic Empire following the end of the Clone Wars in 19 BBY.

Balfus was a Wookiee who lived on the Mid Rim planet Kashyyyk, by around 41 BBY. In the lead-up to Life Day, an important Wookiee festivity, Trandoshan hunters took advantage of the Wookiees' weakness during the holiday to capture Balfus.
Nooranbakarakana, often referred to as Nooran, was a Frozian Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Jedi Master Stellan Gios knew of Nooranbakarakana by reputation alone.
Chell Trambin was a male Morseerian who was a member of Pan Eyta's Tempest of the Nihil, serving aboard Eyta's flagship Elegencia.
Bakari was a Jedi of the Jedi Order stationed at the Jedi outpost on the Mid Rim planet Bromlarch during the High Republic Era.

Kitrep "Kip" Soh was a male human from Daghee whose mother, Lina Soh, served as the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era. When he was around seventeen years old, he joined his mother for the Republic Fair on Valo.

Jom Lariin was a Valon whose father was Nas Lariin, the mayor of Lonisa City on Valo. When the Republic Fair was held there during the High Republic Era, Jom met Kitrep Soh, the son of the Galactic Republic's Supreme Chancellor Lina Soh.
Klerin Chekkat, a Kuranu female and daughter of Mantessa Chekkat, invented a recainium-powered four-seven nullifier that the pair hoped to sell at the Valo Republic Fair.

Tiss was a Togruta who served as an ambassador for his species during the High Republic Era. Despite the distant relationship the Togrutas had with the Galactic Republic, Ambassador Tiss attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo, accompanying Regasa Elarec Yovet.

Madam Trangess Conserra was a Mon Calamari female opera singer. She attended the Republic Fair on the planet Valo, where she was set to perform. Madam Conserra survived the subsequent attack on the Republic Fair by Nihil raiders, but suffered a deflated lung.
Pall Sleko was a Toydarian male who was the manager of the opera singer Madam Trangess Conserra. Sleko accompanied Conserra to the Republic Fair on the planet Valo.

Maramis was a Togruta who served Regasa Elarec Yovet as the captain of the Togruta guard. He and his guard accompanied the regasa to the Republic Fair on the planet Valo. When the fair was attacked by Nihil raiders, Maramis provided assistance to the survivors.

Milon Thakkery was a male individual who served as a space traffic controller aboard a space traffic control satellite above the planet Valo. During the Republic Fair on Valo, Thakkery directed arrivals to the planet.

Skuun was a timid Peasle assistant to space traffic controller Milon Thakkery aboard a space traffic control satellite above the planet Valo. During the Republic Fair hosted on the planet, Skuun reported the details of the accidental explosion of a cruiser carrying Jinda dancers.

A Dathomirian Zabrak male individual was a member of the Nightbrothers, a group of warriors under the leadership and control of the Nightsister coven of witches on the planet Dathomir. He acted as the keeper of the young Nightbrother boy Maul around 40 BBY.

A Nightbrother boy born in 54 BBY, was the kin of Maul during his childhood on Dathomir. The boy resented Maul, and when his father left him and his brother home, the two boys beat him. During the Selection, Maul used his anger to choke the boy with the Force.

A Nightbrother boy born in 55 BBY, was the kin of Maul during his childhood on Dathomir. The boy resented Maul. When his father left him and his brother home, the two boys beat him. During the Selection, Maul used his anger to choke the boy with the Force.

Quin Amarant was a male Lamproid who was a member of Lourna Dee's Tempest of the Nihil. Exiled from his homeworld Florn after he murdered his home nest, Amarant fought alongside Dee during the Nihil's attack on Valo, but was captured by Jedi archivist OrbaLin.
A human male TIE pilot served in the Galactic Empire's starfighter corps during the Galactic Civil War.

Lerahel was a female Krantian who lived during the High Republic Era. Along with her family, including her son Sarry, she attended the Valo Republic Fair. However, in the Nihil attack on the festivities, Lerahel lost all of her family except for Sarry.

Sarry was a male Krantian who lived during the High Republic Era. As a child, he attended the Valo Republic Fair with his family. However, when the Nihil attacked the festivities, Sarry lost all of his family except for his mother Lerahel.

Dan G'vash was a human male Jedi Padawan. G'vash traveled with his master Tajin Crosser to investigate a disturbance in the Force on the planet Habo. After locating Habo village, the two Jedi found a ship that Crosser believed looked like one that a Sith would use.
The Ronin was the alias used by a male human former Sith who wandered the far edge of the Outer Rim Territories in the aftermath of the Sith rebellion. He would later be nicknamed as Grim.

Lenk was a Twi'lek female who was a member of the Free Ryloth Movement early in the Imperial Era. She participated in a mission to rescue several rebels arrested by the Galactic Empire after being caught smuggling weapons.

Baheeoo was a Gigoran Nihil marauder who was part of the crew of the Gaze Electric, Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's flagship. In 232 BBY, they and the Nihil Garank and Ordo raced across the Gaze Electric to relay Ro's command to change course to the planet Trymant IV.

Grik was a member of the Nihil pirate organization by 232 BBY. That year, they worked for a day to fix the comm unit of the Gaze Electric—Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's flagship—which had ceased functioning due to fried wiring.

Garank was a Gamorrean male Nihil marauder who was part of the crew of the Gaze Electric, Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's flagship. In 232 BBY, they and the Nihil Baheeoo and Ordo raced across the Gaze Electric to relay Ro's command to change course to the planet Trymant IV.
Serin was a Twi'lek female who was a member of the nascent Free Ryloth Movement shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire.

Roark Garnet was a human male smuggler associated with the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. He flew a HWK-290 light freighter and wore a white shirt with a brown jacket. He had light skin, brown hair, and brown eyes.
As that night happened to be Vader's birthday, the Sith Lord hoped that his stormtroopers had planned a party for him and anticipated that they had set up the meeting to surprise him.
Xet was a Falleen member of the Black Sun crime syndicate who later became a spy for the Crimson Dawn syndicate, feeding them information on Black Sun.

Tal Bota was a human male Jedi Master who lived in the Old Republic-era, in a time where he often fought the Sith. By the High Republic Era, Bota was considered an iconic Jedi, and younglings such as Lula Talisola and Farzala Tarabal watched holostories of his exploits.

apprentices: At least five other Padawan learners
x: Obratuk Glii was a male Parwan Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era.
Ishnar Ti-Kharatal was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who, in 231 BBY, served for Skarabda the Hutt as the head of security during the time of the High Republic Era.

Bonnard was a human female who served as a Lieutenant in the Galactic Empire’s Hunter Fleet during the Galactic Civil War. Bonnard served aboard Admiral Kalaxo's ISD Ultima II, participating in a battle against the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
A human female was the sister of the pilot Leox Gyasi during the High Republic Era.
A Orincan served as the captain of a starship that hauled cargo during the time of the High Republic Era.
"Jawa68" was the online alias of a Jawa who spent time on Tatooine. By 1 BBY, Jawa68 encountered Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina's policy of not allowing Jawas, which Jawa68 found annoying.

Lop was a Force-sensitive Lepi female resident of the planet Tao during the Imperial Era. An orphan who was not originally from Tao, Lop was an enslaved laborer for the Galactic Empire, which had occupied the planet.

"PigsMightFly" was the online alias of an Ugnaught who lived on Cloud City. In 3 ABY, PigsMightFly responded to reviews of the Bespin carbon-freezing chamber in Yoda's Guide to the Galaxy, a book written by the Jedi Master Yoda during his exile on Dagobah.
"snowtrooper4life" was the online alias of a human snowtrooper who served the First Order. They wore standard white, insulated snowtrooper armor with an accompanying snowtrooper helmet.

Clone0000004 was the designation of a human clone trooper from Kamino who served the Galactic Republic. By 19 BBY, he posted a five-star review of Kamino in Yoda's Guide to the Galaxy, a book written by the Jedi Master Yoda during his exile on Dagobah.

Clone0000005 was the designation of a human clone trooper from Kamino who served the Galactic Republic. By 19 BBY, he posted a five-star review of Kamino in Yoda's Guide to the Galaxy, a book written by the Jedi Master Yoda during his exile on Dagobah.

"BountyH" was the online alias of a humanoid bounty hunter who spent time on Tatooine. By 1 BBY, BountyH visited Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina, and thought that the food wasn't the best, however they also thought that the establishment's lighting was handy for secret meetings.

Bluebrow was an Ithorian pirate and a fairy tale character appearing in some songs and rhymes taught to younglings across the Core Worlds. Like Princess Chaia of Alderaan, Bluebrow's character was fictional, but rooted in fact.
A Trandoshan secretly served in the court of Sly Moore, Sub-Administrator in the Galactic Empire and a member of the Emperor's inner circle.
