x: Luthen Rael was the name adopted by Lear, a human male spymaster who led a covert network during the time of the Galactic Empire.

Maarva Carassi Andor was a human female who lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic and into the era of the Galactic Empire. On her homeworld, Maarva was a member of the Daughters of Ferrix and was revered by the members of her community.
Kyong Greylark was a human female politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, holding office jointly with Chancellor Orlen Mollo.
Orlen Mollo was a Quarren male politician who served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era, holding office jointly with Chancellor Kyong Greylark in 382 BBY.

Teeka was a Jawa who resided on the planet Tatooine and was part of a Jawa tribe in 9 BBY. She searched for a T-16 skyhopper toy and delivered it to Obi-Wan Kenobi, a Jedi Master, who gave Teeka seventy-five credits.

Minas Velti was a human female Jedi Master who wielded a green-bladed lightsaber. In 19 BBY, toward the end of the Clone Wars, she was training a group of younglings at the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant when clone troopers of the 501st Legion stormed the temple as part o…
Nari was a Force-sensitive human male who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi. In 9 BBY, after the destruction of the Jedi Order, Nari was hiding on the planet Tatooine and helped the owner of a saloon.
Nax, a veteran of the Clone Wars, was a human male clone of Jango Fett who once served as a clone trooper in the elite 501st Legion of the Galactic Republic's Grand Army of the Republic.

Vect Nokru was a human mercenary from the planet Alderaan who was active during the Imperial Era. In 9 BBY, he and his Black Mask gang were hired by the Third Sister of the Galactic Empire Jedi-hunting group the Inquisitorius to kidnap the ten year-old Princess Leia Organa of …

Groff Ditcher was a brutish human who worked as the foreman of Tibidon Station, a sand whaling station on his homeworld, Tatooine. In 9 BBY, he shoved his employee Padu Cherd and threatened to pay him nothing when Cherd complained at only receiving half pay.
Matthea "Matty" Cathley was a Twi'lek female Jedi Padawan who was the apprentice of Jedi Master Leebon. She operated out of the moon Jedha alongside Oliviah Zeveron in 382 BBY.

Agira was an Imroosian female from the planet Imroosia who served as a handmaiden of the House of Organa on the planet Alderaan. In 9 BBY, Princess Leia Organa convinced Agira to wear her clothing as a disguise, claiming that Queen Breha Organa would find it amusing.
Niano Organa was a human male member of the House of Organa. He was the son of Duke Kayo Organa and Duchess Celly Organa, and the adoptive cousin of Princess Leia Organa.
Padu Cherd was a human male who worked as a laborer at Tibidon Station, a tibidon sand whale–harvesting station on the desert planet Tatooine.

Tetha Grig was a human female who worked as a spice dealer on her homeworld, Daiyu, after becoming separated from her family. In 9 BBY, she approached the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and offered to sell him spice, but Kenobi instead requested information.
Tredgar Volk was a Thuggatoris who scraped by as a bounty hunter. In 9 BBY, he spent time in the courtyard lounge outside the Den on the planet Daiyu before going for a meal of ribs at Swartz BBQ.

A human male was the owner and bartender of a saloon in the spaceport city Mos Eisley on the planet Tatooine. He had trouble with thieves threatening and stealing from him, but was saved by 9 BBY when the fugitive Jedi Nari intervened.

Syril Karn was a human male civil servant who was employed by the Imperial Bureau of Standards of the Galactic Empire, and had prior been a senior law enforcement officer for the Preox-Morlana as a Deputy Inspector during the Imperial Era.

The Time Grappler was a human who resided on Ferrix. It was his duty to ring in the beginning and end of each day by striking a beskar anvil atop a bell tower on Rix Road. The Time Grappler handled this task with reverence, adopting rhythmic poses before each hammer strike.
Daho Sejan was a male Pau'an senator who represented his homeworld of Utapau in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

A Boosodian vendor operated an outdoor clothing stand called Chiu Mo Threads on the planet Daiyu. In 9 BBY, the stand was visited by the Jedi-in-hiding Obi-Wan Kenobi and Princess Leia Organa, whom he had been sent to rescue from capture.

Corran was a Force-sensitive human male that lived on the planet Daiyu. Corran and his mother, Nyche, desperately needed to leave Daiyu as Corran's abilities put him in danger. Corran's mother contacted a supposed Jedi named Haja Estree and asked him to get them both off Daiyu.
Gella Nattai was a human female Jedi Knight and Wayseeker who was active during the High Republic Era. She wielded two purple-bladed lightsabers.
Jayco was a human male con artist who worked on the Daiyu during the Imperial Era alongside Haja Estree.

Densin Clord was a human male deck officer who worked at a spaceport on the planet Daiyu. In 9 BBY, he dismissed a traveler seeking help about a delayed transport when he was approached by the fugitive Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, who explained that he was tracking a starship.
Chubbray was an Ewok male of the Bright Tree tribe who lived in Bright Tree Village on the moon of Endor.

Sprocket was a male Mon Calamari medic and programmer who participated in the Hunters of the Outer Rim tournament on the planet Vespaara. Around 9 ABY, Sprocket created the droid J-3DI, who also participated as a Hunter.

Pav-ti Tano was a Togruta female from the planet Shili who was the partner of Nak-il Tano and the mother of Ahsoka Tano. Living in a small village, she believed in the traditional ways of her people and wanted to take Ahsoka on her first hunt in 36 BBY, when she was just a baby.
Nyche was a human female from the planet Daiyu who was the mother of Corran, a Force-sensitive boy. In 9 BBY, Nyche and Corran resided on her homeworld.

Erk Zallis was a male Ugnaught who worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Before the Battle of Lola Sayu, Zallis was responsible for carrying about the carbon-freezing of the team that would infiltrate the Citadel.

Dardin Shull was a human male who lived on the planet Tatooine. In 9 BBY, Shull was present in a town square in Anchorhead when Inquisitors Third Sister and Fifth Brother interrogated the locals for information regarding the fugitive Jedi Nari.

A human female medic served in the Resistance during the First Order-Resistance War. During the Battle of Crait in 34 ABY she worked to support her fellow soldiers. She wore a Resistance tunic and blue armband with Aurebesh lettering.
Monsalmo was a Happabore that lived on the astronomical object Endovar under the care of Jedi Master Yoda and the Jedi Order.

Freck was an affable Condluran who worked as a transport driver for the Galactic Empire on the mining planet Mapuzo, his homeworld. Aligning with the Empire, he gained rapport with the local stormtroopers.
A male individual was the father of Obi-Wan Kenobi, a human male from Stewjon. Obi-Wan had vague memories of his father, specifically his hands.
A female individual was the mother of Obi-Wan Kenobi, a human male from Stewjon. Obi-Wan had vague memories of his mother, specifically the shawl that she wore.
Tala Durith was a human female who served in the Imperial Army in the Galactic Empire. While on the Outer Rim planet Garel, she participated in the execution of four Force-sensitive families.
Tauntaza was a human female member of the Galactic Empire who served as governor of the planet Gabredor III.
A Rodian worked as a waiter at the Convors Perch Restaurant in the Wealthy District of the planet Milvayne. At some point the waiter became associated with the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate.
A stormtrooper was active on the planet Mapuzo during 9 BBY. He had an encounter with the rogue Jedi, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Princess Leia Organa.
Vidara Jurness was a humanoid alien mercenary who worked in the Black Mask gang alongside the human mercenary Vect Nokru and the mercenary Ayo Bons, operating out of Daiyu City on the planet Daiyu.

A stormtrooper was active on the planet Mapuzo in 9 BBY. Taking a lift from Freck in the back of his mining repulsortruck, he and his squad had a passing encounter with the farmer "Orden" and his daughter "Luma," in actuality the Jedi fugitive Obi-Wan Kenobi and Princess Leia …

A human male stormtrooper was active on the planet Mapuzo in 9 BBY. Taking a lift in the back of Freck's mining repulsortruck, the stormtrooper and his squad had a passing encounter with the farmer "Orden" and his daughter "Luma," in actuality the Jedi fugitive Obi-Wan Kenobi …

A stormtrooper was active on the planet Mapuzo during 9 BBY. As part of the reinvigorated hunt for the Jedi fugitive Obi-Wan Kenobi, he was paired with another trooper to check buildings, which happened to include the safehouse used by Tala Durith.

A stormtrooper was active on the planet Mapuzo in 9 BBY. As part of the reinvigorated hunt for the Jedi fugitive Obi-Wan Kenobi, he was paired with another trooper to check buildings, which happened to include the safehouse used by Tala Durith.
Ayo Bons was a humanoid mercenary who worked with Vect Nokru and Vidara Jurness during the year 9 BBY. The mercenary captured the Princess Leia Organa on the orders of the Third Sister.

A pilot was a human male who worked as part of an anti-Imperial network on the planet Mapuzo. He prepared a starship to help refugees Obi-Wan Kenobi and Leia Organa escape, but when several Inquisitors arrived with Darth Vader in search of Kenobi, Tala Durith contacted him and…

Rosbuen Frisk was a female diplomat who served as the Galactic Republic's regional diplomat for multiple star systems. Cato Neimoidia was one planet she represented the Republic for, though she was typically off-world covering her duties in other systems.
Vivert Stag was a female Jedi Initiate whose clan was scheduled to build their lightsabers on the planet Ilum as part of the the Gathering shortly after the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.
Aytar was a male acrobat who worked for a traveling circus. He eventually started a relationship with the then Jedi Padawan Kantam Sy when his circus visited the planet Endovar.
Booma Ball Bob was a male Weequay residing on Tatooine. He was in charge of the Booma Ball Game and would reward the winner a Kyber brick.

Panicking Pedestrian is a character in LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga. They can be found by any gender or species as well as being found on all planets. They are frightened by someone or something and will not care to talk with the player and instead run from them.

Keer was a bounty hunter and a member of Hal'Lath Quadruplets who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Lady Domina Tagge of the House of Tagge placed a bounty on rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

A human was an intern for De'Rruyet Industries during the Galactic Civil War. In 3 ABY, they were present at the De'Rruyet Center on the planet Midarr before Beol De'Rruyet, the company's leader, intended to unveil his replication of a Nihil Path engine hyperdrive.
Neeso was a Rodian who lived on Sedri Minor during the High Republic Era. They were a parent of Julus, who had gone missing by the time of the mission to Sedri Minor.

"Doc" was a clone trooper who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Doc fell into a trap within a fortress along with mercenary Asajj Ventress.
Karthata was a coach at a school located on the planet Tinnel IV.
Rees Rishikesh was a male Grand Counselor at a school on the planet Tinnel IV.

Lohim Nara was a boy who lived during the High Republic Era who dreamed of joining the Jedi Order despite not being Force-sensitive. When he was fourteen years old, he traveled from Level 1312 to the Jedi Temple, where he encountered Reina Bilass and Grand Master Yoda.

Kawlan Roken was a human male activist during the height of the Galactic Empire, who operated an underground network known as Hidden Path that smuggled surviving Jedi and Force-sensitives to safety during the Great Jedi Purge.
Wade Resselian was a male human dissident who was part of an underground movement known as The Path that helped smuggle Jedi hunted by the Galactic Empire to safety.
Sully Stark was a human female dissident of an underground movement that helped smuggle surviving Jedi to safety.
Tytan Latimer was a human who served as a security guard in Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon Nur by 9 BBY. The lead security on his level, Latimer held the rank of lieutenant.
A human male with the military rank of captain served as a terminal officer in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army and was stationed on Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon Nur.
An individual who was a human female served as a major in the Galactic Empire. By 9 BBY, the officer was stationed on Fortress Inquisitorius on the ocean moon Nur.
Skarhorn was a human male who served as a general in the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Skarhorn was present at an Imperial Complex on the planet Garel to open a munitions factory.

Jarl was a Weequay male who led a crew on the planet Coruscant by 22 BBY. That year, when the Mirialan Servit asked the Weequay about what price a family droid of his would fetch, Jarl, knowing that the droid was connected to the legend of the moon Shara'Tam, tried to take it …

Maree was a human who was the child of Imperial General Skarhorn and a woman during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, Maree was present when her father gave a speech at the opening of a munitions factory at an Imperial Complex on the Outer Rim world Garel.

An individual was a member of the Jedi Sturm Umbrik's Republic Pathfinder team. According to later family legend about her, she was killed during a pirate raid at the moon Shara'Tam in the Outer Rim Territories.

A woman was the wife of the human operative of the Hidden Path Kawlan Roken. She was a fugitive Force-sensitive during the Great Jedi Purge in the age of the Galactic Empire and was hunted down and killed by the Inquisitors of the Empire's Inquisitorius.

An unidentified small man was present on Neral's moon. He noticed Princess Rinetta Gan was wearing a gherlian fur tunic and offered to buy it from her for 1,000 credits. When she refused, he offered 2,000 credits and a hold-out blaster.
Xeebi's daughter was a Rodian female who, along with her mother, was freed from slavery on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine by the former Naboo Royal Handmaiden Sabé in 28 BBY.

A Togruta male individual was part of a crew on the planet Coruscant. In 22 BBY, while chasing after a droid that was known to point to treasure, the crew ended up at Dex's Diner, holding the customers there hostage.

An individual observed Chiss Mitth'raw'nuruodo, who had been exiled to a planet where Chiss Ascendancy Supreme General Ba'kif selected as it was likely that Thrawn encountered the Galactic Empire, from a discreet distance.
Sturm Umbrik was a Pathfinder Jedi who was part of an Outer Rim Exploration Team that discovered the moon Shara'Tam, the location of a valuable statue.

A Mon Calamari male escaped from slavery in the Outer Rim. He was brought to the planet Karlinus in the Chommell sector, where he automatically became a citizen. The Mon Calamari was nervous at first but the Rodian Xeebi helped him comprehend his new freedom.
Tepoh was a genderfluid human hailing from the Mid Rim planet Naboo. The Naboo worker eventually joined the employ of the Naboo diplomatic corps and explored the galaxy outside of zher homeworld.

Zarah Bliss was a female spice runner and pilot who led the Spice Runners of Kijimi. In 40 BBY, Bliss allowed the runaway Jedi Padawan Lizel Liit to travel with her; however, the spice runner ultimately brought Liit to the planet Desinta to be auctioned to the highest bidder.

Varna was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic that held the military rank of Clone Commander during the Clone Wars under the command of Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi. Varna was killed while evacuating from the siege of Devalok aboard a Low Altitude Assault Transport.
A female individual was the mother of the Mirialan Servit. One of her ancestors was a member of a team of Republic Pathfinders centuries before Servit's lifetime.

Perturbed Party Planner was a Lanai residing on Ahch-To. They were a party planner and had set up much music and games, however, no one was dancing. As a result, the Practical Party Planner asked a Protocol droid to help get five Lanai to dance and start the party.
Practical Party Planner was a Lanai residing on Ahch-To. They were a party planner along with the Perturbed Party Planner and had set up much music and games, however, no one was dancing.
A clone trooper was an Advanced Recon Force trooper in the Grand Army of the Republic's 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.
Concerned Resistance Officer was a male Human aligned with the Resistance. He admired the late Admiral Gial Ackbar and wanted to get the rookie soldiers out of the traps on Endor, Crait and Jakku.

Aki-Aki Storyteller was a male Aki-Aki found at the Festival of the Ancestors. He told the story "The Rise and Fall of Panakin Slytalker" which was about a Jedi Knight named Bye-Gon Jim who met a young Panakin Slytalker.

Character Expert was a Aki-Aki found at the Festival of the Ancestors. They were the expert of the characters in the story "The Rise and Fall of Panakin Slytalker" which was about a Jedi Knight named Bye-Gon Jim who met a young Panakin Slytalker.

Rayyne was a Wookiee female navigator who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Rayyne met with Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on a mission for the Galactic Senate.

Naijoh was a Wookiee male captain who worked on the Wookiee starship Namrelllew in 22 BBY. Shortly after the beginning of the Clone Wars, Naijoh met with Senator Padmé Amidala when she went undercover on the ship on a mission for the Galactic Senate.

Servit was a Mirialan male who owned an EX droid that was a clue to the location of a valuable treasure. In 22 BBY, he accidentally revealed the droid to Jarl, a Weequay who wished to take the droid for himself.
Tals Trilby was a Kadrillian male who served as a detective in the Temple District Police on the planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era.
Reina Bilass, formerly known as Reina Ganzee, was a humanoid female Jedi Initiate during the High Republic Era.

Reyé Hollis was a Naboo human and a sergeant in the Rebel Alliance Special Forces. The man from Naboo was one of the rebels who participated in constructing Echo Base. Despite his doubts about the Jedi Order, he soon bonded with the Jedi Luke Skywalker.
Uma Kalidi was a female Jedi Master from Devalok. During her lifetime, Kalidi saved her homeworld by single-handedly defeating an army of fear-naughts.
Hol Okand was a human male who served as a starfighter pilot for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Okand was a member of Gold Squadron within the Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps.

Pasaana Farmer was a Male Aki-Aki who lived in the Pasaana Plains. He was the owner of the speeder bikes that Finn, Rey Skywalker, Poe Dameron, Chewbacca, C-3PO and BB-8 destroyed during the battle with the First Order during the Festival of the Ancestors.

Mar-Ko was a male Human and former First Order Stormtrooper who lived on Kef Bir. He was a member of Company 77. He was digging for treasure after discovering a letter from imperial stationary on the beach.

Injured Wookiee Captain was a male Wookiee who resided on Kashyyyk during the Clone Wars. He was worried that his warriors were not going to live much longer fighting the remaining Clone troopers on Kachirho. He asked for assistance in their cause and to push back the clones.

Wookiee Choir Master was a Male Wookiee who resided on Kashyyyk. He was upset that his bandmates were not in correct positions and were making a mockery of his performance. He wished that he could be a Jedi so that he could use The Force to move them into positions.
A human male Imperial Navy officer was the captain of the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader's Imperial I-class Star Destroyer Devastator.
Sliro Barsha, also known as Sliro Ruback, was a human male who served as a Director in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau.

A human female was the mother of the child Maree, whom they had with General Skarhorn of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the three traveled to Garel, an Outer Rim world, where Skarhorn gave a speech at the opening of a munitions factory.
Zaycker Asheron was a male individual who served as the commanding officer of Halo Squadron within the New Republic Defense Force. Asheron held the military rank of lieutenant.
Dina Dipurl was a female individual who served as a pilot within Halo Squadron of the New Republic Defense Force. Dipurl held the military rank of flight sergeant.

Lizel Liit was a female Jedi Padawan in the service of the Jedi Order. Sometime between 42 BBY and 32 BBY, Liit began to wonder if she truly belonged with the Jedi Order, and ran away from Coruscant without informing anyone, including her Master.
Sono Molec was a Zygerrian prince and the son of King Atai Molec. He ruled over the Zygerrian Empire slave operations from his palace on the planet Kowak.
Enyo was an orange-skinned Twi'lek female. In 21 ABY, they served as an instructor for the Jedi Order at Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's Academy on the planet Ossus.
An old human female was the magistrate of the planet Hebekrr Minor during the Clone Wars, a pan-galactic conflict between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Galactic Republic.
A female individual was the granddaughter of the planet Hebekrr Minor's magistrate by the time of the Clone Wars conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

x: A female individual was the wife of the granddaughter of the planet Hebekrr Minor's magistrate by the time of the Clone Wars conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.
A male colonel in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army served on the Mid Rim planet Haidoral Prime during the Galactic Civil War, policing the governor, Everi Chalis.

Axel Greylark, known in holomags as the "Coruscant Prince," or as "Chaos" to the Mother of the Path of the Open Hand, was a human male who was the controversial son of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark.

Mahlnor, also nicknamed Mal, was a Twi'lek individual acquainted with Gial Ackbar.

A clerk of the same species as Armo Malou was the proprietor of a supply store in the town of Anchorhead on Tatooine. In 9 BBY, he served moisture farmers Owen Lars and Luke Skywalker when they found themselves in need of replacement parts for their speeder.
An individual served as the dean of the University of Bar'leth on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth at some point between 11 BBY and 3 BBY.
Aminar was a female nominally elected leader of the planet Desinta. Aminar served as the leader of Desinta sometime during the years 42 BBY and 32 BBY.

Dagan Gera was a Force-sensitive Arkanian Offshoot male who was a Jedi Knight and renowned explorer during the High Republic Era and a well-respected member of the Jedi Order during his prime, and discovered the paradisical planet Tanalorr on an uncharted trip through the dead…

Sekhmet was a targon female who was owned by the former Acolytes of the Beyond member Komat on the planet Polaar. She was immune to the planets distronic radiation.

The male overseer of the Outer Rim planet Vernid's worm farming industry employed the man Devon Lhent, in reality the ex-Imperial Major Soran Keize, as a dig-rig worker around 4 ABY.

Wilmar was a human boy aboard the Halcyon and the son of Colram Vestig.

A non-binary Chalhuddan youngling was a Force-sensitive Jedi Initiate of the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, they were part of a group addressed by Jedi Anakin Skywalker regarding lessons learned on the way to becoming a Jedi Knight.

TD-3300 was a human who served as a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Not long after the destruction of Alderaan, TD-3300 was stationed aboard the Halcyon starcruiser under the command of General Kardan.

The Magysine was a fictitious Force-sensitive male of The Magys's species that Chiss Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo "Thrawn" created to confuse his enemy according to the enemy himself, the Grysk operative "Jixtus." Around 18 BBY, on the Unknown Regions planet Sunrise, Thraw…
A female individual lived during the New Republic Era. In 13 ABY, they had a daughter—Kadara Calrissian—with the human Lando Calrissian.

Xarah Blacwood was a middle-aged female individual who served as a commander in the New Republic and was in command of the New Republic staging outpost in orbit of the planet Adelphi. She had sharp features, and had a bob of bright white hair with a metallic blue sheen.

Plo Mandrill was a criminal known to the twins Bosvarga and Cerensco. By 21 ABY, Mandrill had died, a fact Bosvarga informed his twin of when Cerensco suggested hiring Mandrill to assist them and the Jedi hunter Ochi in locating a young girl for the Sith.

Casul Seedol was a male Mikkian from the remote planet Lenahra. He was the brother of Audj Seedol and the son of Ampher and Chemi.

A human male officer in the Milvayne Authority, the planet Milvayne's law enforcement agency, held a senior position in the police force.

Gorko was a human male who worked at Rekias Nodo's shipyard on an unidentified planet. He was best friends with the PJ unit droid Esstee-Ninety-Three.

A male Grysk commanded the Shatter-class WarMaster HopeBreaker while the warship orbited the Unknown Regions planet Sunrise, which the Grysk species had occupied, around 18 BBY.

Eliaora was a female individual who served as empress of the world Forrn. By 4 ABY, Princess Leia Organa had visited Forrn and established a connection with Eliaora.

A human individual served as an Imperial officer on planet Qhulosk during the Imperial Era. When Beilert Valance found by Han Solo's team, they sent him to a medical center. The Imperial officer told that Valance that he did not qualify for Imperial cybernetics coverage.
A female individual served as chieftess of the world Inusagi during the reign of the Galactic Empire. By 4 ABY, Princess Leia Organa visited the world and established a connection with the chieftess.

By 4 ABY, an individual was a student at the University of Bar'leth located on the Core Worlds planet Bar'leth and wrote a thesis that included a mention of the moon Madurs.

Jul Tambor was a Skakoan male nationalist and pirate who was the grandson of Techno Union Foreman Wat Tambor and the son of Wat Tambor II. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Tambor led an uprising to reclaim the planet Skako Minor from a regime loyal to the Galactic Empire.

Avril Heert was a human male Imperial officer who served as an Attendant of the Imperial Security Bureau of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Heert served as the assistant to ISB Supervisor and Lieutenant Dedra Meero of Investigations.

Hyne was a human male who served as the Chief Inspector in the Pre-Mor Enforcement Inspection Team for the corporation Preox-Morlana during the Imperial Era.
Amyt was a Twi'lek girl from the planet Lenahra. By 41 BBY, she was one of a dozen children and teenagers who remained alive on the planet.
Vetch was an Urodel spare parts vendor whom the spare parts vendor Nurchi used to try and threaten the human Cassian Andor into repaying him a deposit in 5 BBY.

Around 3 ABY, a blue-skinned Twi'lek played the mercenary Sana Starros at a game of Dejarik on the Outer Rim Territories' 3rd Moon. During the game, the pair drew blasters on each other. In the midst of the standoff, an alien brough a holocomm that had been hailed for Starros.
Around 3 ABY, an alien was present on the Outer Rim Territories' 3rd Moon, and took a holocomm being hailed for the mercenary Sana Starros to its recipient.
Re-Bec Arclarka was a Hoopaloo male professor who worked for the Lerct Historical Institute. In 21 ABY, Arclarka presided over an expedition on Yoturba.

Tee Mairi was a female archaeologist who worked for the Lerct Historical Institute at their dig site on the planet Yoturba. In 21 ABY, she discovered a Sith holocron at the site which she presented to her supervisor, Professor Re-Bec Arclarka, believing it was a piece of art.
Mico Haswell was a Human male researcher who worked for the Lerct Historical Institute. In 21 ABY, Haswell participated in an expedition on Yoturba.
An individual was a member of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, they were sent undercover by the Alliance at Chinook Station on the world Bespin.

Eedy Karn was a human female who was the mother of Deputy Inspector Syril Karn and lived on Level 91 on Coruscant. In 5 BBY, Karn was surprised by a visit from her son, Syril Karn.

Verlo Skiff was a human male who served the law enforcement arm of Preox-Morlana on Morlana One as a sentry guard.

Bosvarga was an alien mercenary who worked alongside his identical twin, Cerensco. They accompanied the assassin Ochi of Bestoon when he reclaimed his starship, Bestoon Legacy, after it was hijacked by Dathan and Miramir to lead Ochi away from their daughter, Rey.
Capo was a young Force-sensitive Rodian who was a Jedi youngling that at some time after the Third Battle of Geonosis, asked a Jedi to find his misplaced favorite toy.

Gremac was an Iktotchi boy from the planet Lenahra. By 41 BBY, he was a young and cautious but cheerful child.

Whistle was a young Nautolan from the planet Lenahra. Due to the hostile environment of the planet, she and her sibling Trill had to live in a barrel full of water in the shipwreck that acted as the group's home and was cared for by their older sibling Shush and the other teen…

Trill was a young Nautolan from the planet Lenahra. Due to the hostile environment of the planet, she and her sibling Whistle had to live in a barrel full of water in the shipwreck that acted as the group's home and was cared for by their older sister Shush and the other teena…
Shush was a teenage Nautolan from the planet Lenahra. Due to the hostile environment of the planet, she lived in a barrel of water, only occasionally venturing out to help the group with tasks.

A Cerean female pilot was a refugee from the attack of Nihil. She was present Starlight Beacon during its destruction. Her starship was broked and she couldn't open the door until jedi knight Indeera Stokes helped her. She was one of the few who survived the destruction.
A Japealean female pilot was a refugee from the attack of Nihil. Her starship was saved by the Vessel.

An Enso female was the defense minister of the planet Eiram. When the Starlight Beacon fell to one of the big cities of Eiram, she advised to shoot it apart, but the Queen of Eiram dismissed the idea.

A human assassin worked for the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn during the Galactic Civil War. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the assassin was present on the planet Garel when General Skarhorn delivered a speech to mark the opening of an Imperial munitions factory.

A human individual served as an engineer in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the engineer was present along with sixteen other engineers aboard an Imperial starship when its reactor was sabotaged by a Crimson Dawn mole.
Perrin Fertha was a Chandrilan human male who was the husband and consort of Senator Mon Mothma, who he married when they were teenagers, and the father of Leida Mothma.

A Twi'lek served in the court of Imperial Sub-Administrator Sly Moore. In 3 ABY, the Twi'lek and the rest of Moore's court plotted to assassinate the Sith Lord Darth Vader by hiring the assassin droid IG-88 and provided the bounty hunter with a datacard that contained the deta…
An individual was a member of Imperial Sub-Administrator Sly Moore's court. In 3 ABY, the court plotted to assassinate the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Aaston Lok, designated Prisoner Five-Nine-One, was a prisoner located on Starlag XIX.
Drisk was a Pau'an aide who served alongside Tolteck on Starlag XIX.

Willa Volfrham was a female who was married to her husband Bolin during the Imperial Era. They had at least two adopted children, Jinko and a baby Xot. As celebrities on their homeworld, the Volfrhams used their children as devices to improve their popularity.

Crez Lorell was a human male cyborg who operated as an accountant. He worked for Bolin Volfrham during the Imperial Era. At some point he ran afoul of Volfrham who kidnapped him and exiled him to an unknown planet whose atmosphere prevented offworld communications.

Jinko was the adopted son of Bolin and Willa Volfrham during the Imperial Era. Adopted as a device to improve the Volfrhams' popularity, as Jinko grew older his use to the Volfrhams grew less and eventually he was replaced by a baby Xot.
Koop was a criminal who worked for the Sneevel Skraik.
Lister was a male Chadra-Fan criminal who worked for the Sneevel Skraik. At one point, he stole starship parts from the Lasat, Garazeb Orrelios.
Jarina was a human female who served against the Empire with the Mykapo insurgents, in Iron Squadron.
Stanger was a criminal who attacked a bar on Mykapo.

A human Imperial officer served in the Galactic Empire's prescreen department. In 3 ABY, after former Administrator Sly Moore was demoted to Sub-Administrator and placed in the prescreen department, she was present when the Imperial officer read off a number of items from a da…
Vargo was a Devaronian bounty hunter that once captured the Mandalorian Fenn Rau.
Bon-ray was a bartender who owned a cantina on the planet Orra.
Fraulda Rynn was a female Chiss who owned the pet Skoogia.
Marilena Pet-and-Ella Alda Mattea was the human commander of Freemarch, a rebel movement operating at the astronomical object Lorrd in the Corporate Sector.
Garr was a Force-sensitive Sullustan who was a Jedi youngling.
Tuz was a young Force-sensitive Mon Calamari who was a Jedi youngling that lived in the Jedi Temple.
Jama was a Force-sensitive Human female who was a Jedi youngling.
Brith was an alien individual who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Reen was a human individual and the child of Imperial workers Bevelyn and Jon Melton. Reen lived aboard the second Death Star with their parents and sibling Zelly as Bev and Melton worked aboard the station.

Zelly was a human female who was the daughter of Imperial personnel Bevelyn and Jon Melton. Along with her sibling Reen and parents, Zelly lived on the Empire's second Death Star as her parents worked aboard the station during its construction.
A female individual was the mother of Jude Edivon. She who held patents on numerous devices used in Bespin's cloud-mining technology.
In 19 BBY an individual served as Patriarch for the Chiss family Droc.
In 19 BBY an individual served as Patriarch for the Chiss family Csap.
A male Agbui indivudual served as a guard of a fake Agbui mining settlement located on the planet Hoxim, in 18 BBY.

A Chiss male individual served as a delegate of the Chiss Ascendancy's Clarr family. In 18 BBY, he, along with a delegate of the Obbic family, complained to Mitth family Syndic Mitth'urf'ianico, core name "Thurfian," about the Universal Analysis Group—an organization that stud…

In 18 BBY an individual served as a delegate for the Chiss family Obbic. The individual presented threats to Syndic Prime Mitth'urf'ianico along with a delegate from the Clarr family regarding the fish on Sposia because of the Universal Analysis Group.
Zallah Macri was a Soikan female Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. She was the master of the Pantoran Kevmo Zink and was the head of the Temple Outpost at Port Haileap.

Kevmo Zink was a Pantoran male who became the Padawan of Jedi Master Zallah Macri around 384 BBY during the High Republic Era. After a Force artifact was stolen from Hynestia, the two followed a trail to Dalna while investigating.

Rooper Nitani was a human female Jedi Knight who lived during the High Republic Era. As a Padawan, she was apprenticed to Jedi Master Silandra Sho. Hailing from the planet Rohm, Nitani was recruited by the Jedi Order at a young age.

Sannen was a male Force-sensitive individual who served the Jedi Order as a Jedi General during the Clone Wars. During the battle for the fourth moon of Parein II, Sannen led the Galactic Republic's forces against General Grievous and his Separatist forces.
Coromun was a male individual who served as a Viceprex for the Corporate Sector Authority.

Gantika was a Togruta female who served as the elder of a village on the planet Shili during the Republic Era. When Pav-ti Tano and Nak-il Tano's daughter Ahsoka Tano was born, Gantika was summoned to the scene in order to be informed of the child's name.
Vel Sartha was a human Chandrilan female during the Imperial Era who was a rebel within a network operated by the revolutionary leader Luthen Rael in resistance to the Galactic Empire.
Kai Brightstar was a human male Jedi youngling sent to the forest planet Tenoo for training during the High Republic Era.
Nash Durango was a female human pilot and mechanic from the Outer Rim planet of Tenoo who lived during the High Republic Era.
The Eleventh Brother was a Force-sensitive male individual who served the Galactic Empire as part of its Jedi-hunting Inquisitorius.
Rosack Denahst was a Defel who worked as a miner in an outpost on the planet Codia I's second moon at some point between 41 BBY and 32 BBY.
Kron was a Force-sensitive individual who was a Jedi youngling who asked a Jedi on the planet Tatooine to find a model podracer.
A human burglar was part of a group of thieves who destroyed the power core of a mining outpost on Codia's second moon while attempting to steal a shipment of diamonds.
A Gran worked as supervisor of an outpost on the planet Codia I's second moon at some point between 44 BBY and 32 BBY.
A bearded human male thief was part of a group of burglars who attempted to steal diamonds from a mining outpost on Codia's second moon.

Cerensco was an alien mercenary who worked alongside his identical twin, Bosvarga. They accompanied the assassin Ochi of Bestoon when he reclaimed his starship, Bestoon Legacy, after it was hijacked by Dathan and Miramir to lead Ochi away from their daughter, Rey.
A Chiss syndic represented the Chiss Ascendancy's Kiwu family in the Chiss Syndicure, the ruling body of the Ascendancy.
Moona was a Twi'lek female who seemingly never left the bar Enlightenment on Jedha. In 382 BBY, Moona was middle-aged.

Saretha von Beel was a female human hyperspace prospector active during the High Republic Era. Operating out of Black Spire Outpost on Batuu, von Beel met Jedi Master Lee Harro after being captured by pirates.
Keth Cerepath was a human male resident of Jedha City during the High Republic Era. He was an adjunct at the Temple of the Kyber, and spent his evenings drinking at the tapbar Enlightenment.

Bordeaux was a human individual who served under General Maximilian Veers at the Battle of Hoth in 3 ABY. During the battle, Bordeaux carried out an assault on the rear blast doors of Echo Base which tipped the battle to the Empire.
Omel Sampak was a Pyke gangster who served as a member of the Pyke Syndicate during the Galactic Civil War.

A Pyke was a member of the Pyke Syndicate during the Galactic Civil War. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, they served under the gangster Omel Sampak and was present with Sampak aboard the space station Accretion Disco when Sampak hired out the station to celebrate a victory over a rival.

A human served as an Imperial officer in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, the officer was present on the Imperial Star Destroyer Righteous Fist and bought a drink for Lieutenant Beilert Valance, who they considered cute.

The personal bodyguard of Duke Chanward, an aristocrat of the Noble Court of the Anoat sector, was assassinated during the Iron Blockade, an Imperial lockdown of the sector to prevent its occupants from learning of the death of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Empir…

Nubs was a Pooba male who trained as a Jedi Initiate during the High Republic Era. Inseparable from fellow younglings Kai Brightstar and Lys Solay, Nubs studied the ways of the Force under the watchful eye of Grand Master Yoda on the planet Tenoo.
Leebon was a Selonian who served as a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era.
Lee Harro was a human male Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. He and hyperspace prospector Saretha von Beel were once captured by the same band of pirates.
Chantho was a male Ithorian bartender who worked at the Enlightenment tapbar in the Holy City on the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era.
Delphine was a female Gloovan bodyguard who worked at the Enlightenment tapbar in Jedha City as one of the Twinkle Sisters, alongside the nearly-identical Gloovan Camille.

A human individual was an assassin in Kanjiklub from the Outer Rim world Nar Kanji. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the assassin sought revenge on the Pyke Syndicate gangster Omel Sampak after he ordered the bombing of a Nar Kanji fight school, which killed a number of students as th…
A human Imperial officer served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era aboard the flagship of Tauntaza, the governor of the planet Gabredor III.

Camille was a female Gloovan bodyguard who, alongside her almost-identical counterpart Delphine, worked at the Jedha City tapbar Enlightenment as security during the High Republic Era. The duo were known as the Twinkle Sisters.

Madelina Song was a female Iktotchi musician who worked as an electroharpist at the Enlightenment tapbar on Jedha during the High Republic Era. She played music which came off as bemusing and impenetrable, although Keth Cerepath supposed that she intended it to be soothing.
A human Imperial Army commander was stationed at an Imperial outpost on Tatooine where they gave his subordinate, JM-909, a reprimand because of the loss of the ration stores.

The sister of the human Stallo was a female who lived in a village on the planet Carajam. At one point between around 2 BBY and 4 ABY, the villagers were taken hostage by the criminal Zingo Gabnit, who was trying to set a trap for the bounty hunter Boba Fett.
Bleena was a male slicer who lived on the planet Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, he worked for Lady Valarian's lieutenant Kavas Urdano.

Timm Karlo was a human male who worked at Caleen Salyard on Ferrix with his eventual lover Bix Caleen. Jealous and drinking, Karlo reported the wanted Cassian Jeron Andor, the ex-boyfriend of Caleen, to Preox-Morlana.

Willi was a chatty human who worked in propulsion and visited the planet Ferrix to spend money. In 5 BBY, he traveled to Ferrix City on a shuttle ferry and began talking to fellow passenger Luthen Rael when the shuttle began circling the city, waiting to land.

Granik was a surly alien who worked as a dispatcher at Xanwan's freight kiosk on the planet Ferrix. In 5 BBY, he discussed a notice put out by the Preox-Morlana corporation with the kiosk's proprietor, Xanwan. The notice mentioned the world Kenari, which Garnik had not heard of.
Brasso was a human male who served as a Grappler and Honor guard on the planet Ferrix within the Free Trade Sector, which he had long been a citizen of.
A human Imperial lieutenant served in the Galactic Empire under Admiral Firmus Piett aboard the Executor, the flagship of the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

A Yarkora individual with white hair, brown eyes, and brown skin was a pit warrior who fought at the Garkata Fighting Arena on the moon Nar Shaddaa during the Imperial Era. They wore white armor with a brown tunic underneath.

East-1 was the callsign of a human individual who served in the Preox-Morlana Corporate Tactical Forces. During the Imperial Era, East-1 participated in an ambush on Ferrix against Cassian Jeron Andor.
North-1 was the callsign of a human individual who served in the Preox-Morlana Corporate Tactical Forces. During the Imperial Era, North-1 led North Team in an ambush on Ferrix.

North-3 was the callsign of a human individual who served in the Preox-Morlana Corporate Tactical Forces. During the time of the Galactic Empire, North-3 participated in an mission to try and arrest Cassian Andor.
West-4 was the call sign of a human individual who served in the Preox-Morlana Corporate Tactical Forces. During the Imperial Era, West-4 participated in an ambush on Ferrix against Cassian Andor.

West-3 was the call sign of a human individual who served in the Preox-Morlana Corporate Tactical Forces. During the Imperial Era, West-3 participated in an ambush on Ferrix against Cassian Jeron Andor.
A Chiss communications officer served the Xodlak family's Midsummer as the ship's communications officer. He was a member of the Xodlak family.
A Chiss pilot served the Xodlak family's Midsummer as the ship's pilot. He was a member of the Xodlak family.
A Chiss second officer served the Xodlak family's Midsummer as the ship's second officer. He was a member of the Xodlak family.
A Chiss sensors officer served the Xodlak family's Midsummer as the ship's sensors officer. The officer was a member of the Xodlak family.
Wilmon Paak, or "Wil" for short, was a human male who lived on Ferrix during the Imperial Era. His father Salman Paak operated Repaak Salyard in town.

Clem Andor was a male human mechanic and salvager from the planet Ferrix. Prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars, he accompanied his wife Maarva on the planet Kenari, where the pair found and adopted Cassian Jeron Andor.

Rashi was a human male who lived and worked on the planet Ferrix as a grappler in a salvage yard. In 5 BBY, Rashi was present in the salvage yard when a team of Preox-Morlana Corpos arrived on Ferrix.

Gani was the name used by a human hostess at a Leisure Zone brothel on the planet Morlana One. In 5 BBY, Gani conversed with the Preox-Morlana sentries Corporal Kravas Drezzer and Verlo Skiff at the establishment's bar after the pair complained that another hostess had approac…
A human female hostess worked at a brothel in the Leisure Zone on the planet Morlana One.
Pegla was a human male who worked for Zorby as a sentry at Zorby's Western Shiplot on the planet Ferrix during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

A human bartender was an enforcer of Jarm Brock. They were stationed in Mos Entha when Deva Lompop and Boba Fett came for Brock's head. While the two bounty hunters spoke with the bartender, they were ambushed by Brock.
An individual was a member of the crime syndicate Crimson Dawn. They visited the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure at his palace to invite him to an auction for Han Solo.
A Nautolan criminal lived on the moon Nar Shaddaa. The Nautolan and their friends teased Deva Lompop, but the bounty hunter hit them unconscious.

Jezzi was a human female living on the planet Ferrix. She was a member of the Daughters of Ferrix, a local social club, and a good friend to Maarva Carassi Andor, an elder woman of the community and a former president of the Daughters.
One night in 5 BBY, Femmi and Jezzi bought medicine for the elderly human Maarva Andor and supper to the Andor household on the planet Ferrix.
Zorby was the proprietor of Zorby's Western Shiplot on the planet Ferrix during the reign of the Galactic Empire, employing the human sentry Pegla as his de facto head of security.

Dams Denna was a diminutive human from the planet Naboo who worked as an animal trainer. In 32 BBY, they attended a celebratory parade held in the streets of Naboo's capital, Theed, following the Naboo and Gungan victory over the Trade Federation during the Battle of Naboo.

Bruckman was among the team members that entered the security bunker at the rear of the generator where they began placing charges; however, they were captured by Imperial forces that had laid a trap for them.
Xanwan, also known as Xan, was a human male who owned a transport business on Ferrix. He ran his business alongside the alien Granik.

Jezra'lin was a Mon Calamari non-binary member of the missionary order Path of the Open Hand on the planet Dalna. They had an older sibling who was Force-sensitive and had an unfulfilled hope that they would also be sensitive to the Force.
A human female individual was the leader of a group of children on the planet Kenari. She was approximately sixteen years of age when she was killed while approaching a wrecked craft.

Kradon Minst was a Villarandi who owned the tapbar Enlightenment on Jedha in 382 BBY. He was willing to sell information on his patrons for the right price, gaining him a reputation of being the go-to information broker on Jedha. He introduced Saretha von Beel to Keth Cerepath.
A human individual was the doorman of a brothel in the Leisure Zone on the planet Morlana One. In 5 BBY, he scanned Cassian Jeron Andor before allowing him to enter the brothel.

Gemmy was a tooka who lived at the Jedi temple on the Outer Rim planet Dalna during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, when Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh and Jedi Padawan Imri Cantaros visited the temple, Gemmy was present at the temple's entrance.
Kensaric was a human male who served as a corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.
Mamazooz was a Culisetto female and the mother of Cribiriz Idollax and Sribiriz.

Brooks Carlson was a human male who was a sergeant in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's Pathfinders unit during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. By 4 ABY, he was considered a veteran and had trained the communications operative Corporal Beezer.

Sribiriz was a Culisetto male and the brother of warlord and droid mechanic Cribiriz Idollax. One day, before 9 BBY, Sribiriz told his brother he was going to report his crimes to the authorities. Therefore, Cribiriz decided to change his ways and to stop being a criminal.

A Dug was a bounty hunter during the Imperial Era. At some point before 9 BBY, Deva Lompop hired a group of bounty hunters, including the infamous Zuckuss and 4-LOM, to kill Culisetto warlord Cribiriz Idollax, who, in her opinion, was becoming a threat.
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana's Pre-Mor Security Inspection team in 5 BBY.
This rebel was a human female from Onderon who served the Onderon rebels during the Clone Wars.

Radicaz Dobbs, known as "Sunshine" to his friends, was a human male treasure hunter and smuggler from the planet Eriadu who lived during the High Republic Era. Dobbs specialized in Force artifacts and operated out of the pleasure yacht Scupper.

By later the same year, Aurin had become wary of the Path due to their incitement of the Battle of Jedha on the Mid Rim moon. The reporter Ric Farazi questioned the Umbaran about the Path due to their friendship with Ro, making them uncomfortable.
Tycho Celchu was a male rebel pilot from Alderaan who piloted an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor at one point during the Battle of Endor.

Juno Eclipse was a human from Corulag and a pilot of the Galactic Empire, considered the finest from her planet. At one point, she piloted a TIE Advanced x1 through an asteroid field by a celestial body, firing lasers from the ship's L-s9.3 laser cannons.

Sicko, designated CT-1127/549, was a clone trooper pilot of the Galactic Republic who served in the pan-galactic Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. During the conflict, Sicko piloted an LAAT/i gunship in several instances.

"Sigma 5" was the callsign used by an Imperial Starfighter Pilot during the Imperial Era. Sigma 5 participated in the Battle of Yavin, piloting a TIE/IN interceptor as part of Sigma Squadron. During the battle, they were flying in a defensive position over the equatorial trench.

"Sigma 6" was the callsign used by an Imperial Starfighter Pilot during the Imperial Era. Sigma 6 participated in the Battle of Yavin, piloting a TIE/IN interceptor as part of Sigma Squadron. They had at least one kill during the battle, destroying a Rebek BTL Y-wing starfighter.
Karis Nemik was a human male freedom fighter who served as part of a team assigned to steal the quarterly payroll of the Galactic Empire's base on Aldhani.
Blevin was a human male who held the rank of lieutenant and served as a supervisor in the Imperial Security Bureau's Investigations detachment during the Imperial Era.

Lonni Jung was a human male who served as a mole for the Axis network led by Luthen Rael within the Imperial Security Bureau's Investigations branch. Despite his position as a ISB Supervisor, Looni had both a wife and a daughter, whom he went out of his way to protect.

Arvel Skeen was a human male who served under Vel Sartha as a part of her team. He was among the group who carried out a mission on the planet Aldhani. He was killed by Cassian Jeron Andor following the heist for his proposal to betray surviving members of the team.

Taramyn Barcona was a human male who was a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire's Stormtrooper Corps before becoming a soldier in a secret rebel network. In 5 BBY, Barcona worked as part of a team that served a mission on the planet Aldhani, and perished during the raid.
Cinta Kaz was a human female who was a member of the rebel network operated by Luthen Rael in resistance to the Galactic Empire. At some point, Kaz's entire family was killed by stormtroopers.
Gorn was a human male dissident during the Imperial Era who served the Galactic Empire as a lieutenant in the Imperial Army local garrison on Aldhani.
A Frizznoth was a Nihil marauder, holding the rank of Strike in the Tempest of Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, serving aboard the starship Lourna Dee.

Sont Eval was a Nihil marauder served in the Tempest of Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, on aboard the starship Lourna Dee. After the Battle of Galov Sont was captured by the Galactic Republic and Jedi Order forces, and taken to Starlight Beacon.
Rekanaktric or Rek was an insectoid female criminal who was captured and imprisoned aboard the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era. She often plays card with Tasia.

Stub was a male member of the Kouhun, a secret order of assassins operating in the Anoat sector. Between 4 ABY and 5 ABY, Stub contacted the Smuggler—leader of the Uprising—to obtain information regarding Imperial activity on the planet Mataou.

Arman was an individual male who was a governor and the commander of the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era. After Pan Eyta and his gang occupy the ship he was executed by Pan when he tried to call the Galactic Republic.

Yana Ro was an Evereni female who lived in 382 BBY. She was the cousin of Marda Ro. As young children, their grandparents and Yana's sire were killed in an attack, and their respective mothers fled with them to the planet Dalna.
Kor Plouth was a Force-sensitive Nautolan female who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. She was the daughter of Werth and Opari Plouth, and the girlfriend of Yana Ro.

Opari Plouth was a Nautolan female member of the Path of the Open Hand cult during the High Republic Era. She was married to Werth Plouth, the cult's former leader, and was the mother of Kor Plouth. She suffered from a wasting disease.

Azlin Rell was a human male Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. A naturally humble and self-effacing individual, Rell deeply trusted in the Force and cared about undertaking his duties as a Jedi.

Xiri A'lbaran was a human female who was princess and heir to the throne of the planet E'ronoh and a captain in Thylefire Squadron during the High Republic Era. She fought in the war between E'ronoh and its sister planet, Eiram, which raged for five years.
Char-Ryl-Roy was a Cerean male Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council during the High Republic Era.
Lina was a female pilot in the fleet of the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh, her homeworld. She was the sister of Bly Tevin, who also resided on the world with their mother in a family apartment.

Alonso San Tekka was a human male Republic Pathfinder official and member of the San Tekka clan who lived during the High Republic Era. He was involved in the plotting of a hyperspace route to a planet on the edge of Wild Space.

A male Paccosh served the Paccian Governance as a commando. They served Paccosh Commander Uingali foar Marocsaa as one of the commandos of Marocsaa's commando squad aboard the commander's Nikardun blockade frigate Aelos.

A male individual was claimed to be the brother of Arvel Skeen, a human male. Arvel told the team of rebels on Aldhani that his brother had grown pepper trees on his farm and later committed suicide after an Imperial Prefect possessed and flooded his land.
Deng was a Swokes Swokes Nihil who was a member of Pan Eyta's Tempest but later captured and imprisoned aboard the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era.

Gar Tafeed was an individual who talked with Perrin Fertha, the husband of Senator Mon Mothma, at an event in 5 BBY. He and Fertha discussed Mothma, who was also present at the event, during the conversation.
Remou was a criminal who was captured and imprisoned aboard the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era. She often plays cards with Tasia.
A non-binary Force-sensitive individual was the older sibling of Jezra'lin—a non-binary Mon Calamari who was one of the Littles, children in the Path of the Open Hand cult.

Cincey was a human who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. They managed the communications of the order, censoring outgoing messages on the behalf of the Elders, and collecting information useful for the Children's missions.
Aris Ade was a human female who was an Elder in the Path of the Open Hand.

Delwin was a Weequay who was an Elder in the Path of the Open Hand in 382 BBY. When Morton San Tekka, the mediator for the Eiram–E'ronoh peace treaty was killed, the Path put forward Delwin as a replacement mediator, but was rejected.
Eff was a Klatooinian member of the Path of the Open Hand and the younger sibling of Ferali.
A rebel bombed an Imperial facility on the shore of the Cordaxian Sea on the planet Odona, where Frax was forced to labor. The pilot angered Frax and was killed by him.
Treze was a Mikkian male who was a member of the Children within the Path of the Open Hand.

Hazeltow was a counselor aboard the Galactic Republic prison ship Restitution during the High Republic Era. Dee's presence aboard the Restitution eventually led her rival, former Tempest Runner Pan Eyta, to attack the vessel.
Efrik was a human who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand.

Trilok was a Gormak and the new lieutenant of Pan Eyta during the High Republic Era. Trilok helped to capture Lourna Dee and occupy the prison ship Restitution. He was killed when Quin Carree reprogrammed Eyta's scavenge droids to attack the team.
Er Dal was a Kessarine male who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. He was one of Ferize's partners, and they had five children.
Jacinda Graf was a female member of the Graf family who was the aunt of Sky Graf. She owned the Graf family compound on Thelj.
Pamalonia Graf was a member of the Graf family during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, it was announced that Graf was to marry a shipping heir from the Core Worlds planet Coruscant.

A member of the Grysk species commanded six Prism-class BattleChiefs part of Grysk operative Jixtus's fleet. Around 18 BBY, they reported the Chiss Clarr light cruiser Orisson encounter with the Grysk warships in the Rhigal system's Junkyard asteroid field.
Sachar Rold was an individual who founded the Path of the Open Hand cult on the planet Dalna after breaking away from the Guardians of the Whills on the moon Jedha where he served as a priest.

A Hynestian female was queen of the Colonies planet Hynestia Prime during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, a Force artifact known as the Rod of Seasons owned by the queen was stolen from the Hynestian royal palace by members of the Path of the Open Hand cult.

Ferize was a Kessarine female member of the Path of the Open Hand. She had two male partners, Er Dal and Fel Ix. In 382 BBY, Ferize and her partners hatched a clutch of five children, including Fe Isle, Fe Tale, and Fe Remine.

Harlo was a friend of the Karn family, close enough that Eedy Karn and Syril Karn always called him "Uncle Harlo." He took an interest in Syril's career, helping him get a position in the Imperial Bureau of Standards and monitoring his advancement in the office.

An individual served as a royal guard for the Royal Family of Alderaan. In 3 BBY, he was stationed in the antechamber of the palace's throne room the day of princess' Leia Organa's Day of Demand being the tallest guard there.

A Chiss member of the Tahmie family served aboard a Tahmie patrol cruiser during a crisis in the Chiss Ascendancy nation. The Tahmie was present at a Skirmish at Jamiron where the Tahmie family faced off against the Droc family
Jayhold Beehaz was an Imperial Military officer who served the Galactic Empire as the commandant of the Aldhani Garrison, headquartered on the Aldhani dam and Alkenzi Air Base on the planet Aldhani.
Looking forward to viewing the upcoming Eye of Aldhani celestial event, Petigar witnessed a meteor pass over the dam while using a survey scope.

Leonart Beehaz was the son of Jayhold Beehaz, an Imperial Military Officer, and his wife, Roboda Beehaz. He and his mother were taken captive by rebels in order to make his father co-operate in the Aldhani heist.
Roboda Beehaz was the wife of Commandant Jayhold Beehaz and mother of Leonart Beehaz. She and her son were taken captive by rebels during the Aldhani heist in order to make her husband co-operate.
A skilled Jillsarian male surgeon known only as Doctor Quadpaw worked on those in need who had nowhere else to turn, and the credits to pay, on the moon Frezno.
Tarna Miak was a human who served as an Adept in the Sorcerers of Tund and who could manipulate fire. In 382 BBY, Miak was the Sorcerers representative in the Convocation of the Force on Jedha.

Dhow was a human who served as a senator in the Imperial Senate during the Imperial Era. In 5 BBY, Dhow advocated together with Chandrilan senator Mon Mothma in the Senate for the rights of the Ghormans who were being persecuted by the Galactic Empire.

Alkenzi Wing Seven was the call sign of a pilot that served under the Alkenzi Air Command on Aldhani. During a mission on Aldhani by a rebel infiltration team, Alkenzi Wing Seven conducted an eastern sweep, with the individual checking in through their communications and heard…
Kilan T'Dara was an Ayrou member of the Church of the Force on the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era.

Shogun was an alias used by a Jedi of the Jedi clans who fought in the Sith rebellion. Near the end of the war, they experienced a vision of a god known as the Father, who told them to visit the Temple of Elujoji on the planet Sukalan.

Karla was an individual whom Maarva Andor, adoptive mother of the human male Cassian Andor, considered to be one of "Cassian's women." In 5 BBY, Maarva and Cassian discussed who knew that Cassian's real homeworld was Kenari while in their home on the planet Ferrix.

Sondreen was a female individual whom the human male Cassian Andor's adoptive mother, Maarva Andor, considered to be one of "Cassian's women." In 5 BBY, when Cassian and Maarva had a discussion in their home on the planet Ferrix about who knew that Cassian's real homeworld was…
Creighton Sun was a human male Jedi Master who lived during the High Republic Era. A virtuous and traditional Jedi, Sun had a reputation of being unsociable.

Elris Florent was a female member of the Disciples of the Whills religion during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Florent was the Disciples' representative on the Convocation of the Force council on the holy moon Jedha.
Sirené Taran was a Force-sensitive member of the Fallanassi during the High Republic Era and represented the religion on the Convocation of the Force on the moon Jedha around 382 BBY.

Susalee was a Lonto who served as the representative for her people on the Convocation of the Force, a council of Force-based religious organizations based in the Holy City of the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era.
Waran Val was a Kel Dor individual who served as the Matukai's representative on the Convocation of the Force on the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era.
The Yacombe Delegate was an envoy for the Yacombe religion during the High Republic Era. She spoke through a proxy as they did not speak themselves.
A Sarkan female pilgrim visited the moon Jedha in 382 BBY. During the journey to the Holy City on a starship, the Sarkan sat next to Jedi Vildar Mac.

A Kessurian criminal worked as an assistant to Ran Yaltan. In 382 BBY, Yaltan and the assistant were present in the Holy City on Jedha, and Yaltan posed as the last member of the Truthsayers of Bpfassh in order to scam the citizens of the city of zukkels.

Sister V'Kara was a Sarravi female who lived in the Holy City on the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, there were a series of robberies across the city, and she approached the Sephi Tey Sirrek for help.
Sky Graf was a human non-binary pilot and member of the Graf family. A tech genius by the age of fifteen, Graf was determined to be the first to reach the mysterious Planet X.

Yarli Yren was a human who served as a Republic Pathfinder during the High Republic Era, in 382 BBY. They stayed at Lady Jara's boarding house in the town of Ferdan on the planet Dalna at the same time as Jedi Knight Zallah Macri and her Padawan, Kevmo Zink.

Ravna Abronsa was a human female who served as a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era. She owned the droid ZZ-10 and was the Master of the Wookiee Arkoff. In 382 BBY, the three fought in the Battle of Dalna against the Path of the Open Hand.

Vlem Hill was a member of the Muun Hill family who worked for the InterGalactic Banking Clan. Decades before the Clone Wars, Hill quietly purchased the rights to an uninhabited planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Instrop sector from the Galactic Republic for industrial develo…
Ran Yaltan posed as the last member of the Truthsayers of Bpfassh in order to scam citizens on the moon Jedha. In 382 BBY, Yaltan was confronted by a real Truthsayer of Bpfassh.

In 382 BBY, a Truthslayer of Bpfassh confronted Ran Yaltan, who posed as the last member of the Truthsayers of Bpfassh on Jedha. In the heat of the moment a fight between the Truthsayer of Bpfassh, a follower of the Black Eye and the Jedi Knight Vildar Mac broke out.
A member of the Lacertilo species served as a bailiff to an Imperial judge at a courthouse on the Outer Rim Territories world of Niamos.
Windi was a curly-haired human woman who spent time with Cassian Andor, a man she knew as "Keef Girgo," in a hotel suite on the world Niamos in 5 BBY.
A Ximpi served as a proxy to an envoy of the Yacombe. When the Yacombe applied for membership on the Convocation of the Force on the moon Jedha in 382 BBY, the Ximpi spoke on their behalf.
A human served as an Imperial judge in the Courthouse on Niamos around 5 BBY. They sentenced Cassian Andor—under the alias of Keef Girgo—to six years of detention.
Felzonis was a human attendant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau (ISB). He worked within the ISB's Investigations department at their central office on the planet Coruscant.

In 18 BBY, an individual served as a crew lead under Kolvin. The individual lived on the moon Raada during the first year of the Galactic Empire. She was a member of the Raada resistance during the Raada Uprising. She was killed by the Sixth Brother.

Adrine was the sister of Marsa and Tay Kolma, a Chandrilan human associated with the Bank Of Kolma. The sisters at one point met Chandrilan senator Mon Mothma's daughter, Leida Mothma, on her homeworld, Chandrila.

A female was the grandmother of Miramir, a human female from the Outer Rim world of Hyperkarn. Miramir had a close relationship with her grandmother, whom she missed after leaving her homeworld with her husband Dathan and their daughter Rey.

Marsa was the sister of Adrine and the Chandrilan human Tay Kolma, a member of the Bank Of Kolma. They at one point made the acquaintance of Leida Mothma, the daughter of Chandrilan senator Mon Mothma, on the Mothmas' homeworld, Chandrila.

In 5 BBY, a coastal defender stormtrooper served as part of the Galactic Empire's occupation force on the world Niamos. That year, he noticed the incognito thief Cassian Andor as the latter was heading to the Arkie's shop.

A male individual was the father of the mechanic Bix Caleen. At some point by 5 BBY, he caught Cassian Andor climbing over the wall of the Caleen Salyard on Ferrix. Bix's father eventually died and she began to run the salvage yard.
Flob was a human male who worked in bureaucratic record keeping at the Imperial Bureau of Standards office on the planet Coruscant.
A Tauntaun youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.
Vaclav was a Hassarian prisoner of Jabba the Hutt during the Imperial Era who was a self-proclaimed storyteller.

Kazameer was a Hassarian male Separatist general during the Clone Wars according to a story told by Vaclav during the Imperial Era. He fought against Republic forces including Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Depa Billaba on Malenko.
A human served as an Imperial prosecutor in the Courthouse on Niamos around 5 BBY. In conjunction with a judge, they sentenced Cassian Andor—under the alias of Keef Girgo—to six years of detention.
A human worked as a newscaster during the Imperial Era. In 5 BBY, this individual reported on the events of the Aldhani heist.

Rala De, also known under the false identity of "Yodel Proof," was a Kaminoan researcher assisting in the creation of clones for the Galactic Republic. He once posed as the Quermian Jedi Master Yarael Poof after escaping to the planet Coruscant from the planet Kamino.
An Ewok was present at a party celebrating the smuggler Han Solo's upcoming wedding with Princess Leia Organa that was held in the Bright Tree Village on the moon Endor in 4 ABY.

Arkik Von was a male Force-sensitive Geonosian who lived during the High Republic Era. He was formerly a member of the Sorcerers of Tund. Decades before in 382 BBY, Von was conned out of the planet Takodana by the pirate queen Maz Kanata and sought revenge.

A human male Imperial officer served on the planet Ferrix around 18 BBY. As an officer, he commanded a regiment of clone troopers, and called for them to a halt when protesters pelted rocks at the Imperial forces as they marched through a town on Ferrix.

Halorum was a member of a species. She was a proprietor of the salvage store, Lost and Found on the planet Banas. She kept a strict no refund policy and was skeptical of individual stealing from her store.

A Wookiee was a guest of Bail Prestor Organa at a state dinner. During the dinner the Wookiee made an impression that Organa's daughter, Princess Leia Organa, who would later remember and recount the story to Luke Skywalker.

Moular was an individual of a species and a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. He was also cousins to Halorum who sent him to assist Commander Luke Skywalker and Princess Leia Organa escape the planet Banas, during the Galactic Civil War.

Arkie was an individual who ran a beachfront store near several resorts on the planet Niamos. In 5 BBY, Windi, a human who was staying in a nearby hotel with fellow human Cassian Andor, asked Andor to visit Arkie's when he went out for a walk.

Jobo was an individual who worked as a server at Hot Chili Restaurant on Mustafar. A menu for the restaurant, which listed Jobo as a server, was collected in Yoda's Guide to the Galaxy, a book written by the Jedi Master Yoda during his exile on Dagobah.
Max was a human male who joined the Imperial Army before the destruction of Alderaan. He was the childhood best friend of Rel who later joined the Rebel Alliance.
A male member of the warlike Grysk species was the commander of the Grysk StoneCrusher-class WarMaster Armageddon, which was part of the Grysk operative "Jixtus"'s fleet.
This Neimoidian individual served as the Trade Monarch, the ruler of the planet Neimoidia and its purse worlds, Cato, Koru and Deko Neimoidia.
Dagonet was a human male who served as a senator in the Galactic Republic.

A human male smuggler was present on the space station Five Points during the reign of the Galactic Empire. At some point, the man was chased by Crawfin, but eventually lost his pursuer when he took his ship into the Smuggler's Run.

Katri was a Mirialan Jedi Master and member of the Jedi Order's Jedi High Council. Between 50 BBY and 48 BBY, she was killed by a group of security guards on Raxus Secundus, and her death was investigated by Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Dooku.
Kino Loy was a human male incarcerated in Narkina 5 during 5 BBY. He oversaw the labors of his fellow prisoners working the day shift in Unit Five-Two-D as their floor manager.
A Scofti male became the Prefect and Head of State of the Unknown Regions Scoftic government, after the previous one was assassinated, around 36 BBY.
A Scofti male served as the Prefect and Head of State of the Unknown Regions Scoftic government. Around 36 BBY, the Prefect was assassinated, and was subsequently replaced by a new Prefect.

Veemoss was a human who was imprisoned by the Galactic Empire on the moon Narkina 5. In the prison, his unit of prisoners constructed complex Imperial machinery by day and at night slept in cells surrounded by electrified flooring.

Larik was a human male senator who represented the planet Raxus Secundus in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic. Due to his corrupt nature, he was caught in a coup by his own guards, who wished to use him for Raxus' benefit.

Semage was a human guard who served under Senator Larik of the Galactic Republic. Semage, along with Hanel, wanted to force the corrupt Larik to Raxus Secundus, but were both stopped by Jedi Masters Dooku and Mace Windu, after Jedi Master Katri was murdered on the planet.
Hanel was a human male guard who served under Senator Larik. Hanel, along with Semage, tried to use Larik to help the planet Raxus Secundus, but were stopped by Jedi Masters Dooku and Mace Windu.
Nak-il Tano was a Togruta male who was the partner of Pav-ti Tano and the father of Ahsoka Tano.
Gorst was a human male doctor who served as an interrogator for the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau (ISB) in its Interrogation branch.
A human female individual worked as a farmer in a village during the Imperial Era, alongside her brother.

A human old man lived in a farm village during the Imperial Era. He held a supervisory role for the farmers there, doling out water for anyone who needed it and announcing when breaks and mealtimes occurred.
A female individual lived in the galaxy. They were the mother of the human Maarva Carassi Andor—who was born around 82 BBY. Maarva also had a sister.
Uriel Dagonet was a human male and the son of Galactic Republic Senator Dagonet and lived on the planet Wayyl.

Xaul was a human male prisoner of the Galactic Empire that served time on Narkina 5. He worked in Unit Five-Two-D, at Table Five. In 5 BBY, he perished during an uprising of the Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex's prisoners.
Taga was a human male prisoner of the Galactic Empire that served time on Narkina 5. He worked in Unit Five-Two-D, at Table Five.
Ulaf, known affectionately as Uli, was a human male prisoner of the Galactic Empire that served time on Narkina 5. He worked in Unit Five-Two-D, at Table Five.

Ham was a human male prisoner of the Galactic Empire that was sentenced to eight Standard years in an Imperial Prison Complex on the moon Narkina 5 for "self defence." He worked in Unit Five-Two-D as one of the seven men on Table Five, assembling complex EP-N5 fasteners for th…

Jemboc, also known as Jem, was a human male prisoner of the Galactic Empire that served time on Narkina 5. He worked in Unit Five-Two-D, at Table Five. Jemboc was the swing, operating the console that fed new components onto the table to be worked on.
An individual served as an intake warden in an Imperial factory facility part of the Galactic Empire's Prison Complex on Narkina 5.
A Ortolan youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.
Several porg younglings were stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.

Vivyn was a human senator in the Imperial Senate of the Galactic Empire. Shortly after Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine introduced the Public Order Resentencing Directive in response to a rebel heist on the planet Aldhani in 5 BBY, Vivyn attended a party held at the Chandrilan…
An human individual served as an Imperial officer aboard the Interdictor-class heavy cruiser Spectral, serving under Admiral Ektol Traz.

Teenar was a human senator in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Senate. In 5 BBY, a rebel heist on the planet Aldhani prompted Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine to introduce the Public Order Resentencing Directive.
Zinska was a human male prisoner who served as the floor manager for Level 5, Room 2's night shift unit at the Imperial facility on the moon Narkina 5.

Slorda was a human who attended a party at the Chandrilan Embassy on the planet Coruscant in 5 BBY. At the party he spoke with Senators Mon Mothma, Dhow, Teenar, and Vivyn about the Galactic Empire's new Public Order Resentencing Directive, but he was unconcerned with the incr…
Anto Kreegyr was a human male who served the Separatist Alliance during the Clone Wars before going on to be a leading member of the Neo-Separatist Coalition during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
Maya Pei was the leader of the Maya Pei Brigade during the time of the Galactic Empire. The collective had connections with the anti-Imperial network coordinated by the rebel agent Luthen Rael.

A human female ingenue attended a party held by Imperial Senator Mon Mothma at the Chandrilan Embassy on Coruscant in 5 BBY. She was in a conversation with an older senator and Mothma's husband Perrin Fertha.
Birnok was a human male prisoner in the Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex. He perished after he was shot for attempting to climb onto the Unit Five-Two-D walkway during the prison uprising.

Tuck Hybecks was a human from the planet Galdi. In 5 BBY, they were charged in court by the Galactic Empire on the planet Niamos. Afterwards, the individual joined a queue of convicts being led to Imperial transports, which would take them to penal facilities.
A Kilji vassal served aboard the Kilji Illumine war cruiser Whetstone as its comm operator under the command of Generalirius Nakirre, the Illumine's ruler, around 18 BBY.
A human male individual worked as a farmer in a village during the Imperial Era, alongside his sister.

A Chiss male was the son of the Chiss Ascendancy nation's Mitth family Patriarch Mitth'omo'rossodo "Thomoro". Some centuries after 5019 BBY, an enemy beared down on the Ascendancy capital planet of Csilla.
