Anyel was a marine biologist who worked at the underwater fishing base on Madurs. She conducted a tour of the base for a group of tourists who were on Madurs as part of a cruise on the Halcyon.
Beolars Bribbs was the Chief Executive Officer of SoroSuub Corporation and represented the planet Sullust as a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic.

Dass Leffbruk was a human male who lived during the High Republic Era and was the son of hyperspace prospector Spence Leffbruk. Dass accompanied his father on his travels, and was an eager participant in their adventures.
Kam was a male Rutian Twi'lek communications engineer who worked as a Republic Pathfinder during the High Republic Era.
Amos Tillian was a male Theelin communications engineer who worked for the Galactic Republic during the High Republic Era.

Mittik was a female Katikoot. The daughter of Kittik, the minister of works of the species' Grand Council, and the cousin of Rillik, Mittik teamed up with Jedi Master Silandra Sho's Pathfinder team to investigate the disappearance of another Republic Pathfinder expedition on G…

Rillik was a male Katikoot. The nephew of minister of works Kittik and the cousin of Kittik's daughter Mittik, Rillik once worked as a miner in the mines on Gloam, the twin planet of Aubadas, the home of the Katikoot species.
Volan Das was an individual who piloted a Droid tri-fighter that was specially modified for a pilot.

The mother of the Nautolan Ksana was a female individual who lived on the Outer Rim planet Batuu and shared an apartment with their daughter as well as both Ksana's father and grandmother, Mother Katlock.
Maliq was a male Jedi Padawan apprenticed to Jedi Master Rok Buran during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Maliq was part of Outer Rim Expedition Two-Five-Two, Buran's Republic Pathfinder team.
Spence Leffbruk was a human male hyperspace prospector who lived during the High Republic Era. After the death of his wife, Spence raised their son, Dass, on his starship, the Silverstreak.
Rok Buran was a human male Jedi Master active during the High Republic Era.
A Loth-Cat youngling was stationed on the Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts' Youngling Care Space Station.

The mother of Dass Leffbruk and wife of Spence Leffbruk was a female individual. She was killed in a shuttle accident when her son was a baby, during which Spence also received an injury which crippled his right arm.

Peleth was a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order who trained under Jedi Master Silandra Sho and died on a dangerous mission. Around 389 BBY, sometime after Peleth's passing, Sho took on another Padawan, Rooper Nitani.
A Quarren patron visited the Outer Rim planet Batuu by the time of the war between the First Order and the Resistance.

While examining Ulaf, Rhasiv spoke with the Unit Five-Two-D manager, Kino Loy, and the prisoner Cassian Andor. He informed the pair that Ulaf had suffered a massive stroke, meaning nothing could be done for him.

Skormarra was an alien member of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, Skormarra took control of the Unbroken Clan Palace on the Core Worlds planet Corellia, declaring themself the syndicate's All-Leader in an attempt to hold leadership un…

Dietrix Jago was a female pilot who served as a Republic Pathfinder during the High Republic Era. A member of the Pathfinder team led by Jedi Master Silandra Sho, Jago flew the team's starship, Umberfall.
This individual was a bartender for a brothel in the Leisure Zone on the planet Morlana One.

Dro-Nal-Pru was a female Cerean marshal of an encampment on Salstan during the High Republic Era. At one point, she led a mercenary army that included the saber-for-hire Ty Yorrick and the Mythrol Gren.

Davo Sculdun was a human male oligarch, financier, and banker from the planet Chandrila. Rising to power and wealth through non-conventional means, the corrupt Sculdun developed a bad reputation as a shady thug.

A Troig individual served as the auctioneer of an auction on the planet Spira during the Galactic Civil War. During the auction, a Nihil strikeship was put up for sale by the auctioneer, beginning with a twenty-five thousand credits bid from the curator of the Imperial Museum.
Droid Snoke was a humanoid male clone of Snoke who was created by the Sith Eternal cult on Exegol. His cloning process was unsuccessful which left him believing that he was a droid.
Intellectual Snoke was a humanoid male clone of Snoke who was created by the Sith Eternal cult on Exegol. His cloning process was unsuccessful which left him with genius intelligence.

Backwards Snoke was a humanoid male clone of Snoke who was created by the Sith Eternal cult on the planet Exegol. His cloning process was unsuccessful which left him with a reversed head and backwards speech.
An human individual served as an Imperial officer aboard the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Tarkin's Will during the Galactic Civil War.
An Urchiv-ki male served as a traffic controller of Urch Planetary and Space Control, which controlled space traffic around the Unknown Regions planet Urch, the capital of the Tower Dimension nation.
Obik Dennisol was a Mirialan male medic who served on the team of Republic Pathfinders led by Jedi Master Silandra Sho during the High Republic Era.
Ares Nune was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi Master within the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Fluffy was a female Gobbler from the planet Lenahra who was adopted by Amyt.

Ampher was a Mikkian from Lenahra, who had two children, Audj Seedol and Casul Seedol, with Chemi. When most of the Lenahrans left the planet, Ampher was one of thirty-eight who stayed behind but died by 41 BBY due to the accelerated aging caused by use of the Power.
A Geonosian spy was a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.

Mullmoy was a human male doctor that worked on the planet Ferrix during the Imperial Era. In 5 BBY, as Maarva Carassi Andor's health began to decline, Mullmoy approached the Andor household to check on Maarva.

Jaydyn was a Quermian female who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult in 382 BBY. During that time, Jaydyn was present at a almshouse dedicated to the Path on the moon Jedha and preached the teachings of the Mother to citizens of the Holy City.
Stekan Sculdun was a human male who was the son of Davo Sculdun. In 5 BBY, Sculdun wished for his son to meet Leida Mothma as she would soon be of age to be married under Chandrilan customs.

A female individual was the daughter of ISB Supervisor Lonni Jung. Following her birth at some point between 6 and 5 BBY, her father wished to resign from his position in the ISB, where he was secretly a spy for the curator Luthen Rael's undercover rebel network.

A human male prison commander was an Imperial officer in the Imperial Prison Complex on Narkina 5. He controlled numerous aspects of a Imperial factory facility in the prison complex including the PA system and the hydroelectric power plants, and was also in command of two tec…
A human male box guard was an Imperial officer in a an Imperial factory facility part of an Imperial Prison Complex on Narkina 5. This box guard was tasked with delivering the prisoners to Kino Loy.

A human console guard served in an Imperial factory facility part of the Imperial Prison Complex on Narkina 5. During the Narkina 5 prison escape, the console guard requested for backup after the prisoners on Level 5 started to rebel, but was shot dead by Cassian Andor.
An Evereni male lived during the High Republic Era. Around 402 BBY, they and an Evereni female sired an Evereni daughter named Yana Ro.
A rebel pilot served as part of Anto Kreegyr's group. In 5 BBY, the pilot was killed by the Galactic Empire and staged to look like an accident.

Corran Horn was a rebel pilot who piloted an T-65B X-wing starfighter. Horn served as Rogue Nine of Rogue Squadron. At one point, Horn and two other T-65Bs flew in formation through the cloudy skies of an ecumenepolis world.

An Evereni female who lived during the High Republic Era was the mother of the Evereni girl Marda Ro. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, they lived with their daughter and Marda's sire on the Expansion Region planet Genetia along with Marda's cousin Yana Ro, her mother and si…

An Evereni female active in the High Republic Era was the mother of the Evereni girl Yana Ro. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, they resided on the Expansion Region planet Genetia with their daughter and Yana's sire, along with Yana's cousin Marda Ro, her mother and sire, an…

An Evereni male was the sire of the Evereni girl Marda Ro. Between around 397 BBY and 387 BBY, the sire, Marda, and her mother lived on the Expansion Region planet Genetia along with Marda's cousin Yana Ro, her mother and sire, and the cousin's grandparents.
Briff was a Condluran smuggler on Jedha during the High Republic Era. Tey Sirrek approached Briff in an attempt to garner information about individuals interested in stolen artifacts.

Vitsun Weiss was a human male who served in the Galactic Empire with the military rank of general. Weiss commanded a customized All Terrain Scout Transport during the Imperial Era. Weiss had light skin, and sported a jumpsuit and helmet used by AT-ST drivers.
Hallisara was a Rodian who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Hallisara was a child and lived with the Path of the Open Hand on the planet Dalna.

Jukkyuk was a Wookiee who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult in 382 BBY. He was retainer and guard of the The Herald, one of the Path's leaders, adept for the job due to the physical advantages of his Wookiee biology.
Jinx Pickwick was a human female who was the sheriff of the basin on the planet Dalna that contained the City Ferdan.
A female was a Taymar and the grandmother of Svi'no Atchapat who lived on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era. She taught songs to her granddaughter.
An individual was a male Taymar musician and the father of Svi'no Atchapat who lived on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era.
An indiviual was a female Taymar musician and the mother of Svi'no Atchapat who lived on the planet Corellia during the High Republic Era.

Mykge was a member of the Path of the Open Hand on Dalna in 382 BBY. When the others discussed inviting refugees to join the Path, he declared that they were needed after the previous winter, which had been very hard.

Old Waiden was a human who was an Elder of the cult called the Path of the Open Hand. He lived on the planet Dalna at the Path's compound on the planet. He often helped look after the cult's littles when Path member Marda Ro could not.
A human male was a guard who worked at the Santhe Shipyards on Corellia. He was hit unconscious by his partner Borgar.

Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, during her attempts to destroy the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Vader, Crimson Dawn leader Lady Qi'ra created a rumor about the existence of a Sith Lord that had lived long before the Imperial Era and had been sealed away by the Fermata Cage, a w…

Dewi Pamular was a Keredian male fisher who worked on the moon Narkina 5 with his brother, Freedi Pamular. While fishing at a quarry lake on the moon in around 5 BBY, the pair captured Cassian Andor and Ruescott Melshi, fugitives who had escaped from a nearby Imperial prison.

Elk was a human captain in the Imperial Navy who commanded a Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser as part of the Segra-Milo Imperial patrol. In 5 BBY, his cruiser encountered the Fondor Haulcraft of the rebel Luthen Rael above the planet Segra Milo.

Dijuka was a Dybrinthe Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, Dijuka served on the Jedi High Council. Sometime later, after the Council received a message of help from the Scalvi, Dijuka discussed the matter with the other Masters.

Ela Sutan was a Caamasi female Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. By 382 BBY, she served on the Jedi High Council. Sometime later, Sutan was present in the Jedi Council Chamber when the Council received a message of help from the Scalvi.
Freedi Pamular was a male alien from the moon Narkina 5 who worked as a fisher with his brother Dewi Pamular.
Qwerb was a human who was a retainer for Werth Plouth, the Herald of the Path of the Open Hand.
Borgo Val was an individual who was a member of Dizcaro's bodyguard agency. They were impersonated by Jedi padawan Reath Silas.
A human prisoner of the Galactic Empire served time at the prison facility on Narkina 5, working the night shift at Level 5, Room 2 at table 2.
A human prisoner of the Galactic Empire served time at the prison facility on Narkina 5, working the night shift at Level 5, Room 2 at table 2.

A human senator attended a party hosted by their fellow senator Mon Mothma at the latter's apartment. They were in a conversation with Mothma's husband Perrin Fertha and another guest, when Mothma joined them in their conversation.
Enya Keen was a human female Jedi who was the Padawan of Jedi Master Char-Ryl-Roy during the High Republic Era.
Tox was a young boy during the High Republic Era. During that era, Tox, his sister, his mother and his father were looking for a better life on the Galactic Frontier.
Tala was a young girl during the High Republic Era. During that time, she, her brother Tox, her mother and her father were looking for a better life on the Galactic Frontier.
Tox's mother lived during the High Republic Era. During that time, she, her husband, daughter, and Tox were looking for a better life on the Galactic Frontier.
Tox's father lived during the High Republic Era. During that time, he, his wife, his daughter and Tox were looking for a better life on the Galactic Frontier.

Brannix Tzg'ada was a male Arcona who lived on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War. Sometimes after the Battle of Yavin, he tasked a spacer with eliminating the Krayt cultists living in a cave near his home.
Leana Kilnar was a female Human member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who lived on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Snilas Thripp was a female Human member of the Royal Naboo Security Forces who lived on Naboo during the time of the Galactic Civil War.
Sanke Paro was a human male police officer who served in Coronet City during the High Republic Era. He was one of the survivors after the Nihil attacked the station in 230 BBY.
Orban was a male police captain who served in Coronet City during the High Republic Era. He was killed when the Nihil attacked the station in 230 BBY.

Meli Day was a Zeltron female Jedi who lived during the High Republic Era and made friends with fellow youngling Gella Nattai. Eventually, the Zeltron chose to become a Jedi Wayseeker, confident she wanted to seek the Force in her own way.
A boy lived in an orphanage on Naboo during the High Republic Era. A kolvor snatched the boy and Lula Talisola and tried to kill them but Kantam Sy saved them.
Ten-four Pee-Onepee was a codename of a bodyguard who served in Dizcaro's bodyguard company during the High Republic Era.

Runai Sculdun was a human female who was married to Davo Sculdun. In 5 BBY she visited Senator Mon Mothma's residence on Coruscant alongside Davo and his son Stekan Sculdun, as Davo wished for Stekan to be introduced to Leida Mothma.

A human served to the Galactic Empire as an executive officer with the military rank of commander alongside Captain Elk on a Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser. In 5 BBY, the ship encountered the V-21.1 Chevlex of the rebel Luthen Rael and caught it in a tractor beam.

A female individual was the sister of the human female Maarva Carassi Andor. Around 76 BBY, she walked with her sister down Rix Road from Fountain Square, where Maarva first encountered the Ferrixian tradition of a funerary stone.

Tenek was a human cook who worked at Hotel Rix on the planet Ferrix while the building was used as a base of operation by the Galactic Empire. In 5 BBY, Tenek entered the kitchen with a tray while a funeral procession was taking place outside for the local woman Maarva Andor.

Bly Tevin, nicknamed "Blitz," was a male E'roni pilot who flew for Thylefire Squadron under the callsign Thylefire Nine during the Eiram and E'ronoh War. A recent recruit to E'ronoh's fleet, he gained his nickname after crashing several times during training.
In 5 BBY, a coastal defender stormtrooper processed convicts that were being transported off of the planet Niamos.

A Royal Guard was assigned to guard Emperor Palpatine between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. Like their nine other cohorts, they where poisoned by Ochi of Bestoon, and died while standing at attention to Palpatine.

A Royal Guard was assigned to guard Emperor Palpatine between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. Like their nine other cohorts, they where poisoned by Ochi of Bestoon, and died while standing at attention to Palpatine.

Aida Forte was a Kadas'sa'Nikto female who served as a Jedi Knight during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, Forte attended the Wedding of Phan-tu Zenn and Xiri A'lbaran on Eiram and helped with the search for fugitive and saboteur Axel Greylark as well as fighting bounty hunt…
Kittik was an elderly Katikoot male who was Minister of works of the Grand Council of the Katikoot city Diurna on the planet Aubadas. He was the father of Mittik and the uncle of Rillik.

A male unidentified Muun was a member of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Muunilinst, this Muun oversaw the Separatist forces on the ground via hologram alongside several other Muuns and a Neimoidian.

A male unidentified Muun was a member of the InterGalactic Banking Clan during the Clone Wars. During the Battle of Muunilinst, this Muun was among the Banking Clan leaders that oversaw the battle via hologram.
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana's Pre-Mor Security Inspection team in 5 BBY.
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana's Pre-Mor Security Inspection team in 5 BBY.
Lexxir Greylark was a male senator of the Galactic Republic and the husband of Kyong Greylark. The two were parents of Axel Greylark.

A human male bartender worked at the Outer Rim planet Akiva's the Alcazar cantina during the Imperial Era. In 4 ABY, the bartender took drink orders from the former Imperial loyalty officer Sinjir Rath Velus and his Twi'lek companion Orgadomo Dokura.

Xarok was a human male Imperial officer of the Galactic Empire that held the military rank of colonel. During the Imperial Era, Colonel Xarok was stationed on Lothal and became infamous for his brutal practices.

Wat Tambor II was a Skakoan male who was the son of Techno Union foreman Wat Tambor. At some point, they had a son of their own named Jul Tambor. After the Galactic Empire took over the planet Skako Minor Tambor was killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader.
Raf Thatchburn was a human male inspector of Galactic Antipiracy Command who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was the most notorious Pirate hunter in the galaxy.
Alak was a human male pirate who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was wanted in about twenty systems.

Quiet Shan was a human female pirate who lived during the High Republic Era. Quiet Shan alongside her teacher Alak escaped from the Scarlet Skull Cult as children, but not before they had taken her tongue.

KA-336 was a human individual who served as a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, KA-336 was assigned as a personal guard of Lieutenant Commander Sabé along with KV-222.
KV-222 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire who, along with KA-336, served as a personal guard of Lieutenant Commander Sabé between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.

Jerid was a human male member of the Path of the Open Hand cult who lived at their compound on the planet Dalna. He had a little sister named Vemian and in 382 BBY was the oldest of the Path's Littles who were looked after by Path member Marda Ro.

TK-7780 was a male Imperial stormtrooper who served aboard the battle station known as the Death Star. In 1 BBY, TK-7780 was ordered to report to a control room on the Death Star, but was impeded by a malfunctioning door.

Vemian was a human female member of the Path of the Open Hand religion and the younger sister of fellow path member Jerid. She lived in the Path compound on the planet Dalna and was looked after by Marda Ro along with the rest of the Path's Littles.

Utalir was a Force-sensitive Mikkian female member of the Path of the Open Hand cult who lived at their compound on the planet Dalna. In 382 BBY, she was nine years old and one of the Path's Littles who were looked after by Path member Marda Ro.
Chellwinark Frethylrin, also known as Chell and Fret, was a female Keshiri who served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era as an analyst.
A Kaminoan male going by the alias of "Starson Wonderpower" resided on the planet Kamino. They had white skin as well as black eyes with white irises, and they wore a blue and white outfit.

Sarevelin was an individual who was an Elder in the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, they were present in the aftermath of Path leader "The Mother" unleashing the living weapon called the Leveler against Jedi Master Zallah Macri and Jedi Padawan Kevmo Zink.

Simi was a human male who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Simi was a child and lived with the Path of the Open Hand on the planet Dalna where he and the rest of the Path's Littles were looked after by Path member Marda Ro.

Ferali was a Klatooinian who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Ferali was a child and lived with the Path of the Open Hand on the planet Dalna where he and the rest of the Path's Littles, including his younger sibling Eff, were looked after by Path me…

t: Unidentified First Order stormtrooper (Station Theta Black)
x: A human stormtrooper served the First Order military junta and its military. In 34 ABY, the stormtrooper accompanied First Order Captain Phasma's demolition squad to the Unknown Regions' Station Theta Black, where the military junta mined dedlanite, a metal used for blaster co…
During the High Republic Era, a Tholothian Jedi Wayseeker became a minor singing sensation on Alderaan. In 232 BBY, this was considered a memorable case.

An unnamed Patrolian was present in the Moshi Bar when Ahsoka Tano and Plo Koon entered, seeking information on Aurra Sing. The Patrolian was seen talking to an Ithorian about something they saw on a video screen the previous night.

An unnamed Ithorian was seen in Moshi Bar, a cantina on in the Coruscant underworld. They were talking to a Patrolian about what the latter saw on a video screen the previous night when Jedi Master Plo Koon entered the cantina with Padawan Ahsoka Tano.

An Quarren was present in Moshi Bar on the planet Coruscant at the time of the Clone Wars. When Jedi Master Plo Koon and Padawan Ahsoka Tano visited the cantina in search of information on Aurra Sing, they were arguing with a Rodian about a Twi'lek dancer.
An Twi'lek worked as an exotic dancer during the Clone Wars at Moshi Bar, a seedy cantina in the Coruscant Underworld.
An unnamed Rodian was a patron of Moshi Bar, a seedy cantina in the Coruscant Underworld, when Jedi Master Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano entered the tavern in search of information on Aurra Sing.

Maeve Cuilinn was a human female Jedi during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, she used the Force to save a group of members of the Path of the Open Hand cult from an out-of-control speeder in the Holy City on the moon Jedha.

Whool was an Abednedo male Path of the Open Hand who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. Once a miner on his home planet, he eventually joined the Path and in 382 BBY, was present in the Holy City on Jedha.
Piralli was a Sullustan male dock worker on Jedha. He was often seen in the tapbar Enlightenment in the Holy City of Jedha.
Tawni Ames was a female human who served as the governor of Desix during the Imperial Era.

Phee Genoa was a female human pirate, treasure hunter, explorer, and associate of the Mantellian information broker Ciddarin Scaleback during the early Imperial Era. Scaleback considered Genoa to be the most trustworthy pirate she knew.
Bode Akuna was a Force-sensitive human male who once served as a Jedi Knight and was assigned to Republic Intelligence by the Jedi High Council under the command of Lank Denvik during the Clone Wars.
Balada was a female Hutt who sponsored and ran the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition on the Outer Rim planet Vespaara, alongside Daq Dragus.

S. Claus was a humanoid who was the son of Santa Claus, an individual who traveled around the galaxy on Christmas each year to deliver toys to children who he deemed as "good." When Santa eventually became unable to deliver all the gifts by himself, he enlisted the help of S.
Sianna Sekko was a dark side Force witch and noble of Empress Teta who was active during the Imperial Era.

Aber was a doctor who was a member of a species on the planet Escalan. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the smuggler Han Solo was dumped on Escalan after he was shot by the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo, two younger members of Aber's species brought Solo to Aber.
Aragu Kato was a Chagrian criminal who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, Kato was imprisoned at a prison on the prison planet Gulhadar.
Phaedra was a Quaraxian criminal who was imprisoned on the planet Gulhadar.

A human was a member of the Benelex Marshal Service's Tribunal at a prison on the planet Gulhadar. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, after the Wookiee Chewbacca, who was imprisoned at the prison, got into a fight with other prisoners, he was brought before the Tribunal for sente…

A Rodian was a member of the Benelex Marshal Service's Tribunal at a prison on the planet Gulhadar. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the Rodian was present for the sentencing of the Wookiee Chewbacca after he had been brought before the Tribunal.

A Togruta was a member of the Benelex Marshal Service's Tribunal at a prison on the planet Gulhadar. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the Togruta opened proceedings for the sentencing of the Wookiee Chewbacca after he had been brought before the Tribunal by stating that the Woo…
Drya Thornne was a humanoid lieutenant of the Bedlam Raiders who was skilled enough to be gifted an orange-bladed lightsaber with retractable crossguards by the Raiders' leader, Rayvis.
Rayvis was a male Gen'Dai warrior who served as the leader of the Bedlam Raiders, a marauder group based on Koboh.
Phan-tu Zenn was a human male heir to the Eiram royal family during the High Republic Era. His mother was the ruling queen of the planet Eiram in 382 BBY.

Morton San Tekka was a human male who was a member of the San Tekka clan during the High Republic Era. He was appointed by Galactic Republic Chancellor Mollo to serve as a mediator at a summit on Jedha around 382 BBY.
Meldan was a Pantoran chairperson during the High Republic Era. She was the head of the committee that oversaw Galactic Republic affairs on Jedha.
Adrialla was the queen of Eiram in 382 BBY during the High Republic Era. She was the adoptive mother of Phan-tu Zenn and the wife of Odelia.

A human individual served as an Imperial officer during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the officer was present at the Imperial Impound Facility on the planet Iakar at the time the criminal Corbus Tyra, the bounty hunter Greedo, and the crew o…
8123 was an humanoid individual who served as a guard of the Benelex Marshal Service at a prison on the planet Gulhadar.
A male merchant was a member of a species from the planet Escalan. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, the merchant offered to help the smuggler Han Solo leave Escalan aboard his ship.

Laan was a Falleen male Jedi Knight who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, they and dozens of other Jedi attended the wedding of Prince Phan-tu Zenn and Princess Xiri A'lbaran on the Outer Rim planet Eiram to serve as the event's security.
Abda was a female Kage Path of the Open Hand member during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, she became one of the Mother's Children.

A'lbaran was a human male Monarch of the planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. He was the father of Niko and Xiri A'lbaran. After Niko died on a diplomatic mission to Eiram he doubled down on the war between the two planets again.
Niko A'lbaran was the son of Monarch A'lbaran and heir to the E'ronoh royal family. He died on Eiram during a diplomatic mission, which restarted the Eiram and E'ronoh War.
Braxen was an E'roni soldier from the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh who served in his homeworld's military for several years until resigning to labor as a quarry miner when the world was at peace.
Binnot Ullo was a Force-sensitive Mirialan male, who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. Ullo hated his own Force-sensitivity and denied it, as per his beliefs as a member of the Path.
Odelia was the queen consort of Eiram during the High Republic Era, and was married to Queen Adrialla, the reigning regent.

Fila was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. During or after 1 BBY, she worked as a scout for the Rebel Alliance during a battle on the Outer Rim moon Shard.

A light-skinned human with brown hair served as a member of the pit crew on the bridge of a Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser commanded by Captain Elk as part of the Galactic Empire's Segra-Milo Imperial patrol.
A human male served as a pit crew member on board an Imperial Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser commanded by Captain Elk as part of the Segra-Milo Imperial patrol.
During the High Republic Era, the queen of Eiram planned to marry her daughter Adrialla to a male Baron of Pantora, but Adrialla chose to marry the woman Odelia instead.

A female individual was the mother of Adrialla. She served as queen of the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. They planned to marry thier daughter to a male Pantoran baron, but Adrialla chose to marry Odelia instead.

Grael was a Force-sensitive Abednedo male during the High Republic Era. His family was fearful of his abilities and made him surpress them. One day, he and his brother Whool were mining Adelyne crystals when the mine collapsed.

A female individual was the mother of the Abednedo Path of the Open Hand member Whool and his brother, Grael. She came from a family of miners. She, her father, and her sons were all miners who sought adelyne crystals buried deep within their planet's crust.
Galdros was a Force-sensitive human who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
A green-skinned individual was a member of the Nihil and a chosen one who helped Marchion Ro catch Nameless on a planet.

A human was the captain of the flagship of the Republic Defense Coalition Outreach Fleet. The fleet was traveling to the Outer Rim Territories and when a lieutenant informed the bearded human that duty assignments had been transmitted to the Outreach Fleet, the captain complim…

A Kajain'sa'Nikto worked as a bartender at The Lucky Whistle. During the First Order-Resistance War, Resistance members, Finn and Poe Dameron visited the planet Kamil to negotiate a deal for livestock that the Resistance needed.

A human male was the lieutenant of the flagship of Republic Defense Coalition. The fleet was traveling to the Outer Rim Territories but was destroyed in hyperspace when it entered the Nihil's occlusion zone by stormseeds.
Barquet was a Dressellian who served as a director in the Galactic Republic. Barquet investigated about the connection of the Nihil and Arathab Fal.
This Anooba was one of several Anoobas at the Citadel prison on Lola Sayu, that were used in case of prison breakouts for tracking down and eliminating fugitives.
Oklane Viss was a Falleen male who served as a captain in the Guardians of the Whills on Jedha during the High Republic Era.

A Pau'an male was an undercover agent of the Galactic Republic. He investigated about the connection of Arathab Fal and the Nihil on the planet Vorzyd V when Nihil marauders attacked him on his hidden place while he tried to make a deal with Arathab and killed him.

Barmbat was a Nihil marauder during the High Republic Era. He and two other Nihil members traveled to the planet Vorzyd V to find and kill Arathab Fal and his partner. They find the hideout and killed the Pau'an, who were an undercover agent of the Republic.

Dags was a Nihil marauder during the High Republic Era. Dags and two other Nihil members traveled to the planet Vorzyd V to find and kill Arathab Fal and his partner. They find the hideout and killed the Pau'an, who were an undercover agent of the Republic.
A Cyclorrian was investigated about a homicide on the planet Vorzyd V during the High Republic Era. The Cyclorrian found a dead Pau'an, who were an undercover agent of the Galactic Republic.

An Abednedo male was a Nihil marauder during the High Republic Era. They were one of the crew mamber of Kisma Uttersond's ship. When Arathab Fal attacked the ship, they and one of their partners tried to save Dr. Uttersond but were killed by the doctor.

A human was a Nihil marauder during the High Republic Era. They were one of the crew mamber of Kisma Uttersond's ship. When Arathab Fal attacked the ship, the human and one of their partners tried to save Dr. Uttersond. The doctor shot them in the back.
A Feeorin was a Nihil marauder during the High Republic Era. They were one of the crew mamber of Kisma Uttersond's ship and was killed when Arathab Fal attacked the ship.

A male individual was the father of Sian Holt during the High Republic Era. Before Sian and her father moved to Undercity, her father used to plant bebatek seeds in soil boxes in a little alley behind their house. He always said: Let the galaxy do it's work.
An individual was part of a group of insurgents backed by the criminal syndicate Crimson Dawn that fought against the Galactic Empire on the Inner Rim planet Bestine IV during the Imperial Era.

A human served as a Stormtrooper Commander in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Stormtrooper Commander was present at an Imperial naval base on the planet Bestine IV at the time a transport, that was carrying munitions to be used against…

An elderly Chiss male individual once interacted with Senior Captain Xodlak'in'daro, core name "Lakinda," when she was a member of her original family on the Chiss Ascendancy terrestrial astronomical object Oyokal.

Ney Madiine was a Theelin female who operated at the fighting establishment the Rusty Rancor on Hesperys Station during the High Republic Era. Her champion in the fight arena was Dario Melek, who procured ninety-nine wins.
Iana Percei was a Mon Calamari female who served as the marshal of the village of U'ronoh on the planet E'ronoh.

Dario Melek was a male champion of Ney Madiine on the Hesperys Station. In 382 BBY, he fought against Jedi Knight Gella Nattai at the Rusty Rancor. He wore green-velvet robes and wielded a green double-bladed lightsaber during fights.
Goldy Bex was a Pa'lowick announcer on Hesperys Station during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY she announced the fight of Gella Nattai and Dario Melek.
Jerrod Segaru was a male military leader of the planet E'ronoh. In 387 BBY, he lost one of his eyes in the first battle of the Eiram and E'ronoh War.
Oshi Karmo was a non-binary Mirialan engineer who served as a tech supervisor on the Republic Supreme Chancellor Orlen Mollo's Alif-class Longbeam Paxion during the High Republic Era.
A Rodian served as a leader in the Son-tuul Pride criminal organization during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
A Rodian was a member of Son-tuul Pride criminal organization during the reign of the Galactic Empire and served under one of its leaders.
Kori Zaran was a human female soldier who served the Alliance to Restore the Republic. In 3 ABY, Zaran became stranded in the galaxy and had to return to Echo Base on Hoth.
An Imperial officer served aboard the Avenger during the Galactic Civil War as the first officer to Captain Lorth Needa.

Serrena was a female Kage who was a member of Path of the Open Hand cult during the High Republic Era. She was also a member of a subgroup within the cult called the Children that served one of the Path's leaders, who they called The Mother.
A human male served as a weapons specialist on the bridge of a Cantwell-class Arrestor Cruiser commanded by captain Elk as part of the Galactic Empire's Segra-Milo Imperial patrol.
Dregg was a Twi'lek male who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he and the Nautolan Ralen argued about who rightly owned a sack full of ambercrysts on Boneworld.
Ralen was a Nautolan male who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he and the Twi'lek Dregg had an argument about who the rightful owner of a sack full of ambercrysts was on Boneworld.
This individual was a Diathim who took up primary residence on Iego after her homeworld Millius Prime was invaded by the Separatist Alliance.

Kinni was a female pilot who was a member of E'ronoh's fleet. She was a retired mechanic before joining Thylefire Squadron, led by Xiri A'lbaran, some years before 382 BBY. She taught A'lbaran and Jerrod Segaru the Kestrel's Dive, which was used by A'lbaran to defeat Rev Ferrol.
A stormtrooper was stationed aboard the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station near Tractor Beam 12 when the Millennium Falcon was captured by the battle station.
Abediah Viess was a Mirialan female who served as the general of a mercenary army.
An Aqualish lived on the remote planet of Abafar during the Clone Wars, in the city of Pons Ora. As D-Squad arrived at the town, the Aqualish spat into a bucket as the squad walked past.

A Neimoidian aide accompanied Senator Lott Dod of the Trade Federation to Toydaria with the hopes of preventing the negotiations between King Katuunko and Senator Bail Prestor Organa and Representative Jar Jar Binks.

A Toydarian minister was present on the Toydarian Ministry Council on Toydaria during the Clone Wars. He was present in the alongside King Katuunko and a few other ministers when Alderaanian Senator Bail Organa and Naboo Representative Jar Jar Binks approached them and asked f…

A female Neimoidian was a historical figure in Neimoidian society. She was significant enough to be granted a portrait that displayed her in regal clothing posed in front of a hanging drapery. The portrait was hung in a gallery in Lott Dod's Palace.
This Neimoidian, historically famous enough to be granted a heroic portrait that was hung up in a gallery in Lott Dod's Palace, was a historic military commander.

A Neimoidian was a famous figure in Neimoidian history. They were historically significant enough that they were granted a portrait that displayed them posed in front of a golden background. The artwork was hung up in a gallery in Lott Dod's Palace on Cato Neimoidia.
A Toydarian royal guard lived on Toydaria during the Clone Wars. The guard encountered Senator Bail Organa of the Galactic Republic, who had arrived on a diplomatic mission to speak with Katuunko.
A Weequay deputy was a member of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. The individual informed Hondo Ohnaka that there was a transmission coming in from Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Mama Gonk was the mother of Gonker, a EG-6 power droid. They had multiple children, but did not have enough money to send all of them to school, so only Gonker was able to attend.
A clone medical officer was stationed aboard a Pelta-class frigate in the Ryndellia system and was killed when the Malevolence destroyed the ship.

Hondo Ohnaka kept a massiff as a pet. It was tended to by one of his gang members. When Ohnaka safely delivered Ahsoka Tano and a group of Jedi Initiates to Obi-Wan Kenobi's Venator-class Star Destroyer aboard Slave I, the mastiff entertained itself by gnawing on the head of a…
A Christophsian senator was one of the senators held hostage by Cad Bane during his raid on the Galactic Senate.

This Twi'lek child and his mother were captured as hostages at a Coruscant train station by Cassilyda Cryar, who was being pursued by Ahsoka Tano and Tera Sinube. The child and his mother were freed when Sinube disarmed Cryar and knocked her unconscious.

This Twi'lek mother and her child were captured as hostages at a Coruscant train station by Cassilyda Cryar, who was being pursued by Ahsoka Tano and Tera Sinube. The mother and her child were freed when Sinube disarmed Cryar and knocked her unconscious.
This Kindalo lived in the Underworld of Aleen during the time of the Clone Wars. He and three others encountered C-3PO and R2-D2 when they fell into the Underworld.
A Kindalo resided in the Underworld on the planet Aleen during the Clone Wars. He encountered R2-D2 and C-3PO when the two droids fell into the Underworld, initially seeing them as intruders.

A Force-sensitive Togruta individual served as a member of the Darkseekers, a group who hunted threats to the Sith. At one point, he led a group of Darkseekers in search of the Chadra-Fan Miril, who led the Ascendant cult.

Fel Ix was a Kessarine male who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. He was one of Ferize's partners along with Er Dal, and in 382 BBY they hatched five children who were then the subject of a Naming ceremony that the Path performed, with one of the leaders of the Path, …

Fe Isle was a Kessarine male who was the child of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When he was born in 382 BBY, he was put through a Naming ceremony that inducted him into the Path of the Open Hand, a cult that his parents were a part of.

Fe Remine was a Kessarine male who was the son of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When he was born in 382 BBY, he was put through a Naming ceremony that inducted him into the Path of the Open Hand, a cult that his parents were members of.

Fe Tale was a Kessarine male who was the child of Ferize, Er Dal, and Fel Ix. When he was born in 382 BBY, a Naming ceremony was held that inducted him into the Path of the Open Hand cult that his parents were a part of.

Bruzo was a Pantoran male who lived at the Barakat Outpost on the planet E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, he challenged Princess Xiri A'lbaran with an archaic E'roni rite, believing that she was not worthy of E'ronoh's throne.
A clone trooper served the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems.
Helion Volte was a Mikkian Jedi Master who was part of Galactic Republic Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven during the High Republic Era.
Benj Marko was a human Jedi Padawan during the High Republic Era who was apprenticed to Jedi Master Helion Volte.
Sallee Ooph was a human who was part of Galactic Republic Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven during the High Republic Era.
Grint Rupar was a Britarro who was the medic of Galactic Republic Outer Rim Exploration Team Outer Rim Expedition Eight-Zero-Seven during the High Republic Era.

An Aqualish female individual served the Nihil. In 230 BBY, she was responsible for guarding the Mon Calamari Ghal Tarpfen, whom the Nihil had kidnapped. Tarpfen was able to overtake the Aqualish, however, and escape.

An individual lived during the Imperial Era and served in the bureaucracy of the Galactic Empire. They were also a friend of the Quaraxian criminal Phaedra. At one point the individual came to owe Phaedra a favor.

Castor was a gardener on the Galactic Republic's Starlight Beacon space station. In 231 BBY, Administrator Velko Jahen of Starlight asked Castor to force the station's gardens to bloom for the visiting Galactic Agricultural Alliance, which she felt was a small ask seeing as th…

An unidentified Muun judge presided over the trial of the Core Five, the leadership of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, in 20 BBY. The Core Five faced trial for embezzling funds intended to help refugees displaced by the Clone Wars.

Rev Ferrol was a human male who was the son of Viceroy Ferrol of the planet E'ronoh. In 382 BBY, after E'roni Princess Xiri A'lbaran brought an end to the Eiram and E'ronoh War by deciding to marry Prince Phan-tu Zenn of Eiram, Rev and his father helped form the terrorist orga…

t: Unidentified Guardians of the Whills representative
x: A member of the Guardians of the Whills religious order represented the Guardians on the Convocation of the Force—a council that promoted understanding between a number of Force groups on the Mid Rim moon Jedha—during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY.
Zumeg was a Talpiddian individual who served as an archivist as part of the Disciples of the Whills at the Temple of the Kyber in the Holy City on the moon Jedha in 382 BBY.

Feric Oranalli was a corrupt Dressellian male who worked at the Temple of the Kyber in the Holy City on the moon Jedha as an archivist and the assistant to archivist Zumeg as members of the Disciples of the Whills.

Forvan was a human male who lived as a member of the Colony of Kezarat in No-Space, where the headquarters of the Nihil, a group of marauders, was once located. Forvan was the son of the Blythe, the captain of the convoy.

Ferrol was a human male who was the Viceroy of the planet E'ronoh and one of Monarch A'lbaran's closest advisors.

Tilson Graf was a human male member of the hyperspace prospecting Graf family during the High Republic Era. After mediator Morton San Tekka died, Tilson offered himself to take Morton's place as mediator.
Mesook was a human Guardian of the Whills and friend of Jedi Silandra Sho during the High Republic Era. Around 382 BBY, Mesook met Sho, who was on Jedha undertaking a pilgrimage.
Selik was an Iridonian Zabrak who served as a Guardian of the Whills, and was a friend of fellow Guardian Mesook during the High Republic Era.
Mylas was a Duros child who was one of the Path of the Open Hand's Littles. In 382 BBY, Milus and other Littles found a new home in the Healing house on Jedha. They were protected by Marda Ro.

Naddie was a human female who was one of the Path of the Open Hand's Littles. In 382 BBY, she gave Jedi Master Silandra Sho a flower in the Holy City of the moon Jedha, but was warned about doing so by Marda Ro—an Evereni who served as the Path's Guide—as the Path believed the…
Pela was a Togruta who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. In 382 BBY, Pela lived at the healing house on Jedha with the other members of the Path.
Phinea was a member of the Path of the Open Hand. In 382 BBY, Phinea lived in the Healing house on Jedha together with Marda Ro and other members of the Path.

Wilco was a clone trooper who served as a stormtrooper and Clone Captain in the army of the Galactic Empire following the end of the Clone Wars between 19 BBY and 18 BBY. He oversaw the transfer of the late Count Dooku's war chest from the count's palace on the planet Serenno.

Romar Adell was a human male from Serenno. Adell was, at one time, affiliated with the Confederacy of Independent Systems but eventually lost faith in Dooku, the Separatist Head of State and reigning Count of Serenno as he plundered his own people during the Clone Wars.
CT-8801 was a clone trooper of the Galactic Republic who fought as part of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

Har'kin was a Gran Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During the Battle of Jedha, Masters Har'kin, Vohlan and Xinith Tarl arrived on Jedha to assist Master Creighton Sun and Jedi Knight Aida Forte end the fight.

Vohlan was a human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. During the Battle of Jedha, Masters Vohlan, Har'kin and Xinith Tarl arrived on Jedha to assist Master Creighton Sun and Jedi Knight Aida Forte end the fight.
Xinith Tarl was a Bith Jedi Master who served on the Jedi High Council of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

CT-3278 was a clone who served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper in the Imperial Army. Several months after the conclusion of the Clone Wars, CT-3278 was stationed on the planet of Serenno as part of company under the command of Captain Wilco.
Resamond Saous was a human who served as a prefect of the Church of the Force during the High Republic Era.
Blythe was an Abyssin male who was the father of the human Forvan. The two were members of the Colony of Kezarat in No-Space, which Blythe was the captain of.
This gundark encountered Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi on Vanqor, being trapped in a cave by Ahsoka Tano and members of the 501st Legion.

A Neimoidian female who served as a judge in Cato Neimoidia during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, following the Cadesura disaster in the capital city Zarra, she led the trial of Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and found him guilty.
Gren was a Mythrol mercenary and part of Dro-Nal-Pru's mercenary army during the High Republic Era. While working for Dro-Nal-Pru, Gren was scrached by a Xunji and turned into one.
During the High Republic Era, an Evereni woman attacked a Pantoran man because she believed herself to have been slighted.

A clone navigation officer served under the command of Jedi General Even Piell around the time they were captured by the Separatist Alliance and imprisoned at the Citadel on Lola Sayu in 20 BBY during the Clone Wars.
A male Rodian served as the attendant at the desk of the Spider Arms Hostel in slum district G17 of Coruscant's underworld during the Clone Wars.
Bree Menaren was a young Scalvi boy who lived on Turrak during the High Republic Era. Jedi Master Yoda helped him and his family in the struggle against Crulkon raiders.
A Chiss male of the Chiss Ascendancy's Stybla family served as the family's Patriel on the Ascendancy's planet Rhigar.
A member of the Tagge family was known to the Weequay pirate Hondo Ohnaka, who believed them to be unusually chatty.
Cherro was a Tunguray female from the planet Tunguray who spoke Tunguray. She lived on Coruscant.

A Toydarian Royal Guard lived in King Katuunko's palace around 20 BBY. When Savage Opress attacked, the guard informed Katuunko about the intruder and was ordered, along with the rest of the guards, to stop him.

A male factory worker was an employee of a decommissioning facility on the planet Corellia during the Clone Wars. With the end of the war and the formation of the Galactic Empire, the Separatist battle droids were decommissioned.
CC-1226 was a clone trooper who was created to serve the Republic Military. During the early Imperial Era, the clone served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper officer in the Imperial Military.
Wyler was a clone stormtrooper who served under the Galactic Empire. Wyler served under the command of Commander Cody and was killed during a mission on the planet Desix.
Nova was a clone stormtrooper who served under the Galactic Empire. Nova served under the command of Commander Cody during a Mission to Desix.

Grotton was a human who served as the governor of Desix early in the reign of the Galactic Empire. When assuming his post, he was held hostage by the unrecognized governor Tawni Ames after he relieved her, who led the planet with the aid of her Separatist holdout.
A drunk Toydarian prisoner was arrested at dawn for urinating on passing speeders on the planet Coruscant's Level 1392 in 382 BBY.

"JM-909" was the designation of a human male Imperial Stormtrooper Commander. In 1 BBY, he was stationed on the planet Tatooine as the unit leader of his squad. He and his squad were eventually ambushed by a band of Tusken Raiders, who stole their rations and weapons.

EQ-005 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper. Around 1 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Tatooine as as part of a squad led by JM-909. During a mission, EQ-005 was assigned two other stormtroopers to flank suspected Tusken Raiders from the south.

ND-221 was the designation of an Imperial stormtrooper. In 1 BBY, they were stationed on the planet Tatooine as as part of a squad led by JM-909. Ahead of a skirmish, ND-221 was assigned two other stormtroopers and flanked suspected Tusken Raiders from the north.
An reek fought and was killed at Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis.
An acklay fought and was killed at Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis.
A nexu fought and was killed at Petranaki Arena during the First Battle of Geonosis.
Barnabas Vim was a legendary human Jedi Master who was the Master of Padawan Vix Fonnick. In 482 BBY, Vim traveled with his Padawan to the planet Angcord in search of the Echo Stone.

Grini Millegi was a male Dowutin gangster who was an associate of Ciddarin Scaleback.

Kane, also known as Steel Claw, was a Nikto racer who participated in Riot Racing on the planet Serolonis. Kane worked with another racer Jet Venim to grab hold of opponents who threaten Venim's chance on winning.

Coromont Vizzle was an alien criminal and associate of pirate queen Maz Kanata during the High Republic Era. A famed outlaw, Vizzle's name was echoed throughout the galaxy in songs, many of which he penned himself.
An announcer that commentated races for the Safa Toma Classic on the planet Serolonis.

A Gran lived during the Imperial Era. Between around 8 BBY and 2 BBY, they was present on the Smuggler's Moon Nar Shaddaa and witnessed the arrivial of the smuggler Han Solo onto the moon aboard the Millennium Falcon.

A human worked as a guard at The Den, a spice production facility in Daiyu City. When Obi-Wan Kenobi infiltrated The Den in search of a kidnapped Leia Organa, he was confronted by the human and a Zabrak guard who queried about his presence.

An individual worked as a spicerunner and bounty hunter and, along with another individual, attempted to apprehend young Leia Organa at the Daiyu marketplace in an attempt to get her to reveal the location of Obi-Wan Kenobi and claim the bounty on him.
Drrn was a Muun who lived during the High Republic Era. He was a member of the pirate group Dank Graks and was part of it for over 100 years. He was Force-sensitive to a certain degree.
Saya Keem was a Force-sensitive Iridonian Zabrak who was a member of the Dank Graks during the High Republic Era.

Lavalox Verzen was a Force-Sensitive Cosian Dank Grak who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point she was admitted to convalesce at the Grava Asylum by the Cosian Jedi Master Tera Sinube, who then posed as Verzen to gather intel on the Dank Graks.
Rado was a male officer who lived during the High Republic Era. He was Coromont Vizzle's court-assigned officer. By the year after the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Rado had become a pirate.
Abadoo was a Hoover male technician and pilot of the Venomed Scabbard who lived during the High Republic Era.

A human elder was a lower-class villager who lived on the planet Wayyl. The son of Dagonet, the planet's representative in the Galactic Senate, was kidnapped by her and her fellow villagers, and the Jedi Qui-Gon Jinn and Dooku were sent to rescue him.
A human served the Galactic Empire as a stormtrooper. They served under Chief Regional Auditor Cygnus Anton, an operative of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate within the Empire.
Gheyr was a Trandoshan female who was a Jedi Initiate during the Republic Era.
Thea Starros was a human female who was the matriarch of the Starros Clan during the Imperial Era. She was the grandmother of Sana Starros, who referred to her as "Grammy."

Razere was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.

A human Jedi was present at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant when Jedi Grand Master Yoda sent a message to inform the Jedi Order he intended to stay with the Scalvi on Turrak. The Jedi brought Yoda's message to Jedi Masters Pra-Tre Veter and Ela Sutan.

A royal mistress from the Orthellin system owned the Lady Luck, a model of Luxury 3000 space yacht manufactured by the SoroSuub Corporation. Shortly after the Battle of Endor, she sold it to Lando Calrissian.

Yoss was a Gungan general who served in the Gungan Grand Army on the planet Naboo. In 32 BBY, the Gungan Grand Army planned to retaliate against the Trade Federation, which had invaded the planet, after forming an alliance with the human Naboo population.

Yanna was a Wookiee female elder who was leader of a sanctuary on the planet Kashyyyk. Between 19 BBY and 18 BBY, Yanna allowed the Wookiee Jedi Gungi to stay in the sanctuary after he helped rescue a member of her sanctuary and allied her people with him and Clone Force 99 to…
Babwa Venomor was a Trandoshan commander who led others of his species in helping the Galactic Empire to strip the planet Kashyyyk of its resources.

Luu was a man who helped raise Sana and Phel Starros alongside the siblings' father during the Imperial Era on the Outer Rim moon Nar Shaddaa. Eventually, they and Starros' father retired to the Outer Rim planet Dalna.
Cerasus Ehllo was a human male Imperial officer of the Ehllo family. His father personally knew Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine. Cerasus rose to the rank of captain in the Galactic Empire.

Coron Solstus was a human male who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Pako was a Nikto who served in an Outer Rim Exploration Team on the Witherbloom during the High Republic Era.

Seleen was a human envoy sent to Horatio by the city-state Firevale of the planet Gansevor in 382 BBY.
Joth Ver was a human member of the Spice Runners of Kijimi from the planet Mimban who had a bounty on their head during the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY.

Strotta was a red-eyed Jawa from Arvala-7, a muddy planet where Jawas from the planet Tatooine had settled.

Clone X, also named Sniper X, was a conditioned clone trooper who worked as a clone X operative for the Galactic Empire. His identifying number wiped, he was deployed by Imperial officers to complete high-priority and covert operations for the nascent Empire.

Cade was a clone stormtrooper that served the Galactic Empire. He served aboard Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart's Venator-class Star Destroyer during the attack on Kamino and the bombardment of Tipoca City and was later assassinated when he began to take action to expose Rampart's …
A Pantoran guard protected Senator Riyo Chuchi during the Imperial Era. In 18 BBY, the Pantoran guard was present when Senator Chuchi tracked down Slip, who she was trying to protect.
A male rag-man was present on the Inner Rim planet Jakku in 4 ABY. He attempted to intimidate the traveler Corwin Ballast upon the man's arrival on Jakku, hoping to prey on the newcomer.

Lys Solay was a Pantoran female Jedi youngling stationed on the forest planet Tenoo for further training during the High Republic Era. She had an affinity for animals and was best friends with fellow Jedi younglings Kai Brightstar and Nubs, as well as the pilot Nash Durango.
Cyrus Vuundir was a prince of the planet Vuundalla. Unbeknownst to his parents, he also operated as a pirate under the alias Taborr Val-Dorn.
Zia Zaldor Zanna was a Jedi Master stationed on the planet Tenoo to teach Jedi Initiates during the High Republic Era.
Mindoku was a human male who lived on the moon Jedha during the High Republic Era. He was a disciple of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door, a Force cult affiliated with the dark side of the Force.
Tellion was a male gang leader during the High Republic Era. Shortly before the Battle of Jedha, he sent a Klatooinian member of his gang to rob the tapbar Enlightenment, but they were unsuccessful.

A Klatooinian male gangster was a member of a gang during the High Republic Era. Shortly before the Battle of Jedha, he and other gang members were sent by Tellion to rob the tapbar Enlightenment, but they were unsuccessful.

An individual was a member of the Nihil. According to the Blythe who served as captain of the Kezarat Convoy during the Galactic Civil War, years after the convoy were stranded in No-Space during the High Republic Era, the Nihil member was supposedly captured by the convoy.
An Ugnaught individual worked for the First Order and maintained contact with the pilot Marnia Un'la'na and Major Elrik Vonreg.

A human ace pilot hailing from the planet Hosnian Prime traveled to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus in 34 ABY to participate in the All Aces Battle Royale race. The Resistance spy Kazuda Xiono noticed the pilot's arrival and discovered they had the same homeworld.
Flim was a Cragmoloid child who worked for Anst Wozo on Jedha during the High Republic Era. He was killed while Wozo punished all his kid employee.
Marr was a Hiitian who served as a Guardian of the Whills during the High Republic Era. Together with another Guardian, the Hiitian imprisoned Tey Sirrek after the bombing at the Temple of the Kyber.

An individual served as Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic in 200 BBY. During his mission to Begamor, the Jedi Padawan Sean noticed that despite being part of the Republic, most Begamorians were ignorant of the Supreme Chancellor's identity.
A Gungan worked as a vegetable cook at President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor.

Alareen Xie was a Jedi who was active during the High Republic Era. At some point she ended up in No-Space, where the Nihil had their main base. She eventually joined the Colony of Kezarat, and helped defend it from the Nihil.
Benni Baro was a human male thief and ipsium miner on Ipsidon during the Imperial Era.
A Bith worked in the kitchen of President Jamie Brasson's estate on Begamor during the High Republic Era.

Ilith was a Twi'lek male who lived centuries before the Galactic Civil War as a member of the Ascendant cult. At some point Ilith split from the group, and came to lead a splinter faction that pursued a different form of research than that of Miril, the leader of the Ascendant.
A Trandoshan smuggler made a deal with Dil Pexton. Dil received a stash of fake ship IDs he later gave to Auric Graf.

A TIE fighter pilot crashed into a river on Thune while hunting Lina and Milo Graf. He tried to pull himself out of the water into the boat the Graf siblings were escaping in, but he was unsuccessful.
A senator represented Unzel, their homeworld in the Mid Rim, in the Imperial Senate during the reign of the Galactic Empire.
A Dowutin was a customer at Shalla Mondatha's Moveable Feast. When a small creature tried to eat his food, the Dowutin knocked over a table trying to shoo away the creature.
A trunk-nosed Onodone lackey worked for Cikatro Vizago during the Imperial Era. He was tasked to secure a container of bugs owned by Shalla Mondatha.
DX-491 was a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire. DX-491, together with DZ-372 and many other Stormtroopers, was taken by the Agarians.
DZ-372 was a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire. DZ-372, together with DX-491 and many other Stormtroopers, was taken by the Agarians.
A worker was employed by the port control of the Mos Eisley spaceport on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine during the Clone Wars.

Krrsish was a Wookiee who was a Jedi Initiate sometime by 42 BBY. At the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, Krrsish joined the Tibidee Clan and became friends with a Togorian, Jak'zin, and a Trandoshan, Gheyr.
Mokko was a male alien gang boss who operated in Mokkotown on the desert planet Ipsidon during the start of the Imperial Era.
Drake was a human male scavenger and Ipsium miner who worked for the gang boss Mokko. He was in Mokko's inner-circle and was commonly the "top earner" among the crew of scavengers under Mokko.
Bryce was an individual who worked for the gang boss Mokko. During or after 18 BBY, a miner asked if Bryce and Hugh took out the hyperdrive of the Marauder.
Hugh was an individual who worked for the gang boss Mokko. During or after 18 BBY, a miner asked if Hugh and Bryce took out the hyperdrive of the Marauder.
Ambar was a Mournish medic who served in a Pathfinder team on the Witherbloom during the High Republic Era.

An individual acted as a bounty hunter of the Haxion Brood crime syndicate and lived during the Imperial Era. Sometime between 12 BBY and 11 BBY, he encountered the Nightsister Merrin and Jedi Knight Cal Kestis who required information on the location of a Haxion Brood base.
Mwarr Ja'Randa was a Twi'lek bounty hunter who tried to capture Rey on Kashyyyk.
This human male was a miner who worked as part of Mokko's crew in Mokkotown. He caught the Bad Batch while they were fixing the stolen Marauder at Mokkotown.

A captain served the royal fleet of the Pijali monarchy on the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. They commanded a Corellian corvette staffed by several crew members, including a comm officer and a security chief.

A comm officer served the royal fleet of the Pijali monarchy on the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. They worked alongside several other crew members, including a security chief, under a captain who commanded a Corellian corvette.
