Corde, known as the Half, was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the moon Jedha alongside PR-85T. She took pride in her precise aim and slicer's intuition, a skill she used to upgrade PR-85T. She was further known for cannibalizing parts from droids she considered lesser.

A Zabrak lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 4 ABY, the Zabrak went to the shop owned by the Kajain'sa'Nikto Narin after an incident occurred at the shop. The Zabrak asked Narin if there had been trouble, to which Narin responded it was under control.

Narin was a Kajain'sa'Nikto who ran a shop during the reign of the Galactic Empire, and was an old acquaintance of the smuggler Lando Calrissian, who had helped Narin get a job with Jabba the Hutt at one point.
Rick, known as the Door Technician, was a human scout trooper of the Galactic Empire's scout trooper corps who served as a door technician at Imperial Post 8L-055 on the planet Koboh.
An individual was the sister of Mosey Cimmaron. The pair at one point hunted a fierce creature on the Wild Space planet Farana.

Lank Denvik was a human male commander in the Galactic Empire who served as a chief supervisor for the Imperial Security Bureau. In 9 BBY, he was the commander of the II-0810 Satellite Station in the Nova Garon system.
Skoova Stev was a Sakavian male and a master fisherman who hailed from Sakavi Tar and worked on the planet of Koboh.
Tulakt was a female alien fortune teller who was a visitor of Pyloon's Saloon on the planet Koboh during the Imperial Era.

"Prince" Patren was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant who wielded an orange crossguard lightsaber. Rayvis sent him along with Urjef Mekor and Sebb Eshan in Phon'Qi's Grotto on the planet Koboh. They ambushed Jedi Knight Cal Kestis and tried to kill him.
Urjef Mekor was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a green double-bladed lightsaber. Rayvis sent him along with "Prince" Patren and Sebb Eshan to Phon'Qi's Grotto.
Sebb Eshan was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a purple double-bladed lightsaber. Rayvis sent him along with "Prince" Patren and Urjef Mekor in Phon'Qi's Grotto.
Tayala Akuna was a human female who was the wife of former Jedi Knight Bode Akuna, and mother of Kata Akuna.
Tulli Mu was a female alien individual who, along with her talkative employee Bhima Ook, ran her own Holotactics game in Pyloon's Saloon on the Outer Rim planet Koboh.

San Dersen was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a yellow double-bladed lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis alongside Mads Gresh. After Urgost's death, they were the last two lieutenants of Bedlam Raiders to protect Dagan Gera. Kestis succeeded to kill them after a fierce fight.
Mads Gresh was a lieutenant of the Bedlam Raiders, who wielded a cyan crossguard lightsaber. After Urgost's death, she was one of two last lieutenants of Bedlam Raiders to protect Dagan Gera.
Cleland Cudds was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a magenta double-bladed lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis. Cal found and killed them in the Flooded Bunker on Koboh.

A human male served as a tech stormtrooper of the First Order. In 34 ABY, the tech stormtrooper accompanied Commander Pyre to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus on the planet Castilon to hunt for two orphans from the planet Tehar, Eila and Kel.
A clone trooper officer took part in the Battle of Abrion Bridge.

The First Pilgrim was an alien individual who led the Pilgrim Warriors on the planet Angcord. In 482 BBY the First Pilgrim served the Lady of Angcord when she met with Jedi Master Barnabas Vim and his Padawan Vix Fonnick, who were visiting the planet in search of the fabled Ec…
Moran was a male Mirialan living on Koboh. He formerly worked for the Republic Tax Collection Agency.

Gretta was a human individual who was born on Jedha to a family who were all Fallanassi. At one point she found the kyber crystal specialist Cuata after he fled from the Galactic Empire, brought him to the planet Christophsis and began working with him.

Urgost, Fist of Rayvis served as a smasher in the Bedlam Raiders. He was personally trained in the use of the electrohammer by the raiders leader, Rayvis, coming to treat the weapon as an extension of his own arm.

Sember Vey was a female human Jedi Master who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. She was a protégé of Chief Librarian Jocasta Nu and spent most of her time in the field collecting artifacts and lost knowledge for the Jedi Archives.

Brethupp was an Ewok who lived in Bright Tree Village on the forest moon of Endor. In 4 ABY, Brethupp was present in the village center when a group of rebel captives were brought in by a scouting party.
Elocin was an individual who lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire who operated a crew and ran a club. She also came to know the smugglers Lando Calrissian and Han Solo.

Bhima Ook was a male alien individual who, along with Tulli Mu, ran their own holotactics game in Pyloon's Saloon on Koboh. Bhima was technically an employee of Mu, but used his outsized personality to entertain players and spectators alike.

An individual served as a doctor in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era. After the former Imperial Magna Tolvan joined the Rebel Alliance around 1 ABY, the doctor told her that forgiveness was an essential part of healing and moving on.
Raena Zess was a young human who lived on Tenoo during the High Republic Era. She had a rivalry with Nash Durango.
The uncle of Raena Zess lived during the High Republic Era on Tenoo.

Ceeli Durango was the mother of the pilot Nash Durango who lived during the High Republic Era on Tenoo together with their partner, Kryys Durango. They both watched their daughter race in and win the Kublop Classic.

Kryys Durango was one of the two mothers of the pilot Nash Durango. She lived during the High Republic Era on Tenoo together with her partner, Ceeli Durango. They both watched their daughter race in and win the Kublop Classic.
Kaliah Kublop was the first person to visit the planet Tenoo, where she founded the city of Kublop Springs.

Maarla Jinara was a Chadra-Fan female who owned a junkyard on the planet Tenoo. In 232 BBY, she enlisted the help of three Jedi younglings, as well as the pilot Nash Durango, to assist in catching thieves who had been stealing her junk.

Weebo was a Rodian female farmer who grew jellyfruit on the planet Tenoo. Around 233 BBY, her jellyfruit harvest was stolen by pirates just before the fruit was to be used for the Jellyfruit Festival.
Zepher was a Mon Calamari starship engineer who ran a starship repair shop based on the moon Dedoon of the planet Tenoo.

Raxlo was a Gozzo who lived during the High Republic Era and was the head of the Raxlo Corporation. He often used his custom harvesting vehicle to deforest Outer Rim planets in the name of maximizing profits.

Ace Kallisto was a human female master thief who lived during the High Republic Era. She was once the rival of Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zanna. Around 233 BBY, the Master Thief reunited with her former rival once again by stealing her shuttle.
Faraz was a Houk technician and an old friend of Zia Zaldor Zanna who lived during the High Republic Era.
Ansen Strung was a Dowutin male bounty hunter who later worked as a creature tracker during the High Republic Era. He was hired by the human Raena Zess to find her missing pet kibbin Figgles.
Warok was an Ewok who lived on the forest moon of the planet Endor.
Wini Eres was a female Namara who resided on the planet Koboh.
Grock was a tradesman and mechanic who worked alongside Dana to find treasures on the planet Koboh. In 9 BBY Grock was killed stealing a valuable fuel injector from Imperial territory on Koboh.
Dana was a human mechanic and prospector who worked alongside Grock on the planet Koboh.
Filkus Gorr was a Melbu prospector who repaired B1-series battle droids to sell to the Bedlam Raiders and their leader Rayvis on the planet Koboh.
Pili Walde was an alien botanist who resided on the planet Koboh and worked at Pyloon's Saloon for Greez Dritus.

Toa was a Twi'lek historian who was brought to the planet Koboh, due to her archaeological interest in the planet. She had a keen interest in High Republic history and was eager to study the numerous ruins found on Koboh.

Rugal was a female Jedi in hiding that resided on the desert planet of Golak at some point between 18 BBY and 3 BBY. During those years, she ran the Golak Mahal, a roadside motel located on the planet.
Gar-Ee was a Sith Eternal cultist on the planet Exegol. They were a rival of Ash-Ke, who enlisted the help of a protocol droid to defeat them.

Granny Greenthumb was a woman who resided in the Tuanul Village. She was delivered Tooke-trap plant seeds that came from Gungan Greenthumb. Once they were planted, First Order stormtroopers were alerted of their smuggling onto the planet and attacked her.
Wan'yek Whett was the captain of a crew of fishermen and the ship Grapnel.

Dreyo was Moran's smuggling partner on Coruscant. Once the Empire formed, Dreyo left Moran's smuggling operations because of the Empire's crack down on crime. Moran believed Dreyo was unaware he was alive by 9 BBY.

A human Sith Lord active during a war between the Jedi Order and the Sith, Bichan wore a red face-concealing mask and wielded a lightsaber with an attached whip. At one point, he fought and killed a group of eight Jedi, including the teacher of the Padawan Toul.
Soont Madas was a Gotarite male priorite prospector and technologist who resided on the planet Koboh. He was consumed by greed and tried to access a Jedi Chamber using explosive roller mines.

The Sith Mother was a Force-sensitive near-human female Sith Lord who lived in the galaxy. At some point, she travelled to a planet where she met the young girl Daal, and made the girl her apprentice.

Aau was a Force-sensitive Korban girl who lived on the planet Korba with her father, Abat. On Korba, Aau washed beasts near the entrance of a mine shaft where Abat worked by 19 BBY. After the Jedi Kratu visited the pair's home, they traveled to their respective workstations.
Abat was a male Korban who worked as a miner and lived with his daughter, Aau, on the planet Korba.
Hans R'kov was a Troglof who held the title of Hanna City dance champion from the years 6 ABY to 8 ABY.
Gretchen was a human female pilot who acquainted fellow pilot Isabella and led the Rebellion starfighter squadron Firestar Girls during the Galactic Civil War.
Hytho Pixx was a Bedlam Raider lieutenant wielding a magenta crossguard lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. Cal found him and killed him on the Lucrehulk-class battleship Primacy.
Gatt Medo was a bounty hunter who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Coruscant.

Daal was a Force-sensitive human female who lived on a planet where she worked in an Imperial workhouse as an orphan. At some point, she received an amulet that allowed for communication to a Sith Lord known as the Sith Mother.
Garra was a Rodian prospector on the planet Koboh who hoped to join the Bedlam Raiders in order to stop being seen as weak.

Gluth Andoi was a Morseerian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was a member of the Jedi High Council and took part in the Battle of Dalna against the Path of the Open Hand.
Rinn was a Duros Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. He was the marshal of the Jedi outpost on Elphrona.
Loi'e was a near-human cabaret performer and spy for the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era.

Gumar Adraki was an Andraven villager who lived on the planet Andraven in a village. Around 233 BBY, when it came time to migrate the wellagrin creatures from one side of a mountain to the other, he and his brother Jam were joined by a trio of Jedi younglings: Kai Brightstar, …

Varna was an Andraven wellagrin trainer on the planet Andraven. Around 233 BBY, the trainer oversaw the locals Gumar Adraki and Jam as they led visiting Jedi younglings on a mission to help a herd of wellagrins migrate.
A human female was the mother of Beilert Valance. They lived with Valance and his father on the planet Chorin where Valance's parents worked as miners.
Kumpa was an Aqualish male who operated in a settlement on the planet Yarrum during the High Republic Era.
An individual was a Chagrian pirate who operated in Yarrum Tower on the planet Yarrum.

Kalina Kalfus was a Twi'lek, who got involved in a parent-child starfighter race alongside her daughter Annisoukaline Kalfus. She had blue skin with pink blotches—though her nose was orange—and short lekku. Her eyes were yellow, and she had brown eyebrows.
Baython was a human who went to Screecher's Reach with Daal, Quinn, and Keena.
Quinn was a human male who who lived on a planet where he worked in an Imperial workhouse. At one point he went to Screecher's Reach together with his friends Daal, Baython, and Keena.
Tichina was an alien individual who lived on the planet Selk under Imperial control. Her older sister was Koten.
Koten was a Force-sensitive alien individual who lived on the planet Selk under Imperial control. Her younger sister was Tichina.
Dorota Van Reeple was the mother of Julan Van Reeple.

Ara was a human female pilot who accompanied Toul on a mission. In the past, she was raised in a hidden temple and was part of a group with five other young people who could see prophetic images on rocks when it rained within Dolgarak.

Toul was a human male Jedi Padawan, who was confronted by the Sith Lord, Bichan in a Force vision. The dark lord instructed him to join him and become his apprentice. By 1032 BBY, they met on an asteroid, where Toul was with Ara to cut off the dark head.
Rani was a Force-sensitive human female that lived on Golak during the Imperial Era. Sometime between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, Rani traveled to the Golak Mahal with her older brother Charuk.

Charuk was a human male who lived on Golak. He had a younger sister named Rani who was Force-sensitive. Sometime between 18 BBY and 3 BBY, Charuk and Rani traveled to the Golak Mahal and met the hiding Jedi Rugal.
Crux was a human male who was trapped in a pit. When Crux escaped, the human was tossed back into the pit by Stormtroopers.
Livy was a Force-sensitive human female who was trapped in a pit.
Eureka was a human female who was trapped in a pit.

Kratu was a humanoid female Jedi who obtained kyber from the Korban miner Abat on the planet Korba. At one point, Kratu traveled to Korba and discovered that Aau, Abat's daughter, could purify kyber crystals by singing.
Figgles was a pet kibbin owned by Raena Zess during the High Republic Era.
Harr was a male Ovissian prospector and an avid patron of Pyloon's Saloon on Koboh. He left his homeworld at the age of twelve all by himself.

A Mon Calamari lived on the planet Tenoo. The youngling and their sister were interrogated for information by bounty hunter Ansen Strung around 233 BBY while fishing, although his Jedi associates tried to ask for it in a more polite manner.

A Mon Calamari youngling lived on the planet Tenoo. Around 233 BBY, while fishing for channelfish, the bounty hunter Ansen Strung and Jedi youngling Lys Solay asked her and her sibling about the whereabouts of a kibbin, which they did not know.
Fitan, nicknamed "Fit," was an Ugnaught Jedi Master who trained Oliviah Zeveron.

NAAARTAAAT was an electronic instrumental artist, mostly known for the three songs, "Spiceman," "Fields of Dusk," and "Ground Pulse". NAAARTAAAT's music compositions had a great sense of structure and progression.
An orange-skinned Twi'lek was working as a guard in the Yarrum Tower marketplace during the High Republic Era.

Chigg was an Abednedo male pirate hailing from the planet Abednedo. Around 233 BBY, he purchased a jellyfruit from the pirate gang of Taborr Val Dorn, who had stolen a crate of them and was selling them in the Yarrum Tower marketplace.
Gabino was a Twi'lek male youngling who was friends with the Zygerrian Kaimo.
Kaimo was a Zygerrian male youngling who was friends with the Twi'lek Gabino.
Grok Grok was an individual who served the Hutt Clan. The Nikto Ishnar Ti-Kharatal ordered Grok to take the skiff to Skarabda the Hutt.
Gargo was an individual who served the Hutt Clan.
Torvor was a Nikto who served the Hutt Clan.
Kvar was an individual who served the Hutt Clan.
Talzar was an individual who served the Hutt Cartel.
Blixy was a blixus utilized by the Jedi Padawan Farzala Tarabal during the mission to Bilbousa.
Madoob was a human who resided on Takodana during the High Republic Era.
Bims was a Toydarian who resided on Takodana during the High Republic Era.
Vireen was a male Scalvi elderman who was killed by the Crulkon Riak during raids on his people.
Litah was a Scalvi who lived in a Scalvi village on the planet Turrak.
Mata was a Scalvi who lived in a Scalvi village on the planet Turrak.
Trikk was a Scalvi who lived in a Scalvi village on the planet Turrak.

Tren was a Scalvi who lived in a Scalvi village on the planet Turrak. After he always heard about his uncle, Bree Menaren, defeating the Crulkon and saving his village, Tren, who was accompanied by Carli and Lenni, went to attack the Crulkon, only to find Milok, the daughter o…
Carli was a Scalvi who lived in a Scalvi village on the planet Turrak. Carli accompanied Tren and Lenni to fight the Crulkon, only to kidnap Milok.
Lenni, also known as Len, was a Scalvi who lived in a Scalvi village on the planet Turrak. Lenni accompanied Carli and Tren to fight the Crulkon, only to kidnap Milok.
Milok was a female Crulkon and daughter of Klask.
Clarn was a Crulkon who alerted Klask on her daughter being captured.
Anthen was a human information broker who, during the Clone Wars, provided Jedi Grand Master Yoda information on the Ring of Kafrene about a Separatist project codenamed Operation: Titan.
Cesar was a Clone Captain who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. The clone took part in a mission with the Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Yoda.

An Evereni female individual lived during the High Republic Era. At one point, she created the pirate organization known as the Nihil, which had been originally founded by the Evereni Marda Ro, to be used as a weapon against the Jedi Order.
Jichora was a Twi'lek who was an Elder of the Path of the Open Hand cult and was present onboard their flagship the Gaze Electric shortly after the Battle of Jedha in 382 BBY.
Shea Ganandra, also known as Mari, was a Force-sensitive human female who was a talented engineer and was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its subgroup the Children of the Open Hand.
A doorman was in charge of patrolling the Kasdan Place on the planet Corellia during the Imperial Era.

A human was the Grand Leader of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, he, along with another Unbroken Clan member, who he referred to as brother, traveled to the Unbroken Clan sanctuary on Corellia, where the two discussed their attempts to remove the …
A human male was a member of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. They wore an eye patch over their right eye.

A human served as an Imperial officer in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Around 3 ABY, the officer was at Ryleel Imperial Base on the Colonies planet Carida when an alert came in about a raid of a suspected rebel base with no reported survivors of the incident.

Giggs was a female Gedonian ground weevil that lived during the High Republic Era. Around 233 BBY, the young pilot Nash Durango was tasked to send her to an animal preserve on the forest planet Tenoo.

Emlat was a human who was a member of the Kanjiklub. In 31 ABY, Emlat and other Kanjiklubbers were in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu to capture the smuggler Han Solo, who had betrayed the gang in the past.
Iziz was a Jawa that lived in the galaxy.
Treek was an Ewok living in the Bright Tree Village on the forest moon of Endor. They had black eyes and brown hair with yellow stripes.
Chall Bekan was a Morseerian that lived in the galaxy.

Vyn Rolado was an human that served as a Colonel in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. They were stationed at Echo Base around the time of the Battle of Hoth and were responsible for taking care of the Tauntauns, especially the alpha female.
Fixer was a Dowutin that lived in the galaxy and worked with Unkar Plutt.
Rebuker was a Dowutin that lived in the galaxy and worked with Unkar Plutt.
Kurtruk was a human Imperial officer who held the rank of commodore in the Galactic Empire. The officer was operating the Banas mining operation during the Galactic Civil War.

TK-783 was a stormtrooper officer who operated on the planet Koboh with their partner. TK-783 and their friend were both killed by the Jedi Knight Cal Kestis after he used a mind trick on TK-783 and their partner.

Taske was a female Narkis Anchorite who ran a small trade shop in the Jedi archive on the moon Jedha. She was the last anchorite who remained there after it was raided by Darth Vader and the Galactic Empire.
Fae Doktut was a Twi'lek who lived on the Island along with her father, Kivo Doktut.
Kivo Doktut was a Twi'lek who lived on the Island along with his daughter, Fae Doktut. He owned the shop Doktut's Divinities, which sold various types of headwear.

Tolar Panro was the Trooper Master on the Island. His goal on the Island was to grant skills to help clean the Observatory. He was fascinated by clone troopers, particularly the story of Clone Captain Rex.
Laurasta Vertoa, Laura for short, was a Mirialan who operated the Vehicle HoloSimulator on the Island. She designed all of the HoloSims for the Vehicle HoloSimulator.
Ossa Grum was a human who taught pilots to fly in the Vehicle HoloSimulator on the Island.
Barton Tep was a human who worked at the cantina Brotwu's on the Island.
Olevin Drektek was a male Mon Calamari who spent his time at Barton Tep's cantina on the Island.
Tol Vossra was a Kel Dor who worked closely with Lanur Jad on the Island.
Lanur Jad was a Pau'an who was the Observatory's headmaster on the Island.
Darnyn Mott was a Zabrak who built different ships on the Island.
Arran Grinoto was a Weequay who owned a shop on the Island.
Colric Whitcro was a human who lived on The Island of a planet.
Wett Zantu was a Shozer who lived on the Island.

Floid Burbakk was a Sullustan who worked as a barber on The Island of a planet after being stranded there and becoming one of the many Castaways who called the island home. He had black eyes and light skin. Burbakk ran a barbershop on The Island.
Kirpaul Ventoro was a Zabrak who was a fighter on the Island.
Biff Hics was a Gamorrean fighter who lived on the Island.
Lax Torios was a human who helped Darnyn Mott on the Island.
Barkov was a Lasat member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its elite subgroup, the Children of the Open Hand.
Grath was a Chiss Class Master who lived on the Island.
Aida Bross was a Dathomirian Zabrak who lived on the Island.
Shakem Clegil was a Devaronian who lived on the Island.
Kiq Zu was a Trandoshan shopkeeper who lived on the Island and was mad at Kes Kode.
Kes Kode was a human who lived on the Island. Kode asked an individual to tell Kiq Zu sorry for how much the Krayt dragon pearl cost.
Herrok Jani was a Mon Calamari who lived on The Island of a planet after getting stranded there. He was one of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home.
Sezuke Yanzec was a Twi'lek who owned a shop on The Island of a planet.

Ziso Barl was a human racer who resided on The Island of a planet after being stranded there. Ziso Barl was one of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home. On The Island's beach, he set up Ziso's Race Shack where he held races and offered prizes.
Zarra Fingau was a human who liked to spend time at Barton Tep's cantina.
"The Wise One" was a mysterious human who resided on the Island.
Gibben Phom was a Bith musician who resided on The Island of a planet after getting stranded there. He was one of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home.
Devash Odiin was a Mirialan scribe who resided on the Island.
Tith T'rind was a humanoid who resided on The Island of a planet as a one of the Castaways, the island's stranded inhabitants.
Nemi T'rodthdloeth'ringthl, also known as Nemi Ring for short, was a human who wanted to be a fighter on the Island.

A rebel pilot served the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. They were slated to serve as co-pilot to Lieutenant Colvett Valeria for a mission to destroy the Imperial Strike Station Aurek.
Snowball was a wellagrin on the frigid planet Andraven during the High Republic Era.

An individual was a member of the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, they were amongst a number of members of the Unbroken Clan who planned to assassinate the current leader of the syndicate, Grand Leader Vukorah.
Shalish was a human female who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist.
An individual was an agent of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. By 1 BBY, the agent was caught by the Galactic Empire and frozen in carbonite before getting rescued by Perry.
The grandson of Weebo was a male Rodian who lived on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.

Klefan Opus was a male Askajian Jedi Master who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A veteran of the Clone Wars, he initially survived Order 66, but was later hunted down and slain by a former mentee, Iskat Akaris, during the Great Jedi Purge.

A human Guavian Death Gang soldier visited the supertanker fuel depot Colossus with their partner in 34 ABY. While aboard, the pair took the mechanic Oplock hostage, eventually releasing him only when his employer, the racer Marcus Speedstar, paid his debts to the Guavians.

A human Guavian Death Gang soldier visited the supertanker fuel depot Colossus with their partner in 34 ABY. While aboard, the pair took the mechanic Oplock hostage, eventually releasing him only when his employer, the racer Marcus Speedstar, paid his debts to the Guavians.

A human individual served the First Order as a stormtrooper aboard the Resurgent-class Star Destroyer Thunderer. In 34 ABY, the stormtrooper searched a captured shuttle for the allies of the defecting First Order pilot Tamara Ryvora.
A Bivall was active during the Republic Era and owned a starship. By 40 BBY, the Bivall became stranded in their ship and was rescued by the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn.

Neevaan was a male individual and younger brother of the Nobillian Neeva. After Neeva stood up to the crime boss Boggs Triff, Triff had Neevaan kidnapped. Neeva hired the bounty hunter IG-88 to kill Triff.
Santop was a humanoid thug hired by Boggs Triff's mob, who developed a recipe for purple algae poison. The bounty hunter IG-88 killed Santop on Nar Shaddaa.
Gemet was a humanoid thug hired by Boggs Triff's mob, who was skilled at using knives. The bounty hunter IG-88 killed Gemet on Nar Shaddaa.
Waldee was a humanoid thug hired by Boggs Triff's mob, who celebrated Life Day by exchanging gifts with other members of the gang. The bounty hunter IG-88 killed Waldee on Nar Shaddaa.

Wole was a Rodian mercenary who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and its sub-group the Path of the Closed Fist. He joined the cult in 382 BBY, shortly before it departed the planet Dalna for the holy moon Jedha.
Beyta was a Mon Calamari who served as a lieutenant and pilot in the Starfighter Corps of the New Republic during the New Republic Era. She often worked closely with General Hera Syndulla.
A Trandoshan was a member of a criminal syndicate who were rivals with Boggs Triff's mob. The Trandoshan was held prisoner by Triff until IG-88 inadvertently freed them.
A Rodian worked at a speeder scrapyard located in Boggs Triff's base on Nar Shaddaa.
A female individual was the mother of the Nobillian Neeva.
Boolan was an Ithorian male who lived during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult and was one of its Littles. He was the son of Path member Tragor.
A shopkeeper was a Nautolan who owned and operated a stall in Kublop Springs marketplace on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Mister Mockwell was a male musical artist that used an icon of a KX-series security droid's head with a flower garland on as imagery for their music.
Calar was a Force-sensitive Setaran tracker who was a member of the Sacred Circle before converting to the Path of the Open Hand cult in 382 BBY.

A human served as a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the stormtrooper was present aboard the Raider-class corvette King's Ransom after Imperial captain Cerasus Ehllo retrieved his wife Aryssha from the Starros family homeste…

A human served as a stormtrooper in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the stormtrooper was present aboard the Raider-class corvette King's Ransom of Imperial captain Cerasus Ehllo.
Okut Dand was a silver-whiskered Tarsunt who transported a consignment of bergruutfa from Port Mackie to the Marat system sometime between the Battle of Jedha and the Night of Sorrow.
TK-582 was the designated number of an office stormtrooper stationed aboard the Empire Administration Offices during the Galactic Civil War.
An individual served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance.

Mayanka Catrine was a Jedi who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Catrine and her Padawan, Agustin, encountered Asajj Ventress at the Outpost 716. Catrine engaged Ventress in a lightsaber duel and successfully captured her with the aid of Augustin.
Tendo Gugbridge was a prospector on the planet Koboh who found a cavern full of priorite after purchasing the worst claim in the region of Rambler's Reach Outpost.

Rardal Balnar was a human Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 232 BBY, Balnar accompanied several Jedi on the Padawan Academic Cruiser Star Hopper to the Trymant system where an emergence was occurring.

Xander Cran was a human male who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Cran got into an altercation in the city Ferdan on the planet Dalna with Athul Taran, who was frustrated with the Path's presence in the city and recent pattern of them buying up prope…

Mast Surko was a thug of the Crolute Unkar Plutt. Surko carried a vibro-ax and spent time on the planet Jakku at Niima Outpost. Surko usually bumped into his surroundings due to the large hood he wore, and would walk away with his servomotors screeching.

The Mire Terror was a large mogu that survived being submerged in the Viscid Bog on the planet Koboh. Emerging covered in a morass that made it hardier, the creature killed many of the world's prospectors.

Agustin was a Jedi Padawan who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars alongside their master, Mayanka Catrine. Agustin accompanied their master on a mission to the Outpost 716 to capture Asajj Ventress.

The mother of the human hunter Mosey Cimmaron at one point lived on a ranch on the planet Koboh with Cimmarron, who also had a sister. A feral caniphant terrorized the ranch and twice destroyed its barn, covering its tracks and so it was difficult to find.

A Soikan individual was a contact of the Shani bounty hunter Deva Lompop. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, after Thea Starros was captured by the bounty hunter Marl Jibs, Lompop spoke with her contact, who confirmed to the Shani that the bounty Jibs had intended to claim on Mevera Sta…

Bavoc Ansho was a Nautolan Jedi Knight who was a member of the Jedi assault team during the First Battle of Geonosis. His Jedi Padawan was Tualon Yaluna. Both survived the battle and Yaluna was promoted to Jedi Knight shortly thereafter.

Charlin Plaka was a Twi'lek female Jedi Knight who had a lightsaber duel with Iskat Akaris the day prior to the First Battle of Geonosis. Akaris remembered her duel with Plaka and Onielle shortly before the battle and newly doubted her abilities in combat.
Onielle was a human female Jedi Knight who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Oondun was a large creature found in a cave off of a village on the planet Sakavi Tar. She had tentacles which were used to attack fisherman Skoova Stev before 9 BBY.

A Besalisk who worked for the Galactic Empire lived during the Imperial Era. At some point between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Besalisk was present on a boat on the planet Hosnian Prime when the Starros Clan left their homestead after it was attacked by Imperial Captain Cerasus Ehllo.

Yupah was a Bedlam Raiders lieutenant wielding a blue double-bladed lightsaber who fought Cal Kestis on the planet Koboh. Yupah was sent with a BX-series droid commando and a Smasher to keep the Forest Array.

Gol, known as the "Wither King," was a male Force-sensitive individual who became a Sith. At some point he bled a kyber crystal. The Sith used the powers of the dark side of the Force to keep his face youthful while the rest of his body decayed.

Vork was a friend of Gido and Gulu, a pair of cantankerous prospectors who were long-time residents of Rambler's Reach Outpost on the planet Koboh. By 9 BBY, Vork had been killed by a runaway landspeeder.

Drillo was an individual who was friends with the cantankerous prospectors Gido and Gulu, long-time residents of Rambler's Reach Outpost on the planet Koboh. By 9 BBY, Drillo had perished while attempting to ride a gorocco, a type of powerful predator found on Koboh.

Twakuhka was a friend of a pair of cantankerous prospectors known as Gido and Gulu who were long-time residents of Rambler's Reach Outpost on the planet Koboh. By 9 BBY, Twakuhka died via incineration while juggling thermal detonators.
Leo was a nekko who was the faithful companion of the hunter Mosey Cimmaron. By 9 BBY, the pair got into a scrape where Leo was fatally wounded.
Kagh'rell was an individual who used a phrase claiming everyone in the galaxy was metaphorically either an akk dog or a spanner being chewed on by an akk dog.
A communications officer served the Pijali monarchy of the Inner Rim planet Pijal during the Republic Era. By this time, they were stationed in the Grand Hall of the world's royal palace.

Kimb was a non-binary bartender who worked in the Sublight Lounge of Chandrila Star Line's MPO-1400 Purgill-class star cruiser Halcyon. In 4 ABY, they made a drink for the Rebel Alliance general Han Solo, who was on his honeymoon aboard the vessel.

A human female who lived on the planet Wayyl, this villager owned a pet dog. Between the years 68 BBY and 58 BBY she was residing in her house when her dog went outside, encountering Jedi Master Dooku and Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn, on a mission to rescue Senator Dagonet's son,…
Dhar Wat was a male Octani who was selling Capacitor parts on the planet Kamil during the First Order-Resistance War.

Amadeo Azzazzo was a human male Padawan of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Azzazzo and his master Mirro Lox were called back to the planet Coruscant, following their mission to evacuate villagers during a groundquake on t…
Mirro Lox was a human male Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Lox and his Padawan Amadeo Azzazzo were called back to Coruscant.
Attu was a Korban who worked as a miner on the planet Korba.
Galamal was a Barabel who owned the starship Bonecrusher.

A Twi'lek gang leader was in charge of the Nova Razors, the most ruthless gang on the planet Bestine IV. His gang ran a spice business in the market district of Bsellis City out of the local housing tenement Blue Garden Homes, where they enslaved locals to refine spice.

Mari was a female individual who was the mother of the human female Mari. By 382 BBY, Mari—now known as Shea Ganandra because she did not like her original name—was a member of the Path of the Open Hand's Children, a group of Path members who obtained Force artifacts on behalf…

Nanda was a human female who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Nanda left the Path compound on the planet Dalna with other Path members on the starship Moon of Sarkhai for a mission to the mysterious Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless, creature…

The father of a duchess serving the Mid Rim planet Malastare waged a number of wars. By the time Jedi Padawan Qui-Gon Jinn began studying the holocron of prophecy in 67 BBY, the duchess's father was considered ancient among members of the Jedi Order.
A Wookiee child was enslaved by the Czerka Corporation in 40 BBY. On his first day in slavery, his hand was shaved so that a slave-tracking chip could be implanted under his skin.
Jaylen Vrax, born Jaylen Barsha, was a human male crime lord, and heir to the fortunes of his wealthy Corellian business family, the Barshas. He was an associate of Kay Vess during the Imperial Era.

Nix was a merqaal companion of Kay Vess during the Imperial Era. He grew up on an unknown jungle world and was captured by the Sixth Kin to be sold as an exotic pet. However, he was rescued by Kay Vess, becoming loyal partners in crime.

Kay Vess, also known by the alias Toren Valario Nupp, was a young human female criminal from the Worker's District in Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica, who was raised and trained by her mother Riko Vess, becoming a professional thief and eventually a scoundrel and outlaw in…
Hétis was a waitress at Loi'e's Follies, and Loi'e's daughter.
Jon was a rebel who worked at Loi'e's Follies.
Loi'e's son was the near-human son of the rebel Loi'e. He served the Galactic Empire after being kidnapped as a child.
Danka Orsato was a Mon Calamari information broker who lived in the time of the Imperial Era.
An Imperial officer was a friend of Danka Orsato during the time of the Imperial Era.
An individual was a lieutenant in the Pyke Syndicate. In 3 ABY, the criminal Kay Vess was hired to steal an object from the lieutenant.

Kala was a human female E'roni who lived in U'ronoh village on the planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. She talked with members of the Path of the Open Hand Force religion when they visited the world.
Filias was the brother of the Gotarite Soont Madas who lived on the planet Koboh.

Thevera was a human female who was the daughter of Aryssha of the Starros Clan and Cerasus Ehllo, an Imperial captain. Their name was a mix of the first names of Aryssha's grandmother Thea Starros and Aryssha's mother Mevera Starros.

Desana was a human female who was the daughter of Aryssha of the Starros Clan and Cerasus Ehllo, an Imperial captain. They were born, along with their twin Thevera, on the Raider-class corvette King's Ransom between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.

Feyra Akaris was the mother of Iskat Akaris. Once a Jedi Padawan, Feyra left the Jedi Order after failing her Jedi Trials, specifically her Trial of the Spirit, and returned to her homeworld of Pkori.

A human Imperial officer served the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. In 4 ABY, Lando Calrissian visited Narin's, a weapons shop ran by the Kajain'sa'Nikto Narin, to acquire a datacard that contained plans for Jabba's Palace which Calrissian needed.

A Dark Jedi was originally a Padawan apprenticed to a Jedi Knight. According to him. Sometime after 4 ABY, his master gave him the lightsaber of Anakin Skywalker. One day he fell to The Dark Side of The Force and years later started a cult.

Catak was a genderfluid Clawdite who served as the assistant of the scoundrel Khel Tanna. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Catak and Tanna were present at the Bounty Hunters Guild Social Club on the planet D'Assem, where Tanna had set up a meeting with the bounty hunter T'onga, so she…
A Twi'lek served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, she participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.
A Weequay Jedi served the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, they participated in an attack on the Path of the Open Hand Force religion on the planet Dalna.
A human was a Dhani chieftain who in 5 BBY led a pilgrimage on the planet Aldhani to the sacred temple Nasma Brani to watch the occurrence of the Eye of Aldhani.
A human served as a corporal in the Aldhani Garrison as part of the Low Road Unit.

A Qubey lived on the Outer Rim moon Caliban by the time of the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, it became separated from its parent during Separatist General Grievous' invasion of the moon and found itself trapped on one side of a chasm due to the destruction of a lunar ice bridge.
A Gungan of the Otolla subspecies lived on Naboo with their mother as a child during the Clone Wars. The child found and took possession of a Wookiee doll, which secretly contained an artifact.

Eda'Ni was a human Jedi Padawan who lived during the Republic Era. At one point during the Clone Wars, Eda'Ni was one of a number of Padawans who were present at the Sason Temple on the Outer Rim gas giant Sason.
A female Twi'lek was an Elder of the Path of the Open Hand cult on the planet Dalnan.
Regnar Pulip was a generous supporter of the Path of the Open Hand cult on the planet Dalna. The Mother asked him to send special protein supplement for the cult.

A Falleen male was the aide of Lord Gyuti. Lady Qi'ra, the leader of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, approached Lord Gyuti, a leader of the Black Sun, to offer Crimson Dawn's services to Black Sun.
Bryen Rowne was a human pilot who served as a captain in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

Dasher was one of eight reindeer under the ownership of the Jedi Knight Santa Claus. Alongside Dancer, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Dunder, and Blixem, Dasher pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughou…
Dancer was one of eight reindeer under the ownership of the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Prancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Dunder, and Blixem.

Blixem was one of the eight reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Vixen, Cupid, and Dunder. Blixem pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Dunder was one of the eight reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Vixen, Cupid, and Blixem. Dunder pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Cupid was one of the many reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Vixen, Dunder, and Blixem. Cupid pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Prancer was one of eight reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus alongside Dasher, Dancer, Vixen, Comet, Cupid, Dunder, and Blixem. Prancer pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Vixen was one of the many reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Comet, Cupid, Dunder, and Blixem. Vixen pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

Comet was one of the many reindeer owned by the Jedi Knight Santa Claus, alongside Dasher, Dancer, Prancer, Vixen, Cupid, Dunder, and Blixem. Comet pulled Claus' sleigh on the annual holiday Christmas, to assist him in his delivery of presents to children throughout the galaxy.

t: Unidentified Imperial officer (Darth Vader's Venator-class Star Destroyer)
x: A human officer in the Galactic Empire was stationed aboard the Sith Lord Darth Vader's Venator-class Star Destroyer. At one point, the officer was tasked to repair Vader's TIE fighter, which had sustained damage.

A human Imperial officer served as a commander in the Galactic Empire's Inspectorate during the Imperial Era. The commander responded to a Rebel Alliance incursion on Coruscant and commanded the Imperial counter actions.

Fennro Drogan was a human native of the planet Ghorman born with a limb difference that gave him a short right arm with only four fingers. He eventually joined the Ghorman Front, a group formed against the Galactic Empire.
Bree was a human Jedi Initiate who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Jon was a human Jedi youngling who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Toko was a Togruta Jedi youngling who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Marrok, known at one time as the First Brother, was a mysterious Force-sensitive male humanoid warrior who once served in the Inquisitorius of the Galactic Empire, and the Jedi Order before that.
A human Imperial officer served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's Inspectorate during the Imperial Era.
A Boosodian was the owner of the Bounty Hunters Guild social club on the planet D'assem during the Imperial Era.
Rilly was a female resident of the city Ferdan, on the planet Dalna. She was the girlfriend of Treze and the mother of his unborn child.
Danto Parapa was a brief leader of the Parapa Cartel before running away after being scared of leading the cartel.
Funky Snoke was a humanoid male clone of Snoke who was created on the planet Exegol by the Sith Eternal cult. His cloning process was unsuccessful, leaving him with an altered personality.

A massive creature called the protector lived on Planet X. In 382 BBY, members of the Path of the Open Hand cult came across the creature as they were fleeing from an Under-Dweller, another massive creature that had attacked them after they had taken eggs of the Nameless speci…

An individual was the cousin of the Falleen Lord Xanak Grunseit. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, they were the leader of the criminal syndicate Black Sun. After the Falleen had a death mark placed on them by the Hutts, the cousin hired the bounty hunter Boba Fett to take the hit.
Ordo was a Talpini Nihil marauder who was part of the crew of the Gaze Electric, Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro's flagship.
Hume Tarl was a human stormtrooper who served as a member of the Galactic Empire's Tempest Force legion for six years and earned the rank of sergeant.

Tragor was an Ithorian male scientist and member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. Though his only child Boolan remembered him as a brilliant researcher, Tragor was nonetheless said to have been a troubled individual who was unable to discover a location for him to call home.
Tareen was a Duros pilot who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, he joined a mission to the fabled Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species aboard the Bonecrusher.

Hal was a human member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, Hal captained the Moon of Sarkhai for a mission to the fabled Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species, bringing a group of Path members with him on the ship and accompanying the Scupper and the Bon…

Ort was a Reesarian who was a member of the Path of the Open Hand cult. In 382 BBY, she joined a mission led by prospector Radicaz Dobbs alongside other Path members to the fabled Planet X to retrieve eggs of the Nameless species aboard the Scupper.
The husband of Kaela served the Galactic Empire between the years 19 BBY and 4 ABY. on the world of Torku.
Kaela was a museum guide who worked on the world of Torku.
Davgar Llian was a human rebel who fought Darth Vader on the world Torku.
Bazer was a human rebel who fought the Galactic Empire on the world Torku alongside Anker and Davgar Llian. He was killed by Darth Vader during the mission.
Anker was a human rebel who fought the Galactic Empire on the world Torku alongside Bazer and Davgar Llian. He was killed by Darth Vader during the mission.
Darsana was a member of the Galactic Republic Senate from the planet Glee Anselm who was a strong supporter of the Military Creation Act.
Porter was a human pilot who served as a captain in the Starfighter Corps of the New Republic after the fall of the Galactic Empire.
Spider, designated CT-1123, was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who held the military rank of Clone Captain and led a company of troopers.
Sixty-Seven was a Purge Trooper who served in the Inquisitorius of the Galactic Empire.
Blue 22 was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.
Last Man, designated CT-0528, was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Josk Nivar, Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.

Doc was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider. He later executed Order 66 along with the rest of the company on Frong against his Jedi Generals.
Flip was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.

Nexu was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider. They shared their name with the nexu, a predatory feline from Cholganna.
Nic was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.
Rocko was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.
Storm was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.
Whirl was a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic who served in a company led by Jedi Generals Tualon Yaluna, Iskat Akaris and Clone Captain Spider.

Lan-Drus was an Arcona bounty hunter hired by the Galactic Empire to assassinate Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma. She was shot by Mon Mothma following the failed assassination attempt on the planet Desinta.
A soldier fought in a number of wars on the planet Crucival, eventually coming to serve the Malkhanis clan.
Noegaud was a human who bullied Niko in a town on an astronomical object somewhere in the galaxy.
Niko was a human who lived on an astronomical object with his mother sometime during the Imperial Era.
A human served as a security guard for the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. In 3 BBY, the guard was stationed on duty at the entrance of the Imperial Navy facility on the planet Coruscant.

Velerie Tide was a Force-sensitive human female who was a member of the Jedi Order. After the Galactic Republic turned on the Jedi during the Great Jedi Purge that began in 19 BBY, Tide hid her identity and blended in among the locals on the astronomical object Athio III, but …
A Togruta female was a member of the Nihil who sabotaged the Crashpoint Tower before the attack on the planet Valo.

A hunched Disciple was a member of the Elders of the Path led by Barbatash. After Trymant IV was reduced to an inhospitable desert following an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Barbatash remained on the planet, though the community's numbers and resources continued …

A Zabrak was a member of the Elders of the Path led by Barbatash. After Trymant IV was reduced to an inhospitable desert following an Emergence of the Great Hyperspace Disaster, Barbatash remained on the planet, though the community's numbers and resources continued to dwindle.

Torgo was a male who was the pilot and security officer of the Valo Security Force, operating in Lonisa City on the planet Valo. He was the partner of Idrax Snat, when the captain arrested Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram.
A Dug was one of the operators of Starlight Beacon.
A male individual was a member of the Nihil who attacked the planet Valo. He was killed when Lula Talisola shot his ship. He was the first victim of Lula.

A Qubey parent lived on their homeworld, the Outer Rim moon Caliban, during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In 22 BBY, they became separated from their child during the Separatist General Grievous' invasion of Caliban.
Sunghi Silpari was a Kiffar female Jedi Knight who fought in the Clone Wars.

Ghymnon was a sentient acellular pathogen that was the sole inhabitant of the Unknown Regions planet Uokara. For millions of years, the pathogen covered the planet and killed thousands who attempted to conquer it.
Zeeth was a male Rodian Jedi Knight who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic.
Josk Nivar was a male Jedi Knight who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. He was killed during his commanding mission to the planet Thule.

Reegesk was a Ranat thief who was lurking in Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine when the local moisture farmer Luke Skywalker entered with the Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and the droids C-3PO and R2-D2 in 1 BBY.
Nath was a human who served in the Galactic Empire.

Gorneesh was king of the Duloks known as the Children of Vulgarr on the moon of Endor. During the reign of the New Republic, Gorneesh's Duloks worked with the Ewok siblings Gruekk and Graak to try and take control of Bright Tree Village by kidnapping Chief Chirpa.
A human served as a SCUBA troooper in the First Order in 34 ABY.
A human served as a SCUBA troooper in the First Order in 34 ABY.
Fvorn was a Duros Jedi Padawan who was taken at a young age to the Jedi Temple and trained in the use of the Force.

Heezo was a Force-sensitive Selonian male former Padawan and technician who worked in the Jedi Temple. Secretly an agent of Darth Sidious, he was instrumental in Iskat Akaris' turn to the dark side of the Force and was later murdered by her when she learned the truth.
Nanta was an Ewok in the Bright Tree tribe of the moon Endor. In 4 ABY, Nanta was part of a scouting party that discovered a group of rebel offworlders caught in one of their net traps.
Karie Neth, nicknamed "Krayt," was a human female pilot who served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic's navy during its war against the Galactic Empire.

Brewhada was a Wookiee toymaker who was captured by the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo. After being tricked by Bennun Glau to capture Brewhada instead of the Sunburst gem, Greedo presented the Wookiee to a confused Jabba.
Bennun Glau was a headliner who worked at Jabba's Palace. Glau eventually stole the Sunburst gem from Jabba and made the Rodian bounty hunter Greedo do jobs for her.

Batten was a human Imperial officer who served as a captain in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Batten led an Imperial mission ordered by Emperor Sheev Palpatine to gather up everything within the Amaxine Station.

A Tusken Raider youngling was having a celebration with other Tuskens that included a cake in 1 BBY. However, Platypus Rebel Alliance agent Perry accidentally fell onto the cake and destroyed it, upsetting the youngling and the other Tuskens.
A child was killed by the bounty hunter Shenda Mol when she was four days old at some point during the Republic Era.
A Whiphid was born by around 228 BBY. At some point by around 66 BBY, they were killed by the bounty hunter Shenda Mol.
Drakko was a Trandoshan who was a part of Bossk'wassak'Cradossk's gang during the Imperial Era.

Evar Orbus was an individual whose death was ironically caused by the musician Figrin D'an of the Modal Nodes, at some point prior to Figrin's younger brother Barquin D'an joining the Max Rebo Band, which had occurred by 4 ABY.

Rilo Grenth was a human male technician who served the Galactic Empire as a civilian contractor. Grenth was sent to the moon of Endor to implement and test the interconnectivity protocols of the Death Star's shield generator's system.

A female individual was the sister of Oola, a Twi'lek female dancer enslaved by the crime lord Jabba the Hutt. By the time of Oola's death in 4 ABY, they lived on the Hutt Space moon Nar Shaddaa with two daughters.

A human male served as a stormtrooper in the First Order during the New Republic Era. In 34 ABY, they accompanied Commander Pyre to the supertanker fuel depot Colossus to hunt for two Tehar orphans, Eila and Kel.

The mother of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni woman who hailed from the planet E'ronoh. She lived on the world with her family and sometimes cooked pilafa stew to feed her relatives, which her son enjoyed.

The grandfather of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni man. At some point during their younger days, they served in the military of their homeworld—the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh—to combat the forces of the neighboring planet Eiram.

The grandmother of the pilots Bly Tevin and Lina was an E'roni woman who hailed from the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh. At some point when she was young, she watched ships from the Outer Rim planet Eiram fly over the Rook, E'ronoh's capital city.
Sep was a male Twi'lek child who was the younger brother of Bruff. He lived on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Metz was a human who was the lead singer and electric vioddle player of the Ku-Bops. He performed on the planet Tenoo during the High Republic Era.
Uumay Hawlatha was an ancient Bimm Jedi Master who regularly assisted the Jedi Knight Iskat Akaris in her struggles to find clarity through meditation during the Clone Wars.

Theca was an Arkanian Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who lived during the Republic Era and was rumored to be well past two hundred years old. The Jedi sported white hair and maintained a good deal of energy for their age.

The wife of the E'roni pilot Kinni was a woman who lived on the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh during the High Republic Era. When the pilot enlisted in E'ronoh's fleet, she often missed dining with her wife due to the responsibilities of her duties.

A Kage male was the brother of a Kage female who eventually changed her name to Abda. The siblings resided on their homeworld Quarzite with their parents as part of a clan and engaged in combat training.
Sellaccc Orryak was a Trandoshan who led a biker gang known as the Ganguls on Tenoo.

A female individual was the mother of Xiri A'lbaran, the princess of the planet E'ronoh. On the day of her wedding to Prince Phan-tu Zenn of the planet Eiram in 382 BBY, A'lbaran wore a gown that had belonged to her mother.
A woman was the grandmother of the human E'roni Princess Xiri A'lbaran of the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh and a member of the world's royal family.
An individual was the assistant of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark during the High Republic Era.

Tika was a female Iktotchi Jedi Initiate who became best friends with Iskat Akaris during their time at the Jedi Temple. However, during a training exercise, Tika was left with a severe injury to her spinal cord due to Akaris' accidental toppling of a column onto her.
Gobi was a Jedi of the Jedi Order and served as master to the Padawan Zeeth. They both fought in the First Battle of Geonosis, after which Zeeth was knighted.

A female Sullustan served the Jedi Order as a Padawan during the Republic Era and was trained by the Jedi Knight Josk Nivar. The Padawan aided their Master in a diplomatic mission to Chandrila and was later killed during the First Battle of Geonosis.
Brutus was a nekko tended by Mosey Cimmaron on the planet Koboh, in 9 BBY.
The Warlord of the Tower was a male crime lord on the planet Koboh. He ruled from Riverbed Watch until the rise of the Bedlam Raiders and Rayvis.
A green-skinned Argazdan spacer visited a bar on the astronomical object Rekardia sometime before 382 BBY.

Salas was a male individual who served as a soldier of the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he was killed by a mine on the planet E'ronoh, and as he died, Princess Xiri A'lbaran of E'ronoh sang the sailor's lament to him.
Neverez was a Jedi who lived during the High Republic Era. Led by Jedi Knight Gella Nattai, he joined an expedition to the planet Orvax as part of a Republic Pathfinder team.

Quez Totark was a legendary Dug composer and musician who mentored the Ortolan Maximilian Rebo and the Kitonak Droopy McCool in that field. He played a stringed instrument and taught his students that music was more important than life and death.
Daladit-Chan was the father of the Klatooinian musician Umpass-stay. In 4 ABY, Daladit-Chan gave the order to his son to kill the Hutt Jabba Desilijic Tiure through a DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid.
Braygh was a Besalisk female who operated on the planet Kundu Minor during the High Republic Era.
Slaygh was a Besalisk who operated on the planet Kundu Minor during the High Republic Era.
Kreb was a Devaronian who was serving a prison sentence in a Galactic Empire prison in 4 ABY.
Micho, also known as Old Micho was a human who served the Galactic Empire. By 4 ABY, Micho was imprisoned in an Imperial prison where he met the Devaronian Kreb.

A human individual served in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau. He interrogated the former Imperial technician Rilo Grenth on the moon Endor due to suspicions of him being a Rebel spy, ultimately ordering his arrest and imprisonment.
In 4 ABY, an Ewok approached the Galactic Empire technician Rilo Grenth while he was on break. The Ewok pulled out a spear on Grenth before they were scared off by blaster fire from a scout trooper.

A human was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the rebel was present aboard the Alliance's flagship, Home One, and spoke with the smuggler Lando Calrissian as he sought to find General Leia Organa about using the …

A human Bespinite lived in Cloud City at the gas giant Bespin during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, after the Galactic Empire took over the city, the human was frozen in carbonite along with other Bespinites by the Empire to be taken to the Imperial Security Bureau for interrogat…

A Lurmen bounty hunter operated during the High Republic Era. In 382 BBY, he had a prosthetic eye and traveled to the Outer Rim planet Eiram to attempt to claim a bounty on Axel Greylark, the son of Galactic Republic Supreme Chancellor Kyong Greylark.
A weak-minded individual was a patron of the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant in 22 BBY.
Bruff was a male Twi'lek musician and a member of the Ku-Bops. He was friends with fellow band member Metz. He played the rumble bass.
Hamm was a radio communications clone trooper who participated in the Second Battle of Geonosis.
A male Tintinna was married to a Tintinna woman. He was killed in an attack on the city of U'ronoh on the planet E'ronoh. Later it turned out that Axel Greylark killed him.
Jopar Tandil was an individual who worked as staff in Tech Management for the Jedi Order in the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant.
A Lasat bounty hunter traveled to the Outer Rim planet Eiram in 382 BBY, hoping to collect a bounty on the Republic envoy Axel Greylark.
Senna Strung was a female Dowutin bounty hunter and the younger sister of Ansen Strung.
Inaya was a female human princess of Hazun. While visiting the planet Tenoo for a gift for her father, she was accompanied by the droid PD-4.
Jensen Corbyt was a human who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic Defense Fleet, holding the position of First Officer under Captain Hayle on board the Defender-class cruiser Vesper.

Mycho Zala was a Zekodoan prospector during the High Republic Era. He was an associate of Jedi Master Zia Zaldor Zana and friend of the Jedi Order, and met Jedi Initiate Kai Brightstar and Tenoo pilot Nash Durango on Tatooine around 233 BBY to receive a hyperdrive capacitor.
Dreand Yens was a male individual who served as prime minister of the moon Madurs in 4 ABY.
Draiven Bosh was a Moldwarp thief and collector who lived during the High Republic Era. He owned a droid named K-2PL and an astromech droid named R4-13.
Oswin Dicto was a human male who served as the captain of the Star Cruiser Halcyon during its first voyage free of the Galactic Empire in 4 ABY.

Gamodar was an elderly Ortolan male shopkeeper. He lived in an apartment above his shop on Bar'leth, with several pet tookas. Prior to the First Battle of Geonosis, Gamodar often acquired Jedi and Sith relics, which he traded to Jedi Master Sember Vey.

Jooro Jarrot, also known as "Speeds," was a Quarren member of a biker gang called the Ganguls. When the biker gang expanded into a pirate gang, Jarrot remained as the Ganguls' second-in-command behind their leader Sellaccc Orryak. Jarrot used a net caster in combat.

Toda-Joh was an Anzellan member of the biker gang known as the Ganguls. When the biker gang expanded into a pirate gang, Toda-Joh remained one of the Ganguls' second-in-command behind his leader Sellaccc Orryak.
Varish, referred to by her students as Ms. Varish, was a female Malangsha who worked as a gardening instructor to Jedi Initiates on the planet of Langsha-Raang during the High Republic Era.
Ori was a human male who briefly worked for the biker gang Ganguls as a common thief.
Drahric was a Jablogian bartender who operated in the town of Aklyrr Bend on Tenoo.
Geeli was a Latero who visited his friend, the chef Hap in Hap's Sap Tap.
Muxa was a Mirialan who delivered ingredients for the Latero chef Hap.
Tooba Jinx was an Otolla Gungan who worked with Ace Kallisto and Ishbul Ekwesh to retrieve the Tharnakan Story Stone. Jinx betrayed his crew and stole the Stone to sell it.
Ishbul Ekwesh was a Tharnakan who worked with Ace Kallisto and Tooba Jinx to retrieve the Tharnakan Story Stone.
Tanteek was a female Corellian hound owned by Raf Thatchburn.

Borrim Shub was an alien that found itself on the streets of the planet Daiyu in 9 BBY. While just trying to get by like everyone else, Shub encountered the human child Princess Leia Organa, who nearly ran into the alien.

Sweebotta was an alien who was also known as Sweetie due to their friendly face. In 9 BBY, Sweebotta was at a street market on the planet Daiyu when Princess Leia Organa ran through the alien's four tall legs while fleeing from the fugitive Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi.
Grelli Cryko was a Melitto from the planet Li-Toran. In 9 BBY, Cryko drank in a saloon in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.
The father of the human Princess Inaya was king of the planet Hazun.

Killian Tagge was a human male who, along with Sanya Tagge, was the head of the Tagge Corporation before their daughter Domina. Killian and Sanya were Separatists, who bid for a contract to supply battle droids, though they failed to secure the contract.
Sanya Tagge was a human female. Along with Killian Tagge, with who they had four children—Domina, Orman, Silas, and Ulric—Sanya was the head of the Tagge Corporation.

Pyt'r Stevar was a Jedi Master from the High Republic Era. They were stationed on Koboh, and were planetside during the Great Hyperspace Disaster, in which an Emergence destroyed Koboh's moon, causing catastrophic damage to Republic installations on the planet.
Ginntho was an Anzellan female slicer recruited by the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Rodian individual lived during the reign of the Galactic Empire. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, he met pirates on the Smuggler's Moon Nar Shaddaa to purchase a prototype battle droid that the pirates stole from a Tagge Corporation warehouse on the planet Milvayne.
Sannet Ot'Zien was the appointed Republic ambassador to the Orrik Cluster, which had recently been identified as populated during the High Republic Era.
An individual was the mayor of Aklyrr Bend. He was later chased out of his office by the biker gang Ganguls and fled the town.

An individual was a Jedi of the Jedi Order and the master of Zia Zaldor Zanna, who later became a Jedi master. Around 233 BBY, the Jedi youngling Kai Brightstar had a bad day after waking up late, missing the rest of the younglings who went on a trip to the planet Tiss'ell.
An unidentified Balnab male worked as a bounty hunter during the galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars.

A human male worked as a bounty hunter during galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars. He was part of a cadre of five bounty hunters searching for a bounty with good pay, who were present at the Most Eisley Cantina, where they happened upon the bounty posted on Savage Opress.
A Weequay worked as a bounty hunter during the galactic conflict known as the Clone Wars.

A Separatist official sat next to Tikkes during the Executive Separatist Council's meeting on Utapau in 19 BBY. They were present when General Grievous ordered the relocation of the council to Mustafar.
A individual was a server aboard the Star Cruiser Halcyon. In 4 ABY, they served rebel General Han Solo and Princess Leia Organa a glass of Tristall wine, and informed the two about its origin.

Hayle was a human male who served as a New Republic officer within the New Republic Defense Fleet. Holding the military rank of captain, Hayle previously served in the Rebel Alliance before joining its successor government where he later became the commanding officer of the De…
Murley was a Loth-cat owned by the Mandalorian Sabine Wren during the time of the New Republic, living alongside Wren in the LothalNet comm tower E-272 on the planet Lothal.

Jakris was a Mon Calamari guard who served as a top security officer aboard the New Republic Defense Fleet Defender-class cruiser Vesper in Sector G-38. In 9 ABY, two individuals claiming to be Jedi boarded the cruiser, intending to see a prisoner being held onboard.

Myn Weaver was a human male who operated on the planet Corellia as a Regional Supervisor for the New Republic. He was secretly an Imperial loyalist who worked for the industrialist and witch Morgan Elsbeth and her forces.
Johgeshakka, or Jo for short, was a female Wookiee that lived on Kashyyyk during the High Republic Era. She was the grandchild of Whitaggikk.

Callahan was a human pilot who served as a lieutenant in the Starfighter Corps of the New Republic after the fall of the Galactic Empire. She was part of an E-wing starfighter squadron stationed on the planet Lothal, where she flew alongside Captain Porter.
A New Republic comm officer served on a Defender-class cruiser. The officer notified Captain Hayle about an approaching ship that was carrying "Jedi." He was killed during the attack on the Vesper.
By 22 BBY, a Revwien merchant sold a Zephyr-G swoop to the moisture farmer Owen Lars during an auction in the remote town of Mos Nytram on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine.

Velya Faer was a male Evereni born by around 397 BBY, who lived during the High Republic Era. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, Velya and his twin sister Vika stopped at a space dock orbiting the gas giant Siquay to refuel their ship and were tracked down by the Evereni p…

A female servant worked for the Outer Rim planet E'ronoh's monarchy by 382 BBY. She also a member of terrorist group Children of E'ronoh who attacked the village U'ronoh, took the villagers as a hostage, and captured Xiri A'lbaran and Phan-tu Zenn.
During the Imperial Era, a Dressellian offered a microflora effusion of polysatyrs to the Queen of Ktath'atn, to which the servant Varroa remarked the queen would consider the Dressellian's offering.

Teviy was a human female criminal who lived during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, she was present at Zoulshaus, a nightclub on the planet Galator III where she met the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra.

Zopp was a pirate who operated as part of a pirate group during the Imperial Era. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the group broke into an old Tagge Corporation warehouse on the planet Milvayne and stole a prototype battle droid.

A Gotal worked at a hotel on the planet Galator III. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the Gotal went to inform the rogue archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra that her reservation for a room she had stayed the night in was up and that if she wanted to stay for longer she would need t…

Fori Nagor was a female Twi'lek who was born by around 407 BBY. Around 381 BBY, she visited a public house in the oldest settlement on the planet Dantooine. There, she noticed the Evereni pirate leader Marda Ro and became startled when she recognized Ro's species.
A First Order officer alerted Kylo Ren that Rey was not located in Hangar 718.
Garganchie was a male Gargantua transported by SF-R3 to the Sil Gohtta's Nature Preserve during the High Republic Era. It was Jedi Initiate Lys Solay who named Garganchie.
Morgest was a being who dealt in Force artifacts and, prior to 22 BBY, regularly met with Jedi Master Sember Vey to trade them.

In 7 BBY, Salman Paak attended a Separatist meeting on the planet Jondora where he met a woman who told him that if he was serious about politics, he could act as a liaison when he returned to his homeworld. He was sent a fractal radio unit and was paid to keep the radio alive.
A Dhani woman lived on Aldhani while Gorn was stationed on the planet. Gorn fell in love with this woman, who he eventually "lost".
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana's Pre-Mor Security Inspection team in 5 BBY.
A human officer lived during the Imperial Era and worked for Preox-Morlana as an Astro-Traffic Control Officer.
A human female was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.
A human female was a member of Alpha, which was a group of children on the planet Kenari.
