Eurus was a Force-sensitive human witch who served as ensign for the Brendok coven on the planet Brendok during the High Republic Era.

Two individuals lived during the High Republic Era. Around 247 BBY, they were members of the Elders of the Path—a religious group that believed against use of the Force—and had a Force-sensitive Mikkian daughter named Zeen Mrala.
The empress, according to legend, over saw an expansionist movement of the Anselmi which led to the first settlement of the land of Glee Anselm.
The queen, according to legend, ruled over the Nautolan people during the an expansionist movement of the Anselmi people which led to the first settlement of the land of Glee Anselm.
The mother of the Anselmi empress who, according to legend, oversaw an expansionist movement of the Anselmi, which led to the first settlement of the land of Glee Anselm.
The mother of the Nautolan queen who, according to legend, warned the Anselmi empress that their expansionary ways would anger the ocean spirit.

The mother of a boy named Jherl on Cerosha. She feared that The Dark Wraith would punish her disobedient son but despite her efforts to convince her son to behave the Wraith did eventually target her son.
The merchant who sold sweets from a store on the planet Cerosha. One morning the merchant found that The Dark Wraith had broken into the store the previous evening and killed the boy Jherl.

Marionette was a girl who lived on the planet Cerosha. She was raised as the center of attention by her mother and father but when she was sent to an academy she could not adapt and believed she was above the rules. She was eventually taken away one night by The Dark Wraith.
A female individual was the mother of Marionette, a girl who was eventually taken away by The Dark Wraith after repeatedly misbehaving at her academy.
A male individual was the father of Marionette, a girl who was eventually taken away by The Dark Wraith after repeatedly misbehaving at her academy.

The princess was the fictional ruler of a vast empire in Wild Space. The story of the princess was created by Darth Siberus in order to periodically lure treasure hunters to her carbonite tomb in order to drain their life force and grant her a measure of immortality.

Esstrop was a Kessurian member of the Path of the Open Hand cult who ventured out into the Galactic Frontier to spread their religion's teachings. As a result, they were not present on the Path's home planet, Dalna, when a battle in 382 BBY culminated in the cult's end.

Kortanio was a Kessurian member of the Path of the Open Hand cult who ventured into the Galactic Frontier in service to the Path and was not present when the cult met its violent end on its home planet Dalna in 382 BBY.
A Force-sensitive green-skinned humanoid man was a refugee during the High Republic Era. At some point no earlier than 379 BBY, he was present in a refugee camp that was attacked by raiders.
A Twi'lek crewmember of Solar Array 22-X in the Hetzal system was injured when debris struck the solar collection station during the Great Hyperspace Disaster in 232 BBY.

Samwa was a scavenger. At some point after 1 BBY, a human scavenger mentioned Samwa and his exceptional scavenging skill while pointing out a kyber brick to an individual in Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine.

Brreot Roht was a member of the Rebel Alliance operating under the rank of major who, after the Battle of Endor, was tasked by Princess Leia Organa to rescue the Abednedo Rogue Squadron captain Junhya Havoc.

Junhya Havoc was an Abednedo captain of Rogue Squadron during the Battle of Endor whose A-wing was shot down during the battle. Princess Leia Organa later tasked the Ewok Wicket, the protocol droid C-3PO and Brreot Roht on a mission to rescue him.
Sundu Huxia was an Imperial lieutenant and pilot whose ship crashed during the Battle of Endor, and was later saved by the Ewok Wicket and the Rebel operative Major Brreot Roht.
Yash Helgan was a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order by 33 BBY.

Xaran Raal was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order. As an initiate, Raal was trained in meditation by Jedi Master Depa Billaba. Once Raal was knighted, Billaba sent him to investigate pirate activity in the Slice, particularly the Riftwalkers gang.
Kylah Lohmata, nicknamed Stowaway, was a human female member of the Riftwalkers gang, led by the pirate Zilastra.
Zilastra, also known as Zil, was a Nautolan female pirate who led the Riftwalkers gang.

Vail Tormin was a human bounty hunter who was active during the Galactic Civil War. She was hired by the Zerek Besh criminal syndicate leader Sliro Barsha to kill the criminal Kay Vess. She was one of the best bounty hunters in the Outer Rim Territories.

Sulaco was an Imperial lieutenant and spy for the Rebel Alliance from Sarjenn 3. She served on board Sith Lord Darth Vader's personal flagship, the Executor. However Vader discovered her secret and forced her to become an Imperial double agent.

Reezingrom Abbayav, better known as Reez and Grom, was a Troig who hosted the holofeed program Remember Kwenn. Reez and Grom agreed on absolutely nothing together, which made them both loved and hated equally among their viewers.
Tokchi was an Ithorian engineer in the Riftwalkers pirate gang. He served as the technical expert for Zilastra, the leader of the Riftwalkers.
Ventner was a Rodian member of the Riftwalkers pirate gang. He gathered information and kept tabs on the other gangs of the Slice for Zilastra, the leader of the Riftwalkers.
A Trandoshan served as a Ney Madiine's bouncer at the Rusty Rancor in 382 BBY. They were at the establishment when Jedi Knight Gella Nattai fought champion Dario Melek in the fighting ring.
Gruekk was a male Ewok who collaborated with with brother, Graak, and the Dulok king Gorneesh in order to seize control of Bright Tree Village. They managed to kidnap Chief Chirpa.
Inisa was a Falleen female who worked for the Poisoned Blades pirate gang. While on the planet Kwenn, she met the Jedi Master Eeth Koth at a hotel on Kinnawah Key.
Graak was a male Ewok who entered a plot alongside his brother, Gruekk, and the Dulok King, Gorneesh, to seize control of Bright Tree Village.
Toola was a stargazer from the planet Maldroth. From Maldroth she witnessed flashes the flashes of light in the night sky caused destruction of Jedha City, Scarif, Alderaan and the Death Star.
Rasma was a stargazer from the planet Maldroth.

Barroth was an elder shaman on the planet Maldroth. Following his people witnessing the deconstruction of Alderaan in the night sky, Barroth put himself in a trance and could sense the cries the millions on Alderaan.

Blaask was a Trandoshan bouncer who worked at a nightclub on Vorah Key on the planet Kwenn. In 33 BBY, the Trandoshan was at his post while the Jedi Master Yarael Poof stood near the nightclub to wait for Master Ki-Adi-Mundi to exit a nearby pub during the Jedi Council's missi…
A Trandoshan was associated with a nightclub on Vorah Key, one of the Gem Cities of the planet Kwenn, during the Republic Era. She was familiar with the nightclub's bouncer, fellow Trandoshan Blaask.
A Besalisk harbormaster worked in a docking hangar in the main port city of the planet Kennerla during the High Republic Era.
Jodak was a Yinchorri pilot in the Riftwalkers pirate gang. He piloted the Randomizer, the flagship of the Riftwalkers' leader, Zilastra.

Burlug, nicknamed Luggy, was a Feeorin male who was the second-in-command to Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers pirate gang. The Feeorin had once led the Riftwalkers, but recognized Zilastra's skill and let her take over.

Bazallo was a Trandoshan who was a member of the pirate gang known as the Vile. After the previous leader, Bobo, was killed by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra, Bazallo claimed leadership of the gang, although his rule was contested by Nanna Frouj, who had claimed a chunk of the Vile.

A Hylobon guard worked as a Hylobon Enforcer for the Crimson Dawn criminal organization during the Imperial Era. While on the First Light yacht around 13 BBY, he caught the enslaved girl Qi'ra on a turbolift as she attempted to escape the vessel.
A warden served the Galactic Empire and commanded the observation tower in the entrance of the Imperial labor camp on the planet Erebus during or after 18 BBY.
Ho-Jon was a Ho'Din chiropractor-homeopath that resided on the planet Pendalanor.

Zenny Greylark, nicknamed "Starshine" and "Zen-Zen," was a human female who lived during the High Republic Era. She was a member of the Greylark family as the daughter of Senator Rina Greylark and Republic Defense Coalition member Trystian Greylark.
Churo, or Churo the Hutt, was a Hutt scientist who lived during the High Republic Era. He lived in Bilbousa City on the planet Nal Hutta alongside his family, the Devirsivik Clan.
Meela was a female Rodian who lived on Prandril. She and her wife, Boona governed the colony on Prandril.
Boona was a female Rodian who lived on Prandril. She and her wife, Meela, governed the colony on Prandril.
Smelly was a tauntaun owned by clone trooper 1139. 1139 found the tauntaun on the planet Hoth and brought it aboard a Neimoidian shuttle that 1139's squad had stolen from Viceroy Nute Gunray.
Zervo was a Force-sensitive Naldi Freewielder capable of manipulating fire who lived during the High Republic Era.

Nool was an Abyssin who served under General Abediah Viess of the Nihil Ministry of Protection on Daedus. He had a single eye and his right arm was missing below the elbow. He had primitive electro-tattoos on his left arm.
Theeka was a Weequay orphaned during the Battle of Jedha, and was later adopted by Moona and Erta.
Lof was a Klatooinian orphaned during the Battle of Jedha, and was later adopted by Moona and Erta.
Mikilanie was an Em'liy resident of Jedha during the High Republic Era who sold sacred icons in a stall in the Wayfarer Quarter, like generations of his family before him.
A Force-sensitive girl of the Yacombe, a group once aligned with the dark side of the Force, was present on the planet Kindosorn during the High Republic Era.
Kwang Buga was a Hutt residing on the asteroid M612 in the Hoth asteroid field. He was a cousin of Jabba the Hutt.
The Lobber, also known as Lobber, was the self-given title of a Devaronian male criminal who lived during the Republic Era.
Ghor was a Houk male criminal who operated in the Slice during the Republic Era. He worked alongside The Lobber and Wungo as part of the Idiot Three.
Wungo was a Klatooinian male criminal who lived during the Republic Era. He operated in the Slice alongside The Lobber and Ghor.
Leerah was a human female who lived on the planet Tharben with her husband, Vale, and their two children, a daughter and son, during the Republic Era.

Tal was a member of the Riftwalkers pirate gang during the Republic Era. Under the gang's leader, Zilastra, Tal and fellow Riftwalker Krins boarded the captured freighter Morleen after it had been transported to the Riftwalker Compound on the planet Keldooine.

Krins was a member of the Riftwalkers, a pirate gang led by Zilastra, during the Republic Era. After the Riftwalkers captured the freighter Morleen and brought it to the Riftwalker Compound on the planet Keldooine, Krins and fellow pirate Tal boarded it to negotiate with its o…
Toln Yurak was an individual who served within the Galactic Empire's Imperial Army with the military rank of colonel.
Krynthia was a Loth-cat owned by the bounty hunter Vukorah around 3 ABY after she had left the Unbroken Clan criminal syndicate.
At least two individuals were the parents of the human girl Azita Cruuz. At some point they died on Cruuz's homeworld Haruun Kal during the crossing, leaving the girl oprhaned.

A female Jedi of the Jedi Order lived centuries before 33 BBY. Although she was cut off from any hope of assistance while working in a remote region, the Jedi continued to fight, understanding the role of death in the natural order.
Gorak Palas was an underboss of the Pyke Syndicate and ran their operations on the moon Toshara in 3 ABY.
Ashiga was a queen of the Ashiga Clan who lived in the time of the Imperial Era. She ruled the Ashiga for generations and was admired for resisting the Galactic Empire on Kijimi.

Hadaro was a Twi'lek male who lived on the planet Kwenn during the Republic Era. He was a school student on Essafa Key, although like many of his fellow children, did not care to attend classes as a result of the funding cuts from the companies that subsidized the school.
Pop Teeno was an Iktotchi individual who ran a canteen on the fifth floor of the Republic Defense Coalition mobile launch and repair station.
Fraxa was a Muun who was the owner of Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn. She owned an antique ARC-8 starfighter from the High Republic Era that she attempted to restore.
Dargen Boorho was an individual who was a chef on Starlight Beacon during 231 BBY.

An individual who served in the Hutt Cartel was an informer for the Dowutin Nihil Tempest Runner Pan Eyta during the High Republic Era. By 252 BBY, the informer advised Eyta that a shipment of glitterstim spice was being transported on the Roon way hyperspace route.
Carus was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. According to legend, Carus ignored the warnings of his friends and family to explore the Great Ungeness Trench.
Carus's father was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. Their child, Carus died after awaking a squid-like creature at the bottom of the Great Ungeness Trench.
Carus's mother was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. She child, Carus died after awaking a squid-like creature at the bottom of the Great Ungeness Trench.
Surack was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. According to legend he accompanied his friend Carus to the edge of the Great Ungeness Trench during Carus's first attempts to explore the trench.
Athbrin was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala. According to legend she accompanied her friend Carus to the edge of the Great Ungeness Trench during Carus's first attempts to explore the trench.
Athbrin's father was a Mon Calamari from the planet Mon Cala who served as a soldier.

Noparo Yar was a male Togruta who lived on Miekos with his wife, Fee-Na during the High Republic Era. Her mother Tanabi Yar eventually left her family and became a pirate, but when her wife died, she came back to be a grandmother to her son's and his wife's child.
Fee-Na was a female Nautolan who lived on Miekos with her husband, Noparo Yar during the High Republic Era. She was secretly a member of the Confederation of Haulers.

Kirri was a female individual who lived on Miekos with her wife Tanabi Yar and her son Noparo Yar during the High Republic Era. Tanabi left her family and became a pirate, but when Kirri died, she came back to be a grandmother to her son's and his wife Fee-Na's child.
A Togruta was the cousin of Tanabi Yar and the ruler of Shili after Yar abdicated in favor of her cousin during the High Republic Era.

Teeler was a Togruta who worked as a driver for Kwikhaul Livery Corporation on the planet Kwenn. Along with the rest of Kwikhaul's employees, Teeler lost his job when the company's owner, Fraxa, replaced all the drivers with droids due to being unable to afford paying organic …

Werner Klop was a male Human and a high ranked member of the Confederation of Haulers. He tried to stop Tanabi Yar to fix the communication tower on the planet Miekos and ruined the business of the guild.
An Ithorian male was an assassin who hired by Werner Klop. He and his female partner tried to assassinate Tanabi Yar and her family, but when Vernestra Rwoh helped them, he ran away.

A human female was an assassin who was hired by Werner Klop. In 229 BBY, she received a mission to eliminate Tanabi Yar. On her first attempt to assassinate Yar, her hand was amputated by Vernestra Rwoh using a lightsaber.
Nellis was a helm operator who served under Captain Pell Baylo aboard the CR56 corvette Assurance.
Orl Miscord was a male Skyholme Lucite who masqueraded as a beast tamer with the caravan of exotic beasts owned by Sala Vindako on the planet Weik.
This individual was a pirate in Kragan Gorr's pirate gang.

Hadden Shrag was a Nosaurian male who lived on the planet Kwenn with his wife, Pogee. He owned the Lamplighter Boutique on Kinnawah Key, collecting numerous texts, although rarely sold any of the items, resulting in the boutique becoming full of items.

Pogee Shrag was a Nosaurian female who resided on the planet Kwenn with her husband, Hadden. After Hadden, owner of the Lamplighter Boutique, was injured when some of his materials fell onto him and left to rehabilitate on one of Kwenn's moons, Shrag remained at their home wit…

Venom Vee was a Twi'lek female who was the leader of the Poisoned Blades pirate gang. Along with the leaders of the other three pirate gangs of the Slice, Venom Vee was killed by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra.

The Eviscerator was an Iotran who led the Staved Skulls pirate gang. Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers gang, killed the Eviscerator, along with the leaders of the other pirate organizations in the Slice, in order to gain power for herself.
Darwoh was a human who led the Filthy Credits pirate gang. He was killed, along with the other pirate leaders in the Slice, by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra.

Bobo was a Sanyassan who led the pirate gang known as the Vile. Shortly after ascending to become the leader of the Vile, Bobo became aware of a deal between the Vile and the other gangs in the region.

Jupas was an individual who led the Vile pirate gang. He was replaced by the Sanyassan Bobo, who claimed that Jupas was no longer in charge when the Riftwalkers leader Zilastra questioned what had happened to the former leader.
Tensu Run was a human male Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order who survived Order 66. During the Imperial Era, he trained under the Jedi Elan Rast, who convinced him to try and rebuild the Jedi Order.

Spinran was a Halisite who worked on the docks in Jedha City and whose job it was to scrap the hulls of visiting ships. He had a large bone crest on the top of his head that changed color from red to blue depending on his mood.
JP-054 was a human stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire.

affiliation: Yubnib Zekk and the Main Characters
x: Yubnib Zekk was a musician in the band Yubnib Zekk and the Main Characters.
Sevran Tarkin was a human female who was an important member of the Tarkin family during the High Republic Era.

J'Rea was a Whiphid criminal who assisted Jonram Dremel in the attempt to capture the Dianoga Omi on the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station. She was imprisoned on the first Death Star during its construction over Geonosis.

Geratt was a human criminal who assisted Jonram Dremel in the attempt to capture the Dianoga Omi on the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station. Geratt ran a crew alongside the Espirion Saan, but was imprisoned on the first Death Star during its construction.

Kricad was a Mohsenian criminal who was forced to assist Jonram Dremel in an attempt to capture the Dianoga Omi on the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station. Kricad was imprisoned on the first Death Star during its construction over Geonosis.

Jonram Dremel was a Thradian who served as a pest controller for the Galactic Empire. Between 14 BBY and 9 BBY, Dremel boarded the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station in the Geonosis system to hunt the Dianoga Omi.
Barkle was a human commander who served onboard the DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station.
Lyal Lunn was a Sullustan male who worked at the Gala Key Arena on the planet Kwenn. In order to pay for medical care for his father, Erwen, Lunn resorted to selling illegal drugs for the Vile.

Varralis was a Yarkora female who lived on the planet Kwenn with her husband, Aptorr, with whom she had five children. She was also business partners with her husband, who owned Aptorr Industries; however, Varralis felt neglected due to seeing little of Aptorr.

Sami, also known as SP-39, was a young female Pantoran who was kept as a prisoner inside the vault of Tantiss Base along with Eva and Jax, two other children who had a high M-count. Worn down by her time in captivity, she was quiet and cautious.
Half-Roud was an Eirami male who was a fisherman on the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. He lived on Pastor's Shore and found a talisman on the water, which was owned by Burryaga Agaburry.
Gorta was an Eirami male who was a clerk on the planet Eiram during the High Republic Era. He lived on the city Barraza and tried to help to Padawan Bell Zettifar finding Burryaga Agaburry.
Sula was an Altiri individual who resided on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era and had multiple children, including the Force-sensitive Lene Kostana, their oldest daughter.
The monster hunter Ty Yorrick was hired to hunt a Greta during the High Republic Era.

Hoi was an Enami male who lived on planet Ena. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. Sometime around 229 BBY he with his sister Kian stole some food from the Hutt camp to distribute among the survivors.
Kian was an Enami Female who lived on planet Ena. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt.

Ikaya was an Enami and the cousin of Hoi and Kian who lived on planet Ena. Ikaya was once seen a Jedi Vector. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. Ikaya was killed during that time.

An Enami male was the father of Hoi and Kian who lived on planet Ena. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. He was shot by Gamorrean guards.

Darkiss was an Enami female elder who lived on planet Ena. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. She is one of the survivors.
Mira was an Enami female mother who lived on planet Ena. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. She is one of the survivors.

Tregarra was a Hutt warlord who subjugated the planet Ena after the destruction of Starlight Beacon. He plundered and killed many Enami but Jedi Master Keeve Trennis arrived on the planet with Republic forces to aid in the liberation of the Enami.
Willa was an Enami male elder who lived on planet Ena. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, the Enami were subjugated by the Hutt Cartel led by Tregarra the Hutt. He is one of the survivors.
Gatt was a human lieutenant who served as a pilot for the Galactic Empire. She was stationed on the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station during its construction above the forest moon Endor.

Monne was a human commander who served as a pilot for the Galactic Empire, serving on the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station during its construction over the forest moon Endor. On Life Day one year, Monne took two of his TIE pilots on a standard sweep of the system.

Rode was a human who served as a pilot for the Galactic Empire. At one point, he learned the legend of the Wild Squadron from an old Rendellian on Bray. Between 0 ABY and 4 ABY, on Life Day, Rode told his friend Gatt about the Wild Squadron ahead of a patrol of the Endor system.
A Rendellian told the Imperial pilot Rode about the story of the Wild Squadron while on the planet Bray.
Holmes was a human who held the rank of lieutenant in the army of the Galactic Empire and was placed in charge of Docking Bay 5-02 on board Imperial Station 003 above the planet Coruscant.

Ullan Yite was a male individual who led the Bright Circle criminal organization during the High Republic Era. By around 377 BBY, Yite planned to sell a stash of smuggled weapons to a pirate group in the floating city Penumbra.
Anna Param was a human technician who served on board the second Death Star in 4 ABY during its construction over the forest moon Endor.
Tril Jindrax was a human technician who served as a Lieutenant Commander for the Imperial Engineering Corps aboard the second Death Star in 4 ABY.
Takk was a human technician who served on board the second Death Star in 4 ABY during its construction over the forest moon Endor.
A Sith acolyte served on board the second Death Star in 4 ABY, transporting relics from Emperor Palpatine's private collection off of his shuttle.

Aklin was an individual who served the Galactic Empire. He had knowledge that a powerful ring, which had the power to raise the dead and turn them into worker drones, was contained in Emperor Palpatine's private collection and was being transported onto the DS-2 Death Star II …

Novitz was a human who served as a lieutenant in the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy. During or after 18 BBY, the lieutenant commanded a science vessel docked at Imperial Station 003 that was scheduled to travel to the secret Tantiss Base on the planet Wayland.
Aptorr was a Yarkora male who owned Aptorr Industries on the planet Kwenn. He lived with his wife, Varralis, who was also his business partner.
Gartabba was a Wookiee who the Yarkora Aptorr, owner of Aptorr Industries on the planet Kwenn, trained to operate his plant on Brazatta Key.

An individual was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. When the Nihil Cloud Sarn Starbreaker undertook a raid on the Outer Rim astronomical object Mandrine between 232 BBY and 231 BBY, the Jedi cut Starbreaker with their lightsaber, leaving the Cloud with a s…

A Jedi Knight was knighted during the Clone Wars. After assisting Jedi Masters Mace Windu and Obi-Wan Kenobi as well as Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker and his Padawan Ahsoka Tano with various missions, the Jedi Knight accompanied Grand Master Yoda to the planet Torren and its Te…
Quith Meglar was a Halisite member of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era, working in the Ministry of Protection under General Abediah Viess as a communications officer.
Tippet was a Ewok who was a member of the Bright Tree tribe. After the chief of Bright Tree Village, Chirpa, disappeared, Tippet insisted that Grakk should become the new chief of the village.

A Force-sensitive Jedi of the Jedi Order was the Jedi Master of eventual Jedi Master Indeera Stokes. At one point, they reprimanded their Padawan for using the words "it's not fair." While fighting the Nihil pirates on the Outer Rim planet Valo in 231 BBY, the same words flash…
A male individual was the father of the human girl Kylah Lohmata, who was born to him and his spouse, Lohmata's mother, on a world in Hutt Space.
A female individual was the mother of the human girl Kylah Lohmata and the spouse of Lohmata's father.
Morna was a Woostroid female holofeed engineer that worked for Reezingrom Abbayav, the Troig host of the Remember Kwenn program on the planet Kwenn.

Gabban was the senator of the planet Kwenn in the Galactic Republic. He was known as "Gabban the Gabbler" by Reezingrom Abbayav, the Troig host of the Remember Kwenn holofeed, both halves of whom disliked him.
Linn was a Twi'lek female who claimed leadership over the Filthy Credits pirate gang after the death of the former Chief Executive, Darwoh, orchestrated by Riftwalkers leader Zilastra.
Kooroo-coo was a teal oroko who was the proctor—the leader of his school—in the oceans of the planet Kwenn. The oroko was familiar with the Jedi Master Oppo Rancisis.

A naturalist was associated with a university on the planet Kwenn. When the oroko Kooroo-coo became beached, the Jedi Masters Oppo Rancisis, Saesee Tiin, and Plo Koon attempted to rescue him, summoning the naturalist for assistance.

A veteran makeup artist worked for the local repertory group on the planet Kwenn. Although the repertory group eventually disbanded due to hard times, the Jedi Master Yarael Poof, who had helped fund the group's amphitheater and was familiar with the artist, recruited her assi…
A local boss of the Staved Skulls pirate gang operated on the planet Kwenn out of Gutson's Pub on Vorah Key.

A human male member of the Staved Skulls pirate gang operated on the planet Kwenn, working under a local boss. On Brazatta Key, the human collected payments from merchants when he was approached by the Jedi Masters Yarael Poof and Ki-Adi-Mundi.
A huge feline Cathar was a member of the Staved Skulls pirate gang had a completely hairless head and studs screwed into his skull.

Senar Cappo was a male who was the leader of the village Charbana on the planet Mikkia. He sent a distress signal to the Jedi, requesting their help with the evacuation of Charbana during a massive groundquake, which threatened to destroy their village.
Gria Cappo was a Mikkian Female who was the daughter of Senar Cappo, the leader of the village Charbana on the planet Mikkia. After her father died on earthquake, she was the leader of the village.
At one point, an individual was a prominent Sith Lord. Centuries after his death, the Ankok cult worshiped him and the dark side of the Force while based in a city.
Renzoh Silliac was a Chevin who was a member of the Blood Oath Syndicate. He ran a salvage yard on the planet Hallitron-7.

An Anselmi criminal was active on the planet Coruscant on Level 1313. After interrogating an information broker on the whereabouts of the Hope of Glee Anselm, the Anselmi was attacked and killed by the bounty hunter Jango Fett.

A Trandoshan criminal was active on the planet Coruscant on Level 1313. While making his way to an information broker's office, the bounty hunter Jango Fett was approached by a group of Trandoshans who attempted to steal the armor from Fett.

A human information broker was situated out of an office on Level 1313 of the planet Coruscant. They helped the Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett locate a starship that snuck off of Jaloria following the heist of the Hope of Glee Anselm.

The father of the Nihil Tempest Runner Kassav Milliko was a male individual. During the Eriadu system Emergence, the governor of the planet Eriadu, Mural Veen, called the Weequay Milliko a bastard after the marauder threatened to have a fragment of the Legacy Run crash into Er…

The mother of the Nihil Tempest Runner Kassav Milliko was a female individual. During the Eriadu system Emergence, the governor of the planet Eriadu, Mural Veen, called the Weequay Milliko a bastard after the marauder threatened to have a fragment of the Legacy Run crash into …
Bing was a Pantoran male who lived on the planet Coruscant. He was once a friend of Alees June. One night he met with Alees and her friends in pub and wanted to give him what she owed.

Gaya was a female human vendor who lived on Pabu. During the Bad Batch's stay, she was very friendly towards Batcher. When the Empire occupied the island, Batcher defended Gaya as TK stormtroopers tried to evict them and others from their home.
Lakshay was a human member of the Jedi Order who was apprentice to lightsaber virtuoso Vo'ren Faalo before becoming a Jedi Master during the High Republic Era.
A Sith stormtrooper commander was the grandparent of Kako, a human female who hated the dark side of the Force and killed Tata, the leader of the dark side cult Ankok.
A Jedi of the Jedi Order served as a librarian in the Jedi Archives on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the High Republic Era.

Burner was a clone trooper who served in the Galactic Empire's Coruscant Guard after Operation: Knightfall. He was one of at least nine clones ordered to redecorate the Jedi Temple after Operation: Knightfall.
Topshot, designated CT-1010, was a clone trooper who served alongside Commander Cody in the 212th Attack Battalion during the Clone Wars.

Scatter was a clone trooper who served in the Galactic Empire's Coruscant Guard after Operation: Knightfall. Scatter was stationed with Burner to patrol the Jedi Temple while it was being redecorated.
Vasik Aldritch was one of three leaders of the Final Occultation during the Republic Era, alongside Heldi Cerebron and another individual.
Measel Junco was a famed cyborg long-hauler, and was a columnist for the Independent Traders' Infonet.
Bali Rayden was a journalist who wrote for the publication Starship and Pilot.
Vik was a clone of the bounty hunter Jango Fett who, after serving in the Clone Wars, was imprisoned in the Galactic Empire's Tantiss Base.

Sniper CloneX3 was a Clone X trooper who was active during or after 18 BBY. Sniper CloneX3, along with Sniper CloneX4, Sniper CloneX5, and another Clone X trooper, was activated by Dr. Hemlock to capture Clone Force 99 who had infiltrated Tantiss Base.

Sniper CloneX4 was a Clone X trooper who was active during or after 18 BBY. Sniper CloneX4, along with Sniper CloneX3, Sniper CloneX5, and another Clone X trooper, was activated by Dr. Hemlock to capture Clone Force 99 who had infiltrated Tantiss Base.

Sniper CloneX5 was a Clone X trooper who was active during or after 18 BBY. Sniper CloneX5, along with Sniper CloneX3, Sniper CloneX4, and another Clone X trooper, was activated by Dr. Hemlock to capture Clone Force 99 who had infiltrated Tantiss Base.
A Tusken Raider lived on Tatooine during the Republic Era. The Tusken was purchased from the Hutts by a group of enslavers, who intended to place a transmitter chip in him.
Junya was the commander of a Star Destroyer for the Galactic Empire.

Selena was a Force-sensitive female member of the Nightsisters during the Clone Wars and the mother of Morgan Elsbeth. She died during the Battle of Dathomir, killed by General Grievous during a duel.

A human Jedi survived the destruction of the Jedi Order and the rise of the Galactic Empire. They went into hiding on an unnamed planet, working alongside a local rebel cell. The Fourth Sister and Barriss Offee, Imperial Inquisitors, were dispatched to eliminate the Jedi.

Nadura was an alien ambassador and senator in the New Republic following the defeat of the Galactic Empire. Formerly a resident of her homeworld, the planet Corvus, Nadura left after Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth forced the people of Calodan to labor in factories.

A clone shock trooper was a member of the Coruscant Guard during the end of the Clone Wars and the early days of the Galactic Empire. The clone trooper was stationed at the Republic Center for Military Operations and, along with another trooper, guarded Barriss Offee's cell.
Tasi Lowa was a Zygerrian Jedi of the Jedi Order who lived during the High Republic Era. She was the Padawan of Jedi Knight Yord Fandar.
Ahmar was a Force-sensitive alien Jedi who survived Order 66 and was brought to the moon Nur alongside Barriss Offee and Dante where he was offered the chance to become an Inquisitor.

Isdain was a human male Moff who served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. During this time, Moff Isdain and seven other Imperial officers, including Captain Gilad Pellaeon, attended a briefing aboard an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in orbit above Coruscant tha…

In 148 BBY, Koril brought Verosha and Mae-ho back to the witches' fortress after finding them wandering the nearby forest and discussed their outing with Mother Aniseya prior to the girls' training session.

Micah was a Force-sensitive human who was hunted by the Galactic Empire. During the Imperial Era, Micah and the children of a village were tested by the Galactic Empire. When the tests revealed clues to Micah's Force sensitivity, the Empire wanted to take him away.

Krin Dagbard was a Jedi from Batuu, who was led to Coruscant by the the Force, where they trained to be a Jedi during the High Republic Era. He lived through the Great Hyperspace Disaster, and the rampage of the Nihil.

A Clone X trooper was active at Tantiss Base around the year 18 BBY. The Clone X trooper, along with Sniper CloneX3, Sniper CloneX4, and Sniper CloneX5, was activated by Dr. Hemlock to capture Clone Force 99 who had infiltrated Tantiss Base.

Nali was a human female member of the Mountain Clan. Like the rest of the Mountain Clan, she lived in the safety of the Mountain Clan village. She was killed by a blast from an HMP droid gunship while gathering weapons with Morgan Elsbeth.

Beezar Pert was a Gungan bandleader of the Great Municipal Band alongside Augara Jowil. In 32 BBY, after the Battle of Naboo, Beezar and Augara led the Great Municipal Band through the streets of Naboo's capital, Theed, playing songs including the "Symponik Nabooalla."

Leesagum was a human Jedi Master who served on the Jedi Council at some point by 1032 BBY. While in a meeting, the Jedi Council was approached by Ara, a Dolgarak citizen who could use the planet's rainfall to read prophetic images on the world's rocks.

Reggi was a human in the New Republic following the defeat of the Galactic Empire. Serving as a New Republic Security Guard, Reggi accompanied Nadura, a New Republic ambassador, to the planet Corvus in the hope of seeing the planet join the Senate.

A Mohsenian attendant served the former Jedi Barriss Offee during the Imperial Era. The Mohsenian, Micah, Micah's father, Micah's mother, and another attendant escaped a world in Barriss Offee's starship.

A Patitite lived on Patitite Pattuna when the two droids C-3PO and R2-D2 crash landed on the planet. After their leader Hay-Zu was accidentally killed by the droids, this individual was one of three Patitites who were brought forward to select a new leader.

A Patitite female lived on Patitite Pattuna when the two droids C-3PO and R2-D2 crash landed on the planet. After their leader Hay-Zu was accidentally killed by the droids, this female was one of three Patitites who were brought forward to select a new leader.

A Patitite lived on Patitite Pattuna when the two droids C-3PO and R2-D2 crash landed on the planet. After their leader Hay-Zu was accidentally killed by the droids, this individual was one of three Patitites who were brought forward to select a new leader.
Sig Greebling was a Force-sensitive human nerf herder and Bobarian Afol's Padawan. He lived on the planet Fennesa with his older brother Dev, telling tales of the Jedi's heroics.
Yesi Scala was a human who was an associate of Sig Greebling, a nerf herder who unearthed the artifact known as The Cornerstone of the Galaxy.

A human male was the father of the Force-sensitive child Micah. During the Imperial Era, they and Micah's mother brought Micah to the Mirialan Barriss Offee who then instructed the two to take their child to a friend of hers.
A humanoid attendant served a healer known as the Wise Mother during the Imperial Era. The healer was really the former Jedi, Barriss Offee.

A human male individual was the governor of a settlement on an unnamed planet. Around 19 BBY, the Inquisitors Fourth Sister and Barriss Offee visited the world in search of a Jedi connected to a local rebel cell.

A human female was the mother of the Force-sensitive child Micah. During the Imperial Era, they and Micah's father brought Micah to the Mirialan Barriss Offee, known only as "the healer" who then instructed the two to take their child to an old friend of hers to escape the Gal…
Sendlak was the Twi'lek Jedi Master of Ashla.
Abrish was a Muun male who worked for a small enslavement empire on the planet of Oon during the Age of the Empire.

Dai Danu was a Sullustan freighter technician in service with the SoroSuub Corporation. After discovering a plot to frame him to have him terminated, Danu committed murder and fled aboard a hijacked cargo vessel. Danu then became a professional shipjacker.

Malia Shariv was the captain of the Gundark's Back. When her ship was stolen by Dai Danu, she attempted to get it back. However, she attacked the wrong transport, as it had the cloned transponder code of the Gundark's Back.
A Force-sensitive human female served as Matron of the Mountain Clan, a clan of Dathomiri witches operating in the mountains of the planet Dathomir, during the Clone Wars.
Moru was a Britarro Jedi Master. At some point by 1032 BBY, Moru served on a warship during a war between the Force-sensitive Jedi of the Jedi Order and the dark side Force-users of the Sith.

Two individuals were the parents of the human Elping Tsoo. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Tsoo joined the Republic Defense Coalition, abandoning his frail and elderly parents on Coruscant.
A human girl lived in a settlement on an unnamed planet during the Imperial Era when the Inquisitors Barriss Offee and the Fourth Sister arrived, searching for a Jedi rumored to be hiding there.
Hila Eder was a manager of a SoroSuub Corporation facility. She framed Dai Danu of exhibiting negligence over a safety recall for hyperdrive motivators.

Poc was a Mon Calamari Nihil marauder stationed on the Outer Rim planet Valo during its occupation by the Nihil. In 229 BBY, he patrolled the streets of Lonisa City to enforce the Nihil's curfew and stopped to question the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem.
A human girl lived during the High Republic Era. At one point by 382 BBY, she was present in the market of the town Ferdan on the Outer Rim planet Dalna with her father.
Fogo Charu was a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order. He was the author of a work titled The Wisdom of Master Fogo Charu, Jedi, which was entirely dedicated to fishing.
Vale was a human male who lived during the Republic Era. He had a wife, Leerah, and two children, a daughter and a son.

Erwen Lunn was a Sullustan male and the father of Gala Key Arena worker Lyal Lunn. The Lunn family had lived on Kwenn at least since Erwen's great-grandparents were children, when they had watched the Grand Renewal of Kwenn.
Ak-rev's clan mother was a female Weequay who led a clan of Weequays that lived on Tatooine as servants of Jabba the Hutt.
Annin Gora was a minor bureaucrat who was affiliated with Dai Danu. Gora knew the location of Danu's base in the Caltrop Belt.
An Imperial commander served in the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era on an Imperial outpost somewhere in the galaxy.
Rintero was a crime lord who served as the boss of the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate by sometime between 17 BBY and around 13 BBY, preceding Dryden Vos during the early Imperial Era.
Levier was a male Sephi who lived on the planet Isobe during the Imperial Era.

"Bloodbath" was a member of the Staved Skulls pirate gang who, along with another member "Menace Machine," jostled for leadership of the gang after the death of its preceding leader, the self-proclaimed Eviscerator. His appearance was similar to that of his predecessor.

A Knight of Ren traveled to a Jedi temple to retrieve an ancient Jedi artifact. The Knight of Ren was later killed by the temple's defenses. At some point, Qi'ra came across the knight's corpse while visiting the temple.
Ackzat was a Mon Calamari chef who cooked for the rebels.
Bravara was a human captain who served the Rebel Alliance against the Galactic Empire.
Grrraaalf was a Wookiee who took care of farm animals for the Rebel Alliance.
Myrna Rondo was a human scavenger who helped the Rebel Alliance.
Kaalim Puhn was a Bith musician who played the kloo horn.
Mrs. Incredible was a human female who joined Marge Simpson for a Mother's Day trip to Disney Playground Planet.
In 28 ABY, a Centrist senator attended a minor gathering of individuals that were known to be enthusiastic collectors of items linked to the fallen Galactic Empire.
Mak Krissido was a human pilot who served the Rebel Alliance.
Su Sifta was a human pilot who served the Rebel Alliance.

Tam was a man who lived with his daughter Taya in a farming village in a valley. During the Clone Wars, the valley was attacked by Separatist forces with no explanation. Tam and Taya, along with the other villagers, fled to the head of the valley, towards the winding pass.

Taya was a girl who lived with her father Tam in a farming village in a valley. During the Clone Wars, the valley was attacked by Separatist forces with no explanation. Taya and Tam, along with the other villagers, fled to the head of the valley, towards the winding pass.
Stewie was a human youngling who once attended a party held by Marge Simpson celebrating Mother's Day.
Jago was an Ortolan Nihil marauder in the crew of Melis Shryke. By his time in Shryke's crew, Jago was old and scarred, missing one eye and most of the right side of his face.
A human Male lived on Dolgarak and acted as Interpreter to an order that operated on underneath two statues attuned to The Force, representing the struggle between the light and dark side.

A male individual lived during the High Republic Era and was the father of a human girl. At one point by 382 BBY, the father and daughter were in the market of the town Ferdan on the Outer Rim planet Dalna where the girl was given a flower by Marda Ro—an Evereni female Path of…
An individual was the older brother of Mosey Cimmaron. The pair once encountered a Tibidee, they planned on leaving the beast alone before it grabbed the brother and took flight.

In 14 BBY, an individual served as a specialist on the Imperial escort carrier Goliath. He informed Moff Wilhuff Tarkin of the deployment of Commander Abel LaSal, who had been impersonated by the rebel Berch Teller.
Bob Iger was a Human who possessed a reserved parking zone for their starship on the Disney Parking Planet. However, Mickey took down their sign and parked their own car there.

A blurrg was the mount and companion for the Twi'lek freedom fighter Cham Syndulla during the Clone Wars and into the Imperial Era. It fought alongside Syndulla during the Battle of Ryloth in 21 BBY and also during missions on the planet Ryloth against the Galactic Empire.
An individual performed as a fire juggler at Rambler's Reach Outpost sometime prior to 9 BBY. People paid to watch her performances. She ultimately burned down half of the outpost's food silo.

Kurt V was a Humanoid male and leader of the Mécateks. He resembled a pile of recycled carcasses grafted haphazardly around the silhouette of a man. He had experimental brain implants, which drove him mad.
Fan'Goriah was a Twi'lek pirate and one of the leaders of the Princes of Hell.
A male individual was the grandfather of the Abednedo Path of the Open Hand member Whool and his brother Grael, and the father of their mother.

An individual was the parent of the Abednedo Path of the Open Hand member Whool and his brother, Grael. After Grael showed signs of being Force-sensitive, Whool's parent and Whool's mother feared that the Jedi would take him, and helped him learn to supress his powers.

A Force-sensitive human was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. At one point by 384 BBY, they were present in the Jedi Temple on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant during the Pantoran youngling Kevmo Zink's first day at the Temple.

A Swokes Swokes shopkeeper their shop was visited in a city on an asteroid. Whilst working in their shop, they sold various items to Ara in preparation for her mission to destroy the dark head of the Statues of prophecy.

A human Jedi who served the Jedi Order during a war waged between the Jedi Order and their ideological antithesis, the Sith tradition of Force-users, at some point by 1032 BBY. This Jedi acted as traning partner to Toul at one point after the death of his master.

Ayo Tam was a short alien individual who could be found on Tatooine at some point during 9 BBY. He and an Aki-Aki were seen walking and talking near the Mos Eisley spaceport when exiled Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi made his way towards an outbound passenger transport in an attem…

Gorg Singo was an alien individual who could be found on Tatooine at some point during 9 BBY. Singo was seen departing from a passenger transport parked at the Mos Eisley spaceport, passing by the exiled Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi who intended to board the same shuttle on a mi…

"The Ambassador" was a Rodian ambassador from a planet, and helped provide resources for the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Padmé Amidala undertook a mission to meet with the Ambassador, where they were attacked by B1-series battle droids.

An individual was a member of a cell of Crimson Dawn based at a Crimson Dawn Regional Outpost in the Outer Rim Territories. At one point, they and another member of the cell were contracted by the Savvy Clan to take out a number of targets, which they did.
An individual was a member of a cell of Crimson Dawn based at a Crimson Dawn Regional Outpost in the Outer Rim Territories.
A human patrol trooper of the Galactic Empire acted as a checkpoint officer on Level 2046 of the planet Coruscant's underworld in 9 BBY.
Torcraig was an individual who lived on the planet Brazadann as leader of the Salamander Warriors.
Klop Nol was a Skrilling who acted as the speaker of a settlement and hired the monster hunter Ty Yorrick to fight off the Nihil.

A female individual was the wife of the human Scarabi mercenary Hachi. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, after Hachi led a group of Scarabi that kidnapped Rebel Alliance leader Mon Mothma, she spoke with Mothma while holding her in a Scarabi safe house and asked her why she had decided…

Tobin was a Human male who owned a pulp enterprise in Calda on Thorum. He was late in paying his protection money to Crimson Dawn so he was visited by Qi'ra, Eleera, Myem and Qorsha who took all of his credits to pay his monthly fee.
An individual served as bureau chief of a law enforcement agency that operated in the city Efavan on the Outer Rim planet Vorzyd V during the High Republic Era.
FN0143 was an individual who wore a standard-issue stormtrooper armor.
Tohan Lege, known as the Lore-weaver, was a Miraluka historian who lived in Black Spire Outpost on the planet Batuu long before the First Order-Resistance War.

Cam Lindon was a human male who served as a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He used a vocoder after being involved in a hovercar accident on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant and lost the ability to speak naturally.

A human served the Galactic Empire as a Stormtrooper Commander during the Imperial Era. At some point during the Empire's reign, the commander led a garrison of Imperial stormtroopers on a mission to a planet in hopes of finding kyber crystals.
Sassandra was a female Twi'lek mercenary who worked for Jabba the Hutt.
Glix was a human female Nihil marauder who served as the gunner of the Cacophony, the Stormship of the Storm Melis Shryke, during the High Republic Era.
A Jedi Order seeker operated during the Republic Era and brought Dooku from Serenno to Coruscant.
During the existence of the Galactic Republic, an Urodel boy accompanied a group of Republic prison escapees who were hiding on the planet Roxuli.
Snord was a Gamorrean Nihil pirate who served on the Star Hopper alongside "The Warden".

An Azumel child lived in the Osler community on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era. Because of their Force-senstivity, the child was captured by the Nihil before being rescued by the monster hunter Ty Yorrick.
A Duros child lived on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era. Because of their Force-senstivity, the child was captured by the Nihil before being rescued by the monster hunter Ty Yorrick.

A four-armed alien pirate served the Nihil as a member of a Cloud during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the Cloud abducted several Force-sensitive children on the planet Temerancé, with the Tholothian monster hunter Ty Yorrick being hired to rescue the children.
Tara was a Mon Calamari Nihil pirate that was active during the High Republic Era. At some point, Tara, alongside Karnos, planned to kidnap Chancellor Lina Soh's son, Kitrep Soh, on the planet Abtin.

Karnos was a Nihil pirate that was active during the High Republic Era. At some point, Karnos, alongside Tara, planned to kidnap Chancellor Lina Soh's son, Kitrep Soh, on the planet Abtin. Tara later imagined making Tempest Runners alongside Karnos for the kidnapping.
A Frigosian served as an informant for the Mon Calamari Tara in the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era.
During the Republic Era, an Iktotchi criminal was active on the planet Roxuli. After confronting the bounty hunter Jango Fett, the Iktotchi was gunned down by the Mandalorian.
An Urodel criminal was active on the planet Roxuli during the Republic Era. After encountering the bounty hunter Jango Fett, the Urodel was gunned down by the Mandalorian.

A Mirialan female child lived during the High Republic Era. In 230 BBY, she was one of several children kidnapped by Tempest Runner Kara Xoo's Tempest of the Nihil pirates as would-be recruits, alongside the Kage Krylind and the humans Liam and Avon Starros.
Henry "Typex" O'Reilly was a young bureaucrat and corporal of the Rebel Alliance. He was stationed at Echo Base. He had a wife named Gwen and a son named Henry Junior.
Kent Stars was a captain of the Rebel Alliance. He was a supervisor who was responsible for supplying Echo Base and its outposts.
Henry Strips was a colonel of the Rebel Alliance stationed at Echo Base. He was head of the Fourth Bureau, a military police force of the Army Defense and Investigation Service.

An Aqualish was present at a street market on the planet Caraad sometime during the Imperial Era. After witnessing the Force-sensitive Tarlafar Bayrn use the Force while at a market, the Aqualish hired the Duros bounty hunter Cad Bane to capture the youngling.
Selch was a Falleen Nihil marauder and a follower of General Abediah Viess who was known for her brutality.

Zohra was a female native of Devalok. During the Siege of Devalok, she and her younger brother, Dumuz, spent five days hiding from the Separatist Droid Army in their family's apartment after her parents went to search for supplies at the Enki greenhouse.

A Toydarian was a Nihil and part of Kara Xoo's Tempest. In 230 BBY, Avon Starros and other children who were kidnapped by Kara Xoo and brought them to the planet Dalna. The Toydarian was one of the guards who looked after the kids.

A Quarren was a Nihil and part of Kara Xoo's Tempest. In 230 BBY, Avon Starros and other children who were kidnapped by Kara Xoo and brought them to the planet Dalna. The Quarren was one of the guards who looked after the kids.

A human woman was a resident of the city Saludad on the planet Dalna. In 230 BBY, the Nihil made a big earthquake of Dalna. While Vernestra Rwoh tried to find the President Sachary Jeffington, the woman told her she was a Nihil member.
A female individual was the mother of the Ortolan musician Maximilian Rebo and the partner of Jeph Rebo.

An Mizi female was part of Crimson Dawn. She travelled to Thorum after Qi'ra found out a local criminal organization had detailed maps of the Karthakk sector and was making moves into Crimson Dawn space.

Arryssslesh was an Elia-An medicine artist who lived on Oanne during the High Republic Era. Although a translator droid could not translate her name, it was similar to the Shyriiwook word for "chiming bells." When the Jedi Knights Burryaga Agaburry and Bell Zettifar embarked o…
Verosha "Osha" Aniseya, nicknamed Oshie by her sister, was a Force-sensitive human female Sith acolyte during the High Republic Era.
Blex was a Neimoidian member of the Trade Federation who served as captain of the WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer Fallon.
Fillik was a human who was born on the planet Kwenn around 158 BBY and spent much of his childhood around Kwenn Space Station.

Queya was the Neimoidian Chief Officer of the Trade Federation WD-2250 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer Fallon during the High Republic Era. An ambitious officer, she served under Captain Blex and helped to clean up his missteps while awaiting transfer to another vessel.

Cabuck was a Drezar from Drez who was born around 166 BBY. He served as owner, manager, and bartender of the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop in Point Ueda on the world Ueda during the High Republic Era but resisted customizing it due to a superstitious belief that it was haunted by Lomi…
Tor Bez'lin was a Shorwilt security expert who was arrested in the Corporate Sector during the High Republic Era and imprisoned on board the DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship Palwick.
Cord Taunus was a human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order who administered the Jedi temple on the planet Olega during the High Republic Era.

A Gamorrean male served as a guard that worked at Jabba's palace. After the Khetanna was destroyed and Jabba was killed, he was one of the few survivors that found Bib Fortuna in the desert and revived hím.

Od Keder was a Jedi Padawan of the Jedi Order who was stationed at the Jedi temple on the planet Olega during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, the assassin Mae-ho Aniseya broke in to the temple in a failed attempt to kill Jedi Master Torbin.
Melo Tolicus was a human miner who lived during the High Republic Era. After suffering space psychosis, he killed several fellow miners and was taken prisoner.
Syreth Dunn was a human slicer. In 132 BBY, Dunn and his crew were detained by the Detention Task Force in the Corporate Sector and were being transported on the prison transport Palwick.

Rott Mercer was a cybernetic alien convict who was present on the Palwick, a prison transport, during the High Republic Era. During an escape attempt, the convict managed to disable the pilot droids who controlled the ship.
Kella Antro was a human salt trader from a coastal town. She supported her aging parents by delivering seasoning minerals to the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop on the world Ueda.
Deesh Crozli was a black-skinned alien who left her homeworld and ended up on the planet Ueda, where she kept her ear to the ground for information to trade.
Chit-Chit, also know as Chif-Chaf, was a krinnan male from Kindosorn who was adopted by Terec.
Dennet Clyde was the leader of the Hammers, a criminal organization on Thorum. He was killed by a bomb set by Crimson Dawn after it was determined his syndicate was intruding on Crimson Dawn space.
Meevid was a human scavenger who lived during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, Meevid hiked through a forest on the Outer Rim planet Khofar along with the scavenger Manju.

Manju was a human scavenger who lived during the High Republic Era. In 132 BBY, Manju hiked through a forest on the Outer Rim planet Khofar with the scavenger Meevid. When they came across a crashed starship, Manju hoped to find a hyperdrive to strip for parts within it.
Mister X was a mysterious individual who ran a smuggling network in Echo Base. He always acted through droid intermediaries.

Andrew Thomas "Dirty" Cohnely was a human male. Cohnely used to work for the Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations where his impeccable service allowed him to rapidly rise through the ranks, even earning him an Imperial Medal of Honor.

A salmaca creature lived in a cave on the world Batuu. Around 379 BBY, the salmaca began raiding homes in Peka, a nearby village. The raids continued for several weeks, and during one raid, the salmaca killed the villager Tuntis, who had tried to fight back.

A female individual was the grandmother of the Serennian Lady Jenza of House Serenno, who was the daughter of Count Gora and Countess Anya of the planet Serenno and sister of Ramil. Jenza owned a crystal that had previously belonged to her grandmother.

A human male was an agent for the New Republic's intelligence branch. In 4 ABY, he was sent to the planet Vernid after intelligence personnel working for agent Caern Adan found a lead on the former Imperial Major Soran Keize.
A human female was an agent for the New Republic's intelligence branch. In 4 ABY, she went to the planet Vernid after a lead was found on the former Imperial Major Soran Keize.
During the High Republic Era, a Neimoidian was ppresent on the space station Starlight Beacon. While there, he helped the Soikan Velko Jahen hang numerous tapestries and banners around the station.
Aila Gris was an individual who served as Adjutant Captain during the High Republic Era. During the assault on Qunatos during the Soikan conflict, Gris was killed by a blaster bolt.
A humanoid male Mandalorian was a member of a Mandalorian covert that existed in the galaxy in 9 ABY.

Errin was an old male individual who worked for Jabba's criminal empire. Prior to joining Jabba's forces, Errin workeed for the Hutt Cartel. He was saved Sion from the Black Sun, and gave him a job in Jabba's palace.
Arfit was a male individual who worked for Jabba's criminal empire. He was one of the guard in Jabba's Palace during 4 ABY.
Nackt was a male individual who worked for Jabba's criminal empire. He was one of the guard in Jabba's Palace during 4 ABY.
A village chief served as chief of Meevai Village on the Outer Rim planet of Keelia. He had a granddaughter, Haru, who was set to marry a man named Asu.

Quint Cresadde was a Weequay gunslinger who lived during the Imperial Era. A former pirate member of the Ohnaka Gang and Gwarm's gang who later worked for the Hutt Clan, she eventually turned away from her lifestyle to become the sheriff of Wayfar on the planet Tatooine.
Aviay was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. After the Guardian Protocols were implemented in 229 BBY, he partnered with the Cathar Jedi Knight Far Linghe.

Far Linghe was a non-binary Cathar Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. According to Jedi Master Avar Kriss, they were well-liked, and Kriss knew them by a reputation which centered on strong piloting and dedication.

A human male was a member of the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, the man served aboard the Gaze Electric—flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro—when the Gaze traveled to the fifth moon of the Outer Rim planet Norisyn so Ro could investig…

Bas Ear'lasr was a Nihil pirate who served on the Gaze Electric, the flagship of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro during the High Republic Era. They fed a three-legged tooka within a hangar on the Gaze which eventually came to Ro's attention.

A female prosthetics specialist lived during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, she visited the San Tekka manor's library on the planet Coruscant with the physicist Xylan Graf carrying a display of cybernetic hands, including ones made of sleek black metal and polished rainchr…

Isrie Fallau was a Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, a team of Jedi led by Jedi Master Avar Kriss helped to liberate the Mid Rim planet Naboo from the Nihil pirates.
Limal Pakt was a Dyplotid metalsmith who operated a shop in the Federal District on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. She had four narrow golden eyes.
Ba'luun was a Thisspiasian individual who served as a captain in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. In 228 BBY, she commanded the Star Cruiser Axiom.

x: An individual was the commanding officer of a starship of the Imperial Navy during the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. They were allegedly involved in an argument over starfighter tactics during a meeting prior to the battle.

A human civilian lived in a settlement on the Outer Rim planet Banchii. In 231 BBY, they fell off a ladder and were saved by the Jedi archivist Ru-Ru. Ru-Ru then asked if they were alright, and they responded that they were.
TK-429 was a Stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire. During the Galactic Civil War, they were sent to the planet Bracca to find the protocol droid C-3PO, who was in posession of stolen Imperial data.
Reyna Oskure was an Anzati female mystic who was a high-ranking member of the dark side cult known as the Acolytes of the Beyond.

During the Imperial Era, an Ishi Tib criminal operated on the planet Lothal out of Monad Outpost. In 5 BBY, the Ishi Tib was found by the Imperial, Lieutenant Jenkes, and was unjustly shot by the lieutenant after a short confrontation.
An Imperial captain commanded the Arquitens-class light cruiser Peacemaker at the planet Arieli.
A Mon Calamari served in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Princess Leia Organa visited displaced children living on the Alliance Fleet.

Fern was a human female youngling who lived in the galaxy in the early New Republic Era. Fern lived together with her mother Fara on At Attin, where Fara was a teacher and part of the government, and was best friends with another child called KB.
An Imperial officer visited the planet Axxila sometime during the Imperial Era when Firmus Piett was twelve years old. The officer helped Piett after he fell down from a hill.
Jod Na Nawood was a Force-sensitive human male pirate who operated under many aliases such as Crimson Jack, Dash Zentin, Professor Umiam Gorelox, Emissary, Jodwick Zank, or the "Mad" Captain Silvo.

KB was a female human youngling who lived on At Attin with her parents Garree and Maree in the early years of the New Republic Era and was best friends with another child named Fern. Around 9 ABY, another child, Wim, found an old starship buried in the woods outside their city.

Wim was a male human youngling who lived on the isolated planet of At Attin in the New Republic Era together with his father, Wendle. He attended At Attin Middle School Gamma alongside his best friend, Neel.

Neel was a male Myykian youngling who lived on the isolated planet of At Attin and was best friends with another child named Wim during the early New Republic Era. Around 9 ABY, Wim found an old starship buried in the woods outside their city.

Mica was a human male who served as an assistant to Chancellor Lina Soh during the High Republic Era. After Keven Tarr found a loophole that existed in the Stormwall, Mica rushed to Soh to inform her of the breakthrough.
A human female served as a Nihil pirate during the High Republic Era. While on the planet Hetzal Prime, the pirate choked her comrade to death so she may own a ship.
A human male served as a Nihil pirate during the High Republic Era. While on the planet Hetzal Prime, the pirate was choked to death by his comrade so that she may own a ship.
An individual served as the planetary governor of the planet Dinwa Prime for the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.
A lieutenant governor of the Galactic Empire was involved in the destruction of cities on the planet Ivera X.
A human male was a high-ranking officer in the Galactic Empire. He took a liking to the taste of the rare watervine peach, known for its sweet but slightly salty taste.

A Nautolan individual was a member of the pathfinders in the Alliance to Restore the Republic Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the pathfinders, led by Kes Dameron, were deployed to Uveron City after rebel leader, Mon Mothma was kidnapped by the Scarabi mercenary group.
Garn Drel was a Sugi high-stakes gambler. After learning his rival, a Pau'an named Neon Prok, was trying to rig the Duo Relay Race, Drel hired help to investigate and prevent Prok's interference.

Benin was a human who was an administrator. They were in charge of security at Uveron City and was responsible for providing security for rebel leader Mon Mothma, during a funding mission, between 3 ABY and 4 ABY.
Dascha was a human male who served as a Nihil during the High Republic Era. Dascha, alongside the Pantoran female Niquita, were stationed on a ship inside the Occlusion Zone in the year 229 BBY.
Niquita was a Pantoran female who served as a Nihil during the High Republic Era. Niquita, alongside the human male Dascha, were stationed on a ship inside the Occlusion Zone in the year 229 BBY.

Hoss was a Sullustan male mercenary, gunslinger, and violent criminal who was active during the Imperial Era. Seen as an outlaw legend, he was known for his wild gambling, collection of weapons, and risk-taking.

Ruen Nam was a Sullustan smuggler who worked with the Crimson Dawn syndicate. In 3 ABY, Nam was acting as a merchant from a stall within the Crimson Dawn District of the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara.
Preeban was a male Weequay technician who operated in the Worker's District in Canto Bight.
Bok Anbrin was an Utai jockey who rode a dactillion and participated in the Duo Relay Race.
Mok Anbrin was an Utai jockey who rode a varactyl and participated in the Duo Relay Race.

A human individual was a mercenary for the Scarabi mercenary group. Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, the mercenary took part in the kidnapping of Alliance to Restore the Republic leader, Mon Mothma at Uveron City.

A howler was ridden by Shin Hati during the quest to find Ezra Bridger on the extragalactic planet of Peridea. After Thrawn instructed Hati and her master Baylan Skoll to follow Sabine Wren at their own pace, they set out in pursuit of her on their own howlers.
A Force-sensitive human was a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Shortly before the Great Jedi Rumble Race in 230 BBY, they were present on the Starlight Beacon space station.

Barabo was a Jedi Master who lived during or before the High Republic Era. When Jedi Initiates Lys Solay, Kai Brightstar, and Nubs discovered a wall sculpture depicting the Jedi Solay noticed that they had been a Pooba, just like Nubs.

At least two individuals were the parents of the human female Ellian Zahra. While Zahra was still young, her parents were killed, along with the rest of her family, in a rebel terrorist attack long before around 1 BBY.
Bosnok was a Gallusian with a knack for numbers. He spent the greater part of his life drifting though the galaxy doing quick jobs with fast payment.
Thorden was a human governor of the moon Toshara, serving the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.
A commanding officer was an individual who stationed on the planet Endor. He was killed by a Fungus.

An Imperial commander was an individual who stationed on the planet Endor. He became aware in- and outcoming ships near the bunker of the Shield generator of Death Star II., the commander dispatched a team of stormtroopers, including TK-830, to gather information
A Verpine was a technician who was a member of the Rebel Alliance and stationed on its flagship Home One ín 4 ABY.
A male individual was the brother of the rebel pilot Karie Neth. She often sent him messages before attackes.

Yarzion Vell was a Force-sensitive alien who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Vell became the Padawan of Jedi Master Lulad, and a few months into his training, they traveled to Vell's homeworld on a mission.
An individual was the flight coordinator and a member of the Rebel Alliance and stationed on its flagship Home One in 4 ABY.
A female individual was a technician who was a member of the Rebel Alliance and stationed on its flagship Home One ín 4 ABY.
Darth Devastator, born Dev Greebling and nicknamed Darth Dev, was a Force-sensitive human male individual who was the older brother of the nerf herder Sig Greebling.

Fara was a human female individual who lived in the galaxy during the New Republic Era together with her daughter Fern on the planet At Attin. Fara was a teacher at a school on the planet and part of the government as an undersecretary.

Blick was a Quarren who served as a Nihil pirate during the High Republic Era. After the Nihil Stormship, the Cacophony, was taken over by Jedi Masters Avar Kriss and Porter Engle, and the captain of the ship, Melis Shryke, called for assistance, the Foregone Catastrophe, pilo…

Catherio Para was a male shopkeeper who ran the Olega Apothecary, which provided for the local Jedi temple. In 132 BBY, the apothecary was taken over by "Qimir," who took the shopkeeper's coat. Qimir claimed that Para's absence was due to visiting family.
