A female Nautolan was the mother of Kamose and the neighbor of Dexter Jettster in Coruscant during

A male man was a resident of Coruscant. His family was killed by the Galactic Empire when they destroyed Jedha. In 4 ABY he was a member of a crowd who tried to kill a young stormtrooper. He changed his mind thanks to Dexter Jettster and Vekin Menez.
A young male human was a stormtrooper who stationed on Coruscant. In 4 ABY, he was captured by a crowd who tried to kill him. He was saved by Dexter Jettster and Vekin Menez.

Vekin Menez was a young female resident of Coruscant. In 4 ABY she helped a young stormtrooper when an angry crowd tried to kill him. Later, while hiding in Dex's Diner, she met Dexter Jettster, who showed her the way to the smuggler’s route through Coruscant.

A Bivall individual became an experiment of Baron Boolan of the Nihil marauders. When Boolan escaped from Shingcu Station, he had the Child of the Storm H'Tar bring his test subjects with them on his stormcruiser Dalnan Dawn.

Zimtok was a Force-sensitive creature who lived on the moon Astenban during the High Republic Era. When the Nihil pirates' Occlusion Zone swallowed up Astenban, she befriended the Banchiian Shosho, who had traveled to the moon with Jedi Master Sav Malagán and the droid ZZ-10 t…

Shosho was a Banchiian leader who lived on the planet Banchii during the High Republic Era. In order to protect his home from the Nihil pirates, Shosho accompanined Jedi Master Sav Malagán and the droid ZZ-10 on a mission to the moon Astenban to deny them a base from which the…

Pi'tar was an individual who was friends with the cantankerous prospectors Gido and Gulu, long-time residents of Rambler's Reach Outpost on the planet Koboh. By 9 BBY, Pi'tar left the Outpost because he got a job off-world, however, he died soon after when his shuttle crashed.

Jaws-of-Death, also known as Jaws, was a Trandoshan enforcer in the crew of Dahara Devirsivik Norri, a Hutt of the Devirsivik Clan. She was one of several enforcers who accompanied Dahara and her brother, Churo, on a mission to meet with the Nihil marauders.
Dahara Devirsivik Norri was a Hutt female of the Devirsivik Clan. The sister of Churo, she led a crew during the High Republic Era.
Ric Ket was a Rodian enforcer and a member of Dahara the Hutt's crew. He had lost an eye fighting the Nihil marauders.
Filly was a human female enforcer in the crew of Dahara the Hutt. She hailed from Rorak, an astronomical object in Hutt Space.
Tronk was a Pau'an member of the crew of Dahara the Hutt. She served as the captain of the Viperi-class cargo shuttle Sarlacc's Scorn.
Sul-Nath-Rune was a Cerean Jedi Knight of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He had advanced to the rank of Knight as a result of the Guardian Protocols.
An individual using the callsign "Scythe 6" flew a TIE/ln fighter during the Battle of Endor.
"Scimitar 3" was the callsign of an individual who piloted a TIE bomber during the Battle of Endor.
An individual piloted a TIE Interceptor under the callsign "Sapphire 2" during the Battle of Endor.
Daynaal was a Trandoshan male who lived during the High Republic Era. He was the nephew of the pirate Sellaccc Orryak, leader of the Ganguls.

Rudi was a Wookiee male who lived during the High Republic Era. He was the brother of Johgeshakka. On Life Day, he was the pilot of a shuttle carrying food for the feast, but his starship was shot down by the pirate Sellaccc Orryak and the Ganguls, who intended to ruin the Woo…
Tragkul Tarkin was a human male member of the Tarkin family during the High Republic Era and was the uncle of Sevran Tarkin.

A human individual worked as a doctor during the Imperial Era. While in the Outer Rim, the doctor was forced by Imperial Governor Tauntaza to use her fortress on a planet which housed numerous Rebel Alliance soldiers.

A human individual served as a general for the Rebel Alliance during the Imperial Era. After listening to a doctor explain the destructive power of a fortress previously owned by the Imperial Tauntaza, the general then ordered their soldiers to eliminate the doctor and their a…
A Snivvian approached the smuggler Han Solo, requesting help with delivering a shipment of Hutt holoporn to the Kurluvion system.

Fym was a Mikkian who traveled to the moon Bracront alongside other Mikkians during the High Republic Era. While there, Fym conversed with the Mikkian Devo about infiltrating the fortress of the Nihil pirates warlord Tartak Vil.
During the High Republic Era, an eye-patched Mikkian traveled to the moon Bracront alongside other Mikkians to infiltrate the fortress of the Nihil pirates warlord Tartak Vil.
During the High Republic Era, a red-skinned Mikkian traveled to the moon Bracront alongside other Mikkians to infiltrate the fortress of the Nihil pirates warlord Tartak Vil.
During the High Republic Era, a pink-skinned Mikkian traveled to the moon Bracront alongside other Mikkians to infiltrate the fortress of the Nihil pirates warlord Tartak Vil.

A Pau'an served as a guard to the Nihil pirate warlord Tartak Vil on the moon Bracront. After Vil managed to scare off some raiders when visiting the fortress of the Pau'ans, the group pledged their loyalty to the Nihil and gave Vil their fortress.
Brendrak was an individual who served as an assassin in Commander Krix Kamerat's cell for the Nihil marauder organization during the High Republic Era.
Bledloe Seven was a Gotal member of the Nihil during the High Republic Era among the Nihil presence on the Core Worlds planet Corellia.
At least two individuals were the parents of the Force-sensitive human male Asu, who lived in Meevai Village on the planet Keelia. At some point, both individuals died.

A Nautolan served the Nihil as a pirate during the High Republic Era. While in the Nihil main base on Hetzal Prime, a planet situated in the Occlusion Zone, the Nautolan attempted to kill the daughter of Ghirra Starros, Avon, after pretending to be unconscious, but was quickly…

A female human was the mother of the Force-sensitive human Haru and her sister Saku. After the mother's death, shortly before Haru's wedding between 19 BBY and 1 BBY, she expressed her wish that her parents could have been there to witness it and recalled a time when she and h…

Staas Ragnabi was a Jedi Master who explored the Outer Rim Territories. He fought the droid pirate Blackbolt with Kaliah Kublop. In 232 BBY, Jedi Younglings Kai Brightstar and Djovi Resmia found a recording of Kublop and Staas.

During the High Republic Era, a Nihil worked as a chef on the space station Lightning Crash. While situated in the Occlusion Zone, the human Xylan Graf sweet-talked with the chef in preparing a vegetarian cuisine for him.

A male individual was the father of the Force-sensitive human Haru and her sister Saku, who were both the grandchildren of the chief of Meevai Village on the planet Keelia. At some point, Haru and Saku's father and mother both died.
A human served as a commander in the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire.

In 228 BBY, Sevran mentioned her father when she attempted to recognize the Zygerrian Jedi Knight Farzala Tarabal to address the Outer Rim planet Eriadu's ruling council—the Quintad—in the Seswenna Hall in Eriadu City.

When Sevran tried to endorse the Zygerrian Jedi Knight Farzala Tarabal to speak to the Quintad—the ruling council of the Outer Rim planet Eriadu—within Seswenna Hall in Eriadu City in 228 BBY, Sevran mentioned her mother.
Navaj Tarkin was a human male who lived during the High Republic Era and was the twin brother of Sevran Tarkin. The two were the children of Lord Famol Tarkin and Grand Dame Veermol Tarkin.

Val Delvardus was a human Eriaduan who lived during the High Republic Era. After Eriadu was swallowed up by the Nihil Occlusion Zone, Delvardus was present in the Seswenna Hall when the Quintad met and invited the Nihil representative, "The Warden," to speak to the council.

A human was an elder member of the Diagu, a group of humans located on Targyon. Between 12 BBY and 9 BBY, The Grand Inquisitor and the Galactic Empire visited the Diagu after receiving intelligence that the Jedi Knight, Tensu Run was building a refuge on Targyon.
Nanna Frouj was a Chagrian female who was leader of the Vile pirates.

This officer was an Imperial naval officer who served as an instructor. They taught new shipmasters how to command a capital ship and engage in naval warfare, and came into conflict with Admiral Gial Ackbar, who was instructing Rebel officerss how to do the same thing for the …
Meedro was an Ewok warrior of the Bright Tree tribe who lived on the borders of Bright Tree Village on the moon Endor.
Onderrs was an Andraven male who was the father of Gumar Adraki. He gave his son advice and support when Adraki competed in the Andraven Ancestors Circuit.

A human was a member of the Filthy Credits pirate gang. On the planet Kwenn, the human served as the driver of a LiteVan transporting a Besalisk of the Vile and a Cathar of the Staved Skulls to attack the Gala Key Arena manager Lyal Lunn.

A Besalisk was a member of the Vile pirate gang. He took part in an attack on the Sullustan Lyal Lunn on Gala Key on the planet Kwenn, alongside a Cathar of the Staved Skulls, a human driver of the Filthy Credits, and a Twi'lek of the Poisoned Blades.

A male Twi'lek was a member of the Poisoned Blades pirate gang. He participated in an attack on the Sullustan Lyal Lunn on Gala Key on the planet Kwenn alongside a Besalisk of the Vile, a Cathar of the Staved Skulls, and a human driver of the Filthy Credits.
At least two paupers from the planet Bonadan were the parents of the Force-sensitive human Torbin, who was born around 173 BBY.

A man worked as a blaster salesman at the outpost Port Haileap on the Outer Rim planet Haileap during the High Republic Era. They were known to the Mirialan Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh and, according to her, had been cited for defrauding individuals several times.
Bulcha, also referred to as Bulcha the Hutt, was a Hutt gangster who operated within Tenoo's sector during the High Republic Era. He was known as one of the most feared criminals of the sector.
Two individuals lived during the High Republic Era. Around 412 BBY, they became the parents of a Force-sensitive human girl named Gella Nattai.
Ergaugh was a Tholothian technician who served the Nihil on the space station Lightning Crash which was situated in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era.

Moothie was a Nihil who served on the space station Lightning Crash in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era. Before the human Xylan Graf left the Occlusion Zone for a few days, he had asked Moothie to watch over his Grand Theljian snow dog, Plinka, while he was gone.
Lafre Impolk was a Nihil who served on the space station Lightning Crash in the Occlusion Zone during the High Republic Era.

Bren was a human Jedi Initiate who was part of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. Brought to the planet Tenoo as one of the new younglings from the Coruscant Jedi Temple, Bren once fled off-world in hopes of returning to Coruscant, only to end up at Yarrum Tower, a p…

Latara was an Ewok who lived on the The Forest Moon of Endor. Latara lived in Bright Tree Village, along with Wicket Wystri Warrick and Princess Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka, whom Latara walked with both at one point.
A member of the Stormtrooper Corps served as a scout trooper for the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

A human member of the Galactic Empire was stationed on the forest moon of Endor during the Imperial Era. While conversing about holotexts at a table, the human Rilo Grenth approached her and asked what topic was being discussed.
The human father of the technician Rilo Grenth served as the head of Grenth Technologies which was located on the planet Hosnian Prime.

A human individual was the mother of the technician Rilo Grenth. While Grenth was away serving the Galactic Empire on the forest moon of Endor, his mother worried that Grenth would not eat enough food while stationed at the Death Star's shield generator.
An individual was the sister of the human technician Rilo Grenth. While witnessing an Imperial supposedly admire another Imperial, Grenth decided to try and make the two come together in love.
Vrell was a Trandoshan member of the Sixth Kin gang who served as a bouncer in the Sixth Kin's nightclub, Club Tarsus, within the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Calys was a member of the Rebel Alliance that died during the Battle of Scarif. Her death led her brother, the Twi'lek rebel named Asara Deyn, also joining the Rebel Alliance.

Riko Vess was a human female slicer and thief and the mother of Kay Vess. Born around 47 BBY, Vess became a famous slicer during the Clone Wars, but retired at the end of the war when she had her daughter Kay in 19 BBY.

Dennion was a human spy for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. They were conscripted by the Empire to fight against insurgents on their homeworld, initially believing they needed to conform in order to survive.

Asara Deyn was a Twi'lek who was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. While his sister, Calys, organized a rebel cell, he assisted by spying on Imperial patrols.

Waka was a Rodian mechanic and scavenger who resided on the moon Toshara during the Imperial Era. While fleeing from bandits, he encountered the scoundrel Kay Vess after she crashed on the moon in the Trailblazer.

Aila Bren was a human computer expert and slicer who lived during the Imperial Era. Bren operated on the moon Toshara during the Galactic Civil War by freelancing for the criminal syndicates on the moon, and had a reputation for her effectiveness.
Selo Rovak was a Tosharan human mechanic. Raised in the wind fishing settlement of Kadùa Village on the moon Toshara, she spent her time creating devices to streamline the process.

Ank Parako was a Chadra-Fan explosives expert and safecracker who worked for decades with her husband, Pirrip. During a job in which the pair broke into a Black Sun vault, Pirrip's heart gave out, resulting in their mission's failure.
Krisk Ashiga was a Melitto female who was the heir to the Ashiga Clan hive and crime syndicate, led by her mother, Queen Ashiga, on the planet Kijimi.

A Sullustan lived in a village on a planet. When the Sith Okinaa, another resident of the village, recovered the badly damaged astromech droid R5-D56, the Sullustan assisted with repairing him and celebrated with the other villagers when they finished.
Haze Delik was a Heliko female who was born on the planet Helikoprion. After the planet was engulfed in a civil war, Delik's family moved to Actlyon and lived in Actlyon City.

Raa-lyn Las was an Eirami female who served as a Jedi Knight within the Jedi Order. During a Nihil raid on the planet Palagosal, Las stayed back to fight the Nihil, however was greatly injured with an electrospear wound and blight growing on her.
Trystian Greylark was a member of the Greylark family and the husband of Rina Greylark along with the father of Lexi and Zenny Greylark.
Marl was a male Nikto that lived on the planet Palagosal along with his wife Darl. While living on the planet, he worked at his shop co-ran with his wife, Marl's Good Enough Eats.
Darl was a female Nikto that lived on the planet Palagosal along with her husband Marl. While living on the planet, she worked at her shop co-ran with her husband, Marl's Good Enough Eats.

Guho was a female Pantoran who served as a commander for the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. While present for a Nihil raid on the planet Palagosal, Guho sprained her ankle and retreated into a cave with four other survivors.

Welga was a female Nautolan who served as an ensign for the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. After a distress signal was sent out from the planet Palagosal in the Arkanis sector, Welga amongst others undertook a mission to rescue whoever sent out the call.

Nofis was a Quarren who led a team of duct scrubbers working in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica, considering the job to be tough, but honest. The team included a droid who sometimes got stuck during the work. Nofis was acquainted with the thief Kay Vess.
During the High Republic Era, the mother of Haze Delik lived alongside her husband on the Stingray after the three departed from their homeworld Helikoprion due to a civil war.
During the High Republic Era, the father of Haze Delik lived alongside his wife on the Stingray after the three departed from their homeworld Helikoprion due to a civil war.
Ambush was a clone trooper who served in the 41st Elite Corps under the command of Clone Commander Gree and Jedi General Yoda.
Rocket was a clone trooper who served in the 41st Elite Corps under the command of Clone Commander Gree and Jedi General Yoda.

Razafi was a Rodian gambler on the moon Toshara during 3 ABY. They frequently played Kessel Sabacc with the humans Daqu and Tanhi in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. Razafi had green skin and black eyes.
Interceptor was a female fathier who was born around 0 ABY. She took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Space Case was a male fathier who competed in fathier racing in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica during the reign of the Galactic Empire. He was born around 1 ABY and had brown fur and black eyes.
Ggurtoo's Favorite was a male fathier who was born around 1 BBY. She took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Hoojib's Foot was a female fathier with brown fur and black eyes who was born around 1 ABY. They took part in the fathier racing season in 3 ABY, which included at least one race as part of the Canto Cup tournament held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Man From Naboo was a male fathier who competed in the Canto Cup fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. Born around 1 BBY, the fathier had brown fur and black eyes.
Cactus Juice was a male fathier who was a competitor in the Canto Cup, a fathier race held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. He was born around 2 ABY and had brown fur and black eyes.
Hyper Hopper was a female fathier who was born around 2 ABY. They took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Spirit of Serenno was a female fathier who competed in the Canto Cup, a fathier race held in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in 3 ABY. They were born around 1 BBY and had brown fur and black eyes.

Jumping Jammer was a female fathier with brown fur and black eyes who was born around 2 ABY. They took part in the fathier racing season in 3 ABY, which included at least one race as part of the Canto Cup tournament held in Canto Bight, the capital city of the planet Cantonica.

Double Time was a female fathier who was born around 1 BBY with brown fur and black eyes. In 3 ABY, they took part in the Canto Cup, a fathier race that was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Sabacc Shift was a male fathier who was born around 2 ABY. He had brown fur and black eyes. In 3 ABY, he competed in the Canto Cup fathier race held in the city of Canto Bight on the casino planet Cantonica.

Canto Queen was a female fathier born around 0 ABY who had brown fur and black eyes. She competed in the Canto Cup, a fathier race held on the planet Cantonica in the city Canto Bight in 3 ABY. That year, the fathier stood at 318 centimeters tall and weighed 927 kilograms.
Boonta Eve was a male fathier with brown fur and black eyes who was born around 0 ABY. They shared their name with the Boonta Eve holiday held on the planet Tatooine.
Fast Jortimer was a male fathier who was born around 2 ABY. He took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Tough Mucker was a female fathier with brown fur and black eyes. He was born around 1 BBY. The fathier competed in the Canto Cup, a fathier race held on the planet Cantonica in the city Canto Bight in 3 ABY.
Sylop Gallop was a female fathier who was born around 1 ABY. She took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
Silly Hoof was a female fathier who was born around 1 ABY. He took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Comet Dodger was a male fathier who was born around 1 ABY with brown fur and black eyes. They took part in the Canto Cup fathier race that took place in 3 ABY and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Free Trader was a male fathier with brown fur and black eyes who was born around 0 ABY. In 3 ABY, they took part in the Canto Cup, a fathier race that was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.

Ol' Green Senator was a male fathier who was a competitor in the Canto Cup, a fathier race held on the planet Cantonica in the city Canto Bight in 3 ABY. Born around 1 BBY, the fathier stood at 296 centimeters tall and weighed 982 kilograms by the time of the Canto Cup.

Mynock Spit was a male fathier who was born around 0 ABY. They had brown fur, black eyes, and were considered to be feisty. Mynock Spit competed in the Canto Cup fathier race held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica in 3 ABY.

Salvo was a female fathier born around 1 ABY who had brown fur and black eyes. He competed in the Canto Cup, a fathier race held on the planet Cantonica in the city Canto Bight in 3 ABY. That year, the fathier stood at 286 centimeters tall and weighed 902 kilograms.

Shooting Star was a male fathier who competed in the Canto Cup fathier race in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. Born around 1 BBY, he had brown fur and black eyes.

Verrick was a human enforcer and contract broker who worked for Hutt Cartel and oversaw its operations on the Outer Rim moon Toshara during 3 ABY.

Korcola was a Force-sensitive individual who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. By 228 BBY, they had taught the Jedi youngling Jamil Sollis a defense stance involving holding his hand out in a flat palm.

Pirrip was the husband of Ank Parako, a Chadra-Fan safecracker. The two worked together for twenty years. According the Imperial Security Bureau, during which they were responsible for over 590 million credits worth of damage and were never arrested or even detained.

A female member of the Greylark family lived during the High Republic Era. They were one of the aunts of the human girl Zenny Greylark, who had an older sister named Lexi. At one point, according to Zenny, it took the aunt seventeen minutes to answer a yes-or-no question.

Jinnjo Blorgh was a Pyke criminal who served under the Pyke Syndicate on the moon Toshara and, after his defection in 3 ABY, the Hutt Cartel on the planet Tatooine.

Cynra Basho was a Rutian Twi'lek merchant who operated a fabric shop in the Worker's District of the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. During the Canto Cup fathier race in the city in 3 ABY, Basho opened the store and had a vial of bacta available for purchase.

Entip was a Jawa trader who resided on the planet Tatooine and traveled in a sandcrawler. In 3 ABY the Jawa exchanged a power injector system and a BT-P7 ion accelerator with the thief Kay Vess in return for various parts and credits.

Jet Kordo was an Ugnaught pilot who formerly owned the Trailblazer.Associated with a droid named H1-ON.

Gedeek Obaz, also known as The Toymaker, was a male Rodian droidsmith who was raised in Canto Bight's Worker's District. A former Imperial Engineer, he designed an Alpha Droid variant of the Viper Probe Droid.
Banzo was the name given by the Jedi youngling Tep Tep to a tortle that she utilized while undertaking a mission on the Arkanis sector planet Palagosal.

Franek was an individual who served as a lieutenant in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He had a husband. At one point, Franek served in a squad led by the Greylark family member Lexi Greylark.
A male individual who lived during the High Republic Era was the husband of Republic Defense Coalition Lieutenant Franek.
Gregmu'ur, known as Gregmu for short, was a Quermian who served as marshal of the town Faydra on the Outer Rim planet Mynos III during the High Republic Era.
Lorko was a Hutt of the Hutt Clan who was the cousin of the Hutt male Churo
Yorn was a Twi'lek bandit hiding on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

Jonkah Rremset was a Mon Calamari merchant who worked from a stall in Mirogana Market on the moon Toshara. They specialized in consumables but sold a variety of items. In 3 ABY, the thief Kay Vess aided Rremset when two Imperial stormtroopers tried to extort the merchant.

Tanhi was a human gambler on the moon Toshara during 3 ABY. They played Kessel Sabacc with the human Daqu and the Rodian Razafi in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. Tanhi had light skin, blue eyes and black hair.

Daqu was a human gambler who, during 3 ABY, played Kessel Sabacc with the Rodian Razafi and the human Tanhi in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara. They claimed to have played sabacc with the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, who according to Daqu played fairly.
Roba Barev was a Pyke contract broker for the criminal Pyke Syndicate, only providing work to those on good terms with the organization.
Jora Margal was a Pyke scavenger who worked as a merchant for the criminal Pyke Syndicate from a stall in the Pyke Cardroom of the Pyke District in the city of Mirogana on the moon Toshara.

Rooster Trace was a human female mercenary who was active in the years before and during the Galactic Civil War. By 3 ABY, her ship had been destroyed by the Galactic Empire, who confiscated her weapons. Her pet skettlebeast, Thumpo, died with the ship.

Nor'sha Nassko was a Weequay who worked as a contract broker for the Hutt Cartel in the city of Myrra on the planet Akiva. In 3 ABY, Nassko was in the Hutt Cartel District of the city providing contracts only to those on good terms with the Hutts.

Shuma was a Quarren merchant who has been to many star systems. By 3 ABY, the Quarren had visited 117 star systems, including visiting the Outer Rim moon of Toshara and the planet Kijimi. While traveling, they were accompanied by two astromech droids.

Tretet Zadiket was a Jawa who worked as a trader on the planet Tatooine. In 3 ABY, they exchanged a J8 terrain sensor with the thief Kay Vess, who provided ray accelerators and actuating modules in return.
Otip Ashtep was a human scavenger who sold goods as a merchant from a corner of the junkyard in Bestine, a small city on the desert planet Tatooine.

Sopa Nandor was an Ualaq Aqualish merchant who operated out of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city Mos Eisley on the Outer Rim planet Tatooine in 3 ABY. That year, their inventory included direct-energy circuits, quadanium steel, and a Tatooine gunslinger belt.

Raivan Dhavik was a human contract broker who resided on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY During which they offered contracts for various criminal syndicates to freelancers from Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in the city of Mos Eisley on Tatooine.

Nibbles was an individual that competed in fights that could be viewed from the Outer Rim planet Tatooine. By 3 ABY, Nibbles had been torn in half while fighting against another contestant named Rock-Claw.
Pinota Pakinota was a Jawa merchant who operated from a camp in the canyon Seeker's Peril in South Jundland Wastes region on the Outer Rim desert planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.
Raiva Melin was a humanoid merchant who resided on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. During which they operated a store in Ridge Terrace section of Kijimi City.
A farmer from the planet Mon Gazza visited the Mos Eisley spaceport on the planet Tatooine in 3 ABY.

Kranash was a Trandoshan contract broker with brown skin and yellow eyes who was active during the reign of the Galactic Empire. By 10 BBY, he had become well known in the criminal underworld after being involved in a job for the Black Sun crime syndicate on the planet Manaan.

Selik Mynnabah was a Zabrak merchant that operated a store called Selik's in the Thieves' Quarter of Kijimi City on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi. By 3 ABY, they had begun selling amulets secretly containing spice from Selik's to repay a load they took from the Pyke Syndicate.

Neva Yaranu was a human smuggler and merchant who resided on the planet Kijimi in 3 ABY. They ran a store in the Crimson Dawn District of Kijimi City. Yaranu had dark skin, black short hair and brown eyes.

Whaluta Skanni was a Quarren who worked as a contract broker in the town Jaunta's Hope on the moon Toshara.

Trellem Hobarchi was a human who worked as a speeder mechanic and scavenger out of a garage in the town of Jaunta's Hope on the moon Toshara. Hobarchi sold speeder parts, also using provided materials to upgrade speeders, and was capable of upgrading a S-57 Cardinal speeder bike.

Hansher was a member of the Poisoned Blades pirate gang. When Zilastra, leader of the Riftwalkers, united the Poisoned Blades with the other gangs of the region, she plotted their collective attack on the planet Kwenn.

Selli was a human child that lived on Arli's moon during the High Republic Era. After hearing the sounds of the minicruiser Brightbird, Selli hid from the individuals who piloted the cruiser.

Freery was a Bith who lived on the planet Arli during the High Republic Era while the planet was trapped within the Occlusion Zone.

Vaneer was an individual who served as an admiral in the officer corps of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy.

Badru was a gangster and member of the Sullustan Surat Nuat's gang, which operated during the Imperial Era on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva.

Phenesta Wesh was a senator in the Galactic Senate of the Galactic Republic who, after leaving the Senate, wrote a tell-all autobiography about his career titled Turmoil which he released during the reign of the Republic's successor state, the Galactic Empire, in 3 ABY.

Frel was a Human citizen of the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. During the Eternal Empire conquest Frel served in the Eternal Empire military under the command of Captain Koth Vortena and was eventually killed by an infection on Quesh.

A Ho'Din worked as a specialist and a scientist by the year 228 BBY. The Ho'Din created files in relation to the planet Oanne, which the Jedi Knight Burryaga Agaburry researched upon before traveling to the planet.

A boy born around 5 BBY organized a fundraiser for a new orbital cannon on the Outer Rim Territories planet Takobo at the age of eight in 3 ABY.
Galdrim was an Altiri who resided on the planet Temerancé during the High Republic Era and had multiple children, including the Force-sensitive Lene Kostana, their oldest daughter.

Lendha Drefty was an Iridonian Zabrak who worked as a ship mechanic. In 3 ABY, Drefty operated a business called Tosharan Ships which bought, sold and upgraded starships on Renpalli Station in the Toshaal system. They had light skin and hazel eyes.

Lalini Ledeno was a Twi'lek who worked as a smuggler and merchant on the Outer Rim moon Toshara during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, he worked with the Crimson Dawn crime syndicate and operated a black market stall in Mirogana, the capital city of Toshara.

Berek Keehro was a human tailor that worked at a clothing store called Sirei's Stall on the Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. During which they were associated with the Pyke Syndicate and was willing to pass information along to them.

Valith Nuulvys was a Mirialan mechanic who operated Valith Nuulvys's Goods and Services at Mirogana Spaceport Outer Rim moon Toshara in 3 ABY. That year, they were capable of upgrading a S-57 Cardinal speeder bike when they had access to the appropriate materials.

Gunter was a male, human cyborg who belonged to a pirate crew during the New Republic Era. Originally serving under Captain Silvo, he swore his loyalty to the new leader, Brutus, in the aftermath of a failed raid on a merchant freighter, ascending to the position of First Mate.

Chaelt was an elderly human space pirate who served under Captain Silvo and Captain Brutus during the New Republic Era.

Jadd Flaxum was a Quarren male spy who worked for the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate during the Imperial Era. He was the partner of the Crimson Dawn contract broker Dart Subterra, residing on the planet Kijimi.

Dart Subterra was a human male who worked as a contract broker for the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate on the planet Kijimi during the Imperial Era. He was the boyfriend of Jadd Flaxum, a spy who also worked for Crimson Dawn.
Procyon Wy was a Pantoran female pirate leader active during the Imperial Era. In 3 ABY, she captured the Crimson Dawn spy Jadd Flaxum, intending to ransom him to the Pyke Syndicate.
Soren Chrephontis was a Pyke contract broker for the Pyke Syndicate criminal organisation during the Imperial Era. He operated in the city of Myrra on the planet Akiva.
Karpen Miltik was a Pyke merchant who operated a stall in the city of Myrra on the Outer Rim jungle planet Akiva in 3 ABY.

Yarg'l was a Rodian who served as a Senate Intelligence Officer for the Galactic Republic. After they were captured by the Pyke Syndicate on Black Rock, a mission to the moon was conducted by the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to free him.

Scalesong was a female Trandoshan who served as a captain for the Galactic Republic. While conducting a mission alongside the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to rescue the Senate Intelligence Officer Yarg'l on one of the moons of Varl, Scalesong was consumed by Kayfou…

Torrick was a human Corellian who served as the second mate to Captain Scalesong on the Silence. While conducting a mission alongside the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker to rescue the Senate Intelligence Officer Yarg'l on one of the moons of Varl, Torrick was consumed…
EE'zok was a human member of the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate who worked as a contract broker in the city of Bestine on the planet Tatooine during the Imperial Era.

Ays Varga was a human superweapons engineer who served the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, Varga defected from the Empire, intending to join the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate through the contract broker EE'zok on the planet Tatooine.

Dim was an Aleena podracer that raced in the galaxy during the Republic Era. The Aleena podracer had a rivalry with the Blarina Barba. While racing on the Varl Circuit in 29 BBY, Dim was fatally shot by Barba which ended their feuding.

An Ugnaught worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. While racing in the Varl Circuit, the Ugnaught racer crashed after her podracer collided with another contestants vehicle, which ultimately killed both of them in the ensuing explosion.

A Gran worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. While racing in the Varl Circuit, the Gran racer crashed after a Bantha tusk decoration on his podracer fell off and went into the engine of the vehicle, causing it to explode.

A Fosh worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. After completing in one of the final places while racing in the Varl Circuit, the Fosh podracer and a Xexto were dragged away by enforcers and subsequently fed to the Kayfoundo Kapa that resided on Black Rock.

A Xexto worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. After completing in one of the final places while racing in the Varl Circuit, the Xexto podracer and a Fosh were dragged away by enforcers and subsequently fed to the Kayfoundo Kapa that resided on Black Rock.

A Squib worked as a podracer in the galaxy during the Republic Era. After completing in last place while racing on the second day in the Varl Circuit, the Squib podracer was dragged away by enforcers and subsequently fed to the Kayfoundo Kapa that resided on Black Rock.

Romtok was an Ithorian who worked as a salvage tow captain while on the moon Black Rock. After being confronted by a battle droid who wanted a datadisc from them, Romtok swallowed the disc so the droid would not obtain it.
A Force-sensitive man served the Galactic Empire as an Inquisitor, though he was once a Jedi of the Jedi Order.
Razze Colbra was a male Twi'lek. He was the leader of Clan Colbra
A human enslaver operated a moisture farm on the desert planet Tatooine using enslaved workers including Amee, Melee, and Seek.

A human thief operated on the planet Tatooine between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. With two accomplices, they killed a vendor for an energy capsule and then sought out the pair who had sold it to him, Kitster Banai and Wald.
A human vendor worked in a settlement on the desert planet Tatooine and knew Kitster Banai, who had escaped enslavement on the world with the Rodian Wald.

Sillin was a Quarren who played Sabacc and became a reigning champion on their homeworld. In 3 ABY, the gambler played in Sheriff Quint Cresadde's Sabacc parlor in the town of Wayfar on the planet Tatooine, eventually losing to the thief Kay Vess in a game with Cressade and th…

Clave Rollek was an alien pirate who was based at Yarrum Tower during the High Republic Era. He befriended the lost Jedi youngling Bren from Tenoo, who accidentally stowed aboard a starship bound for Yarrum.

Hudi was a Twi'lek scrapper who owned a mechanic's store called Hudi's Depot on the planet Yarrum during the High Republic Era. They had a GNK-series power droid named DV. Hudi had a testy relationship with the pirate Clave Rollek, who had a reputation for dishonesty.
Zaph Mora was a Zeltron male Jedi who was the Padawan of Jedi Master Eve Byre during the High Republic Era. A quiet but confident and considerate individual, Mora appreciated everything around him.

Carticus was an individual who tutored Sicarus during his time as a member of the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door dark side organization.

A human individual was a member of the Nihil marauders and was stationed at a base on the moon Astenban in 228 BBY. After complaining there was nothing to eat on Astenban, the Nihil spotted the Banchiian Shosho, who was performing reconnaissance on the moon.

Zade Winstone was a musician who had performed the song "Warm Jungle, Cold Heart" by 3 ABY. The song's cover art featured Winstone's name written prominently in Aurebesh above a member of the Quarren species.

A humanoid individual was a member of the Nihil marauders. In 229 BBY, they were stationed at a base on the moon Astenban that the Nihil had recently occupied. On the moon, another Nihil complained to them that there was nothing to eat there.

Shukko was a musician who had performed the song "Nightmares and Daydreams" by 3 ABY. That year, their song "Nightmares and Daydreams" could be selected on jukeboxes in the Outer Rim's Toshaal system.
Uvi Yessira was a musician who performed the song "Wings of Time." By 3 ABY, "Wings of Time" could be selected from the jukebox at the Domak Refectory on the Mid Rim planet Kijimi.
Ashton Vol was a female mercenary active during the High Republic Era who worked alongside the combat droid L-77.

Dorian Innes was a trans male medical officer in the Republic Defense Coalition during the High Republic Era. He was assigned on a Republic and Jedi Order mission to the planet Angoth to capture one of the Nameless creatures from the Nihil marauders.
Peleg Ryn was a Force-sensitive Noghri who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Remla Moonis was a Weequay musician. During 3 ABY, he was the drummer for the band Skungy Gungus and the Refractors.
Jenneh Ley was a Force-sensitive human female who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Inith Lowera was a Force-sensitive Pantoran female who served as a Jedi of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era.
Rynn Zenat was a human female pilot and officer for the Alliance to Restore the Republic and later its successor, the New Republic.

Preeti Delmin was a human pilot of the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. Following the Battle of Endor, Preeti and Rynn Zenat fought against Imperial TIE fighters in the Anoat sector.
Threeka was a Tholothian female member of the Nihil marauders during the High Republic Era. She was stationed at the Nihil base on the planet Angoth.
